chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Kungani kufanele ufunde nge-ecology? Mhlawumbe unesithakazelo sokufunda ngezwe lemvelo nokuthi izinto eziphilayo ziye zazivumelanisa kanjani nezimo zomzimba zendawo yazo. Noma, mhlawumbe ungudokotela wesikhathi esizayo ofuna ukuqonda ukuxhumana phakathi kwempilo yabantu kanye ne-ecology.

 Abantu bayingxenye yendawo yemvelo, futhi impilo yabantu yingxenye ebalulekile yokusebenzisana kwabantu nendawo yethu engokwenyama nephilayo. Isifo se-Lyme, isibonelo, sisebenza njengesibonelo esisodwa sanamuhla sokuxhumana phakathi kwempilo yethu nomhlaba wemvelo (Isithombe 35.1). Esaziwa kakhulu ngokuthi i-Lyme borreliosis, isifo se-Lyme siwukutheleleka kwamagciwane okungadluliselwa kubantu uma kulunywa yi-deer tick (Ixodes scapularis), okuyiyona vector eyinhloko yalesi sifo. Kodwa-ke, akuwona wonke ama-deer tick aphethe amabhaktheriya azobangela isifo se-Lyme kubantu, kanti i-I. scapularis ingaba nezinye izidalwa ngaphandle kwezinyamazane. Eqinisweni, kuvela ukuthi amathuba okutheleleka ancike ohlotsheni lomnikazi lapho ikhikhi likhula khona: inani elikhulu lamakhikhi ahlala kumagundane anezinyawo ezimhlophe athwala igciwane kunekhikhi ahlala ezinyamazaneni. Ulwazi mayelana nezindawo kanye nobuningi babantu lapho izinhlobo zomnikazi ziningi khona lungasiza udokotela noma isazi sezifo ezithathelwanayo ukuqonda kangcono ukuthi isifo seLyme sidluliselwa kanjani nokuthi ukusabalala kwaso kungancishiswa kanjani.

 Isibonelo, ubusika obuthambile enyakatho-mpumalanga phakathi kuka-2010-2011 babangela ukwanda kwama-acorn, okwabangela ukwanda kwenani lamagundane anezinyawo ezimhlophe. Kodwa-ke, ubusika obulandelayo babupholile, okwaholela ekuncipheni kwama-acorn, kanti ukwehla okulandelayo kwenani lamagundane kusho ukuthi amakhikhi azoba namathuba amaningi okufuna abantu ukuze badle igazi labo.
question1: Kungani i-ecology ibalulekile empilweni yabantu?
answer1: Kuyasiza ukuchaza ukuthi ukusebenzisana phakathi kwabantu nendawo ezungezile kuthinta kanjani izifo kanye nempilo
distractor1b: Ifunda umlando wesimo sezulu soMhlaba kuphela
question2: Yini ebangela isifo seLyme?
answer2: Ukutheleleka ngamagciwane okudluliselwa ngamakhizane anegciwane
question3: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.1. Yisiphi isidalwa esiyinhloko esibangela isifo seLyme?
answer3: I-Ixodes scapularis (ikhakha lezinyamazane)
question4: Kungani amagundane anezinyawo ezimhlophe ebalulekile emvelweni yesifo saseLyme?
answer4: Amakhizane adla amagundane anezinyawo ezimhlophe cishe athwala igciwane lesifo saseLyme
distractor4a: Amagundane anezinyawo ezimhlophe aqeda igciwane lesifo saseLyme
distractor4b: Amagundane anezinyawo ezimhlophe avimbela amakhizane ukuthi angadli abantu
distractor4c: Amagundane anezinyawo ezimhlophe yiwona kuphela aphethe amakhizane ezinyamazane
question5: Ulwazi lwezemvelo lungasiza kanjani ekunciphiseni ukwanda kwesifo seLyme?
answer5: Ngokuqonda izindawo kanye nobuningi bezinhlobo zezilwane ezithwalayo ezithinta ukutheleleka kwamakhizane
question6: Yisiphi isenzakalo semvelo esabangela ukwanda kwenani lamagundane anezinyawo ezimhlophe phakathi kuka-2010–2011?
answer6: Ubusika obuthambile baholela ekukhuleni kwama-acorn, okunikeza ukudla okwengeziwe kwamagundane
distractor6b: Iqhwa elikhulu laqeda izilwane ezidla ezinye izimpuku
distractor6c: Ukwanda kwenani lezinyamazane kunikeze izindawo eziningi zokuzalela
question7: Kungani amakhizane ayevame ukufuna abantu ngemva kobusika obubandayo obulandelayo?
answer7: Ukuncipha kwama-acorn kuholele ekutheni kube namagundane amancane anezinyawo ezimhlophe, okwenza amakhizane afune ezinye izidalwa ezihlala kuwo njengabantu
distractor7a: Abantu baba yizivakashi ezikhethwayo ngoba izinyamazane zanyamalala
distractor7b: Amazinga okushisa apholile abangela ukuba amakhizane ayeke ukudla izilwane
distractor7c: Igciwane lesifo saseLyme lingaphila kuphela kubantu

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.1 Ububanzi be-Ecology | Ukuxhumana kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.1 Ububanzi be-Ecology | Ukuxhumana kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
I-Ecology isifundo sokusebenzisana phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezikuyo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo zezinhlobo ezifanayo kanye naphakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene. Umgomo oyinhloko we-ecology ukuqonda ukusatshalaliswa kanye nobuningi bezinto eziphilayo ezihlala eMhlabeni. I-Ecology ihlanganisa izifundo eziningi zesayensi ngaphezu kwe-tBiology..., kufaka phakathi i-molecular biology, i-physiology, ukuziphendukela kwemvelo, ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo, i-geology, kanye nesimo sezulu. Olunye ucwaningo lwe-ecology lusebenzisa nezici ze-chemistry kanye ne-physics, futhi luvame ukusebenzisa amamodeli ezibalo.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 4 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nenye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 4
Izinhlelo ze-biological ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezicini eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nendawo yazo kuphumela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.15 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo ezibonakalayo ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi ukukhombisa ukuthi ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo yazo kuphumela kanjani ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla
question1: Kuyini i-ecology?
answer1: Ucwaningo lokuxhumana phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezizungezile
question2: Yibuphi ubudlelwano obufundwayo emvelweni?
answer2: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo zohlobo olufanayo, izinhlobo ezahlukene, kanye nendawo ezizungezile
distractor2a: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwamalungu ohlobo olufanayo kuphela
distractor2b: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezilwane ezidla ezinye kanye nezilwane ezidla ezinye kuphela
distractor2c: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nesimo sezulu kuphela
question3: Iyini inhloso eyodwa eyinhloko ye-ecology?
answer3: Ukuqonda ukusabalala kanye nobuningi bezinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni
distractor3a: Ukuhlukanisa zonke izinto eziphilayo zibe yimibuso
question4: Yimiphi imikhakha yesayensi efaka isandla ocwaningweni lwezemvelo?
answer4: Ibhayoloji, i-molecular biology, i-physiology, ukuziphendukela kwemvelo, ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo, i-geology, kanye nesimo sezulu
question5: Yiziphi isayensi ezengeziwe ezivame ukusetshenziswa ocwaningweni lwezemvelo?
answer5: Ikhemistri, ifiziksi, kanye nokumodela kwezibalo
question6: Ngokusho kwe-AP® Biology Big Idea 4, yini ebangelwa ukusebenzisana kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezizungezile?
answer6: Ukuhamba kwezinto kanye namandla
question7: Yini egcizelelwa yi-AP® Biology Learning Objective 4.15?
answer7: Ukusebenzisa izethulo ezibonakalayo ukuhlaziya indlela ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezizungezile okuholela ngayo ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla
distractor7a: Ukukhumbula amagama esayensi azo zonke izinto eziphilayo
distractor7c: Ukuchaza izigaba zokuphefumula kwamaseli kusuka enkumbulweni

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.1 Ububanzi be-Ecology | Amazinga Ocwaningo Lwe-Ecology
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.1 Ububanzi be-Ecology | Amazinga Ocwaningo Lwe-Ecology
chapterContent: Uma kufundwa isifundo esinjenge-biology, kuvame ukusiza ukusihlukanisa sibe yizindawo ezincane, ezihlobene. Isibonelo, izazi zebhayoloji zamaseli ezinentshisekelo ekuboniseni amaseli zidinga ukuqonda ikhemistri yama-molecule esignali (okuvame ukuba amaprotheni) kanye nomphumela wokubonisa amaseli. Izazi zebhayoloji ezinentshisekelo ezintweni ezithinta ukusinda kwezinhlobo ezisengozini zingasebenzisa amamodeli ezibalo ukubikezela ukuthi imizamo yamanje yokulondoloza ithinta kanjani izinto eziphilayo ezisengozini. Ukuze kukhiqizwe isethi enengqondo yezinketho zokuphatha, isazi sebhayoloji yokulondoloza sidinga ukuqoqa idatha enembile, kufaka phakathi usayizi wabantu bamanje, izinto ezithinta ukuzala (njenge-physiology nokuziphatha), izidingo zendawo yokuhlala (njengezitshalo nomhlabathi), kanye nethonya labantu elingaba khona kubantu abasengozini kanye nendawo yabo yokuhlala (okungatholakala ngezifundo ze-sociology kanye ne-urban ecology). Ngaphakathi kwesifundo se-ecology, abacwaningi basebenza emazingeni amane athile, ngezinye izikhathi ngokuhlukile futhi ngezinye izikhathi ngokuhambisana: izinto eziphilayo, abantu, umphakathi, kanye ne-ecosystem (Isithombe 35.2)
question1: Kungani i-biology ivame ukuhlukaniswa ngezindawo ezincane ezihlobene nezifundo?
answer1: Ukuvumela ososayensi ukuthi bagxile ezihlokweni ezithile ngenkathi behlanganisa ulwazi oluvela emikhakheni ehlobene
distractor1a: Ukuqeda isidingo socwaningo oluhlanganisa imikhakha eyahlukene
question2: Kungani izazi zebhayoloji zamaseli ezifunda ngokudluliselwa kwezimpawu zamaseli kufanele ziqonde ikhemistri?
answer2: Ngoba ama-molecule okubonisa izimpawu ngokuvamile amaprotheni anezakhiwo zamakhemikhali ezithinta ukuxhumana kwamaseli
distractor2b: Ngoba i-chemistry inquma inani lama-chromosome esitokisini
distractor2c: Ngoba amaprotheni awakwazi ukuhlanganyela ekudluliseleni kwesignali yamaseli
question3: Kungani izazi zemvelo zingasebenzisa amamodeli ezibalo lapho zifunda ngezinhlobo ezisengozini yokuqothulwa?
answer3: Ukubikezela ukuthi imizamo yokulondoloza ingathinta kanjani ukusinda kwemiphakathi esengozini
distractor3a: Ukuthola yonke into ephilayo endaweni ezungezile
distractor3b: Ukulinganisa ukulandelana kwe-DNA yezinhlobo ezisengozini yokuqothulwa
question4: Yisiphi isici esibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuphatha ukongiwa kwemvelo ezisebenzayo?
answer4: Ukuqoqa idatha enembile ngobukhulu benani labantu, ukuzala, izidingo zendawo yokuhlala, kanye nethonya labantu
distractor4a: Ukufunda kuphela izakhi zofuzo zezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane
distractor4b: Ukugxila kuphela esimweni sezulu ngaphandle kokucabangela izinto eziphilayo
distractor4c: Ukungazinaki izimo zendawo yokuhlala kanye nemisebenzi yabantu
question5: Yimiphi imikhakha ngaphandle kwebhayoloji engaba negalelo ocwaningweni lokulondolozwa kwemvelo?
answer5: Isayensi yezenhlalo kanye nemvelo yasemadolobheni
question6: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.2. Yiziphi amazinga amane ocwaningo lwezemvelo?
answer6: Izinto eziphilayo, inani labantu, umphakathi, kanye nesimiso sezinto eziphilayo
question7: Izazi zemvelo zivame ukufunda kanjani amazinga amane okuhleleka kwemvelo?
answer7: Bangazifunda ngokwehlukana noma ngokuhambisana kuye ngombuzo wocwaningo
distractor7a: Bahlala befunda izinga elilodwa kuphela bebodwa ngokuphelele
distractor7b: Bafunda kuphela ngezinhlelo zemvelo ngoba amanye amazinga awasizi ngalutho
distractor7c: Bafunda kuphela imiphakathi futhi bangazinaki izinto eziphilayo kanye nemiphakathi

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.1 Ububanzi be-Ecology | I-Ecology yezinto eziphilayo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.1 Ububanzi be-Ecology | I-Ecology yezinto eziphilayo
chapterContent:
Abacwaningi abafunda nge-ecology ezingeni lezinto eziphilayo banesithakazelo ekuzivumelaniseni okuvumela abantu ukuba bahlale ezindaweni ezithile zokuhlala. Lokhu kuzivumelanisa kungaba ngokwesimo somzimba, ngokomzimba, kanye nokuziphatha. Isibonelo, uvemvane oluluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka i-Karner (Lycaeides melissa samuelis) (Isithombe 35.3) lubhekwa njengochwepheshe ngoba abesifazane bakhetha ukubeka amaqanda ku-lupine yasendle. Lokhu kuzivumelanisa okhethekile kusho ukuthi uvemvane oluluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka i-Karner luncike kakhulu ekubeni khona kwezitshalo ze-lupine zasendle ukuze luqhubeke luphila.

 Ngemva kokuchamisela, izibungu ezisakhula ziyavela futhi zichithe amasonto amane kuya kwayisithupha zidla kuphela i-lupine yasendle (Isithombe 35.4). Izibungu ziyathuthuka (zishintsha ukwakheka kwazo) futhi zivele njengezimvemvane ngemva kwamasonto amane. Izimvemvane ezindala zidla umpe wezimbali ze-lupine yasendle nezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo. Umcwaningi onesifiso sokufunda ngezimvemvane eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka zaseKarner ezingeni lezinto eziphilayo, ngaphezu kokubuza imibuzo mayelana nokubeka amaqanda, angase abuze imibuzo mayelana nokushisa okukhethwa yizimvemvane (umbuzo womzimba) noma ukuziphatha kwezimvemvane lapho zisezigabeni ezahlukene zezibungu (umbuzo wokuziphatha)
question1: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko ye-ecology yezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Ukuguquguquka okuvumela izinto eziphilayo ngazinye ukuthi zihlale ezindaweni ezithile zokuhlala
question2: Yiziphi izinhlobo zokuzivumelanisa nezimo ezifundwayo emvelweni yezinto eziphilayo?
answer2: Ukuguquguquka kwesimo somzimba, okomzimba, kanye nokuziphatha
distractor2a: Ukuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo, kwezemvelo, kanye nesimo sezulu
question3: Bheka Umfanekiso 35.3. Kungani uvemvane oluluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka iKarner lubhekwa njengochwepheshe?
answer3: Abesifazane bakhetha ukubeka amaqanda abo ezitshalweni zasendle ze-lupine
distractor3a: Idla amaqabunga emithi kuphela impilo yayo yonke
distractor3b: Ingaphila kahle ngokulinganayo kunoma iyiphi indawo yokuhlala
distractor3c: Ibekela amaqanda ezinhlotsheni eziningi zezitshalo ezahlukene
question4: Kungani uvemvane oluluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka iKarner luthembele kakhulu ku-lupine yasendle?
answer4: Ukuzala kwayo kanye nokukhula kwayo okusanhlamvu kuncike ekubeni khona kwezitshalo zasendle ze-lupine
distractor4a: I-Wild lupine iwukuphela komthombo wayo wamanzi
distractor4b: I-Wild lupine ivikela izimvemvane ezindala ezidla ezinye izilwane
distractor4c: I-Wild lupine inikeza indawo yokukhosela kuphela ebusika
question5: Bheka Isithombe 35.4. Zidlani izibungu ze-Karner blue butterfly ngemva kokuchamisela?
answer5: Zidla kuphela i-lupine yasendle
question6: Yini edla kakhulu izimvemvane ezindala eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka i-Karner?
answer6: Umpe wezimbali ze-lupine zasendle nezinye izitshalo eziqhakazayo
question7: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sombuzo wezinto eziphilayo isazi sezinto eziphilayo esingawufunda mayelana novemvane oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka i-Karner?
answer7: Yizinga lokushisa elingakanani ama-butterflies athandayo
distractor7b: Indlela izakhamzimba ezijikeleza ngayo ohlelweni lwe-ecosystem
distractor7c: Indlela isimo sezulu esithinta ngayo ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo emhlabeni jikelele
question8: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sombuzo wokuziphatha mayelana novemvane oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka i-Karner?
answer8: Indlela ukuziphatha kwesibungu okushintsha ngayo phakathi nezigaba ezahlukene zesibungu
distractor8a: Indlela i-carbon dioxide esemoyeni ethinta ngayo i-photosynthesis
distractor8b: Indlela amaminerali enhlabathi ajikeleza ngayo ezindaweni zemvelo
distractor8c: Indlela ubuningi babantu obushintsha ngayo phakathi namakhulu eminyaka

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.1 Ububanzi be-Ecology | I-Population Ecology
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.1 Ububanzi be-Ecology | I-Population Ecology
chapterContent: Isibalo sabantu yiqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezizalana ezingamalungu ohlobo olufanayo ezihlala endaweni efanayo ngesikhathi esifanayo. (Izinto eziphilayo ezingamalungu ohlobo olufanayo zibizwa ngokuthi ama-conspecific.) Isibalo sabantu sibonakala, ngokwengxenye, lapho sihlala khona, futhi indawo yaso yabantu ingaba nemingcele yemvelo noma yokwenziwa: imingcele yemvelo ingaba imifula, izintaba, noma amahlane, kuyilapho izibonelo zemingcele yokwenziwa zifaka utshani obugundiwe, izakhiwo ezenziwe ngabantu, noma imigwaqo. Ucwaningo lwe-population ecology lugxile enanini labantu endaweni nokuthi kanjani futhi kungani usayizi wabantu ushintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Izazi zemvelo zabantu zinesithakazelo esikhulu ekubaleni uvemvane oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka i-Karner, isibonelo, ngoba luhlukaniswa njengolusengozini yokuqothulwa nguhulumeni. Kodwa-ke, ukusabalala kanye nobuningi balolu hlobo kuthonywa kakhulu ukusabalala kanye nobuningi be-lupine yasendle. Abacwaningi bangase babuze imibuzo mayelana nezici eziholela ekuncipheni kwe-lupine yasendle nokuthi lezi zithinta kanjani izimvemvane eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka i-Karner. Isibonelo, izazi zemvelo ziyazi ukuthi i-lupine yasendle ichuma ezindaweni ezivulekile lapho izihlahla nezihlahla zingekho khona kakhulu. Ezindaweni zemvelo, imililo yasendle eyenzeka ngezikhathi ezithile isusa njalo izihlahla nezihlahla, okusiza ekugcineni izindawo ezivulekile ezidingwa yi-lupine yasendle. Amamodeli ezibalo angasetshenziswa ukuqonda ukuthi ukucindezelwa komlilo wasendle ngabantu kuholele kanjani ekuweni kwalesi sitshalo esibalulekile ku-butterfly blue karner.
question1: Iyini inani labantu ku-ecology?
answer1: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezizalanayo zohlobo olufanayo ezihlala endaweni efanayo ngesikhathi esifanayo
distractor1a: Zonke izinto eziphilayo ezihlala endaweni efanayo
distractor1c: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezingahlobene ezihlala ezindaweni ezahlukene
question2: Zibizwa ngokuthini izinto eziphilayo ezingohlobo olufanayo?
answer2: Okuqondile
question3: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo somngcele wemvelo wabantu?
answer3: Umfula
question4: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko ye-population ecology?
answer4: Inani labantu emphakathini nokuthi kanjani futhi kungani usayizi wabantu ushintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
question5: Kungani izazi zemvelo zabantu zinesifiso sokubala izimvemvane eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka zaseKarner?
answer5: Ngoba lolu hlobo lusengozini yokuqothulwa nguhulumeni
distractor5a: Ngoba yilona uhlobo lwebhabhathane olutholakala kakhulu
distractor5c: Ngoba ayinazo izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane zemvelo
question6: Kungani ukusabalala kanye nobuningi bezimvemvane eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka zaseKarner kuhlobene kakhulu ne-lupine yasendle?
answer6: I-wild lupine ibalulekile ekuzaleni nasekukhuleni kwama-larvae
distractor6a: I-Wild lupine ivikela izimvemvane ezindala ezidla ezinye izilwane
distractor6b: I-Wild lupine iwukuphela komthombo wabo wamanzi
distractor6c: I-wild lupine iheha izinhlobo ze-butterfly ezincintisanayo
question7: Kungani i-lupine yasendle ichuma ezindaweni ezivulekile?
answer7: Ngoba izihlahla nezihlahla azikho kakhulu
distractor7a: Ngoba amahlathi aminyene anikeza ukukhanya kwelanga okwengeziwe
distractor7b: Ngoba ikhula kahle kakhulu emthunzini ojulile
question8: Imililo yasendle yemvelo izuzisa kanjani izihlahla zasendle ze-lupine?
answer8: Basusa izihlahla nezihlahla, balondoloze indawo yokuhlala evulekile edingwa yi-lupine yasendle
question9: Ukucinywa komlilo wasendle ngabantu kuye kwawuthinta kanjani uvemvane oluluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka iKarner?
answer9: Kuye kwaba nomthelela ekunciphiseni kwe-lupine yasendle, kwanciphisa indawo yokuhlala efanele ivemvane
distractor9a: Ikhulise inani le-lupine yasendle kuyo yonke indawo yayo yokuhlala

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.1 Ububanzi be-Ecology | I-Ecology yomphakathi
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.1 Ububanzi be-Ecology | I-Ecology yomphakathi
chapterContent:
Umphakathi wezinto eziphilayo uqukethe izinhlobo ezahlukene endaweni, ngokuvamile isikhala esinezinhlangothi ezintathu, kanye nokusebenzisana ngaphakathi naphakathi kwalezi zinhlobo. Izazi zemvelo zomphakathi zinentshisekelo ezinqubweni eziqhuba lokhu kuxhumana kanye nemiphumela yako. Imibuzo mayelana nokusebenzisana okuqondile ivame ukugxila ekuncintisaneni phakathi kwamalungu ezinhlobo ezifanayo ukuze kutholakale imithombo elinganiselwe. Izazi zemvelo nazo zifunda ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene; amalungu ezinhlobo ezahlukene abizwa ngokuthi ama-heterospecifics. Izibonelo zokuxhumana okuhlukile zifaka phakathi ukudla ezinye izilwane, ama-parasitism, ukhula lwezitshalo, ukuncintisana, kanye nokuvundisa impova. Lokhu kuxhumana kungaba nemiphumela elawulayo ngobukhulu benani labantu futhi kungathinta izinqubo zemvelo kanye nokuziphendukela kwemvelo ezithinta ukuhlukahluka.

 Isibonelo, izibungu ze-butterfly eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka zaseKarner zakha ubudlelwano bokubambisana nezintuthwane. I-Mutualism uhlobo lobuhlobo besikhathi eside oluye lwavela phakathi kwezinhlobo ezimbili futhi lapho uhlobo ngalunye luzuza khona. Ukuze i-mutualism ibe khona phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ngazinye, uhlobo ngalunye kumele luthole inzuzo ethile kolunye ngenxa yobudlelwano. Abacwaningi bakhombisile ukuthi kukhona ukwanda kwamathuba okusinda lapho izibungu ze-butterfly eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka zaseKarner (izibungu) zinakekelwa yizintuthwane. Lokhu kungenzeka ngoba izibungu zichitha isikhathi esincane esigabeni ngasinye sokuphila lapho zinakekelwa izintuthwane, okunikeza inzuzo izibungu. Okwamanje, izibungu ze-butterfly eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka zaseKarner zikhipha into ecebile ngama-carbohydrate engumthombo wamandla obalulekile wezintuthwane. Zombili izibungu eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka zaseKarner kanye nezintuthwane ziyazuza ekusebenzisaneni kwazo.
question1: Uyini umphakathi wezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Izinhlobo ezahlukene ezihlala endaweni kanye nokusebenzisana ngaphakathi naphakathi kwalezo zinhlobo
distractor1a: Inani labantu bohlobo olulodwa oluhlala endaweni eyodwa
distractor1c: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezinezakhi zofuzo ezifanayo
question2: Yini izazi zemvelo zomphakathi eziyifundayo ngokuyinhloko?
answer2: Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlobo kanye nezinqubo kanye nemiphumela yalokho kuxhumana
question3: Zibizwa ngokuthini izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane?
answer3: I-Heterospecific
question4: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sokusebenzisana okungafani?
answer4: Ukuzingelwa
question5: Ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene kungathinta kanjani imvelo?
answer5: Zingalawula ubukhulu babantu futhi zithonye izinqubo zemvelo kanye nokuziphendukela kwemvelo ezithinta ukuhlukahluka
distractor5b: Zivimbela abantu ukuthi bashintshe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
question6: Uhlobo luni lobudlelwano olukhona phakathi kwezibungu ze-butterfly eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ze-Karner kanye nezintuthwane?
answer6: Ukubambisana
question7: Kungani izibungu ze-Karner blue butterfly zizuza ngokunakekelwa yizintuthwane?
answer7: Amathuba abo okusinda ayanda ngoba bachitha isikhathi esincane esigabeni ngasinye sokuphila
question8: Izintuthwane zizuza kanjani ebudlelwaneni bazo obuhambisanayo nezimpungushe ze-Karner blue butterfly?
answer8: Izibungu zikhipha into ecebile ngama-carbohydrate esebenza njengomthombo wamandla ezintuthwane
distractor8a: Izibungu zivikela izintuthwane ezidla ezinye izilwane

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.1 Ububanzi be-Ecology | I-Ecology ye-Ecology
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.1 Ububanzi be-Ecology | I-Ecology ye-Ecology
chapterContent:
I-ecology yesistimu yezemvelo iyisandiso se-ecology yezinto eziphilayo, inani labantu, kanye nomphakathi. I-ecosystem yakhiwe yizo zonke izingxenye ze-biotic (izinto eziphilayo) endaweni kanye nezingxenye ze-abiotic (izinto ezingaphili) zaleyo ndawo. Ezinye zezingxenye ze-abiotic zifaka umoya, amanzi, kanye nomhlabathi. Izazi ze-ecosystem zibuza imibuzo mayelana nokuthi izakhamzimba namandla zigcinwa kanjani nokuthi zihamba kanjani phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nomoya ozungezile, inhlabathi, kanye namanzi.

 Izimvemvane eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka zaseKarner kanye ne-lupine yasendle zihlala endaweni yokuhlala engenalutho ye-oak-pine. Le ndawo yokuhlala ibonakala ngokuphazamiseka kwemvelo kanye nenhlabathi engenazo izakhamzimba ene-nitrogen eningi. Ukutholakala kwezakhamzimba kuyisici esibalulekile ekusatshalalisweni kwezitshalo ezihlala kule ndawo yokuhlala. Abacwaningi abanentshisekelo ku-ecosystem yesistimu yezemvelo bangabuza imibuzo mayelana nokubaluleka kwezinsizakusebenza ezilinganiselwe kanye nokuhamba kwezinsizakusebenza, njengezakhamzimba, yize izingxenye ze-biotic kanye ne-abiotic zesistimu yezemvelo
question1: Iyini i-ecosystem?
answer1: Zonke izingxenye ze-biotic kanye ne-abiotic endaweni ethile
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyingxenye yezinto eziphilayo ohlelweni lwemvelo?
answer2: Izitshalo
question3: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyingxenye engeyona i-abiotic ye-ecosystem?
answer3: Inhlabathi
question4: Yini efundwa yizazi zemvelo?
answer4: Indlela izakhamzimba namandla okugcinwa futhi ahamba ngayo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezungezile
distractor4c: Ukwehlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kuphela phakathi kwabantu
question5: Hlobo luni lwezindawo zokuhlala ezihlala izimvemvane eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka zaseKarner kanye ne-lupine yasendle?
answer5: Indawo yokuhlala engenalutho ye-oki-pine
question6: Yiziphi izici zendawo yokuhlala engenamithi ye-oki-pine?
answer6: Ukuphazamiseka kwemvelo kanye nenhlabathi engenazo izakhamzimba enomsoco ophansi ku-nitrogen
distractor6a: Inhlabathi ecebile ene-nitrogen eningi kanye nokuphazamiseka okuncane
distractor6c: Inhlabathi evundile ejulile enezitshalo eziminyene zemvula
question7: Kungani ukutholakala kwezakhamzimba kubalulekile endaweni ezungezile?
answer7: Kuthinta ukusabalala kwezitshalo ezihlala lapho
question8: Yiziphi izinhlobo zemibuzo ezingabuzwa ososayensi bezinto eziphilayo mayelana nendawo yokuhlala yamavemvane aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka aseKarner?
answer8: Indlela izinsizakusebenza kanye nezakhamzimba ezilinganiselwe ezihamba ngayo ezingxenyeni eziphilayo kanye nezingaphilayo ze-ecosystem
distractor8a: Indlela yokuhlukanisa izimvemvane zibe izinhlobo ezintsha
distractor8b: Indlela izimvemvane ngazinye ezikhetha ngayo abangane
distractor8c: Indlela izinombolo ze-chromosome ezishintsha ngayo ngesikhathi se-mitosis

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.1 Ububanzi be-Ecology | Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi | Isazi Se-Ecology
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.1 Ububanzi be-Ecology | Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi | Isazi Se-Ecology
chapterContent: Umsebenzi we-ecology unegalelo ezicini eziningi zomphakathi wesintu. Ukuqonda izinkinga zemvelo kungasiza umphakathi uhlangabezane nezidingo eziyisisekelo zabantu zokudla, indawo yokuhlala, kanye nokunakekelwa kwempilo. Izazi zemvelo zingenza ucwaningo lwazo elabhorethri nangaphandle ezindaweni zemvelo (Isithombe 35.5). Lezi zindawo zemvelo zingaba seduze nekhaya njengomfula ogeleza ekhampasi yakho noma kude njengemigodi yamanzi ashisayo phansi koLwandlekazi iPacific. Izazi zemvelo ziphatha izinsiza zemvelo njengezilwane ezihlala emahlathini amhlophe (i-Odocoileus virginianus) zokuzingela noma i-aspen (Populus spp.) ezimele ukukhiqiza iphepha. Izazi zemvelo zisebenza njengabafundisi abafundisa izingane nabantu abadala ezikhungweni ezahlukene okuhlanganisa amanyuvesi, izikole zamabanga aphezulu, iminyuziyamu, kanye nezikhungo zemvelo. Izazi zemvelo zingasebenza nasezikhundleni zokweluleka zisiza abenzi benqubomgomo bendawo, besifundazwe, kanye nohulumeni ukuthuthukisa imithetho ehambisana nemvelo, noma zingase zithuthukise lezo zinqubomgomo kanye nemithetho ngokwabo. Ukuze ube yisazi semvelo kudinga iziqu ze-undergraduate, ngokuvamile kwisayensi yemvelo. Iziqu ze-undergraduate zivame ukulandelwa ukuqeqeshwa okukhethekile noma iziqu ezithuthukisiwe, kuye ngendawo ekhethiwe ye-ecology. Izazi zemvelo kufanele futhi zibe nobubanzi obuphelele kg kwisayensi yemvelo, kanye nesisekelo esiqinile kwizibalo kanye nezibalo.
question1: Umsebenzi wezazi zemvelo uwuzuzisa kanjani umphakathi wesintu?
answer1: Ngokusiza umphakathi uhlangabezane nezidingo ezifana nokudla, indawo yokuhlala, kanye nokunakekelwa kwempilo ngokuqonda izinkinga zemvelo
question2: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.5. Izazi zemvelo zivame ukwenza kuphi ucwaningo lwazo?
answer2: Kokubili ezindaweni zokucwaninga kanye nasezindaweni zemvelo
question3: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sendawo yemvelo lapho izazi zemvelo zingasebenza khona?
answer3: Imigodi yomoya engaphansi kolwandle iPacific
question4: Yiziphi izinsiza zemvelo ezingaphathwa ososayensi bezinto eziphilayo?
answer4: Izinhlobo zezinyamazane ezinemisila emhlophe kanye nezindawo zokhuni ze-aspen
distractor4a: Izinhlobo zezinja zezilwane ezifuywayo kanye nezingadi zasekhaya
question5: Ngaphandle kokwenza ucwaningo, iyiphi indima enayo izazi eziningi zemvelo?
answer5: Bafundisa abafundi kanye nomphakathi emanyuvesi, ezikoleni, eminyuziyamu nasezikhungweni zemvelo
distractor5b: Baphatha kuphela izindawo zokugcina izilwane zasendle
question6: Izazi zemvelo zinikela kanjani enqubweni yezemvelo?
answer6: Beluleka abenzi bezinqubomgomo noma basize ekuthuthukiseni imithetho nemithetho evikela imvelo
question7: Yimuphi imfundo evame ukudingeka ukuze ube yisazi sezinto eziphilayo?
answer7: Iziqu ze-undergraduate kwisayensi yemvelo, ngokuvamile zilandelwa ukuqeqeshwa okukhethekile noma iziqu ezithuthukisiwe
question8: Yimaphi amakhono engeziwe abalulekile kososayensi bezinto eziphilayo?
answer8: I-bac kg eqinile kwisayensi yemvelo, izibalo, kanye nezibalo

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Amandla amaningi athonya imiphakathi yezinto eziphilayo ezikhona ezingxenyeni ezahlukene ze-biosphere (zonke izingxenye zoMhlaba ezihlalwa yizinto eziphilayo). I-biosphere idlulela emkhathini (amakhilogremu amaningana amamitha ngaphezu koMhlaba) nasekujuleni kolwandle. Naphezu kobukhulu bayo obubonakalayo kumuntu ngamunye, i-biosphere ithatha isikhala esincane kuphela uma iqhathaniswa nendawo yonke eyaziwayo. Amandla amaningi e-abiotic athonya lapho impilo ingaba khona kanye nezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezitholakala ezingxenyeni ezahlukene ze-biosphere. Izici ze-abiotic zithonya ukusatshalaliswa kwama-biomes: izindawo ezinkulu zomhlaba ezinesimo sezulu esifanayo, izitshalo, nezilwane.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zebhayoloji zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

Ukukhula kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla yesistimu yezinto eziphilayo kuthonywa izinguquko endaweni yesistimu.

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | I-Biogeography
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | I-Biogeography
chapterContent:
I-Biogeography isifundo sokusatshalaliswa kwendawo kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nezici ze-abiotic ezithinta ukusatshalaliswa kwazo. Izici ze-abiotic ezifana nokushisa kanye nemvula ziyahlukahluka ngokusekelwe ikakhulu ku-latitude kanye nokuphakama. Njengoba lezi zinto ze-abiotic zishintsha, ukwakheka kwemiphakathi yezitshalo nezilwane nakho kuyashintsha. Isibonelo, uma ubungaqala uhambo e-equator bese uhamba uye enyakatho, ubuzobona izinguquko kancane kancane emiphakathini yezitshalo. Ekuqaleni kohambo lwakho, ubuzobona amahlathi amanzi asezindaweni ezishisayo anezihlahla ezihlala ziluhlaza ezinamaqabunga abanzi, okuyizinto ezivamile emiphakathini yezitshalo etholakala eduze kwe-equator. Njengoba uqhubeka uhamba uye enyakatho, ubuzobona lezi zitshalo ezihlala ziluhlaza ezinamaqabunga abanzi ekugcineni ziveza amahlathi omile ngezikhathi ezithile anezihlahla ezihlakazekile. Ubuzoqala nokubona izinguquko ekushiseni nasekuswakameni. Cishe kuma-degrees angu-30 enyakatho, la mahlathi abezonika indawo amahlane, abonakala ngemvula encane.

 Uma uqhubeka enyakatho, ubuzobona ukuthi amahlane athathelwa indawo amahlane noma amadlelo. Ekugcineni, amahlane athathelwa indawo amahlathi anesimo sezulu esifudumele. La mahlathi anesimo sezulu esibandayo abe yindawo yamahlathi atholakala e-subarctic, indawo eseningizimu ye-Arctic Circle. Ekugcineni, uzofika e-Arctic tundra, etholakala ezindaweni ezisenyakatho kakhulu. Lolu hambo oluya enyakatho lwembula izinguquko ezincane esimweni sezulu kanye nezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo eziye zajwayela izici zemvelo ezihlobene nezindawo ezitholakala ezindaweni ezihlukene. Kodwa-ke, kunezindawo ezahlukene zemvelo endaweni efanayo ngenxa yezici ezingaphili njengemifudlana yejethi, iGulf Stream, kanye nemisinga yolwandle. Uma ubungakhuphuka intaba, izinguquko obungazibona ezitshalweni bezizofana nalezo njengoba uthuthela ezindaweni eziphakeme.

 Izazi zemvelo ezifunda i-biogeography zihlola amaphethini okusatshalaliswa kwezinhlobo. Azikho izinhlobo ezikhona yonke indawo; isibonelo, i-Venus flytrap itholakala endaweni encane eNyakatho naseNingizimu Carolina. Uhlobo olutholakala endaweni ethile lutholakala ngokwemvelo kuphela endaweni ethile evame ukulinganiselwa ngobukhulu. Ezinye izinhlobo zingabantu abavamile: izinhlobo ezihlala ezindaweni eziningi ezahlukene zezindawo; i-raccoon, isibonelo, ivela ezindaweni eziningi zaseNyakatho naseMelika Ephakathi.

 Amaphethini okusatshalaliswa kwezinhlobo asekelwe ezintweni eziphilayo kanye nezingaphilayo kanye nethonya lazo phakathi nesikhathi eside esidingekayo ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo kwezinhlobo; ngakho-ke, izifundo zokuqala ze-biogeography zazihlobene kakhulu nokuvela kokucabanga kokuziphendukela kwemvelo ngekhulu le-18. Ezinye zezinhlobo ezihluke kakhulu zezitshalo nezilwane zenzeka ezindaweni ezihlukaniswe ngokomzimba izigidi zeminyaka yizithiyo zendawo. Izazi zezinto eziphilayo zilinganisela ukuthi i-Australia, isibonelo, inezinhlobo zezitshalo nezilwane eziphakathi kuka-600,000 no-700,000. Cishe ingxenye yesithathu kwezine zezinhlobo zezitshalo nezilwane eziphilayo ziyizinhlobo ezitholakala e-Australia kuphela (Isithombe 35.6 a no-b).

 Ngezinye izikhathi izazi zemvelo zithola amaphethini ahlukile okusatshalaliswa kwezinhlobo ngokunquma ukuthi izinhlobo azitholakali kuphi. I-Hawaii, isibonelo, ayinazo izinhlobo zezilwane ezihuquzelayo noma izilwane ezihlala emanzini nasemanzini, futhi inesilwane esisodwa kuphela esincelisayo sasemhlabeni, ilulwane eliyimpunga. Iningi laseNew Guinea, njengenye isibonelo, alinazo izilwane ezincelisayo ezitholakala endaweni ye-placenta.

 Izitshalo zingaba yi-endemic noma i-generalist: izitshalo ezitholakala kuphela ezindaweni ezithile zoMhlaba, kuyilapho i-generalist zitholakala ezindaweni eziningi. Izindawo ezihlukanisiwe—njenge-Australia, iHawaii, neMadagascar—zivame ukuba nezinhlobo eziningi zezitshalo ezitholakalayo. Ezinye zalezi zitshalo zisengozini ngenxa yemisebenzi yabantu. I-forest gardenia (i-Gardenia brighamii), isibonelo, itholakala eHawaii; kulinganiselwa ukuthi kunezihlahla ezingu-15-20 kuphela okucatshangwa ukuthi zikhona (Isithombe 35.7)
question1: Kuyini i-biogeography?
answer1: Ucwaningo lokusatshalaliswa kwendawo kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nezici ze-abiotic ezithonya ukusatshalaliswa kwazo
question2: Yiziphi izinto ezingaphili ezithinta kakhulu ukusabalala kwezinto eziphilayo emhlabeni wonke?
answer2: Izinga lokushisa kanye nemvula, okuhlukahluka kakhulu ngokwe-latitude kanye nokuphakama
distractor2b: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokukhetha kwemvelo
question3: Njengoba uhamba usuka enyakatho usuka enkabazwe, iyiphi i-biome evame ukutholakala ngemva kwamahlathi omile ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka?
answer3: Amahlane
question4: Kungani kungaba khona izimiso zemvelo ezahlukene endaweni efanayo?
answer4: Ngoba izinto ezingaphili njengemifudlana yejethi, iGulf Stream, kanye nemisinga yolwandle kuthonya isimo sezulu
distractor4b: Ngoba zonke izimiso zemvelo ezise-latitude efanayo ziyafana
distractor4c: Ngoba ukusebenzisana kwezinto eziphilayo kuphela okunquma uhlobo lwe-ecosystem
question5: Luyini uhlobo olutholakala kalula?
answer5: Uhlobo olutholakala ngokwemvelo endaweni ethile kuphela
question6: Iyini uhlobo olujwayelekile?
answer6: Uhlobo oluhlala ezindaweni eziningi ezahlukene zezwe
question7: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.6. Kungani i-Australia inenani elikhulu kangaka lezinhlobo ezitholakala endaweni eyodwa?
answer7: Sekuyiminyaka eyizigidi zeminyaka ihlukanisiwe ngokwendawo
distractor7b: Ihlangabezana nesimo sezulu esifanayo yonke indawo
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende ngeHawaii esinembile?
answer8: Ayinazo izilwane ezihuquzelayo noma izilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini futhi inesilwane esisodwa kuphela esincelisayo sasemhlabeni, ilulwane eliyimpunga.
distractor8a: Inezilwane ezihuquzelayo eziningi kakhulu kunanoma yisiphi esinye isifunda
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.7. Kungani i-gardenia yamahlathi ibhekwa njengesengozini?
answer9: Kutholakala eHawaii futhi kulinganiselwa ukuthi kusele izihlahla ezingu-15-20 kuphela ngenxa yemisebenzi yabantu.
distractor9a: Itholakala emhlabeni wonke kodwa ayivamile ukuba nezimbali
distractor9b: Ikhula kuphela ezingwadule lapho kunemvula eningi khona

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | I-Biogeography | Imithombo Yamandla
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | I-Biogeography | Imithombo Yamandla
chapterContent:
Amandla avela elangeni abanjwa izitshalo eziluhlaza, ulwelwe, ama-cyanobacteria, kanye nama-photosynthetic protists. Lezi zinto eziphilayo ziguqula amandla elanga abe amandla amakhemikhali adingwa yizo zonke izinto eziphilayo. Ukutholakala kokukhanya kungaba amandla abalulekile athinta ngqo ukuvela kokuguquguquka kwe-photosynthesizers. Isibonelo, izitshalo ezingaphansi kwehlathi elinomoya opholile ziyafihlwa lapho izihlahla ezingaphezulu kwazo emphemeni ziphuma ngokuphelele ngasekupheleni kwentwasahlobo. Akumangalisi ukuthi izitshalo ezingaphansi kwendlu zinezindlela zokushintsha ukuze zibambe ngempumelelo ukukhanya okutholakalayo. Okunye ukuzivumelanisa okunjalo ukukhula okusheshayo kwezitshalo zesikhashana zasentwasahlobo njengobuhle bentwasahlobo (Isithombe 35.8). Lezi zimbali zasentwasahlobo zithola ukukhula kwazo okuningi futhi ziqede umjikelezo wazo wokuphila (zizala kabusha) ekuqaleni kwesizini ngaphambi kokuba izihlahla eziphezu kwendlu zikhule amaqabunga.

 Ezindaweni zemvelo zasemanzini, ukutholakala kokukhanya kungancishiswa ngoba ukukhanya kwelanga kumuncwa amanzi, izitshalo, izinhlayiya ezilengayo, kanye nezinambuzane eziphilayo. Ngaphansi kwechibi, echibini, noma olwandle, kunendawo ukukhanya okungenakuyifinyelela. I-Photosynthesis ayikwazi ukwenzeka lapho, futhi ngenxa yalokho, kuye kwavela izinguquko eziningana ezenza izinto eziphilayo ziphile ngaphandle kokukhanya. Isibonelo, izitshalo zasemanzini zinezicubu ze-photosynthetic eduze kobuso bamanzi; isibonelo, cabanga ngamaqabunga abanzi, antantayo e-water lily—ama-water lilies awakwazi ukusinda ngaphandle kokukhanya. Ezindaweni ezifana nemigodi yamanzi, amanye amabhaktheriya akhipha amandla kumakhemikhali angaphili ngoba akukho ukukhanya kwe-photosynthesis.

 Ukutholakala kwezakhamzimba ezinhlelweni zasemanzini nakho kuyisici esibalulekile samandla noma i-photosynthesis. Izinto eziphilayo eziningi ziyacwila phansi kolwandle lapho zifa emanzini avulekile; uma lokhu kwenzeka, amandla nezakhamzimba ezitholakala kuleyo nto ephilayo ziyagcinwa isikhathi esithile ngaphandle kokuthi ulwandle lukhuphuke. Ukuphakama kolwandle ukuphakama kwamanzi ajulile olwandle okwenzeka lapho imimoya enamandla ivunguza emanzini angaphezulu eduze nogu lolwandle (Isithombe 35.9). Njengoba umoya usunduza amanzi olwandle ogwini lolwandle, amanzi avela phansi kolwandle aya phezulu ukuze athathe indawo yala manzi. Ngenxa yalokho, amandla nezakhamzimba ezike zatholakala ezintweni eziphilayo ezifile ziyatholakala ukuze ziphinde zisetshenziswe ezinye izinto eziphilayo.

 Ezinhlelweni zamanzi ahlanzekile, ukuphinda kusetshenziswe izakhamzimba kwenzeka ngenxa yokushintsha kwezinga lokushisa lomoya. Izakhamzimba ezingaphansi kwamachibi ziphinda zisetshenziswe kabili ngonyaka: entwasahlobo nasekwindla. Ukuguquka kwentwasahlobo nasekwindla kuyinqubo yesizini ephinda isebenzise izakhamzimba nomoya-mpilo kusukela phansi kwendawo yamanzi ahlanzekile kuya phezulu emanzini (Isithombe 35.10). Lokhu kuguquka kubangelwa ukwakheka kwe-thermocline: ungqimba lwamanzi olunezinga lokushisa elihluke kakhulu kwelezendlalelo ezizungezile. Ebusika, ubuso bamachibi atholakala ezindaweni eziningi ezisenyakatho buqandisiwe. Kodwa-ke, amanzi angaphansi kweqhwa afudumele kancane, kanti amanzi angaphansi kwechibi afudumele kodwa ku-4 °C kuya ku-5 °C (39.2 °F kuya ku-41 °F). Amanzi aminyene kakhulu ku-4 °C; ngakho-ke, amanzi ajulile nawo aminyene kakhulu. Amanzi ajulile awanayo i-oxygen ngoba ukubola kwezinto eziphilayo phansi kwechibi kusebenzisa i-oxygen etholakalayo engenakushintshwa ngokusabalala kwe-oxygen emanzini ngenxa yongqimba lweqhwa elingaphezulu.

 Entwasahlobo, amazinga okushisa omoya ayanda futhi iqhwa elingaphezulu liyancibilika. Lapho izinga lokushisa lamanzi angaphezulu liqala ukufika ku-4 °C, amanzi aba nzima futhi acwile phansi. Amanzi aphansi echibini abe esesuswa amanzi angaphezulu asindayo, ngaleyo ndlela, akhuphukele phezulu. Njengoba lawo manzi ekhuphukela phezulu, inhlabathi nezakhamzimba ezivela phansi echibini zilethwa kanye nawo. Phakathi nezinyanga zasehlobo, amanzi echibini ayahlukana, noma akha izendlalelo, lapho amanzi afudumele kakhulu ebusweni bechibi.

 Njengoba amazinga okushisa omoya ehla ekwindla, izinga lokushisa lamanzi echibi liphola lifike ku-4 °C; ngakho-ke, lokhu kubangela ukushintshashintsha kokuwa njengoba amanzi abandayo anzima ecwila futhi esusa amanzi aphansi. Amanzi acebile nge-oxygen ebusweni bechibi abese ehamba aye phansi echibini, kuyilapho izakhamzimba eziphansi echibini zikhuphukela phezulu (Isithombe 35.10). Ebusika, i-oxygen ephansi echibini isetshenziswa yizinto ezibolayo nezinye izinto eziphilayo ezidinga i-oxygen, njengezinhlanzi
question1: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezibamba amandla elangeni bese ziwaguqula abe amandla amakhemikhali?
answer1: Izitshalo eziluhlaza, ulwelwe, ama-cyanobacteria, kanye nama-photosynthetic protists
question2: Kungani izitshalo ezingaphansi kwesakhiwo emahlathini anesimo sezulu esipholile zivame ukukhula ngokushesha ekuqaleni kwentwasahlobo?
answer2: Ziqeda ingxenye enkulu yokukhula kwazo ngaphambi kokuba ihlathi livale ukukhanya kwelanga
distractor2a: Zidinga amazinga okushisa abandayo ukuze ziphinde zikhule
question3: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.8. Yisiphi isibonelo sesitshalo sesikhashana sasentwasahlobo?
answer3: Ubuhle bentwasahlobo
question4: Kungani ukutholakala kokukhanya kulinganiselwe ezindaweni zemvelo zasemanzini ezijulile?
answer4: Ukukhanya kwelanga kumuncwa amanzi, izitshalo, izinhlayiya ezilengayo, kanye nezinambuzane ezincane
distractor4a: Amanzi ajulile aqukethe umoya-mpilo omningi kakhulu
distractor4c: Izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthesis zisebenzisa konke ukukhanya okutholakalayo
question5: Amanye amabhaktheriya ahlala eduze kwemigodi yamanzi ashisayo athola kanjani amandla?
answer5: Zikhipha amandla kumakhemikhali angaphili
question6: Kuyini ukukhuphuka kolwandle?
answer6: Ukukhuphuka kwamanzi olwandle ajulile, acebile ngezakhamzimba kuya phezulu lapho imimoya isunduza amanzi angaphezulu ogwini lolwandle
question7: Kungani ukukhuculula ulwandle kubalulekile?
answer7: Ibuyisela izakhamzimba namandla avela emanzini ajulile kuya ezindaweni zemvelo ezingaphezulu lapho zingasetshenziswa khona kabusha
distractor7a: Isusa unomphela izakhamzimba ezindaweni zemvelo zasolwandle
question8: Kuyini ukushintshwa kwentwasahlobo nekwindla emachibini ahlanzekile?
answer8: Inqubo yokuxuba yesizini ephinda isebenzise izakhamzimba kanye nomoya-mpilo phakathi kwamanzi angaphansi naphezulu
question9: Iyini i-thermocline?
answer9: Ingqimba yamanzi enezinga lokushisa elihluke kakhulu emanzini azungezile
distractor9b: Ingqimba lapho wonke umoya-mpilo ususwa khona
distractor9c: Indawo lapho i-photosynthesis yenzeka khona ngokushesha okukhulu
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.10 kanye noMfanekiso 35.10.1. Amagrafu abonisa izinga lokushisa loLwandle lwaseCaribbean kulo lonke u-1995 ekujuleni okuhlukahlukene. Ukujula kwe-thermocline kushintsha kanjani phakathi nonyaka?
answer10: Ezinyangeni zasehlobo, i-thermocline iqala eduze kobuso
distractor10b: Ezinyangeni zasebusika, i-thermocline iqala eduze kobuso

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | I-Biogeography | Izinga lokushisa
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | I-Biogeography | Izinga lokushisa
chapterContent:
Izinga lokushisa lithinta i-physiology yezinto eziphilayo kanye nobuningi kanye nesimo samanzi. Izinga lokushisa linethonya elibalulekile ezintweni eziphilayo ngoba zimbalwa izinto eziphilayo ezingasinda emazingeni okushisa angaphansi kuka-0 °C (32 °F) ngenxa yemingcele ye-metabolic. Akuvamile futhi ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zisinde emazingeni okushisa adlula u-45 °C (113 °F); lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sempendulo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo emazingeni okushisa ajwayelekile. Ama-enzyme asebenza kahle kakhulu ngaphakathi kobubanzi obuncane nobuthile bamazinga okushisa; ukuchithwa kwama-enzyme kungenzeka emazingeni okushisa aphezulu. Ngakho-ke, izinto eziphilayo kumele zigcine izinga lokushisa langaphakathi noma kumele zihlale endaweni ezogcina umzimba ngaphakathi kobubanzi bamazinga okushisa obusekela i-metabolism. Ezinye izilwane ziye zajwayela ukuvumela imizimba yazo ukuthi isinde ekushintsheni okukhulu kwezinga lokushisa, okubonakala ebusika noma ekushayweni yizilwane ezihuquzelayo. Ngokufanayo, amanye amabhaktheriya ajwayela ukusinda emazingeni okushisa ashisa kakhulu njengama-geysers. Amabhaktheriya anjalo ayizibonelo zama-extremophile: izinto eziphilayo ezichuma ezindaweni ezimbi kakhulu.

 Izinga lokushisa linganciphisa ukusatshalaliswa kwezinto eziphilayo. Izilwane ezibhekene nokuguquguquka kwezinga lokushisa zingasabela ngokuzivumelanisa nezimo, njengokufuduka, ukuze zisinde. Ukufuduka, ukuhamba kusuka endaweni ethile kuya kwenye, kuyindlela yokuzivumelanisa nezimo etholakala ezilwaneni eziningi, okuhlanganisa eziningi ezihlala ezindaweni ezibandayo ngezikhathi ezithile. Ukufuduka kuxazulula izinkinga ezihlobene nokushisa, ukuthola ukudla, kanye nokuthola umngane. Ekufudukeni, isibonelo, i-Arctic Tern (Sterna paradisaea) yenza uhambo lokuya nokubuya oluyi-40,000 km (24,000 mi) minyaka yonke phakathi kwezindawo zayo zokudla eningizimu yezwe kanye nezindawo zayo zokuzalela e-Arctic Ocean. Ama-Monarch butterflies (Danaus plexippus) ahlala empumalanga ye-United States ezinyangeni ezifudumele futhi athuthela eMexico naseningizimu ye-United States ngesikhathi sasebusika. Ezinye izinhlobo zezilwane ezincelisayo nazo ziyahamba zifuduka. Ama-Reindeer (Rangifer tarandus) ahamba cishe amakhilomitha angu-5,000 (3,100 mi) minyaka yonke ukuze athole ukudla. Izilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini nezilwane ezihuquzelayo zilinganiselwe kakhulu ekusabalaleni kwazo ngoba azikwazi ukufuduka. Akuzona zonke izilwane ezingafuduka ezenza kanjalo: ukufuduka kuthwala ingozi futhi kuza ngezindleko eziphezulu zamandla.

 Ezinye izilwane ziyalala noma ziyazama ukusinda emazingeni okushisa angemahle. Ukulala phansi kwenza izilwane zikwazi ukusinda ezimweni ezibandayo, kanti ukulala phansi kuvumela izilwane ukuthi zisinde ezimweni ezibandayo zesimo sezulu esishisayo nesomile. Izilwane ezilala phansi noma ziyazama ukusinda zingena esimweni esaziwa ngokuthi yi-torpor: isimo lapho izinga lazo lokugaya ukudla lehla kakhulu. Lokhu kwenza isilwane sikwazi ukulinda kuze kube yilapho indawo yaso isekela kangcono ukusinda kwaso. Ezinye izilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini, njengexoxo lezinkuni (iRana sylvatica), zinekhemikhali efana ne-antifreeze emaseli azo, egcina ubuqotho bamaseli futhi iwavimbele ekuqhumeni.
question1: Kungani izinga lokushisa lithonya kakhulu ukusabalala kwezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Ngoba ama-enzyme asebenza kahle kuphela ngaphakathi kwezinga lokushisa elilinganiselwe, okuthinta i-metabolism kanye nokusinda
distractor1a: Ngoba izinga lokushisa lithinta kuphela ukutholakala kwamanzi
distractor1b: Ngoba zonke izinto eziphilayo zingasinda kunoma yiliphi izinga lokushisa
distractor1c: Ngoba izinga lokushisa alinawo umthelela ku-physiology
question2: Kungani zimbalwa izinto eziphilayo ezisindayo emazingeni okushisa angaphansi kuka-0 °C noma ngaphezulu kuka-45 °C?
answer2: Ukushisa okukhulu kuphazamisa ukusebenza kwe-metabolism futhi kungalimaza ama-enzyme
distractor2a: Amanzi aba nosawoti kakhulu kulezi zimo zokushisa
distractor2b: Ukukhanya kwelanga akutholakali kulawa mazinga okushisa
distractor2c: I-oksijini ayikwazi ukuncibilika emanzini kulezi zimo zokushisa
question3: Yini ama-extremophile?
answer3: Izinto eziphilayo ezichuma ezindaweni ezibucayi kakhulu
distractor3b: Izitshalo ezidinga amazinga okushisa aphakathi nendawo
distractor3c: Izinto eziphilayo ezihlala emahlathini emvula asezindaweni ezishisayo kuphela
question4: Kuyini ukufuduka?
answer4: Ukuhamba kwezinto eziphilayo kusuka endaweni eyodwa kuya kwenye ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusinda, kutholakale ukudla, noma kuzalwe kabusha
distractor4b: Ukwehla kwesilinganiso se-metabolic okubangelwa ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni
question5: Iyiphi inyoni ehamba cishe amakhilomitha angu-40,000 (24,000 mi) minyaka yonke phakathi kweNingizimu Yenkabazwe kanye noLwandlekazi i-Arctic?
answer5: Inyoni yase-Arctic tern
question6: Kungani izilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini nezilwane ezihuquzelayo ngokuvamile zilinganiselwe kakhulu ekusabalaleni kwazo kunezinyoni eziningi nezilwane ezincelisayo?
answer6: Ngokuvamile abanalo ikhono lokufuduka amabanga amade
distractor6b: Azikwazi ukusinda ngaphezu kwamazinga okushisa abandayo
question7: Kuyini ukuthuthumela?
answer7: Isimo lapho izinga lokudla okudliwa yizilwane lincipha kakhulu
question8: Kuhluke kanjani ubusika kanye nobusika?
answer8: Ukulala ebusuku kusiza izilwane ukuba zisinde ezimweni ezibandayo, kanti ukuphumula kusiza izilwane ukuba zisinde ezimweni ezishisayo nezomile
distractor8a: Ukulala ebusuku kwenzeka ezinyonini kuphela, kanti ukuphumula kwenzeka ezincelisayo kuphela
distractor8b: Zombili zenzeka kuphela ezintweni eziphilayo zasemanzini
distractor8c: Ukushisa kwenzeka ebusika obubandayo, kanti ubusika buhlala isikhathi eside ehlobo elishisayo.
question9: Yikuphi ukuzivumelanisa nezimo okusiza ixoxo lezinkuni ukuba likwazi ukumelana namazinga okushisa abandayo?
answer9: Ikhiqiza amakhemikhali afana ne-antifreeze avikela amangqamuzana ayo ekuqhumeni

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | I-Biogeography | Amanzi
chapterContent:
Amanzi ayadingeka yizo zonke izinto eziphilayo ngoba abalulekile ezinqubweni zamaseli. Njengoba izinto eziphilayo zasemhlabeni zilahlekelwa amanzi endaweni ezungezile ngokusabalala kalula, ziye zathuthukisa izindlela eziningi zokuguqula ukuze zigcine amanzi.

 Izitshalo zinezici eziningana ezithakazelisayo emaqabunga azo, njengezinwele zamaqabunga kanye ne-wax cuticle, ezisiza ukunciphisa izinga lokulahleka kwamanzi ngokuphefumula.
Izinto eziphilayo zamanzi ahlanzekile zizungezwe ngamanzi futhi zihlala zisengozini yokuba amanzi angene emangqamuzaneni azo ngenxa ye-osmosis. Izindlela eziningi zokuguqula izinto eziphilayo ezihlala ezindaweni zamanzi ahlanzekile ziye zashintsha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amazinga ancibilikayo emizimbeni yazo ahlala ngaphakathi kwamazinga afanele. Okunye ukuzivumelanisa okunjalo ukukhipha umchamo oncibilikisiwe.
Izinto eziphilayo zasolwandle zizungezwe ngamanzi anokuxinana okuphezulu kokuncibilikisa kunezinto eziphilayo futhi, ngakho-ke, zisengozini yokulahlekelwa amanzi endaweni ezungezile ngenxa ye-osmosis. Lezi zinto eziphilayo zinokuzivumelanisa kwemvelo kanye ne-physiological ukuze zigcine amanzi futhi zikhulule izinto ezincibilikisayo endaweni ezungezile. Isibonelo, ama-Marine iguana (Amblyrhynchus cristatus), akhipha umhwamuko wamanzi ogcwele usawoti ukuze agcine amazinga ancibilikayo ngaphakathi kwebanga elamukelekayo ngenkathi ebhukuda olwandle futhi edla izitshalo zasolwandle.
question1: Kungani amanzi ebalulekile kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Ngoba kuyadingeka ezinqubweni zamaselula
distractor1a: Ngoba inikeza zonke izinto eziphilayo umoya-mpilo
question2: Kungani izinto eziphilayo zasemhlabeni zidinga ukuzivumelanisa nezimo ukuze kulondolozwe amanzi?
answer2: Balahlekelwa amanzi endaweni ezungezile ngokusabalala
question3: Yiziphi izindlela zokuzivumelanisa nezimo zezitshalo ezisiza ekunciphiseni ukulahleka kwamanzi ngokuphefumula?
answer3: Izinwele zamaqabunga kanye nesikhumba esifana ne-wax
question4: Kungani izinto eziphilayo zasemanzini ahlanzekile zisengozini yokuphuza amanzi amaningi kakhulu?
answer4: Amanzi angena emangqamuzaneni awo nge-osmosis ngoba amanzi azungezile anokuhlushwa okuncibilikayo okuphansi
distractor4b: Amanzi ahlanzekile aqukethe usawoti omningi kakhulu
question5: Izinto eziphilayo eziningi zasemanzini ahlanzekile zigcina kanjani amazinga afanele okuncibilikisa amanzi?
answer5: Ngokukhipha umchamo oncibilikisiwe
distractor5c: Ngokuvimbela amanzi ukuthi angangeni emizimbeni yabo
question6: Kungani izinto eziphilayo zasolwandle zisengozini yokulahlekelwa amanzi?
answer6: Amanzi olwandle azungezile anokugcwala okuphezulu kokuncibilika, okubangela ukuba amanzi aphume emizimbeni yawo nge-osmosis
distractor6a: Amanzi olwandle aqukethe usawoti omncane kakhulu
distractor6b: Amanzi angena njalo emangqamuzaneni awo ngokusabalala
distractor6c: Izinto eziphilayo zasolwandle azikwazi ukulawula amazinga ancibilikayo
question7: Izinto eziphilayo zasolwandle ngokuvamile zilondoloza kanjani ibhalansi yamanzi?
answer7: Ngokugcina amanzi nokukhulula izinto ezincibilikisiwe emvelweni
question8: Ama-iguana asolwandle asiza kanjani ukugcina amazinga afanele okuncibilikisa?
answer8: Bakhipha umhwamuko wamanzi ocebile ngosawoti ngenkathi behlala endaweni yasolwandle

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | I-Biogeography | Izakhamzimba Ezingaphili kanye Nenhlabathi
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | I-Biogeography | Izakhamzimba Ezingaphili kanye Nenhlabathi
chapterContent: Izakhamzimba ezingaphili, njenge-nitrogen ne-phosphorus, zibalulekile ekusatshalalisweni nasekunabeni kwezinto eziphilayo. Izitshalo zithola lezi zakhamzimba ezingaphili enhlabathini lapho amanzi engena esitshalweni ngezimpande. Ngakho-ke, isakhiwo somhlabathi (usayizi wezinhlayiya zezingxenye zomhlabathi), i-pH yomhlabathi, kanye nokuqukethwe kwezakhamzimba zomhlabathi kudlala indima ebalulekile ekusatshalalisweni kwezitshalo. Izilwane zithola izakhamzimba ezingaphili ekudleni ezikudlayo. Ngakho-ke, ukusatshalaliswa kwezilwane kuhlobene nokusatshalaliswa kwalokho ezikudlayo. Kwezinye izimo, izilwane zizolandela imithombo yazo yokudla njengoba ihamba endaweni ezungezile.
question1: Kungani izakhamzimba ezingaphili njenge-nitrogen ne-phosphorus zibalulekile?
answer1: Zithinta ukusabalala kanye nobuningi bezinto eziphilayo
distractor1a: Zinquma inani lokukhanya kwelanga elifinyelela ebusweni bomhlaba
distractor1c: Zivimbela amanzi ukuthi angangeni ezimpandeni zezitshalo
question2: Izitshalo zithola kanjani izakhamzimba ezingaphili?
answer2: Zimunca enhlabathini njengoba amanzi engena ngezimpande zazo
question3: Yiziphi izici zenhlabathi ezithinta ukusabalala kwezitshalo?
answer3: Isakhiwo somhlabathi, i-pH yomhlabathi, kanye nokuqukethwe kwezakhamzimba zomhlabathi
question4: Kungani i-pH yomhlabathi ithinta ukusatshalaliswa kwezitshalo?
answer4: Kuthinta ukutholakala kwezakhamzimba ezimuncwa yizitshalo enhlabathini
distractor4c: Kuvimbela amanzi ukuthi angangeni ezimpandeni zezitshalo
question5: Izilwane zithola kanjani izakhamzimba ezingaphili?
answer5: Ngokudla ukudla okuqukethe lezo zakhamzimba
question6: Kungani ukusabalala kwezilwane kuvame ukuhlotshaniswa nokusabalala kwezitshalo noma ezinye izinto eziphilayo?
answer6: Ngoba izilwane zithembele ekudleni okuhlinzeka ngezakhamzimba ezingaphili
distractor6a: Ngoba izilwane zithola izakhamzimba ngqo emadwaleni
distractor6c: Ngoba zonke izilwane zidla ukudla okufanayo
question7: Kungani ezinye izilwane zisuka kwenye indawo ziye kwenye?
answer7: Balandela izinsiza zabo zokudla njengoba behamba endaweni ezungezile
distractor7c: Ziyanyakaza ngoba izitshalo azikwazi ukumunca izakhamzimba

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | I-Biogeography | Ezinye Izinto Zasemanzini
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | I-Biogeography | Ezinye Izinto Zasemanzini
chapterContent: Ezinye izinto ezingaphili kahle, njenge-oxygen, zibalulekile ezindaweni zemvelo zasemanzini kanye nasezindaweni zasemhlabeni. Izilwane zasemhlabeni zithola i-oxygen emoyeni eziwuphefumulayo. Ukutholakala kwe-oxygen kungaba yinkinga ezintweni eziphilayo ezihlala ezindaweni eziphakeme kakhulu, nokho, lapho kunama-molecule ambalwa e-oxygen emoyeni. Ezinhlelweni zasemanzini, ukugcwala kwe-oxygen encibilikisiwe kuhlobene nokushisa kwamanzi kanye nesivinini amanzi ahamba ngaso. Amanzi abandayo ane-oxygen encibilikisiwe eningi kunamanzi afudumele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, usawoti, ugesi, kanye nolwandle kungaba yizinto ezibalulekile ezingaphili kahle ezindaweni zemvelo zasemanzini.
question1: Kungani ukutholakala komoya-mpilo kungaba yisici esivimbela izinto eziphilayo ezihlala ezindaweni eziphakeme?
answer1: Kunama-molecule e-oxygen ambalwa emoyeni ezindaweni eziphakeme
distractor1a: Umoya uqukethe i-carbon dioxide eningi kune-oxygen
distractor1b: I-oksijini ayikwazi ukusabalala iye ezintweni eziphilayo ezindaweni eziphakeme
distractor1c: Izitshalo ziyayeka ukukhiqiza umoya-mpilo ezindaweni eziphakeme
question2: Izilwane zasemhlabeni ziyithola kanjani i-oxygen ngokuyinhloko?
answer2: Ngokuphefumula umoya
question3: Izinga lokushisa lamanzi lithinta kanjani inani lomoya-mpilo oncibilikisiwe ezindaweni zemvelo zasemanzini?
answer3: Amanzi abandayo aqukethe umoya-mpilo oncibilikile omningi kunamanzi afudumele
distractor3a: Amanzi afudumele aqukethe umoya-mpilo oncibilikile omningi kunamanzi abandayo
distractor3b: Izinga lokushisa lamanzi alinawo umthelela emoyeni oncibilikisiwe
distractor3c: Amanzi ahlanzekile kuphela aqukethe umoya-mpilo oncibilikisiwe
question4: Ukunyakaza kwamanzi kuthinta kanjani amazinga e-oxygen encibilikisiwe?
answer4: Amanzi ahamba ngokushesha ngokuvamile aqukethe umoya-mpilo oncibilikisiwe kakhulu
distractor4a: Ukuhamba kwamanzi akunawo umthelela ekugxilweni komoya-mpilo
distractor4b: Amanzi ahamba kancane ahlala equkethe umoya-mpilo oncibilikisiwe kakhulu
distractor4c: Amanzi olwandle kuphela athinta umoya-mpilo oncibilikisiwe
question5: Yiziphi izinto ezingaphili ezibaluleke kakhulu ezindaweni zemvelo zasemanzini?
answer5: Usawoti, umsinga, kanye nolwandle
distractor5a: Isivinini somoya, ukuphakama, kanye nomsebenzi wentaba-mlilo
distractor5b: I-pH yomhlabathi, udoti wamaqabunga, kanye nemvamisa yomlilo
distractor5c: Umswakama, isembozo samafu, kanye nomfutho womoya
question6: Kungani umoya-mpilo oncibilikisiwe ubalulekile ezintweni eziphilayo zasemanzini?
answer6: Kuyadingeka ukuze amaseli aphefumule futhi asinde
question7: Iyiphi indawo okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi ibe nokuhlushwa okuphezulu kakhulu komoya-mpilo oncibilikisiwe?
answer7: Umfula obandayo, ohamba ngokushesha

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | I-Biogeography | Ezinye Izinto Ezikhona Emhlabeni
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | I-Biogeography | Ezinye Izinto Ezikhona Emhlabeni
chapterContent:
Umoya ungaba yinto ebalulekile engaxutshwa nalutho ngoba uthonya izinga lokuhwamuka kanye nokuphuma komoya. Amandla omoya nawo abalulekile ngoba angashukumisa inhlabathi, amanzi, noma ezinye izinto ezingaxutshwa nalutho, kanye nezinto eziphilayo ze-ecosystem.

 Umlilo ungenye into esemhlabeni engaba yimbangela ebalulekile yokuphazamiseka kwezindawo zemvelo zomhlaba. Ezinye izinto eziphilayo zijwayele umlilo, ngakho-ke, zidinga ukushisa okuphezulu okuhlobene nomlilo ukuze kuqedwe ingxenye yomjikelezo wazo wokuphila. Isibonelo, i-jack pine—isihlahla se-coniferous—sidinga ukushisa okuvela emlilweni ukuze ama-cone embewu yaso avuleke (Isithombe 35.11). Ngokushiswa kwezinaliti zephayini, umlilo wengeza i-nitrogen enhlabathini futhi unciphise ukuncintisana ngokubhubhisa izihlahla ezingaphansi komhlaba.
question1: Umoya uthinta kanjani imvelo yasemhlabeni?
answer1: Kuthinta izinga lokuhwamuka kanye nokuphefumula futhi kungashukumisa inhlabathi, amanzi, kanye nezinto eziphilayo
distractor1c: Ayinawo umthelela ezintweni ezingaphili noma ezingaphili
question2: Kungani umoya ubhekwa njengento ebalulekile engenzi lutho?
answer2: Kuthinta ukulahleka kwamanzi futhi kungathutha izinto ezingaphili kanye nezinto eziphilayo
question3: Kungani umlilo ubhekwa njengokuphazamiseka okukhulu kwemvelo?
answer3: Kungashintsha izimiso zemvelo futhi kuthonye ukusinda nokuzalana kwezinhlobo ezithile
distractor3a: Kuhlala kubhubhisa zonke izinto eziphilayo endaweni ezungezile
question4: Ezinye izinto eziphilayo zijwayelana kanjani nomlilo?
answer4: Badinga ukushisa okuvela emlilweni ukuze baqede ingxenye yomjikelezo wabo wokuphila
distractor4b: Zigwema zonke izindawo lapho kwenzeka khona umlilo
question5: Bheka Umfanekiso 35.11. Kungani i-jack pine idinga umlilo?
answer5: Ukushisa okuvela emlilweni kubangela ukuthi ama-cone embewu yawo avuleke
distractor5a: Umlilo unikeza amanzi adingekayo ukuze imbewu ihlume
distractor5c: Umlilo uvumela isihlahla ukuthi simunce umoya-mpilo ngezimpande zaso
question6: Umlilo uzuzisa kanjani inhlabathi ezindaweni zemvelo ze-jack pine?
answer6: Izinaliti zikaphayini ezivuthayo zengeza i-nitrogen enhlabathini
question7: Umlilo unganciphisa kanjani ukuncintisana phakathi kwezitshalo?
answer7: Ngokubhubhisa izihlahla ezikhula ngaphansi komhlaba ezincintisana ngezinsizakusebenza

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | Izici ze-Abiotic Ezithonya Ukukhula Kwezitshalo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.2 I-Biogeography | Izici ze-Abiotic Ezithonya Ukukhula Kwezitshalo
chapterContent:
Izinga lokushisa kanye nomswakama kuyithonya elibalulekile ekukhiqizweni kwezitshalo (ukukhiqiza okuyinhloko) kanye nenani lezinto eziphilayo ezitholakala njengokudla (ukukhiqiza okuyinhloko okungenayo i-net). Ukukhiqiza okuyinhloko okungenayo i-net kuwukulinganisa kwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ezitholakala njengokudla; kubalwa njengenani eliphelele lekhabhoni elihlala njalo ngonyaka ngaphandle kwenani elikhishwa i-oxid ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kwamaseli. Ezindaweni zomhlaba, ukukhiqiza okuyinhloko okungenayo i-net kulinganiselwa ngokulinganisa i-biomass engaphezulu komhlaba ngendawo ngayinye, okuyisisindo esiphelele sezitshalo eziphilayo, ngaphandle kwezimpande. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iphesenti elikhulu le-biomass yezitshalo ekhona ngaphansi komhlaba alifakiwe kulesi silinganiso. Ukukhiqiza okuyinhloko okungenayo i-net kuyinto ebalulekile uma kucatshangelwa umehluko kuma-biomes. Ama-biomes akhiqiza kakhulu anezinga eliphezulu le-biomass engaphezulu komhlaba.

 Ukukhiqizwa kwe-biomass yonyaka kuhlobene ngqo nezingxenye ezingaphili zemvelo. Izindawo ezinenani elikhulu le-biomass zinezimo lapho i-photosynthesis, ukukhula kwezitshalo, kanye nokukhiqiza okuyinhloko okungenayo i-net kulungiselelwa khona. Isimo sezulu salezi zindawo sifudumele futhi simanzi. I-Photosynthesis ingaqhubeka ngesivinini esiphezulu, ama-enzyme angasebenza kahle kakhulu, kanti i-stomata ingahlala ivulekile ngaphandle kwengozi yokuphuma komoya ngokweqile; lezi zici ziholela enanini elikhulu le-carbon dioxide (CO2) elingena esitshalweni, okuholela ekukhiqizweni okuphezulu kwe-biomass. I-biomass engaphezulu komhlaba ikhiqiza izinsiza ezibalulekile eziningana zezinye izinto eziphilayo, okuhlanganisa indawo yokuhlala nokudla. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izindawo ezomile nezibandayo zinezinga eliphansi le-photosynthesis ngakho-ke i-biomass encane. Imiphakathi yezilwane ehlala lapho izothinteka futhi ukwehla kokudla okutholakalayo.
question1: Yiziphi izinto ezingasebenzi kahle ezinomthelela omkhulu ekukhiqizweni kwezitshalo kanye nokukhiqiza okuyisisekelo okungenayo i-intanethi?
answer1: Izinga lokushisa kanye nomswakama
question2: Kuyini ukukhiqiza okuyisisekelo okungenayo i-net (NPP)?
answer2: Inani lezinto eziphilayo ezitholakala njengokudla ngemva kokukhipha ikhabhoni esetshenziswa ekuphefumuleni kwamaseli ku-carbon iyonke elungisiwe
distractor2a: Inani eliphelele lekhabhoni eliqiniswa yi-photosynthesis minyaka yonke
distractor2c: I-biomass iyonke ehlanganisa izinto eziphilayo nezifile
question3: Umkhiqizo oyinhloko ophelele uvame ukulinganiselwa kanjani ezindaweni zemvelo zomhlaba?
answer3: Ngokulinganisa i-biomass engaphezulu komhlaba ngendawo ngayinye
question4: Kuyini i-biomass engaphezulu komhlaba?
answer4: Isisindo esiphelele sezitshalo eziphilayo ngaphezu komhlabathi, ngaphandle kwezimpande
question5: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-biome oluvame ukuba nomkhiqizo oyinhloko ophezulu kakhulu?
answer5: Ama-biome afudumele, amanzi
question6: Kungani izindawo ezifudumele nezimanzi zisekela ukukhiqizwa okuphezulu kwe-biomass?
answer6: I-Photosynthesis iyasebenza kahle, ama-enzyme asebenza kahle, futhi i-stomata ingahlala ivulekile ngaphandle kwengozi enkulu yokulahlekelwa amanzi amaningi.
distractor6a: Izitshalo azidingi i-carbon dioxide ezindaweni ezifudumele
distractor6b: Izimpande zimunca ukukhanya kwelanga ngqo enhlabathini
question7: Ukukhiqiza okuphezulu okuyisisekelo kuzizuzisa kanjani ezinye izinto eziphilayo?
answer7: Inikeza ukudla okuningi kanye nendawo yokuhlala ngokwandisa i-biomass yezitshalo
question8: Kungani izindawo ezomile nezibandayo zinomkhiqizo ophansi kakhulu?
answer8: Amazinga aphansi e-photosynthesis akhiqiza i-biomass encane yezitshalo kanye nokudla okuncane kwezinye izinto eziphilayo
distractor8a: Izitshalo zenza ukuphefumula kwamaseli kakhulu kune-photosynthesis
distractor8c: Izilwane zidla yonke i-biomass yezitshalo ngaphambi kokuba iqongelele

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi kulesi sigaba lungaphandle kobubanzi be-AP®. Awudingi ukubamba ngekhanda uhlu lwe-biome ezinkulu zomhlaba kanye nezici zazo ezichazayo. Kodwa-ke, sifunde ngaphambilini ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana kanye nezindawo zazo ukuze zihambise izinto namandla. Ama-biome avuthiwe ngezibonelo zalokhu kusebenzisana. I-biome ibhekisela ohlotsheni olukhulu lomphakathi wasemhlabeni (noma wasemanzini) osakazwa ngokwesimo sezulu, okunquma izitshalo ezivelele. Ngokulandelayo, izitshalo zithonya ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezilwane ezingahlala kule ndawo. Ukuqhathanisa inani lonyaka lemvula kanye nokuguquguquka kwemvula kusuka kwenye i-biome kuya kwenye kunikeza izinkomba mayelana nokubaluleka kwezinto ezingaphili ekusatshalalisweni kwama-biome. Uhlobo olufanayo lwe-biome lungenzeka ezindaweni ezahlukene zomhlaba (Isithombe 35.12).

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibhalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.D
Ukukhula kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla yesistimu yezinto eziphilayo kuthonywa izinguquko endaweni yesistimu.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.D.1 Izici ze-Abiotic endaweni zinquma izici zendawo (i-biome).

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
1.3 Umfundi angalungisa izethulo kanye namamodeli ezehlakalo nezinhlelo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu endaweni.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
3.2 Umfundi angalungisa imibuzo yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.22 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuhluza amamodeli esayensi kanye nemibuzo mayelana nomthelela wokuxhumana okuyinkimbinkimbi kwe-biotic kanye ne-abiotic ezinhlelweni zezinto eziphilayo, kusukela kumaseli nezinto eziphilayo kuya kubantu, emiphakathini, nasezindaweni zemvelo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.D.1 Izici ze-abiotic endaweni ezungezile zinquma izici zendawo ezungezile (i-biome).

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
5.1 Umfundi angahlaziya idatha ukuze abone amaphethini noma ubudlelwano.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.24 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuhlaziya idatha ukuze abone amaphethini angaba khona kanye nobudlelwano phakathi kwe-biotic noma i-abiotic factor kanye nohlelo lwezinto eziphilayo (amaseli, izinto eziphilayo, abantu, imiphakathi, noma izindawo zemvelo)
question1: Iyini i-biome?
answer1: Uhlobo olukhulu lomphakathi wasemhlabeni noma wasemanzini olusatshalaliswa ngokwesimo sezulu
distractor1b: Iqembu lezindawo zemvelo ezinezinhlobo zezilwane ezifanayo
distractor1c: Indawo yokuhlala eyodwa ehlalwa umphakathi owodwa
question2: Yini enquma ngokuyinhloko uhlobo lwezitshalo ezitholakala ku-biome?
answer2: Isimo sezulu
question3: Izimila zithinta kanjani i-biome?
answer3: Kuthonya ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezilwane ezingahlala kule ndawo
distractor3b: Kuvimbela izinto ezingasebenzi emzimbeni ukuthi zingathinti imvelo
question4: Kungani kuwusizo ukuqhathanisa imvula yonyaka phakathi kwama-biome?
answer4: Kuyasiza ekwembuleni ukubaluleka kwezinto ezingaphili kahle emzimbeni ekunqumeni ukusatshalaliswa kwe-biome
distractor4a: Ikhomba zonke izinhlobo eziphilayo endaweni ethile
question5: Ingabe uhlobo olufanayo lwe-biome lungenzeka ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zomhlaba?
answer5: Yebo, izimo zezulu ezifanayo zingakhiqiza i-biome efanayo ezindaweni ezahlukene zezwe
distractor5a: Cha, yonke i-biome ihlukile ezwenikazi elilodwa
distractor5b: Ama-biome asemanzini kuphela atholakala ezindaweni eziningi
distractor5c: Ama-biome asezindaweni ezishisayo kuphela atholakala emhlabeni jikelele
question6: Ngokusho kwe-AP® Biology Essential Knowledge 2.D.1, yini enquma izici ze-biome?
answer6: Izici ze-Abiotic emvelweni

distractor6b: Ukwehlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kuphela phakathi kwabantu
question7: Yini egcizelelwa yi-AP® Biology Learning Objective 2.24?
answer7: Ukuhlaziya idatha ukuze kutholakale ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo noma izinto ezingaphili kanye nezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo
distractor7b: Ukuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo ngokusebenzisa i-taxonomy kuphela
distractor7c: Ukubala amazinga okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kubantu
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.12. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo mayelana nama-biome esingamanga?
answer8: Amahlathi aseBoreal agcwele izihlahla ezibolayo
distractor8b: Utshani bubusa ama-savanna kanye nezindawo ezinotshani ezifudumele

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | Ihlathi Elimanzi LaseTropical
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | Ihlathi Elimanzi LaseTropical
chapterContent:
Amahlathi asezindaweni ezishisayo abizwa nangokuthi amahlathi emvula asezindaweni ezishisayo. Le biome itholakala ezindaweni ezishisayo (Isithombe 35.12). Izitshalo zibonakala ngezitshalo ezinamahlamvu abanzi awela unyaka wonke. Ngokungafani nezihlahla zamahlathi aqothulayo, izihlahla kule biome azinawo ukulahleka kwamaqabunga ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka okuhambisana nokushintshashintsha kwezinga lokushisa nokukhanya kwelanga; la mahlathi aluhlaza unyaka wonke.

 Amaphrofayili okushisa nokukhanya kwelanga kwamahlathi ashisayo ashisayo azinzile kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa namanye ama-biome asemhlabeni, kanti amazinga okushisa asukela ku-20 °C kuya ku-34 °C (68 °F kuya ku-93 °F). Uma umuntu eqhathanisa ukushintshashintsha kwezinga lokushisa lonyaka kwamahlathi ashisayo nalawo amanye ama-biome amahlathi, ukuntuleka kokushintshashintsha kwezinga lokushisa lonyaka ehlathini elishisayo kuyabonakala. Lokhu kuntuleka kwezinkathi kuholela ekukhuleni kwezitshalo unyaka wonke, kunokukhula kwezinkathi (intwasahlobo, ihlobo, kanye nekwindla) okubonakala kwamanye ama-biome. Ngokungafani nezinye izindawo zemvelo, izindawo zemvelo ezishisayo azinazo izinsuku ezinde nezinsuku ezimfushane phakathi nomjikelezo wonyaka. Esikhundleni salokho, inani eliqhubekayo lansuku zonke lokukhanya kwelanga okuqondile (amahora angu-11-12 ngosuku) linikeza imisebe yelanga eyengeziwe, ngaleyo ndlela, ukwanda kokukhula kwezitshalo.

 Imvula yonyaka emahlathini ashisayo ashisayo isukela ku-125 kuya ku-660 cm (50–200 in) ngokushintshashintsha okuthile kwanyanga zonke. Ngenkathi ukukhanya kwelanga nokushisa kuhlala kulungile Imvula yonyaka ehambisanayo iyahlukahluka kakhulu. Amahlathi asezindaweni ezishisayo anezinyanga ezimanzi lapho kungaba khona imvula engaphezu kuka-30 cm (11–12 in), kanye nezinyanga ezomile lapho kunemvula engaphansi kuka-10 cm (3.5 in) khona. Kodwa-ke, inyanga eyomile kakhulu ehlathini elishisayo elimanzi isadlula imvula yonyaka yezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo, njengezingwadule.

 Amahlathi asezindaweni ezishisayo anomkhiqizo ophezulu oyinhloko ngoba amazinga okushisa onyaka kanye namanani emvula kulezi zindawo afanele ukukhula kwezitshalo. Ngakho-ke, i-biomass ebanzi ekhona ehlathini elishisayo elimanzi iholela emiphakathini yezitshalo enezinhlobo eziningi kakhulu (Isithombe 35.13). Amahlathi asezindaweni ezishisayo anezinhlobo eziningi zezihlahla kunanoma iyiphi enye i-biome; ngokwesilinganiso phakathi kwezinhlobo zezihlahla eziyi-100 nezingu-300 zikhona ehektheleni elilodwa (amahektha angu-2.5) eNingizimu Melika. Enye indlela yokubona lokhu ukuqhathanisa izendlalelo eziqondile ezihlukile ngaphakathi kwe-biome yehlathi elishisayo elimanzi. Phansi kwehlathi kukhona ungqimba oluncane lwezitshalo nezinto zezitshalo ezibolayo. Ngaphezulu kwalokho kukhona ingaphansi lesihlahla esifushane esinamaqabunga amafushane. Ingqimba yezihlahla iphakama ngaphezu kwalesi sigaba futhi ingaphezulu kwengqimba evaliwe ephezulu—ingqimba ephezulu yamagatsha namaqabunga. Ezinye izihlahla ezengeziwe ziyavela ngale ngqimba evaliwe ephezulu. Lezi zingqimba zinikeza izindawo zokuhlala ezahlukahlukene neziyinkimbinkimbi zezitshalo ezahlukahlukene, isikhunta, izilwane, nezinye izinto eziphilayo emahlathini ashisayo anamanzi. Isibonelo, ama-epiphyte yizitshalo ezikhula kwezinye izitshalo, ngokuvamile ezingalimali. Ama-Epiphyte atholakala kuwo wonke ama-biome amahlathi ashisayo anamanzi. Izinhlobo eziningi zezilwane zisebenzisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zezitshalo kanye nesakhiwo esiyinkimbinkimbi samahlathi ashisayo anamanzi ukuze zidle futhi ziphephe. Ezinye izinto eziphilayo zihlala eziningana amamitha ngaphezu komhlaba futhi ziye zajwayela le ndlela yokuphila yezihlahla
question1: Atholakala kuphi amahlathi ashisayo anamanzi?
answer1: Ezifundeni zase-equator
question2: Kungani amahlathi asezindaweni ezishisayo ebhekwa njengaluhlaza?
answer2: Izihlahla zabo azilahlekelwa yiwo wonke amaqabunga azo ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka
question3: Yisiphi isici samahlathi emvula ashisayo esivumela ukukhula kwezitshalo unyaka wonke?
answer3: Amazinga okushisa azinzile kanye nokukhanya kwelanga kwansuku zonke okungaguquguquki
question4: Ingakanani imvula evamile yaminyaka yonke emahlathini ashisayo anamanzi?
answer4: Cishe 125 kuya ku-660 cm (amasentimitha angu-50 kuya ku-200)
distractor4b: 25 kuya ku-75 cm (10 kuya ku-30 amayintshi)
distractor4c: 75 kuya ku-100 cm (amasentimitha angu-30 kuya kwangu-40)
question5: Kungani amahlathi asezindaweni ezishisayo ekhiqiza kakhulu?
answer5: Amazinga okushisa afudumele kanye nemvula eningi kunikeza izimo ezifanele zokukhula kwezitshalo
distractor5b: Ukuhlukahluka okuphansi kwezinto eziphilayo kunciphisa ukuncintisana
question6: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.13. Yiluphi ungqimba lwehlathi olwakha ungqimba olungaphezulu kakhulu lwamagatsha namaqabunga?
answer6: Ikhava ephezulu evaliwe
question7: Ziyini i-epiphytes?
answer7: Izitshalo ezikhula kwezinye izitshalo ngaphandle kokuzilimaza ngokuvamile
distractor7a: Izitshalo ezithola izakhamzimba ngokufaka izimila ezihlahleni
question8: Isho ukuthini indlela yokuphila yezihlahla?
answer8: Ukuhlala kakhulu ezihlahleni
question9: Kungani amahlathi asezindaweni ezishisayo esekela ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezinhlobo zezilwane?
answer9: Ukukhiqiza kwazo okuphezulu kanye nesakhiwo sazo esiqondile esiyinkimbinkimbi kunikeza izindawo zokuhlala eziningi kanye nezinsiza eziningi
distractor9c: Imililo evame ukwenzeka idala izindawo zokuhlala ezifanayo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | Ama-Savanna
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | Ama-Savanna
chapterContent: AmaSavanna ayizindawo zotshani ezinezihlahla ezihlakazekile, futhi atholakala e-Afrika, eNingizimu Melika, nasenyakatho ye-Australia (Isithombe 35.12). AmaSavanna ayizindawo ezishisayo, ezishisayo ezinamazinga okushisa asukela ku-24 °C kuya ku-29 °C (75 °F kuya ku-84 °F) kanye nemvula yonyaka engu-10–40 cm (3.9–15.7 in). AmaSavanna anesizini ende yesomiso; ngenxa yalesi sizathu, izihlahla zehlathi azikhuli kahle njengoba zikhula ehlathini elimanzi elishisayo (noma kwezinye izitshalo zehlathi). Ngenxa yalokho, ngaphakathi kotshani kanye nezihlahla (izitshalo eziqhakaza izimbali) ezibusa iSavanna, kunezihlahla ezimbalwa kakhulu (Isithombe 35.14). Njengoba umlilo ungumthombo obalulekile wokuphazamiseka kule biome, izitshalo ziye zathuthukisa izinhlelo zezimpande ezithuthukile kahle ezizivumela ukuthi ziphinde zihlume ngokushesha ngemva komlilo.
question1: Zitholakala kuphi izindawo ezihlala abantu abaningi?
answer1: I-Afrika, iNingizimu Melika, kanye nenyakatho ye-Australia
distractor1b: INyakatho Melika kanye neNyakatho ye-Asia kuphela
question2: Yini echaza kahle i-savanna?
answer2: Indawo enotshani enezihlahla ezihlakazekile
distractor2c: Ihlathi le-coniferous elinezihlahla ezinde ezingaphansi komhlaba
question3: Iyini izinga lokushisa elijwayelekile elijwayelekile emahlathini ase-savanna?
answer3: 24 °C kuya ku-29 °C (75 °F kuya ku-84 °F)
question4: Ingakanani imvula yonyaka elinganiselwa emahlathini ase-savanna?
answer4: 10–40 cm (3.9–15.7 amayintshi)
question5: Kungani amahlathi engakhuli kakhulu ezindaweni ezishisayo?
answer5: AmaSavanna anesikhathi eside sesomiso esivimbela ukukhula kwezihlahla
distractor5c: Izihlahla azikwazi ukwenza i-photosynthesize emahlathini ase-savanna
question6: Yiziphi izinhlobo zezitshalo ezibusa ama-savanna?
answer6: Utshani kanye ne-fobs
question7: Bheka Isithombe 35.14. Kungani izitshalo eziningi zase-savanna ziye zathuthukisa izinhlelo zezimpande ezithuthukile kahle?
