answer7: Zivumela izitshalo ukuthi ziphinde zihlume ngokushesha ngemva komlilo
distractor7a: Zisiza izitshalo ukuba zisinde ezikhukhuleni ezingapheli
distractor7b: Zivumela izitshalo ukuthi zikhuphuke ezihlahleni eziseduze
question8: Kungani umlilo ubhekwa njengento ebalulekile emvelweni ezindaweni ezishisayo?
answer8: Kuwukuphazamiseka okuvamile okuye kwathonya ukuzivumelanisa nezimo kwezitshalo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | Amahlane ase-Subtropical
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | Amahlane ase-Subtropical
chapterContent:
Izingwadule ezingaphansi kwezindawo ezishisayo zikhona phakathi kuka-15 ° no-30 ° enyakatho naseningizimu futhi zigxile eZindaweni Ezishisayo Zomdlavuza kanye neCapricorn (Isithombe 35.12). Le biome yomile kakhulu; eminyakeni ethile, ukuhwamuka kudlula imvula. Izingwadule ezishisayo ezingaphansi kwezindawo ezishisayo zingaba namazinga okushisa omhlaba emini angaphezu kuka-60 °C (140 °F) kanye namazinga okushisa asebusuku asondela ku-0 °C (32 °F). Ezindaweni ezibandayo, amazinga okushisa angaba phezulu aze afike ku-25 °C futhi angehla ngaphansi kuka-30 °C (-22 °F). Izingwadule ezingaphansi kwezindawo ezishisayo zibonakala ngemvula ephansi yonyaka engaphansi kuka-30 cm (12 in) ngokushintshashintsha okuncane kwanyanga zonke kanye nokuntuleka kokubikezela kwemvula. Kwezinye izimo, imvula yonyaka ingaba ngaphansi kuka-2 cm (0.8 in) ezingwadule ezingaphansi kwezindawo ezishisayo ezise-Australia ephakathi (i-Outback) kanye nasenyakatho ye-Afrika.

 Izitshalo kanye nokuhlukahluka okuncane kwezilwane zalesi sitshalo kuhlobene eduze nale mvula ephansi futhi engalindelekile. Izingwadule ezomile kakhulu azinazo izitshalo ezihlala isikhathi eside eziphila kusukela onyakeni kuya kolandelayo; esikhundleni salokho, izitshalo eziningi ziyizitshalo zonyaka ezikhula ngokushesha futhi zizale lapho imvula ifika, bese ziyafa. Ezinye izitshalo eziningi kulezi zindawo zibonakala ngokuba nezimo eziningana ezilondoloza amanzi, njengezimpande ezijulile, amaqabunga ancishisiwe, kanye neziqu zokugcina amanzi (Isithombe 35.15). Izitshalo zembewu ehlane zikhiqiza imbewu engaba sebusuku isikhathi eside phakathi kwezimvula. Izimo ezilwaneni zasehlane zifaka phakathi ukuziphatha kwasebusuku kanye nokumba imigodi
question1: Zitholakala kuphi izingwadule ezingaphansi kwezindawo ezishisayo?
answer1: Phakathi kuka-15° no-30° enyakatho naseningizimu ye-latitude eduze neTropics of Cancer kanye neCapricorn
question2: Yisiphi isici esichazayo sezingwadule ezingaphansi kwezindawo ezishisayo?
answer2: Imvula yonyaka ephansi kakhulu futhi engalindelekile
distractor2c: Umswakama ophezulu kanye nezikhukhula ezivame kakhulu
question3: Ingakanani imvula yonyaka evame ukutholakala ezingwadule ezingaphansi kwezindawo ezishisayo?
answer3: Ngaphansi kwamasentimitha angu-30 cm (amasentimitha angu-12)
question4: Kungani izitshalo eziningi zasehlane ziqeda umjikelezo wazo wokuphila ngokushesha ngemva kwemvula?
answer4: Imvula ayivamile futhi ayibikezeleki, ngakho-ke kumele ikhule futhi izale ngokushesha
distractor4a: Imvula enkulu ivimbela ukukhula kwesikhathi eside
question5: Yikuphi ukuzivumelanisa nezimo okusiza izitshalo zasehlane ukuthi zilondoloze amanzi?
answer5: Izimpande ezijulile, amaqabunga anciphile, kanye neziqu ezigcina amanzi
question6: Bheka Umfanekiso 35.15. Kungani izitshalo zembewu yasehlane zingahlala zingasebenzi isikhathi eside?
answer6: Zingasinda kuze kube yilapho imvula eyanele ivumela ukuhluma
distractor6a: Zidinga amazinga okushisa abandayo ngaphambi kokuhluma
question7: Yiziphi izindlela zokuziphatha ezivamile ezilwaneni zasehlane?
answer7: Umsebenzi wasebusuku kanye nokumba imigodi
distractor7c: Ukuhlala usebenza elangeni eliqondile usuku lonke
question8: Kungani ukuhlukahluka kwezilwane ngokuvamile kuphansi ezindaweni ezishisayo?
answer8: Izimo ezomile kakhulu kanye nokutholakala kwamanzi okulinganiselwe kunciphisa inani lezinhlobo ezingasinda
distractor8a: Izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane ziqede izinhlobo eziningi zezilwane
distractor8c: Akukho ukukhanya kwelanga okutholakalayo ukuze kukhiqizwe umkhiqizo oyinhloko

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | I-Chaparral
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | I-Chaparral
chapterContent: I-chaparral ibizwa nangokuthi ihlathi lezihlahla futhi itholakala eCalifornia, ogwini loLwandle iMedithera, kanye nogwini oluseningizimu ye-Australia (Isithombe 35.12). Imvula yaminyaka yonke kule biome isukela ku-65 cm kuya ku-75 cm (25.6–29.5 in), kanti iningi lemvula lina ebusika. Ihlobo lomile kakhulu futhi izitshalo eziningi ze-chaparral azilali ngesikhathi sasehlobo. Izitshalo ze-chaparral, eziboniswe ku-Isithombe 35.16, zigcwele izihlahla futhi zijwayele imililo eyenzeka ngezikhathi ezithile, kanti ezinye izitshalo zikhiqiza imbewu ehluma kuphela ngemva komlilo oshisayo. Umlotha oshiywe ngemuva komlilo ucebile ngezakhamzimba ezifana ne-nitrogen evundisa inhlabathi futhi ikhuthaze ukukhula kabusha kwezitshalo.
question1: Liyini elinye igama le-chaparral biome?
answer1: Ihlathi lokuhlafuna
question2: Itholakala kuphi i-chaparral biome?
answer2: ICalifornia, isifunda saseMedithera, kanye nogu oluseningizimu ye-Australia
question3: Iyini imvula evamile yonyaka ku-chaparral biome?
answer3: 65–75 cm (25.6–29.5 amayintshi)
question4: Yisiphi isikhathi lapho i-chaparral ithola khona iningi lemvula yayo?
answer4: Ubusika
question5: Izitshalo eziningi ze-chaparral zisabela kanjani ehlobo elishisayo nelomile?
answer5: Ziyalala
question6: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.16. Yiluphi uhlobo lwezitshalo olubusa i-chaparral biome?
answer6: Izihlahla
question7: Izitshalo eziningi ze-chaparral zijwayelana kanjani nemililo eyenzeka ngezikhathi ezithile?
answer7: Ezinye zikhiqiza imbewu ehluma kuphela ngemva kokuchayeka ekushiseni komlilo
distractor7a: Zigwema zonke izindawo lapho kwenzeka khona imililo
distractor7c: Balahlekelwa yimbewu yabo ngaphambi kokuba kuqale umlilo
question8: Kungani izitshalo zivame ukukhula kabusha ngokushesha ngemva komlilo e-chaparral?
answer8: Umlotha osele ucebile ngezakhamzimba ezifana ne-nitrogen evundisa inhlabathi
distractor8b: Umlilo ususa zonke izinto eziphilayo enhlabathini

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | Izindawo Ezinotshani Ezifudumele
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | Izindawo Ezinotshani Ezifudumele
chapterContent:
Izindawo zotshani ezifudumele zitholakala kulo lonke elaseNyakatho Melika ephakathi, lapho zaziwa nangokuthi amadlelo; zitholakala nase-Eurasia, lapho zaziwa khona ngokuthi ama-steppes (Isithombe 35.12). Izindawo zotshani ezifudumele zinezinguquko ezinkulu zonyaka ekushiseni kanye nehlobo elishisayo kanye nobusika obubandayo. Ukushintshashintsha kwezinga lokushisa lonyaka kuveza izinkathi ezithile zokukhula kwezitshalo. Ukukhula kwezitshalo kungenzeka lapho amazinga okushisa efudumele ngokwanele ukusekela ukukhula kwezitshalo kanye nalapho kutholakala amanzi amaningi, okwenzeka entwasahlobo, ehlobo, nasekwindla. Phakathi nesikhathi esiningi sasebusika, amazinga okushisa aphansi, kanti amanzi, agcinwe ngesimo seqhwa, awatholakali ekukhuleni kwezitshalo.

 Imvula yonyaka isukela ku-25 cm kuya ku-75 cm (9.8–29.5 in). Ngenxa yemvula ephansi yonyaka ezindaweni zotshani ezifudumele, kunezihlahla ezimbalwa ngaphandle kwalezo ezitholakala zikhula emifuleni noma emifudlaneni. Izitshalo ezivelele zivame ukuba notshani kanti ezinye izindawo zotshani zinakekela izilwane eziningi ezidla imifino Isithombe 35.17. Izitshalo ziminyene kakhulu futhi inhlabathi ivundile ngoba ingxenye engaphansi komhlabathi igcwele izimpande nama-rhizome (iziqu ezingaphansi komhlaba) zalezi zitshalo. Izimpande nama-rhizome asebenza ekuqiniseni izitshalo emhlabathini futhi agcwalise izinto eziphilayo (i-humus) enhlabathini lapho zifa futhi zibola.

 Imililo, ebangelwa kakhulu umbani, iyisiphazamiso semvelo ezindaweni ezinotshani ezifudumele. Lapho umlilo ucindezelwa ezindaweni ezinotshani ezifudumele, izitshalo ekugcineni ziphenduka zibe yizihlahla eziluhlaza kanye namahlathi aminyene. Ngokuvamile, ukuvuselelwa noma ukuphathwa kwezindawo ezinotshani ezifudumele kudinga ukusetshenziswa kokushiswa okulawulwayo ukucindezela ukukhula kwezihlahla nokugcina utshani.
question1: Zitholakala kuphi izindawo ezinotshani ezifudumele?
answer1: ENyakatho Melika ephakathi (amathafa) kanye ne-Eurasia (ama-steppes)
question2: Uhlobo luni lwesimo sezulu oluchaza izindawo ezinotshani ezifudumele?
answer2: Ihlobo elishisayo kanye nobusika obubandayo obunokwehluka okukhulu kwezinga lokushisa lonyaka
question3: Kungaziphi izinkathi lapho ukukhula kwezitshalo kusebenza kakhulu ezindaweni ezinotshani ezifudumele?
answer3: Intwasahlobo, ihlobo, kanye nekwindla
question4: Kungani ukukhula kwezitshalo kunqunyelwe ebusika ezindaweni ezinotshani ezifudumele?
answer4: Izinga lokushisa liphansi futhi amanzi awatholakali ngoba aqandisiwe
question5: Iyini imvula evamile yaminyaka yonke ezindaweni ezinotshani ezifudumele?
answer5: 25–75 cm (9.8–29.5 amayintshi)
question6: Kungani kunezihlahla ezimbalwa ezindaweni ezinotshani ezifudumele?
answer6: Imvula yonyaka iphansi kakhulu, ngaphandle kwemifula nemifudlana
distractor6b: Izihlahla azikwazi ukubekezelela izinguquko zokushisa zesizini
question7: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.17. Hlobo luni lwezitshalo olubusa ezindaweni ezinotshani ezifudumele?
answer7: Utshani
distractor7b: Izihlahla ezihlala ziluhlaza eziluhlaza ezinamaqabunga aluhlaza
question8: Izimpande nama-rhizome otshani azizuzisa kanjani izindawo zemvelo ezikhula ezindaweni ezifudumele?
answer8: Ziqinisa izitshalo futhi zigcwalise izinto eziphilayo enhlabathini njengoba zibola
distractor8a: Zivimbela zonke izinto eziphilayo enhlabathini ukuthi zingakhuli
question9: Kungani ukusha okulawulwayo kuvame ukusetshenziswa ukuphatha izindawo ezinotshani ezisezingeni elifanele?
answer9: Ukucindezela ukukhula kwezihlahla nokugcina imvelo egcwele utshani

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | Amahlathi Afudumele
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | Amahlathi Afudumele
chapterContent:
Amahlathi afudumele yiwona avame kakhulu empumalanga yeNyakatho Melika, eNtshonalanga Yurophu, eMpumalanga Asia, eChile, naseNew Zealand (Isithombe 35.12). Le biome itholakala kuzo zonke izifunda eziphakathi nendawo. Amazinga okushisa asukela ku--30 °C kuya ku-30 °C (-22 °F kuya ku-86 °F) futhi ehla abe ngaphansi kweqhwa minyaka yonke. Lawa mazinga okushisa asho ukuthi amahlathi afudumele anezinkathi zokukhula ezichaziwe entwasahlobo, ehlobo, kanye nasekwindla yokuqala. Imvula ayiguquguquki unyaka wonke futhi isukela ku-75 cm kanye no-150 cm (29.5–59 in).

 Ngenxa yemvula yaminyaka yonke kanye namazinga okushisa aphakathi nendawo, izihlahla ezikhula amaqabunga ziyisitshalo esivelele kule biome (Isithombe 35.18). Izihlahla ezikhula amaqabunga zilahlekelwa amaqabunga azo njalo ekwindla futhi zihlala zingenamaqabunga ebusika. Ngakho-ke, akukho photosynthesis eyenzekayo ezihlahleni ezikhula amaqabunga ngesikhathi sasebusika esithule. Intwasahlobo ngayinye, kuvela amaqabunga amasha njengoba izinga lokushisa likhuphuka. Ngenxa yesikhathi sokulala, umkhiqizo oyinhloko wamahlathi anesimo sezulu esipholile ungaphansi kowamahlathi anesimo sezulu esishisayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amahlathi anesimo sezulu esishisayo abonisa ukuhlukahluka okuncane kwezinhlobo zezihlahla kune-biomes yamahlathi anesimo sezulu esishisayo.

 Izihlahla zamahlathi anesimo sezulu esishisayo zikhipha amaqabunga futhi zifake umthunzi engxenyeni enkulu yomhlabathi; noma kunjalo, le biome ivulekile kakhulu kunamahlathi anesimo sezulu esishisayo ngoba izihlahla emahlathini anesimo sezulu esishisayo azikhuli zinde njengezihlahla emahlathini anesimo sezulu esishisayo. Inhlabathi yamahlathi anesimo sezulu esishisayo icebile ngezakhamzimba ezingaphili kanye nezemvelo. Lokhu kungenxa yongqimba olujiyile lwamaqabunga phansi kwehlathi. Njengoba lokhu kungcola kwamaqabunga kubola, izakhamzimba zibuyiselwa enhlabathini. Ukungcola kwamaqabunga kuvikela nenhlabathi ekugugulekeni, kuvikela umhlabathi, futhi kuhlinzeke ngezindawo zokuhlala zezilwane ezingenamgogodla (njenge-pill bug noma i-roly-poly, i-Armadillidium vulgare) kanye nezilwane ezizingelayo, njenge-salamander ebomvu (i-Plethodon cinereus)
question1: Atholakala kuphi amahlathi anesimo sezulu esipholile?
answer1: I-Eastern North America, i-Western Europe, i-Eastern Asia, i-Chile, ne-New Zealand
question2: Yisiphi isimo sezulu esichaza amahlathi anesimo sezulu esifudumele?
answer2: Amazinga okushisa aphakathi nendawo anezinkathi ezihlukile, kufaka phakathi ubusika obubandayo
question3: Iyini imvula evamile yaminyaka yonke emahlathini anesimo sezulu esipholile?
answer3: 75–150 cm (29.5–59 amayintshi)
question4: Kungani imithi ebolayo iyizitshalo ezivame kakhulu emahlathini anesimo sezulu esipholile?
answer4: Amazinga okushisa aphakathi nendawo kanye nemvula kunikeza izimo ezinhle zokukhula kwazo
distractor4b: Zikhula kahle kuphela enhlabathini eqandisiwe unomphela
distractor4c: Bathembele emlilweni wehlathi oqhubekayo ukuze basinde
question5: Bheka Umfanekiso 35.18. Kwenzekani ezihlahleni ezibolayo ebusika?
answer5: Zilahlekelwa amaqabunga azo bese zingena esikhathini sokulala
question6: Kungani umkhiqizo oyinhloko wamahlathi anesimo sezulu esipholile uphansi kunowamahlathi ashisayo anamanzi?
answer6: I-Photosynthesis iyama ngesikhathi sasebusika lapho izihlahla ezinquma amahlamvu zilahlekelwa amaqabunga azo
distractor6a: Amahlathi afudumele athola ukukhanya kwelanga okwengeziwe
question7: Kungani inhlabathi yasehlathini enesimo sezulu esipholile icebile ngezakhamzimba?
answer7: Amahlamvu aqala ukubola abuyisela izakhamzimba eziphilayo kanye nezingaphilile enhlabathini
distractor7b: Inhlabathi ithola izakhamzimba kuphela ngenxa yemvula
distractor7c: Izimpande zezihlahla zikhiqiza njalo izakhamzimba zamaminerali
question8: Ngaphandle kokubuyisela izakhamzimba enhlabathini, iyiphi enye inzuzo enikezwa yizinsalela zamaqabunga?
answer8: Kuvikela inhlabathi ekugugulekeni, kuvikela umhlabathi, futhi kunikeze indawo yokuhlala yezinto eziphilayo eziningi
distractor8c: Kuvimba wonke amanzi ukuthi angafiki enhlabathini
question9: Kungani phansi kwehlathi ngokuvamile kuvulekile kakhulu emahlathini anesimo sezulu esipholile kunasemahlathini anamanzi asezindaweni ezishisayo?
answer9: Izihlahla zehlathi ezifudumele ngokuvamile zimfushane kunezihlahla zehlathi lasezindaweni ezishisayo, okuvumela isakhiwo esivulekile kakhulu
distractor9c: Zonke izihlahla zehlathi ezinesimo sezulu esipholile ziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | Amahlathi aseBoreal
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | Amahlathi aseBoreal
chapterContent:
Ihlathi le-boreal, elaziwa nangokuthi ihlathi le-taiga noma le-coniferous, litholakala eningizimu ye-Arctic Circle kanye nasezingxenyeni eziningi zeCanada, i-Alaska, iRussia, kanye nenyakatho yeYurophu (Isithombe 35.12). Leli hlathi linobusika obubandayo, obomile kanye nehlobo elifushane, elipholile, elimanzi. Imvula yonyaka isukela ku-40 cm kuya ku-100 cm (15.7–39 in) futhi imvamisa ithatha isimo seqhwa. Ukuhwamuka okuncane kwenzeka ngenxa yokushisa okubandayo.

 Ubusika obude nobubandayo ehlathini le-boreal buholele ekubuseni kwezitshalo ezithwala ama-cone ezibekezelela ukubanda. Lezi yizihlahla ze-coniferous ezihlala ziluhlaza njengephayini, i-spruce, ne-fir, ezigcina amaqabunga azo amise okwenaliti unyaka wonke. Izihlahla ezihlala ziluhlaza zingadala i-photosynthesize ekuqaleni kwentwasahlobo kunezihlahla ezibolayo ngoba kudingeka amandla amancane avela elangeni ukuze kufudunyezwe iqabunga elifana nenaliti kuneqabunga elibanzi. Lokhu kuzuzisa izihlahla ezihlala ziluhlaza, ezikhula ngokushesha kunezihlahla ezibolayo ehlathini le-boreal. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inhlabathi ezindaweni zasehlathini laseBoreal ivame ukuba ne-asidi ene-nitrogen encane etholakalayo. Amaqabunga ayisakhiwo esicebile nge-nitrogen futhi izihlahla ezibolayo kumele zikhiqize isethi entsha yalezi zakhiwo ezicebile nge-nitrogen minyaka yonke. Ngakho-ke, izihlahla ze-coniferous ezigcina izinaliti ezicebile nge-nitrogen zingase zibe nenzuzo yokuncintisana kunezihlahla ezibolayo ezinamahlamvu abanzi.

 Umkhiqizo oyinhloko wamahlathi aseBoreal uphansi kunowamahlathi aseBoreal anesimo sezulu esipholile kanye namahlathi aseTropical anamanzi. I-biomass engaphezulu komhlaba yamahlathi aseBoreal iphakeme ngoba lezi zinhlobo zezihlahla ezikhula kancane zihlala isikhathi eside futhi ziqoqa i-biomass emi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezitshalo kuncane kunalokho okubonwa emahlathini aseTropical anamanzi kanye namahlathi aseTropical anamanzi. Amahlathi aseBoreal awanazo izakhi ezivelele zesakhiwo sehlathi esinezingqimba ezibonakala emahlathini aseTropical anamanzi. Isakhiwo sehlathi laseBoreal sivame ukuba ungqimba lwesihlahla kanye nongqimba lomhlabathi (Isithombe 35.19). Lapho izinaliti ze-conifer ziwiswa, zibola kancane kunamaqabunga abanzi; ngakho-ke, izakhamzimba ezimbalwa zibuyiselwa enhlabathini ukuze zikhuthaze ukukhula kwezitshalo.
question1: Amahlathi e-boreal atholakala kuphi ngokuyinhloko?
answer1: Eningizimu ye-Arctic Circle kulo lonke elaseCanada, e-Alaska, eRussia, nasenyakatho yeYurophu
question2: Yisiphi isimo sezulu esichaza ihlathi le-boreal?
answer2: Ubusika obubandayo, obomile kanye nehlobo elifushane, elipholile, nelimanzi
distractor2a: Ihlobo elishisayo nelinomswakama kanye nobusika obuthambile
distractor2c: Izinsuku ezishisa kakhulu nobusuku obufudumele unyaka wonke
question3: Yiziphi izitshalo ezibusa ihlathi le-boreal?
answer3: Izihlahla ze-coniferous ezihlala ziluhlaza njengephayini, i-spruce, ne-fir
question4: Kungani ama-conifer ahlala ekhona enenzuzo kunezihlahla ezinqumayo emahlathini ase-boreal?
answer4: Amaqabunga awo afana nenaliti adinga amandla amancane ukuze afudumale futhi angakwazi ukwenza i-photosynthesis ekuqaleni kwentwasahlobo
distractor4a: Zilahlekelwa yiwo wonke amaqabunga azo njalo ebusika
distractor4b: Zidinga i-nitrogen eningi kunezihlahla ezinquma amaqabunga
distractor4c: Amaqabunga awo abanzi athola ukukhanya kwelanga okwengeziwe
question5: Kungani izihlahla ze-coniferous zinenzuzo yokuncintisana enhlabathini engenazo izakhamzimba emahlathini ase-boreal?
answer5: Zigcina izinaliti zazo ezicebile nge-nitrogen esikhundleni sokukhiqiza amaqabunga amasha njalo ngonyaka
question6: Umkhiqizo oyinhloko we-net wamahlathi e-boreal uqhathaniswa kanjani nowamahlathi ashisayo namanzi ashisayo?
answer6: Kuphansi
question7: Kungani i-biomass engenhla komhlaba yamahlathi e-boreal iphakeme kakhulu naphezu kokukhiqiza okuphansi kwe-net primary?
answer7: Izihlahla ezikhula kancane zihlala isikhathi eside futhi ziqoqana i-biomass ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor7a: Amahlathi anezinhlobonhlobo zezitshalo eziningi kakhulu eMhlabeni
distractor7c: Imililo evame ukwenzeka ikhulisa ngokushesha i-biomass
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.19. Isakhiwo sehlathi eliyi-boreal sihlelwa kanjani ngokuvamile?
answer8: Ngokuvamile kuqukethe ungqimba lwesihlahla kanye nongqimba lomhlabathi
question9: Kungani izakhamzimba ezimbalwa zibuyiselwa enhlabathini emahlathini ase-boreal kunasemahlathini anesimo sezulu esipholile?
answer9: Izinaliti ze-conifer zibola kancane kunamaqabunga abanzi
distractor9c: Imvula isusa zonke izakhamzimba ngaphambi kokuba zibole

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | I-Arctic Tundra
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.3 Ama-Biomes aseMhlabeni | I-Arctic Tundra
chapterContent:
I-Arctic tundra isenyakatho yehlathi le-subarctic boreal futhi itholakala kuzo zonke izifunda ze-Arctic zenyakatho ye-hemisphere (Isithombe 35.12). Izinga lokushisa elijwayelekile lasebusika lingu-34 °C (-29.2 °F) kanti izinga lokushisa elijwayelekile lasehlobo lisukela ku-3 °C kuya ku-12 °C (37 °F–52 °F). Izitshalo ezise-arctic tundra zinesikhathi esifushane kakhulu sokukhula esingamaviki ayi-10-12. Kodwa-ke, phakathi nalesi sikhathi, cishe amahora angama-24 okukhanya kwelanga futhi ukukhula kwezitshalo kuyashesha. Imvula yonyaka ye-Arctic tundra iphansi kakhulu futhi imvula incane kakhulu. Futhi, njengasemahlathini ase-boreal, kukhona ukuhwamuka okuncane ngenxa yokushisa okubandayo.

 Izitshalo ezise-Arctic tundra ngokuvamile ziphansi emhlabathini (Isithombe 35.20). Kunokwehlukahluka okuncane kwezinhlobo, umkhiqizo ophansi we-net primary, kanye ne-biomass ephansi ngaphezu komhlaba. Inhlabathi ye-Arctic tundra ingahlala esimweni esiqandisiwe esibizwa ngokuthi i-permafrost. I-permafrost yenza kube nzima ukuthi izimpande zingene zijule enhlabathini futhi inciphisa ukubola kwezinto eziphilayo, okuvimbela ukukhishwa kwezakhamzimba ezintweni eziphilayo. Ngesikhathi sokukhula, umhlabathi we-Arctic tundra ungambozwa ngokuphelele ngezitshalo noma ama-lichen.
question1: Itholakala kuphi i-Arctic tundra?
answer1: Enyakatho yehlathi le-boreal elingaphansi kwe-Arctic kuzo zonke izifunda ze-Arctic zeNyakatho Yenkabazwe
question2: Iyini isimo sezulu esivamile se-Arctic tundra?
answer2: Ubusika obubandayo kakhulu, ihlobo elipholile, kanye nemvula ephansi yonyaka
distractor2b: Izinga lokushisa elifudumele unyaka wonke elinemvula enkulu
question3: Kungani izitshalo zingakhula ngokushesha ngesikhathi sokukhula kwe-Arctic tundra?
answer3: Zithola cishe amahora angama-24 okukhanya kwelanga ngesikhathi esifushane sokukhula
distractor3a: Amazinga okushisa ahlala ngaphezu kwama-30°C kulo lonke ihlobo
question4: Kungani ukuhwamuka kwamanzi kuphansi e-Arctic tundra?
answer4: Ngenxa yokushisa okubandayo
question5: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.20. Yisiphi isici esichaza kangcono izitshalo zase-Arctic tundra?
answer5: Izitshalo ngokuvamile azikhuli kahle
distractor5a: Izihlahla ze-coniferous ezinde ezihlala ziluhlaza zivamile
distractor5b: Amahlathi aminyene anamaqabunga abanzi amboze indawo
question6: Kuyini i-permafrost?
answer6: Ingqimba yomhlabathi ehlala iqandisiwe unomphela
question7: I-permafrost ithinta kanjani ukukhula kwezitshalo?
answer7: Kuvimbela izimpande ukuthi zingene zijule enhlabathini
question8: Kungani ukutholakala kwezakhamzimba kuphansi enhlabathini ye-Arctic tundra?
answer8: Ukushisa okubandayo kanye neqhwa elihlala njalo kuyayehlisa ukubola kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor8c: Izitshalo zimunca izakhamzimba ngokushesha kunokuba zikhiqizwa yi-photosynthesis
question9: Yini evame ukumboza umhlabathi we-Arctic tundra ngesikhathi sokukhula?
answer9: Izitshalo nama-lichen

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ukuxhumana kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ukuxhumana kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi kulesi sigaba lungaphandle kwesikhala se-AP®. Awudingi ukukhumbula uhlu lwezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-biome zasemanzini zoMhlaba kanye nezici zazo ezichazayo. Kodwa-ke, sifunde ngaphambilini ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana kanye nezindawo zazo ukuze zihambise izinto namandla. Izinhlobo ze-biome zasemanzini zivuthiwe ngalezi zindlela zokuxhumana. Izihlahla zamakhorali, isibonelo, zibonisa ukuhlukahluka okucebile.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nenye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zebhayoloji zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo wokwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.D
Ukukhula kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla yesistimu yezinto eziphilayo kuthonywa izinguquko endaweni ezungezile yesistimu.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.D.1 Izici ze-Abiotic endaweni ezungezile zinquma izici zendawo ezungezile (i-biome).

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
5.1 Umfundi angahlaziya idatha ukuze abone amaphethini noma ubudlelwano.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.24 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuhlaziya idatha ukuze abone amaphethini angaba khona kanye nobudlelwano phakathi kwe-biotic noma i-abiotic factor kanye nesistimu yezinto eziphilayo
question1: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko yama-biome asemanzini ku-AP® Biology?
answer1: Ukuqonda ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zixhumana kanjani kanye nendawo ezikuyo ukuze zihambise izinto kanye namandla
distractor1a: Ukukhumbula yonke i-biome yasemanzini kanye nezici zayo
distractor1b: Ukuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo zasemanzini ngamaqembu e-taxonomic
distractor1c: Ukufunda ngezindawo zemvelo zamanzi ahlanzekile kuphela
question2: Kungani ama-biome asemanzini ebalulekile ekufundeni i-ecology?
answer2: Zinikeza izibonelo eziningi zokusebenzisana phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezungezile
distractor2c: Ziqukethe izinto eziphilayo ezincane kakhulu kuphela
question3: Yisiphi isimiso semvelo sasemanzini esiqokonyiswa njengesibonelo sezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezicebile?
answer3: Amatshe e-coral
question4: Ngokusho kwe-AP® Biology Essential Knowledge 2.D.1, yini enquma izici ze-biome?
answer4: Izici ze-Abiotic emvelweni
distractor4b: Ukuxhumana phakathi kwezilwane ezidla ezinye nezilwane ezidla ezinye kuphela
question5: Yini egcizelelwa yi-AP® Biology Big Idea 2?
answer5: Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye nezakhi zokwakha zama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis
distractor5a: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka kuphela ngokukhetha kwemvelo
distractor5c: Ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo lugcinwa kuphela kumaprotheni
question6: Ithini i-Enduring Understanding 2.D?
answer6: Ukukhula kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla kuthonywa izinguquko emvelweni
distractor6a: Zonke izimiso zemvelo azishintshi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor6b: Izinto eziphilayo kuphela ezithinta izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo
question7: Yini egcizelelwa yi-AP® Biology Learning Objective 2.24?
answer7: Ukuhlaziya idatha ukuze kutholakale ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo noma izinto ezingaphili kanye nezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo
distractor7a: Ukukhumbula amagama azo zonke i-biomes zasemanzini
distractor7b: Ukudweba izihlahla ze-phylogenetic zezinto eziphilayo zasolwandle

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Izici ze-Abiotic ezithonya ama-Biomes asemanzini
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Izici ze-Abiotic ezithonya ama-Biomes asemanzini
chapterContent:
Njenge-biomes yasemhlabeni, ama-biomes asemanzini athonywa uchungechunge lwezinto ezinga-abiotic. Indawo yasemanzini—amanzi— inezakhiwo ezihlukile zomzimba nezamakhemikhali kunomoya, nokho. Ngisho noma amanzi asechibini noma kwenye indawo yamanzi ecacile ngokuphelele (azikho izinhlayiya ezilengayo), amanzi, ngokwawo, amunca ukukhanya. Njengoba umuntu ehla emanzini ajulile, ekugcineni kuzoba nokujula okungenakufinyelelwa ukukhanya kwelanga. Ngenkathi kunezinye izici ezinga-abiotic nezi-biotic endaweni ezungezile engasitha ukukhanya (njengenkungu, uthuli, noma izixuku zezinambuzane), ngokuvamile lezi akuzona izici ezihlala njalo zemvelo. Ukubaluleka kokukhanya kuma-biomes asemanzini kubalulekile emiphakathini yezinto eziphilayo ezitholakala ezindaweni zemvelo zamanzi ahlanzekile nezasolwandle. Ezinhlelweni zamanzi ahlanzekile, ukwahlukaniswa ngenxa yokwehluka kobuningi mhlawumbe kuyisici esibaluleke kakhulu se-abiotic futhi kuhlobene nezici zamandla zokukhanya. Izakhiwo zamanzi ezishisayo (amazinga okushisa nokupholisa) zibalulekile ekusebenzeni kwezinhlelo zasolwandle futhi zinemiphumela emikhulu esimweni sezulu somhlaba kanye namaphethini esimo sezulu. Izinhlelo zasolwandle nazo zithonywa ukunyakaza kwamanzi amakhulu angokoqobo, njengemisinga; lezi azibalulekile kangako emachibini amaningi ahlanzekile.

 Ulwandle luhlukaniswe ngezindawo noma izindawo eziningana (Isithombe 35.21). Wonke amanzi avulekile olwandle abizwa ngokuthi indawo ye-pelagic (noma indawo). Indawo ye-benthic (noma indawo) inwebeka phansi kolwandle kusukela ogwini lolwandle kuya ezingxenyeni ezijulile kakhulu phansi kolwandle. Ngaphakathi kwendawo ye-pelagic kukhona indawo ye-photic, okuyingxenye yolwandle ukukhanya okungangena kuyo (cishe amamitha angu-200 noma angu-650). Ekujuleni okungaphezu kwamamitha angu-200, ukukhanya akukwazi ukungena; ngakho-ke, lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi indawo ye-photic. Iningi lolwandle alunawo umoya futhi alunawo ukukhanya okwanele kwe-photosynthesis. Ingxenye ejulile yolwandle, i-Challenger Deep (e-Mariana Trench, etholakala entshonalanga ye-Pacific Ocean), ijule cishe ngamamitha angu-11,000 (cishe ngamamitha angu-6.8). Ukuze kunikezwe umbono othile ngokujula kwalo msele, ulwandle, ngokwesilinganiso, lujule ngamamitha angu-4267 noma angu-14,000. Lezi zindawo nezindawo zihlobene namachibi amanzi ahlanzekile futhi
question1: Kungani ukukhanya kubhekwa njengenye yezinto ezibaluleke kakhulu ze-abiotic kuma-biomes asemanzini?
answer1: Ngoba amanzi amunca ukukhanya, anciphisa i-photosynthesis ngokujula okwandayo
question2: Kungani ukwahlukaniswa kwezindawo kuyisici esibalulekile se-abiotic ezindaweni zemvelo zamanzi ahlanzekile?
answer2: Kubangelwa umehluko ekubuneni kwamanzi futhi kuthinta ukusatshalaliswa kwamandla
question3: Izakhiwo zamanzi ezishisayo ziwuthinta kanjani uMhlaba?
answer3: Zithonya kakhulu izinhlelo zasolwandle, isimo sezulu somhlaba wonke, kanye namaphethini esimo sezulu
question4: Iyini indawo ye-pelagic?
answer4: Zonke izilwandle zivulekile amanzi
question5: Iyini indawo yase-benthic?
answer5: Iphansi lolwandle kusukela ogwini lolwandle kuya ezingxenyeni ezijulile kakhulu phansi kolwandle
distractor5c: Ingqimba lapho ukukhanya kwelanga kungena khona
question6: Iyini indawo yezithombe?
answer6: Ingxenye yolwandle lapho ukukhanya kungena khona ngokwanele ukuze kwenziwe i-photosynthesis
distractor6a: Indawo ejulile yolwandle lapho kungekho ukukhanya okufinyelela khona
distractor6c: Isifunda esiphakathi kokuphakama kwamanzi nokwehla kwamanzi
question7: Yini echaza indawo ye-aphotic?
answer7: Ayitholi ukukhanya okwanele kwe-photosynthesis
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.21. Amanzi olwandle athola inani elihlukahlukene lokukhanya kwelanga ngokusekelwe ekujuleni. Ungalindela kuphi ukuthola i-photosynthesis eningi kakhulu ku-biome yolwandle?
answer8: Indawo yezithombe
question9: Kungani iningi lolwandle lingasekeli i-photosynthesis?
answer9: Ngoba ingxenye enkulu yolwandle ingaphakathi kwendawo engcolile lapho ukukhanya kwelanga kungenakukwazi ukungena khona
distractor9a: Ngoba amanzi olwandle awanawo i-carbon dioxide
distractor9b: Ngoba amazinga okushisa olwandle ahlala engaphansi kweqhwa
distractor9c: Ngoba zonke izakhamzimba zigcinwa phansi kolwandle kuphela

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ulwandle
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ulwandle
chapterContent:
Ulwandle luyi-biome enkulu kunazo zonke zasolwandle. Luwumzimba oqhubekayo wamanzi anosawoti afanayo ngokwakhiwa kwamakhemikhali; luyisisombululo esibuthakathaka sikasawoti wamaminerali nezinto eziphilayo ezibolile. Ngaphakathi kolwandle, ama-coral reefs awuhlobo lwesibili lwe-biome yasolwandle. Izindawo zomfula, izindawo ezisogwini lapho amanzi anosawoti namanzi ahlanzekile axubana khona, zakha i-biome yesithathu ehlukile yasolwandle.

 Ulwandle
Ukuhlukahluka okubonakalayo kolwandle kuyithonya elikhulu ezitshalweni, ezilwaneni nakwezinye izinto eziphilayo. Ulwandle luhlukaniswe ngezindawo ezahlukene ngokusekelwe ekutheni ukukhanya kufinyelela kude kangakanani emanzini. Indawo ngayinye ineqembu elihlukile lezinhlobo ezivumelaniswe nezimo ze-biotic kanye ne-abiotic ikakhulukazi kuleyo ndawo.

 Indawo ephakathi kwamaza, okuyi-zone ephakathi kwamaza aphezulu naphansi, yisifunda solwandle esiseduze nomhlaba (Isithombe 35.21). Ngokuvamile, abantu abaningi bacabanga ngale ngxenye yolwandle njengolwandle olunesihlabathi. Kwezinye izimo, indawo ephakathi kwamaza empeleni iyibhishi elinesihlabathi, kodwa ingaba namatshe noma udaka. Indawo ephakathi kolwandle iyindawo eguquguqukayo kakhulu ngenxa yamagagasi. Izinto eziphilayo zivezwa emoyeni naselangeni lapho amanzi ephansi futhi zihlala ngaphansi kwamanzi isikhathi esiningi, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi solwandle oluphezulu. Ngakho-ke, izinto eziphilayo ezichuma endaweni ephakathi kolwandle ziyajwayela ukuba zome isikhathi eside. Ugu lwendawo ephakathi kolwandle luphinde lushaywe amagagasi ngokuphindaphindiwe, futhi izinto eziphilayo ezitholakala lapho ziyajwayela ukumelana nomonakalo ovela esenzweni sokusha kwamagagasi (Isithombe 35.22). Ama-exoskeletons ezilwane ezihlala ogwini (njengenkalankala yolwandle, i-Carcinus maenas) aqinile futhi awavikela ekomeni (ekomeni) nasekulimaleni kwamagagasi. Omunye umphumela wamagagasi ashaya ngamandla ukuthi zimbalwa izitshalo ezihlala emadwaleni ahamba njalo, esihlabathini, noma odakeni.

 Indawo ye-neritic (Isithombe 35.21) isuka endaweni ephakathi kolwandle iye ekujuleni okungaba ngu-200 m (noma 650 ft) emaphethelweni eshelufu lezwekazi. Njengoba ukukhanya kungangena kulokhu kujula, i-photosynthesis ingenzeka endaweni ye-neritic. Amanzi lapha aqukethe udaka futhi anomoya-mpilo omuhle, aphansi ekucindezelweni, futhi azinzile ekushiseni. I-Phytoplankton kanye ne-floating Sargassum (uhlobo lwe-free-floating seaweed) zinikeza indawo yokuhlala kwezinye izilwane zasolwandle ezitholakala endaweni ye-neritic. I-Zooplankton, ama-protist, izinhlanzi ezincane, kanye ne-shrimp zitholakala endaweni ye-neritic futhi ziyisisekelo se-food chain yezindawo eziningi zokudoba emhlabeni.

 Ngaphesheya kwendawo ye-neritic kukhona indawo evulekile yolwandle eyaziwa ngokuthi indawo ye-oceanic (Isithombe 35.21). Ngaphakathi kwendawo ye-oceanic kukhona ukuhlukaniswa kokushisa lapho amanzi afudumele nabandayo ehlangana khona ngenxa yemisinga yolwandle. I-plankton eningi isebenza njengesisekelo se-food chain yezilwane ezinkulu njengemikhomo namahlengethwa. Izakhamzimba azitholakali futhi lokhu kuyingxenye ekhiqiza kancane ye-biome yasolwandle. Lapho izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-photosynthesis kanye nama-protist kanye nezilwane ezidla kuzo zifa, imizimba yazo iwela phansi kolwandle lapho zihlala khona; ngokungafani namachibi ahlanzekile, ulwandle oluvulekile alunawo inqubo yokubuyisela izakhamzimba eziphilayo phezulu. Iningi lezinto eziphilayo endaweni ye-aphotic lifaka phakathi ama-sea cucumber (phylum Echinodermata) kanye nezinye izinto eziphilayo ezisinda ngezakhamzimba eziqukethwe ezidumbu zezinto eziphilayo endaweni ye-photic.

 Ngaphansi kwendawo ye-pelagic kukhona indawo ye-benthic, indawo yamanzi ngale kweshelufu lezwekazi eliqala ogwini futhi lidlulele ezindaweni ezijulile zolwandle (Isithombe 35.21). Ingxenye engezansi yendawo ye-benthic yakhiwe yisihlabathi, udaka, kanye nezinto eziphilayo ezifile. Izinga lokushisa liyancipha, lihlale ngaphezu kweqhwa, njengoba ukujula kwamanzi kukhuphuka. Lena ingxenye ecebile ngezakhamzimba yolwandle ngenxa yezinto eziphilayo ezifile eziwela ezingxenyeni eziphezulu zolwandle. Ngenxa yaleli zinga eliphezulu lezakhamzimba, kukhona ukuhlukahluka kwesikhunta, iziponji, ama-sea anemones, izibungu zasolwandle, izinkanyezi zasolwandle, izinhlanzi, kanye namabhaktheriya.

 Ingxenye ejulile yolwandle yindawo engaphansi komhlaba, ejulile ngamamitha angu-4000 noma ngaphezulu. Indawo engaphansi komhlaba (Isithombe 35.21) ibanda kakhulu futhi inomfutho ophezulu kakhulu, okuqukethwe umoya-mpilo okuphansi kakhulu noma okungenawo, kanye nokuqukethwe kwezakhamzimba okuphezulu njengoba izinto ezifile nezibolayo zisuka ezingqimbeni ezingenhla. Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane ezingenamgogodla nezinhlanzi ezitholakala kule ndawo, kodwa indawo engaphansi komhlaba ayinazo izitshalo ngenxa yokuntuleka kokukhanya. Imigodi yamanzi ashisayo itholakala ikakhulukazi endaweni engaphansi komhlaba; amabhaktheriya e-chemosynthetic asebenzisa i-hydrogen sulfide kanye namanye amaminerali akhishwa emithonjeni yamanzi ukuze akhiqize i-biomass. Lawa mabhaktheriya e-chemosynthetic asebenzisa ama-molecule ahlukahlukene njengomthombo wamandla futhi asebenza njengesisekelo seketanga lokudla elitholakala endaweni engaphansi komhlaba.
question1: Yisiphi isilwane sasolwandle esikhulu kunazo zonke emhlabeni?
answer1: Ulwandle
question2: Iyini indawo ephakathi kwamaza olwandle?
answer2: Indawo ephakathi kokuphakama kolwandle okuphezulu nokuphansi okuvezwa emoyeni futhi kucwiliswe emanzini
question3: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.22. Yikuphi ukuzivumelanisa nezimo okusiza izilwane ezihlala ogwini ukuba zisinde endaweni ephakathi kwamaza?
answer3: I-exoskeleton eqinile evikela ekulimaleni kwamagagasi kanye nokoma kwamagagasi
question4: Kungani i-photosynthesis ingenzeka endaweni ye-neritic?
answer4: Ngoba ukukhanya kwelanga kungena emanzini kuze kube lapha ekujuleni
question5: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezakha isisekelo sochungechunge lokudla endaweni ye-neritic?
answer5: I-Phytoplankton kanye ne-Sargassum entantayo
question6: Kungani ulwandle oluvulekile (indawo yolwandle) ngokuvamile lungatheli kakhulu kunendawo enesithukuthezi?
answer6: Izakhamzimba azitholakali kalula futhi ayikho inqubo yokubuyisela izakhamzimba eziphilayo endaweni engaphandle
question7: Yini echaza indawo engaphansi komhlaba?
answer7: Kungaphansi kolwandle, okucebile ngezakhamzimba ezivela ezintweni eziphilayo ezifile ezicwila phezulu
question8: Yiziphi izimo ezivamile endaweni engaphansi komhlaba?
answer8: Amazinga okushisa abandayo kakhulu, umfutho ophezulu, umoya-mpilo omncane noma awukho nhlobo, futhi akukho ukukhanya
distractor8a: Izinga lokushisa elifudumele, ukukhanya kwelanga okuningi, namahlathi aminyene
distractor8c: Amanzi angajulile anezinguquko ezivamile zokugeleza kwamanzi
question9: Amabhaktheriya e-chemosynthetic aseduze nemigodi yamanzi ashisayo athola kanjani amandla?
answer9: Ngokusebenzisa i-hydrogen sulfide kanye namanye amakhemikhali angaphili akhishwa emithonjeni yomoya

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Coral Reef
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Coral Reef
chapterContent:
Ulwandle luyi-biome enkulu kunazo zonke zasolwandle. Luwumzimba oqhubekayo wamanzi anosawoti afanayo ngokwakhiwa kwamakhemikhali; luyisisombululo esibuthakathaka sikasawoti wamaminerali nezinto eziphilayo ezibolile. Ngaphakathi kolwandle, ama-coral reefs awuhlobo lwesibili lwe-biome yasolwandle. Izindawo zomfula, izindawo ezisogwini lapho amanzi anosawoti namanzi ahlanzekile kuhlangana khona, zakha i-biome yesithathu ehlukile yasolwandle.

 Ama-Coral Reefs
Ama-coral reefs ayizindunduma zasolwandle ezakhiwe yizilwane ezingenamgogodla zasolwandle ezihlala emanzini afudumele angajulile ngaphakathi kwendawo ye-photic yolwandle. Atholakala ngaphakathi kwama-30 ̊ enyakatho naseningizimu ye-equator. I-Great Barrier Reef uhlelo lwama-reefs oludumile olutholakala ngamakhilomitha ambalwa ukusuka ogwini olusenyakatho-mpumalanga ye-Australia. Ezinye izinhlelo zama-coral reef ziyiziqhingi ezizungezile, eziseduze ngqo nomhlaba, noma ama-atoll, okuyizinhlelo zama-reef eziyindilinga ezizungeze indawo eyayingaphansi komhlaba manje. Izinto eziphilayo zama-coral (amalungu e-phylum Cnidaria) ziyikoloni zama-polyps amanzi anosawoti akhipha uhlaka lwe-calcium carbonate. La mathambo acebile nge-calcium aqoqana kancane kancane, akha ulwandle olungaphansi kwamanzi (Isithombe 35.23). Amakhorali atholakala emanzini angajulile (ajule cishe ngamamitha angu-60 noma cishe ngamamitha angu-200) anobuhlobo obuhambisanayo ne-algae ye-photosynthetic unicellular. Lobu budlelwano buhlinzeka amakhorali ngobuningi bokudla kanye namandla awadingayo. Amanzi lapho la makhorali ehlala khona awanele ngokomsoco futhi, ngaphandle kwalokhu kuxhumana, bekungeke kwenzeke ukuthi amakhorali amakhulu akhule. Amanye amakhorali ahlala emanzini ajulile nabandayo awanabo ubuhlobo obuhambisanayo ne-algae; la makhorali athola amandla kanye nezakhamzimba esebenzisa amaseli ahlabayo ezimpondweni zawo ukuze abambe inyamazane.

 Kulinganiselwa ukuthi izinhlobo zezinhlanzi ezingaphezu kuka-4,000 zihlala ezimpondweni zamakhorali. Lezi zinhlanzi zingadla amakhorali, i-cryptofauna (izilwane ezingenamgogodla ezitholakala ngaphakathi kwe-calcium carbonate substrate yamakhorali), noma ulwandle kanye ne-algae ezihlotshaniswa namakhorali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezinye izinhlobo zezinhlanzi zihlala emingceleni yolwandle lwamakhorali; Lezi zinhlobo zihlanganisa izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane, izilwane ezidla utshani, noma izilwane ezidla imifino. Izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane ziyizilwane ezizingelayo futhi ziyizilwane ezidla inyama noma ezidla inyama.” Izilwane ezidla utshani zidla izitshalo, kanti izilwane ezidla imifino zidla imifino.
question1: Zitholakala kuphi izindawo eziningi zamakhorali?
answer1: Emanzini afudumele, angajulile ngaphakathi kwendawo ye-phototic, ngokuvamile ngaphakathi kwama-30° enyakatho naseningizimu ye-equator
question2: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezakha ama-coral reefs?
answer2: Amakholoni ama-polyp ase-cnidarian asolwandle akhipha amathambo e-calcium carbonate
distractor2b: Izilwane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-crustacean ezakha izindunduma zesihlabathi
question3: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.23. Yiziphi izinto ezakha uhlaka lwamakhorali akha amatshe angaphansi komhlaba?
answer3: I-calcium carbonate
question4: Kungani amakhorali asemanzini angajulile ekwazi ukuchuma emanzini angenazo izakhamzimba?
answer4: Banobudlelwano obuhambisanayo ne-photosynthesis unicellular algae
distractor4c: Bathembele kuphela emanzini olwandle ukuze bathole ukudla okunempilo
question5: Amakhorali asemanzini ajulile akuthola kanjani ukudla ngaphandle kwe-photosynthetic algae?
answer5: Zisebenzisa amaseli ahlabayo ezintendeni zazo ukuze zibambe inyamazane
question6: Cishe zingaki izinhlobo zezinhlanzi ezilinganiselwa ukuthi zihlala ezihlahleni zamakhorali?
answer6: Izinhlobo ezingaphezu kuka-4,000
question7: Iyini i-cryptofauna?
answer7: Izilwane ezingenamgogodla ezihlala ngaphakathi kwe-calcium carbonate substrate yama-coral reefs
distractor7a: Ulwelwe oluncane oluhlala ngaphakathi kwamaseli e-coral
distractor7c: Amabhaktheriya olwandle olujulile eduze kwemigodi yamanzi ashisayo
question8: Iyini i-planktivore?
answer8: Isilwane esidla i-plankton
question9: Iyiphi inzuzo enikezwa yi-photosynthetic algae kuma-coral akha ama-reef?
answer9: Zinikeza iningi lamakhorali ukudla okunempilo kanye namandla ngokusebenzisa i-mutualism
distractor9b: Zivikela amakhorali ngokuhlaba izilwane ezidla ezinye

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Coral Reef | Ukuncipha Komhlaba Wonke Kwama-Coral Reef
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Coral Reef | Ukuncipha Komhlaba Wonke Kwama-Coral Reef
chapterContent:
Kuthatha isikhathi eside ukwakha i-coral reef. Izilwane ezakha i-coral reefs ziye zavela eminyakeni eyizigidi, ziqhubeka nokufaka kancane kancane i-calcium carbonate eyakha amakhaya azo ahlukile olwandle. Zihlanziwe emanzini afudumele asezindaweni ezishisayo, izilwane ze-coral kanye nabalingani bazo be-symbiotic algal bavela ukuze basinde emkhawulweni ophezulu wokushisa kwamanzi olwandle.

 Ndawonye, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kanye nomsebenzi wabantu kusongela kabili ekusindeni kwesikhathi eside kwe-coral reefs emhlabeni. Njengoba ukufudumala komhlaba ngenxa yokukhishwa kukaphethiloli wezinto zasendulo kuphakamisa amazinga okushisa olwandle, i-coral reefs iyahlupheka. Ukufudumala ngokweqile kubangela ukuthi i-coral ikhiphe i-algae yayo ehambisanayo, ekhiqiza ukudla, okuholela entweni eyaziwa ngokuthi i-bleaching. Lapho kwenzeka i-bleaching, i-coral reefs ilahlekelwa umbala wayo omningi njengoba i-algae nezilwane ze-coral zifa uma ukulahlekelwa yi-symbiotic zooxanthellae kuthatha isikhathi eside.

 Amazinga akhuphukayo e-carbon dioxide esemkhathini asongela ama-coral ngezinye izindlela; njengoba i-CO2 incibilika emanzini olwandle, yehlisa i-pH futhi ikhuphule i-acidity yolwandle. Njengoba i-asidi ikhula, iphazamisa i-calcification evame ukwenzeka njengoba izilwane zamakhorali zakha amakhaya azo e-calcium carbonate.

 Lapho i-coral reef iqala ukufa, ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo kwehla njengoba izilwane zilahlekelwa ukudla nendawo yokuhlala. I-coral reef nayo iyizindawo ezibalulekile zokuvakasha kwezomnotho, ngakho-ke ukwehla kwe-coral reefs kuyisongo esikhulu emnothweni wasogwini.

 Ukukhula kwabantu kuye kwalimaza amakhorali ngezinye izindlela. Njengoba inani labantu basogwini landa, ukugeleza kwenhlabathi kanye namakhemikhali ezolimo kuye kwanda, okwenza amanye amanzi asezindaweni ezishisayo ayesecwebezelisiwe abe namafu. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, ukudoba ngokweqile kwezinhlobo zezinhlanzi ezidumile kuye kwavumela izinhlobo zezilwane ezidla amakhorali ukuba zingalawulwa.

 Nakuba ukwenyuka kwamazinga okushisa omhlaba wonke angu-1–2 ̊C (ukubikezela kwesayensi okulondoloziwe) emashumini eminyaka ezayo kungase kungabonakali kukhulu, kubaluleke kakhulu kule biome. Lapho ushintsho lwenzeka ngokushesha, izinhlobo zingaphela ngaphambi kokuba ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuholele ekuzivumelaniseni okusha. Ososayensi abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi ukufudumala komhlaba, kanye nokukhula kwawo okusheshayo (ngokwesikhathi sokuziphendukela kwemvelo) kanye nokwenyuka okungenakuqhathaniswa kwezinga lokushisa, kunciphisa ibhalansi ngale kwephuzu lapho amadwala amaningi e-coral emhlabeni angalulama khona.
question1: Kungani ama-coral reef esengozini enkulu yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu?
answer1: Amakhorali ashintsha ahlala eduze komkhawulo ophezulu wamazinga okushisa olwandle, ngakho-ke ngisho nokwenyuka okuncane kungaba yingozi
distractor1c: Amakhorali adinga amazinga okushisa abandayo ukuze asinde
question2: Kuyini ukumhlopheza kwamakhorali?
answer2: Ukulahlekelwa yi-algae ehambisanayo evela kumakhorali ngenxa yokushisa kwamanzi ngokweqile
question3: Ukwanda kwe-carbon dioxide emoyeni kusongela kanjani ama-coral reefs?
answer3: Yehlisa i-pH yolwandle, ikhuphule i-acidity futhi iphazamise i-calcification
distractor3a: Kukhulisa amazinga e-oxygen futhi kuvimbela i-calcium
distractor3b: Kukhulisa usawoti wolwandle futhi kusheshise ukukhula kwamakhorali
distractor3c: Yehlisa ingcindezi yolwandle futhi incibilikise izakhiwo zamatshe angaphansi komhlaba
question4: Kungani i-calcification ibalulekile kumakhorali?
answer4: Ivumela amakhorali ukuthi akhe amathambo awo e-calcium carbonate
question5: Ukuncipha kwezindawo zamakhorali kuthinta kanjani ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo?
answer5: Ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo kwehla ngoba izinto eziphilayo eziningi zilahlekelwa ukudla nendawo yokuhlala
distractor5a: Ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo kuyanda ngoba izilwane ezidla ezinye ziyanyamalala
distractor5c: Ukuncipha kwama-coral reef akunawo umthelela omkhulu ezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo
question6: Imisebenzi yabantu ngaphandle kokushintsha kwesimo sezulu ingalimaza kanjani amadwala amakhorali?
answer6: Ukugeleza kwamanzi odaka, amakhemikhali ezolimo, kanye nokudoba ngokweqile kunegalelo ekunciphiseni amatshe asolwandle
distractor6a: Ukutshala izitshalo zasogwini kwandisa ukufa kwamatshe asogwini
distractor6b: Ukwanda kokugeleza kwamanzi ahlanzekile kuqinisa imifula yamakhorali
distractor6c: Ukunciphisa ingcindezi yokudoba kubangela ukumhlophe kwamakhorali
question7: Kungani ukudoba ngokweqile kuyingozi ezitsheni zamakhorali?
answer7: Kungavumela izinhlobo zezilwane ezidla amakhorali ukuthi zande zingalawulwa
question8: Kungani ama-coral reef angase angakwazi ukululama ekushiseni komhlaba okusheshayo?
answer8: Ushintsho lwemvelo lwenzeka ngokushesha kunokuba amakhorali angalushintsha ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor8b: Ukufudumala komhlaba kuthinta kuphela amakhorali olwandle olujulile
distractor8c: Amakhorali azala ngokushesha kakhulu ukuze avumelane nokubaluleka kwawo
question9: Iyini imiphumela yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni wonke kanye nokwanda kwamazinga e-carbon dioxide ezitsheni zamakhorali? Kuyithinta kanjani indawo ezungezile?
answer9: Ngenxa yokwenyuka kwezinga lokushisa, ama-coral reef alahlekelwa umlingani wawo wokubambisana, i-algae, enkambisweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-bleaching. Ukunyuka kwe-CO2 kushintsha i-pH yamanzi, okuphazamisa i-calcification. Izilwane ezithola ukudla kwazo kuyi-coral reef nazo ziyancipha ngamanani.
distractor9a: Ngenxa yokushisa okuphezulu, uhlaka oluqinile lwe-calcium carbonate lwama-coral reefs luyabhujiswa ngenxa yenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-bleaching. Ukunyuka kwe-CO2 kushintsha i-pH yamanzi okuphazamisa i-calcification. Izilwane ezithola ukudla kwazo kuyi-coral reefs nazo ziyancipha ngamanani.
distractor9b: Ngenxa yokwenyuka kwezinga lokushisa, ama-coral reefs alahlekelwa umlingani wawo wokubambisana, i-algae, enkambisweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-ocean acidification. Ukwenyuka kwe-CO2 kushintsha i-pH yamanzi, okuphazamisa i-calcification. Izilwane ezithola ukudla kwazo kuyi-coral reefs nazo ziyancipha ngamanani.
distractor9c: Ngenxa yokwenyuka kwezinga lokushisa, ama-coral reefs alahlekelwa umlingani wawo wokubambisana, i-algae. Ukwenyuka kwe-CO2 kushintsha i-pH yamanzi ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-bleaching. Izilwane ezithola ukudla kwazo kuyi-coral reefs nazo ziyancipha ngamanani.

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Imisele yamanzi: Lapho uLwandle luhlangana khona namanzi ahlanzekile
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Imisele yamanzi: Lapho uLwandle luhlangana khona namanzi ahlanzekile
chapterContent:
Imisele yamanzi yizinto eziphilayo ezenzeka lapho umthombo wamanzi ahlanzekile, njengomfula, uhlangana nolwandle. Ngakho-ke, kokubili amanzi ahlanzekile namanzi anosawoti atholakala endaweni efanayo; ukuxubana kuholela emanzini anosawoti axutshwe (angenasawoti). Imisele yamanzi yakha izindawo ezivikelwe lapho iningi lezingane ezincane zezilwane ezihlala emanzini, ama-mollusk, nezinhlanzi ziqala khona ukuphila kwazo. Usawoti uyisici esibaluleke kakhulu esithonya izinto eziphilayo kanye nokuzivumelanisa nezimo zezinto eziphilayo ezitholakala emanzini. Usawoti wamanzi amanzi uyahlukahluka futhi usekelwe esilinganisweni sokugeleza kwemithombo yawo yamanzi ahlanzekile. Kanye noma kabili ngosuku, amaza aphezulu aletha amanzi anosawoti emanzini. Amaza aphansi ayenzeka ngesivinini esifanayo aguqula ugesi wamanzi anosawoti.

 Ukwehluka kwesikhashana nokusheshayo kosawoti ngenxa yokuxubana kwamanzi ahlanzekile namanzi anosawoti kuyinselele enzima yempilo yezitshalo nezilwane ezihlala emanzini amanzi. Izinhlobo eziningi zezitshalo zamanzi angama-halophyte: izitshalo ezingabekezelela izimo ezinosawoti. Izitshalo ze-halophytic zijwayele ukubhekana nosawoti obangelwa amanzi anosawoti ezimpandeni zazo noma ekufakweni kolwandle. Kwezinye i-halophytes, izihlungi ezimpandeni zisusa usawoti emanzini adonswa yisitshalo. Ezinye izitshalo ziyakwazi ukupompa umoya-mpilo ezimpandeni zazo. Izilwane, njenge-mussels kanye ne-clams (phylum Mollusca), ziye zathuthukisa ukuzivumelanisa nokuziphatha okusebenzisa amandla amaningi ukusebenza kule ndawo eshintsha ngokushesha. Lapho lezi zilwane zivezwa kusawoti ophansi, ziyayeka ukudla, zivale amagobolondo azo, bese zishintsha ekuphefumuleni nge-aerobic (lapho zisebenzisa khona ama-gill) ziye ekuphefumuleni nge-anaerobic (inqubo engadingi umoya-mpilo). Lapho amanzi amaningi ebuyela esizalweni, usawoti kanye nokuqukethwe komoya-mpilo emanzini kuyanda, futhi lezi zilwane zivula amagobolondo azo, ziqale ukudla, bese zibuyela ekuphefumuleni nge-aerobic.
question1: Iyini ichweba lolwandle?
answer1: Indawo lapho amanzi ahlanzekile avela emifuleni ehlangana khona namanzi anosawoti avela olwandle, okudala amanzi anosawoti
distractor1a: Ichibi lamanzi ahlanzekile elingenalo uxhumano nolwandle
distractor1c: Idwala lamakhorali elitholakala emanzini ashisayo kuphela
question2: Kungani imifula ibalulekile ezilwaneni eziningi zasemanzini?
answer2: Zihlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala ezivikelwe lapho izinhlanzi eziningi ezincane, ama-crustacean, kanye nama-mollusk ziqala khona ukuphila kwazo
distractor2b: Yizona kuphela izindawo zokuhlala lapho izilwane ezincelisayo zasolwandle zizalela khona
question3: Yini eyinhloko ethonya izinto eziphilayo ezihlala emifuleni yamanzi?
answer3: Usawoti
question4: Kungani usawoti olwandle lushintsha phakathi nosuku?
answer4: Amaza aphezulu naphansi aletha futhi asuse amanzi anosawoti njalo
question5: Iyini i-halophyte?
answer5: Isitshalo esijwayele ukubekezelela izimo ezinosawoti
question6: Amanye ama-halophyte akunciphisa kanjani ukungenisa usawoti?
answer6: Basebenzisa izihlungi zezimpande ezisusa usawoti ngaphambi kokuba amanzi angene esitshalweni
question7: Izimbaza nama-clams zisabela kanjani uma zivezwa kusawoti ophansi?
answer7: Zivala amagobolondo azo, ziyeke ukudla, bese zishintshela ekuphefumuleni okungena-aerobic
question8: Kwenzekani lapho amanzi aphezulu ebuyela esizalweni somfula?
answer8: Ukwanda kosawoti nomoya-mpilo, okuvumela izimbaza nama-clams ukuthi aqale ukudla nokuphefumula nge-aerobic
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.24 kanye noMfanekiso 35.24.1. Amagrafu abonisa izinga lokushisa loLwandle lwaseCaribbean kulo lonke u-1995 ekujuleni okuhlukahlukene. Ukujula kwe-thermocline kushintsha kanjani phakathi nonyaka?
answer9: Ezinyangeni zasehlobo, i-thermocline iqala eduze kobuso
distractor9b: Ezinyangeni zasebusika, i-thermocline iqala eduze kobuso

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Biomes asemanzini ahlanzekile | Amachibi namachibi
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Biomes asemanzini ahlanzekile | Amachibi namachibi
chapterContent:
Ama-biome amanzi ahlanzekile afaka amachibi namachibi (amanzi amile) kanye nemifula nemifudlana (amanzi agelezayo). Afaka futhi izindawo ezimanzi, okuzoxoxwa ngazo kamuva. Abantu bathembele kuma-biome amanzi ahlanzekile ukuhlinzeka ngemithombo yamanzi okuphuza, ukunisela izitshalo, ukuhlanzeka, kanye nezimboni. Lezi zindima ezahlukahlukene kanye nezinzuzo zabantu kubizwa ngokuthi izinsizakalo zemvelo. Amachibi namachibi atholakala ezindaweni zomhlaba futhi, ngakho-ke, ahlobene nezici ze-abiotic kanye ne-biotic ezithonya la ma-biome amanzi.

 Amachibi namachibi
Amachibi namachibi angahluka ngobukhulu kusukela ku-square amamitha kuya ku-square kilogram amamitha . Izinga lokushisa liyisici esibalulekile se-abiotic esithinta izinto eziphilayo ezitholakala emachibini namachibini. Ehlobo, ukuhlukaniswa kwamachibi namachibi okushisa kwenzeka lapho ungqimba olungaphezulu lwamanzi lufudunyezwa yilanga futhi lungahlangani namanzi ajulile, apholile. Ukukhanya kungangena ngaphakathi kwendawo ye-phototic yechibi noma ichibi. I-Phytoplankton (i-algae kanye ne-cyanobacteria) itholakala lapha futhi yenza i-photosynthesis, ihlinzeka ngesisekelo sewebhu yokudla yamachibi namachibi. I-Zooplankton, njenge-rotifers kanye ne-crustaceans encane, idla lawa ma-phytoplankton. Ngaphansi kwamachibi namachibi, amabhaktheriya endaweni ye-aphotic aphula izinto eziphilayo ezifile ezicwila phansi.

 I-nitrogen ne-phosphorus zibalulekile ekuvimbeleni izakhamzimba emachibini namachibini. Ngenxa yalokhu, zinquma izici enanini lokukhula kwe-phytoplankton emachibini namachibini. Uma kukhona ukungenisa okukhulu kwe-nitrogen ne-phosphorus (kusuka emanzini angcolile kanye nokugeleza okuvela otshanini obuvundisiwe nasemapulazini, isibonelo), ukukhula kwe-algae kuyanda kakhulu, okuholela ekuqongeleleni okukhulu kwe-algae okubizwa ngokuthi i-algal bloom. Izimbali ze-algal (Isithombe 35.25) zingaba ziningi kangangokuthi zinciphisa ukungena kokukhanya emanzini. Ngenxa yalokho, ichibi noma ichibi liba yi-aphotic futhi izitshalo ze-photosynthetic azikwazi ukusinda. Lapho i-algae ifa futhi ibola, kwenzeka ukuncipha okukhulu komoya-mpilo wamanzi. Izinhlanzi nezinye izinto eziphilayo ezidinga umoya-mpilo zisengozini enkulu yokufa, futhi izindawo ezifile ezitholakalayo zitholakala emhlabeni wonke. ILake Erie kanye neGulf of Mexico zimelela izindawo zokuhlala zamanzi ahlanzekile nezasolwandle lapho ukulawulwa kwe-phosphorus kanye nokugeleza kwamanzi esiphepho kubangela izinselele ezinkulu zemvelo.
question1: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezimbili eziyinhloko ze-biomes zamanzi ahlanzekile okuxoxwe ngazo kulesi sigaba?
answer1: Amanzi amile (amachibi namachibi) namanzi agelezayo (imifula nemifudlana)
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo senkonzo ye-ecosystem enikezwa yi-freshwater biomes?
answer2: Ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi okuphuza, ukunisela, ukuhlanzeka, kanye namanzi ezimboni
question3: Yini ebangela ukuhlukaniswa kwezinga lokushisa emachibini nasemachibini ngesikhathi sasehlobo?
answer3: Ilanga lifudumeza ungqimba olungaphezulu lwamanzi, livimbele ukuthi luhlangane namanzi abandayo najulile
distractor3a: Imvula enkulu ipholisa amanzi angaphansi kuphela
distractor3b: Imimoya enamandla ixuba ngokuphelele ikholomu yamanzi
question4: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezakha isisekelo sewebhu yokudla emachibini nasemachibini?
answer4: I-phytoplankton efana ne-algae kanye ne-cyanobacteria
question5: Iyiphi indima edlalwa amabhaktheriya endaweni engavamile yamachibi namachibi?
answer5: Zibola izinto eziphilayo ezifile ezicwila phansi
question6: Yiziphi izakhamzimba ezivame ukuvimbela ukukhula kwe-phytoplankton emachibini nasemachibini?
answer6: I-nitrogen ne-phosphorus
question7: Kuyini ukuqhakaza kwe-algal?
answer7: Ukwanda okusheshayo kwe-algae okubangelwa izakhamzimba eziningi njenge-nitrogen ne-phosphorus
distractor7a: Ukufuduka kwe-algae ngezikhathi ezithile kuya emanzini ajulile
distractor7b: Ukufa kwazo zonke izinhlobo ze-algae ebusika
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.25. Kungani ukuqhakaza kwe-algal kungaholela ekubulaweni kwezinhlanzi nasezindaweni ezifile?
answer8: Ukubola kwenani elikhulu lolwelwe kuqeda umoya-mpilo oncibilikisiwe emanzini
distractor8a: I-algae idla ngokushesha konke ukukhanya kwelanga okutholakalayo
distractor8b: I-algae ikhulisa ukugcwala komoya-mpilo ngaphezu kwamazinga angasinda
distractor8c: I-algae iguqula amanzi ahlanzekile abe amanzi anosawoti
question9: Yimiphi imisebenzi yabantu evame ukuba nomthelela ekuqhakazeni kwe-algal?
answer9: Ukukhishwa kwendle kanye nokugeleza okucebile ngezakhamzimba okuvela otshanini nasemapulazini avundisiwe

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Biomes asemanzini ahlanzekile | Imifula nemifudlana
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Biomes asemanzini ahlanzekile | Imifula nemifudlana
chapterContent:
Ama-biome amanzi ahlanzekile afaka amachibi namachibi (amanzi amile) kanye nemifula nemifudlana (amanzi agelezayo). Afaka futhi izindawo ezimanzi, okuzoxoxwa ngazo kamuva. Abantu bathembele kuma-biome amanzi ahlanzekile ukuze banikeze izinsiza zasemanzini zamanzi okuphuza, ukunisela izitshalo, ukuhlanzeka, kanye nezimboni. Lezi zindima ezahlukahlukene kanye nezinzuzo zabantu kubizwa ngokuthi izinsizakalo zemvelo. Amachibi namachibi atholakala ezindaweni zomhlaba futhi, ngakho-ke, ahlobene nezici ze-abiotic kanye ne-biotic ezithonya la ma-biome amanzi asemhlabeni.

 Imifula Nemifudlana
Imifula nemifudlana iyimizimba yamanzi eqhubeka ihambisa amanzi amaningi esuka emthonjeni, noma emanzini ayinhloko, iye echibini noma olwandle. Imifula emikhulu ifaka uMfula iNayile e-Afrika, uMfula i-Amazon eNingizimu Melika, kanye noMfula iMississippi eNyakatho Melika.

 Izici ze-abiotic zemifula nemifudlana ziyahlukahluka ngobude bomfula noma umfudlana. Imifudlana iqala endaweni lapho ivela khona ebizwa ngokuthi amanzi omthombo. Amanzi omthombo avame ukubanda, abe nezakhamzimba ezincane, futhi acwebile. Umsele (ububanzi bomfula noma umfudlana) mncane kunanoma iyiphi enye indawo eduze kobude bomfula noma umfudlana. Ngenxa yalokhu, umfudlana uvame ukushesha lapha kunanoma iyiphi enye indawo yomfula noma umfudlana.

 Amanzi ahamba ngokushesha abangela ukuqongelela okuncane kwe-silt phansi komfula noma umfudlana; ngakho-ke, amanzi acacile. I-Photosynthesis lapha ihlotshaniswa kakhulu ne-algae ekhula emadwaleni; umfudlana osheshayo uvimbela ukukhula kwe-phytoplankton. Ukufakwa okwengeziwe kwamandla kungavela emaqabunga noma kwezinye izinto eziphilayo eziwela emfuleni noma umfudlana ezivela ezihlahleni nakwezinye izitshalo ezizungeze amanzi. Lapho amaqabunga ebola, izinto eziphilayo nezakhamzimba ezisemaqabungeni zibuyiselwa emanzini. Izitshalo nezilwane ziye zajwayela la manzi ahamba ngokushesha. Isibonelo, ezinye izinhlobo ze-mayfly (phylum Arthropoda) zinemizimba nemilenze eyisicaba enezinzipho eziguquliwe ukuze zibambelele ngaphansi kwamadwala angaphansi kwamanzi. Lolu hlobo lomzimba lunciphisa ukuhudula futhi luvumela lezi zinhlobo ukuthi zizuze ekugxilweni okuphezulu kwe-oxygen emifudlaneni ehamba ngokushesha ngaphandle kokukhishwa. Izinhlobo ze-trout zasemanzini ahlanzekile (i-phylum Chordata) ziyisilwane esibalulekile kulezi zimila nemifudlana ehamba ngokushesha.

 Njengoba umfula noma umfudlana ugeleza usuka emthonjeni, ububanzi bomsele buyanda kancane kancane futhi umsinga uyancipha. Lawa manzi ahamba kancane, abangelwa ukwehla kwe-gradient kanye nokwanda kwevolumu njengoba imifula ihlangana, anokuchitheka okukhulu. I-Phytoplankton ingafakwa emanzini ahamba kancane. Ngakho-ke, amanzi ngeke acwebe njengoba eseduze nomthombo. Amanzi nawo afudumele. Izibungu (i-phylum Annelida) nezinambuzane (i-phylum Arthropoda) zingatholakala zimboza odakeni. Izilwane ezinomgogodla ezidla ezinye (i-phylum Chordata) eziphakeme zihlanganisa izinyoni zasemanzini, amaxoxo, nezinhlanzi. Lezi zilwane ezidla ezinye kumele zithole ukudla kula manzi ahamba kancane, ngezinye izikhathi amnyama, futhi, ngokungafani ne-trout emanzini asemthonjeni, lezi zilwane ezinomgogodla zingase zingakwazi ukusebenzisa umbono njengomqondo wazo oyinhloko ukuthola ukudla. Esikhundleni salokho, kungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi zisebenzise izinkomba zokunambitha noma zamakhemikhali ukuthola inyamazane.
question1: Uyini umthombo (imithombo yamanzi) womfula noma umfudlana?
answer1: Iphuzu lomsuka lapho umfula noma umfudlana uqala khona
distractor1a: Indawo lapho umfula ungena khona olwandle
question2: Yiziphi izici ezichaza imithombo yamanzi emifuleni nasemifudlaneni?
answer2: Kubanda, kunezakhamzimba ezimbalwa, kucacile, futhi kuhamba ngokushesha
distractor2a: Kufudumele, kucebile ngezakhamzimba, futhi kuhamba kancane
question3: Kungani amanzi aseduze nomthombo womfula evame ukuba acwebile?
answer3: Ugesi osheshayo uvimbela ukungcola okukhulu ekuqongeleleni
question4: Kungani i-phytoplankton ingavamile kakhulu eduze kwamanzi emifula nemifudlana?
answer4: Umsinga osheshayo uvimbela ukukhula kwe-phytoplankton
distractor4a: Amanzi afudumele kakhulu ukuthi angafakwa ku-phytoplankton
question5: Yimuphi umthombo wamandla obalulekile wezinto eziphilayo ezihlala eduze komthombo womfudlana?
answer5: Amaqabunga nezinye izinto eziphilayo eziwela emanzini bese zibola
question6: Izimpukane ze-mayflies zijwayelana kanjani nokuphila emifuleni ehamba ngokushesha?
answer6: Zinemizimba eyisicaba kanye nezinzipho ezilungisiwe ezizisiza ukuba zinamathele emadwaleni
distractor6c: Bakhiqiza ama-web anamathelayo ukuze babambe ukudla
question7: Imifula ivame ukushintsha kanjani njengoba igeleza isuka emthonjeni wayo?
answer7: Isiteshi siyakhula, umsinga uyahamba kancane, futhi inhlabathi iyakhula
distractor7a: Isiteshi siyancipha futhi isivinini samanje siyakhuphuka
question8: Kungani amanzi angaphansi komfula evame ukuba mancane kakhulu kunasemthomboni?
answer8: Amaza ahamba kancane avumela inhlabathi eyengeziwe kanye ne-phytoplankton ukuthi ihlale imile
distractor8c: Umfula ulahlekelwa yizo zonke izakhamzimba zawo
question9: Kungani izilwane eziningi ezidla ezinye emanzini ahamba kancane emfuleni zithembele kakhulu ekunambithekeni noma ezinkombeni zamakhemikhali kunokubona?
answer9: Amanzi avame ukuba mnyama, okwenza ukubona kungasebenzi kahle ekutholeni izisulu
distractor9a: Amehlo abo ayayeka ukusebenza emanzini afudumele
distractor9c: Izimpawu zamakhemikhali zihamba ngokushesha kunokukhanya emanzini

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Izindawo ezimanzi
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.4 Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Ama-Biomes asemanzini | Izindawo ezimanzi
chapterContent:
Ama-biome amanzi ahlanzekile afaka amachibi namachibi (amanzi amile) kanye nemifula nemifudlana (amanzi agelezayo). Afaka futhi izindawo ezimanzi, okuzoxoxwa ngazo kamuva. Abantu bathembele kuma-biome amanzi ahlanzekile ukuze banikeze izinsiza zasemanzini zamanzi okuphuza, ukunisela izitshalo, ukuhlanzeka, kanye nezimboni. Lezi zindima ezahlukahlukene kanye nezinzuzo zabantu kubizwa ngokuthi izinsizakalo zemvelo. Amachibi namachibi atholakala ezindaweni zomhlaba futhi, ngakho-ke, ahlobene nezici ze-abiotic kanye ne-biotic ezithonya la ma-biome amanzi.

 Izindawo ezimanzi
Izindawo ezimanzi yizindawo lapho inhlabathi igcwala khona amanzi unomphela noma ngezikhathi ezithile. Izindawo ezimanzi zihlukile emachibini ngoba izindawo ezimanzi ziyimizimba yamanzi engajulile kanti amachibi ayahlukahluka ngokujula. Izitshalo ezikhulayo zakhiwa izitshalo zasemanzini ezigxile enhlabathini kodwa zinezingxenye zamaqabunga, iziqu, nezimbali ezinwebeka ngaphezu kobuso bamanzi. Kunezinhlobo eziningana zamanzi amanzi afaka phakathi amaxhaphozi, amaxhaphozi, amachibi, udaka, kanye namaxhaphozi anosawoti (Isithombe 35.26). Izici ezintathu ezihlanganyelwe phakathi kwalezi zinhlobo—okuzenza zibe yizindawo ezimanzi—yi-hydrology yazo, izitshalo ezimanzi, kanye nenhlabathi enamanzi.

 Amaxhaphozi namanzi ahlanzekile abonakala ngokugeleza kwamanzi okuhamba kancane nokuzinzile. Amaxhaphozi akhula ezindaweni lapho ukugeleza kwamanzi kuphansi noma kungekho khona. Amaxhaphozi avame ukuvela ezindaweni lapho kukhona phansi kobumba okunokungcola okuncane. Ukuqhekeka ukuhamba kwamanzi ngemigodi enhlabathini noma emadwaleni. Amanzi atholakala exhaphozini amile futhi umoya-mpilo uyancipha ngoba umoya-mpilo osetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokubola kwezinto eziphilayo awuthathelwa indawo. Njengoba umoya-mpilo emanzini uphela, ukubola kuyehla. Lokhu kuholela kuma-acid e-organic namanye ama-acid akhiwa futhi ehlise i-pH yamanzi. Nge-pH ephansi, i-nitrogen ayitholakali ezitshalweni. Lokhu kudala inselele ezitshalweni ngoba i-nitrogen iwumthombo obalulekile ovimbelayo. Ezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo zamanzi (njenge-sundews, izitshalo ze-pitcher, kanye ne-Venus flytraps) zibamba izinambuzane futhi zikhiphe i-nitrogen emizimbeni yazo. Ama-bog anezinga eliphansi lokukhiqiza ngoba amanzi atholakala ema-bog anamazinga aphansi e-nitrogen ne-oxygen.
question1: Iyini isici esichaza indawo emanzi?
answer1: Inhlabathi igcwala amanzi unomphela noma ngezikhathi ezithile
question2: Amaxhaphozi ahluke kanjani emachibini?
answer2: Izindawo ezimanzi ziyimithombo yamanzi engajulile, kanti amachibi ahlukahluka kakhulu ngokujula
distractor2a: Izindawo ezimanzi ziqukethe amanzi anosawoti, kanti amachibi aqukethe amanzi ahlanzekile
distractor2b: Izindawo ezimanzi zigeleza amanzi ngokushesha kunamachibi
question3: Kuyini izimila ezisafufusa?
answer3: Izitshalo ezigxile enhlabathini ezineziqu, amaqabunga, noma izimbali ezinwebeka ngaphezu kwamanzi
question4: Yiziphi izici ezintathu ezichaza wonke amaxhaphozi?
answer4: I-Hydrology, izitshalo ezimanzi, kanye nenhlabathi enamanzi
distractor4a: Amanzi ajulile, usawoti omningi, kanye nenhlabathi enesihlabathi
distractor4b: Izinga lokushisa elibandayo, izihlahla ze-coniferous, kanye ne-permafrost
distractor4c: Amaza asheshayo, amatshe angaphansi, kanye namazinga aphezulu e-oxygen
question5: Kungani amanzi asezindaweni zamachibi evame ukuba nomoya-mpilo ophansi?
answer5: Ukugeleza kwamanzi kuphansi kakhulu noma akukho, ngakho-ke umoya-mpilo osetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokubola awushintshwa
question6: Kungani amadamu ngokuvamile enamanzi ane-asidi?
answer6: Ukubola kancane kubangela ukuthi ama-asidi e-organic aqongelelane
distractor6a: Amaza olwandle aletha amanzi olwandle ane-asidi emachibini
question7: Kungani i-nitrogen ivame ukungatholakali ezitshalweni ezisemabhodweni?
answer7: I-pH ephansi yenza i-nitrogen ingatholakali
distractor7b: Amabhaktheriya aguqula yonke i-nitrogen ibe yi-oxygen
question8: Izitshalo ezidla inyama njenge-Venus flytraps kanye nezitshalo ze-pitcher zithola kanjani i-nitrogen?
answer8: Zibamba izinambuzane futhi zikhiphe i-nitrogen emizimbeni yazo
question9: Kungani ama-bog enomkhiqizo ophansi oyisisekelo?
answer9: Ziqukethe amazinga aphansi e-nitrogen kanye nomoya-mpilo, okunciphisa ukukhula kwezitshalo
distractor9c: Amanzi ageleza ngokushesha kakhulu ukuthi izitshalo zingazinza

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.5 Isimo Sezulu kanye Nemiphumela Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba Wonke | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.5 Isimo Sezulu kanye Nemiphumela Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba Wonke | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Zombili i-biome zomhlaba kanye neyasemanzini zithintwa yizimo zomhlaba, njengesimo sezulu. Ososayensi baphawule izinguquko eziphawulekayo ezishintshe amaphethini esimo sezulu emhlabeni. Ngokubambisana, lezi zinguquko zibizwa ngokuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni wonke futhi zifaka phakathi ukwanda kwezinga lokushisa emhlabeni wonke ngenxa yokwenyuka kwamazinga e-carbon dioxide esemkhathini. Kunezimbangela eziningana zokuguquka kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni wonke, okuhlanganisa nemisebenzi yabantu. Imiphumela yomsebenzi womuntu kwezinye izici zemvelo izohlolwa esahlukweni se-Conservation Biology kanye ne-Biodiversity.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 4 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 4
Izinhlelo zebhayoloji ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezicini eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezizungezile kuphumela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo kanye nezibikezelo mayelana nezehlakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi kanye namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda

question4: Ngokusho kwendima, iyiphi imbangela eyodwa yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni wonke?
answer4: Imisebenzi yabantu

answer5: Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lokhu kusebenzisana kunezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi
