chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.5 Isimo Sezulu kanye Nemiphumela Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba Wonke | Isimo Sezulu kanye Nesimo Sezulu
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.5 Isimo Sezulu kanye Nemiphumela Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba Wonke | Isimo Sezulu kanye Nesimo Sezulu
chapterContent:
Umbono ovamile ongalungile mayelana nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu somhlaba wonke ukuthi isenzakalo esithile sezulu esenzeka esifundeni esithile (isibonelo, isonto elipholile kakhulu ngoJuni enkabeni ye-Indiana) siwubufakazi bokushintsha kwesimo sezulu somhlaba wonke. Kodwa-ke, isonto elibandayo ngoJuni liyisenzakalo esihlobene nesimo sezulu hhayi esihlobene nesimo sezulu. Le mibono engalungile ivame ukuvela ngenxa yokudideka mayelana nesimo sezulu nesimo sezulu.

 Isimo sezulu sibhekisela ezimweni zomkhathi zesikhathi eside, ezibikezelwayo zendawo ethile. Isimo sezulu se-biome sibonakala ngokuba nokushisa okuhambisanayo kanye nezikhathi zemvula zonyaka. Isimo sezulu asibheki inani lemvula elawa ngosuku oluthile ku-biome noma amazinga okushisa abandayo kunesilinganiso enzeke ngosuku olulodwa. Ngokuphambene nalokho, isimo sezulu sibhekisela ezimweni zomkhathi ngesikhathi esifushane. Izibikezelo zesimo sezulu zivame ukwenziwa ngemijikelezo yamahora angu-48. Izibikezelo zesimo sezulu zesikhathi eside ziyatholakala kodwa zingathembeki.

 Ukuze uqonde kangcono umehluko phakathi kwesimo sezulu nesimo sezulu, cabanga ukuthi uhlela umcimbi wangaphandle enyakatho yeWisconsin. Ubungacabanga ngesimo sezulu uma uhlela umcimbi ehlobo kunokuba uhlele ebusika ngoba unolwazi lwesikhathi eside lokuthi noma yimuphi uMgqibelo onikeziwe ezinyangeni zikaMeyi kuya ku-Agasti uzoba yisinqumo esingcono somcimbi wangaphandle eWisconsin kunanoma yimuphi uMgqibelo onikeziwe ngoJanuwari. Kodwa-ke, awukwazi ukunquma usuku oluthile umcimbi okufanele ubanjelwe ngalo ngoba kunzima ukubikezela ngokunembile isimo sezulu ngosuku oluthile. Isimo sezulu singabhekwa njengesimo sezulu esijwayelekile.
question1: Siyini isimo sezulu?
answer1: Izimo zezulu zesikhathi eside nezibikezelayo zendawo ethile
question2: Siyini isimo sezulu?
answer2: Izimo zomkhathi ngesikhathi esifushane
distractor2a: Izimo zezulu ezimaphakathi zesikhathi eside zesifunda
distractor2c: Izinga lokushisa elimaphakathi eminyakeni embalwa edlule
question3: Yikuphi okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sezulu kunesimo sezulu?
answer3: Isonto elipholile ngoJuni enkabeni ye-Indiana
distractor3a: Imvula ejwayelekile yonyaka yehlathi lemvula lasezindaweni ezishisayo
distractor3b: Amazinga okushisa ajwayelekile asebusika e-Arctic tundra
distractor3c: Isimo sezulu sesikhathi eside enyakatho yeWisconsin
question4: Yiziphi izici ezivame ukusetshenziswa ukuchaza isimo sezulu se-biome?
answer4: Izinga lokushisa elihambisanayo kanye nezinga lemvula yonyaka
distractor4a: Isivinini somoya sansuku zonke kanye nesembozo samafu
question5: Kungani izibikezelo zezulu zesikhathi eside ngokuvamile zingathembeki kakhulu kunezibikezelo zesikhathi esifushane?
answer5: Isimo sezulu kunzima ukusibikezela ngokunembile esikhathini esizayo
distractor5c: Isimo sezulu sincike kuphela emvuleni yonyaka
question6: Kungani umuntu ohlela umcimbi wangaphandle enyakatho yeWisconsin engakhetha ihlobo esikhundleni sobusika?
answer6: Ngoba isimo sezulu sibonisa ukuthi ihlobo ngokuvamile linezimo ezinhle kakhulu
distractor6a: Ngoba izibikezelo zezulu zinembile eminyakeni eminingi kusengaphambili
distractor6c: Ngoba isimo sezulu sibikezela isimo sezulu esiqondile ngosuku oluthile
question7: Kungani isimo sezulu singakwazi ukunquma usuku olufanele kakhulu lomcimbi wangaphandle?
answer7: Ngoba isimo sezulu sichaza isilinganiso sesikhathi eside, kuyilapho izimo zansuku zonke zincike esimweni sezulu
distractor7a: Ngoba isimo sezulu siyashintsha njalo emahoreni angu-48
distractor7b: Ngoba isimo sezulu nesimo sezulu kuyafana
distractor7c: Ngoba isimo sezulu silinganisa imvula kuphela
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwesimo sezulu nesimo sezulu?
answer8: Isimo sezulu singabhekwa njengesimo sezulu esijwayelekile isikhathi eside
distractor8a: Isimo sezulu yisimo sezulu esijwayelekile eminyakeni eminingi
distractor8b: Isimo sezulu nesimo sezulu kuhlale kuchaza izimo ezifanayo
distractor8c: Isimo sezulu sibhekisela ekushiseni kuphela, kanti isimo sezulu sibhekisela emvuleni kuphela

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.5 Isimo Sezulu Nemiphumela Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba Wonke | Ukushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba Wonke | Ubufakazi Bokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba Wonke
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.5 Isimo Sezulu Nemiphumela Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba Wonke | Ukushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba Wonke | Ubufakazi Bokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba Wonke
chapterContent:
Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kungaqondwa ngokubheka izindawo ezintathu zocwaningo:

 ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu komhlaba kwamanje nokwedlule
izimbangela zokushintsha kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni jikelele kwangesikhathi esidlule nanamuhla
imiphumela yasendulo neyamanje yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu
Kuyasiza ukugcina lezi zici ezintathu ezahlukene zokushintsha kwesimo sezulu zihlukaniswe ngokucacile lapho kucutshungulwa imibiko yabezindaba mayelana nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni jikelele. Kuvamile ukuthi imibiko nezingxoxo mayelana nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni wonke zididanise idatha ekhombisa ukuthi isimo sezulu soMhlaba siyashintsha nezinto ezibangela lolu shintsho lwesimo sezulu.

 Ubufakazi Bokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba Wonke
Njengoba ososayensi bengakwazi ukubuyela emuva ngesikhathi ukuze balinganise ngqo izinguquko zesimo sezulu, njengokushisa okumaphakathi kanye nemvula, kumele balinganise izinga lokushisa ngokungaqondile. Ukuze benze lokhu, ososayensi bathembele ebufakazini bomlando besimo sezulu soMhlaba esidlule.

 I-Antarctic ice cores iyisibonelo esibalulekile sobufakazi obunjalo. Lezi zinhlobo zeqhwa ziyizibonelo zeqhwa elisezindaweni ezibandayo ezitholakala ngokusebenzisa imishini yokubhoboza efinyelela izinkulungwane amamitha emaphepheni eqhwa noma ezintabeni eziphakeme zeqhwa. Ukubuka izinhlobonhlobo zeqhwa kufana nokuhamba emuva ngesikhathi; Uma isampula ijula, isikhathi sishesha. Kuboshwe ngaphakathi kweqhwa kukhona amabhamuza omoya kanye nobunye ubufakazi bezinto eziphilayo obungadalula idatha yokushisa kanye ne-carbon dioxide. I-Antarctic ice cores iqoqwe futhi yahlaziywa ukuze kulinganiswe ngokungaqondile izinga lokushisa loMhlaba eminyakeni engu-400,000 edlule (Isithombe 35.27a). Idatha emelelwe kuMfanekiso 35.27 iyisibonelo sokuhlaziywa okunjalo. I-0 °C kule grafu ibhekisela esilinganisweni sesikhathi eside. Izinga lokushisa elikhulu kune-0 °C lidlula izinga lokushisa elijwayelekile loMhlaba isikhathi eside. Ngokuphambene nalokho, izinga lokushisa elingaphansi kwe-0 °C lingaphansi kwezinga lokushisa elijwayelekile loMhlaba. Lesi sibalo sibonisa ukuthi kube nemijikelezo yesikhathi esithile yokushisa okwandayo nokwehla.

 Ngaphambi kweminyaka yama-1800, uMhlaba ubupholile ngamaphesenti angu-9 °C futhi ufudumele ngamaphesenti angu-3. Qaphela ukuthi igrafu kuMfanekiso 35.27b ikhombisa ukuthi izinga lokushisa elisemkhathini le-carbon dioxide nalo likhuphuke futhi lehla ngemijikelezo yesikhathi; qaphela ubudlelwano phakathi kokuhlushwa kwe-carbon dioxide kanye nezinga lokushisa. Isibalo 35.27b sibonisa ukuthi amazinga e-carbon dioxide emoyeni abelokhu ejikeleza phakathi kwezingxenye ezingu-180 no-300 ngesigidi (ppm) ngokomlando.

 Isibalo 35.27a asibonisi iminyaka engu-2,000 edlule ngemininingwane eyanele yokuqhathanisa izinguquko zokushisa koMhlaba eminyakeni engu-400,000 edlule nokushintsha kokushisa okwenzeke muva nje. Kuye kwenzeka izinto ezimbili ezibalulekile zokushisa, noma ukungahleleki, eminyakeni engu-2000 edlule. Lezi yi-Medieval Climate Anomaly (noma i-Medieval Warm Period) kanye ne-Little Ice Age. I-third temperature anomaly ihambisana ne-Industrial Era. I-Medieval Climate Anomaly yenzeka phakathi kuka-900 no-1300 AD. Phakathi nalesi sikhathi, ososayensi abaningi besimo sezulu bacabanga ukuthi izimo zezulu ezifudumele kancane zazikhona ezingxenyeni eziningi zomhlaba; izinguquko zokushisa eziphakeme kunesilinganiso zazihluka phakathi kuka-0.10 °C no-0.20 °C ngaphezu kwesilinganiso. Nakuba i-0.10 °C ibonakala ingekho ngokwanele ukukhiqiza ushintsho olubonakalayo, yakhulula ulwandle lweqhwa. Ngenxa yalokhu kufudumala, amaViking akwazi ukuhlala eGreenland.

 I-Little Ice Age kwakuyinkathi yokubanda eyenzeka phakathi kuka-1550 AD no-1850 AD. Phakathi nalesi sikhathi, ukupholisa okuncane okungaphansi kancane kuka-1 °C kwabonakala eNyakatho Melika, eYurophu, futhi mhlawumbe nakwezinye izindawo zoMhlaba. Lokhu kushintsha kwe-1 °C ekushiseni komhlaba wonke kuwukuhluka okuncane ekushiseni (njengoba kwabonakala ngesikhathi se-Medieval Climate Anomaly); noma kunjalo, kwaholela nasekushintsheni okubonakalayo. Ukulandisa komlando kwembula isikhathi sobusika obunzima kakhulu obuneqhwa nesithwathwa esiningi.

 I-Industrial Revolution, eyaqala cishe ngo-1750, yabonakala ngezinguquko emphakathini omkhulu wesintu. Intuthuko kwezolimo yandisa ukutholakala kokudla, okwathuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu eYurophu nase-United States. Kwasungulwa ubuchwepheshe obusha futhi kwahlinzeka ngemisebenzi kanye nezimpahla ezishibhile. Lawa ma-technologies amasha asebenza kusetshenziswa uphethiloli, ikakhulukazi amalahle. Inguquko Yezimboni eyaqala ekuqaleni kwekhulu leshumi nesishiyagalolunye yaqala ekuqaleni kweNkathi Yezimboni. Lapho uphethiloli wezinto zasendulo ushiswa, kukhishwa ikhabhoni dioksijini. Ekuqaleni kweNkathi Yezimboni, ikhabhoni dioksijini esemkhathini yaqala ukukhuphuka (Isithombe 35.28)
question1: Yiziphi izindawo ezintathu eziyinhloko zocwaningo ezisetshenziswa ukuqonda ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu?
answer1: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kwamanje nokwesikhathi esidlule emhlabeni wonke, izimbangela zokushintsha kwesimo sezulu kwasendulo nokwamanje, kanye nemiphumela yasendulo neyamanje yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu
distractor1a: Ukubikezela isimo sezulu, imisinga yolwandle, kanye nokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor1b: Ukuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo, ukuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo, kanye nokuzamazama komhlaba
question2: Kungani ososayensi befunda ngezindawo ezibandayo zase-Antarctica?
answer2: Ziqukethe amabhamuza omoya avalelekile kanye nobunye ubufakazi obuvumela ososayensi ukuthi balinganise amazinga okushisa adlule kanye namazinga e-carbon dioxide asemkhathini
distractor2b: Baqopha izinhlobo zezitshalo eziguqulwe zaba yizinsalela kuphela
question3: Kudala kangakanani i-Antarctic ice cores isetshenziswe ukukala isimo sezulu soMhlaba?
answer3: Cishe iminyaka engu-400,000
question4: Ngokusho koMfanekiso 35.27, yibuphi ubuhlobo obukhona ngokomlando phakathi kwe-carbon dioxide esemkhathini kanye nokushisa komhlaba wonke?
answer4: Ukuhlushwa kwe-carbon dioxide kanye nokushisa komhlaba wonke kuye kwanda futhi kwehla ndawonye
distractor4a: I-carbon dioxide kanye nokushisa kuye kwashintsha njalo ngezindlela eziphambene
distractor4b: I-carbon dioxide ibilokhu injalo ngenkathi izinga lokushisa lishintsha
distractor4c: Izinga lokushisa lishintsha ngaphandle kwe-carbon dioxide
question5: Yayiyini i-Medieval Climate Anomaly?
answer5: Isikhathi sokushisa okufudumele kancane kunesilinganiso esiphakathi kuka-900 AD no-1300 AD
distractor5a: Isikhathi sokupholisa umhlaba wonke ngesikhathi seNguquko Yezimboni
distractor5b: Isikhathi lapho iziqhwa zanyamalala khona ngokuphelele
distractor5c: Isenzakalo sentaba-mlilo esabangela ukufudumala komhlaba wonke
question6: Yayiyini iNkathi Yeqhwa Elincane?
answer6: Isikhathi sokushisa okupholile phakathi kuka-1550 AD no-1850 AD
distractor6a: Isikhathi sokufudumala okukhulu phakathi kuka-1550 AD no-1850 AD
distractor6b: Isikhathi esibanda kakhulu emlandweni wonke woMhlaba
distractor6c: Umcimbi omfushane wokupholisa owathatha iminyaka embalwa kuphela
question7: I-Industrial Revolution yathinta kanjani amazinga e-carbon dioxide emoyeni?
answer7: Ukushiswa kabanzi kwezinto zokubasa ezimbiwa phansi kubangele ukwanda kwezinga le-carbon dioxide emoyeni
distractor7a: Amazinga e-carbon dioxide ehlile ngoba amahlathi anda
question8: Kungani kubalulekile ukuhlukanisa phakathi kobufakazi bokushintsha kwesimo sezulu kanye nezimbangela zokushintsha kwesimo sezulu?
answer8: Ubufakazi bubonisa ukuthi isimo sezulu siyashintsha, kanti ucwaningo oluhlukile lwesayensi luthola izinto ezibangela lezo zinguquko.
distractor8a: Ubufakazi bufakazela ngokuzenzakalelayo yonke imbangela ephakanyisiwe
distractor8b: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu akunazo izimbangela ezibonakala
distractor8c: Idatha yesimo sezulu kuphela engahlonza ushintsho lwesimo sezulu
question9: Yisiphi isenzakalo esingokomlando esavumela amaViking ukuthi athathe iGreenland njengekoloni?
answer9: Izimo ezifudumele ngesikhathi se-Medieval Climate Anomaly zanciphisa iqhwa lolwandle
distractor9a: I-Little Ice Age yandise umkhiqizo wezolimo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.5 Isimo Sezulu Nemiphumela Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba | Ukushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba | Abashayeli Bamanje Nabesikhathi Esidlule Bokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.5 Isimo Sezulu Nemiphumela Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba | Ukushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba | Abashayeli Bamanje Nabesikhathi Esidlule Bokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba
chapterContent:
Njengoba kungenakwenzeka ukubuyela emuva esikhathini ukuze kubonwe ngqo futhi kulinganiswe isimo sezulu, ososayensi basebenzisa ubufakazi obungaqondile ukuthola abaqhubi, noma izici, ezingaba yimbangela yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu. Ubufakazi obungaqondile buhlanganisa idatha eqoqwe kusetshenziswa i-ice cores, imigodi emincane (umgodi omncane obhobozwe emhlabathini), amasongo ezihlahla, ubude beqhwa, izinsalela zempova, kanye nenhlabathi yolwandle. Imininingwane ikhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwesikhathi sokushintsha kwezinga lokushisa kanye nabaqhubi bokushintsha kwesimo sezulu: ngaphambi kweNkathi Yezimboni (ngaphambi kuka-1780), kwakukhona abaqhubi abathathu bokushintsha kwesimo sezulu ababengahlobene nomsebenzi womuntu noma amagesi omoya. Owokuqala walokhu imijikelezo yeMilankovitch. Imijikelezo yeMilankovitch ichaza imiphumela yezinguquko ezincane ekujikelezeni koMhlaba esimweni sezulu soMhlaba. Ubude bemijikelezo yeMilankovitch buphakathi kweminyaka eyi-19,000 neyi-100,000. Ngamanye amazwi, umuntu angalindela ukubona izinguquko ezithile ezibikezelwayo esimweni sezulu soMhlaba ezihlobene nezinguquko ekujikelezeni koMhlaba okungenani njalo eminyakeni eyi-19,000.

 Ukwehluka kwamandla elanga kuyisici sesibili semvelo esibangela ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu. Amandla elanga yinani lamandla elanga noma amandla ilanga eliwakhiphayo ngesikhathi esithile. Kukhona ubudlelwano obuqondile phakathi kwamandla elanga kanye nokushisa. Njengoba amandla elanga enyuka (noma ehla), izinga lokushisa loMhlaba liyanda (noma lehla ngokufanayo). Izinguquko kumandla elanga ziye zaphakanyiswa njengenye yezincazelo eziningana ezingaba khona zeNkathi Yeqhwa Encane.

 Okokugcina, ukuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo kuyimbangela yesithathu yemvelo yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu. Ukuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo kungahlala izinsuku ezimbalwa, kodwa izinto eziqinile namagesi akhishwa ngesikhathi sokuqhuma kungathinta isimo sezulu esikhathini seminyaka embalwa, okubangela izinguquko zesimo sezulu zesikhashana. Amagesi nezinto eziqinile ezikhishwa ukuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo zingafaka i-carbon dioxide, umhwamuko wamanzi, i-sulfur dioxide, i-hydrogen sulfide, i-hydrogen, kanye ne-carbon monoxide. Ngokuvamile, ukuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo kuyapholisa isimo sezulu. Lokhu kwenzeka ngo-1783 lapho izintaba-mlilo e-Iceland ziqhuma futhi zabangela ukukhishwa kwenani elikhulu le-sulfuric oxide. Lokhu kwaholela ekupholiseni komphumela womhwamuko, into eyenzeka emhlabeni wonke lapho uthuli, umlotha, noma ezinye izinhlayiya ezilengayo zivimba ukukhanya kwelanga futhi zibangele amazinga okushisa aphansi omhlaba ngenxa yalokho; ukupholisa komphumela womhwamuko kuvame ukuqhubeka unyaka owodwa noma ngaphezulu. EYurophu naseNyakatho Melika, ukupholisa komphumela womhwamuko kwakhiqiza amanye amazinga okushisa aphansi kakhulu asebusika aqoshwe ngo-1783 nango-1784.

 Amagesi okushisa cishe yiwona abangela isimo sezulu esibaluleke kakhulu. Lapho amandla okushisa avela elangeni eshaya uMhlaba, amagesi aziwa ngokuthi amagesi okushisa abamba ukushisa emkhathini, njengoba kwenza amaphaneli engilazi endlu yokushisa avimbela ukushisa ukuba kuphume. Amagesi okushisa athinta uMhlaba afaka phakathi i-carbon dioxide, i-methane, umhwamuko wamanzi, i-nitrous oxide, ne-ozone. Cishe ingxenye yemisebe evela elangeni idlula kula magesi asemkhathini bese ishaya uMhlaba. Lo mhwamuko uguqulwa ube imisebe yokushisa ebusweni boMhlaba, bese ingxenye yalawo mandla ibuyiselwa emuva emkhathini. Nokho, amagesi okushisa abonakalisa amandla amaningi okushisa abuyele ebusweni boMhlaba. Uma amagesi okushisa aphezulu emkhathini eba maningi, kulapho amandla okushisa amaningi ebonakala khona ebusweni boMhlaba. Amagesi okushisa adonsa futhi akhiphe imisebe futhi ayisici esibalulekile emphumeleni wokushisa: ukufudumala koMhlaba ngenxa ye-carbon dioxide namanye amagesi okushisa emkhathini.

 Ubufakazi busekela ubudlelwano phakathi kokugcwala kwe-carbon dioxide emoyeni kanye nokushisa: njengoba i-carbon dioxide ikhuphuka, izinga lokushisa lomhlaba liyakhuphuka. Kusukela ngo-1950, ukugcwala kwe-carbon dioxide emoyeni kuye kwanda kusuka cishe ku-280 ppm kuya ku-382 ppm ngo-2006. Ngo-2011, ukugcwala kwe-carbon dioxide emoyeni kwakungama-392 ppm. Kodwa-ke, iplanethi ibingeke ihlalwe yizinhlobo zokuphila zamanje ukube umhwamuko wamanzi awuzange ukhiqize umphumela wawo omkhulu wokufudumala kwe-greenhouse.

 Ososayensi babheka amaphethini kudatha futhi bazama ukuchaza umehluko noma ukuphambuka kula maphethini. Idatha ye-carbon dioxide emoyeni yembula iphethini yomlando ye-carbon dioxide ekhuphuka futhi yehla, ijikeleza phakathi kwe-180 ppm ephansi kanye ne-300 ppm ephezulu. Ososayensi baphethe ngokuthi kuthathe iminyaka ecishe ibe ngu-50,000 ukuthi izinga le-carbon dioxide yomoya likhuphuke lisuka ekugxilweni kwalo okuphansi kuya ekugxilweni kwalo okuphezulu kakhulu. Kodwa-ke, kusukela muva nje, ukugxilwa kwe-carbon dioxide yomoya kukhuphuke ngaphezu komkhawulo womlando ongu-300 ppm. Ukwanda kwamanje kwe-carbon dioxide yomoya kwenzeke ngokushesha kakhulu—eminyakeni engamakhulu kunokuba kube yizinkulungwane zeminyaka. Iyini imbangela yalo mehluko ngesilinganiso sokushintsha kanye nenani lokwanda kwe-carbon dioxide? Isici esibalulekile okumele siqashelwe lapho kuqhathaniswa idatha yomlando kanye nedatha yamanje ukuba khona komphakathi wesintu wanamuhla; akekho omunye umshayeli wokushintsha kwesimo sezulu oye waletha izinguquko emazingeni e-carbon dioxide yomoya ngalesi silinganiso noma kulesi silinganiso.

 Imisebenzi yabantu ikhipha i-carbon dioxide kanye ne-methane, amagesi amabili abaluleke kakhulu okushisa, emkhathini ngezindlela eziningana. Indlela eyinhloko ekhipha i-carbon dioxide ukushiswa kwamafutha angaphansi komhlaba, njengophethiloli, amalahle, kanye negesi yemvelo (Isithombe 35.29). Ukugawulwa kwamahlathi, ukukhiqizwa kwesimende, ezolimo zezilwane, ukuhlanzwa komhlaba, kanye nokushiswa kwamahlathi eminye imisebenzi yabantu ekhipha i-carbon dioxide. I-Methane (CH4) ikhiqizwa lapho amagciwane ephula izinto eziphilayo ngaphansi kwezimo ze-anaerobic. Izimo ze-Anaerobic zingenzeka lapho izinto eziphilayo zibhajwe ngaphansi kwamanzi (njengasemapulazini elayisi) noma emathunjini ezilwane ezidla uhlaza. I-Methane ingakhishwa futhi emasimini egesi yemvelo kanye nokubola okwenzeka ezindaweni zokulahla udoti. Omunye umthombo we-methane ukuncibilika kwe-clathrate. Ama-Clathrate ayizingcezu zeqhwa ne-methane eziqandisiwe ezitholakala phansi kolwandle. Lapho amanzi efudumala, lezi zingcezu zeqhwa ziyancibilika bese kukhishwa i-methane. Njengoba izinga lokushisa lamanzi olwandle likhuphuka, izinga lapho ama-clathrate encibilika khona liyakhula, likhipha i-methane eyengeziwe. Lokhu kuholela emazingeni akhuphukile e-methane emkhathini, okusheshisa kakhulu izinga lokufudumala komhlaba. Lesi yisibonelo se-positive feedback loop eholela esilinganisweni esisheshayo sokwanda kwamazinga okushisa omhlaba.
question1: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungeyona enye yezinto ezintathu ezibangela ushintsho lwemvelo ngaphambi kweNkathi Yezimboni?
answer1: Ukushisa amafutha asetshenziswa kudala
question2: Iyini imijikelezo yaseMilankovitch?
answer2: Izinguquko eziqhubekayo emjikelezweni woMhlaba ezithinta isimo sezulu sesikhathi eside
question3: Ukwanda kwamandla elanga kuthinta kanjani isimo sezulu soMhlaba?
answer3: Kwenyusa izinga lokushisa loMhlaba
question4: Ukuqhuma okukhulu kwezintaba-mlilo ngokuvamile kuthinta kanjani isimo sezulu somhlaba wonke?
answer4: Zibangela ukupholisa kwesikhashana ngokukhulula izinhlayiya ezivimba ukukhanya kwelanga
distractor4c: Azinawo umthelela esimweni sezulu somhlaba wonke
question5: Iyini imiphumela yokushisa komhlaba?
answer5: Ukufudumala koMhlaba okubangelwa amagesi okushisa abambe imisebe yokushisa emkhathini
distractor5a: Ukupholisa koMhlaba okubangelwa amagesi okushisa abangela ukukhanya kwelanga esikhaleni
distractor5b: Ukufudumala koMhlaba okubangelwa imisebe yelanga kuphela
question6: Yimaphi amagesi aphakathi kwamagesi okushisa abaluleke kakhulu?
answer6: I-carbon dioxide, i-methane, umhwamuko wamanzi, i-nitrous oxide, kanye ne-ozone
distractor6c: I-carbon monoxide kanye ne-sulfur dioxide kuphela
question7: Yibuphi ubufakazi obusekela ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-carbon dioxide esemkhathini kanye nokushisa komhlaba wonke?
answer7: Njengoba amazinga e-carbon dioxide asemoyeni ekhuphuka, amazinga okushisa omhlaba nawo ayanda
distractor7a: I-carbon dioxide kanye nokushisa kuhlala kushintsha ngezindlela ezihlukile
distractor7b: I-carbon dioxide ibilokhu ingaguquki kuwo wonke umlando woMhlaba
distractor7c: Izinguquko zokushisa zenzeka ngaphandle kwamagesi okushisa
question8: Iyini imisebenzi eyinhloko yabantu ebangela ukwanda kwe-carbon dioxide emoyeni?
answer8: Ukushisa amafutha angaphansi komhlaba njengamalahle, uphethiloli, kanye negesi yemvelo
question9: Kungani i-methane ekhishwa kuma-clathrates ancibilikayo ibhekwa njenge-feedback loop enhle?
answer9: Ukufudumala kukhipha i-methane, okwandisa ukufudumala kwezindawo ezishisayo futhi kubangele ukufudumala okwengeziwe
distractor9a: I-Methane ipholisa umoya futhi yehlisa ukufudumala
distractor9b: I-Methane yehlisa amazinga e-carbon dioxide emoyeni
distractor9c: Ama-clathrate ancibilikayo asusa unomphela amagesi okushisa emkhathini

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.5 Isimo Sezulu Nemiphumela Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba Wonke | Imiphumela Ebhalwe Phansi Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu: Esedlule Nesamanje | Ukushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Kwendawo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.5 Isimo Sezulu Nemiphumela Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba Wonke | Imiphumela Ebhalwe Phansi Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu: Esedlule Nesamanje | Ukushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Kwendawo
chapterContent:
Ososayensi banobufakazi be-geological ngemiphumela yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu kudala. Izenzakalo zanamuhla ezifana nokuhlehla kweqhwa kanye nokuncibilika kweqhwa lase-polar kubangela ukukhuphuka okuqhubekayo kolwandle. Okwamanje, izinguquko esimweni sezulu zingathinta kabi izinto eziphilayo.

 Ukushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Se-Geological
Ukufudumala komhlaba kuhlotshaniswa okungenani nesenzakalo esisodwa sokuphela komhlaba wonke ngesikhathi esidlule se-geological. Isenzakalo sokuphela kwe-Permian senzeka eminyakeni engaba yizigidi ezingu-251 edlule ngasekupheleni kwesikhathi se-geological esiyiminyaka engaba yizigidi ezingu-50 esaziwa ngokuthi i-Permian period. Lesi sikhathi se-geological sasingesinye sezikhathi ezintathu ezifudumele kakhulu emlandweni we-geological woMhlaba. Ososayensi balinganisela ukuthi cishe amaphesenti angu-70 ezinhlobo zezitshalo nezilwane zasemhlabeni kanye namaphesenti angu-84 ezinhlobo zasolwandle zaphela, zanyamalala unomphela ngasekupheleni kwesikhathi se-Permian. Izinto eziphilayo ezazijwayele izimo zezulu ezimanzi nezifudumele, njengemvula yaminyaka yonke engu-300–400 cm (118–157 in) kanye no-20 °C–30 °C (68 °F–86 °F) ehlathini elimanzi elishisayo, kungenzeka ukuthi azikwazanga ukusinda ekushintsheni kwesimo sezulu sasePermian.
question1: Yisiphi isenzakalo sanamuhla esinikeza ubufakazi bokuthi isimo sezulu soMhlaba siyashintsha?
answer1: Ukubuyela emuva kweqhwa kanye nokuncibilika kweqhwa lasezindaweni ezibandayo okufaka isandla ekukhuphukeni kwamazinga olwandle
question2: Cishe kwenzeka nini umcimbi wokuphela kwePermian?
answer2: Eminyakeni engaba yizigidi ezingu-251 edlule
question3: Kungasiphi isikhathi lapho kwenzeka khona umcimbi wokuphela kwePermian?
answer3: Isikhathi samaPermian
question4: Cishe yiliphi iphesenti lezinhlobo zezitshalo nezilwane zasemhlabeni ezanyamalala ngesikhathi sokuphela kwePermian?
answer4: Cishe amaphesenti angama-70
question5: Cishe yiliphi iphesenti lezinhlobo zasolwandle ezanyamalala ngesikhathi sokuphela kwePermian?
answer5: Cishe amaphesenti angu-84
question6: Kungani ezinye izinto eziphilayo zingazange zikwazi ukusinda ekushintsheni kwesimo sezulu sasePermian?
answer6: Zazijwayezwa izimo ezithile zemvelo ezifudumele nezimanzi ezashintsha kakhulu
question7: Yini eboniswa yisenzakalo sokuphela kwePermian ngokushintsha kwesimo sezulu?
answer7: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu okukhulu kungabangela ukuqothulwa kwezinhlobo eziningi
distractor7a: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuthinta kuphela izinto eziphilayo zasolwandle
distractor7b: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu akunamiphumela yesikhathi eside yezinto eziphilayo
distractor7c: Izehlakalo zokuphela zenzeka ngaphandle kokushintsha kwemvelo
question8: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu sanamuhla kungathinta kanjani izinto eziphilayo ngendlela embi?
answer8: Ngokushintsha izindawo zokuhlala ngokushesha kunokuba ezinye izinhlobo zingazivumelanisa nezimo
distractor8b: Ngokwandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kuzo zonke izindawo zemvelo
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.29.1. Isithombe sibonisa izinguquko eqhweni lasebusika elizungeze iNorth Pole. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kulesi sithombe
answer9: Izilwane ezihlala eqhweni zilahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala yazo
distractor9b: Izinguquko eqhweni ziyingxenye yezinguquko zesimo sezulu ezenzeka eMhlabeni.
distractor9c: Azikho izitshalo ezithintekile ngenxa yoshintsho lweqhwa elimbozwe yiqhwa

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.5 Isimo Sezulu Nemiphumela Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba Wonke | Imiphumela Ebhalwe Phansi Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu: Esedlule Nesamanje | Ukushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Kwamanje
chapterContent:
Kuye kwenzeka izenzakalo eziningana zomhlaba wonke ezingase zibangelwe ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu ngesikhathi sokuphila kwethu. I-Glacier National Park eMontana ilahlekelwa yiqhwa layo eliningi, into eyaziwa ngokuthi ukwehla kwamandla eqhwa. Ngo-1850, le ndawo yayineqhwa elicishe libe yi-150. Nokho, ngo-2010, le paki yayineqhwa elicishe libe yi-24 kuphela elingaphezu kwamahektha angu-25 ngobukhulu. Elinye lala maqhwa yi-Grinnell Glacier (Isithombe 35.30) eNtabeni iGould. Phakathi kuka-1966 no-2005, ubukhulu beGrinnell Glacier bancipha ngamaphesenti angu-40. Ngokufanayo, isisindo samaqhwa eGreenland nase-Antarctica siyancipha: IGreenland ilahlekelwe yiqhwa elingamakhilomitha ayi-150–250 ngonyaka phakathi kuka-2002 no-2006. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubukhulu kanye nobukhulu beqhwa lolwandle i-Arctic buyehla.

 Lokhu kulahlekelwa yiqhwa kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lolwandle lomhlaba. Ngokwesilinganiso, ulwandle lukhuphuka ngesilinganiso esingu-1.8 mm ngonyaka. Kodwa-ke, phakathi kuka-1993 no-2010 izinga lokukhula kwezinga lolwandle laliphakathi kuka-2.9 no-3.4 mm ngonyaka. Izici ezahlukahlukene zithinta umthamo wamanzi olwandle, okuhlanganisa izinga lokushisa lamanzi (ubuningi bamanzi buhlobene nokushisa kwawo) kanye nenani lamanzi atholakala emifuleni, emachibini, eziqongweni zeqhwa, eziqongweni zeqhwa zasezindaweni ezibandayo, kanye naseqhweni lolwandle. Njengoba iziqongo zeqhwa zasezindaweni ezibandayo kanye neziqongo zeqhwa zasezindaweni ezibandayo zincibilika, kukhona umnikelo omkhulu wamanzi acwebezelayo ayekade eqandisiwe.

 Ngaphezu kwezimo ezithile ezishintshayo ngenxa yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, izinto eziningi eziphilayo nazo ziyathinteka yizinguquko zokushisa. Izinga lokushisa kanye nemvula kudlala indima ebalulekile ekunqumeni ukusatshalaliswa kwendawo kanye ne-phenology yezitshalo nezilwane. (I-phenology iwucwaningo lwemiphumela yezimo zezulu esikhathini semicimbi yempilo ejwayelekile, njengokuqhakaza kwezitshalo noma ukufuduka kwezinyoni.) Abacwaningi bakhombisile ukuthi izinhlobo zezitshalo ezingu-385 eGreat Britain ziqhakaza izinsuku ezingu-4.5 ngaphambi kwalokho okwabhalwa ngaphambilini eminyakeni engu-40 edlule. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlobo ezitholwe yizinambuzane zazinamathuba amaningi okuqhakaza ngaphambi kwezinhlobo ezitholwe yizinambuzane. Umthelela wokushintsha kwezinsuku zokuqhakaza uzoncishiswa uma izinambuzane zivele ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Lesi sikhathi esingahambisani sezitshalo nezinambuzane ezitholwa yizinambuzane singaholela emiphumeleni elimazayo yezemvelo ngoba, ukuze ziqhubeke ziphila, izitshalo ezitholwe yizinambuzane kumele ziqhakaze lapho izinambuzane zazo zikhona.

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.7 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 35. I-Ecology kanye ne-Biosphere | 35.7 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
35.1 Ububanzi Bezinto Eziphilayo
I-Ecology isifundo sokusebenzisana kwezinto eziphilayo nendawo ezizungezile. Izazi zemvelo zibuza imibuzo emazingeni amane okuhlela kwezinto eziphilayo—izinto eziphilayo, inani labantu, umphakathi, kanye nendawo ezungezile. Ezingeni lezinto eziphilayo, izazi zemvelo zifunda izinto eziphilayo ngazinye nokuthi zixhumana kanjani nendawo ezizungezile. Ezingeni labantu kanye nelomphakathi, izazi zemvelo zihlola, ngokulandelana, ukuthi inani lezinto eziphilayo lishintsha kanjani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kanye nezindlela lezo zinhlobo ezisebenzisana ngazo nezinye izinhlobo emphakathini. Izazi zemvelo ezifunda indawo ezungezile zihlola izinhlobo eziphilayo (izingxenye eziphilayo) zendawo ezungezile kanye nezingxenye ezingaphili (izingxenye eziphilayo), njengomoya, amanzi, kanye nomhlabathi, wendawo ezungezile.

 35.2 I-Biogeography
I-Biogeography isifundo sokusatshalaliswa kwendawo kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nezici ze-abiotic ezithinta ukusatshalaliswa kwazo. Izinhlobo ze-endemic ziyizinhlobo ezitholakala ngokwemvelo kuphela endaweni ethile yezwe. Ukusatshalaliswa kwezinto eziphilayo kuthonywa izici eziningana zemvelo, ngokwengxenye, ezilawulwa yi-latitude noma ukuphakama lapho kutholakala khona into ephilayo. Ukukhuphuka kolwandle kanye nokuguquka kwentwasahlobo kanye nokwindla kuyizinqubo ezibalulekile ezilawula ukusatshalaliswa kwezakhamzimba nezinye izinto ezingaphili ezibalulekile ezindaweni zemvelo zasemanzini. Imithombo yamandla, izinga lokushisa, amanzi, izakhamzimba ezingaphili, kanye nomhlabathi yizinto ezivimbela ukusatshalaliswa kwezinto eziphilayo ezinhlelweni zomhlaba. Ukukhiqiza okuyisisekelo okuyisisekelo kuyisilinganiso senani le-biomass ekhiqizwa yi-biome.

 35.3 Ama-Biomes Omhlaba
Umhlaba unama-biomes omhlaba kanye nama-biomes omhlaba. Ama-biomes omhlaba afaka kokubili izindawo zamanzi ahlanzekile kanye nezasolwandle. Kunezinhlobo eziyisishiyagalombili zama-biomes omhlaba: amahlathi ashisayo anamanzi, ama-savanna, amahlane angaphansi kwe-tropical, ama-chaparral, izindawo zotshani ezifudumele, amahlathi afudumele, amahlathi e-boreal, kanye ne-Arctic tundra. I-biome efanayo ingenzeka ezindaweni ezahlukene zezwe ezinezimo zezulu ezifanayo. Izinga lokushisa kanye nemvula, kanye nokwehluka kokubili, yizici ezibalulekile ze-abiotic ezakha ukwakheka kwemiphakathi yezilwane nezitshalo kuma-biomes omhlaba. Amanye ama-biome, njengezindawo zotshani ezifudumele namahlathi afudumele, anezinkathi ezihlukene, lapho isimo sezulu esibandayo nesimo sezulu esishisayo sishintshashintsha unyaka wonke. Kuma-biome afudumele, anomswakama, njengehlathi elimanzi elishisayo, umkhiqizo oyinhloko ophelele uphezulu, njengoba amazinga okushisa afudumele, amanzi amaningi, kanye nokukhula kwezitshalo okukhula unyaka wonke. Amanye ama-biome, njengezindawo ezigwadule kanye ne-tundra, anomkhiqizo ophansi oyinhloko ngenxa yokushisa okukhulu kanye nokuntuleka kwamanzi atholakalayo.

 35.4 Ama-Biome Asemanzini
Izindawo zemvelo zasemanzini zifaka phakathi ama-biome amanzi anosawoti kanye namanzi ahlanzekile. Izici ze-abiotic ezibalulekile ekwakhiweni kwezindawo zemvelo zasemanzini zingahluka kunezo ezibonakala ezinhlelweni zomhlaba. Ukukhanya kwelanga kungamandla ashukumisayo ngemuva kwesakhiwo samahlathi futhi kuyisici esibalulekile emizimbeni yamanzi, ikakhulukazi leyo ejulile kakhulu, ngenxa yendima ye-photosynthesis ekusekeleni izinto eziphilayo ezithile. Ubuningi kanye nokushisa kwakheka isakhiwo sezinhlelo zasemanzini. Izilwandle zingacatshangwa njengezinezindawo ezahlukene ngokusekelwe ekujuleni kwamanzi kanye nebanga ukusuka ogwini kanye nokungena kokukhanya. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinto eziphilayo zivumelaniswa nezimo ezitholakala endaweni ngayinye. Ama-coral reef ayizindawo zemvelo zasolwandle ezihlukile eziyikhaya lezinhlobo eziningi zezilwane. Kutholakala imifula lapho imifula ihlangana khona nolwandle; amanzi ayo angajulile ahlinzeka ngokudla nendawo yokuhlala kwezilwane ezincane ezinama-crustacean, ama-mollusk, izinhlanzi, nezinye izinhlobo eziningi. Ama-biome amanzi ahlanzekile afaka amachibi, amachibi, imifula, imifudlana, kanye namaxhaphozi. Ama-bog awuhlobo oluthakazelisayo lwezindawo ezimanzi ezibonakala ngamanzi amile, i-pH ephansi, kanye nokuntuleka kwe-nitrogen.

 35.5 Isimo Sezulu Nemiphumela Yokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Somhlaba
Umhlaba udlule emijikelezweni ephindaphindayo yokwanda nokwehla kwezinga lokushisa. Eminyakeni engu-2000 edlule, i-Medieval Climate Anomaly yayiyisikhathi esifudumele, kuyilapho i-Little Ice Age yayipholile ngendlela engavamile. Zombili lezi zimo ezingajwayelekile zingachazwa yizimbangela zemvelo zokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, futhi, yize izinguquko zokushisa zazincane, zaba nemiphumela ebalulekile. Izinto ezibangela ushintsho lwesimo sezulu zemvelo zifaka imijikelezo yaseMilankovitch, izinguquko emsebenzini welanga, kanye nokuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo. Nokho, akukho neyodwa yalezi zici eholela ekwenyukeni okusheshayo kwezinga lokushisa lomhlaba noma ekwenyukeni okuqhubekayo kwe-carbon dioxide. Ukushiswa kwamafutha emvelo kuwumthombo obalulekile wamagesi okushisa umhlaba, odlala indima enkulu emphumeleni wokushisa umhlaba. Esikhathini eside esidlule, ukufudumala komhlaba kwaholela ekuqothulweni kwePermian: umcimbi wokuqothulwa okukhulu okulotshwe kurekhodi lamathambo. Njengamanje, ushintsho lwesimo sezulu lwanamuhla luhlotshaniswa nokuncibilika okukhulu kwezinguzunga zeqhwa kanye nama-ice sheet asezindaweni ezibandayo, okuholela ekwenyukeni kancane kancane kwezinga lolwandle. Izitshalo nezilwane nazo zingathinteka ekushintsheni kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni lapho isikhathi semicimbi yezinkathi zonyaka, njengokuqhakaza noma ukuvundisa impova, sithinteka ekufudumaleni komhlaba.

question59: Kwenzekani ezimpilweni zasemanzini emachibini ajulile lapho amanzi eqanda phakathi nezinyanga zasebusika?
answer59: Ebusika, kwakheka ungqimba lweqhwa phezu kwamanzi, njengoba iqhwa lincane kakhulu kunamanzi. Amanzi aminyene kakhulu ku-4°C futhi agcina isimo sawo soketshezi ngaphansi kwamanzi, lapho ungqimba lweqhwa lukhona khona. Emanzini oketshezi, izinto eziphilayo zasemanzini zingasinda ngokusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo.
distractor59a: Ebusika, ungqimba lweqhwa luwela phezu kwamanzi njengoba lungaqinile kangako kunamanzi. Amanzi aminyene kakhulu ku-7°C futhi agcina isimo sawo soketshezi ngaphansi kwamanzi. Izinto eziphilayo zasemanzini zingaba khona emanzini oketshezi
distractor59b: Ngesikhathi sasebusika, impilo yasemanzini ikhona emanzini acwebile, akhona ngaphansi kongqimba olungaphezulu, ngokusebenzisa izinsiza ezengeziwe ukuze zikwazi ukusinda ngesikhathi sasebusika esinzima.
distractor59c: Ngesikhathi sasebusika, iqhwa lakha kuphela phezu kwamanzi kanye namamitha ambalwa ngaphansi kwamanzi. Amanzi aminyene kakhulu ku-4°C futhi agcina isimo sawo soketshezi ngaphansi kwamanzi, lapho kukhona khona ungqimba lweqhwa. Emanzini oketshezi, izinto eziphilayo zasemanzini zingaba khona kusetshenziswa izinsiza ezitholakalayo.
question60: Chaza izinselele ezibhekene nezinto eziphilayo ezihlala endaweni ehlangana nolwandle kanye nokuzivumelanisa kwazo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nalezi zinselele
answer60: Zichayeka njalo emoyeni, elangeni, ezikhathini zokomisa, kanye namagagasi ashaya ngamandla. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, ezinye izinhlobo zine-exoskeleton
distractor60a: Zihlala zichayeka emoyeni, elangeni, ezikhathini zokomisa, kanye namagagasi ashaya ngamandla. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, ezinye izinhlobo zine-exoskeleton
distractor60b: Zichayeka njalo emoyeni, elangeni, ezikhathini zokomisa, kanye namagagasi ashaya ngamandla. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, zonke izinhlobo zine-exoskeleton
distractor60c: Zichayeka njalo emoyeni, elangeni, ezikhathini zokomisa, kanye namagagasi ashaya ngamandla. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, izinhlobo eziningi zine-endoskeleton
question61: Uma ulwelwe lukhula ngaphezu kwesilinganiso njengoba kubonakala ngesikhathi sokuqhakaza kwe-algal, luthinta kanjani imvelo?
answer61: Izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-photosynthesis ngeke zikwazi ukukhula. Izilwane nezinyoni eziphila kulezo zinto eziphilayo zizothinteka. Njengoba ulwelwe lufa, umoya-mpilo uzophela, kuthinte izinhlanzi nezinye izilwane zasemanzini. I-pH yamanzi izoshintsha, ithinte nezinqubo ze-metabolic.
distractor61a: Izinto eziphilayo ezingezona eze-photosynthesis ngeke zikwazi ukukhula ngenxa yokuntuleka kokukhanya. Izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthesis ezidinga ukuba ziphile zizothinteka. Njengoba ulwelwe lufa, umoya-mpilo uzophela, kuthinte izinhlanzi nezinye izilwane zasemanzini. I-pH yamanzi izoshintsha, ithinte nezinqubo ze-metabolic.
distractor61b: Izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-photosynthesis ngeke zikwazi ukukhula. Izilwane nezinyoni eziphila kulezo zinto eziphilayo zizothinteka. Njengoba ulwelwe lufa, i-carbon dioxide izophela, kuthinte izinhlanzi nezinye izilwane zasemanzini. I-pH yamanzi izoshintsha, ithinte nezinqubo ze-metabolic.
distractor61c: Izinto eziphilayo ezingezona eze-photosynthesis ngeke zikwazi ukukhula. Izilwane nezinyoni eziphila kulezo zinto eziphilayo zizothinteka. Njengoba ulwelwe lufa, i-carbon dioxide izophela, kuthinte izinhlanzi nezinye izilwane zasemanzini. I-pH yamanzi izoshintsha, ithinte nezinqubo ze-metabolic.
question62: Yiziphi ezinye izinto ezingasebenzi emzimbeni ezithinta ama-biomes amanzi ahlanzekile? Chaza
answer62: Usawoti kanye nokushisa kokubili kuyizinto ezingaphili ezithinta impilo kuma-biome ahlanzekile. Njengoba izinto eziphilayo ezihlala kuma-biome ahlanzekile zingenakubekezelela amazinga aphezulu kasawoti, lezo zinto eziphilayo bezingeke zisinde uma amazinga kasawoti enyuka kakhulu. Izinto eziningi eziphilayo ezisebenza njengokudla kwabanye ziyi-photosynthesis futhi zingafa uma izimbali ze-algal zifihla ukukhanya. Ukubola kwazo kanye nokuncipha komoya-mpilo yi-algae kungabangela ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ezidinga umoya-mpilo nazo ziphele.
distractor62a: Usawoti kanye nokukhanya kwelanga kokubili kuyizinto ezingaphili kahle ezithonya impilo kuma-biome ahlanzekile. Njengoba izinto eziphilayo ezihlala kuma-biome ahlanzekile zidinga usawoti omningi ukuze ziphile, ukuncipha kwawo kungabulala izinto eziphilayo. Izinto eziningi eziphilayo ezisebenza njengokudla kwabanye ziyi-photosynthesis futhi zingafa uma izimbali ze-algae zifihla ukukhanya. Ukubola kwazo kanye nokuncipha komoya-mpilo yi-algae kungabangela ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ezidinga umoya-mpilo nazo ziphele.
distractor62b: Usawoti kanye nokukhanya kwelanga kokubili kuyizinto ezingaphili ezithinta impilo ezindaweni zamanzi ahlanzekile. Njengoba izinto eziphilayo ezihlala ezindaweni zamanzi ahlanzekile zingenakubekezelela amazinga aphezulu kasawoti, lezi zinto eziphilayo bezingeke zisinde uma zinganda. Izinto eziningi eziphilayo ezisebenza njengokudla kwabanye ezikwazi ukwenza i-photosynthesis zingafa uma izimbali ze-algal zifihla ukukhanya. Ukubola kwazo kanye nokuphela kwe-carbon dioxide yi-algae kungabangela ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ezidinga i-carbon dioxide nazo zife.
distractor62c: Usawoti kanye nokukhanya kwelanga kokubili kuyizinto ezingaphili ezithinta impilo ezindaweni zamanzi ahlanzekile. Njengoba izinto eziphilayo ezihlala ezindaweni zamanzi ahlanzekile zingenakubekezelela amazinga aphezulu kasawoti, lezi zinto eziphilayo bezingeke zisinde uma zinganda kakhulu. Izinto eziningi eziphilayo ezisebenza njengokudla kwabanye ziyi-photosynthesis futhi zingafa uma ukuqhakaza kwe-algal kufihla ukukhanya. Ukubola kwazo kanye nokuncipha komoya-mpilo yi-algae kungabangela ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ezidinga umoya-mpilo nazo ziphele.
question63: Kungenzeka yini ukuguqula imiphumela yokufudumala komhlaba? Yiziphi izinyathelo ezingasiza ekunciphiseni ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni?
answer63: Akunakwenzeka ukuguqula imiphumela yokufudumala komhlaba, njengoba sesivele sibona izinguquko emvelweni, ezitshalweni nasekuziphatheni kwezilwane. Ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kukaphethiloli kanye nokusebenzisa imithombo yemvelo yamandla kunganciphisa ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni jikelele.
distractor63a: Kungenzeka ukuguqula imiphumela yokufudumala komhlaba ngokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamafutha emvelo, ukusebenzisa amafutha ahlukile, ukusebenzisa ezinye izindlela esikhundleni sama-CFC kanye nokusebenzisa imithombo yemvelo yamandla.
distractor63b: Akunakwenzeka ukuguqula imiphumela yokufudumala komhlaba, njengoba izinguquko ezinkulu zesimo sezulu sezivele zenzekile futhi zaxazululwa emvelweni. Ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kukaphethiloli wezinto zakudala, ukusebenzisa imithombo yemvelo yamandla kanye namafutha ahlukile kunganciphisa ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni jikelele.
distractor63c: Kungenzeka ukuguqula imiphumela yokufudumala komhlaba ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha obuzosiza ekuvimbeleni izinguquko zokushisa emhlabeni jikelele. Ukusebenzisa amandla omoya kanye nokukhiqizwa kwegesi yemvelo okusebenzayo kakhulu kuzosiza ekufezeni lo mgomo.
question64: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.37. Umugqa obomvu kugrafu ukhombisa izilinganiso zenyanga ze-carbon dioxide phakathi kuka-2016 no-2021. Ichashazi ngalinye limelela inyanga. Ichashazi lokuqala lonyaka linguJanuwari. Yisiphi isici esixhomeke kulo grafu?
question65: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.38. Le grafu ikhombisa ukukhishwa kwamagesi okushisa aseMelika ngokwemikhakha. Qaphela ukuthi le grafu inokusetshenziswa kukagesi okusatshalaliswe emikhakheni eyahlukene. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu
answer65: Ukwehla ngo-20% kokukhishwa kwamagesi okushisa umhlaba ngenxa yezokuthutha kuzonciphisa ukukhishwa okuphelele kwamagesi ngo-5%
distractor65a: Ukwehla ngo-20% kokukhishwa kwamagesi abangela ukushisa ngenxa yemisebenzi yezolimo kuzonciphisa ukukhishwa okuphelele kwamagesi cishe ngo-5%
distractor65b: Ukwehla ngo-20% kokukhishwa kwamagesi abangela ukushisa yizimboni kuzonciphisa ukukhishwa okuphelele kwamagesi cishe ngo-6%
distractor65c: Ukwehla ngo-20% kokukhishwa kwegesi ebamba ukushisa ngokusetshenziswa kwezindawo zokuhlala nezentengiselwano kuzonciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi okuphelele cishe ngo-8%
question66: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.37. Umugqa obomvu kugrafu ukhombisa izilinganiso zenyanga ze-carbon dioxide phakathi kuka-2016 no-2021. Ichashazi ngalinye limelela inyanga. Ichashazi lokuqala lonyaka linguJanuwari. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi
answer66: Izinyanga zasebusika eNyakatho Nenkabazwe zibona ukukhishwa okukhulu kwe-carbon dioxide, mhlawumbe ngenxa yokushisa
distractor66a: Ukukhishwa kwe-carbon dioxide kufinyelela phezulu ezinyangeni zasehlobo, mhlawumbe ngenxa yokwanda kwemisebenzi yezolimo neyezimboni
distractor66b: Ukukhishwa kwe-carbon dioxide kuhlala njalo unyaka wonke. Ihlobo likhulisa umsebenzi wezolimo ngokushisa kwasebusika enyakatho yezwe
distractor66c: Ukukhishwa kwe-carbon dioxide kuyanda njalo phakathi nonyaka, ngenxa yokwanda kwabantu kanye nokusetshenziswa kakhulu kwezinto zokubasa ezimbiwa phansi.
question67: Ivemvane eliluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka iKarner selimenyezelwe njengohlobo olusengozini yokuqothulwa. Lincike ku-lupine yasendle ukuze likhule ama-larval. Uhlobo lwevemvane, olutholakale ngobuningi e-Indiana Dunes National Park, manje lutholakala eNyakatho eWisconsin naseMichigan. I-lupine yasendle ibhujiswe ezindaweni lapho ikhule khona ngobuningi ngenxa yentuthuko nokwakhiwa ezindaweni ezivulekile lapho ithanda ukukhula khona. Yiziphi kulezi zinto ezilandelayo eziphilayo ezikhona emphakathini?
answer67: Uvemvane oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka i-Karner kanye ne-lupine yasendle
distractor67b: Uvemvane oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka i-Karner, i-lupine yasendle, nomlilo
distractor67c: Uvemvane oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka iKarner, i-lupine yasendle, kanye nezindawo zotshani
question68: Endaweni enesimo sezulu esipholile saseNyakatho Melika, izitshalo zibhujiswe ngomlilo. Kuzokwenzekani ekukhiqizeni okuyinhloko kanye nemvelo yendawo lapho izimvula zibuya ngesizini ezayo?
answer68: Utshani buzokhula futhi nezilwane ezidla uhlaza ezazihlala lapho zizobuya. Umkhiqizo oyinhloko kufanele ufane nowesizini edlule.
distractor68a: Utshani buzokhula futhi, kodwa izilwane ezidla utshani ezazihlala lapho ngeke zibuye, njengoba ngabe zithole indawo entsha yokuhlala kuyo. Ngakho-ke, umkhiqizo oyinhloko uzoncipha
distractor68b: Utshani ngeke buphinde bukhule, ngakho-ke izilwane ezidla uhlaza ezazihlala lapho ngeke zibuye. Ngakho-ke, umkhiqizo oyinhloko uzoncipha
distractor68c: Utshani buzokhula futhi nezilwane ezidla uhlaza ezazihlala lapho zizobuya. Umkhiqizo oyinhloko uzoba ngaphansi kwesizini edlule.
question69: I-Karner blue butterfly larva ikhipha i-carbohydrate, okuwumthombo wamandla ezintuthwane. Kanti-ke, izintuthwane ziyathanda i-larva, okwandisa amathuba okukhula zibe yi-butterfly endala. Bhala ukuthi lokhu kumelelani nokuxhumana.
question70: Ichibi eliseMidwest libona ukwanda okungazelelwe kwenani le-algae (ukuqhakaza kwe-algae) elimboza ichibi. Izici ezithinta umkhiqizo oyinhloko ziyi-__
question71: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.39. Igrafu ikhombisa amazinga okushisa alinganiswa ekujuleni okuhlukahlukene olwandle nasezilwandle. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu
answer71: Izinga lokushisa liqala ukwehla ngokushesha ngokujula okwandayo. Ngemva kwesikhashana izinga lokwehla liba lincane kakhulu.
distractor71a: Izinga lokushisa liyancipha njalo ngokujula okwandayo
distractor71b: Izinga lokushisa liqala ukwehla kancane kancane ngokujula okwandayo. Ngemva kwesikhashana izinga lokwehla liba likhulu kakhulu.
distractor71c: Izinga lokushisa alihlobene nokujula kolwandle kanye nolwandle
question72: Ucelwa ukuthi ulinganisele okuqukethwe kwezakhamzimba echibini kanye nomthelela walo ongaba khona ekukhiqizeni okuyisisekelo okuhlanzekile. Yiluphi ulwazi ozoluqoqa ukuze unqume umphumela?
answer72: Thatha isampula yamanzi echibini bese uwacebisa ngokwenziwa, bese ubona umphumela wokucebisa ekukhuleni kwe-phytoplankton uma kuqhathaniswa nokukhula emanzini echibi angacebile.
distractor72a: Thatha isampula yamanzi avela ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zechibi bese uthola ukwakheka kwezakhamzimba
distractor72b: Isampula okuqukethwe yikhabhoni kwesitshalo esikhula nge-phytoplankton
distractor72c: Linda ukujika kwentwasahlobo ukuze uhlole izakhamzimba ezitholakala phansi kolwandle
question73: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.40. Igrafu ikhombisa ukuthi zingaki izinhlobo zezitshalo ezinemithambo yegazi (ezithuthuke kakhulu) ezikhona ku-latitude ngayinye. I-Latitude ingu-0° ku-equator kanye no-90° ku-pole ngayinye kwezimbili. Yenza isimangalo ngale grafu
answer73: Kunezinhlobo ezimbalwa zezitshalo ezinemithambo yegazi eziye zajwayela ukuhlala ezindaweni eziphakeme
distractor73a: Azikho izitshalo zemithambo yegazi ezindaweni ezingaphezu kuka-60°
distractor73b: Kukhona i-biomass ephelele yezitshalo ezinemithambo yegazi encipha njengoba ububanzi bukhuphuka
distractor73c: Ezindaweni eziphakeme, izitshalo ezingezona imithambo yegazi zibusa imvelo
question74: Emlilweni wehlathi, kwabhujiswa imithi eminingi ye-oki. Ngemva komlilo, imithi eminingi emide yathatha indawo yemithi ye-oki. Iyiphi incazelo engcono kakhulu yalesi senzakalo?
answer74: Izihlahla ezinde zikhula ngokushesha futhi zakha uphahla, okwakungavumeli izihlahla ze-oki ukuba zikhule
distractor74a: Ukushiswa kwezihlahla kushintshe i-pH yenhlabathi, okwakwenza i-oki ingakhuli.
distractor74b: Izimpande zezihlahla nezihlahla ziyakhula, zithathe indawo yezihlahla ze-oki
distractor74c: Izihlahla ze-oki ziyanqotshwa yizinambuzane, ngakho-ke ezinye izihlahla ezimelana nezinambuzane ziyakwazi ukwanda
question75: Yimiphi imiphumela engaba khona uma kukhona ukuchitheka okukhulu kwamafutha phakathi nolwandle? Kuzothinta kanjani ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nomkhiqizo oyinhloko? Yiziphi ezinye izindlela zokuhlanza lokhu kuchitheka kwamafutha?
answer75: Ukuchitheka kukawoyela kuhlanganisa ubuso bolwandle, kunciphisa inani lokukhanya nomoya-mpilo ongena olwandle. I-phytoplankton ingase ife. Ukuba khona kukawoyela kunganciphisa ukuhamba kwezilwane zasolwandle futhi kungabangela ukufa. Amanye amakhemikhali kanye nokulungiswa kwezinto eziphilayo kungasiza ekuhlanzeni uwoyela
distractor75a: Ukuchitheka kukawoyela kwandisa inani lokukhanya nomoya-mpilo ongena olwandle. Ama-phytoplankton angase abhubhe. Ukuba khona kukawoyela kunganciphisa ukuhamba kwezilwane zasolwandle futhi kungabangela ukufa. Amanye amakhemikhali kanye nokulungiswa kwezinto eziphilayo kungasiza ekuhlanzeni uwoyela
distractor75b: Ukuchitheka kukawoyela kwandisa inani lokukhanya nomoya-mpilo ongena olwandle. Ama-phytoplankton anganda. Ukuhamba kwezilwane zasolwandle kuyanda. Ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo, ngakho-ke, umkhiqizo oyinhloko ophelele uyakhula. Amanye amakhemikhali kanye nokulungiswa kwezinto eziphilayo kungasiza ekuhlanzeni uwoyela
distractor75c: Ukuchitheka kukawoyela kuhlanganisa ubuso bolwandle, kunciphisa inani lokukhanya okungena olwandle. Izinto eziphilayo zasolwandle ezingasinda ngaphandle kokukhanya ngeke zithinteke. Amanye amakhemikhali kanye nokulungiswa kwezinto eziphilayo kungasiza ekuhlanzeni uwoyela
question76: Bheka uMfanekiso 35.41. Igrafu ikhombisa ukukhishwa kwe-carbon dioxide ngabantu phakathi kuka-1850 no-2019. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu
answer76: Ukukhishwa kwe-carbon dioxide okubangelwa abantu kwakuphansi kakhulu ekuqaleni kwawo-1800
distractor76a: Ukukhishwa kwe-carbon dioxide okubangelwa abantu kwahlala kungaguquki phakathi kuka-1900 no-1950
distractor76b: Ngemva kuka-2010, ukukhishwa kwekhabhoni okubangelwa abantu kwehla minyaka yonke
distractor76c: Phakathi kuka-1875 no-2010, ukukhishwa kwekhabhoni okubangelwa abantu kwanda minyaka yonke
question77: Yimiphi imiphumela yesikhashana neyesikhathi eside yezinqubo zemvelo nezibangelwa abantu ekushintsheni kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni wonke, futhi ngenxa yalokho, ezindaweni zemvelo?
answer77: Izinguquko zesikhathi esifushane zifaka phakathi izinguquko emaphethini esizini, imvula engavamile, izinguquko emjikelezweni wokuphila kwezinambuzane nezilwane, njalo njalo. Izinguquko zesikhathi eside zingaba ukuncibilika kwezinguzunga zeqhwa, kanye nokwenyuka kwamazinga ezindawo zamanzi ezingase zimboze iziqhingi eziseduze nolwandle, zibhubhise uhlelo lwendawo oluzungezile.
distractor77a: Izinguquko zesikhashana zifaka phakathi ukuncibilika kwezinguzunga zeqhwa, ukukhuphuka kwamazinga amanzi angamboza iziqhingi eziseduze nolwandle, ukubhubhisa imvelo yendawo kanye nezilwane, njalo njalo. Izinguquko zesikhathi eside ezenzekayo zingafaka phakathi izinguquko emaphethini esizini, imvula engavamile, kanye nezinguquko emjikelezweni wokuphila kwezinambuzane.
distractor77b: Izinguquko zesikhathi esifushane zifaka phakathi izinguquko emaphethini esizini, imvula engavamile, izinguquko emjikelezweni wokuphila kwezinambuzane nezilwane, njalo njalo. Izinguquko zesikhathi eside zingaba ushintsho ezikhathini zokuqhakaza kwezimbali, kanye nokwenyuka kwamazinga ezindawo zamanzi, ezingase zimboze iziqhingi eziseduze nolwandle, zibhubhise uhlelo lwendawo oluzungezile.
distractor77c: Izinguquko zesikhathi esifushane zifaka phakathi ukuncibilika kwezinguzunga zeqhwa, imvula engavamile, izinguquko emjikelezweni wokuphila kwezinambuzane nezilwane, njll. Izinguquko zesikhathi eside zingaba ukwanda kwamazinga ezindawo zamanzi ezingase zimboze iziqhingi eziseduze nolwandle, zibhubhise uhlelo lwendawo.

chapterContent:
Cabanga uhamba ngomkhumbi emfuleni ngesikebhe esincane esinenjini ntambama ngempelasonto; amanzi abushelelezi futhi ujabulela ilanga elifudumele nomoya opholile lapho ngokuzumayo ushaywa ekhanda yi-carp yesiliva engamakhilogremu angu-20. Lokhu kuyingozi manje emifuleni eminingi nasezinhlelweni zemisele e-Illinois naseMissouri ngenxa yokuba khona kwe-carp yase-Asia.

 Le nhlanzi—empeleni iqembu lezinhlobo ezihlanganisa i-carp yesiliva, emnyama, utshani, kanye ne-carp enkulu—ibilokhu ifuywa futhi idliwa eShayina iminyaka engaphezu kwe-1000. Ingenye yezinsiza zokudla zasemanzini ezibaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Nokho, e-United States, i-carp yase-Asia ibhekwa njengenhlobo eyingozi ehlaselayo ephazamisa isakhiwo somphakathi kanye nokwakheka kwayo kuze kube sezingeni lokusongela izinhlobo zezilwane zasendaweni.

 I-carp yase-Asia manje isongela ukuhlasela amaGreat Lakes. Bheka Umfanekiso 36.1
question1: Kungani i-Asian carp ibhekwa njengesilwane esiyingozi esihlaselayo e-United States?

chapterContent:
Ngokusebenzisa izibalo, izazi zemvelo zingahlola ukuthi ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezikuyo kuthinta kanjani ukusatshalaliswa, ubuningi, ubuningi, kanye namasu okuphila kwezinhlobo. Inani labantu lakhiwa abantu bezinhlobo ezifanayo abahlala endaweni ethile. Inani labantu liyashintshashintsha ngokusekelwe kokubili izici ze-biotic kanye ne-abiotic. Lapho kufundwa inani labantu, izici zalelo nani labantu ziyalinganiswa futhi ushintsho lwazo luyaqashelwa. Lolu cwaningo lwezibalo lwalezi zinguquko, i-demography, luhlola ukuthi inani labantu lisabela kanjani kulokhu kushintshashintsha. Ukushintsha kwabantu kungathinta isakhiwo somphakathi kanye ne-ecosystem iyonke.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 kanye no-Big Idea 4 wohlaka lwe-AP® Biology Curriculum. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwe-Curriculum zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nenye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zebhayoloji zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.D
Ukukhula kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla yesistimu yezinto eziphilayo kuthonywa izinguquko endaweni yesistimu.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.D.1 Zonke izinhlelo zebhayoloji kusukela kumaseli nezinto eziphilayo kuya kubantu, imiphakathi kanye nezindawo eziphilayo zithintwa ukusebenzisana okuyinkimbinkimbi kwe-biotic kanye ne-abiotic okubandakanya ukushintshana kwezinto kanye namandla amahhala.

6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo kanye nezibikezelo mayelana nezehlakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

2.3 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela ukuthi izinguquko ekutholakaleni kwamandla amahhala zithinta kanjani izinto eziphilayo, abantu, kanye nezindawo eziphilayo.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A

 Ucwaningo lobudlelwano phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo nendawo yazo, i-ecology, lubheka izinto eziphilayo emazingeni omuntu ngamunye, abantu, umphakathi, i-ecosystem, kanye ne-biosphere.

 Izibalo ziyizinto eziguquguqukayo. Isibalo sabantu sakhiwa yibo bonke abantu bohlobo oluthile oluvela endaweni ethile futhi abanamandla okuxhumana. Izibalo ziyahlukahluka ngokusekelwe ezintweni eziningana: izinguquko zesizini nezonyaka emvelweni, izinhlekelele zemvelo ezifana nemililo yamahlathi nokuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo, kanye nokuncintisana ngezinsiza phakathi kwezinhlobo nangaphakathi kwazo. Ucwaningo lwezibalo lwe-population dynamics, i-demography, lusebenzisa uchungechunge lwamathuluzi ezibalo ukuphenya ukuthi isibalo sabantu sisabela kanjani ezinguqukweni ezindaweni zabo eziphilayo nezingaphili. Amaningi ala mathuluzi ekuqaleni ayeklanyelwe ukutadisha isibalo sabantu. Isibonelo, amathebula okuphila, achaza isikhathi sokuphila sabantu ngaphakathi kwesibalo, aqalwa athuthukiswa yizinkampani zomshuwalense wokuphila ukuze kubekwe amazinga omshuwalense. Eqinisweni, nakuba igama elithi "demographics"livame ukusetshenziswa lapho kuxoxwa ngabantu, zonke izinhlobo eziphilayo zingafundwa kusetshenziswa le ndlela.

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.1 I-Demography Yabantu | Usayizi Nobuningi Babantu
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.1 I-Demography Yabantu | Usayizi Nobuningi Babantu
chapterContent: Ucwaningo lwanoma yiliphi inani labantu luvame ukuqala ngokunquma ukuthi zingaki izinhlobo ezithile zohlobo oluthile ezikhona, nokuthi zihlobene kangakanani. Ngaphakathi kwendawo ethile yokuhlala, inani labantu lingabonakala ngobukhulu balo bomphakathi (N), inani eliphelele labantu, kanye nobuningi balo bomphakathi, inani labantu ngaphakathi kwendawo ethile noma umthamo. Ubukhulu kanye nobuningi babantu yizimpawu ezimbili eziyinhloko ezisetshenziselwa ukuchaza nokuqonda inani labantu. Isibonelo, inani labantu abaningi lingase lizinze kakhulu kunezinhlobo ezincane ngokusekelwe ekuguqukeni kwazo kwezakhi zofuzo, ngaleyo ndlela libe namandla okuzivumelanisa nemvelo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ilungu labantu abanobuningi obuphansi (abasakazeke kakhulu endaweni yokuhlala), lingase libe nobunzima obukhulu ekutholeni umlingani wokuzala uma kuqhathaniswa nenani labantu abanobuningi obukhulu. Njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 36.2, izinto eziphilayo ezincane zivame ukusabalala kakhulu kunezinhlobo ezinkulu.

distractor1c: Inani lezindawo zokuhlala ezihlalwa uhlobo oluthile

answer2: Inani labantu ngaphakathi kwendawo ethile noma ivolumu

answer3: Usayizi wabantu kanye nobuningi babantu

answer4: Ngokuvamile banokuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nekhono elingcono lokuzivumelanisa nezinguquko zemvelo

answer5: Abantu bangase babe nobunzima bokuthola abangane bokuzala
distractor5c: Abantu bazala ngokushesha kakhulu kunezixuku zabantu

answer6: Izinto eziphilayo ezincane

answer7: Lezi zici zinikeza isisekelo sokuqonda isakhiwo kanye nokuguquguquka kwenani labantu
distractor7a: Zinquma umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwalolu hlobo
distractor7b: Zikhomba zonke izinto ezingasebenzi emzimbeni wezinto eziphilayo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.1 I-Demography Yabantu | Usayizi Nobuningi Babantu | Izindlela Zokucwaninga Zabantu
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.1 I-Demography Yabantu | Usayizi Nobuningi Babantu | Izindlela Zokucwaninga Zabantu
chapterContent:
Indlela enembile kakhulu yokunquma usayizi wabantu ukubala nje bonke abantu abakuleyo ndawo yokuhlala. Kodwa-ke, le ndlela ivame ukungabi nokwenzeka ngokwezinto noma ngokwezomnotho, ikakhulukazi lapho kufundwa izindawo zokuhlala ezinkulu. Ngakho-ke, ososayensi bavame ukutadisha abantu ngokuthatha isampula yengxenye emele yendawo ngayinye yokuhlala bese besebenzisa le datha ukwenza iziphetho mayelana nendawo yokuhlala iyonke. Izindlela ezahlukahlukene zingasetshenziswa ukuthatha isampula yabantu ukuze kutholakale usayizi wabo kanye nobuningi babo. Ezintweni eziphilayo ezinganyakazi njengezitshalo, noma ezintweni eziphilayo ezincane kakhulu nezihamba kancane, i-quadrat ingasetshenziswa (Isithombe 36.3). I-quadrat iyindlela yokumaka izindawo eziyisikwele ngaphakathi kwendawo yokuhlala, kungaba ngokubeka indawo ngezinduku nentambo, noma ngokusebenzisa isikwele sokhuni, ipulasitiki, noma sensimbi esibekwe phansi. Ngemva kokubeka ama-quadrats, abacwaningi babe sebebala inani labantu abangaphakathi kwemingcele yabo. Amasampula amaningi ama-quadrat enziwa kuyo yonke indawo yokuhlala ezindaweni eziningana ezingahleliwe. Yonke le datha ingasetshenziswa ukulinganisa usayizi wabantu kanye nobuningi babantu ngaphakathi kwendawo yonke. Inani nosayizi wamasampula e-quadrat kuncike ohlotsheni lwezinto eziphilayo ezifundwayo kanye nezinye izici, okuhlanganisa nobuningi bezinto eziphilayo. Isibonelo, uma kuthathwa amasampula e-daffodils, i-quadrat engu-1 m2 ingasetshenziswa kanti ngezihlahla ezinkulu ezibomvu, ezinkulu futhi ezihlala kude kakhulu komunye nomunye, i-quadrat enkulu engu-100 m2 ingasetshenziswa. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi kubalwa izinhlobo ezanele ukuze kutholakale isampula enembile ehambisana nendawo yokuhlala, okuhlanganisa nezindawo ezingathathwanga amasampula.

 Ezintweni eziphilayo ezihambayo, njengezilwane ezincelisayo, izinyoni, noma izinhlanzi, inqubo ebizwa ngokuthi uphawu kanye nokuthathwa kabusha ivame ukusetshenziswa. Le ndlela ihilela ukumaka isampula yezilwane ezibanjiwe ngandlela thile (njengamathegi, amabhande, upende, noma ezinye izimpawu zomzimba), bese uzikhulula endaweni ezungezile ukuze zihlangane nabanye abantu; kamuva, kuqoqwa isampula entsha, okuhlanganisa ezinye ezimakiwe (ukuthathwa kabusha) kanye nezinye ezingamakiwe (Isithombe 36.4).

 Besebenzisa isilinganiso sabantu abaphawuliwe nabangenamaki, ososayensi banquma ukuthi bangaki abantu abakulesi sampula. Kusukela kulokhu, kubalwa kusetshenziswa ukulinganisa usayizi wenani labantu. Le ndlela icabanga ukuthi uma inani labantu likhulu, iphesenti lezinto eziphilayo eziphawuliwe ezizophinde zithathwe liyancipha njengoba zizobe sezixubene nezinye eziningi ezingaphawuliwe. Isibonelo, uma izinyamazane ezingu-80 zibanjwa, ziphawulwe, futhi zikhishwa ehlathini, futhi kamuva izinyamazane ezingu-100 zibanjwa futhi ezingu-20 zazo seziphawuliwe kakade, singanquma usayizi wenani labantu (N) sisebenzisa lesi sibalo esilandelayo:

 (inombolo ephawulwe ngokubamba kokuqala x inani eliphelele lokubamba kwesibili)

 ÷

 inombolo ephawulwe ukubamba kwesibili

 = N

 Sisebenzisa isibonelo sethu, usayizi wenani labantu uzolinganiselwa ku-400.

 (80 x 100)

 ÷20

 = 400

 Ngakho-ke, kulinganiselwa ukuthi kunezinhlobo ezingu-400 eziphelele kubantu bokuqala.

 Kunemikhawulo ethile endleleni yokumaka nokuphinda ubambe. Ezinye izilwane ezibanjwe okokuqala zingase zifunde ukugwema ukubanjwa emzuliswaneni wesibili, ngaleyo ndlela zikhulise izilinganiso zabantu. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izilwane zingase zithathwe kalula (ikakhulukazi uma kunikezwa umvuzo wokudla), okuholela ekunciphiseni usayizi wabantu. Futhi, ezinye izinhlobo zingase zilimale yindlela yokumaka, kuncishiswe ukusinda kwazo. Kuye kwasungulwa amanye amasu ahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukulandelela nge-elekthronikhi izilwane ezifakwe ama-radio transmitters kanye nokusetshenziswa kwedatha evela emisebenzini yokudoba nokudoba kwezohwebo ukuze kulinganiswe usayizi nempilo yabantu kanye nemiphakathi.
question1: Kungani izazi zemvelo zivame ukulinganisa usayizi wabantu ngokuthatha amasampula esikhundleni sokubala wonke umuntu?
answer1: Ukubala wonke umuntu ngokuvamile akwenzeki ngokwezinto ezibonakalayo noma ngokwezomnotho
distractor1a: Ukusampula kuhlale kunembe kakhulu kunokubala okuphelele
distractor1c: Izinhlobo ezisengozini yokuphela kuphela ezingabalwa ngqo
question2: Iyini i-quadrat esetshenziswa ocwaningweni lwabantu?
answer2: Ukuthatha amasampula ezinto eziphilayo ezinganyakazi noma ezihamba kancane endaweni echaziwe
distractor2b: Ukubamba izilwane ezincelisayo ezinkulu ukuze zibekwe uphawu
question3: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.3. Kungani amasampula amaningi e-quadrat ethathwa ezindaweni ezingahleliwe?
answer3: Ukuthola isampula emele ukulinganisa inani labantu bonke
question4: Kungani izazi zemvelo zingasebenzisa i-quadrat enkulu lapho zifunda ngama-redwood amakhulu kunalapho zifunda ama-daffodil?
answer4: Ngoba izihlahla ezinkulu ezibomvu zikhulu futhi zibanzi kakhulu
distractor4a: Ngoba izihlahla ezinkulu ezibomvu zizala ngokushesha okukhulu
distractor4c: Ngoba ama-quadrats amakhulu ahlala equkethe izinhlobo eziningi
question5: Iyiphi indlela yokusampula inani labantu evame ukusetshenziswa ezilwaneni ezihambayo njengezilwane ezincelisayo, izinyoni nezinhlanzi?
answer5: Maka bese uphinda uthwebule
question6: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.4. Yiluphi ulwazi olusetshenziswa ukulinganisa usayizi wabantu endleleni yokumaka nokuphinda babambe?
answer6: Isilinganiso sabantu abamakiwe kubantu abangamakiwe kusampula yesibili
distractor6c: Ubudala bomuntu omdala kunabo bonke abathunjiwe
question7: Uma izinyamazane ezingu-80 ziphawulwa futhi zikhululwa, bese kuthi izinyamazane ezingu-100 zibanjwe kamuva bese kuthi ezingu-20 ziphawulwe, ungakanani usayizi wabantu abalinganiselwayo?
answer7: Abantu abangu-400
question8: Yikuphi ukucabanga ngophawu kanye nendlela yokuthatha kabusha okungaholela ekulinganisweni ngokweqile kobukhulu benani labantu?
answer8: Izilwane ezibanjwe ngaphambilini zifunda ukugwema ukuphinde zibanjwe
distractor8a: Izilwane eziphawulwe ngophawu ziphinde zibanjwe kaningi ngenxa yemivuzo yokudla
distractor8b: Zonke izilwane eziphawuliwe ziyafa ngokushesha ngemva kokukhululwa
distractor8c: Usayizi wendawo yokuhlala uyancipha ngesikhathi sokuthatha amasampula
question9: Iyiphi indlela yesimanje esetshenziswayo ukulinganisa usayizi wabantu ngaphandle kokuphawula nokuphinda babambe?
answer9: Ukulandelela izilwane nge-elekthronikhi okufakwe ama-radio transmitter
distractor9b: Ukulandelelanisa i-DNA yazo zonke izinto eziphilayo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.1 I-Demography Yabantu | Ukusatshalaliswa Kwezinhlobo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.1 I-Demography Yabantu | Ukusatshalaliswa Kwezinhlobo
chapterContent:
Ngaphezu kokulinganisa ubuningi obulula, ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana nenani labantu lungatholakala ngokubheka ukusabalala kwabantu ngabanye. Amaphethini okusabalala kwezinhlobo (noma amaphethini okusabalala) abonisa ubudlelwano bendawo phakathi kwamalungu enani labantu ngaphakathi kwendawo yokuhlala ngesikhathi esithile. Ngamanye amazwi, abonisa ukuthi amalungu ezinhlobo ahlala eduze noma aqhelelene, nokuthi yimaphi amaphethini abonakalayo lapho ehlukaniswe.

 Abantu ngabanye emphakathini bangahlukaniswa ngokulinganayo, bahlakazeke ngokungahleliwe ngaphandle kwephethini elibikezelwe, noma baqoqwe ngamaqembu. Lawa aziwa ngokuthi amaphethini okusabalala afanayo, angahleliwe, kanye namaphethini okusabalala aqoqene, ngokulandelana (Isithombe 36.5). Ukusabalala okufanayo kubonakala ezitshalweni ezikhipha izinto ezivimbela ukukhula kwabantu abaseduze (njengokukhishwa kwamakhemikhali anobuthi yisitshalo se-sage i-Salvia leucophylla, into ebizwa ngokuthi i-allelopathy) kanye nasezilwaneni ezifana ne-penguin ezigcina indawo echaziwe. Isibonelo sokusabalala okungahleliwe senzeka nge-dandelion nezinye izitshalo ezinembewu ehlakazekile emoyeni ehluma noma kuphi lapho ziwela khona endaweni enhle. Ukusabalala okunamaqhubu kungabonakala ezitshalweni ezilahla imbewu yazo phansi ngqo, njengezihlahla ze-oki, noma izilwane ezihlala ngamaqembu (iqembu lezinhlanzi noma imihlambi yezindlovu). Ukusabalala okunamaqhubu kungase kube umsebenzi wokungafani kwendawo yokuhlala. Ngakho-ke, ukusabalala kwabantu ngabanye ngaphakathi kwesibalo kunikeza ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana nendlela abaxhumana ngayo kunokulinganisa okulula kobuningi. Njengoba nje izinhlobo ezincane zobuningi zingase zibe nobunzima obukhulu ekutholeni umlingani, izinhlobo ezizimele ezinokusabalalisa okungahleliwe zingase zibe nobunzima obufanayo uma ziqhathaniswa nezinhlobo zomphakathi ezihlanganiswe ngamaqembu.
question1: Zichaza ukuthini izindlela zokusabalala kwezinhlobo?
answer1: Ubudlelwano bendawo phakathi kwabantu ngaphakathi kwesizwe
distractor1a: Izinga lapho inani labantu lizala khona
question2: Yiziphi izindlela ezintathu eziyinhloko zokusabalala kwezinhlobo?
answer2: Ifana, ingahleliwe, futhi ihlanganisiwe
question3: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.5. Yiluphi uhlobo lokuhlakazeka olwenzeka lapho abantu ngabanye behlukaniswe ngokulinganayo?
answer3: Ukuhlakazeka okufanayo
question4: Kungani ezinye izitshalo, njengeSalvia leucophylla, zibonisa ukusabalala okufanayo?
answer4: Zikhipha amakhemikhali anobuthi avimbela ukukhula kwezitshalo eziseduze
question5: Yiluphi uhlobo lokuhlakazeka olujwayelekile kuma-dandelion?
answer5: Ukuhlakazeka okungahleliwe
question6: Yisiphi isimo esiyisibonelo sokuhlakazeka okuhlanganisiwe?
answer6: Izikole zezinhlanzi ezihlala ndawonye
question7: Ukwehlukahlukana kwezindawo zokuhlala kungathinta kanjani ukusatshalaliswa kwezinhlobo?
answer7: Kungabangela ukuthi abantu ngabanye bavele emaqenjini ahlangene lapho kutholakala khona indawo yokuhlala efanelekile
distractor7b: Kuqeda konke ukuncintisana phakathi kwabantu ngabanye
question8: Kungani ukusabalala kwezinhlobo zezilwane kuvame ukuba wusizo kakhulu kunobuningi babantu kuphela?
answer8: Inikeza ukuqonda ukuthi abantu baxhumana kanjani omunye nomunye
distractor8c: Ibikezela ukuvela kwesimo esizayo ngaphandle kwedatha eyengeziwe
question9: Kungani izinhlobo ezihlakazeke ngokungahleliwe zodwa zingase zibe nobunzima bokuzala?
answer9: Abantu bangase babe nenkinga yokuthola abangane bomshado ngoba basakazeke kude kakhulu

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.1 I-Demography Yabantu | I-Demography
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.1 I-Demography Yabantu | I-Demography
chapterContent:
Nakuba ubukhulu kanye nobuningi babantu buchaza inani labantu ngesikhathi esithile, ososayensi kumele basebenzise i-demography ukuze batadishe ukuguquguquka kwenani labantu. I-demography isifundo sezibalo sokushintsha kwenani labantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi: amazinga okuzalwa, amazinga okufa, kanye nokulindela impilo. Ngayinye yalezi zilinganiso, ikakhulukazi amazinga okuzalwa, ingathinteka yizici zabantu ezichazwe ngenhla. Isibonelo, inani elikhulu labantu libangela izinga lokuzalwa eliphezulu ngoba kukhona abantu abaningi abangase bazale. Ngokuphambene nalokho, inani elikhulu labantu lingabangela nezinga lokufa eliphakeme ngenxa yokuncintisana, izifo, kanye nokuqongelela imfucuza. Ngokufanayo, inani eliphezulu labantu noma iphethini yokuhlakazeka ehlanganisiwe ibangela ukuhlangana okungenzeka kokuzala phakathi kwabantu, okungakhulisa izinga lokuzalwa. Okokugcina, isilinganiso sobulili esibandlulula abesifazane (isilinganiso sabesilisa nabesifazane) noma isakhiwo sobudala (isilinganiso samalungu abantu abaseminyakeni ethile yobudala) esakhiwe ngabantu abaningi abaneminyaka yokuzala singakhulisa amazinga okuzalwa.

 Ngaphezu kwalokho, izici zabantu zabantu zingathonya indlela inani labantu elikhula noma elincipha ngayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Uma amazinga okuzalwa nokufa elingana, inani labantu lihlala lizinzile. Kodwa-ke, usayizi wabantu uzokwanda uma amazinga okuzalwa edlula amazinga okufa; inani labantu lizoncipha uma amazinga okuzalwa engaphansi kwamazinga okufa. Isikhathi sokuphila singenye into ebalulekile; ubude besikhathi abantu abahlala kuso buyathinta izinsiza zendawo, ukuzala, kanye nempilo iyonke yabantu. Lezi zici zabantu zivame ukuboniswa ngesimo sethebula lokuphila.
question1: Kuyini ukubalwa kwabantu?
answer1: Ucwaningo lwezibalo lwezinguquko zabantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, okuhlanganisa amazinga okuzalwa, amazinga okufa, kanye nokulindeleke kokuphila
question2: Yiziphi izici zezibalo zabantu ezivame ukulinganiswa ezifundweni zabantu?
answer2: Amanani okuzalwa, amazinga okufa, kanye nokulindeleke kokuphila
distractor2a: Umbala wabantu, isivinini sokufuduka, kanye nosayizi wendawo yokuhlala
distractor2c: Izinga lokudla izilwane, izinga lokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo, kanye nezinga le-photosynthesis
question3: Kungani inani elikhulu labantu lingandisa izinga lokuzalwa?
answer3: Ngoba kukhona abantu abaningi abangase bazale
distractor3b: Ngoba abantu bazalana ngendlela engahambisani nobulili
question4: Kungani inani elikhulu labantu lingandisa nezinga lokufa?
answer4: Ngenxa yokuncintisana okwandayo, izifo, kanye nokuqongelela imfucuza
distractor4b: Ngoba abantu abaningi bahlala benezinsiza ezimbalwa ezitholakalayo kusukela ekuqaleni
question5: Ubuningi babantu abaningi noma ukusabalala kwenqwaba yezilwane kungathinta kanjani izinga lokuzalwa?
answer5: Zandisa amathuba okuhlangana kokuzala phakathi kwabantu ngabanye
distractor5c: Zinciphisa isikhathi sokuphila sokuzala sabo bonke abantu
question6: Isilinganiso sobulili esibandlulula abesifazane noma isakhiwo sobudala esinabantu abaningi abazalayo singabathinta kanjani abantu?
answer6: Kungakhuphula izinga lokuzalwa
question7: Kwenzekani kubantu uma amazinga okuzalwa nokufa elingana?
answer7: Inani labantu lihlala lizinzile
distractor7c: Inani labantu liphindeka kabili esizukulwaneni ngasinye
question8: Iyiphi ithonya elilindelekile lokuphila kubantu?
answer8: Kuthinta ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza, ukuzala kabusha, kanye nempilo iyonke yabantu
distractor8b: Kuthinta kuphela ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu
question9: Izici zabantu zivame ukuvezwa kanjani?
answer9: Etafuleni lokuphila

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.1 I-Demography Yabantu | I-Demography | Amathebula Okuphila
chapterContent:
Amathebula okuphila ahlinzeka ngolwazi olubalulekile mayelana nomlando wokuphila kwento ephilayo. Amathebula okuphila ahlukanisa inani labantu ngamaqembu eminyaka futhi ngokuvamile ubulili, futhi abonise ukuthi ilungu lalelo qembu lingase liphile isikhathi esingakanani. Aklanywa ngamathebula e-actuarial asetshenziswa imboni yomshuwalense ukulinganisa ubude bokuphila komuntu. Amathebula okuphila angafaka phakathi amathuba okuba abantu bafe ngaphambi kosuku lwabo lokuzalwa olulandelayo (okungukuthi, izinga lokufa kwabo), iphesenti labantu abasindile abafa ngesikhathi esithile sobudala, kanye nobude bokuphila kwabo ngesikhathi ngasinye. Isibonelo sethebula lokuphila siboniswe etafuleni le-Life Table of Dall Mountain Sheep (bheka ngezansi) kusukela ocwaningweni lwezimvu zasezintabeni zaseDall, uhlobo oluvela enyakatho-ntshonalanga yeNyakatho Melika. Qaphela ukuthi inani labantu lihlukaniswe ngezikhawu zobudala (ikholomu A). Izinga lokufa (ngo-1000), eliboniswe kukholomu D, lisekelwe enanini labantu abafa ngesikhathi sobudala (ikholomu B) elihlukaniswe ngenani labantu abasindile ekuqaleni kwesikhawu (Ikholomu C), eliphindwe ngo-1000.

 izinga lokufa =

 inani labantu abafayo

 Isibonelo, phakathi kweminyaka emithathu nemine, abantu abayi-12 bayafa kwabayi-776 ababesele ezimvini zokuqala eziyi-1000. Leli nani libe seliphindaphindwa ngo-1000 ukuze kutholakale izinga lokufa ngenkulungwane.

 izinga lokufa = 12 ÷ 776 x 1000 ≈ 15.5

 Njengoba kungabonakala kudatha yezinga lokufa (ikholomu D), izinga lokufa eliphezulu lenzeke lapho izimvu ziphakathi kwezinyanga eziyi-6 ne-12 ubudala, bese zenyuka kakhulu zisuka eminyakeni eyi-8 kuya kweyi-12 ubudala, okwathi ngemva kwalokho kwaba nabambalwa abasindile. Idatha ikhombisa ukuthi uma imvu kuleli qembu ingasinda ize ifike eminyakeni eyodwa, kungalindeleka ukuthi iphile eminye iminyaka engu-7.7 ngokwesilinganiso, njengoba kuboniswe yizinombolo zobude bempilo kukholomu E.

 Ithebula Lokuphila Lezimvu Zezintaba ZaseDall

 Leli thebula lokuphila le-Ovis dalli libonisa inani lokufa, inani labasindile, izinga lokufa, kanye nobude bempilo ngesikhathi ngasinye sobudala sezimvu zezintaba zaseDall.
