question1: Iyini injongo eyinhloko yetafula lokuphila?
answer1: Ukufingqa ukusinda, ukufa, kanye nokulindeleke kokuphila kwamaqembu ahlukene eminyaka emphakathini
distractor1a: Ukuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo zibe amaqembu e-taxonomic
distractor1b: Ukulinganisa ubuningi babantu ezindaweni ezahlukene zokuhlala
distractor1c: Ukubikezela izinguquko zesimo sezulu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
question2: Imiphakathi ivame ukuhlukaniswa kanjani etafuleni lokuphila?
answer2: Kumaqembu eminyaka futhi ngokuvamile ngokobulili
question3: Yiluphi ulwazi olungafakwa etafuleni lokuphila?
answer3: Izinga lokufa, iphesenti lokusinda, kanye nobude bokuphila
distractor3b: Ukuceba kwezinhlobo kanye nenkomba yezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo
question4: Izinga lokufa libalwa kanjani etafuleni lokuphila?
answer4: Inani labantu abafayo lihlukaniswe ngenani elisinda ekuqaleni kwesikhawu, liphindwe ngo-1000
distractor4a: Inombolo esindayo ihlukaniswe ngenombolo efayo, iphindwe ngo-100
distractor4b: Inani labantu lihlukaniswe ngenani labantu abazalwe
question5: Ngokusho kwethebula lokuphila kwezimvu zasezintabeni zaseDall, lalingakanani izinga lokufa phakathi kweminyaka emi-3 nengu-4?
answer5: Cishe ukufa okungu-15.5 kubantu abayi-1000
question6: Ngokusho kwetafula lokuphila kwezimvu zasezintabeni zaseDall, yisiphi isikhathi sobudala lapho ukufa kwakuphakama khona?
answer6: Iminyaka eyi-13–14
question7: Ngokusho kwetafula lokuphila kwezimvu zasezintabeni zaseDall, lingakanani isikhathi sokuphila semvu esindayo ize ikhule?
answer7: Cishe iminyaka engu-7.7
question8: Yimuphi umkhuba wokufa obonakala emphakathini wezimvu zasezintabeni zaseDall?
answer8: Ukufa kuphezulu phakathi nonyaka wokuqala wokuphila, kuhlala kuphansi kakhulu phakathi neminyaka ephakathi, futhi kuyanda kakhulu ekugugeni
distractor8a: Ukufa kuhlala njalo kukho konke ukuphila
distractor8b: Ukufa kwehla kancane kancane njengoba iminyaka ikhula
distractor8c: Ukufa kuphezulu kakhulu kuphela ngesikhathi sobudala obuphakathi

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.1 I-Demography Yabantu | I-Demography | Ama-Curve Rankings
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.1 I-Demography Yabantu | I-Demography | Ama-Curve Rankings
chapterContent: Elinye ithuluzi elisetshenziswa ososayensi bezinto eziphilayo yi-curve yokusinda, okuyigrafu yenani labantu abasindayo ngesikhathi ngasinye sobudala esidwetshwe ngokumelene nesikhathi (ngokuvamile ngedatha eqoqwe etafuleni lokuphila). La ma-curve asivumela ukuthi siqhathanise umlando wokuphila kwabantu abahlukene (Isithombe 36.6). Abantu kanye nezilwane eziningi eziphila ezilwaneni babonisa i-curve yokusinda yohlobo I ngoba iphesenti eliphezulu lezingane lisinda eminyakeni yazo yokuqala nephakathi—ukufa kwenzeka kakhulu kubantu abadala. Lezi zinhlobo zezinhlobo zivame ukuba nenani elincane lezingane ngesikhathi esisodwa, futhi zinikeza ukunakekelwa kwabazali okuphezulu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ziyasinda. Izinyoni ziyisibonelo se-curve yokusinda ephakathi noma yohlobo II ngoba izinyoni ziyafa cishe ngokulinganayo ngesikhathi ngasinye sobudala. Lezi zinhlobo zingase zibe nenzalo encane futhi zinikeze ukunakekelwa okubalulekile kwabazali. Izihlahla, izilwane ezingenamgogodla zasolwandle, kanye nezinhlanzi eziningi zibonisa i-curve yokusinda yohlobo III ngoba zimbalwa kakhulu kulezi zinhlobo eziphilayo ezisinda eminyakeni yazo yobusha; nokho, lezo ezifika eminyakeni yobudala zinamathuba amaningi okusinda isikhathi eside. Izinto eziphilayo kulesi sigaba zivame ukuba nenani elikhulu kakhulu lezingane, kodwa uma sezizelwe, ukunakekelwa okuncane kwabazali kunikezwa. Ngakho-ke lezi nzalo zizimele zodwa” futhi zisengozini yokudliwa, kodwa inani lazo liqinisekisa ukusinda kwezinhlobo ezanele zokulondoloza uhlobo
question1: Iyini ijika lokusinda?
answer1: Igrafu ekhombisa inani labantu abasindayo ngesikhathi ngasinye sobudala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor1a: Igrafu ekhombisa izinguquko ekubuneni kwabantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor1b: Igrafu ekhombisa amazinga okuzalwa ezindaweni ezahlukene zokuhlala
distractor1c: Igrafu eqhathanisa ukuceba kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo phakathi kwezindawo zemvelo
question2: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko yama-curve okusinda?
answer2: Ukuqhathanisa umlando wempilo yabantu abahlukene
distractor2a: Ukuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo zibe amaqembu e-taxonomic
question3: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.6. Yiluphi uhlobo lomjikelezo wokusinda olubonakala kubantu nasezinhlotsheni eziningi zezilwane?
answer3: Uhlobo I
question4: Kungani izinhlobo ezine-Type I survivorship curve zisinda kakhulu ngesikhathi zisencane?
answer4: Bakhiqiza abantwana abambalwa kakhulu futhi banikeza ukunakekelwa okubanzi kwabazali
distractor4a: Bazala izinkulungwane zezingane ngaphandle kokunakekelwa ngabazali
distractor4c: Babhekana nokufa okulinganayo kuyo yonke iminyaka
question5: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezivame ukubonisa umugqa wokusinda wohlobo lwesibili?
answer5: Izinyoni
question6: Iyini isici esichazayo sejika lokusinda lohlobo lwesibili?
answer6: Abantu banamathuba ahlala njalo okufa kunoma yimuphi ubudala
distractor6a: Ukufa okuningi kwenzeka kuphela ngesikhathi sokuguga
distractor6b: Ukufa okuningi kwenzeka ngokushesha ngemva kokuzalwa
distractor6c: Ukufa kwehla kube yi-zero ngemva kokuvuthwa
question7: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezivame ukubonisa umugqa wokusinda wohlobo lwesithathu?
answer7: Izihlahla, izilwane zasolwandle ezingenamgogodla, kanye nezinhlanzi eziningi
distractor7a: Abantu kanye nezinye izilwane eziphila ezilwaneni
question8: Kungani izinhlobo ezine-Type III survivorship curve zikhiqiza inzalo eningi?
answer8: Iningi lezingane lifa lisencane, ngakho ukukhiqiza eziningi kwandisa amathuba okuba ezinye zisinde zize zibe ngabantu abadala.
distractor8a: Inani elikhulu lezingane lihlala lithola ukunakekelwa okubanzi kwabazali
distractor8b: Inzalo yabo ayivikelekile ezilwaneni ezidla ezinye
distractor8c: Zizala kanye kuphela njalo eminyakeni eyishumi

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.2 Imilando Yempilo Nokukhethwa Kwemvelo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo, okuhlanganisa nezinhlobo, zidinga amandla amahhala ukuze zilondoloze ukuhleleka, zikhule futhi zizalane. Njengoba sifundile ezahlukweni zangaphambilini, izinguquko ekutholakaleni kwamandla amahhala zingabangela ukuguquguquka kwenani labantu. Zonke izinhlobo zinesabelomali samandla futhi kumele zilinganisele ukusetshenziswa kwamandla nokusebenzisa kwazo amandla ukuze kusetshenziswe i-metabolism, ukunakekelwa kwabazali, kanye nokugcinwa kwamandla.

 Kuyamangalisa ukuthi kungakanani amandla amahhala adingekayo ekuzaleni nasekunakekelweni okulandelayo kwezingane. Ukuzala kuchaza ukuthi zingaki izingane ezingakhiqizwa uma umuntu enezingane eziningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Ezilwaneni, ukuzala kuhambisana ngokuphambene nenani lokunakekelwa okunikezwa inzalo ngayinye.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 kanye no-Big Idea 2 wohlaka lwe-AP® Biology Curriculum. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwe-Curriculum zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 1
Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka kanye nobunye bokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.A
Ushintsho ekwakheni izakhi zofuzo zabantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.A.2 Ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza ekushintsheni kwe-phenotypic kubantu.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
2.2 Umfundi angasebenzisa izindlela zezibalo emananini achaza izehlakalo zemvelo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
5.3 Umfundi angahlola ubufakazi obunikezwa ngamasethi edatha maqondana nombuzo othile wesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.2 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuhlola ubufakazi obunikezwa yidatha ukuze aphenye ngekhwalithi nangobuningi indima yokukhethwa kwemvelo ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zebhayoloji zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.1 Zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo zidinga ukufakwa okuqhubekayo kwamandla amahhala.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obukhiqizwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.1 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuthi izinhlelo zebhayoloji zisebenzisa kanjani amandla amahhala ngokusekelwe kudatha yobufakazi yokuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo zidinga ukufakwa kwamandla aqhubekayo ukuze zilondoloze ukuhleleka, ukukhula kanye nokuzala.

 Umlando wokuphila kohlobo uchaza uchungechunge lwezehlakalo phakathi nesikhathi salo sokuphila, njengokuthi izinsiza zabelwa kanjani ukukhula, ukugcinwa, kanye nokuzala. Izici zomlando wokuphila zithinta ithebula lokuphila lento ephilayo. Umlando wokuphila kohlobo unqunywa futhi ulolongwe yimvelo kanye nokukhethwa kwemvelo.
question1: Kungani zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo zidinga ukufaka amandla mahhala njalo?
answer1: Ukugcina ukuhleleka, ukukhula, nokuzala kabusha
question2: Iyini isabelomali samandla?
answer2: Ibhalansi phakathi kokungenisa amandla kanye namandla asetshenziselwa ukugaya ukudla, ukunakekelwa kwabazali, kanye nokugcina ukudla
distractor2a: Inani eliphelele lamandla agcinwe ohlelweni lwemvelo
question3: Kuchaza ukuthini ukuzala?
answer3: Inani elikhulu kakhulu lenzalo umuntu angayizala
distractor3b: Inani lenzalo elisindayo lize libe ngabantu abadala
question4: Ukuzala ngokuvamile kuhlobene kanjani nokunakekelwa kwabazali ezilwaneni?
answer4: Kuyisilinganiso esiphambene; izinhlobo ezinokuzala okuphezulu zivame ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okuncane kwabazali ngenzalo ngayinye
distractor4a: Kungokulingana ngqo; ukuzala okuphezulu kusho ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe kwabazali ngenzalo ngayinye
distractor4b: Akukho buhlobo phakathi kokuzala nokunakekelwa kwabazali
distractor4c: Ukunakekelwa kwabazali kunquma kuphela isikhathi sokuphila
question5: Ngokusho kwe-AP® Biology Learning Objective 1.2, abafundi kufanele bakwazi ukuhlola ubufakazi bayiphi inqubo?
answer5: Indima yokukhetha kwemvelo ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo
question6: Ngokusho kwe-AP® Biology Learning Objective 2.1, izinto eziphilayo zidinga amandla angaguquki kuziphi izinqubo?
answer6: Ukugcina inhlangano, ukukhula, kanye nokuzala kabusha
distractor6a: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo, ukuhlukaniswa, kanye nokufuduka
distractor6c: Ukugaya ukudla, ukujikeleza kwegazi, kanye nokukhipha ukudla kuphela
question7: Uchaza ukuthini umlando wokuphila kohlobo?
answer7: Uchungechunge lwezehlakalo phakathi nesikhathi sokuphila kwayo, okuhlanganisa nendlela izinsiza ezabelwe ngayo ukukhula, ukugcinwa, kanye nokuzala kabusha
question8: Yiziphi izici ezithinta umlando wokuphila kohlobo?
answer8: Izakhi zofuzo, indawo ezungezile, kanye nokukhetha kwemvelo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.2 Imilando Yempilo Nokukhethwa Kwemvelo | Amaphethini Omlando Wempilo kanye Nezabelomali Zamandla
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.2 Imilando Yempilo Nokukhethwa Kwemvelo | Amaphethini Omlando Wempilo kanye Nezabelomali Zamandla
chapterContent: Amandla adingwa yizo zonke izinto eziphilayo ukuze zikhule, zigcinwe, futhi zizalane; ngesikhathi esifanayo, amandla avame ukuba yisici esibalulekile ekunqumeni ukusinda kwento eziphilayo. Izitshalo, isibonelo, zithola amandla elangeni nge-photosynthesis, kodwa kumele zisebenzise la mandla ukuze zikhule, zilondoloze impilo, futhi zikhiqize imbewu ecebile ngamandla ukuze zikhiqize isizukulwane esilandelayo. Izilwane zinomthwalo owengeziwe wokusebenzisa amanye amandla azo agciniwe ukuze zithole ukudla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezinye izilwane kumele zisebenzise amandla zinakekela izingane zazo. Ngakho-ke, zonke izinhlobo zinesabelomali samandla: kumele zilinganisele ukusetshenziswa kwamandla nokusebenzisa kwazo amandla ukuze kugaywe umzimba, ukuzala, ukunakekelwa kwabazali, kanye nokugcinwa kwamandla (njengamabhere akha amafutha omzimba ukuze ahlale ebusika)
question1: Kungani amandla ebalulekile kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Kuyadingeka ekukhuleni, ekunakekelweni nasekuzaleni kabusha
distractor1c: Isetshenziswa kuphela ukulawula izinga lokushisa lomzimba
question2: Kungani amandla evame ukubhekwa njengento evimbela ukusinda?
answer2: Izinto eziphilayo kumele zithole amandla anele ukusekela zonke izinqubo ezibalulekile zokuphila
distractor2a: Amandla awanamkhawulo kuzo zonke izinhlaka zemvelo
distractor2b: Izitshalo kuphela ezidinga amandla ukuze ziphile
distractor2c: Izinto eziphilayo zingaphila unomphela ngaphandle kokusebenzisa amandla
question3: Izitshalo zithola kanjani amandla eziwasebenzisayo?
answer3: Zibamba amandla avela elangeni nge-photosynthesis
question4: Ngaphandle kokukhula nokugcinwa kwayo, izitshalo zisebenzisani amandla?
answer4: Ukukhiqiza imbewu ecebile ngamandla ukuze ikhiqize kabusha
question5: Kungani izilwane ngokuvamile zidinga amandla aphezulu kunezitshalo?
answer5: Kumelwe basebenzise amandla ukuze bathole ukudla ngaphezu kokukhula, ukugcinwa, kanye nokuzala
question6: Yimuphi umsebenzi ongadinga amandla engeziwe ezilwaneni eziningi?
answer6: Ukunakekela inzalo
question7: Iyini isabelomali samandla?
answer7: Ibhalansi phakathi kokungenisa amandla kanye namandla asetshenziselwa ukugaya ukudla, ukuzala, ukunakekelwa kwabazali, kanye nokugcina
distractor7a: Inani eliphelele lamandla atholakalayo ohlelweni lwemvelo
distractor7c: Izinga lapho amandla adluliselwa khona phakathi kwamazinga e-trophic
question8: Kungani amabhere eqoqa amafutha emzimbeni ngaphambi kokuba ahlale ebusika?
answer8: Ukugcina amandla okusetshenziswa lapho ukudla kungatholakali

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.2 Imilando Yempilo Nokukhethwa Kwemvelo | Amaphethini Omlando Wempilo kanye Nezabelomali Zamandla | Ukunakekelwa Kwabazali Nokuzala
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.2 Imilando Yempilo Nokukhethwa Kwemvelo | Amaphethini Omlando Wempilo kanye Nezabelomali Zamandla | Ukunakekelwa Kwabazali Nokuzala
chapterContent:
Ukuzala yikhono lokuzala elingaba khona lomuntu ngamunye emphakathini. Ngamanye amazwi, ukuzala kuchaza ukuthi zingaki izingane ezingakhiqizwa kahle uma umuntu enezingane eziningi ngangokunokwenzeka, okuphinda umjikelezo wokuzala ngokushesha okukhulu ngemva kokuzalwa kwenzalo. Ezilwaneni, ukuzala kuhlobene kakhulu nenani lokunakekelwa kwabazali okunikezwa inzalo ngayinye. Izinhlobo, njengezilwane eziningi ezingenamgogodla zasolwandle, ezikhiqiza inzalo eziningi zivame ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okuncane uma kukhona kwenzalo (bezingeke zibe namandla noma ikhono lokwenza kanjalo noma kunjalo). Iningi lesabelomali sazo samandla lisetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza inzalo encane kakhulu. Izilwane ezinaleli cebo zivame ukuzimela zisencane kakhulu. Lokhu kungenxa yokushintshana kwamandla okwenziwe yilezi zinto eziphilayo ukuze zikhulise ukufaneleka kwazo kokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Ngenxa yokuthi amandla azo asetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza inzalo esikhundleni sokunakekelwa kwabazali, kunengqondo ukuthi lezi nzalo zinekhono elithile lokukwazi ukuhamba endaweni yazo futhi zithole ukudla kanye nendawo yokuhlala. Ngisho nangala makhono, ubuncane bazo buzenza zibe sengozini enkulu yokudliwa yizilwane, ngakho ukukhiqizwa kwenzalo eziningi kuvumela okwanele kwazo ukuba zisinde ukuze zilondoloze uhlobo.

 Izinhlobo zezilwane ezinenzalo encane ngesikhathi sokuzala zivame ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okukhulu kwabazali, zinikela ingxenye enkulu yesabelomali sazo samandla kule misebenzi, ngezinye izikhathi zilimaza impilo yazo. Lokhu kunjalo ngezilwane eziningi ezincelisayo, njengabantu, ama-kangaroo, nama-panda. Inzalo yalezi zinhlobo ayinamandla kangako ekuzalweni futhi idinga ukukhula ngaphambi kokuba ikwazi ukuzimela.

 Izitshalo ezinokuzala okuncane zikhiqiza imbewu encane ecebile ngamandla (njenge-coconut nama-chestnut) ngayinye inethuba elihle lokuhluma ibe yinto entsha; izitshalo ezinokuzala okuphezulu zivame ukuba nembewu encane, engenamandla (njenge-orchid) enethuba elincane lokusinda. Nakuba kungase kubonakale sengathi ukhukhunathi nama-chestnut anethuba elingcono lokusinda, ukuhwebelana kwamandla kwe-orchid nakho kusebenza kahle kakhulu. Kuyindaba yokuthi amandla asetshenziswa kuphi, ngenani elikhulu lembewu noma ngembewu encane enamandla amaningi
question1: Kuyini ukuzala?
answer1: Amandla okuzala angaba khona omuntu, noma inani elikhulu kakhulu lenzalo angayikhiqiza
distractor1b: Iphesenti lenzalo elisindayo lize libe mdala
question2: Ukuzala ngokuvamile kuhlobene kanjani nokunakekelwa kwabazali ezilwaneni?
answer2: Izinhlobo ezinokuzala okuphezulu zivame ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okuncane kwabazali kumntwana ngamunye
distractor2a: Izinhlobo ezinokuzala okuphezulu zihlala zinikeza ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe kwabazali
distractor2c: Izilwane ezincelisayo kuphela ezibonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kokuzala kanye nokunakekelwa kwabazali
question3: Kungani izilwane eziningi ezingenamgogodla zasolwandle zikhiqiza inani elikhulu labantwana?
answer3: Ngoba ukuzala inzalo eningi kwandisa amathuba okuthi okwanele kuzosinda naphezu kokunakekelwa okuncane kwabazali
distractor3a: Ngoba ingane ngayinye idinga ukunakekelwa okubanzi kwabazali
question4: Kungani inzalo yezinhlobo ezinamaqabunga amaningi ivame ukuzimela isencane?
answer4: Abazali babo bachitha amandla abo ekuzaleni izingane eziningi kunokunakekela abazali.
distractor4a: Zithola ukunakekelwa kwabazali okwengeziwe kunezilwane ezincelisayo
distractor4b: Zichamisela ngamandla amakhulu agciniwe anikezwa abazali bazo
distractor4c: Zivikelwe ezitheni ezidla ezinye ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kwazo
question5: Kungani izilwane ezincelisayo njengabantu, ama-kangaroo, nama-panda ngokuvamile zinezingane ezimbalwa kakhulu?
answer5: Batshala ingxenye enkulu yesabelomali sabo samandla ekunakekelweni kwabazali
question6: Izitshalo ezinokuzala okuncane zivame ukuzala kanjani?
answer6: Zikhiqiza imbewu encane kakhulu ecebile ngamandla futhi zinethuba eliphezulu lokuhluma ngempumelelo
distractor6a: Zikhiqiza izinkulungwane zembewu encane ngaphandle kwamandla agciniwe
distractor6c: Bakhiqiza imbewu njalo ngekhulu leminyaka kuphela
question7: Yiluphi uhlobo lwembewu oluvame ukukhiqizwa yizitshalo ezinokuzala okuphezulu?
answer7: Imbewu eziningi ezincane, ezingenawo amandla amaningi
question8: Kungani ukukhiqiza imbewu encane eminingi kuyindlela ephumelelayo yokuzala ama-orchid?
answer8: Nakuba imbewu ngayinye inethuba eliphansi lokusinda, ukukhiqiza eziningi kwandisa amathuba okuthi ezinye zizotshala izitshalo ezintsha.
distractor8a: Imbewu ngayinye iqukethe amandla amaningi agciniwe kunekakhukhunathi
distractor8c: Imbewu ithola ukunakekelwa okukhulu kwabazali ngemva kokuhlakazeka

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.2 Imilando Yempilo Nokukhethwa Kwemvelo | Amaphethini Omlando Wempilo kanye Nezabelomali Zamandla | Ukuzala Kwasekuqaleni Uma kuqhathaniswa Nokuzala Kwangemva Kwesikhathi
chapterContent: Isikhathi sokuzala emlandweni wokuphila sithinta nokusinda kwezinhlobo. Izinto eziphilayo ezizala zisencane zinethuba elikhulu lokuzala, kodwa lokhu kuvame ukulimaza ukukhula kwazo kanye nokugcinwa kwempilo yazo. Ngokuphambene nalokho, izinto eziphilayo eziqala ukuzala kamuva ekuphileni zivame ukuba nokuzala okukhulu noma zikwazi kangcono ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwabazali, kodwa zibeka engcupheni yokuthi ngeke ziphile kuze kube sesikhathini sokuzala. Izibonelo zalokhu zingabonakala ezinhlanzini. Izinhlanzi ezincane ezifana nama-guppies zisebenzisa amandla azo ukuzala ngokushesha, kodwa azifinyeleli usayizi ongazivikela kwezinye izilwane ezidla ezinye. Izinhlanzi ezinkulu, njenge-bluegill noma i-shark, zisebenzisa amandla azo ukuzala zinkulu, kodwa zenza kanjalo ngengozi yokuthi zizofa ngaphambi kokuba zizale noma okungenani zizale zize zifike ezingeni lazo eliphezulu. Lawa maqhinga ahlukene wamandla kanye nokushintshana kuyisihluthulelo sokuqonda ukuvela kohlobo ngalunye njengoba kukhulisa ukufaneleka kwalo futhi kugcwalisa indawo yalo. Ngokuphathelene nesabelomali samandla, ezinye izinhlobo zichitha konke futhi zisebenzisa iningi lamandla azo agciniwe ukuze zizale kusenesikhathi ngaphambi kokuba zife. Ezinye izinhlobo ziyephuza ukuzala ukuze zibe ngabantu abanamandla nabanolwazi oluthe xaxa futhi ziqiniseke ukuthi zinamandla ngokwanele ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwabazali uma kudingeka.
question1: Ukuzala kwasekuqaleni kokuphila ngokuvamile kuyithinta kanjani into ephilayo?
answer1: Kukhulisa amathuba okuzala inzalo kodwa kuvame ukunciphisa amandla atholakalayo okukhula nokunakekela
question2: Iyini inzuzo engaba khona yokuzala kamuva ekuphileni?
answer2: Izinto eziphilayo zingaba nokuzala okukhulu noma zinikeze ukunakekelwa okungcono kwabazali
distractor2c: Bahlala bekhiqiza inzalo eningi kunezakhi zokuzala zakuqala
question3: Iyini ingozi enkulu yokubambezeleka kokuzala?
answer3: Isidalwa singase sife ngaphambi kokufinyelela eminyakeni yokuzala
question4: Kungani ama-guppies ezala esemncane?
answer4: Batshala amandla ekuzaleni okusheshayo esikhundleni sokukhula okuqhubekayo
distractor4b: Zifinyelela ubukhulu bomzimba obukhulu kakhulu ngaphambi kokuzala
distractor4c: Zizala kanye kuphela ngesikhathi sokuphila kwazo
question5: Kungani izinhlanzi ezinkulu njenge-bluegill kanye noshaka ziphuza ukuzala?
answer5: Zinikeza amandla ukuze zikhule zibe zinkulu ngaphambi kokuzala
distractor5c: Zigwema zonke izilwane ezidla ezinye ngokuzalana ngokushesha
question6: Yikuphi ukungqubuzana okubhekene nezinhlanzi ezinkulu ngokulibazisa ukuzala?
answer6: Zingase zife ngaphambi kokuzala noma ngaphambi kokufinyelela amandla aphezulu okuzala
distractor6a: Zihlala zikhiqiza inzalo encane kunezinjana ezincane
question7: Kungani amasu ahlukene amandla okuzala ebalulekile ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo?
answer7: Zisiza ukukhulisa ukuqina komzimba futhi zivumela izinhlobo zezilwane ukuthi zigcwalise izindawo ezahlukene zemvelo
distractor7c: Baqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhlobo zinemilando yokuphila efanayo
question8: Kungani ezinye izinhlobo zihlehlisa ukuzala kuze kube yilapho sezikhulile?
answer8: Ukuze ube namandla, ube nolwazi oluthe xaxa, futhi ukwazi kangcono ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwabazali

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.2 Imilando Yempilo Nokukhethwa Kwemvelo | Amaphethini Omlando Wempilo kanye Nezabelomali Zamandla | Imicimbi Yokuzala Eyodwa Neminingi
chapterContent:
Ezinye izici zomlando wokuphila, njengokuzala, isikhathi sokuzala, kanye nokunakekelwa kwabazali, zingahlanganiswa zibe amasu ajwayelekile asetshenziswa izinhlobo eziningi. Ukuzala kwenzeka lapho uhlobo luzala kanye kuphela ngesikhathi sokuphila kwalo bese lufa. Izinhlobo ezinjalo zisebenzisa iningi lesabelomali sazo semithombo ngesikhathi somcimbi owodwa wokuzala, zidela impilo yazo kuze kube yilapho zingasindi. Izibonelo zokuzalana yi-bamboo, eqhakaza kanye bese ifa, kanye ne-salmon ye-Chinook (Isithombe 36.7a), esebenzisa iningi lamandla ayo agciniwe ukuze isuke olwandle iye endaweni yayo yokuhlala emanzini ahlanzekile, lapho izala khona bese ifa. Ososayensi baveze ezinye izincazelo ngenzuzo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo yokufa kwe-Chinook ngemva kokuzala: ukuzibulala okuhleliwe okubangelwa ukukhishwa okukhulu kwama-hormone e-corticosteroid, mhlawumbe ukuze abazali babe ukudla kwenzalo, noma ukukhathala okulula okubangelwa izidingo zamandla zokuzala; lokhu kusaphikiswana ngakho.

 Ukuzalana kuchaza izinhlobo ezizala ngokuphindaphindiwe phakathi nokuphila kwazo. Ezinye izilwane ziyakwazi ukuzala kanye kuphela ngonyaka, kodwa zisinda ezinkathini eziningi zokuzalana. I-pronghorn antelope iyisibonelo sesilwane esingena emjikelezweni we-estrus wesizini (ukushisa): isimo somzimba esibangelwa amahomoni esilungiselela umzimba ukuhlangana ngempumelelo (Isithombe 36.7b). Izinsikazi zalezi zinhlobo zihlangana kuphela ngesikhathi se-estrus somjikelezo. Iphethini ehlukile iyabonakala ezinkalweni ezincane, okuhlanganisa abantu nezinkawu, ezingase zizame ukuzala nganoma yisiphi isikhathi phakathi neminyaka yazo yokuzala, yize imijikelezo yazo yokuya esikhathini yenza ukukhulelwa kube cishe izinsuku ezimbalwa ngenyanga ngesikhathi sokuvuthwa (Isithombe 36.7c)
question1: Kuyini i-semelparity?
answer1: Isu lomlando wokuphila lapho into ephilayo izala kanye ngesikhathi sokuphila kwayo bese iyafa
distractor1a: Isu lapho isidalwa sizala khona njalo kukho konke ukuphila
distractor1b: Isu lokuzala elihilela ukuzala okungenabo ubulili kuphela
distractor1c: Isu lapho ukuzala kwenzeka khona ebusika kuphela
question2: Kungani izinhlobo ze-semelparous zivame ukufa ngemva kokuzala?
answer2: Batshala iningi lamandla abo kanye nezinsizakusebenza zabo emcimbini owodwa wokuzala
distractor2b: Zihlala zibulawa yizilwane ezidla ezinye ngemva kokuzalana
question3: Bheka Umfanekiso 36.7a. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sezinto eziphilayo ezisanhlamvu?
answer3: I-salmon ye-Chinook
question4: Yisiphi isitshalo esiyisibonelo sokulingana?
answer4: Uqalo
question5: Kuyini i-iteroparity?
answer5: Isu lomlando wokuphila lapho into ephilayo izala khona izikhathi eziningi ngesikhathi sokuphila kwayo
distractor5a: Isu lapho ukuzala kwenzeka kanye kuphela
question6: Bheka Umfanekiso 36.7b. Kuyini i-estrus yesizini?
answer6: Isimo somzimba esibangelwa amahomoni esilungiselela umzimba ukuhlangana ngempumelelo ngesikhathi esithile sonyaka
question7: Yiziphi izilwane ezingazama ukuzala nganoma yisiphi isikhathi phakathi neminyaka yazo yokuzala, nakuba ukukhulelwa cishe kuseduze nokuvuthwa kwamaqanda?
answer7: Abantu nama-chimpanzee
question8: Kungani ukufa kwe-Chinook salmon ngemva kokuzala kusaphikiswana ngakho nososayensi?
answer8: Ngoba kungase kubangelwe izinguquko zama-hormone ezihleliwe, ukukhathala, noma kokubili
distractor8a: Ngoba i-salmon yaseChinook ihlala iphila futhi izalana futhi

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.2 Imilando Yempilo Nokukhethwa Kwemvelo | Izabelomali Zamandla, Izindleko Zokuzala, kanye Nokukhethwa Kocansi e-Drosophila
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.2 Imilando Yempilo Nokukhethwa Kwemvelo | Izabelomali Zamandla, Izindleko Zokuzala, kanye Nokukhethwa Kocansi e-Drosophila
chapterContent:
Ucwaningo lokuthi izilwane zabela kanjani izinsiza zazo zamandla ukuze zikhule, zigcinwe, futhi zizale lusebenzise izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane ezivivinywayo. Omunye walo msebenzi wenziwe kusetshenziswa i-fruit fly evamile, i-Drosophila melanogaster. Izifundo zikhombisile ukuthi ukuzala akugcini nje ngokuba nezindleko mayelana nokuthi izimpukane zesilisa zihlala isikhathi esingakanani, kodwa futhi nezimpukane esezivele zizale izikhathi eziningana zinesidoda esilinganiselwe esisele sokuzala. Izimpukane zesilisa zandisa amathuba azo okugcina okuzala ngokukhetha ozakwethu abafanele.

 Esifundweni sango-1981, izimpukane zesilisa zafakwa ezivalweni ezinezinsikazi ezimsulwa noma ezifakwe isidoda. Abesilisa ababezale nezinsikazi ezimsulwa babenesikhathi esifushane sokuphila kunalabo abaxhumana nenani elifanayo labesifazane abafake isidoda ababengakwazi ukuzala nabo. Lo mphumela wenzeka kungakhathaliseki ukuthi abesilisa babebakhulu kangakanani (okubonisa iminyaka yabo). Ngakho-ke, abesilisa ababengazale baphila isikhathi eside, okubanika amathuba amaningi okuthola ozakwethu esikhathini esizayo.

 Izifundo zakamuva nje, ezenziwe ngo-2006, zibonisa indlela abesilisa abakhetha ngayo insikazi abazohlangana nayo nokuthi lokhu kuthinteka kanjani ekuhlanganeni kwangaphambilini (Isithombe 36.8).2 Abesilisa bavunyelwe ukukhetha phakathi kwabesifazane abancane nabakhulu. Okutholakele kubonise ukuthi abesifazane abakhulu babenokuzala okukhulu, bekhiqiza abantwana abaphindwe kabili kunabesifazane abancane ngokuhlangana. Abesilisa ababekade behlangene ngaphambili, futhi ngaleyo ndlela babenembewu encane, babizwa ngokuthi baphelelwe yimithombo,” kanti abesilisa ababengazange bahlangane babizwa ngokuthi baphelelwe yimithombo.” Ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi nakuba abesilisa abaphelelwe yimithombo babekhetha ukuhlangana nabesifazane abakhulu, lokhu kukhethwa kwabalingani kwakugqame kakhulu kwabesilisa abaphelelwe yimithombo. Ngakho-ke, abesilisa abanembewu encane, ababelinganiselwe enanini lezikhathi ababengakwazi ukuhlangana ngazo ngaphambi kokuba bagcwalise isidoda sabo, bakhetha abesifazane abakhulu, abanenzalo, ngaleyo ndlela bandisa amathuba abo okuthola abantwana. Lolu cwaningo lwalungolunye lokuqala ukukhombisa ukuthi isimo somzimba sendoda sithinte ukuziphatha kwayo kokuhlangana ngendlela ekhulisa ngokusobala ukusetshenziswa kwayo kwemithombo yokuzala elinganiselwe.

 Lezi zifundo zibonisa izindlela ezimbili lapho isabelomali samandla siyingxenye yokuzala. Okokuqala, amandla asetshenziswa ekuzaleni anganciphisa isikhathi sokuphila kwesilwane, kodwa ngalesi sikhathi asevele ezala, ngakho-ke esimweni sokukhetha kwemvelo lokhu kufa kwasekuqaleni akubalulekile kakhulu ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo. Okwesibili, lapho izinsiza ezifana nesidoda (kanye namandla adingekayo ukusigcwalisa) ziphansi, ukuziphatha kwesidalwa kungashintsha ukuze kunikezwe ithuba elihle kakhulu lokudlulisela izakhi zofuzo zaso esizukulwaneni esilandelayo. Lezi zinguquko ekuziphatheni, ezibaluleke kakhulu ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo, zifundwa emkhakheni owaziwa ngokuthi i-behavioral biology, noma i-ethology, ekuxhumaneni phakathi kwe-population biology kanye ne-psychology.
question1: Izifundo ze-Drosophila melanogaster ziboniseni ngokuzala?
answer1: Ukuzala kunezindleko zamandla ezinganciphisa isikhathi sokuphila futhi zithonye impumelelo yokuzala esikhathini esizayo
distractor1b: Izimpukane zezithelo zesifazane kuphela ezikhokha izindleko zamandla zokuzala
distractor1c: Izimpukane zezithelo ziyazala ngaphandle kokusebenzisa amandla agciniwe
question2: Ocwaningweni lwango-1981, ukuzalana kwakuthinta kanjani isikhathi sokuphila kwezimpukane zesilisa?
answer2: Abesilisa ababelala nezinsikazi ezimsulwa babephila isikhathi esifushane kunabesilisa ababengakwazi ukuzala
distractor2a: Abesilisa ababezalelana babephila isikhathi eside kunabesilisa abangakazalelani
distractor2b: Ukuzalana akuzange kube nomthelela olinganisekayo empilweni yokuphila
distractor2c: Amaduna amakhulu kuphela aphila isikhathi esifushane ngemva kokukhwelana
question3: Kusho ukuthini ngempukane yesilisa ephelelwe yizinsiza?
answer3: Owesilisa owayeke wahlangana nowesifazane futhi enesidoda esincane
distractor3c: Owesilisa owayesemncane kakhulu ukuba angakwazi ukuzala
question4: Bheka Umfanekiso 36.8. Kungani izimpukane zesilisa eziphelelwe yizinsiza zibonise ukuthanda kakhulu izinsikazi ezinkulu?
answer4: Izinsikazi ezinkulu zazizala kakhulu futhi zazala izingane eziningi ngokuzalana ngakunye
distractor4a: Abesifazane abakhulu baphila isikhathi eside kunabesifazane abancane
question5: Ucwaningo lwe-Drosophila lwango-2006 lwembulani mayelana nokuziphatha kokuhlangana kwabesilisa?
answer5: Isimo somzimba sabesilisa sithonya ukukhetha umlingani ukuze kwandiswe impumelelo yokuzala
distractor5a: Ukukhetha umlingani wesilisa kuyinto engahleliwe ngokuphelele
distractor5b: Ukuziphatha kwabesifazane kuphela okuthonya impumelelo yokuzala
distractor5c: Izimpukane zezithelo zesilisa zihlala zithanda izinsikazi ezincane
question6: Kungani ukufa kusenesikhathi ngemva kokuzala kuvame ukuba nokubaluleka okulinganiselwe kokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer6: Ngoba umuntu usevele edlulisele izakhi zofuzo zakhe esizukulwaneni esilandelayo
question7: Yiziphi izifundo zasensimini ezishintshayo ekuziphatheni ezithuthukisa impumelelo yokuzala?
answer7: Ibhayoloji yokuziphatha (i-etology)
question8: Izimpukane zezithelo zesilisa ezazike zahlangana ngaphambili zinembewu encane yesidoda. Lezi zinduna zikhetha izinsikazi ezinkulu ukuze zihlangane nazo. Izinsikazi ezinkulu zinoboya obuningi (zikhiqiza amaqanda amaningi) kunezinsikazi ezincane. Izimpukane zezithelo zesilisa ezingakaze zihlangane ngaphambili zinembewu eningi yesidoda. Lezi zinduna azibonisi ukukhetha okunamandla kakhulu kwezinsikazi ezinkulu nezinoboya obuningi. Yikuphi okungachaza lokhu okubonwayo?
answer8: Ukutholakala kwamandla okukhiqiza isidoda kuyisici esivimbelayo lapha. Abesilisa abanesidoda esincane bazama ukwandisa amathuba abo okuthola abantwana
distractor8a: Ukutholakala kwamandla okubeka amaqanda amaningi kuyisici esivimbelayo lapha. Abesifazane bagcina amandla amaningi ngaphambi kokuba baqale ukukhiqiza amaqanda.
distractor8b: Ukutholakala kwamandla okubeka amaqanda amaningi kuyisici esivimbelayo lapha. Abesifazane baqala ukukhiqiza amaqanda ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka, ukuze bakwazi ukukhiqiza amaqanda amaningi.
distractor8c: Ukutholakala kwamandla okukhiqiza isidoda kuyisici esivimbelayo lapha. Abesilisa abanesidoda esincane bazama ukuhlangana nanoma yimuphi owesifazane abamtholayo ngoba sebesondele ekupheleni komjikelezo wabo wokuphila.

Izazi zemvelo zabantu zisebenzisa izindlela zezibalo ukulingisa ukuguquguquka kwenani labantu. Lawa mamodeli angasetshenziswa ukuchaza izinguquko ezenzeka kubantu kanye nokubikezela kangcono izinguquko zesikhathi esizayo. Ukusebenzisa izibalo kulawa mamodeli (nokukwazi ukulawula izilinganiso) kusesilinganisweni se-AP®. (Khumbula ukuthi ku-AP® Exam uzokwazi ukufinyelela ishidi lefomula elinalezi zilinganiso.)

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 4 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo kunezici eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezicini eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.5 Imiphakathi yakhiwe yizinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisana ngezindlela eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
2.2 Umfundi angasebenzisa izindlela zezibalo enanini elichaza izenzakalo zemvelo.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.12 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izindlela zezibalo enanini elichaza imiphakathi eyakhiwe yizinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisana ngezindlela eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.5 Imiphakathi yakhiwe yizinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisana ngezindlela eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo nezibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.13 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela imiphumela yoshintsho kubantu bomphakathi emphakathini.

 Nakuba umlando wokuphila uchaza indlela izici eziningi zabantu (njengokwakheka kweminyaka yabo) ezishintsha ngayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngendlela evamile, izazi zemvelo zabantu zisebenzisa izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokulingisa ukuguquguquka kwabantu ngokwezibalo. Lawa mamodeli anembe kakhulu angasetshenziswa ukuchaza ngokunembile izinguquko ezenzeka kubantu futhi abikezele kangcono izinguquko zesikhathi esizayo. Amanye amamodeli amukelwe amashumi eminyaka manje ayashintshwa noma alahlwa ngenxa yokuntuleka kwawo ikhono lokubikezela, futhi izazi zilwela ukudala amamodeli amasha asebenzayo.
question1: Kungani izazi zemvelo zisebenzisa amamodeli ezibalo?
answer1: Ukuchaza izinguquko zabantu nokubikezela ukuguquguquka kwenani labantu esikhathini esizayo
distractor1a: Ukuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo zibe amaqembu e-taxonomic
question2: Kungani izibalo zibalulekile ku-AP® Biology population ecology?
answer2: Isetshenziselwa ukusebenzisa nokulawula izibalo ezibonisa ukuguquguquka kwabantu
question3: Ngokusho kwe-AP® Biology Learning Objective 4.12, abafundi kufanele bakwazi ukwenzani?
answer3: Sebenzisa izindlela zezibalo emananini achaza imiphakathi eyakhiwe ngabantu abaxhumanayo
distractor3a: Khumbula amagama azo zonke izinhlobo zemvelo
distractor3b: Hlela izinto eziphilayo usebenzisa i-morphology kuphela
question4: Ngokusho kwe-AP® Biology Learning Objective 4.13, abafundi kufanele bakwazi ukubikezela ini?
answer4: Imiphumela yezinguquko emphakathini emphakathini
distractor4b: Ubudala bazo zonke izinto eziphilayo endaweni ezungezile
question5: Amamodeli ezibalo zabantu athuthuka kanjani ezincazelweni zomlando wokuphila ojwayelekile?
answer5: Zinikeza izincazelo ezinembile kakhulu zezinguquko zabantu kanye nezibikezelo ezingcono zezindlela zesikhathi esizayo
distractor5b: Zithatha indawo yesidingo sokuqoqa idatha yabantu
distractor5c: Zichaza kuphela izinto eziphilayo ngazinye kunokuba zichaze imiphakathi
question6: Kungani amanye amamodeli endabuko abantu eshintshwa noma elahliwe?
answer6: Ngoba azibikezeli njalo ngokunembile izinguquko zangempela zabantu
distractor6c: Ngoba izazi zemvelo azisafundi ngokuguquguquka kwenani labantu
question7: Iyini inhloso eyodwa yokuthuthukisa amamodeli amasha abantu?
answer7: Ukudala amamodeli ngokunemba okukhulu kokubikezela
distractor7b: Ukufaka esikhundleni somsebenzi wasensimini ngezivivinyo zelebhu
distractor7c: Ukuhlukanisa zonke izinto eziphilayo zibe uhlobo olusha

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.3 Imikhawulo Yemvelo Ekukhuleni Komphakathi | Ukukhula Okubonakalayo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.3 Imikhawulo Yemvelo Ekukhuleni Komphakathi | Ukukhula Okubonakalayo
chapterContent:
UCharles Darwin, embonweni wakhe wokukhethwa kwemvelo, wathonywa kakhulu ngumfundisi waseNgilandi uThomas Malthus. UMalthus washicilela incwadi ngo-1798 ethi imiphakathi enezinsiza zemvelo ezingenamkhawulo ikhula ngokushesha okukhulu, okumelela ukukhula okukhulu, bese ukukhula kwenani labantu kuncipha njengoba izinsiza zincipha, okubonisa ukukhula kwe-logistic.

 Isibonelo esihle kakhulu sokukhula okukhulu sibonakala kumabhaktheriya. Amabhaktheriya angama-prokaryotes azala ngokuhlukana kwe-prokaryotic. Lokhu kuhlukaniswa kuthatha cishe ihora elilodwa ezinhlobo eziningi zamabhaktheriya. Uma amabhaktheriya ayi-1000 efakwa ebhodleleni elikhulu elinokunikezwa okungenamkhawulo kwezakhamzimba (ukuze izakhamzimba zinganciphi), ngemva kwehora, kuba nomjikelezo owodwa wokuhlukana futhi into ngayinye iyahlukana, okuholela ezintweni eziphilayo ezingu-2000—ukwanda kwe-1000. Ngelinye ihora, into ngayinye yezinto eziphilayo ezingu-2000 izophindeka kabili, ikhiqize ezingu-4000, ukwanda kwezinto eziphilayo ezingu-2000. Ngemva kwehora lesithathu, kufanele kube namabhaktheriya angu-8000 ebhodleleni, ukwanda kwezinto eziphilayo ezingu-4000. Umqondo obalulekile wokukhula kwe-exponential ukuthi izinga lokukhula kwenani labantu—inani lezinto eziphilayo ezengeziwe esizukulwaneni ngasinye sokuzala—liyashesha; okungukuthi, liyanda ngesivinini esikhulu nangokwengeziwe. Ngemva kosuku olu-1 kanye no-24 wale mijikelezo, inani labantu ngabe landa lisuka ku-1000 liye ngaphezu kwezigidigidi eziyi-16. Lapho usayizi wabantu, i-N, udwetshwe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kukhiqizwa ijika lokukhula elinomfanekiso ka-J (Isithombe 36.9).

 Isibonelo samagciwane asimeleli umhlaba wangempela lapho izinsiza zilinganiselwe khona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amanye amabhaktheriya azofa ngesikhathi sokuhlola futhi ngaleyo ndlela angazali, okwehlisa izinga lokukhula. Ngakho-ke, lapho kubalwa izinga lokukhula labantu, izinga lokufa (D) (inani lezinto eziphilayo ezifa ngesikhathi esithile) lisuswa esilinganisweni sokuzalwa (B) (inani lezinto eziphilayo ezizalwa ngaleso sikhathi). Lokhu kuboniswe kule fomula elandelayo:

 ΔN (ushintsho lwenani) ÷ ΔT (ushintsho lwesikhathi)
=
B (izinga lokuzalwa) - D (izinga lokufa)

 Izinga lokuzalwa livame ukuvezwa ngesisekelo somuntu ngamunye (kumuntu ngamunye). Ngakho-ke, u-B (izinga lokuzalwa) = bN (izinga lokuzalwa ngomuntu ngamunye b” liphindaphindwe ngenani labantu N”) kanye no-D (izinga lokufa) =dN (izinga lokufa ngomuntu ngamunye d” liphindaphindwe ngenani labantu N”). Ngaphezu kwalokho, izazi zemvelo zinesifiso sokuthola inani labantu ngesikhathi esithile, isikhathi esincane kakhulu. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, amagama e-differential calculus asetshenziswa ukuthola i-instantaneous” growth rate, esikhundleni soshintsho lwenombolo nesikhathi ngesilinganiso esiqondile senombolo nesikhathi.

 dN ÷ dT = bN − dN = (b − d)N

 Qaphela ukuthi i-d” ehlotshaniswa negama lokuqala ibhekisela ku-derivative (njengoba igama lisetshenziswa ku-calculus) futhi ihlukile kwi-derivative yesilinganiso sokufa, esibizwa nangokuthi i-d.” Umehluko phakathi kwamazinga okuzalwa nokufa wenziwa lula ngokufaka igama elithi r” (izinga lokukhula elingaphakathi elibonisa izinga lokukhula eliphakeme kakhulu ngomuntu ngamunye ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele) ebudlelwaneni phakathi kwamazinga okuzalwa nokufa:

 dN ÷ dT = rN

 Inani r” lingaba lihle, okusho ukuthi inani labantu liyanda ngobukhulu; noma libi, okusho ukuthi inani labantu liyancipha ngobukhulu; noma li-zero, lapho ubukhulu babantu bungashintshi, isimo esaziwa ngokuthi ukukhula kwabantu okungu-zero. Ukulungiswa okwengeziwe kwefomula kuqaphela ukuthi izinhlobo ezahlukene zinomehluko ongokwemvelo esilinganisweni sazo sokwanda (ngokuvamile okucatshangwa ukuthi kungenzeka ukuzala), ngisho nangaphansi kwezimo ezifanele. Ngokusobala, igciwane lingazala ngokushesha futhi libe nezinga lokukhula eliphakeme kunomuntu. Izinga lokukhula eliphezulu lohlobo yikhono lalo le-biotic, noma i-rmax, ngaleyo ndlela kushintshwe i-equation ibe yi:

 dN ÷ dT = r_maxN
question1: Hlobo luni lokukhula kwabantu olwenzeka lapho izinsiza zingenamkhawulo?
answer1: Ukukhula okubonakalayo
question2: Yisiphi isidalwa esihlinzeka ngesibonelo esivamile sokukhula kwenani labantu okubonakalayo?
answer2: Amabhaktheriya
question3: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.9. Yisiphi isimo esivezwayo uma kuhlelwa igrafu yokukhula kwenani labantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
answer3: Ijika elinomumo ofana no-J
question4: Uma amabhaktheriya ayi-1000 ehlukana kanye ngehora ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele, mangaki amabhaktheriya azovela ngemva kwamahora amathathu?
question5: Kungani ukukhula kwebhaktheriya okubonakalayo kungavamile ukubonwa unomphela emvelweni?
answer5: Izinsiza ziyancipha futhi abanye abantu bayafa
distractor5a: Amabhaktheriya ayayeka ukuzala ngemva kwesizukulwane esisodwa
distractor5b: Amanani okuzalwa ahlala elingana namazinga okufa
question6: Yisiphi isibalo esichaza ukukhula kwenani labantu uma kubhekwa kokubili ukuzalwa nokufa?
answer6: I-dN/dT = B - D
question7: Yini i-variable r emele ku-equation yokukhula kwe-exponential?
answer7: Izinga lokukhula elingaphakathi, elilingana nomehluko phakathi kwamazinga okuzalwa nokufa ngomuntu ngamunye
question8: Kusho ukuthini uma izinga lokukhula elingaphakathi (r) lingu-zero?
answer8: Usayizi wabantu uhlala ungaguquki ngoba ukuzalwa kuyalingana nokufa
distractor8c: Inani labantu selifinyelele usayizi walo omkhulu ngangokunokwenzeka
question9: Iyini i-bioactive potential yohlobo (rmax)?
answer9: Izinga eliphezulu kakhulu lokwanda kwabantu ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele
distractor9c: Inani eliphelele lenzalo ekhiqizwe ngesikhathi sokuphila okukodwa

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.3 Imikhawulo Yemvelo Ekukhuleni Komphakathi | Ukukhula Kwezinto Ezidingekayo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.3 Imikhawulo Yemvelo Ekukhuleni Komphakathi | Ukukhula Kwezinto Ezidingekayo
chapterContent: Ukukhula okubonakalayo kungenzeka kuphela uma kukhona izinsiza zemvelo ezingenamkhawulo; lokhu akunjalo ezweni langempela. UCharles Darwin waqaphela leli qiniso encazelweni yakhe yomzabalazo wokuphila,” ethi abantu ngabanye bazoncintisana (namalungu abo noma ezinye izinhlobo) ngezinsiza ezilinganiselwe. Abaphumelelayo bazosinda ukuze badlulisele izici zabo kanye nezici zabo (esaziyo manje ukuthi zidluliselwa izakhi zofuzo) esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngesivinini esikhulu (ukukhethwa kwemvelo). Ukuze babonise iqiniso lezinsiza zemvelo ezilinganiselwe, izazi zemvelo zabantu zakha imodeli yokukhula kwezinto.
question1: Kungani ukukhula kwenani labantu okubonakalayo kungazinzile ezindaweni zemvelo?
answer1: Ngoba izinsiza zemvelo zilinganiselwe
distractor1a: Ngoba amazinga okuzalwa ahlala elingana namazinga okufa
distractor1c: Ngoba zonke izinhlobo zizalana ngesivinini esifanayo
question2: Wayesho ukuthini uCharles Darwin ngomzabalazo wokuphila?
answer2: Abantu bancintisana namalungu ezinhlobo zabo noma ezinye izinhlobo ngezinsiza ezilinganiselwe
distractor2a: Izinto eziphilayo zincintisana kuphela nezinye izinhlobo
distractor2b: Izilwane ezidla ezinye kuphela ezincintisana ngezinsiza
distractor2c: Izinsiza azinamkhawulo kodwa izinto eziphilayo zisancintisana
question3: Ngokusho kukaDarwin, yibaphi abantu abangase badlulisele izici zabo esizukulwaneni esilandelayo?
answer3: Lezo ezisinda futhi zizalane ngempumelelo
distractor3b: Abantu abakhulu kunabo bonke kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baphilile yini
question4: Iyiphi inqubo echaza ukuthi kungani izici ezizuzisayo ziba zivamile kubantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
answer4: Ukukhetha kwemvelo
question5: Kungani kwasungulwa imodeli yokukhula kwe-logistic?
answer5: Ukukhombisa ukukhula kwenani labantu ngaphansi kwezimo zezinsiza ezilinganiselwe
question6: Yikuphi ukucabanga okuhlukanisa imodeli yokukhula kwe-logistic kumodeli yokukhula kwe-exponential?
answer6: Imodeli ye-logistic icabanga ukuthi izinsiza ziyancishiswa njengoba usayizi wabantu ukhula
distractor6a: Imodeli ye-logistic icabanga ukuthi amazinga okuzalwa ahlala edlula amazinga okufa
distractor6b: Imodeli ye-logistic icabanga ukuthi abantu abakaze bancintisane ngezinsizakusebenza
distractor6c: Imodeli ye-logistic ithatha ukudla okungenamkhawulo nendawo
question7: Yisiphi isici semvelo esibangela kakhulu ukwehla kokukhula kwenani labantu kumodeli wezokuthutha?
answer7: Ukuncintisana ngezinsizakusebenza ezilinganiselwe

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.3 Imikhawulo Yemvelo Ekukhuleni Komphakathi | Ukukhula Kwezinto Ezidingekayo | Amandla Okuthwala kanye Nemodeli Yezinto Ezidingekayo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.3 Imikhawulo Yemvelo Ekukhuleni Komphakathi | Ukukhula Kwezinto Ezidingekayo | Amandla Okuthwala kanye Nemodeli Yezinto Ezidingekayo
chapterContent:
Ezweni langempela, ngezinsizakusebenza ezilinganiselwe, ukukhula okubonakalayo akukwazi ukuqhubeka unomphela. Ukukhula okubonakalayo kungenzeka ezindaweni lapho kunabantu abambalwa kanye nezinsizakusebenza eziningi, kodwa lapho inani labantu liba likhulu ngokwanele, izinsizakusebenza zizophela, kunciphise izinga lokukhula. Ekugcineni, izinga lokukhula lizoncipha noma linciphe (Isithombe 36.9). Lobu bukhulu benani labantu, obumele ubukhulu benani labantu obungasekelwa yindawo ethile, bubizwa ngokuthi umthamo wokuthwala, noma i-K.

 Ifomula esiyisebenzisayo ukubala ukukhula kwezinto ezisetshenziswayo inezela umthamo wokuthwala njengamandla okulinganisela izinga lokukhula. Inkulumo ethi K – N” ikhombisa ukuthi bangaki abantu abangangezwa kubantu esigabeni esithile, kanti i-K – N” ehlukaniswe yi-K” iyingxenyana yomthamo wokuthwala otholakalayo ukuze kukhule okwengeziwe. Ngakho-ke, imodeli yokukhula kwe-exponential inqunyelwe yilesi sici ukuze kukhiqizwe i-equation yokukhula kwe-logistic:

 dN ÷ dT = r_maxN * dN ÷ dT = r_maxN * ((K − N) ÷ K)

 Qaphela ukuthi uma i-N incane kakhulu, i-(K-N)/K iba seduze ne-K/K noma i-1, futhi uhlangothi lwesokudla lwe-equation luyancipha lube yi-rmaxN, okusho ukuthi inani labantu likhula kakhulu futhi alithonywa umthamo wokuthwala. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma i-N inkulu, i-(K-N)/K isondela ku-zero, okusho ukuthi ukukhula kwabantu kuzoncishiswa kakhulu noma kumiswe. Ngakho-ke, ukukhula kwabantu kuncishiswa kakhulu kubantu abaningi ngumthamo wokuthwala i-K. Le modeli ivumela futhi inani labantu abakhula kabi, noma ukwehla kwenani labantu. Lokhu kwenzeka lapho inani labantu emphakathini lidlula umthamo wokuthwala (ngoba inani lika-(K-N)/K liyi-negative).

 Igrafu yalesi sibalo iveza ijika eliyi-S (Isithombe 36.9), futhi iyimodeli engokoqobo yokukhula kwenani labantu kunokukhula kwe-exponential. Kunezigaba ezintathu ezahlukene zejika eliyi-S. Ekuqaleni, ukukhula kuyashesha ngoba bambalwa abantu kanye nezinsiza ezanele ezitholakalayo. Ngemuva kwalokho, njengoba izinsiza ziqala ukuncishiswa, izinga lokukhula liyancipha. Ekugcineni, ukukhula kuyashesha kumthamo wokuthwala wendawo, ngokushintsha okuncane ngobukhulu benani labantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
question1: Iyini umthamo wokuthwala (K)?
answer1: Usayizi omkhulu wabantu indawo ezungezile engawusekela ngendlela eqhubekayo
distractor1a: Usayizi omncane wabantu odingekayo ukuze kusindiswe
question2: Kungani ukukhula kwenani labantu kuhamba kancane njengoba usayizi wenani labantu usondela emthwalweni?
answer2: Izinsizakusebenza ziyancipha, okunciphisa izinga lokukhula kwabantu
question3: Ku-equation yokukhula kwe-logistic, limelelani igama elithi (K − N)/K?
answer3: Ingxenye encane yamandla okuthwala asekhona okukhula kwabantu
question4: Kwenzekani ngesibalo sokukhula kwempahla lapho usayizi wabantu (N) umncane kakhulu uma uqhathaniswa nomthamo wokuthwala (K)?
answer4: Kucishe kufane nokukhula kwe-exponential ngoba (K − N)/K cishe ku-1
question5: Kwenzekani uma usayizi wabantu (N) useduze nomthamo wokuthwala (K)?
answer5: Ukukhula kwenani labantu kwehla kakhulu ngoba (K − N)/K kusondela ku-zero
question6: Kwenzekani uma inani labantu lidlula umthamo walo wokuthwala?
answer6: Inani labantu liba nokukhula okungekuhle futhi liqala ukwehla
distractor6c: Amanani okuzalwa aba makhulu kunezinga lokukhula elingaphakathi
question7: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.9. Iyini ukuma kwejika lokukhula kwe-logistic?
answer7: Ijika elimise okwe-S
question8: Yisiphi isigaba sokukhula kwempahla esibonakala ngezinsizakusebenza eziningi kanye nokwanda okusheshayo kwenani labantu?
answer8: Isigaba sokuqala sokukhula okubonakalayo
question9: Kungani imodeli yokukhula kwe-logistic ibhekwa njengengokoqobo kakhulu kunemodeli yokukhula kwe-exponential?
answer9: Ibala izinsiza ezilinganiselwe ngokufaka umthamo wokuthwala ekukhuleni kwenani labantu
distractor9a: Kucabanga ukuthi izinsiza azinamkhawulo kuze kube phakade
distractor9c: Kubikezela ukuthi bonke abantu bakhula ngesivinini esifanayo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.3 Imikhawulo Yemvelo Ekukhuleni Komphakathi | Ukukhula Kwezinto Ezidingekayo | Indima Yomncintiswano Ongaqondile
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.3 Imikhawulo Yemvelo Ekukhuleni Komphakathi | Ukukhula Kwezinto Ezidingekayo | Indima Yomncintiswano Ongaqondile
chapterContent:
Imodeli ye-logistic icabanga ukuthi wonke umuntu ngaphakathi kwesizwe uzoba nokufinyelela okulinganayo ezinsizeni, ngakho-ke, ithuba elilinganayo lokusinda. Ezitshalweni, inani lamanzi, ukukhanya kwelanga, izakhamzimba, kanye nendawo yokukhula yizinsiza ezibalulekile, kanti ezilwaneni, izinsiza ezibalulekile zifaka phakathi ukudla, amanzi, indawo yokukhosela, indawo yokuhlala, kanye nabangane.

 Ezweni langempela, ukuhlukahluka kwe-phenotypic phakathi kwabantu ngaphakathi kwesizwe kusho ukuthi abanye abantu bazojwayela kangcono indawo yabo kunabanye. Ukuncintisana okubangelwayo phakathi kwamalungu esizwe afanayo ezinhlobo zezinsiza kubizwa ngokuthi ukuncintisana kwangaphakathi (intra- = ngaphakathi”; -specific = species). Ukuncintisana kwangaphakathi kwezinsiza kungase kungathinti abantu abangaphansi kakhulu kwamandla abo okuthwala—izinsiza ziningi futhi bonke abantu bangathola abakudingayo. Kodwa-ke, njengoba usayizi wabantu ukhula, lo mncintiswano uyaqina. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqongelela kwemikhiqizo kadoti kunganciphisa amandla okuthwala indawo.
question1: Yimuphi umbono owenziwa yimodeli yokukhula kwe-logistic ngabantu ngabanye emphakathini?
answer1: Wonke umuntu unokufinyelela okulinganayo ezinsizeni kanye nethuba elilinganayo lokusinda
distractor1a: Abantu abadala bahlala bethola izinsiza eziningi kunabasebasha
distractor1b: Abantu abanamandla kakhulu kuphela abazala kabusha
question2: Yiziphi izinsiza ezibaluleke kakhulu ezitshalweni?
answer2: Amanzi, ukukhanya kwelanga, izakhamzimba, nendawo yokukhula
distractor2b: I-oksijini, izindawo zokuzalela, kanye nezilwane ezidlayo
question3: Yiziphi izinsiza ezibalulekile ezilwaneni?
answer3: Ukudla, amanzi, indawo yokukhosela, indawo yokuhlala, kanye nezindawo zokuhlala
distractor3a: Ukukhanya kwelanga, izakhamzimba zomhlabathi, kanye nendawo yezimpande
question4: Kungani abantu ngaphakathi kwesizwe bengenalo ithuba elifanayo lokusinda emvelweni?
answer4: Ukwehlukahluka kwe-phenotypic kubangela ukuthi abanye abantu bazivumelanise kangcono nabanye
distractor4b: Wonke umuntu uthola inani elifanayo lezinsizakusebenza
distractor4c: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kuthinta bonke abantu ngokulinganayo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baluhlobo luni lwe-phenotype
question5: Kuyini ukuncintisana okuqondile?
answer5: Ukuncintisana phakathi kwamalungu ohlobo olufanayo ngezinsiza ezilinganiselwe
distractor5b: Ukuzingelwa kwezilwane phakathi kwamalungu ezinhlobo ezahlukene
question6: Kunini lapho ukuncintisana okuqondene ngqo kungenzeka khona ukuthi kuthinte kakhulu inani labantu?
answer6: Uma inani labantu lingaphansi kakhulu kwamandla alo okuthwala kanye nezinsizakusebenza eziningi
distractor6a: Uma inani labantu lidlula umthamo wokuthwala
distractor6b: Uma inani labantu lifinyelela ekukhuleni okungenalutho
question7: Ukwanda kosayizi wabantu kuthinta kanjani ukuncintisana okuqondile?
answer7: Ukuncintisana kuba nzima kakhulu njengoba abantu abaningi bencintisana ngezinsizakusebenza ezifanayo ezilinganiselwe
distractor7a: Ukuncintisana kuncipha ngoba izinsiza ezengeziwe ziyatholakala
distractor7b: Ukuncintisana kuyanyamalala uma sekufinyelelwe umthamo wokuthwala
distractor7c: Ukuncintisana kuthinta kuphela izilwane ezidla ezinye
question8: Ukuqongelela kwemikhiqizo kadoti kungabathinta kanjani abantu abaningi?
answer8: Kunganciphisa amandla okuthwala izindawo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.3 Imikhawulo Yemvelo Ekukhuleni Komphakathi | Ukukhula Kwezinto Ezidingekayo | Izibonelo Zokukhula Kwezinto Ezidingekayo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.3 Imikhawulo Yemvelo Ekukhuleni Komphakathi | Ukukhula Kwezinto Ezidingekayo | Izibonelo Zokukhula Kwezinto Ezidingekayo
chapterContent: Imvubelo, isikhunta esincane esisetshenziselwa ukwenza isinkwa, sibonisa ijika eliyindilinga eliyi-S uma likhuliswe epayipini lokuhlola (Isithombe 36.10a). Ukukhula kwayo kuyakhuphuka njengoba inani labantu liqeda izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ekukhuleni kwalo. Nokho, ezweni langempela, kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zaleli jika elifanele. Izibonelo ezilwaneni zasendle zifaka phakathi izimvu nezimvu zasolwandle (Isithombe 36.10b). Kuzo zombili izibonelo, usayizi wabantu udlula umthamo wokuthwala isikhathi esifushane bese wehla ngaphansi komthamo wokuthwala ngemva kwalokho. Lokhu kuguquguquka kosayizi wabantu kuyaqhubeka kwenzeka njengoba inani labantu lijikeleza umthamo walo wokuthwala. Noma kunjalo, ngisho nangalokhu kunyakaza, imodeli ye-logistic iyaqinisekiswa.
question1: Yisiphi isidalwa esibonisa ijika lokukhula eliyindilinga eliyi-S eliyindilinga uma likhuliswe eshubhu lokuhlola?
answer1: Imvubelo
question2: Kungani ukukhula kwenani lemvubelo ekugcineni kufinyelela ezingeni elifanele eshubhu lokuhlola?
answer2: Inani labantu liqeda izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ukuze kuqhubeke ukukhula
distractor2a: Izinga lokushisa liba phansi kakhulu ngokuzumayo
distractor2b: Imvubelo iyayeka ukuzala ngemva kwesizukulwane esisodwa
question3: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.10. Yiziphi izilwane zasendle ezivezwa njengezibonelo zokukhula kwezinto eziphilayo?
answer3: Izimvu nezimbuzi zasechwebeni
question4: Kungani izilwane zasendle zivame ukushintshashintsha ngokuya ngomthamo wazo wokuthwala esikhundleni sokuhlala zinjalo?
answer4: Izimo zemvelo kanye nokutholakala kwezinsizakusebenza kuyashintsha njalo
distractor4a: Umthamo wokuthwala awulokothi uthinte izilwane zasendle
distractor4c: Amanani okufa ayama unomphela ngemva kokuba umthamo wokuthwala usufinyelelwe
question5: Kwenzekani uma inani labantu lidlula umthamo walo okwesikhashana?
answer5: Inani labantu livame ukwehla ngaphansi komthamo wokuthwala ngaphambi kokuba likhuphuke futhi
distractor5b: Ukukhula kwenani labantu kuyaqhubeka ngokushesha okukhulu
question6: Naphezu kokuguquguquka kwemvelo, imodeli ye-logistic ichaza ini ngokunembile?
answer6: Ukukhula kwenani labantu kunqunyelwe umthamo wokuthwala
question7: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.10. Chaza izizathu eziyisisekelo zomehluko kuma-curve amabili aboniswe kulezi zibonelo
answer7: Imvubelo ikhuliswa ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele, ngakho-ke umugqa ubonisa ukulinganiselwa kwezinsiza endaweni elawulwayo. Izimvu zamanzi zihlala endaweni yemvelo lapho izinhlobo ezifanayo zezinsiza zilinganiselwe khona; kodwa, zibhekene nezinye izingcindezi ezifana nokufuduka kanye nesimo sezulu esishintshayo.
distractor7a: Imvubelo ikhuliswa ngaphansi kwezimo zemvelo, ngakho-ke ijika libonisa ukulinganiselwa kwezinsiza ngenxa yendawo ezungezile. Izimbobo zabonwa nasezimweni zemvelo; kodwa, kwakukhona izingcindezi ezengeziwe ngaphezu kokulinganiselwa kwezinsiza njengokufuduka kanye nesimo sezulu esishintshayo.
distractor7b: Imvubelo ikhuliswa ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele, ngakho-ke umugqa ubonisa ukulinganiselwa kwezinsiza endaweni engalawulwa. Izimfene zihlala endaweni yemvelo lapho izinhlobo ezifanayo zezinsiza zilinganiselwe khona; kodwa zibhekene nezinye izingcindezi ezifana nokufuduka kanye nesimo sezulu esishintshayo.
distractor7c: Imvubelo ikhuliswa ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele, ngakho-ke umugqa ubonisa ukulinganiselwa kwezinsiza endaweni elawulwayo. Izimvu ziphila endaweni yemvelo lapho izinhlobo ezifanayo zezinsiza zilinganiselwe khona; kodwa, zibhekene nokucindezela okunye kokufuduka kwezimvu zisuka kubantu.
question8: Kungani imvubelo ivame ukusetshenziswa ukubonisa ukukhula kwezinto ezisetshenziswayo ekuhlolweni kwelebhu?
answer8: Ukukhula kwayo kungabonakala ngaphansi kwezimo ezilawulwayo lapho ukutholakala kwezakhamzimba kuyisici esiyinhloko esivimbelayo
distractor8b: Izala kanye kuphela ngesikhathi sokuphila kwayo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Population and Community Ecology | 36.4 Ukuguquguquka Nokulawulwa Kwabantu | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Population and Community Ecology | 36.4 Ukuguquguquka Nokulawulwa Kwabantu | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Nakuba ukubheka imodeli ye-logistic kuwusizo kakhulu lapho kufundwa nge-population dynamics, kusetshenziswa izindlela ezengeziwe lapho kucatshangelwa izimo eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, njengezinguquko kumthamo wokuthwala wendawo. Izici ze-Abiotic kanye ne-biotic zingathinta amazinga okukhula nokufa kwabantu, ngakho-ke lokhu kuguquguquka kudinga nokucatshangelwa lapho kwenziwa isibonelo soshintsho lwabantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ngezinye izikhathi, ososayensi kudingeka bacabangele ukuthi amasu okuzala adlala kanjani indima ekushintsheni kwabantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ukuze kucatshangelwe ukuthi lezi zinto ezahlukene zihlangana kanjani, abantu babhekwa ngezindlela ezahlukene.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 4 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 4
Izinhlelo zebhayoloji ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezimpahleni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.5 Imiphakathi yakhiwe yizinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisana ngezindlela eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
4.1 Umfundi angathethelela ukukhethwa kohlobo lwedatha edingekayo ukuphendula umbuzo othile wesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.11 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuthethelela ukukhethwa kohlobo lwedatha edingekayo ukuphendula imibuzo yesayensi mayelana nokusebenzisana kwabantu emiphakathini.

 Imodeli ye-logistic yokukhula kwabantu, yize isebenza kubantu abaningi bemvelo kanye nemodeli ewusizo, iyindlela elula yokuguquguquka kwabantu emhlabeni wangempela. Okusobala kumodeli ukuthi amandla okuthwala emvelo awashintshi, okuyinto engekho. Amandla okuthwala ayahlukahluka minyaka yonke: isibonelo, amanye amahlobo ayashisa futhi omile kanti amanye ayabanda futhi anamanzi. Ezindaweni eziningi, amandla okuthwala ebusika aphansi kakhulu kunangesikhathi sasehlobo. Futhi, izenzakalo zemvelo njengokuzamazama komhlaba, izintaba-mlilo, nemililo zingashintsha indawo futhi ngaleyo ndlela amandla ayo okuthwala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amanani abantu awavamile ukuba khona ngokwawo. Ahlanganyela emncintiswaneni oqondile: okungukuthi, abelana ngendawo nezinye izinhlobo, encintisana nazo ngezinsiza ezifanayo. Lezi zici zibalulekile futhi ekuqondeni ukuthi inani elithile labantu lizokhula kanjani.

 Imvelo ilawula ukukhula kwenani labantu ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene. Lezi zihlanganiswe ngezinto ezincike ekuxineni kwabantu, lapho inani labantu ngesikhathi esithile lithinta izinga lokukhula kanye nokufa, kanye nezici ezincike ekuxineni kwabantu, ezithonya ukufa kwabantu kungakhathaliseki ukuthi inani labantu lingakanani. Qaphela ukuthi ekuqaleni, umphumela wesici kubantu uncike ekuxineni kwabantu ekuqaleni. Izazi zebhayoloji zokulondolozwa kwemvelo zifuna ukuqonda zombili izinhlobo ngoba lokhu kuzisiza ekuphatheni inani labantu futhi kuvimbele ukuqothulwa noma ukugcwala kwabantu
question1: Kungani kudingeka amamodeli engeziwe ngale kwemodeli yokukhula kwempahla?
answer1: Ngoba abantu bangempela babhekana nokushintsha kwamandla okuthwala kanye neminye imithonya eyinkimbinkimbi yemvelo
distractor1a: Ngoba imodeli ye-logistic ayikwazi ukuchaza ukukhula okubonakalayo
distractor1b: Ngoba abantu abakaze babhekane nokulinganiselwa kwezinsizakusebenza
question2: Yiziphi izinhlobo zezinto ezingathonya ukukhula kwabantu kanye nezinga lokufa?
answer2: Kokubili izici ze-abiotic kanye ne-biotic
question3: Kungani ukucabanga ngomthamo wokuthwala njalo kungenangqondo?
answer3: Umthamo wokuthwala uyashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngoba izimo zemvelo ziyashintsha
distractor3b: Umthamo wokuthwala uncike kuphela kusayizi wabantu
distractor3c: Umthamo wokuthwala uyafana kuzo zonke izimiso zemvelo
question4: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungashintsha umthamo wokuthwala indawo?
answer4: Imicimbi yemvelo efana nokuzamazama komhlaba, izintaba-mlilo, kanye nemililo
distractor4a: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuphela ngaphakathi kwabantu
question5: Kuyini ukuncintisana okuqondile?
answer5: Ukuncintisana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zezinsiza ezifanayo ezilinganiselwe
distractor5b: Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlobo zezilwane ukuze kutholakale izinsiza ezihlanganyelwe
question6: Yiziphi izinto ezincike ekuxineni?
answer6: Izici ezithinta ukukhula kwabantu kanye nokufa kwabo kuncike ekuminyaneni kwabantu
distractor6a: Izici ezithinta abantu kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bangakanani
distractor6c: Izinto ezibangelwa ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuphela
question7: Ziyini izinto ezizimele ngobuningi?
answer7: Izici ezithinta ukufa kwabantu kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bangakanani abantu
question8: Kungani izazi zezinto eziphilayo ezilondoloza imvelo zifunda kokubili izici ezixhomeke ekuminyaneni kanye nezinto ezixhomeke ekuminyaneni?
answer8: Ukuphatha kangcono inani labantu nokuvimbela ukuqothulwa noma ukugcwala kwabantu
distractor8b: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bakhula ngokushesha okukhulu
distractor8c: Ukubala amazinga okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kubantu bemvelo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.4 Ukuguquguquka Nokulawulwa Kwabantu | I-Regulation Esekelwe Kubuningi
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.4 Ukuguquguquka Nokulawulwa Kwabantu | I-Regulation Esekelwe Kubuningi
chapterContent:
Izici eziningi ezincike ekuxineni ziyizinto eziphilayo ngokwemvelo (i-biotic), futhi zifaka phakathi ukudla ezinye izilwane, ukuncintisana okuphakathi nangaphakathi, ukuqongelela imfucuza, kanye nezifo ezifana nalezo ezibangelwa yizinambuzane. Ngokuvamile, uma inani labantu lixinene kakhulu, izinga lokufa lalo liyanda. Isibonelo, ngesikhathi sokuncintisana okuphakathi nangaphakathi, amazinga okuzala kwabantu ngabanye avame ukuba phansi, okunciphisa izinga lokukhula kwabantu babo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuningi obuphansi bezilwane ezidlayo bukhulisa ukufa kwesilwane esidla inyama ngoba sinobunzima obukhulu ekutholeni umthombo waso wokudla.

 Isibonelo sokulawulwa kobuncane siboniswe kuMfanekiso 36.11 ngemiphumela evela ocwaningweni olugxile ku-giant intestine roundworm (Ascaris lumbricoides), i-parasite yabantu nezinye izilwane ezincelisayo. Izinhlobo eziningi zezinambuzane ezidlayo zibonise ukuzala okuphansi: zaziqukethe amaqanda ambalwa. Enye incazelo engaba khona yalokhu ukuthi abesifazane babezoba bancane ezinhlotsheni eziningi ezixinene kakhulu (ngenxa yezinsizakusebenza ezimbalwa) nokuthi abesifazane abancane babezoba namaqanda ambalwa. Lo mbono wahlolwa futhi waphikiswa ocwaningweni lwango-2009 olwabonisa ukuthi isisindo sabesifazane sasingenalo ithonya. Imbangela yangempela yokuncika kobuningi bokuzala kulesi sidalwa ayikacaci futhi ilinde uphenyo olwengeziwe.
question1: Yiziphi izinto ezincike ekuxineni?
answer1: Izinto ezithinta ukukhula kwabantu kanye nokufa kwabo njengoba ubuningi babantu bushintsha
distractor1a: Izici ezithinta abantu kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bangakanani
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuncike ekuxineni kwabantu?
answer2: Umncintiswano oqondile
question3: Ukwanda kwabantu ngokuvamile kuthinta kanjani ukufa?
answer3: Ukufa ngokuvamile kuyanda
question4: Kungani amazinga okuzala evame ukwehla ngesikhathi sokuncintisana okukhulu?
answer4: Abantu banezinsiza ezimbalwa zokuzala
question5: Kungani ukuminyana okuncane kwezilwane ezidla ezinye kwandisa ukufa kwezilwane ezidla ezinye?
answer5: Izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane zinobunzima obukhulu ekutholeni ukudla
distractor5a: Izilwane ezidla ezinye ziyeka ukuzala unomphela
distractor5b: Izilwane ezidla inyama ziba nokudla okunempilo kakhulu
distractor5c: Izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane zilahlekelwa ikhono lokuzingela
question6: Bheka Umfanekiso 36.11. Yini eyabonwa ezixukwini eziningi ze-giant intestine roundworm (Ascaris lumbricoides)?
answer6: Izinsikazi zazizala amaqanda ambalwa, okwaholela ekutheni zingakwazi ukuzala kahle
distractor6a: Abesifazane bakhiqiza amaqanda amaningi njengoba ubuningi banda
distractor6c: Ubukhulu bomzimba wesifazane buphindwe kabili ngokuminyana okwandayo
question7: Ucwaningo lwango-2009 luphethe ngokuthini ngesisindo sabesifazane kanye nokuzala kwabo kuma-Ascaris lumbricoides?
answer7: Isisindo sabesifazane asichazanga ukwehla kokuzala okubonwa ezixukwini eziningi
distractor7a: Izinsikazi ezinkulu zazihlala zikhiqiza amaqanda ambalwa
distractor7b: Izinsikazi ezincane zihlala zikhiqiza amaqanda amaningi
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.12. Ukutheleleka kwamadube yi-Bacillus anthracis kungachazwa kanjani—njengento encike ekuminyaneni noma encike ekuminyaneni elawula ukukhula kwabantu?
answer8: Lesi yisibonelo sesici esixhomeke ekuminyaneni ngoba siba sibi kakhulu njengoba ukuminyana kwabantu kukhuphuka
distractor8a: Lesi yisibonelo sesici esizimele ngobuningi ngoba siba sibi kakhulu njengoba ubuningi babantu bukhula
distractor8b: Lesi yisibonelo sesici esixhomeke ekuminyaneni ngoba siba ngcono njengoba ukuminyana kwabantu kukhuphuka
distractor8c: Lesi yisibonelo sesici esizimele ngobuningi njengoba siba ngcono njengoba ubuningi babantu bukhula

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.4 Ukuguquguquka Nokulawulwa Kwabantu | Ukulawulwa Nokuxhumana Okungaxhomekile Ekuxineni Kwabantu kanye Nezici Ezixhomeke Ekuxineni Kwabantu
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.4 Ukuguquguquka Nokulawulwa Kwabantu | Ukulawulwa Nokuxhumana Okungaxhomekile Ekuxineni Kwabantu kanye Nezici Ezixhomeke Ekuxineni Kwabantu
chapterContent:
Izinto eziningi, ngokuvamile ezingokwenyama noma zamakhemikhali ngokwemvelo (ezingenabungozi), zithonya ukufa kwabantu kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bangakanani, okuhlanganisa isimo sezulu, izinhlekelele zemvelo, kanye nokungcola. Inyamazane ngayinye ingabulawa emlilweni wehlathi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zingaki izinyamazane ezikuleyo ndawo. Amathuba ayo okusinda ayafana kungakhathaliseki ukuthi inani labantu liphezulu noma liphansi. Kunjalo nangesimo sezulu esibandayo sasebusika.

 Ezimweni zangempela, ukulawulwa kwenani labantu kuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu futhi izici ezixhomeke ekubuneni nasekuzimeleni zingasebenzisana. Inani labantu elibunjiwe elincishisiwe ngendlela engaxhomeke ekubuneni yizinto ezithile zemvelo lizokwazi ukululama ngendlela ehlukile kunenani labantu abambalwa. Isibonelo, inani lezinyamazane ezithintekile ebusika obunzima lizolulama ngokushesha uma kunezinyamazane eziningi ezisele ukuze zizale.
question1: Ziyini izinto ezizimele ngobuningi?
answer1: Izici ezithinta ukufa kwabantu kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bangakanani abantu
distractor1a: Izici eziba namandla kuphela ezindaweni ezinabantu abaningi
distractor1b: Izinto ezibangelwa ukusebenzisana phakathi kohlobo oluthile kuphela
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sesici esizimele ngobuningi?
answer2: Umlilo wehlathi
question3: Yiziphi izinhlobo zezinto ezivame ukuzimela ngobuningi?
answer3: Izinto ezingasebenzi njengesimo sezulu, izinhlekelele zemvelo, kanye nokungcola
distractor3a: Izinto eziphilayo ezifana nokudla izilwane kanye nokuncintisana
distractor3c: Ukuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu ohlobo olufanayo kuphela
question4: Kungani inyamazane ingase ife emlilweni wehlathi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi inani labantu lingakanani?
answer4: Ngoba imililo yamahlathi iyizinto ezincike ekuminyaneni kwabantu
distractor4b: Ngoba izilwane ezidla ezinye ziyanda ngesikhathi somlilo
question5: Izinto ezixhomeke ekuxineni kanye nezinto ezixhomeke ekuxineni zixhumana kanjani emvelweni?
answer5: Bangasebenzisana ukuze bathinte usayizi wabantu kanye nokululama kwabo
distractor5c: Uhlobo olulodwa kuphela olungalawula inani labantu ngesikhathi
question6: Ngemva kobusika obunzima, kungani inani lezinyamazane eziminyene lingalulama ngokushesha kunenani elincane?
answer6: Abantu abaningi abasindile basatholakala ukuze bazale
distractor6a: Imiphakathi enabantu abaningi ayithinteki esimweni sezulu esibi
distractor6b: Ubusika obunzima bukhulisa unomphela amandla okuthwala
distractor6c: Imiphakathi embalwa ihlala inamazinga aphezulu okuzalwa
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukulawulwa kwenani labantu emhlabeni wangempela?
answer7: Ukulawulwa kwenani labantu ngokuvamile kuvela ekusebenzisaneni phakathi kwezinto ezixhomeke ekuminyaneni kanye nezinto ezixhomeke ekuminyaneni.
distractor7a: Ukulawulwa kwenani labantu kubangelwa kuphela yizici ezincike ekubuneni kwabantu
distractor7b: Ukulawulwa kwenani labantu kubangelwa kuphela yizici ezizimele ngobuningi
distractor7c: Ukulawulwa kwabantu kuncike kuphela esu lokuzala
question8: Yisiphi isici esingezansi esingase silawule inani labantu kungakhathaliseki ukuthi linabantu abangakanani?
answer8: Isimo sezulu sasebusika esibi

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Population and Community Ecology | 36.4 Ukuguquguquka Nokulawulwa Komphakathi | Kungani I-Woolly Mammoth Yanyamalala?
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Population and Community Ecology | 36.4 Ukuguquguquka Nokulawulwa Komphakathi | Kungani I-Woolly Mammoth Yanyamalala?
chapterContent:
Kulula ukulahleka engxoxweni yama-dinosaur kanye nemibono yokuthi kungani anyamalala eminyakeni eyizigidi ezingama-65 edlule. Ingabe kwakungenxa ye-meteor eyashayisa uMhlaba eduze nogu lwaseMexico yanamuhla, noma kwakungenxa yomjikelezo wesimo sezulu wesikhathi eside ongakaqondwa? Umbono owodwa ongasoze waphakanyiswa ukuthi abantu babenento yokwenza nawo. Izilwane ezincelisayo zaziyizidalwa ezincane, ezingabalulekile ehlathini eminyakeni eyizigidi ezingama-65 edlule, futhi bekungekho bantu ababekhona.

 Nokho, ama-mammoth anoboya aqala ukunyamalala eminyakeni eyi-10,000 edlule, lapho abelana ngoMhlaba nabantu ababengafani ngokomzimba nabantu namuhla (Isithombe 36.13). Ama-mammoth asinda eziqhingini ezikude muva nje ngo-1700 BC. Sazi okuningi ngalezi zilwane ezivela ezidunjini ezitholakale ziqandisiwe eqhweni laseSiberia nakwezinye izindawo zasenyakatho. Ososayensi baye bahlela okungenani amaphesenti angama-50 e-genome yazo futhi bakholelwa ukuthi ama-mammoth aphakathi kwamaphesenti angama-98 nama-99 afana nezindlovu zanamuhla.

 Ngokuvamile kucatshangwa ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kanye nokuzingela abantu kwaholela ekuqothulweni kwazo. Ucwaningo lwango-2008 lulinganisele ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kunciphisa ububanzi bezinyamazane ezinkulu kusukela kumamayela-skwele angu-3,000,000 eminyakeni engu-42,000 eyedlule kuya kumamayela-skwele angu-310,000 eminyakeni engu-6,000 eyedlule.6 Kuphinde kwabhalwa kahle ukuthi abantu babezingela lezi zilwane. Ucwaningo lwango-2012 lubonise ukuthi akukho lutho olulodwa olwalubangela ukuqothulwa kwalezi zidalwa ezinhle kakhulu.7 Ngaphezu kokuzingela kwabantu, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, kanye nokunciphisa indawo yokuhlala, laba ososayensi babonise esinye isici esibalulekile ekuqothulweni kwezinyamazane ezinkulu kwakuwukufuduka kwabantu ngaphesheya kweBering Strait beya eNyakatho Melika ngesikhathi sokugcina seqhwa eminyakeni engu-20,000 eyedlule.

 Ukugcinwa kwezinhlobo ezizinzile kwakuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, futhi kunezici eziningi ezisebenzisanayo ezinquma umphumela. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi abantu nabo bayingxenye yemvelo. Lapho sesifake isandla ekwehleni kwezinhlobo sisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuzingela basendulo kuphela.
question1: Ama-mammoth anoboya aqala nini ukuphela?
answer1: Eminyakeni engaba yi-10,000 edlule
question2: Yibuphi ubufakazi obusize ososayensi bafunda ngezilwane ezincelisayo ezinoboya?
answer2: Izidumbu eziqandisiwe zitholakale eSiberia nakwezinye izindawo ezisenyakatho
distractor2b: Izinsalela ezitholakala emahlathini asezindaweni ezishisayo kuphela
question3: Izilwane ezincelisayo ezinoboya zifana kangakanani ngokwezakhi zofuzo nezindlovu zanamuhla?
answer3: Cishe 98–99% iyafana
question4: Ngokusho kocwaningo, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kube namuphi umphumela omkhulu ezinkomeni ezincelisayo ezinoboya?
answer4: Kwanciphisa kakhulu ubukhulu bendawo yabo yokuhlala
question5: Yimiphi imisebenzi yabantu eyabangela ukwehla kwama-mammoth anoboya?
answer5: Ukuzingela
question6: Ngokusho kocwaningo lwango-2012, yini echaza kangcono ukushabalala kwe-woolly mammoth?
answer6: Izici eziningi ezisebenzisanayo, okuhlanganisa ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, ukuzingela abantu, kanye nokufuduka kwabantu
question7: Kungani ukuqothulwa kwe-woolly mammoth kubhekwa njengesenzakalo esiyinkimbinkimbi?
answer7: Ngoba izici eziningana zemvelo kanye nezihlobene nabantu ziye zasebenzisana ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor7b: Ngoba isenzakalo esisodwa kuphela esibi kakhulu esibangele ukuqothulwa
distractor7c: Ngoba izindlovukazi zanyamalala ngokuzumayo ngaphandle kokushintsha kwemvelo
question8: Chaza izici okungenzeka ukuthi zinegalelo ekuqothulweni kwe-woolly mammoth, futhi zabangela ukuba kwenzeke isikhathi eside.
answer8: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuthinte ikhono le-woolly mammoth lokuthola indawo yokuhlala eyanele nokudla, futhi abantu baba negalelo ekunciphiseni inani labo ngokuzingela.
distractor8a: Ukugawulwa kwamahlathi kwathinta ikhono le-woolly mammoth lokuthola indawo yokuhlala eyanele nokudla, futhi abantu baba negalelo ekunciphiseni inani lazo ngokuzizingela.
distractor8b: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuthinte ikhono le-woolly mammoth lokuthola ukudla okwanele yize yayinendawo yokuhlala eningi, futhi abantu baba negalelo ekunciphiseni inani lezilwane ngokuzizingela.
distractor8c: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kwathinta ikhono le-woolly mammoth lokuthola indawo yokuhlala eyanele nokudla, futhi isifo esiwumshayabhuqe sathinta uMhlaba ngaleso sikhathi okwabangela ukuqothulwa kwawo.
