chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.4 Ukuguquguquka Nokulawulwa Kwabantu | Umlando Wempilo Yezinhlobo Ezikhethiwe Ku-K Nezikhethiwe Ku-R | Imibono Yakuqala Ngomlando Wempilo: Izinhlobo Ezikhethiwe Ku-K Nezikhethiwe Ku-R
chapterContent:
Nakuba amasu okuzala edlala indima ebalulekile emlandweni wokuphila, awabheki izici ezibalulekile njengezinsizakusebenza ezilinganiselwe kanye nokuncintisana. Ukulawulwa kokukhula kwenani labantu ngalezi zici kungasetshenziswa ukwethula umqondo wakudala ku-biology yabantu, lowo wezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-K uma kuqhathaniswa nezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-r.

 Imibono Yokuqala Ngomlando Wokuphila: Izinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-K kanye nezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-r
 Engxenyeni yesibili yekhulu lama-20, umqondo wezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-K kanye nezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-r wawusetshenziswa kabanzi futhi ngempumelelo ukutadisha izinhlobo. Lo mqondo awuhlobene nje kuphela namasu okuzala, kodwa futhi nendawo yokuhlala kanye nokuziphatha kohlobo, ikakhulukazi endleleni oluthola ngayo izinsizakusebenza nokunakekela amaphuphu alo. Kuhlanganisa nobude bokuphila kanye nezici zokusinda. Kulolu hlaziyo, izazi zezinto eziphilayo zabantu zihlanganise izinhlobo ngezinhlobo ngezigaba ezimbili ezinkulu—ezikhethiwe ze-K kanye nezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-r—yize empeleni ziyizinhlangothi ezimbili ze-continuum.

 Izinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-K ziyizinhlobo ezikhethwe yizindawo ezizinzile nezibikezelayo. Izinhlobo zezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-K zivame ukuba khona eduze nomthamo wazo wokuthwala (yingakho igama elithi K-selected) lapho ukuncintisana okuqondile kuphezulu khona. Lezi zinhlobo zinezingane ezimbalwa, ezinkulu, isikhathi eside sokukhulelwa, futhi zivame ukunikeza izingane zazo ukunakekelwa kwesikhathi eside (Ithebula B45_04_01). Nakuba zinkulu ngobukhulu lapho zizalwa, inzalo isuke ingasenamandla futhi ingakavuthwa ekuzalweni. Ngesikhathi zifika ebudaleni, kumele zithuthukise amakhono okuncintisana ngezinsiza zemvelo. Ezitshalweni, ososayensi bacabanga ngokunakekelwa kwabazali kabanzi: ukuthi izithelo zithatha isikhathi esingakanani ukukhula noma ukuthi zihlala isikhathi esingakanani esitshalweni yizona zinto ezinquma isikhathi somcimbi olandelayo wokuzala. Izibonelo zezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-K yizilwane ezincane (kufaka phakathi abantu), izindlovu, nezitshalo ezifana nezihlahla ze-oki (Isithombe 36.14a).

 Izihlahla ze-oki zikhula kancane kakhulu futhi zithatha, ngokwesilinganiso, iminyaka engama-20 ukukhiqiza imbewu yazo yokuqala, eyaziwa ngokuthi ama-acorn. Ama-acorn afinyelela ku-50,000 angakhiqizwa umuthi ngamunye, kodwa izinga lokuhluma liphansi njengoba amaningi alawa abola noma edliwa yizilwane ezifana nama-squirrel. Kweminye iminyaka, ama-oki angakhiqiza inani elikhulu kakhulu lama-acorn, futhi le minyaka ingaba semjikelezweni weminyaka emibili noma emithathu kuye ngohlobo lwe-oki (ukukhetha okungu-r).

 Njengoba izihlahla ze-oki zikhula zibe zinkulu futhi iminyaka eminingi ngaphambi kokuba ziqale ukukhiqiza ama-acorn, zinikela ngephesenti elikhulu lesabelomali sazo samandla ekukhuleni nasekunakekelweni. Ukuphakama nobukhulu bomuthi kuvumela ukuthi ulawule ezinye izitshalo emncintiswaneni wokukhanya kwelanga, umthombo wamandla oyinhloko we-oki. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma uzala kabusha, i-oki ikhiqiza imbewu enkulu, ecebile ngamandla esebenzisa amandla ayo agciniwe ukuze ikhule ngokushesha (ukukhetha okungu-K).

 Ngokuphambene nalokho, izinhlobo ezikhethiwe ngo-r zinenani elikhulu lezingane ezincane (yingakho zibizwa ngokuthi i-r (bheka ithebula Izici zezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ngo-K kanye nezikhethiwe ngo-r ngezansi). Leli cebo livame ukusetshenziswa ezindaweni ezingalindelekile noma ezishintshayo. Izilwane ezikhethiwe ngo-r azinikezi ukunakekelwa kwabazali kwesikhathi eside futhi inzalo ivuthiwe futhi iyazakha lapho izalwa. Izibonelo zezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ngo-r yizilwane ezingenamgogodla zasolwandle, njenge-jellyfish, kanye nezitshalo, njenge-dandelion (Isithombe 36.14b). Ama-dandelion anembewu encane ehlakazeke emoyeni amabanga amade. Imbewu eminingi ikhiqizwa ngesikhathi esisodwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani ezinye zazo zifinyelela endaweni enomoya omuhle. Imbewu efika ezindaweni ezingafaneleki ayinawo amathuba okusinda njengoba imbewu yayo inokuqukethwe kwamandla aphansi. Qaphela ukuthi ukusinda akuyona ngempela umsebenzi wamandla agcinwe embewini ngokwayo.

question1: Uhlobo luni lwendawo oluvame ukuhlotshaniswa nezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-K?
answer1: Izindawo ezizinzile nezibikezelekayo
question2: Kungani izinhlobo ezikhethiwe nge-K zibizwa ngokuthi zikhethiwe nge-K?
answer2: Imiphakathi yazo ivame ukuba khona eduze komthamo wokuthwala (K) wendawo ezungezile
distractor2c: Zitholakala kuphela ezindaweni zokuhlala ezinezinhlobonhlobo eziningi zezinto eziphilayo
question3: Yisiphi isici esivamile sezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-K?
answer3: Bambalwa, abantwana abakhulu abanakekelwa kakhulu ngabazali
distractor3a: Inzalo encane eningi engenakunakekelwa ngabazali abaningi
distractor3b: Ukuvuthwa kwasekuqaleni kanye nokuphila isikhathi esifushane
question4: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo eziyizibonelo zezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-K?
answer4: Abantu, izindlovu, nezihlahla ze-oki
question5: Kungani imithi ye-oki ichitha amandla ayo amaningi ekukhuleni ngaphambi kokuzala?
answer5: Ukukhulisa izitshalo ezinkulu kuthuthukisa ukuncintisana kwelanga ngaphambi kokukhiqiza ama-acorn acebile ngamandla
distractor5a: Izihlahla ze-oki azikwazi ukuzala kuze kube yilapho sezineminyaka engaphezu kweyikhulu ubudala
distractor5b: Izihlahla ze-oki zithembele ngokuphelele emoyeni ukuze zithuthele impova
distractor5c: Izihlahla ze-oki zikhiqiza isivuno esisodwa kuphela sama-acorn ngesikhathi sokuphila kwazo
question6: Yisiphi isici esijwayelekile sezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ngo-r?
answer6: Izingane eziningi ezincane ezinenakekelo elincane noma ezingenalo nhlobo unakekelo lwabazali
distractor6a: Inzalo encane enkulu enakekelwa abazali isikhathi eside
distractor6b: Ukuvuthwa sekwephuzile kanye nokuphila isikhathi eside
distractor6c: Izinga lokuzala eliphansi kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali okuphezulu kumntwana ngamunye
question7: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo eziyizibonelo zezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ngo-r?
answer7: I-Jellyfish kanye nama-dandelion
question8: Kungani ama-dandelion ekhiqiza imbewu eminingi encane, ehlakazekile ngomoya?
answer8: Ukukhiqiza imbewu eningi kwandisa amathuba okuthi eminye izofinyelela ezindaweni ezifanele zokukhula
distractor8a: Imbewu ngayinye iqukethe amandla amakhulu okusinda isikhathi eside
distractor8b: Imbewu ithola ukunakekelwa kwabazali ngemva kokuhlakazeka
distractor8c: Imbewu ihlala imila noma kuphi lapho ifika khona
question9: Yiziphi izici ezimbili ezifanelana kahle nezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ngo-K kanye nezikhethiwe ngo-r?
answer9: Izinhlobo ezikhethiwe ngo-K zivuthwa sekwephuzile futhi zinakekelwa kakhulu ngabazali, kanti izinhlobo ezikhethiwe ngo-r zivuthwa kusenesikhathi futhi ziveza inzalo eningi ngaphandle kokunakekelwa ngabazali.
distractor9a: Izinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-K zivuthwa kusenesikhathi futhi zikhiqize inzalo eningi, kanti izinhlobo ezikhethiwe ze-r zivuthwa sekwephuzile zinenzalo encane.
distractor9b: Zombili izinhlobo ezikhethiwe nge-K kanye nezikhethiwe nge-r zivuthwa sekwephuzile futhi zinikeza ukunakekelwa okubanzi kwabazali
distractor9c: Zombili izinhlobo ze-K-selected kanye ne-r-selected zikhiqiza inzalo encane enkulu

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.4 Ukuguquguquka Nokulawulwa Kwabantu | Imibono Yanamuhla Yomlando Wokuphila
chapterContent: Ithiyori yokukhetha u-r no-K, yize yamukelwe amashumi eminyaka futhi yasetshenziswa ocwaningweni olukhulu oluqavile, manje isiphinde yacatshangelwa kabusha, futhi izazi eziningi zezinto eziphilayo zabantu ziyishiyile noma ziyishintshile. Eminyakeni edlule, izifundo eziningana zazama ukuqinisekisa le thiyori, kodwa le mizamo iye yehluleka kakhulu. Izinhlobo eziningi zatholakala ezingalandelanga izibikezelo zethiyori. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le thiyori ayizange ilalele ukufa kwabantu ngokweminyaka ethile okuyinto ososayensi abaziyo manje ukuthi ibaluleke kakhulu. Kuye kwathuthukiswa amamodeli amasha asekelwe kubantu ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo komlando wokuphila ahlanganisa imiqondo eminingi yemvelo efakwe kuthiyori yokukhetha u-r no-K kanye nesakhiwo sobudala babantu kanye nezici zokufa.
question1: Kungani inkolelo-mbono yendabuko yokukhetha u-r kanye no-K iye yacatshangelwa kabusha yizazi eziningi zezinto eziphilayo zabantu?
answer1: Ngoba izifundo eziningi zehlulekile ukuqinisekisa ngokugcwele izibikezelo zayo futhi izinhlobo eziningi azizange zifane nomodeli
distractor1a: Ngoba zonke izinhlobo zitholakale zikhethwe ngo-K
distractor1c: Ngoba inkolelo-mbono ichaze ngokunembile zonke izinhlobo
question2: Izazi eziningi zebhayoloji yabantu banamuhla zibheka kanjani inkolelo-mbono yokukhetha u-r no-K?
answer2: Ishintshiwe noma ilahliwe ukuze kusetshenziswe amamodeli aphelele kakhulu
distractor2a: Yiyona kuphela incazelo eyamukelekayo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo komlando wokuphila
distractor2b: Ithathe indawo yazo zonke izinhlobo zabantu
question3: Yini eyayiwumkhawulo omkhulu wenkolelo-mbono yokuqala yokukhetha u-r kanye no-K?
answer3: Akuzange kubhekwe ukufa okuhlobene nobudala
question4: Yini etholwe yizifundo eziningi lapho zizama ukuqinisekisa ithiyori yokukhetha i-r- kanye ne-K?
answer4: Izinhlobo eziningi azilandelanga amaphethini abikezelwe yizinkolelo-mbono
distractor4a: Zonke izinhlobo zifanelana kahle nesigaba esikhethiwe se-r noma esikhethiwe se-K
distractor4c: Izinto eziphilayo zasolwandle kuphela ezazihambisana nombono
question5: Yini ehlanganisa amamodeli omlando wokuphila wanamuhla, inkolelo-mbono yokuqala yokukhetha u-r kanye no-K engayinaki kakhulu?
answer5: Isakhiwo seminyaka yabantu kanye namaphethini okufa
question6: Iyini isisekelo semibono eminingi yesimanje yokuziphendukela kwemvelo komlando wokuphila?
answer6: Amamodeli ezibalo zabantu afaka imiqondo yemvelo, isakhiwo sobudala, kanye nezici zokufa
question7: Kungani amaphethini okufa ngokweminyaka ebalulekile ku-biology yabantu banamuhla?
answer7: Zisiza ukuchaza ukuguquguquka kwenani labantu kanye nokuguquka komlando wokuphila ngokunembe kakhudlwana
distractor7b: Zinquma umthamo wokuthwala wazo zonke izimiso zemvelo

chapterContent:
Izindlela ezisetshenziswa ukubheka ukuguquguquka kwenani lezilwane zingasetshenziswa futhi ukubheka inani labantu. Njengezilwane, abantu bathintwa yizici ze-abiotic kanye ne-biotic. Ngokungafani nezilwane, abantu banekhono lokulawula izici ezithinta ukukhula kwenani labantu babo. Ngenxa yalokho, izici ezengeziwe ziyasetshenziswa lapho kufundwa ukuguquguquka kwenani labantu. Lapho kufundwa izilinganiso zokukhula kwenani labantu, imibuzo yokuziphatha nayo ingavela.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 4 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 4
Izinhlelo zebhayoloji ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo kunezici eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zebhayoloji kuholela ezicini eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo yazo kuholela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
4.1 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuthethelela ukukhethwa kohlobo lwedatha edingekayo ukuphendula imibuzo yesayensi mayelana nokusebenzisana kwabantu emiphakathini.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.11 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuthethelela ukukhethwa kohlobo lwedatha edingekayo ukuphendula imibuzo yesayensi mayelana nokusebenzisana kwabantu emiphakathini.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo yazo kuholela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
2.2 Umfundi angasebenzisa izindlela zezibalo emananini achaza izenzakalo zemvelo.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.12 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izindlela zezibalo emananini achaza imiphakathi eyakhiwe yizinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisana ngezindlela eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo yazo kuholela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo kanye nezibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi kanye namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.13 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela imiphumela yoshintsho kubantu bomphakathi emphakathini.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo yazo kuholela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo nezibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.16 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela imiphumela yokushintsha kwezinto noma ukutholakala kwamandla emiphakathini.

 Imibono yokuguquguquka kwenani lezilwane ingasetshenziswa ekukhuleni kwenani labantu. Abantu abahlukile ekhonweni labo lokushintsha indawo yabo. Isibonelo, amadamu e-beaver ashintsha indawo yomfudlana lapho akhiwe khona. Nokho, abantu banekhono lokushintsha indawo yabo ukuze bandise amandla ayo okuthwala ngezinye izikhathi okulimaza ezinye izinhlobo (isb., ngokukhetha okwenziwe kwezitshalo ezinesivuno esikhulu). Inani labantu bomhlaba likhula ngokushesha, kangangokuthi abanye bakhathazeka ngekhono lendawo yomhlaba lokusekela leli nani, njengoba ukukhula kwesikhathi eside okubonakalayo kuthwala izingozi ezingaba khona zendlala, izifo, nokufa okukhulu.

 Nakuba abantu bekhulise amandla okuthwala indawo yabo, ubuchwepheshe obusetshenziswe ukufeza lolu shintsho bubangele izinguquko ezingakaze zibonwe emvelweni yoMhlaba, bushintsha izindawo zemvelo kwaze kwaba yilapho ezinye zingase zibe sengozini yokuwa. Ukuncipha kongqimba lwe-ozone, ukuguguleka ngenxa yemvula ye-asidi, kanye nomonakalo ovela ekushintsheni kwesimo sezulu somhlaba wonke kubangelwa imisebenzi yabantu. Umphumela wokugcina walezi zinguquko kumandla ethu okuthwala awaziwa. Njengoba abanye besho, kungenzeka ukuthi imiphumela emibi yokwandisa amandla okuthwala izodlula emihle—amandla okuthwala omhlaba kubantu angase anciphe ngempela.

 Inani labantu emhlabeni njengamanje libhekene nokukhula okukhulu yize ukuzala kwabantu kungaphansi kakhulu kwamandla abo e-biotic (Isithombe 36.15). Ukuze kufinyelelwe amandla abo e-biotic, bonke abesifazane kuzodingeka bakhulelwe njalo ezinyangeni eziyisishiyagalolunye noma ngaphezulu phakathi neminyaka yabo yokuzala. Futhi, izinsiza kuzodingeka zibe ngendlela yokuthi indawo izosekela ukukhula okunjalo. Azikho kulezi zimo ezimbili ezikhona. Naphezu kwalokhu, inani labantu lisakhula kakhulu.

 Umphumela wokukhula kwenani labantu ngokuqhubekayo ukuthi isikhathi esithathayo ukwengeza inani elithile labantu eMhlabeni siya siba sifushane. Isibalo 36.16 sibonisa ukuthi kwakudingeka iminyaka eyi-123 ukwengeza abantu abayizigidi eziyi-1 ngo-1930, kodwa kwathatha iminyaka engama-24 kuphela ukwengeza abantu abayizigidi eziyi-2 phakathi kuka-1975 no-1999. Njengoba sekuxoxiwe kakade, ngesinye isikhathi kubonakala sengathi ikhono lethu lokukhulisa umthamo wethu wokuthwala unomphela ezweni elinqunyiwe aliqinisekile. Ngaphandle kwentuthuko entsha yezobuchwepheshe, izinga lokukhula kwabantu libikezelwe ukuthi lizoncipha emashumini eminyaka ezayo. Kodwa-ke, inani labantu lizoqhubeka landa futhi usongo lokugcwala kwabantu luyaqhubeka.
question1: Imibono yokuguquguquka kwenani lezilwane ingasetshenziswa kanjani kubantu?
answer1: Amamodeli afanayo emvelo angasetshenziswa ukutadisha ukukhula kwabantu kanye nokulawulwa kwabo
distractor1a: Imiphakathi yabantu ayinakufundwa kusetshenziswa izimiso zemvelo
distractor1c: Imiphakathi yabantu ilandela imithetho yezinto eziphilayo ehluke ngokuphelele
question2: Yini eyenza abantu bahluke kwezinye izilwane eziningi ngokwezinga labantu?
answer2: Abantu bangashintsha ngamabomu indawo yabo ukuze bandise umthamo wokuthwala
distractor2a: Abantu abathinteki yizinto ezingaphili kanye nezingaphili
question3: Ukwandisa amandla okuthwala abantu kungabathinta kanjani kabi ezinye izinhlobo?
answer3: Imisebenzi yabantu ingashintsha imvelo futhi inciphise indawo yokuhlala etholakalayo kwezinye izinto eziphilayo
distractor3c: Kukhulisa unomphela izinsiza zazo zonke izinto eziphilayo
question4: Iyiphi inkinga yemvelo okukhulunywe ngayo embhalweni ebangelwa imisebenzi yabantu?
answer4: Ukuncipha kongqimba lwe-ozone
question5: Kungani amandla okuthwala ikusasa loMhlaba kubantu engaqinisekile?
answer5: Umonakalo wemvelo obangelwa imisebenzi yabantu ungase udlule izinzuzo zentuthuko yezobuchwepheshe ekugcineni
distractor5c: Ubuchwepheshe buqinisekisa ukukhula okungenamkhawulo kwenani labantu
question6: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.15. Kungani inani labantu lisakhula kakhulu naphezu kokuzala ngaphansi kwamandla alo e-biotic?
answer6: Amanani okuzalwa ayaqhubeka edlula amazinga okufa yize amandla okuzala aphezulu engafinyelelwanga
distractor6a: Wonke owesifazane uzala ngesilinganiso sakhe esiphezulu sebhayoloji
distractor6c: Amanani okufa ahlala edlula amazinga okuzalwa
question7: Ngokusho kombhalo, yini edingekayo ukuze abantu bafinyelele amandla abo e-biotic?
answer7: Ukukhiqizwa kabusha okucishe kuqhubeke kanye nezinsiza ezanele zokusekela ukukhula okuphezulu kwenani labantu
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.16. Yimuphi umkhuba obonwayo esikhathini esidingekayo sokwengeza abanye abantu abayizigidigidi kubantu boMhlaba?
answer8: Isikhathi esidingekayo sesifushane kakhulu njengoba inani labantu likhula
distractor8b: Isikhathi esidingekayo siye sanda kancane kancane
question9: Kungani ukwanda kwabantu abaningi kusabhekwa njengento ekhathazayo ngisho noma ukukhula kwabantu kwehla esikhathini esizayo?
answer9: Ngoba inani labantu lilonke kulindeleke ukuthi lande
distractor9a: Ngoba inani labantu kulindeleke ukuthi lehle ngokushesha
distractor9b: Ngoba amazinga okuzalwa abikezelwa ukuthi azoba zero
distractor9c: Ngoba umthamo wokuthwala kulindeleke ukuthi ungabi namkhawulo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.5 Ukukhula Kwabantu | Ukunqoba Ukulawulwa Okuxhomeke Kubuningi
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.5 Ukukhula Kwabantu | Ukunqoba Ukulawulwa Okuxhomeke Kubuningi
chapterContent:
Abantu bahlukile ekhonweni labo lokushintsha indawo abakuyo ngenhloso yokwandisa amandla okuthwala. Leli khono liyisici esiyinhloko esibangela ukukhula kwabantu kanye nendlela yokunqoba ukulawulwa kokukhula okuncike ekubuneni kwabantu. Ingxenye enkulu yaleli khono ihlobene nokuhlakanipha kwabantu, umphakathi, kanye nokuxhumana. Abantu bangakha indawo yokukhosela ukuze babavikele ezimweni zezulu futhi bathuthukise ezolimo nezilwane ezifuywayo ukuze bandise ukudla kwabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu basebenzisa ulimi ukuxhumana nalobu buchwepheshe nezizukulwane ezintsha, okubavumela ukuthi bathuthuke kulokho okufezwe ngaphambilini.

 Ezinye izici ekukhuleni kwabantu ukufuduka kanye nempilo yomphakathi. Abantu bavela e-Afrika, kodwa kusukela lapho bathuthela cishe kuyo yonke indawo ehlalwa abantu eMhlabeni. Impilo yomphakathi, ukuhlanzeka, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwama-antibiotic kanye nemijovo kuye kwehlisa ikhono lezifo ezithelelanayo lokunciphisa ukukhula kwabantu. Esikhathini esidlule, izifo ezifana ne-bubonic plaque yekhulu leshumi nane zabulala phakathi kwamaphesenti angama-30 nama-60 abantu baseYurophu futhi zanciphisa inani labantu emhlabeni wonke ngabantu abayizigidi eziyi-100. Namuhla, usongo lwezifo ezithelelanayo, nakuba lungakapheli, ngokuqinisekile alubi kakhulu. Ngokusho kwe-World Health Organization, ukufa emhlabeni wonke ngenxa yezifo ezithathelwanayo kwehle kusuka ku-16.4 million ngo-1993 kuya ku-14.7 million ngo-2002. Uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye zezifo eziwumshayabhuqe zesikhathi esidlule, iphesenti labantu ababulawa emhlabeni wonke phakathi kuka-1993 no-2002 lehle kusuka ku-0.30% wabantu emhlabeni wonke laya ku-0.24%. Ngakho-ke, kubonakala sengathi ithonya lezifo ezithathelwanayo ekukhuleni kwabantu liya ngokuya lincipha.
question1: Kungani abantu behlukile ngokwezinga labantu abakhula ngalo?
answer1: Abantu bangashintsha ngamabomu indawo yabo ukuze bandise amandla ayo okuthwala
question2: Abantu bawandise kanjani amandla okuthwala uMhlaba?
answer2: Ngokuthuthukisa ezolimo, ukufuya izilwane, nokwakha indawo yokuhlala
question3: Kungani ulimi lubalulekile ekunqobeni ukulawulwa okuncike ekuxineni kwabantu?
answer3: Ivumela ubuchwepheshe nolwazi ukuthi ludluliselwe ezizukulwaneni ezizayo
distractor3c: Kuvimbela ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ukuthi kungenzeki
question4: Abantu bavelaphi ngaphambi kokuba basakazeke emhlabeni wonke?
answer4: I-Afrika
question5: Yiziphi intuthuko ezinciphise umthelela wezifo ezithelelanayo ekwandeni kwabantu?
answer5: Izinyathelo zempilo yomphakathi, ukuhlanzeka, ama-antibiotic, kanye nemigomo
question6: Yayiyini imiphumela emikhulu yesifo se-bubonic phakathi nekhulu le-14?
answer6: Kwabulala abantu abaphakathi kuka-30 no-60% baseYurophu
question7: Ngokusho kwedatha ye-World Health Organisation ekhonjiwe, yimuphi umkhuba owenzekile phakathi kuka-1993 no-2002?
answer7: Ukufa emhlabeni wonke ngenxa yezifo ezithelelanayo kwehlile
distractor7a: Ukufa emhlabeni wonke ngenxa yezifo ezithelelanayo kuphindwe kabili
distractor7b: Akukho ushintsho oluye lwaba khona ekufeni kwezifo ezithelelanayo
question8: Kungani izifo ezithelelanayo zibhekwa njengomkhawulo ongebalulekile ekukhuleni kwabantu namuhla kunangaphambili?
answer8: Intuthuko yezokwelapha kanye nezempilo yomphakathi inciphise ukufa okubangelwa yizifo ezithathelwanayo
distractor8a: Abantu sebengavikelekile ngokuphelele kuzo zonke izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane
distractor8c: Ubuningi babantu abusayithinti indlela yokudluliswa kwezifo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.5 Ukukhula Kwabantu | Isakhiwo Seminyaka, Ukukhula Kwabantu, kanye Nentuthuko Yomnotho
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.5 Ukukhula Kwabantu | Isakhiwo Seminyaka, Ukukhula Kwabantu, kanye Nentuthuko Yomnotho
chapterContent: Isakhiwo sobudala sabantu siyisici esibalulekile ekushintsheni kwenani labantu. Isakhiwo sobudala siyisilinganiso sabantu abaneminyaka ehlukene. Isakhiwo sobudala sivumela ukubikezela okungcono kokukhula kwabantu, kanye nekhono lokuhlobanisa lokhu kukhula nezinga lentuthuko yezomnotho esifundeni. Amazwe anokukhula okusheshayo anesimo se-pyramidal esakhiweni sawo sobudala dia amagremu, okubonisa ukwanda kwabantu abasebasha, abaningi babo abaneminyaka yokuzala noma abazozala maduze (Isithombe 36.17). Leli phethini livame ukubonwa emazweni angakathuthuki lapho abantu bengaphili kuze kube yilapho sebegugile ngenxa yezimo zokuphila ezingezinhle kakhulu. Izakhiwo zobudala zezindawo ezinokukhula okuhamba kancane, okuhlanganisa namazwe athuthukile njenge-United States, zisenesakhiwo se-pyramidal, kodwa zinabantu abaningi abasebasha nabadala abancane kanye nengxenye enkulu yabantu abadala. Amanye amazwe athuthukile, njenge-Italy, awakhuli nhlobo inani labantu. Isakhiwo sobudala salaba bantu sinobungqingili, sinephesenti elikhulu kakhulu labantu abaneminyaka ephakathi nabadala. Amanani okukhula kwangempela emazweni ahlukene aboniswe kuMfanekiso 36.18, kanti amanani aphezulu kakhulu avame ukuba semazweni angathuthuki kangako kwezomnotho ase-Afrika nase-Asia.
question1: Iyini iminyaka yesakhiwo sabantu?
answer1: Inani labantu abaneminyaka ehlukene liphakathi kwabantu
question2: Kungani isakhiwo sobudala sibalulekile kososayensi bezinto eziphilayo?
answer2: Kuyasiza ukubikezela ukukhula kwenani labantu esikhathini esizayo futhi kukuhlobanise nentuthuko yezomnotho
distractor2c: Ikhomba izinguquko zofuzo ngaphakathi kwesibalo sabantu
question3: Yiluphi uhlobo lomdwebo wesakhiwo sobudala olujwayelekile kubantu abakhula ngokushesha?
answer3: Isimo se-pyramidal esinabantu abaningi abasha
distractor3b: Isimo esingunxande esinezinombolo ezilinganayo kuyo yonke iminyaka
question4: Kungani amazwe angakathuthuki evame ukuba nezakhiwo zeminyaka ezi-pyramidal?
answer4: Banabantu abaningi abasebasha kanye nabantu abambalwa abaphila baze baguge
distractor4a: Banamazinga aphansi okuzalwa kanye nobude besikhathi sokuphila
question5: Izakhiwo zobudala zamazwe athuthukile njenge-United States zivame ukuhluka kanjani kwezamazwe akhula ngokushesha?
answer5: Ziqukethe abantu abasha abambalwa kanye nengxenye enkulu yabantu abadala
question6: Yiliphi izwe elinikezwe njengesibonelo sokungakhuli kwenani labantu?
answer6: I-Italy
question7: Zitholakalaphi izinga eliphezulu kakhulu lokukhula kwabantu ngokuvamile?
answer7: Emazweni angathuthuki kangako kwezomnotho ase-Afrika nase-Asia
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.17. Qhathanisa isakhiwo sobudala seSigaba sesi-4 neseSigaba sesi-3. Yiziphi izinguquko ekukhuleni kwabantu okuzodingeka zenzeke ukuze kushintshelwe esiGabeni sesi-3 kuya esiGabeni sesi-4?
answer8: Amanani okuzalwa kanye namanani okufa ehla eSigabeni sesi-4 uma kuqhathaniswa neSigaba sesi-3
distractor8a: Amazinga okuzalwa kanye namazinga okufa ahlala efana kokubili eSigabeni sesi-3 kanye neSigaba sesi-4
distractor8b: Amanani okufa ayancipha eSigabeni sesi-4 uma kuqhathaniswa neSigaba sesi-3, kodwa amazinga okuzalwa ahlala efana
distractor8c: Amanani okuzalwa ehla eSigabeni sesi-4 uma kuqhathaniswa neSigaba sesi-3, kodwa amazinga okufa ahlala efana

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Population and Community Ecology | 36.5 Ukukhula Kwabantu | Imiphumela Yesikhathi Eside Yokukhula Kwabantu Okubonakalayo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Population and Community Ecology | 36.5 Ukukhula Kwabantu | Imiphumela Yesikhathi Eside Yokukhula Kwabantu Okubonakalayo
chapterContent:
Kuye kwenziwa izibikezelo eziningi ezimbi mayelana nenani labantu emhlabeni eziholele enkingeni enkulu ebizwa ngokuthi ukuqhuma kwabantu.” Encwadini ka-1968 ethi The Population Bomb, isazi sezinto eziphilayo uDkt. Paul R. Ehrlich wabhala, “Impi yokondla sonke isintu isiphelile. Ngawo-1970 amakhulu ezigidi zabantu azobulawa yindlala naphezu kwanoma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-crash pro grams oluqalwe manje. Kulolu suku lokugcina akukho okungavimbela ukwanda okukhulu kwesilinganiso sokufa emhlabeni.”8 Ngenkathi abagxeki abaningi bebheka lesi sitatimende njengokweqisa, imithetho yokukhula kwabantu okubonakalayo isasebenza, futhi ukukhula kwabantu okungalawulwa akukwazi ukuqhubeka unomphela.

 Imizamo yokulawula ukukhula kwabantu yaholela enqubweni yomntwana oyedwa eShayina, eyayivame ukufaka imiphumela emibi kakhulu, kodwa manje ibeka izinhlawulo emibhangqwaneni yasemadolobheni enezingane ezingaphezu kweyodwa. Ngenxa yokuthi eminye imibhangqwana ifisa ukuba nendlalifa yesilisa, imibhangqwana eminingi yaseShayina iyaqhubeka nokuba nezingane ezingaphezu kweyodwa. Le nqubomgomo ngokwayo, imiphumela yayo emphakathini, kanye nokusebenza kahle kokunciphisa ukukhula kwabantu jikelele kuyaphikiswana. Inqubomgomo yengane eyodwa yashintshwa yaba yinqubomgomo yezingane ezimbili nezintathu ngo-2016 nango-2021, ngokulandelana. Ushintsho lwenqubomgomo lwaluwumphumela wokwanda kweminyaka yabasebenzi kanye nokungalingani ngokobulili. Naphezu kwezinqubomgomo zokulawula inani labantu, inani labantu liyaqhubeka nokukhula. Ngesinye isikhathi ukutholakala kokudla kungase kuphele ngenxa yesidingo esilandelayo sokukhiqiza ukudla okwengeziwe ukuze kondliwe inani labantu bethu. I-United Nations ilinganisela ukuthi ukukhula kwenani labantu emhlabeni esikhathini esizayo kungase kuhluke kusuka ezigidini eziyi-6 (ukwehla) kuya kubantu abayizigidi eziyi-16 ngonyaka ka-2100. Ayikho indlela yokwazi ukuthi ukukhula kwenani labantu kuzoncipha kuze kufike lapho inkinga echazwe nguDkt. Ehrlich izogwenywa khona.

 Omunye umphumela wokukhula kwenani labantu ubungozi bemvelo. Amazwe amaningi azame ukunciphisa umthelela wabantu ekushintsheni kwesimo sezulu ngokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwawo kwegesi ebamba ukushisa i-carbon dioxide. Kodwa-ke, lezi zivumelwano azikavunyelwa yiwo wonke amazwe, futhi amazwe amaningi angakathuthuki azama ukuthuthukisa isimo sawo sezomnotho angase angabi namathuba amaningi okuvumelana nezinhlinzeko ezinjalo uma kusho intuthuko yezomnotho ehamba kancane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, indima yomsebenzi womuntu ekubangeleni ushintsho lwesimo sezulu isibe yindaba ephikiswana kakhulu kwezenhlalo nezepolitiki kwamanye amazwe athuthukile, okuhlanganisa ne-United States. Ngakho-ke, singena esikhathini esizayo sinokungabaza okukhulu mayelana nekhono lethu lokunciphisa ukukhula kwabantu nokuvikela imvelo yethu.
question1: Yikuphi ukukhathazeka uDkt. Paul R. Ehrlich akuphakamise encwadini yakhe yango-1968 ethi The Population Bomb?
answer1: Ukwanda kwabantu okungalawulwa kungagcina kuholele endlaleni ebanzi kanye nokwanda kwamazinga okufa
distractor1b: Intuthuko yezobuchwepheshe izoqeda konke ukushoda kokudla
distractor1c: Ukukhula kwenani labantu kuzoba kubi ngokushesha emhlabeni jikelele
question2: Kungani izibikezelo eziku-The Population Bomb zisabhekwa njengezibalulekile?
answer2: Ngoba ukukhula kwenani labantu okubonakalayo akukwazi ukuqhubeka unomphela emhlabeni onqunyelwe
distractor2b: Ngoba ukukhula kwenani labantu kume ngokuphelele
distractor2c: Ngoba ukukhiqizwa kokudla kuhlale kukhuphuka ngokushesha kunenani labantu
question3: Yayiyini inhloso eyinhloko yenqubomgomo yengane eyodwa yaseShayina?
answer3: Ukunciphisa ukukhula kwabantu
question4: Kungani inqubomgomo yaseShayina yomntwana oyedwa yashintshwa kamuva ukuze ivumele izingane ezimbili bese kuba ezintathu?
answer4: Ngenxa yokuguga kwabasebenzi kanye nokungalingani ngokobulili
distractor4c: Ngoba amandla okuthwala amazwe aphindwe kabili
question5: Ngokusho kwezilinganiso zeZizwe Ezihlangene okukhulunywe ngazo embhalweni, inani labantu emhlabeni wonke ngo-2100 lingahluka phakathi kwaziphi izindinganiso?
answer5: Cishe abantu abayizigidigidi eziyi-6 kanye nezigidigidi eziyi-16
distractor5a: Cishe abantu abayizigidigidi ezimbili kanye nezigidigidi eziyisishiyagalombili
distractor5b: Cishe abantu abayizigidigidi eziyi-10 kanye nezigidigidi eziyi-12
distractor5c: Cishe abantu abayizigidigidi eziyi-16 kanye nezigidigidi ezingama-30
question6: Yimuphi umphumela owodwa ongaba khona wesikhathi eside wokukhula okuqhubekayo kwenani labantu?
answer6: Ukudla kungase kunganeli ukusekela inani labantu elikhulayo
distractor6a: Umthamo wokuthwala uzohlala ukhula ngaphandle komkhawulo
question7: Kungani imizamo yamazwe ngamazwe yokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi ebangela ukushisa ibhekane nezinselele?
answer7: Akuwona wonke amazwe avumile izibopho ezifanayo, futhi amanye abeka phambili intuthuko yezomnotho
distractor7b: Wonke amazwe amukele ngokugcwele izinqubomgomo ezifanayo zemvelo
distractor7c: Ukukhishwa kwe-carbon dioxide sekufinyelele ku-zero emhlabeni jikelele
question8: Kungani umbhalo uchaza ikusasa lokukhula kwabantu kanye nokuvikelwa kwemvelo njengento engaqinisekile?
answer8: Ngoba akucaci ukuthi ukukhula kwabantu kungancishiswa yini ngenkathi kuvikelwa imvelo
distractor8a: Ngoba amandla okuthwala uMhlaba ayaziwa ukuthi angenamkhawulo
distractor8b: Ngoba zonke izinkinga zemvelo sezixazululiwe kakade
distractor8c: Ngoba ushintsho lwesimo sezulu alusenathonya imvelo

Izihloko ezihlolwe kulesi sigaba ezisetshenziswa kakhulu kwi-AP® zifaka phakathi ukulingisa, isimiso sokuncintisana sokukhipha, i-symbiosis, izinhlobo ze-keystone kanye nesisekelo, kanye nokulandelana okuyinhloko nokwesibili. Izinhlobo ziyasebenzisana ngezindlela eziningi, isibonelo esivamile sokusebenzisana kwezinhlobo ukuzingelwa kwezilwane yisilwane esizingelayo. Ezimweni eziningi, inqwaba yezilwane ezizingelayo kanye nezilwane ezizingelayo ziyahlukahluka ngemijikelezo. Ngaphandle kokuzingela, ngoba izinsiza zivame ukulinganiselwa endaweni, izinhlobo eziningi zingancintisana ukuze zizithole. Imiphakathi iyizinto eziyinkimbinkimbi ezichazwa yizinhlobo nenani lezinhlobo kanye nokuguquguquka kwendlela ezishintsha ngayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Njengezinhlobo, imiphakathi iyashintsha ngesakhiwo kanye nokwakheka, ngokuvamile ngokuphazamiseka kwemvelo njengomlilo noma iziphepho.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 kanye no-Big Idea 4 we-AP® Biology Curriculum Framework. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe ku-Curriculum Framework zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nenye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zebhayoloji zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.D
Ukukhula kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla yesistimu yezinto eziphilayo kuthonywa izinguquko endaweni yesistimu.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.D.1 Zonke izinhlelo zebhayoloji kusukela kumaseli nezinto eziphilayo kuya kubantu, imiphakathi kanye nezindawo zemvelo zithintwa ukusebenzisana okuyinkimbinkimbi kwe-biotic kanye ne-abiotic okubandakanya ukushintshana kwezinto kanye namandla amahhala.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.3 Umfundi angalungisa izethulo kanye namamodeli ezehlakalo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu kanye nezinhlelo kulesi sizinda.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
3.2 Umfundi angalungisa imibuzo yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile

4.2 Umfundi angaklama uhlelo lokuqoqa idatha ukuphendula umbuzo othile wesayensi.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezimpahleni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
