4.A.5 Imiphakathi yakhiwe yizinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisana ngezindlela eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo nezibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.13 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela imiphumela yoshintsho kubantu bomphakathi emphakathini.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezizungezile kuholela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo nezibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.15 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela imiphumela yokushintsha kwezinto noma ukutholakala kwamandla emiphakathini.

 Akuvamile ukuthi imiphakathi ihlale yodwa, uma ikhona, ezindaweni zokuhlala. Ezimweni eziningi, izinhlobo eziningi zabelana ngendawo yokuhlala. Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwalezi zinhlobo kudlala indima enkulu ekulawuleni ukukhula nobuningi bemiphakathi. Zonke imiphakathi ezihlala endaweni efanayo zakha umphakathi: imiphakathi ehlala endaweni ethile ngesikhathi esisodwa. Inani lezinhlobo ezihlala endaweni efanayo kanye nobuningi bazo baziwa ngokuthi ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo. Izindawo ezinezinhlobonhlobo eziphansi, njengeqhwa lase-Antarctica, zisaqukethe izinhlobo eziningi zezinto eziphilayo, kanti ukuhlukahluka kwezihlahla zemvula zasezindaweni ezishisayo kukhulu kakhulu kangangokuthi akunakubalwa. I-ecology ifundwa ezingeni lomphakathi ukuze kuqondwe ukuthi izinhlobo zixhumana kanjani futhi zincintisane ngezinsiza ezifanayo.
question1: Uyini umphakathi wezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Zonke izinhlobo zezinhlobo ezahlukene ezihlala endaweni efanayo ngesikhathi esisodwa
distractor1a: Inani labantu elilodwa elihlala endaweni eyodwa yokuhlala
distractor1b: Zonke izimiso zemvelo ezitholakala ngaphakathi kwe-biome
question2: Yiziphi izihloko ezivela emvelweni yomphakathi ezigcizelelwa ngqo kwi-AP® Biology?
answer2: I-Mimicry, isimiso sokuncintisana sokukhipha abanye, i-symbiosis, izinhlobo zesisekelo kanye nezisekelo, kanye nokulandelana kwemvelo
distractor2c: Ukuphefumula kwamaseli, i-meiosis, kanye nokubhalwa kwe-transcription
question3: Izinhlobo zezilwane ezidla ezinye kanye nezilwane ezidla ezinye zivame ukushintsha kanjani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
answer3: Zivame ukushintshashintsha ngemijikelezo
distractor3b: Isibalo sezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane sihlala sikhula kuyilapho isibalo sezilwane ezidla ezinye sihlala sizinzile
question4: Kungani izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane zivame ukuncintisana emphakathini?
answer4: Ngoba izinsizakusebenza emvelweni zilinganiselwe
distractor4a: Ngoba zonke izinhlobo zithatha indawo efanayo
distractor4b: Ngoba izilwane ezidla ezinye ziqeda ukuncintisana
question5: Yiziphi izehlakalo ezivame ukushintsha isakhiwo kanye nokwakheka kwemiphakathi?
answer5: Ukuphazamiseka kwemvelo okufana nemililo neziphepho
question6: Kuyini ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo?
answer6: Inani lezinhlobo endaweni yokuhlala kanye nobuningi bazo
question7: Yisiphi isimiso semvelo esichazwa njengesinezinhlobo eziningi kakhulu?
answer7: Amahlathi emvula asezindaweni ezishisayo
question8: Kungani izazi zemvelo zicwaninga imiphakathi?
answer8: Ukuqonda ukuthi izinhlobo zezilwane zixhumana kanjani futhi zincintisana kanjani ngezinsizakusebenza

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | Ukuzingelwa Kwezilwane Nezitshalo Ezimila Utshani
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | Ukuzingelwa Kwezilwane Nezitshalo Ezimila Utshani
chapterContent:
Mhlawumbe isibonelo esivamile sokusebenzisana kwezinhlobo zezilwane ukudla: ukuzingelwa kwezilwane ezidlayo yisilwane esizingelayo. Imibukiso yemvelo kuthelevishini iqokomisa idrama yento eyodwa ephilayo ebulala enye. Izibalo zezilwane ezidla ezinye kanye nezilwane ezidla ezinye emphakathini azihlali njalo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi: ezimweni eziningi, ziyahlukahluka ngemijikelezo ebonakala ihlobene. Isibonelo esivame ukucashunwa kakhulu sokusebenza kwezilwane ezidla ezinye sibonakala ekujikelezeni kwe-lynx (isilo) kanye ne-snowshoe hare (isilo), kusetshenziswa idatha yokubamba ecishe ibe neminyaka engu-200 ubudala evela emahlathini aseNyakatho Melika (Isithombe 36.19). Lo mjikelezo wezilwane ezidla ezinye kanye nezilwane ezidla ezinye uhlala cishe iminyaka eyi-10, kanti inani lezilwane ezidla ezinye lihlehla ngeminyaka eyi-1-2 kunenani lezilwane ezidla ezinye. Njengoba inani lezilwane ezidla ezinye landa, kunokudla okwengeziwe okutholakalayo kwe-lynx, okuvumela inani lezilwane ezidla ezinye ukuthi lande. Lapho inani lezilwane ezidla ezinye likhula liye ezingeni elilinganiselwe, nokho, zibulala onogwaja abaningi kangangokuthi inani lezilwane ezidla ezinye liqala ukwehla, kulandelwe ukwehla kwenani lezilwane ezidla ezinye ngenxa yokuntuleka kokudla. Uma inani lama-lynx liphansi, usayizi wonogwaja uqala ukwanda ngenxa, okungenani ngokwengxenye, yengcindezi ephansi yokudla, ukuqala umjikelezo kabusha.

 Umqondo wokuthi ukujikeleza kwenani lalezi zinhlobo ezimbili kulawulwa ngokuphelele amamodeli okudla uke waba nemibuzo. Izifundo zakamuva zikhombe izici ezingachazwanga ezixhomeke ekuxineni njengezibalulekile ekujikelezeni, ngaphezu kokudla. Okunye okungenzeka ukuthi ukujikeleza kwenani lama-hare kuyingxenye yemiphumela encike ekuxineni njengokuzala okuphansi (ukucindezeleka komama) okubangelwa ukuminyana lapho inani lama-hare liba likhulu kakhulu. Ukujikeleza kwenani lama-hare kuzobe sekudala ukujikeleza kwe-lynx ngoba kungumthombo wokudla oyinhloko wama-lynx. Lapho sifunda kakhulu imiphakathi, kulapho sithola khona ubunzima obuningi, okuvumela izazi zemvelo ukuthola amamodeli anembe kakhulu futhi ayinkimbinkimbi okuguquguquka kwenani labantu.

 I-Herbivory ichaza ukusetshenziswa kwezitshalo yizinambuzane nezinye izilwane, futhi kungobunye ubudlelwano obuthile obuthinta inani labantu. Ngokungafani nezilwane, izitshalo eziningi azikwazi ukubaleka izilwane ezidla ezinye noma ukusebenzisa ukulingisa ukuze zicashe ezilwaneni ezilambile. Ezinye izitshalo ziye zakha izindlela zokuzivikela ezifweni ezidla utshani. Ezinye izinhlobo ziye zakha ubudlelwano obuhambisanayo; isibonelo, ukhula luhlinzeka ngendlela yokusabalalisa imbewu esiza ekuzaleni izitshalo.
question1: Kuyini ukudla ezinye izilwane?
answer1: Ukuxhumana lapho into ethile ezingela futhi idle enye into ephilayo
distractor1a: Ubudlelwano lapho zombili izinhlobo zizuza khona
question2: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.19. Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezisetshenziswa njengesibonelo esivamile semijikelezo yenani lezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane?
answer2: Umvundla we-Lynx nowezicathulo zeqhwa
question3: Cishe ubude obungakanani bomjikelezo wokulwa nezilwane ezidla ezinye phakathi kwe-lynx nezinyoni ezidla izicathulo zeqhwa?
answer3: Cishe iminyaka eyi-10
question4: Kungani inani lama-lynx likhula ngemva kokwanda kwenani lama-hare?
answer4: Onogwaja abaningi banikeza ukudla okuningi kwe-lynx
distractor4a: Ama-Lynx aqala ukuzala ngaphandle kwemingcele yokudla
question5: Kungani inani lonogwaja lincipha ekugcineni ngemva kokufinyelela inani eliphezulu?
answer5: Inani elikhulayo lama-lynx lidla onogwaja abaningi
distractor5c: Zonke izinhlobo zonogwaja ziyathuthela ezindaweni ezintsha zokuhlala
question6: Yisiphi esinye isici esingaba nomthelela ekuphindaphindeni kwezinhlobo zonogwaja abadla izicathulo zeqhwa ngaphandle kokuzidla?
answer6: Izinto ezincike ekuminyaneni njengokuncipha kokuzala okubangelwa ukuminyana
distractor6c: Ukungabikho ngokuphelele kwezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane
question7: Kuyini ukudla okunotshani?
answer7: Ukusetshenziswa kwezitshalo yizilwane
distractor7a: Ukuzingela izilwane yizilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane
distractor7c: Ubudlelwano bokubambisana lapho zombili izinhlobo zizuza khona
question8: Ezinye izitshalo zinciphisa kanjani imiphumela yokhula lwezitshalo?
answer8: Bakha izindlela zokuzivikela noma ubudlelwano obuhambisanayo obusiza ekuzaleni
question9: Izitshalo ezidla utshani zingazizuzisa kanjani ezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo?
answer9: Izilwane zingasakaza imbewu, zisize ekuzaleni kwezitshalo
distractor9a: Izitshalo ezidla uhlaza zandisa izinga le-photosynthesis yezitshalo
distractor9b: Izilwane ezidla uhlaza ziqeda konke ukuncintisana kwezitshalo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Personality and Community Ecology | 36.6 I-Community Ecology | Ukucekela phansi kanye ne-Herbivory | Izindlela Zokuzivikela Ekuphikeleni kanye ne-Herbivory
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Personality and Community Ecology | 36.6 I-Community Ecology | Ukucekela phansi kanye ne-Herbivory | Izindlela Zokuzivikela Ekuphikeleni kanye ne-Herbivory
chapterContent:
Ucwaningo lwemiphakathi kumele lucabangele amandla okuziphendukela kwemvelo asebenza kumalungu emiphakathi ehlukahlukene equkethwe kuyo. Izinhlobo azimi ndawonye, kodwa ziyashintsha kancane kancane futhi zivumelanisa nendawo ezikuyo ngokukhetha kwemvelo kanye namanye amandla okuziphendukela kwemvelo. Izinhlobo ziye zathuthukisa izindlela eziningi zokubalekela ukudla nokudla utshani. Lezi zivikelo zingaba ngezomshini, ngamakhemikhali, ngokomzimba, noma ngokuziphatha.

 Ukuzivikela kwemishini, njengokuba khona kwameva ezitshalweni noma igobolondo eliqinile ezimfudu, kuvimbela ukudla utshani kwezilwane kanye nokudla utshani ngokubangela ubuhlungu obungokomzimba kumuntu odla utshani noma ngokuvimbela ngokomzimba umuntu odla utshani ukuthi akwazi ukudla inyamazane. Ukuzivikela kwamakhemikhali kukhiqizwa yizilwane eziningi kanye nezitshalo, njenge-foxglove enobuthi obukhulu uma idliwa. Isithombe 36.20 sibonisa ukuzivikela kwezinye izinto eziphilayo ngokumelene nokudla utshani kanye nokudla utshani.

 Izinhlobo eziningi zisebenzisa ukubukeka ngokomzimba, njengokuma komzimba nombala, ukuze zigweme ukubonwa yizilwane ezidla ezinye. Induku yokuhamba yasezindaweni ezishisayo iyisinambuzane esinombala nesimo somzimba segatsha okwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukusibona lapho simile ngokumelene ne-bac kg nxazonke zamagatsha angempela (Isithombe 36.21a). Kwesinye isibonelo, i-chameleon ingashintsha umbala wayo ukuze ifane nendawo ezungezile (Isithombe 36.21b). Zombili lezi ziyizibonelo zokufihla, noma ukugwema ukubonwa ngokuxubana ne-bac kg nxazonke. Kunezindlela eziningi zokuziphatha zokugwema noma ukudida izilwane ezidla ezinye. Ukudlala zifile futhi zihamba ngamaqembu amakhulu, njengeqembu lezinhlanzi noma imihlambi yezinyoni, kokubili kuyizindlela zokuziphatha ezinciphisa ingozi yokudliwa.

 Ezinye izinhlobo zisebenzisa umbala njengendlela yokuxwayisa izilwane ezidla ezinye ukuthi azilungele ukudla. Isibonelo, isibungu se-cinnabar moth, i-fire-bellyed toad, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi ze-beetle zinemibala ekhanyayo exwayisa ngokunambitheka okubi, ukuba khona kwamakhemikhali anobuthi, kanye/noma ikhono lokuluma, ngokulandelana. Izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane ezinganaki lo mbala bese zidla izinto eziphilayo zizozwa ukunambitheka kwazo okungathandeki noma ukuba khona kwamakhemikhali anobuthi futhi zifunde ukungawadli esikhathini esizayo. Lolu hlobo lwendlela yokuzivikela lubizwa ngokuthi i-aposematic coloration, noma i-aposematic coloration (Isithombe 36.22).

 Ngenkathi ezinye izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane zifunda ukugwema ukudla ezinye izilwane ezingaba khona ngenxa yombala wazo, ezinye izinhlobo ziye zathuthukisa izindlela zokulingisa lo mbala ukuze zigweme ukudliwa, yize zona ngokwazo zingase zingabi mnandi ukuzidla noma ziqukethe amakhemikhali anobuthi. Ku-Batesian mimicry, uhlobo olungenangozi lulungisa umbala oxwayisayo wesilwane esiyingozi. Uma sicabanga ukuthi zabelana ngezilwane ezifanayo ezidla ezinye izilwane, lo mbala ube usuvikela lezo ezingenangozi, yize zingenalo izinga elifanayo lokuzivikela ngokomzimba noma kwamakhemikhali ngokumelene nokudla njengesilwane ezilingisayo. Izinhlobo eziningi zezinambuzane zilingisa umbala wezinyosi noma izinyosi, okuyizinambuzane ezihlabayo, ezinobuthi, ngaleyo ndlela zivimbele ukudla (Isithombe 36.23).

 Ku-Müllerian mimicry, izinhlobo eziningi zinombala ofanayo wokuxwayisa, kodwa zonke empeleni zinezivikelo. Isithombe 36.24 sibonisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zezimvemvane ezinuka kabi ezinombala ofanayo. Ku-Emsleyan/Mertensian mimicry, isisulu esibulalayo silingisa esingeyona ingozi kangako, njengenyoka yekhorali enobuthi elingisa inyoka yobisi engenabo ubuthi. Lolu hlobo lokulingisa luyivelakancane kakhulu futhi kunzima ukuluqonda kunezinhlobo ezimbili zangaphambilini. Ukuze lolu hlobo lokulingisa lusebenze, kubalulekile ukuthi ukudla inyoka yobisi kube nemiphumela engathandeki kodwa engeyona ebulalayo. Ngemuva kwalokho, lezi zilwane ezidla ezinye zifunda ukungadli izinyoka ezinalo mbala, zivikele nenyoka yekhorali. Ukube inyoka ibingabulala isilwane esidla ezinye, bekungeke kube nethuba lokuthi isilwane esidla ezinye sifunde ukungadli, futhi inzuzo yezinhlobo ezingenabo ubuthi obuncane ibizonyamalala.
question1: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sokuzivikela kwemishini ekuhlaselweni yizilwane noma ezidla uhlaza?
answer1: Ameva ezitshalweni noma igobolondo eliqinile lofudu
question2: Kuyini ukuzifihla?
answer2: Ukuzivikela lapho into ephilayo ihlangana khona nendawo ezungezile ukuze igweme ukutholakala
distractor2a: Isibonakaliso sesixwayiso esibonisa ukuthi into ephilayo inobuthi
distractor2c: Ukukhiqizwa kwamakhemikhali anobuthi ukuvimbela izilwane ezidla ezinye
question3: Yisiphi isidalwa esichazwa njengesishintsha umbala waso ukuze sihambisane nendawo esikuyo?
answer3: Unwabu
question4: Kuyini umbala we-aposematic?
answer4: Umbala ogqamile oxwayisayo obonisa ukuthi into ephilayo inobuthi, ayimnandi, noma iyingozi ngandlela thile
question5: Kuyini ukulingisa kweBatesian?
answer5: Uhlobo olungenangozi lulingisa umbala oyisixwayiso wohlobo oluyingozi
distractor5a: Izinhlobo ezimbili eziyingozi zinombala ofanayo wesixwayiso
distractor5b: Isilwane esidla ezinye sishintsha ukubukeka kwaso ukuze sifane nesilwane saso esidla ezinye
question6: Ukulingisa kwe-Müllerian kuhluke kanjani ekulingiseni kwe-Batesian?
answer6: Ku-Müllerian mimicry, zonke izinhlobo ezibelana ngombala oyisixwayiso zivikelwe ngempela
distractor6a: Uhlobo olulodwa kuphela oluvikelwayo ku-Müllerian mimicry
distractor6c: Ukulingisa kwe-Müllerian kusebenzisa i-camouflage esikhundleni sokuxwayisa ngombala
question7: Kungani ukulingisa kwe-Emsleyan/Mertensian kubhekwa njengokungavamile?
answer7: Uhlobo oluyingozi kakhulu lulingisa uhlobo olungayingozi kangako ukuze izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane zikwazi ukusinda lapho zihlangana futhi zifunde ukugwema leyo mibala.
distractor7b: Izitshalo kuphela ezibonisa lolu hlobo lokulingisa
question8: Yikuphi ukuziphatha okunganciphisa ingozi yokudla izilwane?
answer8: Ukudlala ngokufa noma ukuhamba ngamaqembu amakhulu njengezikole noma imihlambi
question9: Kungani izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane zivame ukugwema izinto eziphilayo ezinombala ofana nowemvelo ngemva kokuhlangana kanye?
answer9: Bafunda ukuhlobanisa imibala ekhanyayo nokuhlangenwe nakho okungathandeki njengobuthi, ukunambitheka okubi, noma ukuhlaba
distractor9b: Umbala uvimbela izilwane ezidla ezinye ukuba zingazitholi
distractor9c: Umbala ubangela ukuthi izilwane ezidla ezinye zilahlekelwe umbono wazo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | Isimiso Sokubandlululwa Kokuncintisana
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | Isimiso Sokubandlululwa Kokuncintisana
chapterContent:
Izinsiza zivame ukulinganiselwa ngaphakathi kwendawo yokuhlala futhi izinhlobo eziningi zingancintisana ukuze zizithole. Zonke izinhlobo zinendawo yezemvelo endaweni yokuhlala, echaza indlela ezithola ngayo izinsiza ezizidingayo nokuthi zixhumana kanjani nezinye izinhlobo emphakathini. Isimiso sokukhishwa ngokuncintisana sithi izinhlobo ezimbili azikwazi ukuhlala endaweni efanayo endaweni yokuhlala. Ngamanye amazwi, izinhlobo ezahlukene azikwazi ukuhlala ndawonye emphakathini uma zincintisana nazo zonke izinsiza ezifanayo. Isibonelo salesi simiso siboniswe kuMfanekiso 36.25, ngezinhlobo ezimbili ze-protozoan, i-Paramecium aurelia ne-Paramecium caudatum. Uma zikhuliswe ngazinye elabhorethri, zombili ziyachuma. Kodwa uma zifakwa ndawonye eshubhu lokuhlola elifanayo (indawo yokuhlala), i-P. aurelia incintisana ne-P. caudatum ngokudla, okuholela ekuqothulweni kwayo ekugcineni.

 Lokhu kukhishwa kungagwenywa uma inani labantu lithuthuka ukuze lisebenzise izinsiza ezahlukene, indawo ehlukile yendawo yokuhlala, noma londle ngesikhathi esihlukile sosuku, esibizwa ngokuthi ukuhlukanisa izinsiza. Lezi zinto eziphilayo ezimbili kuthiwa zihlala kuma-microniches ahlukene. Lezi zinto eziphilayo zihlala ndawonye ngokunciphisa ukuncintisana okuqondile
question1: Iyini indawo ebaluleke kakhulu kwezemvelo?
answer1: Indima yohlobo oluthile ohlelweni lwemvelo, okuhlanganisa nendlela oluthola ngayo izinsiza kanye nendlela oluxhumana ngayo nezinye izinhlobo
distractor1a: Indawo yangempela lapho uhlobo luzala khona
question2: Uthini umgomo wokukhishwa kwabantu ngokuncintisana?
answer2: Izinhlobo ezimbili azikwazi ukuhlala endaweni efanayo yemvelo endaweni efanayo unomphela
distractor2a: Izinhlobo ezimbili zihlala zizuza ngokwabelana ngendawo efanayo
distractor2b: Izinhlobo zingaphila ndawonye kuphela uma ziyizilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane
distractor2c: Ukuncintisana kwenzeka kuphela phakathi kwamalungu ohlobo olufanayo
question3: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.25. Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-protozoan oludlule olunye lapho zombili zikhuliswe ndawonye?
answer3: I-Paramecium aurelia iphumelele i-Paramecium caudatum
question4: Kungani i-Paramecium caudatum yagcina inyamalele lapho ikhula nge-Paramecium aurelia?
answer4: Kwakuncintiswana ngezinsiza zokudla
question5: Kuyini ukwahlukanisa izinsiza?
answer5: Inqubo lapho izinhlobo ezincintisanayo zisebenzisa khona izinsiza ezahlukene, izindawo zokuhlala, noma izikhathi zomsebenzi ukunciphisa ukuncintisana
distractor5a: Ukwabelana ngokulinganayo kwazo zonke izinsiza ezitholakalayo
distractor5c: Ukufuduka kwazo zonke izinhlobo zezilwane endaweni entsha yokuhlala
question6: Izinhlobo ezincintisanayo zingakugwema kanjani ukukhishwa ngaphandle kokuncintisana?
answer6: Ngokusebenzisa ama-microniches ahlukene ngokuhlukanisa izinsiza
question7: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sokwahlukaniswa kwezinsiza?
answer7: Izinhlobo ezimbili zidla inyamazane efanayo kodwa ngezikhathi ezahlukene zosuku
distractor7a: Izinhlobo ezimbili zincintisana ngokudla okufanayo endaweni efanayo ngesikhathi esisodwa
distractor7b: Izinhlobo ezimbili zihlala endaweni efanayo yezemvelo unomphela
question8: Iyini i-microniche?
answer8: Ingxenye ekhethekile yendawo yokuhlala noma izinsiza ezisetshenziswa uhlobo oluthile ukunciphisa ukuncintisana

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | Ukusebenzisana
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | Ukusebenzisana
chapterContent: Ubudlelwano be-Symbiotic, noma ama-symbiose (ubuningi), buwukuxhumana okuseduze phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zezinhlobo esikhathini eside okuthinta ubuningi kanye nokusabalala kwezinhlobo ezihambisanayo. Ososayensi abaningi bayayamukela le ncazelo, kodwa abanye bakhawulela leli gama kulezo zinhlobo ezihambisanayo kuphela, lapho zombili zizuza khona ekusebenzisaneni. Kule ngxoxo, kuzosetshenziswa incazelo ebanzi
question1: Kuyini i-symbiosis?
answer1: Ukuxhumana okuseduze, kwesikhathi eside phakathi kwabantu bezinhlobo ezahlukene
distractor1b: Ukuxhumana kwesikhashana phakathi kwezilwane ezidla ezinye kanye nezilwane ezidla ezinye
distractor1c: Ukuhamba kwezinto eziphilayo phakathi kwezindawo zokuhlala
question2: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezihlanganyela ebudlelwaneni bokubambisana?
answer2: Abantu bezinhlobo ezahlukene
distractor2b: Izilwane ezidla ezinye kanye nezilwane ezidla ezinye zohlobo olufanayo kuphela
question3: Ubudlelwano bokubambisana buhlala isikhathi esingakanani?
answer3: Kungukuxhumana okude, okunwetshiwe
question4: Ubudlelwano bokubambisana bungathinta kanjani abantu?
answer4: Zingathonya ubuningi kanye nokusabalala kwezinhlobo ezisebenzisanayo
distractor4a: Zithinta kuphela amazinga okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor4b: Zithinta kuphela amandla okuthwala ezindawo zemvelo
question5: Ososayensi abaningi bayichaza kanjani i-symbiosis?
answer5: Njenganoma yikuphi ukuxhumana okuseduze, kwesikhathi eside phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene
distractor5a: Njengokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu ohlobo olufanayo kuphela
distractor5b: Njengobudlelwano phakathi kwezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane kuphela
question6: Abanye ososayensi balisebenzisa kanjani igama elithi symbiosis ngendlela ehlukile?
answer6: Bayikhawulela ebuhlotsheni obuhambisanayo lapho zombili izinhlobo zizuza khona
question7: Iyiphi incazelo ye-symbiosis esetshenziswe kulesi sahluko?
answer7: Incazelo ebanzi ehlanganisa konke ukuxhumana okuseduze, kwesikhathi eside phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | I-Symbiosis | I-Commensalism
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | I-Symbiosis | I-Commensalism
chapterContent: Ubudlelwano be-commensal buvela lapho uhlobo olulodwa luzuza ekusebenzelaneni okuseduze nokude, kanti olunye aluzuzi futhi alulimali. Izinyoni ezihlala ezihlahleni zinikeza isibonelo sobudlelwano be-commensal (Isithombe 36.26). Umuthi awulinyazwa ukuba khona kwesidleke phakathi kwamagatsha awo. Izidleke zilula futhi azikhiqizi ubunzima obuncane ekuqineni kwesakhiwo segatsha, futhi iningi lamaqabunga, umuthi owusebenzisayo ukuthola amandla nge-photosynthesis, angaphezulu kwesidleke ngakho awathinteki. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, inyoni izuza kakhulu. Uma inyoni kufanele ihlale esidlekeni esivulekile, amaqanda ayo namaphuphu ayo abe sengozini yezilwane ezidla ezinye. Esinye isibonelo sobudlelwano be-commensal yinhlanzi yomshayeli kanye noshaka. Inhlanzi yomshayeli idla okusele kokudla komshayeli, futhi umshayeli akathinteki nganoma iyiphi indlela.
question1: Kuyini i-commensalism?
answer1: Ubudlelwano bokubambisana lapho uhlobo olulodwa luzuza khona kanti olunye alusizwa futhi alulinyazwa
distractor1a: Ubudlelwano lapho zombili izinhlobo zizuza khona
distractor1b: Ubudlelwano lapho uhlobo olulodwa luzuza khona kanti olunye lonakaliswa
distractor1c: Ukuncintisana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezimbili zemithombo efanayo
question2: Yisiphi isidalwa esizuzayo ebuhlotsheni phakathi kwezinyoni ezizalela ezihlahleni kanye nezihlahla?
answer2: Inyoni
question3: Kungani lesi sihlahla ngokuvamile singoniwa yizinyoni ezihlala emagatsheni aso?
answer3: Izidleke zilula futhi ngokuvamile aziphazamisi isakhiwo sezihlahla noma i-photosynthesis
question4: Izinyoni zizuza kanjani ngokuzalela ezihlahleni?
answer4: Amaqanda abo kanye namaphuphu abo avikeleke kangcono ezitheni
distractor4c: Umuthi usiza izinyoni ukuthi zizalane ngokushesha okukhulu
question5: Yisiphi isibili sezinto eziphilayo esinye isibonelo se-commensalism esichazwe embhalweni?
answer5: Izinhlanzi zomshayeli kanye noshaka
question6: Izinhlanzi zomshayeli zizuza kanjani koshaka?
answer6: Zidla okusele okuvela ekudleni koshaka
distractor6a: Bathola isivikelo ngoba oshaka bahlasela izilwane ezidla ezinye
distractor6b: Ushaka unikeza umoya-mpilo ezinhlanzini ezisebenzisa umshayeli wendiza
distractor6c: Ushaka wabelana ngokudla okufana nenhlanzi yomshayeli
question7: Ushaka uthinteka kanjani ngokuba khona kwezinhlanzi zohlobo lwe-pilot?
answer7: Ushaka akasizwa futhi akalimali
distractor7c: Ushaka uba sengozini enkulu yezilwane ezidla ezinye

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | I-Symbiosis | Ukubambisana
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | I-Symbiosis | Ukubambisana
chapterContent: Uhlobo lwesibili lobudlelwano bokusebenzisana lubizwa ngokuthi i-mutualism, lapho izinhlobo ezimbili zizuza khona ekusebenzisaneni kwazo. Abanye ososayensi bakholelwa ukuthi lezi yizibonelo zangempela kuphela ze-symbiosis. Isibonelo, izintuthwane zinobudlelwano bokusebenzisana ne-protozoa ezihlala emathunjini esinambuzane (Isithombe 36.27a). Izintuthwane zizuza ekhonweni le-bacterial symbionts ngaphakathi kwe-protozoa lokugaya i-cellulose. Izintuthwane ngokwazo azikwazi ukwenza lokhu, futhi ngaphandle kwe-protozoa, bezingeke zikwazi ukuthola amandla ekudleni kwazo (i-cellulose okhunini eziluhlafunayo futhi eziludlayo). I-protozoa kanye ne-bacterial symbionts ziyazuza ngokuba nendawo evikelayo kanye nokunikezwa kokudla okuqhubekayo okuvela ezenzweni zokuhlafuna izinkuni zezintuthwane. Izintuthwane zinobudlelwano bokusebenzisana phakathi kwesikhunta kanye ne-photosynthetic algae noma amabhaktheriya (Isithombe 36.27b). Njengoba lezi zinto ezisebenzisana zikhula ndawonye, i-glucose ekhiqizwa yi-algae inikeza ukondla kuzo zombili izinto eziphilayo, kanti isakhiwo somzimba se-lichen sivikela i-algae ezintweni futhi senza izakhamzimba ezithile emoyeni zitholakale kalula ku-algae.
question1: Kuyini ukubambisana?
answer1: Ubudlelwano bokubambisana lapho zombili izinhlobo zizuza khona
distractor1a: Ubudlelwano lapho uhlobo olulodwa luzuza khona kanti olunye lonakaliswa
distractor1b: Ubudlelwano lapho uhlobo olulodwa luzuza khona kanti olunye lungathinteki
distractor1c: Ukuncintisana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezimbili zezinsiza ezifanayo
question2: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezakha ubudlelwano obuhambisanayo ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla lwezintuthwane?
answer2: Izinambuzane kanye nama-protozoa aqukethe izimpawu zamagciwane
question3: Izintuthwane zizuza kanjani ebuhlotsheni bazo obuhambisanayo ne-protozoa?
answer3: Ama-protozoa avumela izintuthwane ukuthi zigaye i-cellulose futhi zithole amandla okhunini
distractor3b: Ama-protozoa avikela izintuthwane ezidla ezinye izilwane
distractor3c: Ama-protozoa asiza izintuthwane ukuthi zizale ngokushesha
question4: I-protozoa kanye ne-bacterial symbionts zayo zizuza kanjani ngokuhlala ezintuthwaneni?
answer4: Bathola indawo evikelekile kanye nokunikezwa kokudla njalo
distractor4a: Zithola isivikelo ezifweni ezibangelwa amagciwane kuphela
question5: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezakha i-lichen?
answer5: Isikhunta kanye ne-alga noma i-bacterium ye-photosynthetic
question6: Umlingani we-photosynthesis umzuzisa kanjani ulwelwesi?
answer6: Ikhiqiza ushukela odla izinto eziphilayo zombili
question7: Umlingani wesikhunta uzuzisa kanjani i-photosynthesis ephilayo e-lichen?
answer7: Ihlinzeka ngesivikelo futhi yenza izakhamzimba ezithile zitholakale kalula
question8: Kungani izintuthwane zingakwazi ukuphila ngokudla izinkuni ngaphandle kwezinhlobo zazo ze-protozoan?
answer8: Abakwazi ukugaya i-cellulose ngokwabo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | I-Symbiosis | I-Parasitism
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | I-Symbiosis | I-Parasitism
chapterContent:
I-parasite iyisidalwa esiphila kwesinye isidalwa esiphilayo noma esithola izakhamzimba kuso. Kulobu budlelwano, i-parasite iyazuza, kodwa uma isidalwa sondliwe, isidalwa siyalimala. Isidalwa esihlala sivame ukuba buthaka yi-parasite njengoba sikhipha izinsiza isidalwa esihlala sihlala kuzo ukuze sizigcine siphilile. Nokho, i-parasite cishe ngeke ibulale isidalwa esihlala kuzo, ikakhulukazi hhayi ngokushesha, ngoba lokhu ngeke kuvumele isikhathi sokuba isidalwa siqedele umjikelezo waso wokuzala ngokusabalala komunye isidalwa esihlala kuzo.

 Imijikelezo yokuzala yama-parasite ivame ukuba yinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, ngezinye izikhathi idinga izinhlobo ezingaphezu kweyodwa zesidalwa esihlala kuzo. I-tapeworm iyi-parasite ebangela izifo kubantu lapho kudliwa inyama engcolisiwe, engaphekiwe kahle njengengulube, inhlanzi, noma inyama yenkomo (Isithombe 36.28). I-tapeworm ingaphila ngaphakathi emathunjini esidalwa iminyaka eminingana, izuze ekudleni isidalwa esikulethayo emathunjini aso ngokudla, futhi ingakhula ibe ngaphezu kwamamitha angu-50 ubude ngokungeza izingxenye. I-parasite isuka kolunye uhlobo iye kolunye uhlobo ngomjikelezo, okwenza izidalwa ezimbili ezihlala kuzo zidingekile ukuze kuqedwe umjikelezo wayo wokuphila. Esinye isilwane esivamile yiPlasmodium falciparum, imbangela ye-protozoan ye-malaria, isifo esibalulekile ezingxenyeni eziningi zomhlaba. Njengoba sihlala esibindini somuntu nasemaseli abomvu egazi, lesi sidalwa sizala ngocansi emathunjini omiyane abancelisa igazi ukuze siqedele umjikelezo waso wokuphila. Ngakho-ke umalaleveva usakazeka kusuka kumuntu uye kumuntu ngomiyane, esinye sezifo eziningi ezithathelwanayo ezithwalwa yi-arthropod.
question1: Iyini i-parasite?
answer1: Isidalwa esiphila kwesinye isidalwa noma kwesinye futhi sithola izakhamzimba kuso
distractor1a: Isidalwa esizizuzisa sona kanye nolunye uhlobo
distractor1c: Isidalwa esincintisana ngezinsiza ngaphandle kokuphila kwesinye isidalwa
question2: Umphathi uthinteka kanjani ebudlelwaneni obunezinambuzane?
answer2: Umninimzi uyalimala ngoba i-parasite isusa izinsiza ezizidingayo
question3: Kungani izimuncagazi ngokuvamile zingabulali abantu ezibaphethe ngokushesha?
answer3: Ngoba zidinga ukuthi umninikhaya aphile isikhathi eside ngokwanele ukuze aqedele umjikelezo wazo wokuzala futhi asakazekele kubaninikhaya abasha
distractor3a: Ngoba izimuncagazi azikwazi ukusinda ngaphakathi kwezidalwa eziphilayo
distractor3b: Ngoba ababungazi bavikelekile ezifweni ezibangelwa amagciwane
distractor3c: Ngoba izimuncagazi zizalana kuphela ngemva kokuba umninimzi efile
question4: Abantu bangangenwa kanjani yizikelemu ezithwala amathephu?
answer4: Ngokudla inyama yengulube, inhlanzi, noma inyama yenkomo engcolisiwe, engaphekiwe kahle
question5: I-tapeworm ihlala kuphi emzimbeni womuntu?
answer5: Emathunjini
question6: Kungani izikelemu ezithwala amathe zizuza ngokuhlala emathunjini omuntu ohlala kuzo?
answer6: Bathola izakhamzimba ekudleni okudliwa ngumninikhaya
question7: Yisiphi isidalwa esibangela umalaleveva?
answer7: I-Plasmodium falciparum
question8: I-malaria idluliselwa kanjani isuka komunye umuntu iye komunye?
answer8: Ngomiyane abancelisa igazi
question9: Kungani izimuncagazi eziningi zinemijikelezo yokuphila eyinkimbinkimbi ehilela abantu abaningi?
answer9: Izinhlobo ezahlukene zomsingathi ziyadingeka ukuze ziqedele izigaba ezahlukene zomjikelezo wazo wokuphila
distractor9a: Azikwazi ukuzala ngaphakathi kwento eyodwa ephilayo
distractor9b: Kumelwe bagweme zonke izilwane ezinomgogodla ezihlala kuzo
distractor9c: Zidinga i-photosynthesis phakathi nengxenye yomjikelezo wazo wokuphila

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | Izici Zemiphakathi
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | Izici Zemiphakathi
chapterContent: Imiphakathi iyizinto eziyinkimbinkimbi ezingabonakala ngesakhiwo sazo (izinhlobo nezinombolo zezinhlobo ezikhona) kanye nokuguquguquka (indlela imiphakathi eshintsha ngayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi). Ukuqonda isakhiwo somphakathi kanye nokuguquguquka kwenza izazi zemvelo zomphakathi zikwazi ukuphatha imvelo ngendlela ephumelela kakhulu.
question1: Iyini isakhiwo somphakathi?
answer1: Izinhlobo nezinombolo zezinhlobo ezikhona emphakathini
distractor1a: Isikhathi sokuphila esimaphakathi sazo zonke izinto eziphilayo emphakathini
question2: Ziyini izindlela zomphakathi?
answer2: Izindlela imiphakathi eshintsha ngazo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor2c: Amaphethini omsebenzi wansuku zonke wezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane
question3: Yiziphi izici ezimbili ezinkulu ezisetshenziswa ukuchaza imiphakathi?
answer3: Isakhiwo kanye nokuguquguquka
distractor3a: Usayizi wabantu kanye nezinga lokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor3c: Ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo
question4: Kungani ukuqonda isakhiwo somphakathi kubalulekile?
answer4: Kusiza izazi zemvelo ukuqonda ukwakheka kwezindawo zemvelo
distractor4a: Inquma ukulandelana kwe-DNA yazo zonke izinto eziphilayo
question5: Kungani izazi zemvelo zifunda ngezinguquko zomphakathi?
answer5: Ukuqonda ukuthi imiphakathi isabela kanjani ezinguqukweni ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
question6: Ukuqonda isakhiwo somphakathi kanye nokuguquguquka kwemvelo kubazuzisa kanjani ososayensi bezinto eziphilayo?
answer6: Ivumela ukuphathwa kwe-ecosystem okuphumelelayo kakhudlwana
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono umphakathi wezinto eziphilayo?
answer7: Iqembu eliyinkimbinkimbi lezinhlobo ezisebenzisanayo ezikwakheka kwazo kanye nobuningi bazo kushintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor7c: Indawo yokuhlala equkethe uhlobo olulodwa kuphela

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Personality and Community Ecology | 36.6 I-Community Ecology | Izici Zemiphakathi | Izinhlobo Eziyisisekelo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Personality and Community Ecology | 36.6 I-Community Ecology | Izici Zemiphakathi | Izinhlobo Eziyisisekelo
chapterContent:
Izinhlobo zesisekelo zibhekwa njengesisekelo "noma isisekelo"somphakathi, zinethonya elikhulu kakhulu esakhiweni sawo sonke. Ngokuvamile zingabakhiqizi abayinhloko: izinto eziphilayo eziletha iningi lamandla emphakathini. I-Kelp, i-brown algae, uhlobo lwesisekelo, oluyisisekelo samahlathi e-kelp ogwini lwaseCalifornia.

 Izinhlobo zesisekelo zingaguqula ngokomzimba indawo ukuze zikhiqize futhi zilondoloze izindawo zokuhlala ezizuzisa ezinye izinto eziphilayo ezizisebenzisayo. Isibonelo amakhorali e-photosynthetic e-coral reef (Isithombe 36.29). Amakhorali ngokwawo awayona i-photosynthetic, kodwa agcina ama-symbionts ngaphakathi kwezicubu zomzimba wawo (ama-dinoflagellates abizwa ngokuthi ama-zooxanthellae) enza i-photosynthesis; lesi esinye isibonelo se-mutualism. Ama-exoskeletons amakhorali aphilayo nafile akha ingxenye enkulu yesakhiwo se-reef, esivikela ezinye izinhlobo eziningi emagagasini nasemifuleni yolwandle.
question1: Luyini uhlobo lwesisekelo?
answer1: Uhlobo olunethonya elikhulu ekwakhiweni komphakathi
distractor1b: Uhlobo olutholakala kuphela ezindaweni zemvelo zasemanzini
distractor1c: Uhlobo oluhlala luthatha izinga eliphezulu kakhulu le-trophic
question2: Yiluphi uhlobo lwezinto eziphilayo oluyizinhlobo eziningi eziyisisekelo?
answer2: Abakhiqizi abayinhloko
question3: Kungani izinhlobo zesisekelo zibalulekile ezindaweni zemvelo?
answer3: Ziletha iningi lamandla emphakathini futhi zithonya kakhulu isakhiwo sawo
question4: Yisiphi isidalwa esinikezwa njengesibonelo sohlobo lwesisekelo?
answer4: I-Kelp
question5: Izinhlobo zesisekelo zingayishintsha kanjani indawo yazo?
answer5: Ngokudala nokugcina izindawo zokuhlala ezizuzisa ezinye izinto eziphilayo
question6: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.29. Amakhorali asebenza kanjani njengezinhlobo zesisekelo?
answer6: Ama-exoskeleton azo akha izakhiwo zamatshe angaphansi komhlaba ezihlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala kanye nokuvikelwa kwezinye izinhlobo eziningi zezilwane
distractor6a: Yizona izilwane ezidla kakhulu izinhlanzi zasemanzini
question7: Kungani amakhorali ekwazi ukusekela i-photosynthesis yize wona ngokwawo engeyona i-photosynthesis?
answer7: Ziqukethe ama-symbionts e-photosynthetic dinoflagellate abizwa ngokuthi i-zooxanthellae
question8: Uhlobo luni lobudlelwano bokubambisana obukhona phakathi kwama-coral kanye ne-zooxanthellae?
answer8: Ukubambisana

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Personality and Community Ecology | 36.6 I-Community Ecology | Izici Zemiphakathi | Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo, Ukuceba Kwezinhlobo, kanye Nobuningi Bezinhlobo Ezihlobene
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Personality and Community Ecology | 36.6 I-Community Ecology | Izici Zemiphakathi | Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo, Ukuceba Kwezinhlobo, kanye Nobuningi Bezinhlobo Ezihlobene
chapterContent: I-Biodiversity ichaza ubunzima bezinto eziphilayo zomphakathi: ilinganiswa ngenani lezinhlobo ezahlukene (ukuceba kwezinhlobo) endaweni ethile kanye nobuningi bazo obuhlobene (ukufana kwezinhlobo). Indawo okukhulunywa ngayo ingaba yindawo yokuhlala, i-biome, noma i-biosphere yonke, okuyisamba sazo zonke izindawo zemvelo. Ukuceba kwezinhlobo yigama elisetshenziselwa ukuchaza inani lezinhlobo ezihlala endaweni yokuhlala noma i-biome. Ukuceba kwezinhlobo kuyahlukahluka emhlabeni wonke (Isithombe 36.30). Esinye isici ekunqumeni ukuceba kwezinhlobo yi-latitude, lapho ukuceba kwezinhlobo ezinkulu kakhulu kwenzeka ezindaweni zemvelo eziseduze ne-equator, ezivame ukuba namazinga okushisa afudumele, inani elikhulu lemvula, kanye nesikhathi esincane sesizini. Ukuceba kwezinhlobo eziphansi kakhulu kwenzeka eduze kwezinsika, ezibanda kakhulu, zomile, futhi ngaleyo ndlela zingavumeli impilo esikhathini samuva nje se-geologic (isikhathi kusukela ekuqhekekeni kweqhwa). Ukubikezela kwesimo sezulu noma ukukhiqiza nakho kuyisici esibalulekile. Ezinye izici zithonya ukuceba kwezinhlobo. Isibonelo, ucwaningo lwe-biogeography yesiqhingi luzama ukuchaza ukuceba okuphezulu kwezinhlobo ezitholakala eziqhingini ezithile ezihlukanisiwe, okuhlanganisa neziQhingi zaseGalápagos ezaphefumulela iDarwin encane. Ubuningi bezinhlobo ezihlobene yinani labantu abaphila ohlotsheni oluthile uma kuqhathaniswa nenani eliphelele labantu kuzo zonke izinhlobo eziphila endaweni yokuhlala, endaweni yokuhlala, noma endaweni ye-biome. Izinhlobo eziyisisekelo zivame ukuba nobuningi obukhulu bezinhlobo.
question1: Kuyini ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Ubunzima bezinto eziphilayo zomphakathi, obulinganiswa ngokuceba kwezinhlobo kanye nobuningi obuhlobene
question2: Kuyini ukuceba kwezinhlobo?
answer2: Inani lezinhlobo ezahlukene ezihlala endaweni yokuhlala noma endaweni ephilayo
distractor2c: Isikhathi sokuphila esimaphakathi sezinto eziphilayo endaweni yokuhlala
question3: Kuyini ukutholakala kwezinhlobo eziningi?
answer3: Inani labantu ohlotsheni oluthile uma liqhathaniswa nenani labantu bazo zonke izinhlobo emphakathini.
distractor3b: Iphesenti lezindawo zokuhlala ezihlalwa uhlobo oluthile
question4: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.30. Kukuphi lapho ukuceba kwezinhlobo ngokuvamile kukhulu khona?
answer4: Eduze kwenkabazwe
question5: Kungani ukuceba kwezinhlobo ngokuvamile kuphakeme kakhulu eduze kwenkabazwe?
answer5: Ngoba lezi zindawo ngokuvamile zinamazinga okushisa afudumele, imvula eningi, kanye nezikhathi zonyaka eziphansi
distractor5c: Ngoba bathola ukukhanya kwelanga okuncane kakhulu
question6: Yisiphi isici esibangela ukuceba kwezinhlobo eziseduze kwezinsika?
answer6: Izimo ezibandayo nezomile ezingalungelanga impilo
question7: Ucwaningo lwe-biogeography yesiqhingi lufuna ukuchazani?
answer7: Kungani iziqhingi ezithile eziqhelile zinothe kakhulu ngezinhlobo
distractor7a: Indlela iziqhingi ezakheka ngayo ngokusebenzisa i-plate tectonics
distractor7b: Kungani iziqhingi zihlala zinezinhlobo ezimbalwa kunezizwekazi
distractor7c: Indlela abantu abaguquka ngayo babe imibuso emisha
question8: Yiluphi uhlobo lwezinhlobo oluvame ukuba nobuningi obukhulu emphakathini?
answer8: Izinhlobo zesisekelo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | Izici Zemiphakathi | Izinhlobo Ze-Keystone
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | Izici Zemiphakathi | Izinhlobo Ze-Keystone
chapterContent: Uhlobo lwe-keystone yilolo olukhona kulona luyisihluthulelo sokugcina ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo ngaphakathi kwendawo ezungezile kanye nokugcina isakhiwo somphakathi wezinto eziphilayo. Inkanyezi yolwandle ephakathi kwamaza, i-Pisaster ochraceus, yasenyakatho-ntshonalanga ye-United States uhlobo lwe-keystone (Isithombe 36.31). Izifundo zibonise ukuthi lapho lesi sidalwa sisuswa emiphakathini, inani lezilwane ezizingelayo zemvelo (izimbaza) liyakhula, okushintsha ngokuphelele ukwakheka kohlobo futhi kunciphisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo. Olunye uhlobo lwe-keystone yi-banded tetra, inhlanzi emifuleni yasezindaweni ezishisayo, enikeza cishe yonke i-phosphorus, isakhamzimba esidingekayo esingaphili, emphakathini wonke. Uma lezi zinhlanzi zingaphela, umphakathi uzothinteka kakhulu.
question1: Luyini uhlobo lwe-keystone?
answer1: Uhlobo olukhona kulo kubalulekile ekugcineni isakhiwo kanye nokuhlukahluka komphakathi
distractor1b: Uhlobo olutholakala kuphela ezindaweni zokuhlala ezishisayo
distractor1c: Umkhiqizi oyinhloko kuzo zonke izimiso zemvelo
question2: Kungani izinhlobo ze-keystone zibalulekile?
answer2: Zinethonya elikhulu kakhulu ekwakhiweni komphakathi kanye nokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo
question3: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.31. Yisiphi isidalwa esichazwa njengohlobo lwe-keystone endaweni ephakathi kwamaza enyakatho-ntshonalanga ye-United States?
answer3: Inkanyezi yolwandle iPisaster ochraceus
question4: Kwenzekani lapho uPisaster ochraceus esuswa emphakathini wakhe?
answer4: Inani lezimbaza landa, lashintsha isakhiwo somphakathi futhi lanciphisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo
question5: Yiluphi uhlobo lwenhlanzi olubizwa ngokuthi uhlobo oluyinhloko emifuleni yasezindaweni ezishisayo?
answer5: I-tetra enebhande
question6: Kungani i-tetra enebhande ibhekwa njengohlobo lwe-keystone?
answer6: Ihlinzeka cishe yonke i-phosphorus edingwa yiwo wonke umphakathi
distractor6a: Yisona kuphela isilwane esidla ezinye esisemfuleni
question7: Kungenzekani uma i-tetra enebhande ingaphela?
answer7: Umphakathi uzothinteka kakhulu ngoba umthombo obalulekile wezakhamzimba uzolahleka
question8: Izinhlobo ze-keystone zihluke kanjani ezinhlotsheni zesisekelo?
answer8: Izinhlobo ze-Keystone zinomthelela omkhulu kakhulu emvelweni naphezu kokuthi azizona ngempela izinhlobo eziningi kakhulu
distractor8b: Izinhlobo zesisekelo zihlala ziyizilwane ezidla ezinye
distractor8c: Akukho mehluko wemvelo phakathi kwalezi zinto ezimbili

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Personality and Community Ecology | 36.6 I-Community Ecology | Izici Zemiphakathi | Izinhlobo Ezihlaselayo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Personality and Community Ecology | 36.6 I-Community Ecology | Izici Zemiphakathi | Izinhlobo Ezihlaselayo
chapterContent:
Izinhlobo ezihlaselayo ziyizinto eziphilayo ezingezona ezendabuko, lapho zilethwa endaweni engaphandle kwezindawo zazo zasekhaya, ezisongela ibhalansi ye-ecosystem yaleyo ndawo yokuhlala. Izinhlobo eziningi ezinjalo zikhona e-United States, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 36.32. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ujabulela ukuhamba ehlathini, ukuthatha uhambo lwesikebhe sasehlobo, noma ukuhamba nje emgwaqweni wasemadolobheni, kungenzeka ukuthi uke wahlangana nohlobo oluhlaselayo.

 Enye yezinhlobo eziningi zakamuva zohlobo oluhlaselayo iphathelene nokukhula kwenani lezinhlanzi zase-Asia. Izinhlanzi zase-Asia zethulwa e-United States ngawo-1970 yizindawo zokudoba nezindawo zokuhlanza indle ezazisebenzisa amakhono amahle kakhulu okuphakela izinhlanzi ukuhlanza amachibi azo izinhlanzi ezinamaqabunga amaningi. Nokho, ezinye zezinhlanzi zasinda, futhi ngawo-1980 zase zihlale emifuleni eminingi yaseMississippi River basin, okuhlanganisa i-Illinois neMissouri Rivers.

 Izinhlanzi ezidla kakhulu nezizala ngokushesha, izinhlanzi zase-Asia zingase zincintisane nezinhlobo zezilwane zasendaweni ngokudla, okungase kuholele ekuqothulweni kwazo. Isibonelo, i-black carp idla kakhulu i-mussels neminenke, okunciphisa lo mthombo wokudla wezinhlobo zezinhlanzi zasendaweni. I-Silver carp idla i-plankton edliwa yi-mussels neminenke zasendaweni, okunciphisa lo mthombo wokudla ngokushintsha okuhlukile kwewebhu yokudla. Kwezinye izindawo zoMfula iMississippi, izinhlobo ze-Asian carp ziye zaba yizona ezivame kakhulu, ezincintisana kahle nezinhlanzi zasendaweni ngendawo yokuhlala. Kwezinye izingxenye zoMfula i-Illinois, i-Asian carp yakha amaphesenti angama-95 e-biomass yomphakathi. Nakuba idliwa, le nhlanzi inamathambo futhi ayiyona ukudla okufunwayo e-United States. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuba khona kwayo kusongela izinhlanzi zasendaweni kanye nokudoba eGreat Lakes, okubalulekile emnothweni wendawo kanye nabadobi bezokuzilibazisa. I-Asian carp iye yalimaza ngisho nabantu. Izinhlanzi, zesatshiswa umsindo wezikebhe ezihamba ngezimoto ezisondelayo, ziziphonsa emoyeni, zivame ukufika esikebheni noma zishaye ngqo abagibeli bezikebhe.

 AmaGreat Lakes kanye nokudoba kwawo okuyigugu kwe-salmon kanye ne-lake trout nakho kusongelwa yilezi zinhlanzi ezihlaselayo. I-Asian carp isivele ihlale emifuleni nasemiseleni eholela eLake Michigan. Omunye umzila wamanzi ogcwele kakhulu yiChicago Sanitary and Ship Channel, umzila wamanzi omkhulu ohlanganisa amaGreat Lakes noMfula iMississippi. Ukuze kuvinjelwe i-Asian carp ukuthi ingaphumi emseleni, uchungechunge lwezithiyo zikagesi lusetshenziswe ngempumelelo ukuvimbela ukufuduka kwazo; nokho, usongo lubaluleke ngokwanele kangangokuthi izifundazwe eziningana neCanada ziye zafaka icala lokuthi umzila waseChicago unqunywe unomphela eLake Michigan. Osopolitiki bendawo kanye nabezwe lonke baye bacabangela indlela yokuxazulula le nkinga, kodwa akekho owaziyo ukuthi i-Asian carp ekugcineni izobhekwa njengenkathazo, njengezinye izinhlobo ezihlaselayo njenge-water hyacinth kanye ne-zebra mussel, noma ukuthi izoba ngumbhubhisi wezindawo zokudoba ezinkulu zamanzi ahlanzekile emhlabeni.

 Izinkinga ezihlobene ne-Asian carp zibonisa ukuthi i-population kanye ne-community ecology, ukuphathwa kwezinhlanzi, kanye nezombusazwe kuhlangana kanjani ezindabeni ezibaluleke kakhulu ekuhlinzekweni kokudla kwabantu kanye nomnotho. Izinkinga zenhlalo nezepolitiki ezinjengalezi zisebenzisa kakhulu isayensi ye-population ecology (ucwaningo lwamalungu ezinhlobo ezithile ezihlala endaweni ethile eyaziwa ngokuthi indawo yokuhlala) kanye ne-community ecology (ucwaningo lokuxhumana kwazo zonke izinhlobo ngaphakathi kwendawo yokuhlala)
question1: Luyini uhlobo oluhlaselayo?
answer1: Isidalwa esingeyona into yasendaweni esisongela ibhalansi yesimiso semvelo lapho sethulwa ngaphandle kobubanzi baso bemvelo
distractor1c: Uhlobo oluzuzisa yonke indawo olungena kuyo
question2: Kungani i-Asian carp yaqala ukungeniswa e-United States?
answer2: Ukusiza izindawo zokudoba kanye nezindawo zokuhlanza indle ukususa i-plankton eningi emachibini
distractor2b: Ukuhlinzeka ngokudla kwezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane
question3: Kungani izinhlanzi zase-Asia zikwazi ukuncintisana nezinhlobo eziningi zezinhlanzi zasendaweni?
answer3: Zizala ngokushesha futhi zidla ukudla okuningi
distractor3a: Zikhiqiza amakhemikhali anobuthi abulala izinhlanzi zasendaweni
distractor3b: Zizala kanye kuphela kodwa azinazo izilwane ezidla ezinye
question4: I-silver carp izithinta kanjani kabi izinhlobo zasemanzini zasemakhaya?
answer4: Zidla i-plankton ezithembele kuyo izimbaza neminenke yemvelo ukuze zidle
distractor4c: Zethula izimuncagazi ezithelela zonke izinhlobo zezinhlanzi
question5: Kungani i-Asian carp ibhekwa njengengozi kubantu kanye nasezindaweni zemvelo?
answer5: Bangagxuma emanzini uma bethuswa yizikebhe futhi balimaze abantu
distractor5a: Bahlasela ababhukudi ukuze bavikele izidleke zabo
question6: Iyiphi indlela esetshenzisiwe ukusiza ukuvimbela i-Asian carp ukuthi ingangeni eGreat Lakes?
answer6: Izithiyo zikagesi eChicago Sanitary and Ship Channel
distractor6c: Ukusebenzisa amanetha angaphansi kwamanzi ngaphesheya kweLake Michigan
question7: Kungani izinhlobo ezihlaselayo njenge-Asian carp ziyinkinga enkulu eNyakatho Melika?
answer7: Azizona izindawo zokuhlala zamanzi ahlanzekile eNyakatho Melika futhi azinazo izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane zemvelo ukuze zilawule inani lazo. Ngenxa yalokho, zizozalana ngokushesha nezinhlanzi zasendaweni ukuze zithole isikhala, ukudla, nezinye izinsiza.
distractor7a: Zikhipha amakhemikhali athile emanzini anobuthi ezitshalweni nasezilwaneni zasemanzini ahlanzekile eNyakatho Melika.
distractor7b: Zibulala izinhlanzi zemvelo ezihlala ezindaweni zokuhlala zamanzi ahlanzekile eNyakatho Melika ngokuthola ukudla kuzo. Lezi zinhlobo ezihlaselayo zizobe sezizala ngokushesha.
distractor7c: Banikeza ukudla nezinye izinsiza kubantu bendawo abaphila ezinhlanzini, okuholela ekwandeni ngokweqile kwabantu babo. Lokhu kunciphisa inani lomoya-mpilo oncibilikisiwe ezindaweni zokuhlala zamanzi ahlanzekile eNyakatho Melika.
question8: Kungani ukuhlasela okungenzeka kweGreat Lakes yi-Asian carp kuyinto ebalulekile ekhathazayo?
answer8: Kusongela izinhlanzi zasendaweni kanye nenye yezindawo zokudoba ezinkulu kakhulu emhlabeni wonke emanzini ahlanzekile
distractor8a: Izosusa zonke izitshalo zasemanzini eGreat Lakes
distractor8c: Kungandisa unomphela inani lezinhlanzi kuwo wonke amachibi
question9: Yimiphi imikhakha yesayensi ebaluleke kakhulu ekuqondeni nasekuphatheni inkinga ye-carp yase-Asia?
answer9: I-ecology yabantu kanye ne-ecology yomphakathi

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | Ukuguquguquka Komphakathi
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | Ukuguquguquka Komphakathi
chapterContent:
Izinguquko zomphakathi ziyizinguquko esakhiweni nasekwakhekeni komphakathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ngezinye izikhathi lezi zinguquko zibangelwa ukuphazamiseka kwemvelo njengezintaba-mlilo, ukuzamazama komhlaba, iziphepho, imililo, kanye nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu. Imiphakathi enesakhiwo esizinzile kuthiwa isesimweni sokulingana. Ngemva kokuphazamiseka, umphakathi ungase ubuyele esimweni sokulingana noma ungabuyeli esimweni sokulingana.

 Ukulandelana kuchaza ukubonakala okulandelanayo kanye nokunyamalala kwezinhlobo emphakathini ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ekulandeleni kokuqala, umhlaba osanda kuvezwa noma osanda kwakhiwa uhlanganiswa yizinto eziphilayo; ekulandeleni kwesibili, ingxenye yesimiso sezinto eziphilayo iyaphazanyiswa futhi izinsalela zomphakathi wangaphambilini zihlala
question1: Ziyini izindlela zomphakathi?
answer1: Izinguquko esakhiweni nasekubunjweni komphakathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor1c: Izinga lokudluliswa kwamandla phakathi kwamazinga e-trophic
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungabangela izinguquko esakhiweni nasekwakhekeni komphakathi?
answer2: Ukuphazamiseka kwemvelo okufana nezintaba-mlilo, ukuzamazama komhlaba, iziphepho, imililo, kanye nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu
distractor2a: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuphela ngaphakathi kohlobo olulodwa
question3: Kusho ukuthini ukuthi umphakathi usesimweni sokulingana?
answer3: Umphakathi unesakhiwo esizinzile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor3b: Azikho izinto eziphilayo ezizalwa noma ezifayo
question4: Yini engase yenzeke ngemva kokuba umphakathi ubhekene nokuphazamiseka?
answer4: Ingase ibuyele esimweni sayo sangaphambilini sokulingana noma ingabuyeli esimweni sayo sangaphambilini sokulingana
distractor4a: Ihlala ibuyela ngokushesha esimweni sayo sokuqala
question5: Kuyini ukulandelana kwemvelo?
answer5: Ukuvela okulandelanayo kanye nokunyamalala kwezinhlobo emphakathini ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor5a: Ukuhamba kwezinto eziphilayo phakathi kwezindawo zemvelo
question6: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokulandelana kokuqala?
answer6: Izinto eziphilayo zihlala ezweni elisanda kuvezwa noma elisha
distractor6a: Ihlathi elikhona liyalulama ngemva komlilo wasendle
distractor6b: Izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane ezidla uhlaza zithatha indawo yezilwane ezidla uhlaza endaweni yokudla
question7: Yini ehlukanisa ukulandelana kwesibili nokulandelana kokuqala?
answer7: Ukulandelana kwesibili kwenzeka ngemva kokuphazamiseka lapho izinsalela zomphakathi wangaphambilini zihlala khona
distractor7a: Ukulandelana kwesibili kuqala edwaleni lentaba-mlilo elisanda kwakheka elingenanhlabathi
distractor7b: Ukulandelana kwesibili kwenzeka kancane kakhulu kunokulandelana okuyinhloko.
distractor7c: Ukulandelana kwesibili kungenzeka kuphela ezindaweni zemvelo zasemanzini

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Population and Community Ecology | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | Ukuguquguquka Komphakathi | Ukulandelana Okuyinhloko kanye Nezinhlobo Eziphambili
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Population and Community Ecology | 36.6 I-Ecology Yomphakathi | Ukuguquguquka Komphakathi | Ukulandelana Okuyinhloko kanye Nezinhlobo Eziphambili
chapterContent: Ukulandelana okuyinhloko kwenzeka lapho kwakheka umhlaba omusha noma itshe livezwa: isibonelo, ngemva kokuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo, njengalezo eziseSiqhingini Esikhulu saseHawaii. Njengoba i-lava igeleza olwandle, kwakheka umhlaba omusha njalo. EsiQhingini Esikhulu, kungezwa cishe amahektha angu-32 omhlaba minyaka yonke. Okokuqala, isimo sezulu kanye namanye amandla emvelo aphula isisekelo esanele sokusungulwa kwezitshalo ezithile eziqinile kanye nama-lichen anezidingo ezimbalwa zenhlabathi, ezaziwa ngokuthi izinhlobo zama-pioneer (Isithombe 36.33). Lezi zinhlobo zisiza ekuhlukaniseni i-lava ecebile ngamaminerali ibe yinhlabathi lapho ezinye izinhlobo, ezingaqinile kangako zizokhula khona futhi ekugcineni zithathe indawo yezinhlobo zama-pioneer. Ngaphezu kwalokho, njengoba lezi zinhlobo zokuqala zikhula futhi zifa, zengeza ungqimba olukhula njalo lwezinto eziphilayo ezibolayo futhi zinegalelo ekwakhekeni kwenhlabathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi indawo izofinyelela isimo sokulingana, ngesethi yezinto eziphilayo ezihluke kakhulu kohlobo lwama-pioneer.
question1: Kuyini ukulandelana okuyinhloko?
answer1: Ukusungulwa komphakathi wezinto eziphilayo endaweni esanda kwakhiwa noma esanda kuvezwa lapho kungekho khona umphakathi wangaphambilini
distractor1b: Ukufakwa esikhundleni kwesinye isilwane esidla ezinye
distractor1c: Ukufuduka kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ngezikhathi ezithile kuya endaweni yokuhlala
question2: Yisiphi isenzakalo esivame ukuqala ukulandelana okuyinhloko?
answer2: Ukuqhuma kwentaba-mlilo okudala umhlaba omusha
question3: Yiziphi izinhlobo zamaphayona?
answer3: Izinto eziphilayo zokuqala eziqinile ukuhlala ezweni elisanda kuvezwa elinomhlaba omncane noma elingenawo nhlobo umhlabathi
distractor3b: Izilwane ezinkulu ezidla ezinye ezibusa imiphakathi yabantu abadala
question4: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.33. Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo eziyizinhlobo ezivamile zamaphayona?
answer4: Izitshalo eziqinile neziqinile ezinezidingo ezimbalwa zenhlabathi
question5: Izinhlobo zezilwane ezisanda kuqala zinegalelo kanjani ekuthuthukisweni kwemvelo?
answer5: Zisiza ekudilizeni amadwala futhi ziqale inqubo yokwakheka kwenhlabathi
distractor5b: Zivimbela ezinye izinhlobo ukuthi zingahlali ndawonye unomphela
question6: Ukufa kwezinhlobo zamaphayona kusiza kanjani ukulandelana?
answer6: Izinto eziphilayo ezibolayo zinegalelo ekwakhekeni kwenhlabathi
question7: Kwenzekani ekugcineni ezinhlotsheni ze-pioneer ngesikhathi sokulandelana kokuqala?
answer7: Kancane kancane zithathelwa indawo ezinye izinhlobo njengoba umphakathi uthuthuka
question8: Uyini umphumela wesikhathi eside wokulandelana okuyinhloko?
answer8: Umphakathi ufinyelela ukulingana okuzinzile nezinhlobo ezihlukile kohlobo lwezingqalabutho

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Personality and Community Ecology | 36.6 I-Community Ecology | Ukuguquguquka Komphakathi | Ukulandelana Kwesibili
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Personality and Community Ecology | 36.6 I-Community Ecology | Ukuguquguquka Komphakathi | Ukulandelana Kwesibili
chapterContent:
Isibonelo esivamile sokulandelana kwesibili senzeka emahlathini e-oki kanye ne-hickory asuswe umlilo wasendle (Isithombe 36.34). Imililo yasendle izoshisa izitshalo eziningi futhi ibulale lezo zilwane ezingakwazi ukubaleka endaweni. Kodwa-ke, izakhamzimba zazo zibuyiselwa emhlabathini ngesimo somlotha. Ngakho-ke, ngisho nalapho izindawo zingenazo izinto eziphilayo ngenxa yemililo enamandla, indawo izobe isilungele impilo entsha.

 Ngaphambi komlilo, izitshalo zazibuswa yizihlahla ezinde ezinokufinyelela emthonjeni omkhulu wamandla ezitshalo: ukukhanya kwelanga. Ukuphakama kwazo kwakunikeza ukufinyelela elangeni ngenkathi futhi kufihla umhlabathi nezinye izinhlobo eziphansi. Nokho, ngemva komlilo, lezi zihlahla azisakwazi ukubusa. Ngakho-ke, izitshalo zokuqala ezikhula kabusha ngokuvamile ziyizitshalo zonyaka ezilandelwa eminyakeni embalwa ngokukhula nokusabalalisa utshani ngokushesha kanye nezinye izinhlobo zokuqala. Ngenxa, okungenani ngokwengxenye, izinguquko endaweni ezungezile ezilethwa ukukhula kotshani nezinye izinhlobo, eminyakeni eminingi, izihlahla zizovela kanye nezihlahla ezincane zephayini, i-oki, kanye ne-hickory. Lezi zinhlobo eziphilayo zibizwa ngokuthi izinhlobo eziphakathi. Ekugcineni, eminyakeni engaphezu kwengu-150, ihlathi lizofinyelela iphuzu lalo lokulingana lapho ukwakheka kwezinhlobo zezilwane kungasashintshi futhi kufane nomphakathi ngaphambi komlilo. Lesi simo sokulingana sibizwa ngokuthi umphakathi ophelele, ozohlala uzinzile kuze kube yilapho kuvela ukuphazamiseka okulandelayo.
question1: Kuyini ukulandelana kwesibili?
answer1: Ukwakhiwa kabusha komphakathi wezinto eziphilayo ngemva kokuphazamiseka lapho inhlabathi nezinsalela zomphakathi wangaphambilini zihlala khona
distractor1a: Ukwakhiwa kabusha komhlaba osanda kwakhiwa ngaphandle kwenhlabathi
distractor1b: Ukufakwa esikhundleni kwesinye isilwane esidla ezinye
distractor1c: Ukufuduka kwezinhlobo zezilwane ziye emvelweni omusha
question2: Yisiphi isibonelo esivamile sokulandelana kwesibili?
answer2: Ukubuyiselwa kwehlathi le-oki ne-hickory ngemuva komlilo wasendle
question3: Kungani ukulandelana kwesibili kungaqala ngokushesha ngemva komlilo wehlathi?
answer3: Izakhamzimba zihlala enhlabathini njengomlotha, okuvumela izitshalo ezintsha ukuthi zikhule
distractor3a: Imililo yasendle idala inhlabathi entsha nge-lava
question4: Bheka Umfanekiso 36.34. Yiziphi izitshalo ezivame ukuvela kuqala ngemva komlilo wasendle ngesikhathi sokulandelana kwesibili?
answer4: Izitshalo zonyaka zilandelwa utshani nezinye izinhlobo ze-pioneer
question5: Yiziphi izinhlobo eziphakathi ngesikhathi sokulandelana kwesibili?
answer5: Izihlahla ezincane zephayini, i-oki, kanye nezihlahla ze-hickory ezikhula ngemuva kwezinhlobo zamaphayona
distractor5c: Izilwane ezinkulu ezidla ezinye ezifika ngemva kokulandelana kwazo seziphelele
question6: Kungani izitshalo notshani bonyaka bukhula ngaphambi kwezihlahla ezinkulu ngemva komlilo?
answer6: Ukulahlekelwa yikhava yehlathi kuvumela ukukhanya kwelanga okuningi ukuba kufike phansi
distractor6b: Utshani budinga umthunzi ophelele ukuze bukhule
distractor6c: Umlilo ususa zonke izakhamzimba ezidingwa yizihlahla
question7: Uyini umphakathi osezingeni eliphezulu?
answer7: Umphakathi ozinzile okwakheka kwawo kwezinhlobo zezilwane kungashintsha kancane kakhulu kuze kube yilapho kuvela okunye ukuphazamiseka
distractor7a: Iqembu lokuqala lezinto eziphilayo elahlala edwaleni elingenalutho
question8: Kwenzekani ekugcineni ngesikhathi sokulandelana kwesibili ehlathini le-oki ne-hickory?
answer8: Ihlathi libuyela kancane kancane emphakathini ozinzile ofana nalowo owawukhona ngaphambi komlilo

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ukuziphatha kuwukushintsha komsebenzi wento ephilayo ngenxa yesikhuthazo. Ukuziphatha okungokwemvelo kunezakhi zofuzo ezinamandla futhi kuzimele kakhulu emathonyeni emvelo. Ngamanye amazwi, lokhu kuziphatha okungokwemvelo kuxhunyiwe ngokuqinile. Izibonelo zokuziphatha okungokwemvelo zifaka phakathi ingane yomuntu ebamba umunwe kanina kanye ne-stork esebenzisa umlomo wayo omude ukuze idle. Ukuziphatha okufundiwe kuvela ekulungiseni indawo futhi kuguqulwa ukufunda. Isibonelo, kungenzeka ukuthi usufundile manje ukuthi ukufunda lezi zixhumanisi ze-AP® kukusiza ukuthi ugaye ulwazi nokuthi ukufundela isivivinyo kuthuthukisa amamaki akho.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 kanye no-Big Idea 3 wohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Inhloso Yokufunda ye-AP® ebhalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu inikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nenye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.C
Izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa izindlela zokuphendula ukulawula ukukhula nokuzala, kanye nokugcina i-dynamic homeostasis.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.C.2 Izinto eziphilayo zisabela ezinguqukweni ezindaweni zazo zangaphandle.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo nezibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.13 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela imiphumela yoshintsho kubantu bomphakathi emphakathini.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.E
Izinqubo eziningi zezinto eziphilayo ezihilelekile ekukhuleni, ekuzaleni nasekuhlanganiseni i-dynamic homeostasis zifaka phakathi ukulawulwa kwesikhathi kanye nokuxhumanisa.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.E.3 Isikhathi kanye nokuxhumanisa ukuziphatha kulawulwa izindlela ezahlukene futhi kubalulekile ekukhetheni kwemvelo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
4.1 Umfundi angathethelela ukukhethwa kohlobo lwedatha edingekayo ukuphendula umbuzo othile wesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.21 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuthethelela ukukhethwa kohlobo lwedatha edingekayo ukuphendula imibuzo yesayensi mayelana nendlela efanele esetshenziswa izinto eziphilayo ukuphendula izinguquko endaweni yazo yangaphandle.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.E.3 Isikhathi kanye nokuxhumanisa ukuziphatha kulawulwa izindlela ezahlukene futhi kubalulekile ekukhetheni kwemvelo.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
5.1 Umfundi angahlaziya idatha ukuze abone amaphethini noma ubudlelwano.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.38 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuhlaziya idatha ukuze asekele isimangalo sokuthi izimpendulo olwazini kanye nokuxhumana kolwazi zithinta ukukhetha kwemvelo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.E.3 Isikhathi kanye nokuxhumanisa ukuziphatha kulawulwa izindlela ezahlukene futhi kubalulekile ekukhetheni kwemvelo.
Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.1 Umfundi angathethelela izimangalo ngobufakazi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.39 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusekela izimangalo zesayensi, esebenzisa ubufakazi, ukuchaza ukuthi isikhathi kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwezehlakalo zokuziphatha ezintweni eziphilayo kulawulwa kanjani izindlela eziningana.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.E.3 Isikhathi kanye nokuhlanganiswa kokuziphatha kulawulwa izindlela ezahlukene futhi kubalulekile ekukhetheni kwemvelo.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
7.2 Umfundi angaxhumanisa imiqondo ezizindeni nakuzo zonke izindawo ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuqhubekayo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.40 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuxhumanisa imiqondo ezizindeni nakuzo zonke izindawo ukuze abikezele ukuthi izici zemvelo zithinta kanjani impendulo yolwazi kanye nokushintsha kokuziphatha.

 Inhloso Enkulu 3
Izinhlelo eziphilayo zigcina, zithole, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.E
Ukudluliswa kolwazi kuphumela ezinguqukweni ngaphakathi naphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.E.1 Abantu bangenza ngolwazi futhi baludlulisele kwabanye.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
5.1 Umfundi angahlaziya idatha ukuze abone amaphethini noma ubudlelwano.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.40 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuhlaziya idatha ekhombisa indlela izinto eziphilayo ezishintshana ngayo ngolwazi ngokuphendula izinguquko zangaphakathi kanye nezinkomba zangaphandle, nokuthi yiziphi ezingashintsha ukuziphatha.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.E.1 Abantu bangenza ngolwazi futhi baludlulisele kwabanye.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.1 Umfundi angadala izethulo kanye namamodeli ezehlakalo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu kanye nezinhlelo endaweni.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.41 Umfundi uyakwazi ukudala isethulo esichaza indlela Izinto eziphilayo zishintshana ngolwazi ngokuphendula izinguquko zangaphakathi kanye nezinkomba zangaphandle, futhi okungaholela ekushintsheni kokuziphatha.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.E.1 Abantu bangenza okuthile ngolwazi futhi baludlulisele kwabanye.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
7.1 Umfundi angaxhumanisa izimo namamodeli kuzo zonke izikali zendawo nezesikhathi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.42 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zishintshana kanjani ngolwazi ngokuphendula izinguquko zangaphakathi noma izinkomba zemvelo.

 Ibhayoloji yokuziphatha iwukufunda izisekelo zezinto eziphilayo kanye nokuziphendukela kwemvelo zezinguquko ezinjalo. Umqondo wokuthi ukuziphatha kwavela ngenxa yezingcindezi zokukhetha kwemvelo awumusha. Ukuziphatha kwezilwane kuye kwafundwa amashumi eminyaka, ngososayensi bezinto eziphilayo kwisayensi ye-ethology, ngososayensi bezengqondo kwisayensi ye-psychology yokuqhathanisa, kanye nososayensi bemikhakha eminingi esifundweni se-neurobiology. Nakuba kukhona ukufana phakathi kwale mikhakha, ososayensi kulezi zindawo zokuziphatha bathatha izindlela ezahlukene. I-psychology yokuqhathanisa isandiso somsebenzi owenziwe kubantu kanye i-psychology yokuziphatha. I-Ethology iyisandiso sezakhi zofuzo, ukuziphendukela kwemvelo, i-anatomy, i-physiology, kanye neminye imikhakha yezinto eziphilayo. Noma kunjalo, umuntu akanakufunda i-biology yokuziphatha ngaphandle kokuthinta kokubili i-psychology yokuqhathanisa kanye ne-ethology.

 Umgomo owodwa we-biology yokuziphatha ukuhlukanisa ukuziphatha okungokwemvelo, okunengxenye enamandla yezakhi zofuzo futhi okuzimele kakhulu emathonyeni emvelo, ekuziphatheni okufundiwe, okuvela ekulungiseni kwemvelo. Ukuziphatha okungokwemvelo, noma imvelo, kubalulekile ngoba akukho bungozi bokuthi ukuziphatha okungalungile kufundwe. Kuxhumene ngokuqinile” ohlelweni. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuziphatha okufundiwe, nakuba kuyingozi, kuyaguquguquka, kuyashintshashintsha, futhi kungashintshwa ngokuya ngezinguquko endaweni ezungezile
question1: Kuyini ukuziphatha?
answer1: Ushintsho emsebenzini wezinto eziphilayo ngenxa yesenzo esishukumisayo
question2: Yini echaza ukuziphatha okungokwemvelo?
answer2: Inesisekelo esiqinile sezakhi zofuzo futhi ayizimele kakhulu emithonyeni yemvelo
question3: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sokuziphatha okungokwemvelo?
answer3: Umntwana womuntu ubamba umunwe kanina
question4: Yini echaza ukuziphatha okufundiwe?
answer4: Kuvela ekulungiseni imvelo kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho
question5: Iyini inzuzo eyinhloko yokuziphatha okungokwemvelo?
answer5: Zinciphisa ingozi yokufunda impendulo engalungile
distractor5a: Bahlala beguquguquka kakhulu kunezindlela zokuziphatha ezifundiwe
question6: Iyini inzuzo eyinhloko yokuziphatha okufundiwe?
answer6: Ziyakwazi ukuguquguquka futhi zingashintshwa njengoba izimo zemvelo zishintsha
question7: Iyini i-biology yokuziphatha?
answer7: Ucwaningo lwesisekelo sokuziphatha sezinto eziphilayo kanye nokuziphendukela kwemvelo
question8: I-ethology ihluke kanjani kwi-psychology yokuqhathanisa?
answer8: I-Ethology igcizelela izindlela zebhayoloji kanye nezokuziphendukela kwemvelo, kanti i-psychology yokuqhathanisa yathuthukiswa kusuka kwi-psychology yokuziphatha
distractor8a: I-Ethology ifunda ngabantu kuphela, kuyilapho i-psychology yokuqhathanisa ifunda izinambuzane kuphela
question9: Kungani kubalulekile ukuhlukanisa phakathi kokuziphatha okungokwemvelo nokwemfundo?
answer9: Ngoba ukuziphatha okungokwemvelo kuhlelwe ngokwezakhi zofuzo kanti ukuziphatha okufundiwe kuvela kokuhlangenwe nakho kwemvelo
distractor9a: Ngoba ukuziphatha okufundiwe kuzuzwe njengefa ngokwezakhi zofuzo
distractor9b: Ngoba ukuziphatha okungokwemvelo akukwazi ukuthonya ukusinda
distractor9c: Ngoba ukuziphatha okufundiwe kuphela okuthintwa ukukhetha kwemvelo

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Kwangaphakathi: Ukunyakaza Nokufuduka
chapterContent: Ukuziphatha okungokwemvelo noma okungokwemvelo kuncike ekuphenduleni ezintweni ezishukumisayo. Isibonelo esilula salokhu isenzo esivuselelayo, impendulo engazikhetheli futhi esheshayo ekushukumiseni. Ukuze avivinye i-reflex yedolo, udokotela uthinta i-tendon ye-patellar ngaphansi kwe-kneecap ngesando senjoloba. Ukushukunyiswa kwemizwa lapho kuholela ekushukumiseni kokwelula umlenze edolweni. Lokhu kufana nokusabela komuntu othinta isitofu esishisayo bese edonsa isandla sakhe ngokwemvelo. Ngisho nabantu, abanekhono lethu elikhulu lokufunda, basabonisa ukuziphatha okuhlukahlukene okungokwemvelo.
question1: Yiziphi izindlela zokuziphatha ezingokwemvelo ezisekelwe kuzo ngokuyinhloko?
answer1: Izimpendulo ezisuselweni ezithile ezihlelwe ngokwezakhi zofuzo
distractor1c: Ukuxhumana komphakathi namanye amalungu alolu hlobo
question2: Iyini isenzo sokuzivumelanisa nezimo?
answer2: Impendulo engahleliwe futhi esheshayo ku-stimulus
question3: Yisiphi isakhiwo udokotela asithintayo ukuze ahlole i-reflex ye-knee-jerk?
answer3: I-tendon ye-patellar ngaphansi kwe-kneecap
question4: Yimuphi ukusabela okutholakalayo ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa kwe-reflex ye-knee-jerk?
answer4: Umlenze unwebeka ngokuzenzakalelayo edolweni
question5: Yisiphi isibonelo salokhu okulandelayo esingesinye sezibonelo zokwakheka kwengqondo okungokwemvelo?
answer5: Susa isandla sakho ngokushesha ngemva kokuthinta isitofu esishisayo
question6: Kungani ukukhipha isandla sakho esitofini esishisayo kubhekwa njengokuziphatha okungokwemvelo?
answer6: Kuyimpendulo ezenzakalelayo engadingi ukufunda okuqondile
question7: Kubonisani ukuba khona kwe-reflexes kubantu?
answer7: Abantu bagcina imikhuba eminingi yemvelo naphezu kokuba nekhono elikhulu lokufunda
distractor7c: Ukufunda kuthatha indawo yazo zonke izindlela zokuziphatha ezingokwemvelo

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Kwangaphakathi: Ukunyakaza Nokufuduka | Ama-Kinesis Namatekisi
chapterContent:
Omunye umsebenzi noma ukunyakaza kokuziphatha okungokwemvelo yi-kinesis, noma ukunyakaza okungaqondiswanga ekuphenduleni isikhuthazo. I-Orthokinesis ijubane elandayo noma elinciphile lokunyakaza kwesidalwa ngenxa yesikhuthazo. Isibonelo, i-Woodlice ikhulisa ijubane layo lokunyakaza lapho ivezwa emazingeni okushisa aphezulu noma aphansi. Lokhu kunyakaza, nakuba kungahleliwe, kwandisa amathuba okuthi isinambuzane sichithe isikhathi esincane endaweni engathandeki. Esinye isibonelo yi-klinokinesis, ukwanda kokuziphatha okuphendukayo. Kuboniswa amabhaktheriya anjenge-E. coli, ahambisana ne-orthokinesis, asiza izinto eziphilayo ngokungahleliwe ukuthola indawo enomoya wokungenisa izihambi.

 Inguqulo efanayo, kodwa eqondiswe kakhulu ye-kinesis amatekisi: ukunyakaza okuqondiswe kuya noma kude nesikhuthazo. Lokhu kunyakaza kungaba ukuphendula ekukhanyeni (i-phototaxis), izimpawu zamakhemikhali (i-chemotaxis), noma amandla adonsela phansi (i-geotaxis) futhi kungaqondiswa (okuhle) noma kude (okubi) emthonjeni wesikhuthazo. Isibonelo se-chemotaxis enhle siboniswa yi-protozoan Tetrahymena thermophila. Lesi sidalwa sibhukuda sisebenzisa i-cilia yaso, ngezinye izikhathi sihamba ngendlela eqondile, kanti ngezinye izikhathi sijikajika. I-ejenti ye-chemotactic ekhangayo ishintsha imvamisa yokujika njengoba isidalwa sihamba ngqo emthonjeni, kulandela ukwanda kwe-gradient yokuhlushwa.
question1: Kuyini i-kinesis?
answer1: Ukunyakaza okungaqondiswanga ukuphendula isikhuthazo
question2: Kuyini i-orthokinesis?
answer2: Ushintsho esivinini sokunyakaza ngenxa yesenzo esishukumisayo
distractor2c: Ukusuka kuzo zonke izinto ezibangela imvelo
question3: Kungani i-woodlice ikhulisa ijubane layo lokunyakaza emazingeni okushisa angemahle?
answer3: Ukunciphisa isikhathi esichithwa endaweni engeyinhle
question4: Kuyini i-klinokinesis?
answer4: Ukwanda kokuziphatha okuphendukayo ngenxa yesikhuthazo
question5: Ibhaktheriya ye-Escherichia coli iyisebenzisa kanjani i-klinokinesis kanye ne-orthokinesis?
answer5: Bafuna indawo efanelekile ngokungahleliwe
distractor5c: Zihlala zimile kuze kube yilapho izimo zithuthuka
question6: Amatekisi ahluke kanjani kuma-kinesis?
answer6: Amatekisi aqondiswa ukunyakaza kuya noma kude ne-stimulus, kanti i-kinesis iwukunyakaza okungaqondiswanga
distractor6a: Amatekisi ayindlela yokunyakaza engahleliwe, kanti i-kinesis iyindlela yokunyakaza eqondiswayo
distractor6b: Amatekisi atholakala kuphela ezilwaneni ezinethambo lomgogodla
question7: Kuyini i-chemotaxis enhle?
answer7: Ukuya emthonjeni wesikhuthazo samakhemikhali
question8: Yisiphi isidalwa esichazwa njengesibonisa i-chemotaxis enhle ngokulandela ukwanda kwesilinganiso samakhemikhali?
answer8: I-Tetrahymena thermophila
