chapterContent: Iphethini yesenzo esiqinile uchungechunge lokunyakaza okubangelwa yisikhuthazo kangangokuthi ngisho nalapho isikhuthazo sisusiwe, iphethini iyaqhubeka kuze kube sekupheleni. Isibonelo sokuziphatha okunjalo senzeka ku-stickleback enemigqa emithathu, inhlanzi encane yasemanzini ahlanzekile (Isithombe 36.35). Abesilisa balolu hlobo bakha isisu esibomvu ngesikhathi sokuzala futhi babonisa ulaka olungokwemvelo kwamanye abesilisa phakathi nalesi sikhathi. Ekuhlolweni kwelabhorethri, abacwaningi baveza izinhlanzi ezinjalo ezintweni ezingafani nhlobo nenhlanzi ngesimo sazo, kodwa ezazipendwe ngombala obomvu ezingxeni zazo ezingezansi. Abesilisa aba-stickleback basabela ngolaka ezintweni njengokungathi bangama-stickleback angempela abesilisa.
question1: Iyini iphethini yesenzo esiqinile?
answer1: Uchungechunge lwezenzo ezibangelwa yisikhuthazo esiqhubeka nokuqedwa noma ngabe isikhuthazo sisusiwe
distractor1c: Ukuziphatha okuma ngokushesha lapho isisusa sinyamalala
question2: Yisiphi isidalwa esisetshenziswa njengesibonelo sephethini yesenzo esiqinile kulesi sigaba?
answer2: I-stickleback enezinsika ezintathu
question3: Yiluphi ushintsho olubonakalayo oluvela ezinsikazini zesilisa ezinezinhluthu ezinezinhluthu ngesikhathi sokuzala?
answer3: Bakha isisu esibomvu
question4: Ama-stickleback amaduna anezipini ezintathu avame ukusabela kanjani kwamanye amaduna ngesikhathi sokuzala?
answer4: Babonisa ukuziphatha okunolaka ngokwemvelo
question5: Yini eyabangela ukuziphatha okunolaka ekuhlolweni kwelabhorethri ngama-stickleback abesilisa?
answer5: Izinto ezipendwe ngombala obomvu ezingxeni zazo ezingezansi
distractor5a: Izinto ezibunjwe ngendlela efana ncamashi nama-stickleback
distractor5c: Izinto ezihambayo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zinombala onjani
question6: Yini eyaboniswa yizilingo ze-stickleback mayelana nesisusa sobudlova?
answer6: Umbala obomvu wawanele ukuqala iphethini yesenzo esinqunyiwe
distractor6a: Ukuma komzimba wenye inhlanzi kuphela okwabangela ulaka
question7: Kungani amaphethini esenzo aqinile ebhekwa njengokuziphatha okungokwemvelo?
answer7: Zihlelwe ngokwezakhi zofuzo futhi zibangelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo yizinto ezithile ezishukumisayo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Kwangaphakathi: Ukunyakaza Nokufuduka | Ukufuduka
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Kwangaphakathi: Ukunyakaza Nokufuduka | Ukufuduka
chapterContent:
Ukufuduka kuwukuhamba kwezilwane isikhathi eside ngezikhathi ezithile. Kuyimpendulo eguquliwe, eguquliwe ekushintsheni kokutholakala kwezinsiza, futhi kuyinto evamile etholakala kuwo wonke amaqembu amakhulu ezilwane. Izinyoni zindiza ziye eningizimu ebusika ukuze zifike ezindaweni ezifudumele zinokudla okwanele, kanti i-salmon iya ezindaweni zayo zokuzalela. Idokhumentari edumile ka-2005 ethi March of the Penguins ilandele ukufuduka kwama-emperor penguin amamayela angu-62 edlula e-Antarctica ukuze abuyisele ukudla endaweni yawo yokuzalela kanye nakumaphuphu awo. Ama-Wildebeest (Isithombe 36.36) ahamba amakhilomitha angaphezu kuka-1800 minyaka yonke efuna izindawo ezintsha zotshani.

 Nakuba ukufuduka kubhekwa njengokuziphatha okuzalwa nakho, ezinye izinhlobo ezifudukayo kuphela ezihlala zifuduka (ukufuduka okuphoqelekile). Izilwane ezibonisa ukufuduka okuqondiswe ku-facultative zingakhetha ukufuduka noma cha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kwezinye izilwane, ingxenye kuphela yabantu iyafuduka, kanti ezinye azifuduki (ukufuduka okungaphelele). Isibonelo, izikhova ezihlala e-tundra zingafuduka eminyakeni lapho umthombo wazo wokudla, amagundane amancane, unqabile, kodwa azifuduki phakathi neminyaka lapho amagundane eningi khona.
question1: Kuyini ukufuduka?
answer1: Ukuhamba kwezilwane ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka ngenxa yokushintsha kokutholakala kwezinsiza
distractor1a: Ukuhamba kwezilwane nsuku zonke endaweni ethile
question2: Kungani izinyoni eziningi zithuthela eningizimu ebusika?
answer2: Ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezifudumele ngokudla okwanele
question3: Kungani i-salmon ifuduka?
answer3: Ukuze bafinyelele izindawo zabo zokuzala
distractor3a: Ukuze ubalekele izilwane ezidla ezinye emanzini ahlanzekile
question4: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.36. Cishe zifuduka ibanga elingakanani izingwenya minyaka yonke?
answer4: Amamayela angaphezu kuka-1,800
question5: Kuyini ukufuduka okuphoqelekile?
answer5: Ukufuduka lapho abantu behlala befuduka khona
distractor5b: Ukufuduka lapho kungekho muntu ofudukayo khona
question6: Kuyini ukufuduka kwabafundisi?
answer6: Ukufuduka lapho izilwane zingakhetha khona ukuthi ziyafuduka yini kuye ngezimo
distractor6a: Ukufuduka okwenzeka minyaka yonke ngaphandle kokukhetha
question7: Kuyini ukufuduka okungaphelele?
answer7: Iphethini lapho ingxenye kuphela yabantu ifuduka khona kuyilapho abanye besala
question8: Kungani izikhova ze-tundra zingase zifuduke eminyakeni ethile kodwa zingafuduki kwezinye?
answer8: Ziyafuduka lapho ukudla kwazo kwegundane kuntula futhi zihlala lapho ukudla kuningi
distractor8a: Ziyafuduka kuphela uma amazinga okushisa enyuka
distractor8b: Zifuduka kuphela ngesikhathi sokuzalana kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ukudla kuyatholakala yini
distractor8c: Bayafuduka ngoba amahora okukhanya kwemini awashintshi

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Kwangaphakathi: Ukunyakaza Nokufuduka | Ukufuna Ukudla
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Kwangaphakathi: Ukunyakaza Nokufuduka | Ukufuna Ukudla
chapterContent: Ukuzifunela ukudla kuyisenzo sokufuna nokusebenzisa izinsiza zokudla. Izindlela zokudla ezikhulisa inzuzo yamandla futhi zinciphise ukusetshenziswa kwamandla zibizwa ngokuthi izindlela ezinhle kakhulu zokuzifunela ukudla, futhi lezi zithandwa ukukhethwa kwemvelo. I-stork edwetshwe ngopende, isibonelo, isebenzisa umlomo wayo omude ukusesha phansi kwexhaphozi lamanzi ahlanzekile ukuze ithole izinkalankala nokunye ukudla (Isithombe 36.37)
question1: Kuyini ukufuya ukudla?
answer1: Isenzo sokusesha nokusebenzisa kabi izinsiza zokudla
distractor1a: Ukuhamba kwezilwane ngezikhathi ezithile phakathi kwezindawo zokuhlala
question2: Yiziphi izindlela ezinhle kakhulu zokudla?
answer2: Izindlela zokudla ezikhulisa amandla atholwe ngenkathi zinciphisa amandla asetshenziswayo
distractor2a: Izindlela zokudla ezikhulisa ukunyakaza kungakhathaliseki ukuthi izindleko zamandla zingakanani
distractor2c: Ukuziphatha okugxila kuphela ekugwemeni izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane
question3: Kungani izindlela ezinhle kakhulu zokudla zithandwa yi-natural selection?
answer3: Zithuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kwezinto eziphilayo ekutholeni amandla
distractor3c: Ziqinisekisa impumelelo yokuzala kuzo zonke izizukulwane
question4: Iyiphi inyoni echazwa njengesibonelo sokuziphatha okuhle kakhulu kokuzifunela ukudla?
answer4: I-stork edwetshwe ngopende
question5: I-stork edwetshiwe ikuthola kanjani ukudla kwayo?
answer5: Isebenzisa umlomo wayo omude ukusesha phansi kwamachibi amanzi ahlanzekile
question6: Hlobo luni lwesilwane esidliwayo ugolantethe odwetshiwe avame ukusifuna?
answer6: Izinkalankala nokunye ukudla okutholakala phansi kwamachibi amanzi ahlanzekile
question7: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko yokufuna ukudla okungcono kakhulu?
answer7: Ukuthola imbuyiselo enkulu kakhulu yamandla ngokusetshenziswa kwamandla okuncane kakhulu
distractor7b: Ukuze kugwenywe konke ukuxhumana nezinye izinhlobo
distractor7c: Ukudla ukudla okunhlobonhlobo okukhulu kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kubiza malini amandla

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Kwangaphakathi: Ukuhlala Ngamaqembu
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Kwangaphakathi: Ukuhlala Ngamaqembu
chapterContent: Akuzona zonke izilwane ezihlala ngamaqembu, kodwa ngisho nalezo eziphila impilo yazo zodwa, ngaphandle kwalezo ezingazalana ngaphandle kocansi, kumele zihlangane. Ukuhlangana ngokuvamile kuhilela isilwane esisodwa esibonisa esinye isifiso sokuhlangana. Kunezinhlobo eziningana zokuziphatha okudinga amandla noma izibonakaliso ezihambisana nokuhlangana, okubizwa ngokuthi amasiko okuhlangana. Ezinye izindlela zokuziphatha ezitholakala ezixukwini ezihlala ngamaqembu zichazwa ngokuthi yiziphi izilwane ezizuzayo kulokhu kuziphatha. Ekuziphatheni kobugovu, yisilwane kuphela esizuzayo; ekuziphatheni kobugovu, izenzo zesilwane esisodwa zizuzisa esinye isilwane; ukuziphatha kokubambisana kuchaza ukuthi zombili izilwane zizuza nini. Zonke lezi zindlela zokuziphatha zihilela uhlobo oluthile lokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi
question1: Kungani izilwane eziningi eziphila zodwa kumele zisasebenzisane nezinye izinhlobo zazo?
answer1: Kumelwe bathole abangane ukuze bazalane ngokocansi
distractor1a: Kumelwe babambisane ukuze bathole konke ukudla kwabo
distractor1b: Kumelwe bahlale behlala emaqenjini omphakathi ahlala njalo
question2: Iyini inhloso yezibonakaliso zokuhlangana?
answer2: Ukudlulisela isifiso somshado komunye umuntu
distractor2a: Ukuxwayisa izilwane ezidla ezinye ukuba zingabi khona
question3: Iyini imikhuba yokuhlangana?
answer3: Ukuziphatha noma izibonakaliso ezisebenzisa amandla amaningi ezihambisana nokuhlangana
question4: Kuyini ukuziphatha kobugovu?
answer4: Ukuziphatha lapho umuntu owenza isenzo kuphela ezuza khona
distractor4b: Ukuziphatha okuzuzisa omunye umuntu ngenkathi kuzilimaza
distractor4c: Ukuziphatha okungenawo umphumela kunoma yisiphi isidalwa
question5: Kuyini ukuziphatha kobuzwela?
answer5: Ukuziphatha lapho izenzo zomuntu oyedwa zizuzisa khona omunye umuntu
question6: Kuyini ukuziphatha kokubambisana?
answer6: Ukuziphatha lapho bobabili abantu bezuza khona
distractor6a: Ukuziphatha lapho kungekho muntu ozuza khona
distractor6b: Ukuziphatha lapho umuntu oyedwa efa khona njalo
distractor6c: Ukuziphatha okuzuzisa kuphela izilwane ezidla ezinye
question7: Yisiphi isici esifanayo esihambisana nokuziphatha kobugovu, kobubele, kanye nokubambisana?
answer7: Konke kuhilela uhlobo oluthile lokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Kwangaphakathi: Ukuhlala Ngamaqembu | Ukuxhumana Ngaphakathi Kohlobo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Kwangaphakathi: Ukuhlala Ngamaqembu | Ukuxhumana Ngaphakathi Kohlobo
chapterContent:
Izilwane ziyaxhumana zisebenzisa izinto ezibizwa ngokuthi izimpawu. Isibonelo salokhu sibonakala ku-stickleback enezinti ezintathu, lapho isignali ebonakalayo yesifunda esibomvu engxenyeni engezansi yenhlanzi ikhombisa abesilisa ukuthi babe nolaka futhi ikhombisa abesifazane ukuthi bathandane. Ezinye izimpawu zingamakhemikhali (ama-pheromone), umsindo (umsindo), okubonakalayo (ukuqomisana nokubonisana okunolaka), noma ukuthinta (ukuthinta). Lezi zinhlobo zokuxhumana zingaba ngokwemvelo noma ezifundwayo noma inhlanganisela yazo zombili. Lokhu akufani nokuxhumana esikuhlanganisa nolimi, okuye kwabonwa kuphela kubantu futhi mhlawumbe kwezinye izinhlobo zezilwane ezincane kanye nezilwane ezincelisayo.

 I-pheromone iyisignali yamakhemikhali ekhishwe esetshenziselwa ukuthola impendulo komunye umuntu wohlobo olufanayo. Inhloso yama-pheromone ukuvusa ukuziphatha okuthile kumuntu owamukelayo. Ama-pheromone avame kakhulu phakathi kwezinambuzane zomphakathi, kodwa asetshenziswa yizinhlobo eziningi ukuheha ubulili obuhlukile, ukukhala ama-alamu, ukumaka imizila yokudla, kanye nokuveza ezinye izindlela zokuziphatha eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu. Ngisho nabantu kucatshangwa ukuthi bayasabela kuma-pheromone athile abizwa ngokuthi ama-axillary steroids. La makhemikhali athonya indlela abantu ababona ngayo abanye abantu, futhi kolunye ucwaningo ayenesibopho seqembu labesifazane elivumelanisa imijikelezo yabo yokuya esikhathini. Indima yama-pheromone ekukhulumisaneni komuntu nomuntu isaphikisana kancane futhi isaqhubeka nokucwaninga.

 Izingoma ziyisibonelo sesignali yezwi, edinga ukuzwakala ngumtholi. Mhlawumbe ezaziwayo kakhulu kulezi yizingoma zezinyoni, ezikhomba izinhlobo futhi ezisetshenziselwa ukuheha abangane. Ezinye izingoma ezaziwayo yilezo zemikhomo, ezivame ukuhamba amabanga amade ngaphansi kwamanzi. Amahlengethwa axhumana wodwa esebenzisa imisindo ehlukahlukene. Ama-cricket esilisa enza imisindo yokutshiyoza esebenzisa isitho esikhethekile ukuheha umngane, ukuxosha amanye amadoda, nokumemezela ukuhlangana okuphumelelayo.

 Imibukiso yokuqomisana iwuchungechunge lwezindlela zokuziphatha ezibonakalayo (izibonakaliso) ezenzelwe ukuheha nokukholisa ilungu lobulili obuhlukile ukuba lihlangane. Lezi mibukiso zitholakala yonke indawo embusweni wezilwane. Ngokuvamile lezi ziboniso zihilela uchungechunge lwezinyathelo, okuhlanganisa ukuboniswa kokuqala yilungu elilodwa kulandelwe impendulo evela kwelinye. Uma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, ukuboniswa kwenziwa ngendlela engafanele noma impendulo efanele inganikezwanga, umkhuba wokuhlangana uyayekwa futhi umzamo wokuhlangana ngeke uphumelele. Ukuboniswa kokuhlangana kwe-norkork evamile kuboniswe ku-Figure 36.38.

 Ukuboniswa okunolaka nakho kuvamile embusweni wezilwane. Isibonelo yilapho inja ikhipha amazinyo ayo lapho ifuna enye inja ihlehle. Cishe, lezi ziboniso azibonisi nje kuphela ukuzimisela kwesilwane ukulwa, kodwa futhi nekhono laso lokulwa. Nakuba lezi ziboniso zibonisa ulaka ohlangothini lomthumeli, kucatshangwa ukuthi lezi ziboniso empeleni ziyindlela yokunciphisa inani lokulwa kwangempela okwenzeka phakathi kwamalungu ohlobo olufanayo: zivumela abantu ukuthi bahlole ikhono lokulwa lomphikisi wabo bese benquma ukuthi kufanelekile yini ukulwa.” Ukuhlolwa kwezimvo ezithile kusetshenziswa inkolelo-mbono yomdlalo kuholele esiphethweni sokuthi ezinye zalezi ziboniso zingase zidlulele ikhono langempela lokulwa lesilwane futhi zisetshenziselwa ukukhohlisa umphikisi. Lolu hlobo lokuxhumana, noma ngabe aluthembekile,” luzothandwa ukukhethwa kwemvelo uma luphumelela izikhathi eziningi.

 Ukuboniswa kokuphazamiseka kubonakala ezinyonini nakwezinye izinhlanzi. Zenzelwe ukudonsela isilwane esidla ezinye kude nesidleke esinabantwana bazo. Lesi yisibonelo sokuziphatha kokuzinikela: kuzuzisa intsha kakhulu kunomuntu owenza umbukiso, okuzibeka engozini ngokwenza kanjalo.

 Izilwane eziningi, ikakhulukazi izilwane ezincane, zixhumana namanye amalungu eqenjini ngokuthinta. Imisebenzi efana nokuzilungisa, ukuthinta ihlombe noma impande yomsila, ukugona, ukuthintana ngezindebe, kanye nemikhosi yokubingelelana konke kuye kwabonwa ku-langur yaseNdiya, inkawu ye-Old World. Ukuziphatha okufanayo kutholakala kwezinye izilwane ezincane, ikakhulukazi ezinkawini ezinkulu
question1: Ziyini izimpawu ekuxhumaneni kwezilwane?
answer1: Isikhuthazo esisetshenziswa yizilwane ukuxhumana namanye amalungu ohlobo olufanayo
question2: Iyini i-pheromone?
answer2: Isibonakaliso samakhemikhali esikhishwe esibangela impendulo komunye umuntu wohlobo olufanayo
distractor2c: Isibonisi esibonakalayo esisetshenziselwa ukugwema izilwane ezidla ezinye
question3: Yiluphi uhlobo lwesignali oluvame ukusetshenziswa yizinambuzane zomphakathi ukuphawula imizila yokudla?
answer3: Izimpawu zamakhemikhali ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-pheromone
question4: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sesignali yezwi?
answer4: Izingoma zezinyoni ezisetshenziselwa ukuheha abangane
question5: Iyini injongo eyinhloko yokubonisana ngokuthandana?
answer5: Ukuheha nokukholisa ilungu lobulili obuhlukile ukuba lishade
question6: Kungani ukubonakaliswa kobudlova kucatshangwa ukuthi kunciphisa ukulwa kwangempela?
answer6: Zivumela izilwane ukuthi zihlole ikhono lokulwa nabaphikisi ngaphambi kokuba zilwe
distractor6b: Bahlala bephoqa izilwane ezibuthakathaka ukuba zihambe ngokushesha
question7: Iyini inhloso yokubonisa ukuphazamiseka ezinyonini?
answer7: Ukudonsa izilwane ezidla ezinye ezidlekeni nokuvikela amaphuphu
question8: Yiluphi uhlobo lokuxhumana oluvame ukubonwa phakathi kwezilwane ezizithobile ngokuziphatha okufana nokuzilungisa nokwamukelana?
answer8: Ukuxhumana okuthintekayo
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.38. Kwenzekani uma esinye isilwane senza umbukiso wokuthandana ngendlela engafanele noma esinye isilwane singasabeli ngendlela efanele?
answer9: Isiko lokuhlangana liyashiywa futhi ukuhlangana akuphumelelanga
distractor9a: Isibonisi siphinda ngokuzenzakalelayo kuze kube yilapho siphumelela
distractor9c: Laba bobabili bayathandana kungakhathaliseki ukuthi babonisana kanjani

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Kwangaphakathi: Ukuhlala Ngamaqembu | Ukuziphatha Okunobugovu
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Kwangaphakathi: Ukuhlala Ngamaqembu | Ukuziphatha Okunobugovu
chapterContent:
Ukuziphatha okwehlisa ukuqina komzimba womuntu kodwa kwandisa ukuqina komzimba komunye umuntu kubizwa ngokuthi ukuzidela. Izibonelo zalokhu kuziphatha zibonakala kabanzi embusweni wezilwane. Izinambuzane zomphakathi njengezinyosi eziqashiwe azikwazi ukuzala, kodwa zigcina indlovukazi ukuze ikwazi ukugcwalisa isidleke nenzalo yayo. Ama-meerkat agcina umlindi omile ukuze axwayise lonke ikoloni ngabangeneleli, yize umlindi ezibeka engcupheni. Izimpisi nezinja zasendle ziletha inyama kumalungu omhlambi angekho ngesikhathi sokuzingela. Ama-lemur anakekela izinsana ezingahlobene nawo. Nakuba ngaphandle, lokhu kuziphatha kubonakala sengathi ukuzidela, kungase kungabi lula kangako.

 Kube nengxoxo eningi ngokuthi kungani kukhona ukuziphatha kokuzidela. Ingabe lokhu kuziphatha kuholela ezinzuzweni zokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwezinhlobo zawo? Ingabe kuyasiza umuntu ozidelayo ukudlulisela izakhi zofuzo zakhe? Futhi kuthiwani ngemisebenzi enjalo phakathi kwabantu abangahlobene? Incazelo eyodwa yokuziphatha kohlobo lokuzidela itholakala ku-genetics yokukhetha kwemvelo. Encwadini ka-1976, ethi The Selfish Gene, usosayensi uRichard Dawkins wazama ukuchaza izindlela eziningi zokuziphatha ezibonakala zinobugovu ngokombono wejini ngokwalo. Nakuba ngokusobala ijini lingenakuba nobugovu ngomqondo womuntu, kungabonakala kanjalo uma umhlatshelo womuntu ngamunye uzuzisa abantu abahlobene ababelana ngezakhi zofuzo ezifanayo ngokozalo (ezikhona ezihlotsheni ngenxa yozalo oluvamile). Abazali bezilwane ezincelisayo benza lo mhlatshelo ukuze banakekele inzalo yabo. Ama-penguin e-Emperor ahamba amamayela ezimweni ezinzima ukuze alethe ukudla kwabantwana bawo. Ithiyori yezakhi zofuzo zobugovu ibilokhu iphikisana eminyakeni edlule futhi isaxoxwa phakathi kososayensi emikhakheni ehlobene.

 Ngisho nabantu abangahlobene kangako, labo abanobugovu obuncane kunabo obuhlanganyelwe ngumzali nenzalo, bayazuza ekuziphatheni okubonakala kunomusa. Imisebenzi yezinambuzane zomphakathi njengezinyosi, ama-wasps, izintuthwane, kanye nezintuthwane ziyizibonelo ezinhle. Izisebenzi eziyinyumba kule miphakathi zinakekela indlovukazi ngoba zihlobene nayo eduze, futhi njengoba indlovukazi inenzalo, idlulisela izakhi zofuzo ezivela kubasebenzi ngokungaqondile. Ngakho-ke, kuyinzuzo yokuqina komzimba ukuthi isisebenzi sigcine indlovukazi ngaphandle kokuba nethuba eliqondile lokudlulisela izakhi zofuzo zaso ngenxa yokungazali kwayo. Ukwehla kokuqina komzimba komuntu ngamunye ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuqina kokuzala kwesihlobo futhi ngaleyo ndlela ukuqina komzimba komuntu okubandakanya wonke umuntu kuyashintsha ngokukhethwa kwezihlobo. Lesi simo singachaza ukuziphatha okuningi kokuzinikela okungabonakali okubonakala ezilwaneni. Kodwa-ke, lokhu kuziphatha kungase kungachazwa ngempela njengokuzinikela kulezi zimo ngoba empeleni umlingisi ukhulisa ukuqina komzimba wakhe ngokuqondile (ngenzalo yakhe) noma ngokungaqondile (ngokuqina komzimba okubandakanya wonke umuntu akutholayo ngezihlobo ezabelana ngezakhi zofuzo nazo).

 Abantu abangahlobene nabo bangase benze ngendlela yokuphana komunye nomunye, futhi lokhu kubonakala kuphikisana nencazelo yezakhi zofuzo zobugovu. Isibonelo salokhu sibonakala ezinhlotsheni eziningi zezinkawu lapho inkawu izonikela ngomhlane wayo enkawu engahlobene ukuze lowo muntu akhethe izimuncagazi eboyeni bayo. Ngemva kwesikhathi esithile, izindima ziyaguqulwa bese inkawu yokuqala manje ilungisa inkawu yesibili. Ngakho-ke, kukhona ukuphana ekuziphatheni. Zombili ziyazuza ekusebenzisaneni futhi ukufaneleka kwazo kukhuliswa kakhulu kunokuba zingabambisani noma uma omunye ebambisana kanti omunye engabambisani. Lokhu kuziphatha akusikho ngempela ukuphana, njengoba "ukuziphatha komdlali"okuphayo kusekelwe ekulindelekeni kokuthi kuzoba ngumamukeli wokuziphatha esikhathini esizayo, okubizwa ngokuthi ukuphana okuhambisanayo. Ukuphana okuhambisanayo kudinga ukuthi abantu bahlangane ngokuphindaphindiwe, ngokuvamile okuwumphumela wokuhlala eqenjini elifanayo lomphakathi, nokuthi abakhohlisi (labo abangaphindiseli) bajeziswe.

 Ithiyori yomdlalo wokuziphendukela kwemvelo, ukuguqulwa kwethiyori yomdlalo wakudala ezibalweni, ikhombisile ukuthi eziningi zalezi zinto ezibizwa ngokuthi ukuziphatha kokuzinikela azikho nhlobo ukuzinikela. Incazelo "yokuzinikela okumsulwa", esekelwe ekuziphatheni komuntu, iyisenzo esizuzisa omunye ngaphandle kwenzuzo eqondile kuye. Iningi lokuziphatha okuchazwe ngaphambilini alibonakali lihlangabezana nale ncazelo, futhi abacwaningi bemidlalo bayakwazi ukuthola izingxenye "zobugovu"kuzo. Abanye baphikise ngokuthi amagama athi "ubugovu"kanye "nokuzinikela"kufanele alahlwe ngokuphelele lapho kuxoxwa ngokuziphatha kwezilwane, njengoba echaza ukuziphatha komuntu futhi kungenzeka angasebenzi ngqo emisebenzini yezilwane engokwemvelo. Okusobala, nokho, ukuthi ukuziphatha okuzuzwa njengefa okuthuthukisa amathuba okudlulisela izakhi zofuzo zomuntu noma ingxenye yezakhi zofuzo zomuntu kuyathandwa ukukhethwa kwemvelo futhi kuzogcinwa ezizukulwaneni ezizayo uma nje lezo zenzo ziveza inzuzo yokufaneleka komzimba. Lezi zenzo ezingokwemvelo zingasetshenziswa, ezimweni ezikhethekile, kwezinye izinhlobo, uma nje zinganciphisi ukufaneleka kwesilwane.
question1: Kuyini ukuziphatha kobuzwela?
answer1: Ukuziphatha okwehlisa ukuqina komzimba womuntu ngenkathi kukhulisa ukuqina komzimba komunye umuntu
distractor1b: Ukuziphatha lapho bobabili abantu bezuza khona ngokulinganayo
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sokuziphatha kokuzinikela okuchazwe embhalweni?
answer2: Izinyosi ezisebenzayo zigcina indlovukazi yize zingakwazi ukuzala
question3: Ngokusho kwemfundiso yezakhi zofuzo zobugovu, kungani into ephilayo ingase yenze izenzo ezibonakala ziwubugovu ezihlotsheni?
answer3: Ukusiza izihlobo kungandisa ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezabiwe ezizukulwaneni ezizayo
distractor3a: Ngoba ukukhetha kwemvelo kusiza ekunciphiseni ukuzala
distractor3b: Ngoba izinto eziphilayo zihlala zizuzisa abantu abangahlobene kuqala
distractor3c: Ngoba izakhi zofuzo ziyavela ngaphandle kokuzala
question4: Kuyini ukukhetha isihlobo?
answer4: Ukukhetha kwemvelo okukhuthaza ukuziphatha okwandisa impumelelo yokuzala yabantu abahlobene ababelana ngezakhi zofuzo
distractor4a: Ukukhethwa komuntu onamandla kunabo bonke emphakathini
question5: Kungani izinyosi ezingasebenzi ezingaboliyo zikhulisa ukuqina kwazo okubandakanya wonke umuntu?
answer5: Ngokusiza indlovukazi ukuthi izale futhi idlulisele izakhi zofuzo ezabelana ngayo nayo
question6: Kuyini ukuzinikela okuhambisanayo?
answer6: Ukusiza omunye umuntu ngokulindela ukuthi umusa uzobuyiselwa esikhathini esizayo
distractor6b: Ukusiza omunye umuntu ngaphandle kokuxhumana esikhathini esizayo
question7: Yikuphi ukuziphatha okuyisibonelo sokuphana okuhambisanayo?
answer7: Izinkawu zilungisa abantu abangahlobene bese kamuva zithola ukulungiswa.
question8: Ngokusho kwemfundiso yokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwemidlalo, kungani ukuziphatha okuningi okubonakala sengathi kuwukuzinikela kungabhekwa njengokuzinikela kwangempela?
answer8: Ngoba zivame ukunikeza inzuzo yokufaneleka eqondile noma engaqondile kumuntu owenza lo mkhuba
distractor8b: Ngoba ukukhetha kwemvelo kususa zonke izindlela zokubambisana
question9: Yiziphi izinhlobo zokuziphatha okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi zithandwa yi-natural selection?
answer9: Ukuziphatha okuzuzwe njengefa okuthuthukisa amathuba okudlulisela izakhi zofuzo zomuntu ngamunye noma izakhi zofuzo ezabiwe
distractor9b: Ukuziphatha okungahleliwe okungenawo umthelela ekufanelekeni komzimba
distractor9c: Ukuziphatha okunciphisa ukusinda ngaphandle kokuzuzisa izihlobo

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Kwangaphakathi: Ukuhlala Emaqenjini | Ukuthola Abalingani Bocansi
chapterContent:
Akuzona zonke izilwane ezizala ngokocansi, kodwa eziningi ezinazo inselele efanayo: zidinga ukuthola umlingani ofanele futhi ngokuvamile kudingeka zincintisane nezinye ukuze zithole oyedwa. Kusetshenziswa amandla amakhulu enkambisweni yokuthola, ukuheha, kanye nokuhlangana nomlingani wobulili. Izinhlobo ezimbili zokukhetha zenzeka phakathi nale nqubo futhi zingaholela ezicini ezibalulekile ekuzaleni ezibizwa ngokuthi izici zocansi zesibili: ukukhetha phakathi kobulili, ukukhetha umlingani lapho abantu bobulili obubodwa bekhetha abangane bobulili obubodwa, kanye nokukhetha phakathi kobulili, ukuncintisana kwabalingani phakathi kwamalungu obulili obubodwa. Ukukhetha phakathi kobulili kuvame ukuba nzima ngoba ukukhetha umlingani kungase kusekelwe ezicini ezahlukahlukene ezibonakalayo, ezizwakalayo, ezithintayo, kanye nezamakhemikhali. Isibonelo sokukhetha phakathi kobulili lapho ama-peacock esifazane ekhetha ukuhlangana nendoda enezimpaphe ezikhanya kakhulu. Lolu hlobo lokukhetha luvame ukuholela ezicini zobulili obukhethiwe ezingathuthukisi ukusinda, kodwa yizo lezo zici ezikhanga kakhulu kobulili obuhlukile (ngokuvamile ezibangela ukusinda). Ukukhetha phakathi kobulili obubodwa kuhilela ukuboniswa kokuhlangana kanye nemikhuba yokuhlangana enobudlova njengezinqama ezishaya amakhanda—onqobayo kulezi zimpi yilowo okwazi ukuhlangana. Eziningi zalezi zindlela zidla amandla amaningi kodwa ziphumela ekukhethweni kwezilwane ezinempilo kakhulu, ezinamandla kakhulu, kanye/noma ezibusa kakhulu ukuze zihlangane. Izinhlelo ezintathu zokuhlangana ezijwayelekile, zonke ezihilela ukuzalwa ngaphandle kokuziphatha okufundiwe, zibonakala ezilwaneni eziningi: i-monogamous, i-polygynous, kanye ne-polyandrous.

 Ezinhlelweni zokuhlangana komuntu oyedwa, iduna elilodwa nensikazi eyodwa zihlanganiswa okungenani isizini eyodwa yokuzala. Kwezinye izilwane, njenge-grey wolf, lokhu kuhlangana kungahlala isikhathi eside kakhulu, ngisho nokuphila konke. Kuye kwaphakanyiswa izincazelo eziningana zalolu hlobo lwesimiso sokuhlangana. I-hypothesis yokulinda umlingani ithi abesilisa bahlala nensikazi ukuze bavimbele amanye abesilisa ukuthi bahlangane nayo. Lokhu kuziphatha kuyazuzisa ezimweni ezinjalo lapho abalingani benqabile futhi kunzima ukuyithola. Enye incazelo i-hypothesis yokusiza abesilisa,” lapho abesilisa abahlala nensikazi ukusiza ukuvikela nokukhulisa amaphuphu abo bazoba nezingane eziningi nezinempilo. I-monogamy ibonwa ezinyonini eziningi lapho, ngaphezu kokunakekelwa kwabazali okuvela kwensikazi, iduna liphinde libe ngumhlinzeki omkhulu wokunakekelwa kwabazali kwamaphuphu. Incazelo yesithathu yezinzuzo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo zokuba nomfazi oyedwa yinkolelo-mbono yokuphoqelelwa kwabesifazane. Kulesi simo, insikazi iqinisekisa ukuthi induna ayinazo ezinye izingane ezingase zincintisane nezayo, ngakho-ke iphazamisa ngenkuthalo izimpawu zenduna ukuze idonse abanye abangane.

 Ukuhlangana kwe-Polygynous kubhekisela ekuhlanganeni kwendoda eyodwa nezinsikazi eziningi. Kulezi zimo, insikazi kumele ibe nesibopho sokunakekelwa kwabazali abaningi njengoba induna eyodwa ingakwazi ukunakekela inzalo eningi kangako. Ku-polygyny esekelwe ezinsizeni, abesilisa bancintisana ngezindawo ezinezinsiza ezinhle kakhulu, bese behlangana nezinsikazi ezingena endaweni, bedonseleka ekucebeni kwayo. Insikazi iyazuza ngokuhlangana nendoda enamandla, efanelana nezakhi zofuzo; nokho, kuyindleko yokungabi nasizo lendoda ekunakekeleni inzalo. Isibonelo sibonakala ku-honeyguide ephuzi, inyoni enamaduna avikela izidleke zezinyosi ngoba izinsikazi zidla i-wax yazo. Njengoba izinsikazi zisondela, induna evikela isidleke izohlangana nazo. Izakhiwo zokuhlangana kwe-Harem ziwuhlobo lwesistimu ye-polygynous lapho izinduna ezithile zibusa khona ukuhlangana ngenkathi zilawula indawo enezinsiza. Izimfene zendlovu, lapho induna ye-alpha ibusa khona ukuhlangana ngaphakathi kweqembu ziyi- Isibonelo. Uhlobo lwesithathu lwe-polygyny uhlelo lwe-lek. Lapha kunendawo yokuthandana yomphakathi lapho abesilisa abaningana benza khona imibukiso eyinkimbinkimbi yabesifazane, kanti abesifazane bakhetha abalingani babo kuleli qembu. Lokhu kuziphatha kubonakala ezinhlotsheni eziningana zezinyoni okuhlanganisa i-sage grouse kanye nenkukhu yase-prairie.

 Ezinhlelweni zokuhlangana kwe-polyandrous, insikazi eyodwa ihlangana nabesilisa abaningi. Lezi zinhlobo zezinhlelo azivamile kakhulu kunezinhlelo zokuhlangana kwe-monogamous kanye ne-polygynous. Ezinhlotsheni ze-pipefish kanye ne-seahorses, abesilisa bathola amaqanda kwabesifazane, bawavundise, bawavikele esikhwameni, futhi bazale inzalo (Isithombe 36.39). Ngakho-ke, insikazi iyakwazi ukunikeza amaqanda kwabesilisa abaningana ngaphandle komthwalo wokuthwala amaqanda avundisiwe.
question1: Kungani izilwane eziningi ezizalanayo ngokobulili zichitha amandla amaningi zifuna umngane?
answer1: Ngoba kumele bathole, bakhange, futhi bahlangane ngempumelelo nomlingani ofanele
distractor1a: Ngoba ukuzalana kudinga ukufuduka uye kwelinye izwekazi
distractor1b: Ngoba abantu abanamandla kuphela abakwazi ukuzala
distractor1c: Ngoba ukuzala kwenzeka kanye kuphela ngesikhathi sokuphila kwezinto eziphilayo
question2: Kuyini ukukhetha abantu abathandana nabobulili obuhlukile?
answer2: Ukukhetha umlingani lapho abantu bobulili obuhlukile bekhetha umlingani wobulili obuhlukile
distractor2a: Ukuncintisana phakathi kwabantu bobulili obufanayo ngabalingani
question3: Kuyini ukukhetha phakathi kobulili?
answer3: Ukuncintisana phakathi kwamalungu obulili obufanayo ngokufinyelela kubalingani
distractor3a: Ukukhetha umngane womshado ngabantu bobulili obuhlukile
distractor3b: Ukuncintisana phakathi kwezilwane ezidla ezinye kanye nezilwane ezidla ezinye
question4: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sokukhethwa kwabantu abathandana nabobulili obuhlukile?
answer4: Amapikoko ezinsikazi akhetha abesilisa abanezimpaphe ezikhanya kakhulu
distractor4a: Izinqama zesilisa zishaya amakhanda ukuze zifinyelele kwabesifazane
question5: Kungani izici ezithandwa ukukhetha kwabantu bobulili obuhlukile zinganciphisa ukusinda?
answer5: Ngoba izici ezikhanga abalingani azihlali zizuzisa ekusindeni
distractor5b: Ngoba zivimbela abantu ekutholeni abangane bomshado
question6: Izinqama zesilisa ezishaya amakhanda ukuze zifinyelele kwabesifazane ziyisibonelo salokhu okulandelayo:
answer6: Ukukhetha phakathi kwabantu abathandana nabobulili obuhlukile
question7: Uyini umphumela wokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwemincintiswano eminingi yokuhlangana ngobudlova?
answer7: Abantu abanempilo kakhulu, abanamandla kakhulu, noma abanamandla kakhulu bathola amathuba okuhlangana
distractor7a: Abantu abancane kakhulu bahlala bezala kabusha
question8: Yiziphi izinhlobo zezimpawu ezingasetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokukhetha abantu abathandana nabobulili obuhlukile?
answer8: Izimpawu ezibonakalayo, ezizwakalayo, ezithintayo, kanye nezamakhemikhali
question9: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezintathu zokuhlangana ezichazwa njengezihilela ukuziphatha okungokwemvelo?
answer9: I-monogamous, polygynous, kanye ne-polyandrous
question10: Yini echaza uhlelo lokuhlangana kwendoda nomfazi oyedwa?
answer10: Iduna elilodwa nensikazi eyodwa zihlala zibhangqiwe okungenani isikhathi esisodwa sokuzalana
distractor10a: Iduna elilodwa lihlangana nezinsikazi eziningi ngesikhathi sokuzala
distractor10b: Insikazi eyodwa ihlangana namadoda amaningi ngesikhathi sokuzala
distractor10c: Kokubili abesilisa nabesifazane bahlangana ngokungahleliwe ngaphandle kokubophana
question11: Ngokombono womnakekeli womlingani, kungani owesilisa ehlala nowesifazane?
answer11: Ukuvimbela amanye amaduna ukuthi angazalani naye
distractor11c: Ukuvumela owesifazane ukuthi athole abangane abengeziwe
answer12: Amaduna asele ukusiza ukuvikela nokukhulisa inzalo akhiqiza inzalo eningi nenempilo
distractor12a: Amaduna ahlala kuphela ukuze avikele izindawo zokudla
distractor12b: Amaduna ayahamba ngokushesha ngemva kokukhwelana ukuze athole amanye amasikazi
distractor12c: Abesilisa bahlala ngoba abesifazane babaphoqa ukuthi bahlale
question13: Ngokombono wokuphoqelelwa kwabesifazane, kungani owesifazane ehlala nowesilisa oyedwa?
answer13: Uvimbela owesilisa ekuzaleni inzalo encintisanayo nezinye izinsikazi
distractor13a: Uthembele ngokuphelele kwendoda ukuze athole ukudla
distractor13c: Uvimbela abanye besifazane ukuthi bangene endaweni
question14: Yini echaza uhlelo lokuzalana olunezitho eziningi?
distractor14b: Indoda eyodwa ihlangana nowesifazane oyedwa kuphela impilo yakhe yonke
distractor14c: Zombili izininsi zinomlingani oyedwa kuphela ngesikhathi ngasinye sokuzalana
question15: Ku-polygyny esekelwe ezinsizeni, kungani abesifazane bekhetha abesilisa abathile?
answer15: Bakhangwa abesilisa abalawula izindawo ezinemithombo eminingi
distractor15b: Bakhetha abesilisa abanikeza ukunakekelwa okulinganayo kwabazali
distractor15c: Bakhetha abangane ngokungahleliwe kungakhathaliseki ukuthi indawo injani
answer16: Uhlobo lwe-polygyny lapho indoda eyodwa ebusayo ilawula ukukhwelana endaweni
distractor16a: Uhlelo lokuzalana lapho abesifazane bencintisana khona ngendoda eyodwa
distractor16b: Uhlelo lokuzalelana komuntu oyedwa olunezibopho zombhangqwana impilo yonke
distractor16c: Uhlelo lokuzalana lapho bonke abesilisa belalana ngokulinganayo
answer17: Uhlelo lapho abesilisa bebuthana endaweni yokubonisana yomphakathi bese abesifazane bekhetha umlingani
distractor17a: Uhlelo lapho abesilisa bevikela khona izidleke ezinamaqanda
distractor17b: Uhlelo lapho abesifazane basungula khona izindawo zabesilisa
distractor17c: Uhlelo lapho ukuhlangana kwenzeka khona kuphela ngemva kokufuduka
question18: Yiluphi uhlobo lwesimiso sokuzalela olungavamile kakhulu?
question19: Kungani izinhlanzi zasolwandle nezinsikazi zingahlangana nezinsikazi eziningi?
answer19: Amaduna athwala amaqanda avundisiwe esikhwameni sokukhulisa amathole bese ezala inzalo
distractor19a: Abesifazane banikeza ukunakekelwa kwabazali ngemva kokukhulelwa
distractor19b: Bobabili abazali bayawashiya amaqanda ngokushesha ngemva kokukhulelwa
distractor19c: Amaqanda akhula ngaphandle ngaphandle kokunakekelwa ngabazali

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Okulula Okufundiwe (Umkhuba, Ukunyathelisa)
chapterContent:
Iningi lezindlela zokuziphatha okuxoxwe ngazo ngaphambilini zazingokwemvelo noma okungenani zinengxenye engokwemvelo (ukwehluka kokuziphatha okungokwemvelo kungafundwa). Zizuzwe njengefa futhi izindlela zokuziphatha azishintshi ngokuphendula izimpawu ezivela endaweni ezungezile. Ngokuphambene nalokho, izindlela zokuziphatha ezifundiwe, noma zingase zibe nezingxenye zemvelo, zivumela into ephilayo ukuthi izivumelanise nezinguquko endaweni ezungezile futhi ziguqulwa ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwangaphambilini. Izindlela zokuziphatha ezilula zokufunda zifaka phakathi ukujwayela nokushicilela—kokubili kubalulekile enkambisweni yokuvuthwa kwezilwane ezincane.

 Ukujwayela
Ukujwayela kuyindlela elula yokufunda lapho isilwane siyeka ukuphendula esishukumisweni ngemva kwesikhathi sokuchayeka ngokuphindaphindiwe. Lolu uhlobo lokufunda okungezona oluhlangene, njengoba isishukumi singahlotshaniswa nanoma yisiphi isijeziso noma umvuzo. Izinja zasePrairie zivame ukukhala i-alamu lapho zisongelwa yisilwane esidla ezinye izilwane, kodwa zijwayela umsindo wezinyathelo zabantu lapho kungekho monakalo ohlotshaniswa nalo msindo, ngakho-ke, azisaphenduli kuzo nge-alamu. Kulesi sibonelo, ukujwayela kuqondene nomsindo wezinyathelo zabantu, njengoba izilwane zisasabela emisindweni yezilwane ezingaba khona.

 Ukunyathelisa
Ukunyathelisa uhlobo lokufunda olwenzeka eminyakeni ethile noma esigabeni sokuphila esisheshayo futhi esizimele kuhlobo oluhilelekile. Amadada aqanduselayo ayaqaphela umuntu omdala wokuqala ambonayo, unina, futhi abopheke naye. Into ejwayelekile ukubona amadada ahamba noma ebhukuda ngemuva komama bawo (Isithombe 36.40). Lolu olunye uhlobo lokufunda okungahlanganisi, kodwa lubaluleke kakhulu enkambisweni yokuvuthwa kwalezi zilwane njengoba luzikhuthaza ukuba zihlale eduze komama wazo ukuze zivikeleke, okwandisa kakhulu amathuba azo okusinda. Kodwa-ke, uma amadada asanda kuzalwa ebona umuntu ngaphambi kokuba abone unina, azonyathelisa kumuntu futhi amlandele ngendlela efanayo naleyo abezolandela ngayo unina wangempela.
question1: Iyini inzuzo eyinhloko yokuziphatha okufundiwe kunokuziphatha okungokwemvelo?
answer1: Zivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zivumelane nezinguquko zemvelo ngokusebenzisa ulwazi
question2: Yiziphi izindlela ezimbili ezilula zokuziphatha ezifundiwe okuxoxwa ngazo kulesi sigaba?
answer2: Ukuhlala kanye nokunyathelisa
question3: Kuyini ukujwayela?
answer3: Indlela elula yokufunda lapho isilwane siyeka ukusabela esikhuthazweni esivezwa ngokuphindaphindiwe esingenangozi
question4: Ukujwayela kuyisibonelo saluphi uhlobo lokufunda?
answer4: Ukufunda okungahlanganyeli
question5: Kungani izinja zasezindaweni zasehlathini zigcina ziyeke ukusabela ekuzwakaleni kwezinyathelo zabantu?
answer5: Ngoba ukuchayeka ngokuphindaphindiwe ngaphandle kokulimala kubangela ukujwayela
distractor5b: Ngoba bacabanga ukuthi abantu bayizilo ezidla ezinye izilwane
distractor5c: Ngoba bayakhohlwa ukuthi bangenza kanjani izingcingo ze-alamu
question6: Ngemva kokujwayela izinyathelo zabantu, izinja zasezindaweni zasemakhaya zisasabela emisindweni yezilwane ezidla ezinye ngoba:
answer6: Ukujwayela kuqondene ngqo nesikhuthazo esingenangozi
distractor6b: Imisindo yezilwane ezidla ezinye akunakwenzeka ukuyishaya indiva ngokwezakhi zofuzo
distractor6c: Izilwane ezidla ezinye zenza imisindo efanayo neyabantu
question7: Kuyini ukuphrinta?
answer7: Uhlobo lokufunda okusheshayo olwenzeka ngesikhathi esithile sokuphila kwasekuqaleni
distractor7a: Impendulo efundiwe ekhula kancane kancane phakathi nobudala
question8: Kungani ukuphrinta kubalulekile kumadada amancane?
answer8: Kubasiza ukuba bahlale beseduze nonina, kwandisa amathuba abo okusinda
distractor8b: Kubenza bakwazi ukufuduka ngokushesha ngemva kokuchamisela
distractor8c: Kubavimbela ekufundeni ukuziphatha okusha kamuva ekuphileni
question9: Bheka Umfanekiso 36.40. Kwenzekani uma idada elisanda kuqanduselwa libona umuntu ngaphambi kokubona unina?
answer9: Iyanyathelisa kumuntu futhi ilandele umuntu njengoba ingenza kunina

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Okunesimo Esifanele
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Okunesimo Esifanele
chapterContent: Ukuziphatha okunesimo kuyizinhlobo zokufunda okuhambisanayo, lapho isikhuthazo sihlotshaniswa nomphumela. Ngesikhathi sokulungiswa kokusebenza, impendulo yokuziphatha iguqulwa yimiphumela yayo, maqondana nokwakheka kwayo, amandla, noma imvamisa.
question1: Yiziphi izindlela zokuziphatha ezilawulwayo?
answer1: Ukuziphatha okufundwe ngokuhlanganiswa phakathi kwesikhuthazo nomphumela waso
distractor1a: Ukuziphatha okuzuzwe njengefa ngokuphelele futhi okungakaze kushintshwe
question2: Ukuziphatha okunemibandela kuyisibonelo saluphi uhlobo lokufunda?
answer2: Ukufunda okuhlangene
question3: Ekufundeni okuhlanganisayo, isikhuthazo sihlotshaniswa nalokhu:
answer3: Umphumela
question4: Kuyini ukulungiswa kokusebenza?
answer4: Uhlobo lokufunda okuhlangene lapho ukuziphatha kuguqulwa khona yimiphumela yako
distractor4a: Uhlobo lokufunda olusekelwe kuphela ekuvezweni okuphindaphindiwe kwento eyingozi
question5: Yisiphi isici sokuziphatha esingashintshwa yisimo sokusebenza?
answer5: Isimo sayo, amandla, noma imvamisa
question6: Indlela yokusebenza ihluke kanjani ekuzijwayezeni?
answer6: Ukulungiswa kwabasebenzi kuhilela ukuhlangana nemiphumela, kanti ukujwayela kubangelwa ukuchayeka okuphindaphindiwe ngaphandle komvuzo noma isijeziso
distractor6a: Ukujwayela kuhilela imivuzo, kuyilapho ukujwayela ukusebenza kungahileli
distractor6b: Ukuziphatha komuntu osebenzayo kuyindlela yokuphila yangaphakathi, kuyilapho ukujwayela kufundwa
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukufunda okuhambisanayo?
answer7: Isidalwa sifunda ngokuxhumanisa isikhuthazo nomphumela othile
distractor7a: Isidalwa siyayeka ukusabela kuzo zonke izikhuthazo eziphindaphindwayo
distractor7b: Isidalwa senza kuphela ukuziphatha okuhlelwe ngokwezakhi zofuzo
distractor7c: Isidalwa sifunda kuphela ngesikhathi sokuqala esibucayi

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Okuhlelekile | I-Classical Conditioning
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Okuhlelekile | I-Classical Conditioning
chapterContent:
Esimweni sokulungisa isimo sakudala, impendulo ebizwa ngokuthi impendulo ehlelekile ihlotshaniswa nesikhuthazo eyayingakaze ihlotshaniswe naso ngaphambili, isikhuthazo esihlelekile. Impendulo esishukumisweni sokuqala, esingenamibandela ibizwa ngokuthi impendulo engahlelekile. Isibonelo esicashunwe kakhulu sesimo sokulungisa isimo sakudala yizivivinyo zika-Ivan Pavlov ngezinja (Isithombe 36.41). Ekuhlolweni kukaPavlov, impendulo engahleliwe kwakuwukuthelwa amathe ezinja ngenxa yesikhuthazo esingenamibandela sokubona noma sokuhogela ukudla kwazo. Isikhuthazo sokulungisa isimo abacwaningi abasihlobanisa nempendulo engahleliwe kwakuwukukhala kwensimbi. Ngesikhathi sokulungisa isimo, njalo lapho isilwane sinikezwa ukudla, kwakukhala insimbi. Lokhu kwaphindwa phakathi nezilingo eziningana. Ngemva kwesikhathi esithile, inja yafunda ukuhlanganisa ukukhala kwensimbi nokudla nokuphendula ngokuthelwa amathe. Ngemva kwesikhathi sokulungisa isimo sesiphelile, inja yayizophendula ngokuthelwa amathe lapho insimbi ikhala, ngisho nalapho isikhuthazo esingenamibandela, ukudla, singekho. Ngakho-ke, ukukhala kwensimbi kwaba isikhuthazo esihleliwe kanti ukuthelwa amathe kwaba impendulo ehlelekile. Nakuba abanye ososayensi becabanga ukuthi izimpendulo ezingaguquki neziguquki ziyafana, ngisho noPavlov wathola ukuthi amathe ezinjeni eziguquki ayenomehluko ophawulekayo uma kuqhathaniswa nenja engaguquki.

 Abanye ososayensi babecabanga ukuthi lolu hlobo lokulungisa ludinga ukuchayeka kaningi esikhuthazweni kanye nempendulo ehambisanayo, kodwa manje sekuyaziwa ukuthi lokhu akudingekile kuzo zonke izimo, nokuthi ukulungisa okuthile kungafundwa ekuhlolweni okukodwa kokulungisa. Ukulungisa okujwayelekile kuyimfundiso enkulu yokuziphatha, igatsha lefilosofi yengqondo ephakamisa ukuthi zonke izenzo, imicabango, kanye nemizwa yezinto eziphilayo ukuziphatha okungaphathwa ngokuguqulwa kokuziphatha kanye nezinguquko endaweni ezungezile.
question1: Kuyini ukulungiswa kwesimo se-classical?
answer1: Uhlobo lokufunda okuhlangene lapho isikhuthazo esingazange sithathe hlangothi ngaphambili sihlotshaniswa nempendulo
distractor1a: Uhlobo lokufunda okungahlanganyeli olusekelwe ekuvezweni okuphindaphindiwe okungenangozi
question2: Iyini i-stimulus engenamibandela ekuhlolweni kukaPavlovs?
answer2: Ukudla
question3: Iyini impendulo engenamibandela ekuhlolweni kukaPavlovs?
answer3: Izinja zikhipha amathe ngenxa yokudla
question4: Yisiphi isikhuthazo esaba isikhuthazo esisekelwe ezivivinyweni zikaPavlov?
answer4: Ukukhala kwensimbi
question5: Ngemva kokulungiswa, yini eyaba impendulo elungiselelwe?
answer5: Amathe aphendula insimbi yodwa
question6: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwensimbi nokudla kwasungulwa kanjani ekuhlolweni kukaPavlovs?
answer6: Insimbi yayishaywa ngokuphindaphindiwe isikhathi ngasinye lapho kulethwa ukudla
distractor6a: Insimbi yashaywa kuphela ngemva kokuba izinja sezidlile
distractor6b: Izinja zizwa insimbi ngaphandle kokuthola ukudla
question7: Ucwaningo lwakamuva lwembulani mayelana nokulungiswa kwesimo se-classical?
answer7: Ezinye izimpendulo ezinemibandela zingafundwa ngemva kokuhlangana okukodwa kuphela
distractor7a: Ukulungiswa kwesitayela sendabuko kudinga ukuphindaphinda okungamakhulu
distractor7b: Ukulungiswa kwesimo sendabuko kwenzeka kuphela ezincelisayo
distractor7c: Izimpendulo ezisekelwe esimweni esithile akunakwenzeka ukuzithola lapho umuntu esemdala
question8: Kuyini ukuziphatha?
answer8: Igatsha lezengqondo eliphakamisa ukuthi ukuziphatha kungashintshwa ngokushintsha izimo zemvelo
question9: Bheka Umfanekiso 36.41. Ngemva kokupholisa, kungani izinja zakhipha amathe lapho zizwa insimbi ngisho noma kungekho ukudla?
answer9: Base befundile ukuhlanganisa insimbi nokudla, okwenza insimbi ibe yisikhuthazo esihambisana nesimo
distractor9a: Insimbi ngokwemvelo yabangela ukuqunjelwa ngamathe ngaphandle kokufunda

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukuziphatha Okuhlelekile | Ukulungiswa Komsebenzi
chapterContent: Ekulungiseni ukusebenza, ukuziphatha okuhlelekile kuguqulwa kancane kancane yimiphumela yako njengoba isilwane sisabela ekukhuthazeni. Umsekeli omkhulu walolu hlobo lokulungisa kwakuyisazi sokusebenza kwengqondo uB.F. Skinner, umsunguli webhokisi likaSkinner. USkinner wafaka amagundane emabhokisini akhe ayene-lever eyayizodlulisela ukudla egundwini lapho licindezelekile. Ngenkathi ekuqaleni igundane lalicindezela i-lever izikhathi ezimbalwa ngengozi, ekugcineni lahlobanisa ukusunduza i-lever nokuthola ukudla. Lolu hlobo lokufunda luyisibonelo sokulungisa ukusebenza. Ukufunda kokusebenza kuyisisekelo sokuqeqeshwa kwezilwane eziningi. Ukuziphatha okuhleliwe kuguqulwa njalo ngokuqiniswa okuhle noma okubi, ngokunikeza umvuzo njengokudla noma ukususa uhlobo oluthile lwesijeziso, ngokulandelana. Ngale ndlela, isilwane silungiselelwe ukuhlobanisa uhlobo lokuziphatha nesijeziso noma umvuzo, futhi, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, singashukunyiswa ukwenza ukuziphatha ababengeke bakwenze endle, njengezindlela ama-dolphin azenza emibukisweni yepaki lokuzijabulisa yasolwandle (Isithombe 36.42)
question1: Kuyini ukulungiswa kokusebenza?
answer1: Uhlobo lokufunda okuhlangene lapho ukuziphatha kuguqulwa khona yimiphumela yako
distractor1a: Uhlobo lokufunda okungahlanganyeli olusekelwe ekuvezweni okuphindaphindiwe
distractor1c: Ukufunda okwenzeka kuphela ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kwasekuqaleni
question2: Ubani owayengumsekeli omkhulu we-operating conditioning?
answer2: B.F. Skinner
question3: Yayiyini injongo yesigwedlo ebhokisini le-Skinners?
answer3: Ukuyicindezela kwanikeza igundane ukudla
question4: Amagundane aqale kanjani ukucindezela i-lever ekuhlolweni kwe-Skinners?
answer4: Ngengozi
question5: Yini amagundane agcine eyifundile?
answer5: Ukucindezela i-lever kwaholela ekutholeni ukudla
distractor5a: Ukudla kwavela kuphela lapho behlala bethule
distractor5c: Ukucindezela i-lever kwavimbela ukudla ukuthi kuvele
question6: Kuyini ukuqinisa okuhle?
answer6: Ukuqinisa ukuziphatha ngokunikeza umvuzo
distractor6c: Ukungawunaki ukuziphatha kuze kube yilapho kunyamalala
question7: Kuyini ukuqinisa okungekuhle?
answer7: Ukuqinisa ukuziphatha ngokususa isisusa noma isijeziso esingathandeki
question8: Kungani ukulungiswa kwezilwane kusetshenziswa kakhulu ekuqeqeshweni kwezilwane?
answer8: Ngoba izilwane zifunda ukuhlobanisa ukuziphatha okuthile nemivuzo noma ukususwa kwesijeziso
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.42. Kungani amahlengethwa ekwazi ukwenza amaqhinga ayinkimbinkimbi emapaki olwandle?
answer9: Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi kuqinisa ukuziphatha okufiselekayo ngemivuzo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor9b: Amahlengethwa enza wonke amaqhinga ngokwemvelo endle

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukufunda Kokuqonda
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | Ukufunda Kokuqonda
chapterContent:
Ukulungiswa kwesimo sezinto zakudala kanye nokusebenzayo kuyizindlela ezingasebenzi kahle zabantu kanye nezinye izilwane ezihlakaniphile zokufunda. Ezinye izilwane eziphila ndawonye, kufaka phakathi abantu, ziyakwazi ukufunda ngokulingisa ukuziphatha kwabanye nangokuthatha imiyalelo. Ukuthuthukiswa kolimi oluyinkimbinkimbi ngabantu kwenze ukufunda kwengqondo, ukuphathwa kolwazi kusetshenziswa ingqondo, kwaba yindlela evelele kakhulu yokufunda komuntu. Eqinisweni, yileyo ndlela abafundi abafunda ngayo njengamanje ngokufunda le ncwadi. Njengoba abafundi befunda, bangenza izithombe zengqondo zezinto noma izinto eziphilayo futhi bacabange izinguquko kuzo, noma ukuziphatha kwazo, futhi balindele imiphumela. Ngaphezu kokucubungula okubonakalayo, ukufunda kwengqondo kukhuliswa nangokukhumbula okuhlangenwe nakho kwangaphambilini, ukuthinta izinto ezibonakalayo, imisindo yokuzwa, ukunambitha ukudla, kanye nezinye izinto eziningi ezisekelwe ezinzwa. Ukufunda kwengqondo kunamandla kangangokuthi kungasetshenziswa ukuqonda ukulungiswa kwesimo ngokuningiliziwe. Esimweni esiphambene, ukulungiswa kwesimo akukwazi ukusiza umuntu afunde ngokuqonda.

 Umsebenzi wakudala wokufunda kwengqondo wenziwa nguWolfgang Köhler ngama-chimpanzee. Wabonisa ukuthi lezi zilwane zazikwazi ukucabanga okungaqondakali ngokubonisa ukuthi zingafunda ukuxazulula iphazili. Lapho ubhanana ulenga ekhejini lawo phezulu kakhulu ukuba angafinyeleli kuwo, futhi amabhokisi amaningana ebekwa ngokungahleliwe phansi, amanye ama-chimp akwazi ukufaka amabhokisi elinye phezu kwelinye, akhuphuke phezu kwawo, bese ethola ubhanana. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ayengawubona umphumela wokufaka amabhokisi ngisho nangaphambi kokuba enze isenzo. Lolu hlobo lokufunda lunamandla kakhulu futhi luguquguqukayo kunokulungisa isimo.

 Ukufunda kwengqondo akukhawulelwe kuma-primates, yize kuyiwona aphumelela kakhulu ekuwusebenziseni. Ukuhlolwa kokugijima kwe-maze okwenziwe ngamagundane ngu-H.C. Blodgett ngawo-1920 kwaba okokuqala ukukhombisa amakhono okuqonda esilwaneni esilula esincelisayo. Isisusa sezilwane ukuba zisebenze ngendlela yazo phakathi kwe-maze kwakuwukudla ekugcineni. Kulezi zifundo, izilwane eziseQenjini I zaziqhutshwa ekuhlolweni okukodwa ngosuku futhi zazinokudla okutholakala kuzo nsuku zonke lapho ziqeda ukugijima (Isithombe 36.43). Amagundane aseQenjini II awazange adliwe ku-maze ezinsukwini eziyisithupha zokuqala futhi ukugijima okulandelayo kwenziwa ngokudla okuqala ngosuku lwesikhombisa. Amagundane eQembu III awazange ondliwe izinsuku ezimbili, futhi aqala ukugijima nokudla ngosuku lwesithathu. Imiphumela yaba ukuthi amagundane alawulayo, iQembu I, afunda ngokushesha, futhi athola indlela yokugijima i-maze ezinsukwini eziyisikhombisa. IQembu III alizange lifunde okuningi phakathi nezinsuku ezimbili ngaphandle kokudla, kodwa lasheshe lafinyelela eqenjini elilawulayo lapho linikezwa umvuzo wokudla. IQembu II lafunda kancane kakhulu ezinsukwini eziyisithupha ngaphandle komvuzo wokulikhuthaza, futhi alizange liqale ukufinyelela eqenjini elilawulayo kwaze kwaba usuku lokunikezwa kokudla, kwabe sekuthatha izinsuku ezimbili isikhathi eside ukufunda i-maze.

 Kungase kungabonakali ngokushesha ukuthi lolu hlobo lokufunda luhlukile kune-conditioning. Nakuba umuntu angase alingeke ukukholelwa ukuthi amagundane afunde nje indlela yokuthola indlela yawo ochungechungeni oluhlelekile lokujika kwesokudla nakwesobunxele, u-E.C. Tolman wafakazela eminyakeni eyishumi kamuva ukuthi amagundane ayenza umfanekiso we-maze ezingqondweni zawo, awubiza ngokuthi imephu yokuqonda.” Lokhu kwakuyisibonakaliso sokuqala samandla okufunda kwengqondo nokuthi la makhono ayengagcini nje kubantu.
question1: Kuyini ukufunda kwengqondo?
answer1: Ukuphathwa kolwazi kusetshenziswa ingqondo ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuthola ulwazi
distractor1b: Uhlobo lokufunda okungahlanganyeli olusekelwe ekuvezweni okuphindaphindiwe
question2: Kungani ukufunda kwengqondo kubhekwa njengokunamandla kakhulu kune-classical noma i-operating conditioning?
answer2: Ivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zicabange, zibone ngeso lengqondo imiphumela, futhi zixazulule izinkinga ezintsha
question3: Yiliphi ikhono elithuthukisa kakhulu ukufunda kwengqondo kubantu?
answer3: Ukuthuthukiswa kolimi oluyinkimbinkimbi
question4: Ngaphandle kokubona, yikuphi okulandelayo okungathuthukisa ukufunda kwengqondo?
answer4: Ukukhumbula okuhlangenwe nakho kwangaphambilini kanye nezinye izinto ezithinta imizwa njengokuthinta nomsindo
question5: Yini uWolfgang Köhler ayibonisa ngezinkawu?
answer5: Babengaxazulula izinkinga ngokucabanga okungaqondakali ngokubeka amabhokisi ukuze bafinyelele ibhanana
distractor5b: Babengaxazulula izinkinga kuphela ngemva kwemiklomelo eminingi yokudla
question6: Ukuhlolwa kokufaka ibhokisi kwasikiselani ngama-chimpanzee?
answer6: Babengasibona ngeso lengqondo isisombululo ngaphambi kokusifeza
distractor6a: Baxazulule umsebenzi ngokuphelele ngokuzama nokwenza amaphutha
distractor6c: Badinga enye i-chimpanzee ukuthi ibonise ikhambi kuqala
question7: Ukuhlolwa kwe-maze ye-H.C. Blodgetts kwabonisani ngamagundane?
answer7: Amagundane anamakhono okufunda ngokucabanga futhi angathuthuka ngokushesha uma eshukunyiswa yimivuzo
question8: Yini u-E.C. Tolman ayiphakamisayo ukuthi yenziwe amagundane ngesikhathi ehlola i-maze?
answer8: Imephu yokuqonda ye-maze
question9: Kungani umqondo kaTolman wemephu yokuqonda wawubalulekile?
answer9: Kwabonisa ukuthi izilwane zingakha izethulo zangaphakathi zengqondo zendawo ezikuyo
distractor9a: Kwafakazela ukuthi abantu kuphela abangaxazulula izinkinga zendawo
distractor9b: Kubonise ukuthi ukufunda i-maze kuncike ngokuphelele ekuzilungiseleleni
distractor9c: Kubonise ukuthi inkumbulo ayidlali indima ekuzulazuleni

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | I-Sociobiology
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.7 I-Biology Yokuziphatha: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha | I-Sociobiology
chapterContent:
I-Sociobiology iyisayensi ehlanganisa imikhakha eyaqala ukuthandwa ngumcwaningi wezinambuzane zomphakathi u-E.O. Wilson ngawo-1970. UWilson wachaza isayensi njengokwandiswa kwebhayoloji yabantu kanye nombono wokuziphendukela kwemvelo enhlanganweni yezenhlalo.”9 Inhloso eyinhloko ye-sociobiology ukuthi ukuziphatha kwezilwane nabantu, okuhlanganisa nolaka nokunye ukuxhumana kwezenhlalo, kungachazwa cishe kuphela ngokwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokukhetha kwemvelo. Le sayensi iyaphikisana; ososayensi abadumile njengoStephen Jay Gould ongasekho bagxeke indlela yokungazinaki imiphumela yemvelo ekuziphatheni. Lesi esinye isibonelo sempikiswano yemvelo ngokumelene nokukhulisa indima yezakhi zofuzo uma kuqhathaniswa nendima yendawo ekunqumeni izici zezinto eziphilayo.

 I-Sociobiology iphinde ixhumanise izakhi zofuzo nokuziphatha futhi ihlotshaniswa nokunqunywa kwezinto eziphilayo,” inkolelo yokuthi zonke izindlela zokuziphatha zifakwe ezakhiweni zethu zofuzo. Akekho ophikisanayo ngokuthi ezinye izindlela zokuziphatha zingazuzwa njengefa nokuthi ukukhetha kwemvelo kudlala indima ekuzigcineni. Ukusetshenziswa kwezimiso ezinjalo ekuziphatheni kwabantu okubangela le mpikiswano, ehlala isebenza nanamuhla.

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 36. I-Ecology Yabantu kanye Nomphakathi | 36.9 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
36.1 Izibalo Zabantu
Izibalo zabantu zingabantu bohlobo oluthile oluhlala endaweni ethile yokuhlala. Izazi zemvelo zilinganisa izici zezibalo zabantu: usayizi, ubuningi, iphethini yokusabalala, isakhiwo seminyaka, kanye nesilinganiso sobulili. Amathebula okuphila awusizo ekubaleni ukulindela ukuphila kwamalungu oluntu ngabanye. Ama-curve okusinda akhombisa inani labantu abasindayo ngesikhathi ngasinye sobudala esidwetshwe ngokuhambisana nesikhathi.

 36.2 Imlando Yokuphila Nokukhethwa Kwemvelo
Zonke izinhlobo zithuthukise iphethini yokuphila, ebizwa ngokuthi isu lomlando wokuphila, lapho zihlukanisa khona amandla okukhula, ukugcinwa, kanye nokuzala. Lawa maphethini aguquka ngokukhethwa kwemvelo; avumela izinhlobo ukuba zivumelane nendawo yazo ukuze zithole izinsiza ezizidingayo ukuze zizale ngempumelelo. Kukhona ubudlelwano obuphambene phakathi kokuzala nokunakekelwa kwabazali. Uhlobo lungazala lusencane ukuze luqinisekise ukuthi luphila luze lufike esikhathini sokuzala noma luzale kamuva empilweni ukuze lube lukhulu futhi luphile kahle futhi lukwazi kangcono ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwabazali. Uhlobo lungazala kanye (ngokulingana) noma izikhathi eziningi (iteroparity) empilweni yalo.

 36.3 Imikhawulo Yezemvelo Ekukhuleni Komphakathi
Izibalo zabantu abanezinsiza ezingenamkhawulo zikhula ngokushesha, ngesivinini sokukhula esisheshayo. Lapho izinsiza ziba nomkhawulo, izibalo zabantu zilandela umugqa wokukhula kwe-logistic. Isibalo sabantu bezinhlobo ezithile sizolingana namandla okuthwala emvelo yaso.

 36.4 Ukuguquguquka Komphakathi Nokulawulwa
Izibalo zabantu zilawulwa yizici ezahlukahlukene ezincike ekuxineni nasekuxineni. Izinhlobo zihlukaniswe ngezigaba ezimbili ngokusekelwe ezicini ezahlukahlukene zamaphethini omlando wazo wokuphila: izinhlobo ezikhethiwe ngo-r, ezinenani elikhulu lenzalo, kanye nezinhlobo ezikhethiwe ngo-K, ezinenzalo encane. Ithiyori yokukhetha ngo-r kanye no-K ayisasetshenziswa; noma kunjalo, izici zayo eziningi ezibalulekile zisasetshenziswa kumamodeli amasha, asekelwe ekubalweni kwabantu ezinguquko zomphakathi.

 36.5 Ukukhula Komphakathi Wabantu
Isibalo sabantu emhlabeni sikhula ngesivinini esikhulu. Abantu bandise amandla okuthwala emhlabeni ngokufuduka, ezolimo, intuthuko yezokwelapha, kanye nokuxhumana. Isakhiwo sobudala sabantu sisenza sikwazi ukubikezela ukukhula kwabantu. Ukukhula kwabantu okungalawulwa kungaba nemiphumela emibi yesikhathi eside endaweni yethu.

 36.6 I-Community Ecology
Imiphakathi ihlanganisa zonke izinhlobo ezahlukene ezihlala endaweni ethile. Izinhlobonhlobo zalezi zinhlobo zibizwa ngokuthi ukuceba kwezinhlobo. Izinto eziphilayo eziningi ziye zakha ukuzivikela ekuhlaselweni yizilwane kanye nokudla utshani, okuhlanganisa ukuzivikela kwemishini, umbala oxwayisayo, kanye nokulingisa, ngenxa yokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nokusebenzisana namanye amalungu omphakathi. Izinhlobo ezimbili azikwazi ukuba khona endaweni efanayo zincintisana ngqo nezinsiza ezifanayo. Izinhlobo zingakha ubudlelwano bokubambisana njenge-commensalism noma i-mutualism. Isakhiwo somphakathi sichazwa ngesisekelo saso kanye nezinhlobo ezibalulekile. Imiphakathi isabela ekuphazamisekeni kwemvelo ngokulandelana (ukubonakala okubikezelwayo kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zezitshalo) kuze kube yilapho isakhiwo somphakathi esizinzile sisungulwa.

 36.7 I-Behavioral Biology: Izimbangela Eziseduze Nezokugcina Zokuziphatha
Ukuziphatha kuyizimpendulo ezishukumisayo. Kungaba ukuziphatha okungokwemvelo/okuzalwa, okungathonywa yindawo ezungezile, noma ukuziphatha okufundiwe, okuthonywa izinguquko zendawo. Ukuziphatha okungokwemvelo kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuhlangana kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana. Ukuziphatha okufundiwe kuhlanganisa ukuphrinta kanye nokujwayela, ukulungisa, kanye, ngamandla amakhulu, ukufunda kokuqonda. Nakuba ukuxhumana phakathi kokuziphatha, izakhi zofuzo, kanye nokuziphendukela kwemvelo kusungulwe kahle, incazelo yokuziphatha komuntu njengokwakhi zofuzo ngokuphelele iyaphikiswana.

question73: Umcwaningi anganquma kanjani ubukhulu benani labantu kanye nobuningi benani lezinyoni esiqhingini saseHawaii?

question74: Imiphakathi emibili ingaba kanjani nobuningi babantu obufanayo kodwa ibe namaphethini okusabalala ahlukene?

question75: Inani labantu linabantu abaningi abasebasha kakhulu kodwa bambalwa kakhulu abantu abavuthiwe ngokocansi. Yimuphi umbono ongcono kakhulu kanye nophenyo lokulandelela?

question76: Iyiphi ingozi indlovu ebhekene nayo ngokutshala imali ekunakekelweni kwabazali isikhathi eside?

question77: Isu lokuzala lezinyosi zoju likuthuthukisa kanjani ukusinda kwalezi zinhlobo?

question78: Izinhlobo ezimbili zezitshalo zichitha cishe inani elifanayo lamandla ekuzaleni, kodwa enye ikhiqiza imbewu eningi kanti enye ikhiqiza embalwa kuphela. Yini okungenzeka ukuthi iyiqiniso?

question79: I-rmax ingahluka kanjani phakathi kwendlovu ne-flea, futhi lokhu kungathinta kanjani izifundo zabantu?

question80: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.47. Le datha iqoqwe ngenani lamabhungane eFlorida. Ngokusekelwe kudatha, ungakuchaza kanjani ukukhula kwenani labantu kuleli cala futhi ubikezela ini ngokukhula kwaleli nani esikhathini esizayo?

question81: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kunganciphisa kanjani amandla okuthwala abantu abathile ngenkathi kwandisa amandla okuthwala abanye?

question82: Qhathanisa umthethonqubo oxhomeke ekuxineni nasekuxineni usebenzisa inani lezibungu njengesibonelo

Isibulala-zinambuzane siyisibonelo sokulawulwa okungaxhomekeki ekuminyaneni kanti ukushoda kokudla kungukulawulwa okuxhomeke ekuminyaneni.
distractor82b: Zombili yizimo zemvelo ezibangela ushintsho enanini labantu. Izinto ezingaxhomekile ekuminyaneni zinomphumela ofanayo kuzo zonke izinhlobo zabantu kanti izinto ezixhomeke ekuminyaneni zinemiphumela ehlukile. Isibulala-zinambuzane sithinta kuphela izibungu uma inani lazo liphansi, kuyilapho ukushoda kokudla kunciphisa inani labantu.
distractor82c: Zombili yizimo zemvelo ezibangela ushintsho enanini labantu. Izinto ezingaxhomekile ekuminyaneni zinomphumela ofanayo kuzo zonke izinhlobo zabantu kanti izinto ezixhomeke ekuminyaneni zinemiphumela ehlukene. Isibulala-zinambuzane sibulala izibungu kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zingakanani, kuyilapho ukushoda kokudla kubangela ukuthi inani lezibungu lande.
question83: Kungani ixoxo, uhlobo olukhethiwe ngo-r, linganakekeli inzalo yalo ngendlela impisi, uhlobo olukhethiwe ngo-K, enakekela ngayo?
answer83: Amaxoxo achitha amandla amaningi ukukhiqiza inani elikhulu labantwana, ngakho-ke awanakho okwanele ukuwanakekela
distractor83a: Amaxoxo akhethwe yizindawo ezizinzile nezibikezelwayo, ngakho-ke awadingi ukunakekela abantwana bawo njengezimpisi
distractor83b: Amaxoxo asebenzisa amandla amancane kakhulu ukukhiqiza inani elikhulu labantwana, ngakho-ke awasasele ngokwanele ukuwanakekela.
distractor83c: Izilwane ezincane ezifana namaxoxo azinandaba nenzalo yazo ngoba eziningi ziyakhiqizwa, kanti izilwane ezinkulu njengezimpisi zikhiqiza ezimbalwa kuphela
question84: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.48. Le grafu ikhombisa inani lama-sea otter endaweni ethile e-Alaska. Ubungalindela ukuthi inani labantu libe yini ngo-2020 ngokusekelwe kule grafu?
answer84: Ngaphansi kuka-26,000, ngoba inani lezinkawu likhuphuke ngaphezu komthamo wokuthwala ngo-2010
distractor84a: Cishe angu-30,000, okuyisilinganiso sokuthwala ama-otter kulesi sifunda.
distractor84b: Cishe angu-40,000 ngoba ama-otter abhekene nokukhula okubonakalayo
distractor84c: Cishe ziyi-26,000, ngoba akunakwenzeka ukuthi inani lezinkawu lingakhula ngale kwaleli nani.
question85: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.49. Le grafu ikhombisa iphiramidi yabantu baseJapan. Ngokusekelwe kule grafu, yenza isimangalo ngokukhula kwabantu baseJapan
question86: I-Industrial Revolution yaqala ngokusungulwa kwenjini yomusi. Cishe ngesikhathi esifanayo, inani labantu laqala ukwanda kakhulu. Chaza ukuthi lezi zenzakalo ezimbili zihlobene kanjani nomqondo wokuthi abantu bayakwazi ukushintsha amandla okuthwala indawo abakuyo.
answer86: Ukusungulwa kwenjini yomusi kwenza abantu bakwazi ukusebenzisa imishini ukwenza imisebenzi yokulima. Inani lezinsiza ezitholakalayo ezidingekayo ukuze kusekelwe ukuphila kwabantu landa ngokusungulwa kwemishini. Lokhu kwanda kwezinsiza kwakhuthaza ukukhula okukhulu kwenani labantu.
distractor86a: Ukusungulwa kwenjini yomusi kwenza abantu bakwazi ukuthuthukisa izinhlobo zezitshalo ezingamelani nezinambuzane. Inani lezinsiza ezitholakalayo ezidingekayo ukuze kusekelwe ukuphila kwabantu landa ngokusungulwa kwemishini. Lokhu kwanda kwezinsiza kwakhuthaza ukukhula okukhulu kwenani labantu.
distractor86b: Inani lezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kusekelwe ukuphila kwabantu lehla ngokusungulwa kwemishini, kodwa amandla okuthwala ayanda. Lokhu kwanda kwamandla okuthwala kwakhuthaza ukukhula okukhulu kwenani labantu.
distractor86c: Ukusungulwa kwenjini yomusi kwenza indawo ikwazi ukuguqulwa ngokwezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kulawulwa kwezimo zemvelo kwakhuthaza ukukhula kwabantu ngokushesha okukhulu.
question87: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.50. Lo mdwebo ukhombisa isakhiwo seminyaka yezwe. Hlaziya isakhiwo seminyaka bese usisebenzisela ukubikezela isimo sezomnotho saleli zwe. Chaza isizathu sakho
answer87: Leli lizwe kungenzeka libe yizwe elingakathuthuki kwezomnotho ngoba linentsha eningi kakhulu kanye nabantu abadala abambalwa kakhulu.
distractor87a: Leli lizwe kungenzeka libe yizwe elithuthukayo kwezomnotho ngoba linenani elilinganayo labantu bazo zonke izigaba zobudala.
distractor87b: Leli lizwe kungenzeka libe yizwe elithuthukile kwezomnotho ngoba linentsha eningi kakhulu kanye nabantu abadala abambalwa kakhulu.
distractor87c: Leli lizwe kungenzeka libe yizwe elithuthukile kwezomnotho ngoba linenani elilinganayo labantu bazo zonke izigaba zobudala.
question88: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.51. Umhlaba wonke uchaza indawo yomhlaba edingekayo ukuze kuhlinzekwe zonke izinsiza ezisetshenziswa yibo bonke abantu. Le grafu ikhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwesikhathi kanye nomhlaba wonke ulinganiswa ngenani lamaplanethi oMhlaba. Hlaziya igrafu, bese uyisebenzisa ukuchaza ukuthi kube yini umphumela wokushintsha kwenani labantu kuze kube manje. Bese ubikezela imiphumela yokushintsha kwenani labantu esikhathini esizayo.
answer88: Indawo ekhona eMhlabeni yokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zethu idlule inani labantu. Uma inani labantu liqhubeka nokwanda, inani labantu elitholakala emvelweni lizokhula kakhulu ngaphezu kwamandla oMhlaba okusekela inani labantu futhi inani labantu lingawa.
distractor88a: Imithombo yamanzi ekhona eMhlabeni idlule inani labantu. Uma inani labantu liqhubeka nokwanda, inani labantu elitholakala emvelweni lizokhula kakhulu ngaphezu kwamandla oMhlaba okusekela inani labantu futhi inani labantu lingancipha.
distractor88b: Indawo ekhona eMhlabeni yokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zethu idlule inani labantu. Uma inani labantu liqhubeka nokwanda, amazinga okuzalwa nokufa azoncipha futhi inani labantu bethu lingancipha.
distractor88c: Imithombo yamanzi ekhona eMhlabeni idlulelwe inani labantu. Uma inani labantu liqhubeka nokwanda, amazinga okuzalwa nokufa azoncipha futhi inani labantu bethu lingancipha.
question89: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.52. Le grafu ikhombisa umjikelezo wezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane ezizingelayo zezimpisi kanye ne-moose. Chaza ukuthi kungani amagrafu engafani namagrafu afanele asetshenziswa njengezibonelo zomjikelezo wezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane ezizingelayo.
answer89: Le grafu ibonisa wonke amathonya kuzo zombili lezi zinhlobo zabantu ngaphezu kwethonya lezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane
distractor89a: Le grafu ibonisa wonke amathonya kuzo zombili lezi zinhlobo zabantu, kodwa hhayi amathonya ezidla ezinye izilwane
distractor89b: Le grafu ibonisa ithonya lokuxhumana kwezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane kuzo zombili lezi zinhlobo zabantu.
distractor89c: Le grafu ibonisa eminye yemithonya kuzo zombili izakhamuzi ngaphandle kwethonya lezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane
question90: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.53. Le grafu ikhombisa inani lezimpisi kanye ne-elk eYellowstone Park eminyakeni enikeziwe. Yikuphi ukukhetha okuchaza i-variable exhomeke, noma i-variable encike, kule grafu?
question91: I-downy woodpecker kanye ne-hairy woodpecker zihlala endaweni efanayo kodwa zondla ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlobana kanjani nomgomo wokukhipha izilwane ezincintisanayo?
answer91: Zombili zihlala endaweni efanayo futhi zifana ngandlela thile, kodwa azitholi ukudla kwazo ezindaweni ezifanayo endaweni efanayo. Ngale ndlela, lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zingahlala ndawonye endaweni efanayo.
distractor91a: Zombili lezi zinyoni ezinezimpondo zinesakhiwo esifanayo somlomo, kodwa azikwazi ukuthola ukudla kwazo ezindaweni ezifanayo endaweni yokuhlala. Azincintisani ngokuqondile ngokudla futhi ngaleyo ndlela, zingahlala ndawonye endaweni efanayo.
distractor91b: Zombili zihlala endaweni efanayo futhi zifana ngandlela thile, kodwa zithola ukudla kwazo ezindaweni ezifanayo endaweni efanayo. Ngale ndlela, lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zingahlala ndawonye endaweni efanayo.
distractor91c: Zombili iziqophamithi zifana ngendlela efanayo ezimilweni zazo zomlomo. Ngakho-ke, zincintisana ngokuqondile ngokudla. Lokhu kuhlobene ngqo nesimiso sokuncintisana sokukhipha abanye
question92: Izinyosi zoju ziyizinambuzane ezithutha impova. Hlobo luni lobudlelwano bokubambisana obukhona phakathi kwezinyosi zoju nezitshalo eziqhakazayo?
answer92: Lobu ubuhlobo obuvumelanayo, ngoba izinyosi zisiza izitshalo ukuthi zithole impova, bese zithola umpe ezitshalweni.
distractor92a: Lokhu kungukubambisana ngoba izinyosi zisiza izitshalo ukuthi zithole impova, bese zithola umpe ezitshalweni.
distractor92b: Lobu ubuhlobo obuvumelanayo, ngoba izinyosi zithola umpe ezitshalweni, kodwa azinikezi izinzuzo ezitshalweni.
distractor92c: Lokhu kungukubumbana, ngoba izinyosi zithola umpe ezitshalweni, kodwa azinikezi izinzuzo ezitshalweni.
question93: Izinja zasePrairie zibhekwa njengezinhlobo ze-keystone ngenxa yokumba kwazo kanye nendima yazo njengezilwane ezidla ezinye. Kungani lezi zici zinikeza izinja zasePrairie indima ye-keystone?
answer93: Ngaphandle kwezinja zasezindaweni zasemakhaya, imvelo ingabhidlika ngenxa yokuntuleka kwesivikelo nendawo yokukhosela yezilwane ezincane kanye nokuntuleka kwezinyamazane zokondla izilwane ezinkulu ezidla ezinye izilwane.
distractor93a: Izinja zasePrairie zihlinzeka ngesivikelo kanye nendawo yokuhlala yezilwane ezincane futhi zilimaza izilwane ezizingelayo endaweni yemvelo
distractor93b: Izinja zasePrairie zimba imigodi engaphansi komhlaba, zinciphisa umoya enhlabathini futhi zivimbele ukukhula ngokweqile kwezitshalo ngaphezu komhlabathi
distractor93c: Imigodi yezinja zasezindaweni ezingaphansi komhlaba ihlinzeka ngendawo yokukhosela kwezinye izinhlobo zezilwane kanye nokuvikelwa ezitheni, kodwa ivimbela ukukhula kwezitshalo ngaphezu komhlabathi.
question94: Bheka Umfanekiso 36.54. Izinhlobo ezimbili ezahlukene zama-parrot ezizalanayo ngezinye izikhathi zikhulisa amaphuphu ndawonye. Izingcingo zazo ze-alamu kanye nezingcingo zokuthintana kufanele zihlukaniswe kanjani?
answer94: Ukukhala kwe-alamu kuyindlela yokuziphatha engokwemvelo kanti ukukhala kokuxhumana kuyindlela yokuziphatha efundwayo. Ukuziphatha okungokwemvelo kuvela ngokuzenzakalelayo ngenxa yesizathu esithile kuyilapho ukuziphatha okufundiwe kukhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngemva kokubona ezinye izinyoni zenza lokhu kuziphatha.
distractor94a: Ukukhala kwe-alamu kuyindlela efundwayo kanti ucingo lokuxhumana luyindlela ezalwa nayo. Ukuziphatha okufundiwe kukhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngemva kokubuka izinyoni zenza lokhu kanti ukuziphatha okuzalwa nakho kuphuma ngokuzenzakalelayo ngenxa yesizathu esithile.
distractor94b: Ukukhala kwe-alamu kuyindlela yokuziphatha engokwemvelo kanti ucingo lokuxhumana luyindlela yokuziphatha efundwayo. Ukuziphatha okungokwemvelo kukhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngenxa yokuvuselelwa ngemva kokuchayeka njalo. Ukuziphatha okufundiwe kukhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngemva kokubuka ezinye izinyoni zenza ukuziphatha kwazo.
distractor94c: Ukushaya i-alamu kuyindlela efundwayo kanti ucingo lokuxhumana luyindlela ezalwa nayo. Ukuziphatha okufundiwe kuvela ngokuzenzakalelayo kanti ukuziphatha okuzalwa nakho kukhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngenxa yokuvuselelwa ngemva kokuchayeka njalo.
question95: Ukukhetha kwemvelo cishe kwakuhileleke kanjani ekuthuthukisweni kwempendulo yokulwa noma yokubaleka kubantu?
answer95: Abantu ababonisa ukuziphatha kokulwa noma kokubaleka babenamathuba amaningi okusinda kunabantu abangenalo lolu phawu. Ngakho-ke, abantu abasindile badlulisela lesi sici kubantwana babo kuyilapho abangasindile bengasindi. Ngakho-ke, le mpendulo yafakwa ohlwini lwabantu.
distractor95a: Abantu ababonisa ukuziphatha kokulwa noma kokubaleka babenamathuba amaningi okusinda kunabantu abangenalo lelo phawu. Lesi sici sakhethwa ngokungahleliwe ngokukhetha kwemvelo, ngaleyo ndlela safakwa ngokukhethekile ohlwini lwabantu.
distractor95b: Abantu ababonisa ukuziphatha kokulwa noma kokundiza babenamathuba amaningi okusinda kunabantu abangenalo leso sici. Izinguquko ezingazelelwe, ezizuzwa njengefa zakhethwa ngokwemvelo, ezazihlanganisa ukuziphatha kokulwa noma kokundiza. Ngakho-ke, le mpendulo yafakwa ohlwini lwabantu.
distractor95c: Abantu ababonisa ukuziphatha kokulwa noma kokundiza babengenamandla kakhulu kunabantu abangenalo lolu hlobo lwesici. Kodwa-ke, lesi sici sakhethwa ngokukhetha kwemvelo ngenxa yesenzakalo esingahleliwe ekuvameni kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu ababonisa ukuziphatha kokulwa noma kokundiza.
question96: Isilwane esidla ezinye safakwa kwelinye lamathangi amabili axhunyiwe, kodwa izinhlanzi kuzo zombili amathangi zabonisa ukuziphatha okuthusayo. Lokhu kungachazwa kanjani?
answer96: Izinhlanzi ezisethangini ezathola isilwane esidla ezinye zakhipha izimpawu zokuxwayisa ngesimo samakhemikhali. Lezi zinhlanzi zajikeleza zaze zafika kwelinye ithangi, okwabangela impendulo yokuxwayisa ezinhlanzini ezazilapho.
distractor96a: Izinhlanzi ezisethangini ezathola isilwane esidla ezinye zakhipha izimpawu zokuxwayisa ngesimo sezimpawu zikagesi. Lezi zinombolo amakhilogremu zajikeleza zaze zafika kwelinye ithangi, okwabangela impendulo yokuxwayisa ezinhlanzini ezazilapho noma kunjalo.
distractor96b: Isilwane esidla ezinye sangenisa kwelinye ithangi lezinhlanzi ezikhishwe izimpawu ze-alamu ngesimo samakhemikhali. Lezi com amakhilogremu zajikeleza zaze zafika kwelinye ithangi, okwabangela impendulo ye-alamu enhlanzini lapho noma kunjalo.
distractor96c: Izinhlanzi ezisethangini ezingayitholanga inyamazane zakhipha izimpawu zokuxwayisa ngesimo samakhemikhali. Lezi zinhlanzi zajikeleza zafika kwelinye ithangi futhi zabangela impendulo yokuxwayisa evela ezinhlanzini.
question97: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.55. Ucwaningo luhlole ubudlelwano phakathi kokusinda kwamathole kanye nokukhanya kwezimpaphe zesilisa kuma-cardinal anezimbobo ezibomvu. Yisiphi isimangalo esisekelwa kangcono yidatha?
answer97: Ukuba nezimpaphe ezikhanyayo kuyisibonakaliso sokuqina komzimba kuma-cardinal esilisa anezinsika ezibomvu
