question98: Ama-sandpiper ezinsikazi anamabala ayalwa ukuze athole izindawo zokuzalela ezicebile ngezinsiza. Yiluphi uhlelo lokuzalela okungenzeka ukuthi lusebenza kakhulu kulolu hlobo?
answer98: Ukuzalana kwe-polyandrous cishe kuyasebenza njengoba izinsikazi zakha izindawo ezihlukile kwezinye izinsikazi. Izinsikazi zizodonsela izinsikazi ezinsizakalweni ezizilawulayo okuzoholela ekutheni izinsikazi eziningi zidonseleke kwezimbalwa ezinsikazi ezinezindawo ezicebile kakhulu.
distractor98a: Ukuhlangana kwe-polygynous cishe kuyasebenza njengoba abesifazane bezakhela izindawo ezihlukile kwezinye izinsikazi. Izinsikazi ezivela kuzo zonke izindawo zingadonsela izinsikazi ezinsizakalweni abazilawulayo, okuzoholela ekutheni izinsikazi ezimbalwa zidonseleke ezinsikazini eziningi endaweni ngayinye.
distractor98b: Ukuzalana kwezilwane eziningi cishe kuyasebenza njengoba izinsikazi zakha izindawo ezihlukile kwezinye izinsikazi. Izinsikazi ezivela kuzo zonke izindawo zingadonsela izinsikazi ezinsizakalweni ezizilawulayo, okuzoholela ekutheni izinsikazi ezimbalwa zidonseleke ezinsikazini eziningi endaweni ngayinye.
distractor98c: Ukuhlangana kwe-polygynous cishe kuyasebenza njengoba abesifazane bezakhela izindawo ezihlukile kwezinye izinsikazi. Izinsikazi zizodonsela izinsikazi ezinsizakalweni abazilawulayo okuzoholela ekutheni izinsikazi eziningi zidonseleke kwezimbalwa ezinsikazi ezinezindawo ezicebile kakhulu.
question99: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle izivivinyo zezinja zikaPavlovs njengesibonelo sesimo semvelo sakudala?
answer99: UPavlov wayeshaya insimbi noma nini lapho inja ilethwa ukudla, okwakukhipha amathe ngenxa yokubona noma iphunga lokudla. Ngokusebenzisa indlela yakudala yokulungisa, inja yaqala ukuphendula lapho insimbi ikhala ngamathe njengoba inja yayihlanganisa umsindo wensimbi nokufika kokudla.
distractor99a: UPavlov wabonisa ukuqina kwesimo semvelo ngokuhlola ukugijima kwe-maze nenja. Isisusa sokuba inja idlule ku-maze kwakuwukudla ekugcineni kwe-maze. Inja yayigijima kanye ngosuku futhi yayinokudla okutholakalayo ekupheleni kokugijima.
distractor99b: UPavlov walengisa ingcezu yenkukhu ekhejini eliphakeme kakhulu ukuba inja ingalifinyelela futhi amabhokisi amaningana abekwa ngokungahleliwe phansi. Ekugcineni inja yakwazi ukuqoqa amabhokisi yakhwela phezulu ukuze ithole ingcezu yenkukhu ngendlela ejwayelekile.
distractor99c: UPavlov wafaka inja ebhokisini elikhulu elaline-lever eyayizonika inja ukudla uma icindezelwa. Nakuba ekuqaleni inja yayicindezela i-lever izikhathi ezimbalwa ngengozi, ekugcineni yahlobanisa ukusunduza i-lever nokuthola ukudla ngendlela yokulungisa yakudala.
question100: Umcwaningi waphawula amafudu amancane angu-200 ngemva kokuchamisela. Cishe angu-80% asinda ngemva konyaka owodwa, angu-60% eqembu lokuqala asinda ngemva kweminyaka emibili, kanti angu-40% asinda ngemva kweminyaka emithathu. Yiliphi ijika lokusinda elichaza kangcono leli nani?
answer100: Ijika lokusinda lohlobo lwesibili ngoba inani labasindile lehla ngenani elifanayo (20%) minyaka yonke.
distractor100a: Ijika lokusinda lohlobo I ngoba inani labasindile lehla ngenani elifanayo (20%) minyaka yonke.
distractor100b: Ijika lokusinda lohlobo lwesibili ngoba inani labasindile likhuphuka ngenani elifanayo (20%) minyaka yonke.
distractor100c: Ijika lokusinda lohlobo lwe-IV ngoba inani labasindile lehla ngenani elifanayo (20%) minyaka yonke.
question101: Ngemva kokubamba intulo esanda kutholakala ezindaweni eziningi ehlathini, yimuphi omunye umbuzo wesayensi umcwaningi angawuphendula esebenzisa idatha esiqoqiwe kakade?
answer101: Kungakanani ukusatshalaliswa kwenani lalolu hlobo lwensalami kule ndawo ezungezile?
distractor101a: Lingakanani izinga lokukhula kwenani lalolu hlobo lwensalami kule ndawo ezungezile?
distractor101b: Yiziphi izinhlobo zezilwane ezidla lolu hlobo lwensalami kule ndawo ezungezile?
distractor101c: Yiziphi izinsiza ezingezona eziphilayo ezibalulekile ukuze lolu hlobo lwensalami luqhubeke nokuhlala kule ndawo ezungezile?
question102: Bheka Umfanekiso 36.56. Izinhlobo zomiyane eBrazil zingashintsha kanjani uma izimo zihlala zingaphezu kuka-30°C futhi zingaphansi kuka-60% womswakama isikhathi eside?
answer102: Inani lomiyane lizoncipha, mhlawumbe lifinyelele ku-zero. Njengoba amazinga okushisa angaphezu kuka-30°C ewumkhawulo ophezulu wezinsikazi ezizalayo, ukukhiqizwa kwenzalo kuzokwehla. Izimo ezomile zingenza okufanayo.
distractor102a: Inani lomiyane lizoncipha uma amazinga okushisa engaphezu kuka-30°C, njengoba lokhu kungumkhawulo ophezulu wezinsikazi ezizalayo, okuholela ekwehleni kokukhiqizwa kwenzalo. Ngaphansi komswakama ongu-60% akukho shintsho olukhulu oluzobonakala enanini lomiyane.
distractor102b: Isibalo somiyane sizohlala sinjalo. Lokhu kungaba ngenxa yokuthi izinga lokushisa elingaphezu kuka-30°C kanye nomswakama ongaphansi kuka-60% kufana nezimo ezinhle zokukhiqizwa kwenzalo yizinsikazi ezizalayo.
distractor102c: Isibalo somiyane sizohlala sinjalo emazingeni okushisa angaphezu kuka-30°C njengoba amazinga okushisa aphezulu ngeke athinte ukukhiqizwa kwenzalo ephilayo yizinsikazi ezibelethayo. Izimo ezomile, ezingaphansi kuka-60% womswakama, zingabangela ukwehla kwesibalo sabantu, njengoba kungumkhawulo ophansi wokukhiqizwa kwenzalo.
question103: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.57. Abacwaningi baqhathanisa izinyoni ezindaweni ezinamazinga ahlukene okudlisa izimvu. Njengoba zonke izinyoni zidla kakhulu izinambuzane, yimuphi umbuzo wesayensi owengeziwe ongathuthukisa kangcono ucwaningo?
answer103: Ingabe ukudla kwezimvu kwenza izinambuzane zitholakale kalula ezinyonini? Lo mbuzo ulungisa umbuzo mayelana nokuthi ukudla kwezimvu kuthinta kanjani inani lezinyoni ngoba ubuza ngokuqondile ukuthi ukudla kwezimvu kushintsha kanjani ukutholakala kokudla kwezinyoni.
distractor103a: Ukufuya izimvu kwenza kanjani izinambuzane zitholakale kalula ezinyonini? Lo mbuzo ulungisa umbuzo mayelana nokuthi ukufuya izimvu kuthinta kanjani inani lezinambuzane ngoba ubuza ngokuqondile ukuthi ukufuya izimvu kushintsha kanjani ukutholakala kokudla kwezinambuzane.
distractor103b: Ingabe ukudla kwezimvu kwenza izinambuzane zitholakale kalula ezinyonini? Lo mbuzo ulungisa umbuzo mayelana nokuthi ukudla kwezimvu kuthinta kanjani inani lezinyoni ngoba ubuza ngokuqondile ukuthi ukudla kwezimvu kushintsha kanjani ukutholakala kokudla kwezinambuzane.
distractor103c: Ukufuya izimvu kwenza kanjani izinambuzane zitholakale kalula ezinyonini? Lo mbuzo ulungisa umbuzo mayelana nokuthi ukufuya izimvu kuthinta kanjani inani lezinyoni ngoba ubuza ngokuqondile ukuthi ukufuya izimvu kushintsha kanjani ukutholakala kokudla kwezinambuzane.
question104: Indawo ezungezile ichibi ensimini evulekile kancane kancane iba nomthunzi ngokuphelele njengoba izihlahla zikhula nxazonke. Qagela ukuthi yini engase yenzeke endaweni ezungezile ichibi
answer104: Ubukhulu benani lazo zonke izinto eziphilayo buzoncipha ngenxa yokwehla kwamandla ageleza echibini.
distractor104a: Ubuningi bazo zonke izinto eziphilayo buzokhula ngenxa yokushisa okuphansi echibini
distractor104b: Ukusabalala kwenani lezinto eziphilayo ezinkulu kuzoshintsha kusuka ekuqongeleleni kuye kokungahleliwe ngenxa yokwehla kwamandla ageleza echibini.
distractor104c: Ukusabalala kwenani lezinto eziphilayo ezincane kuzoshintsha kusuka kokufana kuya kokuqongelela ngenxa yokushisa okuphansi echibini.
question105: Umcwaningi uthole ukuthi uhlobo lwezimbali zasendle lunokusabalala okufanayo kulo lonke idlelo. Yimuphi umbuzo wesayensi olandelayo ongathuthukisa kangcono ukuqonda kwale ndlela yokusabalala?
answer105: Ingabe lolu hlobo lwezimbali zasendle lukhipha noma yimaphi amakhemikhali avimbela ukukhula kwezinye izinhlobo zalo?
distractor105a: Lolu hlobo lwesitshalo luqhakaza nini futhi luheha kanjani abathuthi bempova?
distractor105b: Ingabe lolu hlobo lwezimbali zasendle lunezindlela zokuzivikela ezisebenza ukuvikela lesi sitshalo ezifweni ezidla uhlaza?
distractor105c: Yiziphi izinhlobo zezinambuzane kanye/noma izinyoni ezithwala impova kulolu hlobo lwezimbali zasendle?
question106: Izimpukane zezithelo ezimelana namazinga okushisa abandayo zinokuzala okuncane ekuqaleni kokuphila kunezimpukane ezingamelani namakhaza. Iyiphi incazelo engaba khona yalolu hlobo lwephethini?
answer106: Izimpukane ezinezimpawu ezishintsha amandla okuzala okuqala ukuze zigcine amandla amaningi emizimbeni yazo zathandwa ngokukhethwa kwemvelo ngoba zasinda emakhazeni kangcono kunezimpukane ezazingenazo lezi zimpawu.
distractor106a: Ezimweni ezibandayo, izimpukane azidingi ukuzala kakhulu kunasezimweni ezifudumele ngakho-ke amandla avame ukusetshenziswa ekuzaleni adluliselwa kweminye imisebenzi yokusinda.
distractor106b: Izimpukane zisabela ezimweni zezulu ukuze zishintshe izinsiza zazo zamandla ziye ekugcineni emizimbeni yazo emakhazeni noma ekuzaleni lapho izimo ziphinde zifudumala futhi.
distractor106c: Zonke izimpukane zezithelo zinezakhi zofuzo ezifanayo, kodwa ziveza amaphethini ahlukene ezakhi zofuzo ngaphansi kwezimo ezahlukene, okuholela ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile ezimweni ezibandayo kanye nezinye ezimweni ezifudumele.
question107: Bheka Umfanekiso 36.58. Izinyoni zabesifazane ezithwala amaqanda zibeka amaqanda azo ngaphakathi kwemizimba yezibungu. Izibungu ziyafa lapho amaqanda eqandusela, kanti izinyoni ezincane zidla umzimba wesibungu. Izinyoni zabesifazane ezithwala amaqanda zezinhlobo ezimbili zezinyoni zabantwana ezithwala amaqanda zifundwe emakamelweni okukhula akhethekile lapho umthombo wokudla unikezwa khona noma ushiywe khona. Leli thebula lifingqa eminye yemininingwane eqoqwe. Thola isitatimende esivumelana kakhulu nale datha
answer107: Uma ukutholakala kwamandla kuphansi, abesifazane basusa amandla ekuzaleni bawayise ekuziphileni kwabo.
distractor107a: Uma ukutholakala kwamandla kuphansi, abesifazane basebenzisa amandla amaningi kunokujwayelekile ekuzaleni inzalo
distractor107b: Uma ukutholakala kwamandla kuphezulu, abesifazane bazala abantwana abaphila kahle kakhulu
distractor107c: Uma ukutholakala kwamandla kuphezulu, abesifazane abakwazi ukuzala abantwana abaphilayo futhi baqhubeke nokuphila kwabo.
question108: Ngesikhathi sokuzala, ama-elk amaningi ezinsikazi ahlangana namaduna, kodwa akuzona zonke izinsikazi ezikhulelwe. Ama-elk ezinsikazi anamafutha omzimba angaphansi kuka-6% atholakale enamathuba ancishisiwe kakhulu okukhulelwa kune-elk ezinsikazi anamafutha omzimba angaphezu kuka-10%. Chaza ukuthi ukukhetha kwemvelo kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi kwakuhilelekile ekusunguleni lesi sici kuma-elk. (ikhredithi: USGS Northern Prairie Wildlife Research Center)
answer108: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kuthanda ukukhethwa kwezici ezivimbela ukukhulelwa kuma-elk ezinsikazi anamafutha aphansi, ngakho-ke lesi sici sesivame kakhulu emihlambini yama-elk emvelo ebonwa namuhla.
distractor108a: Ngokukhethwa kwemvelo, ama-elk ezinsikazi ayengenawo amandla okuthwala ukukhulelwa futhi engakhulelwanga ayefa kanti lawo ayekhulelwa ayethandwa.
distractor108b: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kushintsha ngokungahleliwe imvamisa yezakhi zofuzo okuvumela izici ezivimbela ukukhulelwa kuma-elk ezinsikazi anamafutha aphansi ukuthi athandwe.
distractor108c: Ukukhethwa kwemvelo kuholela ekushintsheni okungazelelwe kwe-genome ye-elk yesifazane, okuqinisekisa ukuthi i-elk yesifazane inamafutha amaningi ukuze ikwazi ukukhulelwa ngempumelelo.
question109: Ucwaningo nge-elk eYellowstone National Park lwenziwe ukuze kutholakale ukuthi isimo somzimba sithinta kanjani ukusinda kwe-elk ezinyangeni zasebusika. Kutholakale ukuthi amathuba okusinda kwe-elk yesifazane makhulu uma eseqongelele amafutha omzimba angu-15% noma ngaphezulu ekupheleni kwekwindla. I-elk yesifazane enamafutha omzimba angaphansi kuka-10% ngasekupheleni kwekwindla kutholakale ukuthi isengozini enkulu yokungasindi ebusika. Chaza ukuthi kungani le ndlela ingase ibonwe. (ikhredithi: USGS Northern Prairie Wildlife Research Center)
answer109: Ebusika, ukutholakala kokudla kuyancipha. Ngakho-ke, kudingeka kube nesilinganiso esithile samandla imizimba yabo ewagcina ngendlela yamafutha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bayaphila.
distractor109a: Ebusika, ukutholakala kokudla kuyanda. Ngakho-ke, kufanele kube nesilinganiso esithile samandla emizimbeni yabo esigcinwe ngendlela yamafutha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bayaphila.
distractor109b: Ebusika, isidingo sokudla sama-elk siyanda ngenxa yokwanda kwemisebenzi yokugaya ukudla. Ngakho-ke, kufanele kube nezinga elithile lamandla emizimbeni yawo eligcinwe ngendlela yamafutha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ayaphila.
distractor109c: Ama-elk akhipha amandla engeziwe ebusika. Ngakho-ke, kufanele kube nesilinganiso esithile samandla emizimbeni yawo agcinwe ngendlela yamafutha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ayaphila.
question110: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.59. Ithebula liqukethe amazinga okuzalwa kanye namazinga okufa kwezinhlobo eziningana zezilwane ezihlala endaweni efanayo. Hlaziya idatha ukuze ukhombe inani labantu elibhekene noshintsho olubi ngobukhulu benani labantu.
question111: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.60. Le datha yaqoqwa ngobukhulu benani lezinhlobo zezitshalo ezikhula esifundeni phakathi neminyaka ngemva kokuba isikhukhula sibhubhise indawo. Chaza ukuthi idatha ikhombisani ngaleli nani.
answer111: Inani labantu lakhula kakhulu eminyakeni embalwa yokuqala futhi kamuva laba yizinto ezidingekayo njengoba izinga lehla. Inani labantu ekugcineni lazinza ngemva kokufinyelela inani eliphakeme labantu abangu-120, okungaba umthamo wokuthwala wendawo.
distractor111a: Inani lezitshalo landa kakhulu eminyakeni edlule njengoba inani lezitshalo landa ngesivinini esikhulu. Inani lazo lagcina lizinzile ngemva kokufinyelela inani eliphakeme lezitshalo ezingu-120, okungaba umthamo wokuthwala imvelo.
distractor111b: Inani lezitshalo lakhula ngokwezinto ezidingekayo eminyakeni edlule njengoba izinga lokukhula kwenani labantu lehla. Inani lazo lagcina lizinzile ngemva kokufinyelela inani eliphakeme lezinhlobo ezingu-120, okungaba umthamo wokuthwala imvelo.
distractor111c: Inani labantu lakhula kakhulu eminyakeni embalwa yokuqala futhi kamuva laba yizinto ezidingekayo njengoba izinga lehla. Inani labantu ekugcineni lazinza ngemva kokufinyelela inani labantu abangu-116, okungaba umthamo wokuthwala imvelo.
question112: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.61. Le grafu ikhombisa isisindo esilinganiselwe sezithelo zama-strawberry uma kuqhathaniswa nobuningi bezinyosi endaweni. Yisiphi isimangalo esingenziwa ngokusekelwe kule grafu?
answer112: Ubuningi bezinyosi bukhulisa isisindo esimaphakathi sezithelo zama-strawberry
distractor112a: Ubuningi bezinyosi bunciphisa isisindo esimaphakathi sezithelo zama-strawberry
distractor112b: Ubuningi bezinyosi kanye nesisindo sezithelo zama-strawberry akuhlobene
distractor112c: Ukunaba kwezinyosi kungathinta noma kungabi nomthelela esisindweni sezithelo zama-strawberry. Kudingeka ucwaningo olwengeziwe
question113: Iqembu lokulondolozwa kwemvelo lithi ukugawulwa kwezihlahla endaweni yemvelo yehlathi kuzonciphisa amandla okuthwala ama-trout ahlala emfudlaneni. Yimuphi idatha engaqinisekisa noma iphikise lesi simangalo kangcono?
answer113: Qoqa idatha ngenani lama-trout emfuleni ngaphambi nangemva kokusika, okuzonikeza inkomba yokuthi isimangalo sifanelekile noma cha.
distractor113a: Izinga lokukhula kwezinhlanzi ezincane emfudlaneni ngaphambi nangemva kokugawulwa kwezihlahla lizonikeza inkomba yokuthi isimangalo sifanelekile noma cha.
distractor113b: Hlola izinga lokufa kwezinhlanzi ezincane emfuleni ngemva kokwethulwa kokugawulwa kwemithi, okuzosetshenziselwa ukuthethelela noma ukuphikisa isimangalo.
distractor113c: Qoqa idatha ngenani lama-trout emfuleni ngemuva kokwethulwa kokugawulwa kwemithi, okuzonikeza inkomba yokuthi isimangalo sifanelekile noma cha.
question114: Bika ukuthi ushintsho lwabantu eminyakeni engama-50 ezayo luzothinta kanjani imvelo yasolwandle
answer114: Ukwanda kokukhishwa kwamagesi okushisa okushisa kungenzeka, kanye nokwanda kwamazinga okushisa olwandle okubangela ushintsho kubantu basolwandle
distractor114a: Abantu bazonciphisa amandla abo okuthwala, okuzophinde kunciphise amandla okuthwala ezindawo zemvelo zasolwandle.
distractor114b: Ukuncipha kokudoba kungalindeleka, okuzoholela ekukhuleni kwenani lezinhlanzi kanye nezindawo zemvelo zasolwandle ezinempilo
distractor114c: Ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo ezindaweni zemvelo zasolwandle kuzokhula njengoba abantu besebenzisa ubunjiniyela ukwandisa ukukhiqizwa kokudla olwandle
question115: Ingakanani imfucuza evela emisebenzini yabantu engase ishintshe eminyakeni engama-50 ezayo, futhi lokhu kungathinta kanjani imvelo?
answer115: Inani lemfucuza ekhiqizwa imisebenzi yabantu lizokhula ngokushesha njengoba inani labantu liqhubeka nokwanda ngokushesha. Ukususwa kwemfucuza kuzodinga ukwehla kwezindawo zokuhlala, okuzoholela ekunciphiseni inani lezinhlobo ezincike kulezo zindawo zokuhlala.
distractor115a: Inani lemfucuza ekhiqizwa imisebenzi yabantu lizokhula ngokushesha njengoba inani labantu liqhubeka nokwanda ngokushesha. Ukususwa kwemfucuza kuzodinga ukwanda kwezindawo zokuhlala, okuzoholela ekwandeni okukhulu kwezinhlobo zezinhlobo ezincike kulezo zindawo zokuhlala.
distractor115b: Inani lemfucuza ekhiqizwa imisebenzi yabantu lizoncipha kakhulu njengoba inani labantu liqhubeka nokwanda kakhulu. Ukususwa kwemfucuza kuzodinga ukwanda kwezindawo zokuhlala, okuzoholela ekwandeni okukhulu kwezinhlobo zezinhlobo ezincike kulezo zindawo zokuhlala.
distractor115c: Inani lemfucuza ekhiqizwa imisebenzi yabantu lizoncipha kakhulu njengoba inani labantu liqhubeka nokwanda kakhulu. Ukususwa kwemfucuza kuzodinga ukwehla kwezindawo zokuhlala, okuzoholela ekunciphiseni inani lezinhlobo ezincike kulezo zindawo zokuhlala.
question116: Inkampani ifuna ukufuya izimbaza ngendlela eqhubekayo esizalweni somfula futhi iphakamisa ukuthi ukutholakala kwe-phytoplankton kuyisici esivimbelayo. Yimuphi idatha engathethelela noma ephikisa lesi siphakamiso kangcono?
answer116: Ama-biomass ezinhlobo zezimbaza zemvelo kanye nezinhlobo ze-phytoplankton esizalweni somfula anqunywa ngezikhathi eziningi ezahlukene.
distractor116a: Amazinga okukhula kwezimila zezimbaza ezisanda kusungulwa elebhu ngaphansi kwamazinga ahlukene e-phytoplankton
distractor116b: Ukushintsha kwenani le-phytoplankton esizalweni somfula ngenxa yobukhulu kanye nobude bokukhanya kwelanga
distractor116c: Ukulinganiswa kwelebhu kwe-phytoplankton biomass ngokuphendula inani lezimbaza ezengeziwe
question117: Inyoka engenabo ubuthi inombala ofiphele endaweni eyodwa kanye nombala okhanyayo ofana nenyoka yendawo enobuthi kwenye. Yimuphi umklamo wokuhlola ongahlola kangcono ukuthi umbala okhanyayo uyi-Batesian mimicry?
answer117: Yenza izivivinyo zelebhu lapho izilwane ezidla ezinye ezijwayelene nenyoka enobuthi zinikezwa khona izilwane ezibuthakathaka kanye nezilwane ezinemibala egqamile ukuze ubone ukuthi izilwane ezidla ezinye zibonisa yini ukukhetha.
distractor117a: Yenza izivivinyo zasensimini lapho abantu abamnyama kanye nabantu abanemibala egqamile bebanjwa khona bese beshintshwa baye endaweni yomunye ukuze ubone ukuthi bangaki abasindayo.
distractor117b: Yenza izivivinyo zasensimini lapho kufakwa khona amakhamera evidiyo ukuze aqophe izilwane ezidla ezinye ezithumbile kanye nezilwane ezinemibala egqamile ezindaweni zazo zomdabu
distractor117c: Yenza izivivinyo zelebhu lapho izilwane ezidla ezinye ezijwayelene nezinyoka ezinombala ofiphele ezingenabo ubuthi zinikezwa izilwane ezinombala okhanyayo onobuthi kanye nezilwane ezinombala okhanyayo ezingenabo ubuthi ukuze kubonakale ukuthi izilwane ezidla ezinye zibonisa ukukhetha.
question118: Umcwaningi angahlola kanjani ukuthi amaxoxo ezinsikazi ayazibona yini izinhlanzi ezidla ezinye ngamakhemikhali akhishwa emanzini?
answer118: Hlela izitsha zamanzi lapho amanzi angabiwa khona ngokukhululekile phakathi kwezingxenye ezimbili. Izinhlanzi ziqukethwe ngaphakathi kwengxenye eyodwa kanye namaxoxo kwenye ukuze amaxoxo ngakolunye uhlangothi angakwazi ukubona noma ukuzwa izinhlanzi ngakolunye uhlangothi. Qaphela futhi uqhathanise ukuziphatha kwamaxoxo ezinsikazi lapho kukhona futhi kungekho izinhlanzi ezidla ezinye ethangini lezinhlanzi.
distractor118a: Hlela izitsha zamanzi lapho amanzi angabiwa khona ngokukhululekile phakathi kwezindawo ezimbili. Izinhlanzi namaxoxo ziqukethwe ngaphakathi kwendawo eyodwa ukuze amaxoxo angakwazi ukubona noma ukuzwa izinhlanzi. Qaphela futhi uqhathanise ukuziphatha kwamaxoxo ezinsikazi lapho kukhona futhi kungekho izinhlanzi ezidla ezinye.
distractor118b: Hlela izitsha zamanzi lapho amanzi angabiwa khona ngokukhululekile phakathi kwezingxenye ezimbili. Izinhlanzi namaxoxo ziqukethwe ngaphakathi kwengxenye eyodwa ukuze amaxoxo akwazi ukubona noma ukuzwa izinhlanzi. Qaphela futhi uqhathanise ukuziphatha kwamaxoxo ezinsikazi lapho kukhona futhi kungekho izinhlanzi ezidla ezinye ethangini lezinhlanzi.
distractor118c: Hlela izitsha zamanzi lapho amanzi angabiwa khona ngokukhululekile phakathi kwezingxenye ezimbili. Izinhlanzi ziqukethwe ngaphakathi kwengxenye eyodwa kanye namaxoxo kwelinye ukuze amaxoxo ngakolunye uhlangothi akwazi ukubona noma ukuzwa izinhlanzi ngakolunye uhlangothi. Qaphela futhi uqhathanise ukuziphatha kwamaxoxo ezinsikazi lapho kukhona futhi kungekho izinhlanzi ezidla ezinye ethangini lezinhlanzi.
question119: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.62. Igrafu ikhombisa imiphumela yocwaningo oluhilela izitshalo zepelepele. Izitshalo zepelepele zinezintuthwane ezihlala kuzo. Izintuthwane zidla izibungu ezidla amaqabunga ezitshalo zepelepele. Abacwaningi bethula ezinye izintuthwane kwezinye zezitshalo zepelepele. Izintuthwane zadla izintuthwane, zanciphisa inani lazo. Abacwaningi base beqoqa idatha endaweni engaphezulu kweqabunga lezihlahla lapho kwafakwa khona izintuthwane kanye nemithi eyayingenazo izintuthwane. Yenza isimangalo ngalolu cwaningo
question120: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.63. Uhlobo lwezinkonko zasolwandle lutholakala emanzini angajulile eduze nogu lolwandle. Lo mnkonko udla imfucuza phansi kolwandle. Abacwaningi baqaphele ukuthi izinkonko endaweni eyodwa zazinokubukeka okunamabala, kanti izinkonko kwenye indawo zazinombala oqinile. Abacwaningi bamisa izindawo esifundeni ngasinye ukuze zifundwe base bekhipha izinkonko ezinebala kanye neziqinile esifundeni sezinkonko eziqinile futhi bakhipha izinkonko ezinebala kanye neziqinile esifundeni sezinkonko ezinebala. Izinga lokusinda kwenhlobo ngayinye lilinganisiwe. Imiphumela ifingqiwe kuleli thebula. Yakha umbono ongaba khona ochaza le datha. Chaza ukucabanga kwakho
answer120: Umbono ongaba khona ukuthi umbala we-snake uwukuzivumelanisa nesimo sokuzifihla ukuze kuvikelwe i-snake ezitheni ezihlala endaweni yayo. Iminenke enamabala ingcono kakhulu ukufihlwa endaweni yayo yemvelo futhi ivelele ezitheni ezidla ezinye futhi ihlushwa kakhulu uma ibekwa endaweni evame ukuhlala iminenke eqinile.
distractor120a: Umbono ongaba khona uwukuthi umbala we-snake uncike ezimweni zemvelo. Ukufihlwa kwe-snake kokubili enezinti ezinamabala kanye ne-slid kungcono kakhulu ezimweni zemvelo ezinhle futhi akushintshi ngokuya ngesifunda lapho zibekwe khona.
distractor120b: Umbono ongaba khona ukuthi umbala we-snake uwukuzivumelanisa nesimo sokuzifihla ukuze kuvikelwe i-snake ezitheni ezihlala endaweni eyihlaselayo. Iminenke enamabala ingcono kakhulu ukufihlwa endaweni yeminenke eqinile futhi ivelele ezitheni ezidla ezinye futhi ihlushwa kakhulu uma ibekwa endaweni yayo yemvelo.
distractor120c: Umbono ongaba khona ukuthi umbala womnenke uwukuzivumelanisa nesimo sokucasha ukuze kuvikelwe umnenke ezitheni ezidla ezinye endaweni yawo. Izinti eziqinile zicasha kangcono endaweni yezinti ezinamabala futhi zibonakala kakhulu ezitheni ezidla ezinye uma zibekwe endaweni yazo yemvelo.
question121: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.64. Igrafu ifingqa idatha ephathelene nezinhlobo ezine ezahlukene zezibankwa ezihlala ezindaweni ezishisayo. Qagela ukuthi lezi zinhlobo zizokwazi kanjani ukuhlala ndawonye uma zihlala endaweni efanayo yendawo eshisayo.
answer121: Uhlobo D luzohlala kahle nanoma yiluphi olunye uhlobo ngoba lolu hlobo ludla izinhlobo zokudla ezihluke ngokuphelele.
distractor121a: Zonke izinhlobo zezilwane zizohlala ndawonye ngoba zidla ukudla okufanayo
distractor121b: Izinhlobo A, B, kanye no-C zizohlala ndawonye kangcono ngenxa yokufana kwazo ngobuningi kanye nohlobo lokudla okudliwayo
distractor121c: Izinhlobo A kanye no-B zizohlala ndawonye kangcono ngoba zihambisana kakhulu ekudleni
question122: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.65. Ama-Warbler ayiqembu lezinyoni ezincane eziculayo eziqukethe izinhlobo eziningi. Ithebula lifingqa idatha eqoqwe ngokudla kwezinhlobo ezimbili zama-warbler. Ngaphezu kwalokho, zombili izinhlobo u-A no-B zisebenzisa izinhlobo ezifanayo zezinto zokwakha izidleke kanye nezindawo zokwakha izidleke. Isazi sezinto eziphilayo siphawula ukuthi izinhlobo u-A nohlobo u-B zihlala kakhulu ezindaweni ezahlukene zehlathi entshonalanga yeCanada. Ngesikhathi somlilo wehlathi owaqothula isifunda esasihlala kuso, izinhlobo u-B zabalekela esifundeni esasihlala kuso izinhlobo u-A. Qagela ukuthi yini engase yenzeke kulezi zinhlobo ezimbili esikhathini esizayo. Chaza isizathu sakho
answer122: Uhlobo olulodwa kuphela lwalezi oluzosinda kulesi sifunda ngenxa yezidingo zokudla ezihambisanayo kanye nendawo yokuhlala. Uhlobo olulahlekelwayo luzofa noma luthuthele kwesinye isifunda.
distractor122a: Zombili lezi zinhlobo zizosinda ngenxa yokwehluka kwezidingo zokudla kanye nendawo yokuzalela.
distractor122b: Uhlobo A luzokwanda ngenani labantu kanti uhlobo B luzohlala lufana ngenxa yezidingo zokudla kanye nendawo yokuhlala.
distractor122c: Uhlobo olulodwa kuphela lwalezi oluzosinda kulesi sifunda ngenxa yomehluko wezidingo zokudla nendawo yokuzalela. Uhlobo olulahlekelwayo luzofa noma luthuthele kwesinye isifunda.
question123: Bheka Umfanekiso 36.66. Ama-blackberry aseHimalaya ayizinhlobo ezihlaselayo ezisakazeke ehlathini lasePacific Northwest. Izitshalo ziveza imicu emikhulu yomoba embozwe ameva amboza umhlabathi ngomcamelo oqinile. Izazi zemvelo zicabanga ukuthi ama-blackberry aseHimalaya asusa izinhlobo zezihlahla zemvelo ngokuzala ngokushesha nangokunciphisa izindawo ezitholakalayo zokukhula. Baqopha ubuningi bama-blackberry nama-salmonberry endawo, isihlahla sendaweni, emfuleni iminyaka eminingana. Izindawo ezingaphansi komhlaba ezimbozwe ama-blackberry nezihlahla zemvelo zadwetshwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ngokusekelwe kugrafu, yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle indima yama-blackberry endaweni efundwayo?
distractor123b: Izihlahla zama-blackberry kanye nezihlahla ze-salmonberry aziphazamisi ukukhula kwazo
question124: Bika ukuthi izimiso zemvelo ezindaweni ezisenyakatho kakhulu zomhlaba zizothinteka kanjani ushintsho lwabantu eminyakeni engama-50 ezayo
answer124: Inani lezinto eziphilayo ezihlala kulezi zindawo njengamanje lizoshintsha njengoba ukufudumala komhlaba kubangela ukuthi izinhlobo eziningi zezilwane zinciphe futhi izinhlobo ezintsha zithuthele kuzo.
distractor124a: Ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kulezi zifunda ezisenyakatho kuzohlala kufana njengoba abantu bezothola ezinye izindawo zokuhlala ukuze bagcine inani labo elikhulayo.
distractor124b: Umthamo walezi zindawo kubantu uzoncipha njengoba inani labantu landa ngokushesha.
distractor124c: Izinhlelo zemvelo zingalindelwa ukuthi zingathintwa abantu njengoba kuthuthukiswa ubuchwepheshe obusha ukuze kusekelwe inani labantu elikhulayo
question125: Umcwaningi unesifiso sokuhlola ukuthi iphethini yokubhonga ekhiqizwa abesilisa ohlotsheni lwamaxoxo iwukuziphatha okufundiwe noma ukuziphatha okungokwemvelo. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungasiza umcwaningi ukuphendula lo mbuzo kangcono?
answer125: Ukuqoshwa komsindo kwamaxoxo ngamanye esekhulile ngokobulili ngemva kokukhuliswa eyedwa ngokuphelele
distractor125a: Ukuhlaziywa kwezakhi zofuzo zamaxoxo amadala amadala akhuliswe ngokwawo kanye nasemiphakathini yamaxoxo ezizukulwane eziningi
distractor125b: Ukuqashelwa kwamaxoxo amadala ensimini endaweni yawo yokuhlala ngesikhathi sokuzalana
distractor125c: Amavidiyo aqoshiwe amaxoxo ngamanye akhuliswe emiphakathini emikhulu yamaxoxo ezizukulwane eziningi
question126: Isazi sezinto eziphilayo sicabanga ukuthi izinyoni zezinhlobo ezahlukene ziyaqaphela izixwayiso zezinye izinhlobo zezinyoni. Isazi sezinto eziphilayo simise izindawo zokudla eziningana ehlathini lapho izinyoni ziza khona ukuzondla njalo. Zisakazeke endaweni ebanzi, okwenza kube nzima ukubona wonke amabhokisi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Chaza ukuthi isazi sezinto eziphilayo singayisebenzisa kanjani le sayithi ukuqoqa idatha ukuhlola umbono wakhe
answer126: Isazi sezinto eziphilayo singasebenzisa amakhamera evidiyo ukuqopha ukuziphatha kwezinyoni eziza ezitolo zokudla
distractor126a: Isazi sezinto eziphilayo singashiya irekhoda yomsindo eduze kwezindawo zokondla
distractor126b: Isazi sezinto eziphilayo singaqopha ukuziphatha kwezinyoni ngokuziqhathanisa nezinye izinyoni ngokusebenzisa amakhamera evidiyo
distractor126c: Isazi sezinto eziphilayo sasingabuka izinyoni njalo inyanga eyodwa
question127:
Bheka Umfanekiso 36.67. Ama-buntings aphuzi yizinyoni ezidla ama-butterflies, okuhlanganisa ne-Aglaisurticae, uhlobo lwe-butterflies olunombala ogqamile oyindilinga ephikweni lalo olubizwa ngokuthi i-eyespot. Izazi zezinto eziphilayo ziye zacabanga ukuthi ama-eyespot alingisa amehlo e-owl. Ama-owls ayizilwane ezidla ama-buntings aphuzi.

 Ekuhlolweni kwelabhorethri kusetshenziswa ama-buntings aphuzi abanjwe endle futhi agcinwa ekuthunjweni, izinyoni ngazinye zabonwa ngesikhathi seseshini lapho zanikwa khona ama-butterflies angazange aphathwe noma ayelashwe ukuze asuse ama-buntings awo. Ama-buntings aphuzi anikezwa amaphuzu ngokuya ngokuthi abonise ukuziphatha kokubaleka lapho ehlangana nama-butterflies azo zombili izinhlobo. Idatha yahlanganiswa etafuleni. Le datha iyisekela kanjani isimangalo sokuthi impendulo yohlobo olulodwa kolwazi ingathinta ukukhethwa kwemvelo kolunye uhlobo?
answer127: Ukuqhathaniswa kwenani lezinyoni ezibalekela izimvemvane ezinezimbobo zamehlo nezingenazo kusikisela ukuthi kuye kwakhethwa izimvemvane esikhundleni sesici sembobo yamehlo, esilingisa isilwane esidla inyama sale nyoni.
distractor127a: Ukuqhathaniswa kwenani eliphelele lezinyoni ezihlangane nazo kubonisa ukuthi izinyoni eziningi zasabela endaweni yamehlo, okuyisici okungenzeka ukuthi sizokhethwa ngokumelene naso ezinhlotsheni zemvelo zebhabhathane.
distractor127b: Ukuqhathaniswa kwenani lezinyoni ezihlasela izimvemvane ezinezimbobo zamehlo nezingenazo kusikisela ukuthi ukuba khona kwembobo yamehlo kwenza izimvemvane zibonakale kakhulu ezizingelayo okuholela ekukhethweni ngokumelene nalesi sici.
distractor127c: Ukuqhathaniswa kwenani lezinyoni ezibalekela izimvemvane ezinezimbotshana zamehlo nezingenazo kubonisa ukuthi isici sembotshana yamehlo asithandwa ngoba lesi sici senza izimvemvane zivelele ezizingelayo.
question128:
Bheka uMfanekiso 36.68. Inyoni encane yenza izinhlobo ezintathu ezahlukene zezingcingo: Ukukhala kwesixuku okwenziwa yiqembu labantu abadala lapho behlasela inyoni eyodwa edla ezinye izilwane ukuze bavikele izidleke zabo, ukukhala kwesixuku okwenziwa yinyoni eyodwa ukuze iphazamise inyoni edla ezinye izilwane ehlezi eduze, kanye nokukhala kwesilumkiso okwenziwa yinyoni eyodwa ukuze ixwayise ezinye izinyoni lapho inyoni edla ezinye izilwane indiza iye endaweni eseduze.

 Ucwaningo luhlaziye imvamisa yemisindo yezingcingo ezahlukene. Ithebula lifingqa okutholakele.

 Ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi, yenza isimangalo mayelana nezingcingo ezenziwa yinyoni encane. (ikhredithi: Behavioral Ecology and Sociobiology)
answer128: Ukukhala kwesixwayiso akukwazi ukuzwakala yizinyoni ezinkulu ezidla ezinye izilwane. Lokhu kunikeza izinyoni ezincane isixwayiso esithuthukisiwe. Lesi yisici esihle esinikeza izinyoni ithuba lokusinda.
distractor128a: Ukukhala kokuthethisa akukwazi ukuzwakala ezinye izinyoni ezincane. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ukukhala kokuthethisa kuhlose inyoni enkulu. Akukho nzuzo kwezinye izinyoni ezincane ezikuzwayo.
distractor128b: Ukubuthana kwezinyoni ezinkulu ezidla ezinye izilwane kungazwakala. Ngakho-ke izinyoni ezincane azikwazi ukuvikela izidleke zazo ngaphandle kokuba izilwane ezidla ezinye zazi. Lesi yisici esingathandeki futhi sikhethwa ngokwemvelo.
distractor128c: Ukukhala kokuthethisa akukwazi ukuzwakala yizinyoni ezinkulu. Ngakho-ke, ukukhala kokuthethisa akusebenzi kahle enjongweni yakho. Lesi yisici esingathandeki, kodwa izinyoni ezincane zisenaso
question129: Yisiphi kulezi zitatimende ezilandelayo esisekela ngqo isimangalo sokuthi ukufuduka kwe-Monarch butterfly kuyisenzakalo esilawulwayo?
answer129: Izinguquko zobude bosuku zibangela izinguquko zamahomoni kanye nesistimu yezinzwa kumaMonarchs eziholela ezinguqukweni zokuziphatha
distractor129a: Izimvemvane ze-Monarch zindiza amakhilomitha angaba ngu-3 000 ukusuka endaweni yazo yasehlobo eNyakatho Melika ziye endaweni yazo yasebusika eMexico.
distractor129b: Ngenxa yokuthi isikhathi sokuphila kovemvane iMonarch sifushane kakhulu, akuzona zonke izizukulwane zamaMonarch ezifudukayo
distractor129c: Izibungu zeMonarch zidla i-milkweed kuyilapho izimvemvane ezindala zidla i-nectar yezimbali
question130:
Bheka Umfanekiso 36.69. Izinkomo zasendle zihamba amakhilomitha angaphezu kuka-1800 minyaka yonke zifuna utshani obuvuthiwe. Ucwaningo luqhathanise inani lemvula kanye nezinga lokusinda kwezinkomo zasendle ezindala. Igrafu ikhombisa okutholakele kuzo. Imigoqo ikhombisa inani lemvula kanti umugqa ukhombisa izinga lokusinda.

 Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi
answer130: Isilinganiso sokusinda silandela imvula cishe inyanga eyodwa. Imvula iyisici esiyinhloko esithinta ukusinda kwezilwane zasendle.
distractor130a: Ijika lokusinda alithintwa yimvula. Imvula ayiyona into ebalulekile ekusindeni kwezilwane zasendle
distractor130b: Ijika lokusinda lifana ncamashi nejika lemvula. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukutholakala kwamanzi okuphuza kuyisici esiyinhloko ekusindeni kwezilwane zasendle.
distractor130c: Ukusinda kwezilwane zasendle kuthinteka kabi yimvula eningi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imvula iletha izingozi ezingenakugwenywa yizilwane zasendle.
question131: Ezinye izindlela zokuziphatha zezilwane zingashintshwa ngokuhlangenwe nakho. Yikuphi kokulandelayo okubikezela ngokunembile ukuthi into ethile eyenzeka okuhlangenwe nakho ingathinta kanjani ukuziphatha kwesilwane?
answer131: Amabhere athola ukudla kubantu kamuva anamathuba amaningi okungena ezindaweni zokuhlala zabantu kunamabhere angasondelwa ngabantu
distractor131a: Uhlobo lwe-salmon luzohamba luye emfuleni ofanayo kungakhathaliseki ukwanda kwezilwane ezidla ezinye ezivakashela le misele yamanzi kusukela ngonyaka kuya kolandelayo.
distractor131b: I-elk yesifazane eyayinezinkinga zokuzala amathole izoqhubeka nokuzala nabesilisa ezinkathini zokuzala ezilandelayo
distractor131c: Inyoni ekhuliswe eqandeni ehlukaniswe endaweni yelabhorethri izokhipha i-alamu efanayo nezinyoni zohlobo olufanayo ezikhuliswe endle.
question132: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.70. Isithombe sibonisa ubukhulu obuqhathaniswayo bendlovu kanye ne-brontosaurus, idayinaso enkulu eyayiyisilwane esidla uhlaza. Ngokusekelwe esimweni se-brontosaurus, yenza isimangalo mayelana nokuziphatha kwayo kokufuna ukudla. (Umthombo wesithombe: I-Encyclopedia Britannica)
answer132: I-brontosaurus yayizosebenzisa intamo yayo ende ukufinyelela izitshalo endaweni ebanzi. Yayizonciphisa ukunyakaza komzimba wayo ngoba ukuhambisa umzimba omkhulu kangaka kungabiza amandla amaningi.
distractor132a: I-brontosaurus yayizohamba amabanga amade ngosuku, ihlale ihamba. Imilenze yayo ejiyile yayizoyivumela ukuthi inyakazise umzimba wayo omkhulu ngaphandle komzamo omkhulu.
distractor132b: Imilenze yangemuva emikhulu futhi ejiyile isho ukuthi i-brontosaurus yayikwazi ukuhamba ngokushesha okukhulu. Ngakho-ke, i-brontosaurus yayizohamba phakathi kwezindawo zezitshalo ngendlela esheshayo.
distractor132c: Intamo ende ye-brontosaurus isho ukuthi izitshalo zazikhulela amaqabunga aphezulu kakhulu kunezikhathi zanamuhla. I-brontosaurus yayizofinyelela ezindaweni eziphakeme ngokwandisa intamo yayo ende nomzimba wayo omude.
question133: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.71. Ama-salamander akhiqiza amakhemikhali amakhilogremu asebenza njengezinkomba zokuxwayisa. Esifundweni, amanye ama-salamander alimele. Uketshezi lomzimba oluvela kuma-salamander alimele lwasetshenziswa ukumanzisa amathawula ephepha. Kwabe sekuthi, amanye amabhokisi abekwe kolunye uhlangothi ngamathawula ephepha amanzi ngoketshezi oluvela kuma-salamander alimele kanti kolunye uhlangothi ngamathawula ephepha amanzi ngompompi kuphela. Ama-salamander anempilo abekwa phakathi kwebhokisi futhi abonwa. Kwabe sekuthi, kwenziwa ukuhlolwa okufanayo ngoketshezi lomzimba oluvela kuma-salamander anempilo. Ithebula lifingqa imiphumela. Yisiphi kwezitatimende ezilandelayo esiwukuhlaziywa okunembile kwedatha?
answer133: Lawa ma-salamander akhipha amakhemikhali amakhilogremu ngesikhathi sokulimala okuholela ekugwemeni ukuziphatha kwamanye ama-salamander.
distractor133a: Lawa ma-salamander akhipha amakhemikhali amakhilogremu ngesikhathi sokulimala adonsela amanye ama-salamander
distractor133b: Amakhemikhali akhishwa ama-salamander alimele awaxoshi noma awadonseli amanye ama-salamander
distractor133c: Akukho datha eyanele yokuthola ubudlelwano phakathi kwamakhemikhali nendlela abanye abasebenzisa ama-salamander abaziphatha ngayo
question134: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.72. Ocwaningweni locwaningo, inkawu eyodwa yanikezwa ukukhetha phakathi kwamathokheni amabili. Ithokheni elilodwa lanikeza inkawu engaphansi komthetho umvuzo. Enye ithokheni yanikeza inkawu engaphansi komthetho umvuzo ofanayo kanye nomvuzo kwenye inkawu. Ngakho-ke ithokheni yobugovu yanikeza isihloko kuphela, kuyilapho ithokheni ye-prosocial yanikeza isihloko kanye nenkawu eyodwa, icala lokuziphatha kokuzinikela. Igrafu ikhombisa izinga lokukhethwa kwethokheni ye-prosocial ngezilingo ezengeziwe. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu
answer134: Izinkawu ezikhulunywa ngazo zinomkhuba wokubonisa ububele. Lo mkhuba uyanda ezivivinyweni eziphindaphindwayo
distractor134a: Izinkawu ezikhulunywa ngazo zinomkhuba wokubonisa umusa. Lo mkhuba uhlala njalo ezivivinyweni eziphindaphindwayo
distractor134b: Izinkawu ezikhulunywa ngazo zinomkhuba wokubonisa ukuziphatha kobugovu. Lo mkhuba uhlala njalo ezivivinyweni eziphindaphindwayo
distractor134c: Izinkawu ezikhulunywa ngazo zinomkhuba wokubonisa ukuziphatha kobugovu. Lo mkhuba uyanda ezivivinyweni eziphindaphindwayo
question135: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.73. Lesi sithombe senzelwe ukuchaza indlela ukuziphatha kwekati okwathinteka ngayo njengoba lalivezwa yizinto ezibangela ukucindezeleka ezahlukene. Khomba igama okufanele lisetshenziswe enkambisweni emelelwe yilo mdwebo.
question136: Ama-elk afuduka esuka ezindaweni zokudla zasehlobo emadlelweni aphezulu asezintabeni aye ezigodini eziphansi ebusika. Usebenzisa amagama athi izinguquko zokuziphatha, izinguquko zomzimba, izinguquko zesizini, kanye nokufuduka, bhala ukulandelana kwezenzakalo ezenzekayo ukuze kubangele lokhu kufuduka.
answer136: Izinguquko zesizini, izinguquko zomzimba, izinguquko zokuziphatha, kanye nokufuduka, ngokulandelana
distractor136a: Izinguquko zesizini, izinguquko zomzimba, ukufuduka, kanye nezinguquko zokuziphatha, ngokulandelana
distractor136b: Izinguquko zomzimba, izinguquko zesizini, izinguquko zokuziphatha, kanye nokufuduka, ngokulandelana
distractor136c: Izinguquko zesizini, izinguquko zokuziphatha, izinguquko zomzimba, kanye nokufuduka, ngokulandelana
question137: Ezinye izinhlanzi ziyabhukuda ezikoleni, ezingasabela ngokushesha ngokusuka ngokushesha ezinsongweni zezilwane ezidla ezinye. Ezikoleni, izinhlanzi ziyabhukuda ngendlela ehlelekile ngaphandle kokuhamba ngokuxokozela nokushayisana. Yiluphi uhlobo lokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu olungachaza ukunyakaza okuhlelekile kwazo zonke izinhlanzi esikoleni ngenxa yosongo?
question138: Bheka uMfanekiso 36.74. Lesi sithombe sibonisa i-meerkat ibheke ukubona izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane njengoba ezinye i-meerkat zidla. Yikuphi okukhethwayo okuchaza lokhu kuziphatha?
answer138: Kuwukuziphatha kobubele. I-meerkat ikhetha ukungadli ukuze yandise amathuba okusinda kwezihlobo zayo
distractor138a: Kuyindlela yokuhlangana. Amaduna akwazi ukuqapha ngaphandle kokudla aphilile futhi akhanga kakhulu kwabesifazane
distractor138b: Kuyindlela yokwenza engaguquki. Lapho amanye ama-meerkat eqala ukufuna ukudla, ama-meerkat okugcina aqhubeka nokuphinda lokhu kuziphatha
distractor138c: Kuyi-kinesis. Lapho ama-meerkat amaningi egoba, amanye ama-meerkat angena esimweni sokuqapha ngenxa yokusabela

chapterContent:
Ngo-1993, isibonelo esithakazelisayo se-ecosystem dynamics senzeka lapho isifo samaphaphu esingavamile sihlasela izakhamuzi zaseningizimu-ntshonalanga ye-United States. Lesi sifo saba nesilinganiso esisabekayo sokufa, sabulala iziguli ezingaphezu kwesigamu, eziningi zazo ezazingamaNdiya aseMelika. Laba bantu abadala abasebasha ababephilile bafa ngenxa yokwehluleka kokuphefumula ngokuphelele. Lesi sifo sasingaziwa, futhi i-Centers for Disease Control (CDC), i-ejensi kahulumeni wase-United States ephethe ukuphatha ubhubhane olungase lube khona, yalethwa ukuze ihlole. Ososayensi babengase bafunde ngalesi sifo ukube babekwazi ukukhuluma nabaphilisi baseNavajo ababehlala endaweni futhi ababebone ukuxhumana phakathi kwemvula kanye nenani lamagundane, ngaleyo ndlela bebikezela ukuqubuka kuka-1993.

 Imbangela yalesi sifo, eyatholwa phakathi namasonto ambalwa ngabaphenyi be-CDC, kwakuyi-hantavirus eyaziwa ngokuthi i-Sin Nombre, igciwane elingenagama.” Ngokuqonda okuvela emithini yendabuko yamaNavajo, ososayensi bakwazi ukuchaza lesi sifo futhi ngokushesha basungula izinyathelo zempilo ezisebenzayo zokuvimbela ukusabalala kwaso. Nakuba kungasavamile kangako, ukutheleleka okuvela ku-hantavirus kusaqhubeka. Bheka Umfanekiso 37.1
question1: Yisiphi isenzakalo sezempilo yomphakathi esenzeka eningizimu-ntshonalanga ye-United States ngo-1993?
answer1: Ukuqubuka kwesifo samaphaphu esingavamile futhi esivame ukuba yingozi esibangelwa yi-hantavirus
question2: Yiliphi iqembu labantu elathinteka kakhulu ngesikhathi sokuqubuka kwe-hantavirus ekuqaleni kuka-1993?
answer2: AmaMelika Omdabu
question3: Yisiphi isibonakaliso esagcina sibangele ukufa kweziguli eziningi zokuqala ze-hantavirus?
answer3: Ukwehluleka kokuphefumula okuphelele
question4: Yisiphi isikhungo sikahulumeni esaphenya ngokuqubuka kwesifo okungaqondakali?
answer4: Izikhungo Zokulawula Izifo (CDC)
question5: Yikuphi ukuqaphela kwemvelo okwenziwe abelaphi baseNavajo ngaphambi kokuqubuka kwalesi sifo?
answer5: Imvula ihlobene nokwanda kwenani lamagundane, okusiza ukubikezela ukuqubuka kwezifo
distractor5a: Isomiso saqeda zonke izigundane ezazithwala izifo
distractor5b: Ukufuduka kwezinyoni kubangele ngqo izifo zokuphefumula
question6: Yayiyini igama le-hantavirus eyabangela ukuqubuka kuka-1993?
answer6: Igama Lesono
question7: Ulwazi lwendabuko lwamaNavajo lwaba negalelo kanjani ophenyweni?
answer7: Kusize ososayensi baqonde ubudlelwano bemvelo phakathi kwemvula, inani lamagundane, kanye nokuqubuka kwezifo.
distractor7a: Ithole imbangela yalesi sifo ebangelwa amagciwane
distractor7c: Kwafakazela ukuthi omiyane yibo ababangela lesi sifo
question8: Kungani ukuqubuka kwe-hantavirus ka-1993 kuyisibonelo sendlela izinto eziphilayo ezishintsha ngayo?
answer8: Izinguquko zemvelo zathonya inani lamagundane, okwathinta ukusabalala kwezifo kubantu
distractor8a: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kudale ngqo igciwane elisha
distractor8b: Lesi sifo sisakazeka kuphela ngokuthintana komuntu nomuntu
distractor8c: Ukuqubuka kwalesi sifo kwenzeke ngaphandle kokuxhumana kwemvelo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems | Ukuxhumana kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems | Ukuxhumana kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ukuphila endaweni ezungezile kuvame ukuhambisana nokuncintisana ngezinsiza ezilinganiselwe, okuyisici senkolelo-mbono yokukhethwa kwemvelo. Ukuncintisana emiphakathini (zonke izinto eziphilayo endaweni ethile) kubonakala kokubili ngaphakathi kwezinhlobo naphakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene. Izinsiza ezincintisana ngazo izinto eziphilayo zifaka phakathi izinto eziphilayo ezivela ezintweni eziphilayo noma ezaziphila ngaphambilini, ukukhanya kwelanga, kanye nezakhamzimba zamaminerali, ezinikeza amandla ezinqubo zokuphila kanye nezinto zokwakha izakhiwo zomzimba zezinto eziphilayo. Ezinye izici ezibalulekile ezithonya ukuguquguquka komphakathi yizingxenye zendawo yazo engokwenyama neyendawo: ububanzi bendawo, inani lemvula, i-topography (ukuphakama), kanye nezinhlobo ezitholakalayo. Konke lokhu kuyizinto ezibalulekile zemvelo ezinquma ukuthi yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezingaba khona endaweni ethile.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 kanye no-Big Idea 4 wohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa ye-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kabusha kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.1 Zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo zidinga ukufaka njalo amandla amahhala.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo kanye nezibikezelo mayelana nezehlakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.3 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela ukuthi izinguquko ekutholakaleni kwamandla amahhala zithinta kanjani izinto eziphilayo, abantu, kanye nezindawo zemvelo.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.D
Ukukhula kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla yesistimu yezinto eziphilayo kuthonywa izinguquko endaweni yesistimu.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.D.1 Zonke izinhlelo zebhayoloji kusukela kumaseli nezinto eziphilayo kuya kubantu, imiphakathi kanye nezindawo eziphilayo zithintwa ukusebenzisana okuyinkimbinkimbi kwe-biotic kanye ne-abiotic okubandakanya ukushintshana kwezinto kanye namandla akhululekile.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
5.1 Umfundi angahlaziya idatha ukuze abone amaphethini noma ubudlelwano.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.24 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuhlaziya idatha ukuze abone amaphethini angaba khona kanye nobudlelwano phakathi kwe-biotic noma i-abiotic factor kanye nesistimu yezinto eziphilayo, okuhlanganisa ne-ecosystem.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 4
Izinhlelo zebhayoloji ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zebhayoloji kuholela ezimpahleni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo yazo kuphumela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
2.2 Umfundi angasebenzisa izindlela zezibalo emananini achaza izenzakalo zemvelo.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.14 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izindlela zezibalo emananini achaza ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo nendawo yazo, okuholela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo yazo kuholela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.15 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo ezibonakalayo ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi ukuze abonise ukuthi ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo yazo kuholela kanjani ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezizungezile kuholela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo kanye nezibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi kanye namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.16 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela imiphumela yokushintsha kwezinto noma ukutholakala kwamandla emiphakathini nasezindaweni zemvelo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems | Iyini i-Ecosystem
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems | Iyini i-Ecosystem
chapterContent:
I-ecosystem umphakathi wezinto eziphilayo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo nendawo yazo engaphili (engaphili). Izinhlelo zemvelo zingaba zincane, njengamachibi olwandle atholakala eduze nogu olunamatshe olwandle oluningi, noma ezinkulu, njenge-Amazon Rainforest eBrazil (Isithombe 37.2).

 Kunezinhlobo ezintathu ezibanzi zezinhlelo zemvelo ngokusekelwe endaweni yazo evamile: amanzi ahlanzekile, amanzi olwandle, kanye nomhlaba. Ngaphakathi kwalezi zigaba ezibanzi kunezinhlobo zemvelo ezizimele ngokusekelwe ezintweni eziphilayo ezikhona kanye nohlobo lwendawo yokuhlala yemvelo.

 Izindawo zemvelo zaselwandle yizona ezivame kakhulu, ezihlanganisa amaphesenti angama-75 obuso boMhlaba futhi zakhiwa izinhlobo ezintathu eziyisisekelo: ulwandle olungajulile, amanzi olwandle olujulile, kanye nobuso bolwandle olujulile (izindawo eziphansi zokujula kolwandle olujulile). Izindawo zemvelo zaselwandle olungajulile zifaka phakathi izindawo zemvelo zamakhorali ahlukahlukene kakhulu, kanti ubuso bolwandle olujulile baziwa ngenani elikhulu lama-plankton nama-krill (ama-crustacean amancane) asekela lokhu. Lezi zindawo ezimbili zibaluleke kakhulu kuma-respirator e-aerobic emhlabeni jikelele njengoba i-phytoplankton yenza amaphesenti angama-40 ayo yonke i-photosynthesis eMhlabeni. Nakuba zingahlukani njengezinye ezimbili, izindawo zemvelo zasolwandle ezijulile ziqukethe izinhlobo eziningi zezinto eziphilayo zasolwandle. Izindawo zemvelo ezinjalo zikhona ngisho nangaphansi kolwandle lapho ukukhanya kungakwazi ukungena khona emanzini.

 Izindawo zemvelo zamanzi ahlanzekile ziyivelakancane kakhulu, ezitholakala kumaphesenti angu-1.8 kuphela omhlaba. Amachibi, imifula, imifudlana, nemithombo yakha lezi zinhlelo; zihlukahlukene kakhulu, futhi zisekela izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinhlanzi, izilwane ezihlala emanzini angaphandle, izilwane ezihuquzelayo, izinambuzane, i-phytoplankton, isikhunta, namagciwane.

 Izindawo zemvelo zasemhlabeni, ezaziwa nangokuhlukahluka kwazo, zihlukaniswe ngezigaba ezinkulu ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-biome, njengamahlathi emvula asezindaweni ezishisayo, ama-savanna, amahlane, amahlathi e-coniferous, amahlathi aqothulayo, kanye ne-tundra. Ukuhlanganisa lezi zindawo zemvelo ngezigaba ezimbalwa nje ze-biome kufihla ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezindawo zemvelo ngazinye ezikuwo. Isibonelo, kunokwehluka okukhulu ezitshalweni zasehlane: i-saguaro cacti kanye nezinye izitshalo ehlane laseSonoran, e-United States, ziningi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nogwadule olunamatshe oluyincithakalo lwaseBoa Vista, isiqhingi esisogwini lwaseNtshonalanga Afrika (Isithombe 37.3).

 Izinhlelo zemvelo ziyinkimbinkimbi enezingxenye eziningi ezisebenzisanayo. Zivame ukuchayeka eziphazanyisweni ezahlukahlukene, noma izinguquko emvelweni ezithinta ukwakheka kwazo: ukwehluka kwemvula kanye nokushisa kwaminyaka yonke kanye nezinqubo ezisheshayo zokukhula kwezitshalo, ezingathatha iminyaka eminingana. Eziningi zalezi ziphazamiso ziwumphumela wezinqubo zemvelo. Isibonelo, lapho umbani ubangela umlilo wehlathi futhi ubhubhisa ingxenye yesimiso semvelo sehlathi, umhlabathi ekugcineni ugcwala utshani, bese kuba yizihlahla nezihlahla, bese kuba yizihlahla ezivuthiwe, okubuyisela ihlathi esimweni salo sangaphambili. Umthelela wokuphazamiseka kwemvelo okubangelwa imisebenzi yabantu ubaluleke njengoshintsho olubangelwa yizinqubo zemvelo. Imikhuba yezolimo yabantu, ukungcola komoya, imvula ene-asidi, ukugawulwa kwamahlathi emhlabeni wonke, ukudoba ngokweqile, ukuqothulwa kwezitshalo, ukuchitheka kukawoyela, kanye nokulahla ngokungemthetho ezweni naselwandle konke kuyizinkinga ezikhathaza abalondolozi bemvelo.

 Ukulingana yisimo esizinzile sendawo ezungezile lapho zonke izinto eziphilayo zilingana khona nendawo yazo kanye nomunye nomunye. Ku-ecology, ama-para amamitha amabili asetshenziswa ukukala izinguquko ezindaweni ezungezile: ukumelana nokuqina. Amandla endawo ezungezile okuhlala ilingana naphezu kokuphazamiseka abizwa ngokuthi ukumelana. Isivinini lapho indawo ezungezile iphinda ilingane khona ngemva kokuphazamiseka, okubizwa ngokuthi ukuqina kwayo. Ukumelana nokuqina kwe-ecosystem kubaluleke kakhulu uma kucatshangelwa umthelela womuntu. Uhlobo lwendawo ezungezile lungashintsha ngezinga lokuthi lungalahlekelwa ukuqina kwayo ngokuphelele. Le nqubo ingaholela ekubhujisweni okuphelele noma ekuguqulweni okungenakuguqulwa kwe-ecosystem.

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems | Amaketanga Okudla kanye nama-Food Webs
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems | Amaketanga Okudla kanye nama-Food Webs
chapterContent:
Igama elithi "food chain"ngezinye izikhathi lisetshenziswa ngendlela yokufanisa ukuchaza izimo zomphakathi zabantu. Ngalo mqondo, i-food chain ibhekwa njengomncintiswano wokusinda, njengokuthi ubani odla bani?"Umuntu uyadla bese kudliwa othile. Ngakho-ke, akumangazi ukuthi emphakathini wethu oncintisanayo wokudla izinja, abantu ababhekwa njengabaphumelelayo babonakala njengabaphezulu ochungechungeni lokudla, bedla bonke abanye ngenxa yenzuzo yabo, kanti abangaphumeleli kangako babonakala njengabaphansi.

 Ukuqonda kwesayensi ngochungechunge lokudla kunembile kakhulu kunokusetshenziswa kwalo kwansuku zonke. Ku-ecology, uchungechunge lokudla luwuchungechunge oluqondile lwezinto eziphilayo lapho izakhamzimba namandla kudlula khona: abakhiqizi abayinhloko, abathengi abayinhloko, kanye nabathengi abasezingeni eliphezulu basetshenziswa ukuchaza isakhiwo se-ecosystem kanye nokuguquguquka kwayo. Kukhona indlela eyodwa edlula ochungechungeni. Isidalwa ngasinye ochungechungeni lokudla sithatha lokho okubizwa ngokuthi izinga le-trophic. Kuye ngendima yaso njengabakhiqizi noma abathengi, izinhlobo noma amaqembu ezinhlobo angabelwa amazinga ahlukahlukene e-trophic.

 Ezindaweni eziningi zemvelo, phansi kochungechunge lokudla kuqukethe izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthetic (izitshalo kanye/noma i-phytoplankton), ezibizwa ngokuthi abakhiqizi abayinhloko. Izinto eziphilayo ezidla abakhiqizi abayinhloko ziyizilwane ezidla uhlaza: abathengi abayinhloko. Abathengi besibili bavame ukuba yizilwane ezidla ukudla ezidla abathengi abayinhloko. Abathengi bezinga eliphezulu yizilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane ezidla ezinye. Abathengi bezinga eliphezulu badla amazinga aphansi e-trophic alandelayo, njalo njalo, kuze kufike ezintweni eziphilayo eziphezulu kochungechunge lokudla: abathengi abaphezulu. Kuchungechunge lokudla lwaseLake Ontario oluboniswe kuMfanekiso 37.4, i-Chinook salmon iyi-apex consumer ephezulu kochungechunge lokudla.

 Isici esisodwa esibalulekile esikhawulela ubude bezintambo zokudla amandla. Amandla alahleka njengokushisa phakathi kwezinga ngalinye le-trophic ngenxa yomthetho wesibili we-thermodynamics. Ngakho-ke, ngemva kwenani elilinganiselwe lokudluliselwa kwamandla e-trophic, inani lamandla asele kochungechunge lokudla lingase lingabi likhulu ngokwanele ukusekela imiphakathi ephilayo ezingeni eliphakeme le-trophic.

 Ukulahleka kwamandla phakathi kwamazinga e-trophic kuboniswa yizifundo zokuqala zikaHoward T. Odum endaweni ye-Silver Springs, eFlorida, ngawo-1940 (Isithombe 37.5). Abakhiqizi abayinhloko bakhiqiza ama-kcal angu-20,819/m2/yr (amakhilogremu ngemitha yesikwele ngonyaka), okuyi-primary abathengi bakhiqize ama-kcal angu-3368/m2/ngonyaka, abathengi besibili bakhiqize ama-kcal angu-383/m2/ngonyaka, kanti abathengi besithathu bakhiqize ama-kcal angu-21/m2/ngonyaka kuphela. Ngakho-ke, kunamandla amancane asele kwelinye izinga labathengi kule ndawo ephilayo.

 Kunenkinga lapho kusetshenziswa izintambo zokudla ukuchaza ngokunembile izindawo eziningi emvelo. Ngisho noma zonke izinto eziphilayo ziqoqwe emazingeni afanele e-trophic, ezinye zalezi zinto eziphilayo zingadla izinhlobo ezivela ezingeni le-trophic ezingaphezu kweyodwa; ngokufanayo, ezinye zalezi zinto eziphilayo zingadliwa yizinhlobo ezivela emazingeni amaningi e-trophic. Ngamanye amazwi, imodeli eqondile yezindawo ezungezile, uchungechunge lokudla, ayichazi ngokuphelele isakhiwo sendawo ezungezile. Imodeli ephelele—echaza konke ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene kanye nobudlelwano bazo obuyinkimbinkimbi obuxhumene nomunye nomunye kanye nemvelo—iyimodeli enembile nechazayo yezindawo ezungezile. Iwebhu yokudla iyisithombe esicacile sewebhu ephelele, engeyona eqondile yabakhiqizi abayinhloko, abathengi abayinhloko, kanye nabathengi abasezingeni eliphezulu abasetshenziswa ukuchaza isakhiwo sendawo ezungezile kanye nokuguquguquka kwayo (Isithombe 37.6).

 A Ukuqhathaniswa kwezinhlobo ezimbili zamamodeli e-ecosystem yesakhiwo kubonisa amandla kuzo zombili. Amaketanga okudla aguquguquka kakhulu ekuklameni kokuhlaziya, kulula ukuwalandela, futhi kulula ukuwazama, kanti amamodeli e-food web amelela ngokunembile isakhiwo kanye nokuguquguquka kwe-ecosystem, futhi idatha ingasetshenziswa ngqo njengokufakwayo kokuklameni kokulingisa.

 Izinhlobo ezimbili ezijwayelekile ze-food web zivame ukuboniswa zisebenzisana ngaphakathi kwe-ecosystem eyodwa. I-food food web (njenge-food web yaseLake Ontario ku-Figure 37.6) inezitshalo noma ezinye izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthetic esisekelweni sayo, kulandelwe yizilwane ezidla uhlaza kanye nezilwane ezihlukahlukene ezidla inyama. I-food food web yakhiwa isisekelo sezinto eziphilayo ezidla izinto eziphilayo ezibolayo (izinto eziphilayo ezifile), ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-detritivores noma ama-detritivores. Lezi zinto eziphilayo ngokuvamile zingama-bacteria noma ama-fungus aphinda asebenzise izinto eziphilayo abuyele engxenyeni ye-biotic ye-ecosystem njengoba zona ngokwazo zidliwa ezinye izinto eziphilayo. Njengoba zonke i-ecosystem zidinga indlela yokuphinda zisebenzise izinto ezivela ezintweni eziphilayo ezifile, iningi le-food food webs line-food food web ehlobene nayo. Isibonelo, ku-ecosystem yasendle, izitshalo zingase zisekele i-food food web yezinto eziphilayo ezahlukene, amazinga ayisisekelo kanye namanye abathengi, ngesikhathi esifanayo besekela inethiwekhi yokudla okulimazayo yamabhaktheriya, isikhunta, kanye nezilwane ezingenamgogodla ezibhubhisayo ezidla izitshalo nezilwane ezifile
question1: Iyini iketanga lokudla emvelweni?
answer1: Uchungechunge oluqondile lwezinto eziphilayo lapho izakhamzimba namandla kudlula khona
distractor1a: Inethiwekhi ekhombisa ubudlelwano bonke bokudla endaweni ezungezile
distractor1b: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezihlala endaweni efanayo
question2: Zibizwa ngokuthini izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-photosynthesis eziyisisekelo sezinhlobo eziningi zokudla?
answer2: Abakhiqizi abayinhloko
question3: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.4. Yisiphi isidalwa esidla ukudla okuphezulu eLake Ontario?
answer3: I-salmon ye-Chinook
question4: Kungani izintambo zokudla zinqunyelwe ubude?
answer4: Amandla alahleka njengokushisa phakathi kwamazinga e-trophic ngokusho komthetho wesibili we-thermodynamics
distractor4a: Izakhamzimba azikwazi ukuhamba phakathi kwamazinga e-trophic
distractor4b: Abakhiqizi abayinhloko abakwazi ukusekela izilwane ezidla uhlaza
distractor4c: Abathengi abakwazi ukudla izinhlobo ezingaphezu kweyodwa
question5: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.5. Yiliphi izinga le-trophic elikhiqize amandla amancane kakhulu ohlelweni lwe-ecosystem lwe-Silver Springs?
answer5: Abathengi bezinga eliphezulu
question6: Kungani iwebhu yokudla ngokuvamile iyimodeli enembile kakhulu kuneketanga lokudla?
answer6: Ngoba imelela ubudlelwano obuningi bokudla obuxhumene phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor6a: Ngoba ihlanganisa abakhiqizi kanye nezilwane ezidla uhlaza kuphela
distractor6b: Ngoba ayinaki izinto eziphilayo ezidla emazingeni amaningi e-trophic
distractor6c: Ngoba amandla awadluliselwa phakathi kwamazinga e-trophic
question7: Uyini umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwewebhu yokudla okudliwayo kanye newebhu yokudla engcolile?
answer7: Iwebhu yokudla okudliwayo iqala ngabakhiqizi be-photosynthesis, kanti iwebhu yokudla okungcolile iqala ngezinto eziphilayo ezifile ezidliwa yizinto ezibolayo
distractor7a: Iwebhu yokudla okudliwayo iqukethe izilwane ezidla inyama kuphela, kanti iwebhu yokudla okulimazayo iqukethe izilwane ezidla uhlaza kuphela
distractor7b: Iwebhu yokudla okudliwayo itholakala olwandle kuphela, kanti iwebhu yokudla okungcolile itholakala ezweni kuphela
question8: Iyiphi indima edlalwa yizinto ezibolayo kanye nezinto ezibhubhisayo ezindaweni zemvelo?
answer8: Baphinda basebenzise izinto eziphilayo ezivela ezintweni ezifile babuyele endaweni ezungezile
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.6.1. Igrafu ikhombisa izinga elijwayelekile lezinhlanzi ezibanjwe oLwandlekazini i-North Atlantic oluvulekile kanye nezindawo ezisogwini phakathi kuka-1950 no-2000. Isakhiwo somphakathi sezinhlanzi sashintsha kanjani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ezindaweni ezivulekile zolwandle kanye nezindawo ezisogwini?
answer9: Kunabathengi abambalwa ngokwesilinganiso bezindawo zasemakhaya kanye nezindawo zasemakhaya kokubili ezindaweni zasemanzini ezivulekile kanye nasezindaweni ezisogwini. Ulwandle oluvulekile luthinteke kakhulu.
distractor9a: Kunabathengi abambalwa ngokwesilinganiso ezindaweni ezivulekile zolwandle kanye nasogwini lolwandle. Zombili lezi zindawo zithinteke ngokulinganayo.
distractor9b: Kunabakhiqizi abayinhloko kanye nabathengi abayinhloko abambalwa ngokulinganayo ezindaweni ezivulekile zolwandle kanye nasogwini. Zombili lezi zindawo zithinteke ngokulinganayo
distractor9c: Kunabakhiqizi abayinhloko kanye nabathengi abayinhloko abambalwa ngokulinganayo ezindaweni ezivulekile zolwandle kanye nasogwini. Ulwandle oluvulekile luthinteke kakhulu.

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems | I-Stickleback enezinhluthu
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems | I-Stickleback enezinhluthu
chapterContent:
Kuqinisekiswe kahle yinkolelo-mbono yokukhethwa kwemvelo ukuthi izinguquko emvelweni zidlala indima enkulu ekuziphendukeleni kwezinhlobo ngaphakathi kwendawo ezungezile. Kodwa-ke, kuncane okwaziwayo ngokuthi ukuziphendukela kwezinhlobo ngaphakathi kwendawo ezungezile kungashintsha kanjani indawo ezungezile. Ngo-2009, uDkt. Luke Harmon, wase-University of Idaho eMoscow, washicilela iphepha elabonisa okokuqala ukuthi ukuziphendukela kwezinto eziphilayo zibe izinhlobo ezincane kungaba nemiphumela eqondile endaweni yazo ezungezile.1

 I-stickleback enezinhluthu ezintathu (i-Gasterosteus aculeatus) iyinhlanzi yamanzi ahlanzekile eyavela enhlanzini yasemanzini anosawoti ukuze ihlale emachibini amanzi ahlanzekile eminyakeni engaba ngu-10,000 eyedlule, okubhekwa njengentuthuko yakamuva esikhathini sokuziphendukela kwemvelo (Isithombe 37.7). Eminyakeni eyi-10,000 edlule, lezi zinhlanzi zasemanzini ahlanzekile zabe sezihlukaniswa emachibini ahlukene. Kuye ngokuthi yiliphi inani lamachibi elihloliwe, okutholakele kubonise ukuthi lezi zinhlanzi zasemanzini ahlanzekile zabe sezihlala njengohlobo olulodwa noma zavela zaba izinhlobo ezimbili. Ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezilwane kwenziwa ukuthi kube nokwenzeka ngokusebenzisa kwazo izindawo ezahlukene zechibi ukuze zondle ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-micro niches.

 UDkt. Harmon nethimba lakhe badale ama-microcosm echibini okwenziwa emathangini angamalitha angu-250 futhi banezela udaka oluvela emachibini ahlanzekile njengomthombo we-zooplankton nezinye izilwane ezingenamgogodla ukuze zisekele izinhlanzi. Emathangini ahlukene okuhlola bafaka uhlobo olulodwa lwe-stickleback oluvela echibini lohlobo olulodwa noma olunezinhlobo ezimbili.

 Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ithimba laphawula ukuthi amanye amathangi aqhakaza ulwelwe kanti amanye awazange. Lokhu kwabadida ososayensi, futhi banquma ukulinganisa amanzi ancibilikisiwe i-organic carbon (DOC), equkethe ikakhulukazi ama-molecule amakhulu ezinto eziphilayo ezibolayo ezinikeza amanzi echibini umbala wawo onsundu kancane. Kwavela ukuthi amanzi avela emathangini anezinhlanzi zezinhlobo ezimbili aqukethe izinhlayiya ezinkulu ze-DOC (ngakho-ke amanzi amnyama) kunamanzi anezinhlanzi zezinhlobo ezimbili. Lokhu kwanda kwe-DOC kwavimba ukukhanya kwelanga futhi kwavimbela ukuqhakaza kwe-algal. Ngokuphambene nalokho, amanzi avela ethangini lohlobo olulodwa aqukethe izinhlayiya ezincane ze-DOC, okuvumela ukungena kwelanga okwengeziwe ukuze kukhuthaze izimbali ze-algal.

 Lolu shintsho endaweni ezungezile, olubangelwa imikhuba ehlukene yokudla yezinhlobo ze-stickleback ohlotsheni ngalunye lwechibi, cishe lunomthelela omkhulu ekusindeni kwezinye izinhlobo kulezi zindawo zemvelo, ikakhulukazi ezinye izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthetic. Ngakho-ke, ucwaningo lubonisa ukuthi, okungenani kulezi zindawo zemvelo, indawo kanye nokuvela kwezinhlobo kunemiphumela ehambisanayo manje engase ifakwe kumamodeli okulingisa.
question1: Ucwaningo lukaDkt. Luke Harmons lwango-2009 luboniseni?
answer1: Ukuvela kwezinhlobo kungashintsha ngqo indawo yazo yemvelo
distractor1b: Izinguquko zemvelo azinawo umthelela ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo
distractor1c: Izinhlanzi zasemanzini ahlanzekile azikwazi ukuthuthuka zibe izinhlobo ezintsha
question2: I-stickleback enezipini ezintathu yavela kuyiphi inhloko?
answer2: Inhlanzi yasemanzini anosawoti
question3: Cishe nini lapho i-stickleback enezinsika ezintathu yahlala khona emachibini ahlanzekile?
answer3: Eminyakeni engaba yi-10,000 edlule
question4: Yini eyavumela ezinye izinhlobo ze-stickleback ukuba zihlukane zibe izinhlobo ezimbili?
answer4: Ukusetshenziswa kwazo kwezindawo ezincane zokudla ezahlukahlukene ngaphakathi kwamachibi
question5: Kungani uDkt. Harmon efake udaka lwamachibi emathangini okuhlola?
answer5: Ukuhlinzeka nge-zooplankton nezinye izilwane ezingenamgogodla njengokudla kwama-stickleback
question6: Yimuphi umehluko owabonwa emathangini aqukethe izinhlobo ezimbili ze-stickleback?
answer6: Zaziqukethe izinhlayiya ezinkulu zekhabhoni ezincibilikisiwe, okwaholela emanzini amnyama
question7: Ikhabhoni ephilayo encibilikisiwe yakuthinta kanjani ukukhula kwe-algae ocwaningweni?
answer7: Izinhlayiya ezinkulu zekhabhoni ezincibilikisiwe ezivimbe ukukhanya kwelanga kanye nokuqhakaza kwe-algae okuncishisiwe
distractor7a: Zandise ukutholakala kwezakhamzimba futhi zakhuthaza ukuqhakaza kwe-algae
distractor7c: Zandisa izinga lokushisa kwamanzi futhi zasheshisa i-photosynthesis
question8: Yisiphi isiphetho esibanzi esisekelwe yilolu cwaningo?
answer8: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nezimo zemvelo kungathintana ngemiphumela ehambisanayo
distractor8a: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuhlala kunciphisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor8b: Izinhlelo zemvelo azishintshi naphezu kokuvela kwezinhlobo
question9: Bheka Umfanekiso 37.7. Ema-microcosms echibi, kungani kwakungenzeka ukuthi kuqhakaze i-algal uma kukhona eyodwa, kodwa hhayi izinhlobo ezimbili ze-stickleback?
answer9: Ngoba kwakukhona ama-molecule amakhulu okuqukethwe kwezinto eziphilayo ezincibilikisiwe lapho kukhona izinhlobo ezimbili uma kuqhathaniswa nohlobo olulodwa.
distractor9a: Ngoba izinhlobo ezimbili ze-stickleback zidla zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ukuze ziqhakaze
distractor9b: Ngoba uhlobo olulodwa lwalunezinto eziphilayo eziningi ezincibilikisiwe ezitholakala endaweni yazo yokuhlala kunezinye izinhlobo.
distractor9c: Ngoba kudliwa ulwelwe oluningi lapho kukhona izinhlobo ezimbili ze-stickleback uma kuqhathaniswa nohlobo olulodwa kuphela

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems | Ucwaningo nge-Ecosystem Dynamics: Ukuhlolwa kwe-Ecosystem kanye nokumodela
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems | Ucwaningo nge-Ecosystem Dynamics: Ukuhlolwa kwe-Ecosystem kanye nokumodela
chapterContent:
Ucwaningo lwezinguquko esakhiweni se-ecosystem ezibangelwa izinguquko endaweni ezungezile (ukuphazamiseka) noma ngamandla angaphakathi lubizwa ngokuthi i-ecosystem dynamics. I-ecosystems ichazwa kusetshenziswa izindlela ezahlukene zocwaningo. Abanye ososayensi be-ecosystems bafunda i-ecosystems besebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhlola ezilawulwayo, kuyilapho abanye befunda yonke i-ecosystems esimweni sayo semvelo, kanti abanye basebenzisa zombili izindlela.

 Imodeli ye-ecosystem ephelele izama ukulinganisa ukwakheka, ukusebenzisana, kanye nokuguquguquka kwe-ecosystems yonke; iyona emele kakhulu i-ecosystem esimweni sayo semvelo. Iwebhu yokudla iyisibonelo semodeli ye-ecosystem ephelele. Kodwa-ke, lolu hlobo locwaningo lunqunyelwe isikhathi nezindleko, kanye neqiniso lokuthi akunakwenzeka noma akunangqondo ukwenza izivivinyo ezindaweni zemvelo ezinkulu. Ukulinganisa zonke izinhlobo ezahlukene endaweni kanye nokuguquguquka endaweni yazo yokuhlala kunzima, ikakhulukazi lapho kufundwa izindawo zokuhlala ezinkulu njenge-Amazon Rainforest, ehlanganisa amahektha ayizigidi eziyi-1.4 (5.5 million km2) wobuso boMhlaba.

 Ngenxa yalezi zizathu, ososayensi bafunda i-ecosystems ngaphansi kwezimo ezilawulwa kakhulu. Izinhlelo zokuhlola zivame ukuhilela ukuhlukanisa ingxenye yendawo yemvelo engasetshenziswa ekuhlolweni, okubizwa ngokuthi i-mesocosm, noma ngokudala kabusha indawo yonke yemvelo endaweni yangaphakathi noma yangaphandle yelabhorethri, okubizwa ngokuthi i-microcosm. Umkhawulo omkhulu kulezi zindlela ukuthi ukususa izinto eziphilayo ngazinye endaweni yazo yemvelo noma ukushintsha indawo yemvelo ngokusebenzisa ukuhlukanisa kungashintsha ukuguquguquka kwendawo. Lezi zinguquko zivame ukubangelwa umehluko ezinombolweni zezinhlobo kanye nokuhlukahluka kanye nokuguqulwa kwendawo okubangelwa ukuhlukanisa (mesocosm) noma ukudala kabusha (microcosm) indawo yokuhlala yemvelo. Ngakho-ke, lezi zinhlobo zokuhlola azibikezeli ngokuphelele izinguquko ezizokwenzeka endaweni yemvelo lapho ziqoqwe khona.

 Njengoba zombili lezi zindlela zinemikhawulo yazo, ezinye izazi zemvelo ziphakamisa ukuthi imiphumela evela kulezi zinhlelo zokuhlola kufanele isetshenziswe kuphela kanye nezifundo ze-ecosystem eziphelele ukuthola idatha emele kakhulu mayelana nesakhiwo se-ecosystem, umsebenzi, kanye nokuguquguquka.

 Ososayensi basebenzisa idatha ekhiqizwe yilezi zifundo zokuhlola ukuthuthukisa amamodeli e-ecosystem abonisa isakhiwo kanye nokuguquguquka kwezindawo eziphilayo. Izinhlobo ezintathu eziyisisekelo zokumodela i-ecosystem zisetshenziswa njalo ocwaningweni nasekuphathweni kwe-ecosystem: imodeli yomqondo, imodeli yokuhlaziya, kanye nemodeli yokulingisa. Imodeli yomqondo iyimodeli ye-ecosystem equkethe amashadi okugeleza ukukhombisa ukusebenzisana kwezingxenye ezahlukene zezinto eziphilayo nezingaphili ze-ecosystem. Imodeli yomqondo ichaza isakhiwo se-ecosystem kanye ne-dynamics futhi ikhombisa ukuthi ukuphazamiseka kwemvelo kuthinta kanjani i-ecosystem; noma kunjalo, ikhono layo lokubikezela imiphumela yalezi ziphazamiso lilinganiselwe. Amamodeli okuhlaziya nawokulingisa, ngokuphambene, ayizindlela zezibalo zokuchaza i-ecosystems ezikwazi ngempela ukubikezela imiphumela yezinguquko ezingaba khona zemvelo ngaphandle kokuhlola okuqondile, yize kunemikhawulo ethile mayelana nokunemba. Imodeli yokuhlaziya iyimodeli ye-ecosystem edalwa kusetshenziswa amafomula alula ezibalo ukubikezela imiphumela yokuphazamiseka kwemvelo esakhiweni se-ecosystem kanye ne-dynamics. Imodeli yokulingisa iyimodeli ye-ecosystem edalwa kusetshenziswa ama-algorithms ekhompyutha ayinkimbinkimbi ukuze kumodeliwe ngokuphelele i-ecosystems futhi kubikezelwe imiphumela yokuphazamiseka kwemvelo esakhiweni se-ecosystem kanye ne-dynamics. Okungcono kakhulu, lawa mamodeli anembe ngokwanele ukunquma ukuthi yiziphi izingxenye ze-ecosystem ezizwela kakhulu ekuphazamisekeni, futhi zingasebenza njengomhlahlandlela kubaphathi be-ecosystem (njengabezokongiwa kwemvelo noma izazi zezinto eziphilayo zokudoba) ekugcinweni okusebenzayo kwempilo ye-ecosystem
question1: Kuyini ukuguquguquka kwemvelo?
answer1: Ucwaningo lwezinguquko esakhiweni se-ecosystem ezibangelwa ukuphazamiseka kwemvelo noma amandla angaphakathi
distractor1a: Ukuhlukaniswa kwezindawo zemvelo zibe yi-biomes ezahlukene
distractor1b: Ucwaningo lokugeleza kwamandla kuphela ngezintambo zokudla
distractor1c: Ucwaningo lokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwezinhlobo ngaphandle kokucabangela imvelo
question2: Kungani kunzima ukwenza izifundo zemvelo eziphelele?
answer2: Zidla isikhathi, ziyabiza, futhi ngokuvamile azinamsebenzi noma azinasimilo ukusebenza ezindaweni zemvelo ezinkulu
distractor2c: Bafunda kuphela izinto ezingaphili kahle emzimbeni
question3: Kuyini i-mesocosm?
answer3: Ingxenye ehlukanisiwe yesimiso semvelo esisetshenziselwa ukuhlola okulawulwayo
distractor3b: Indawo ephinde yadalwa kabusha ngokuphelele elabhorethri
question4: Iyini i-microcosm?
answer4: Indawo ephilayo eyakhiwe kabusha endaweni yangaphakathi noma yangaphandle yelabhorethri
distractor4a: Inani elincane labantu abahlala endaweni yemvelo
question5: Iyini imingcele emikhulu yokuhlolwa kwe-mesocosm kanye ne-microcosm?
answer5: Zingashintsha i-ecosystem dynamics ngoba izinto eziphilayo ziyasuswa noma indawo yazo yemvelo iyashintshwa
distractor5b: Zihlala ziveza imiphumela efanayo nemvelo yemvelo
question6: Kungani izazi eziningi zemvelo zincoma ukuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuhlola nezifundo zemvelo eziphelele?
answer6: Ukuthola ulwazi oluthe xaxa mayelana nesakhiwo se-ecosystem, umsebenzi, kanye ne-dynamics
question7: Iyini imodeli yomqondo we-ecosystem?
answer7: Imodeli esebenzisa amashadi okugeleza ukukhombisa ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezingxenye eziphilayo nezingaphili ze-ecosystem
question8: Imodeli ye-analytical ecosystem ihluke kanjani kumodeli yokulingisa?
answer8: Imodeli yokuhlaziya isebenzisa amafomula ezibalo alula, kuyilapho imodeli yokulingisa isebenzisa ama-algorithms ekhompyutha ayinkimbinkimbi
distractor8a: Imodeli yokuhlaziya isebenzisa ukubonwa kwensimu, kuyilapho imodeli yokulingisa isebenzisa ama-food webs kuphela
distractor8b: Imodeli yokuhlaziya ayikwazi ukubikezela izinguquko zemvelo, kanti imodeli yokulingisa ayikwazi ukubikezela noma yikuphi kwalokhu
distractor8c: Imodeli yokuhlaziya ifunda abakhiqizi kuphela, kuyilapho imodeli yokulingisa ifunda abathengi kuphela
question9: Yikuphi ukusetshenziswa okubalulekile kwamamodeli okulingisa imvelo?
answer9: Zisiza ukubikezela ukuthi ukuphazamiseka kwemvelo kungathinta kanjani imvelo futhi zibone izingxenye ezibucayi kakhulu ekushintsheni
distractor9b: Zithatha indawo yaso sonke isilingo sasensimini unomphela
distractor9c: Bahlukanisa izinto eziphilayo zibe amazinga e-trophic

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems | Ucwaningo nge-Ecosystem Dynamics: Ukuhlolwa kwe-Ecosystem kanye nokumodela | Amamodeli Omqondo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems | Ucwaningo nge-Ecosystem Dynamics: Ukuhlolwa kwe-Ecosystem kanye nokumodela | Amamodeli Omqondo
chapterContent:
Amamodeli omqondo awusizo ekuchazeni isakhiwo kanye nokuguquguquka kwemvelo kanye nokubonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ezahlukene emphakathini kanye nendawo ezikuyo. Amamodeli omqondo avame ukuboniswa ngemidwebo njengamashadi okugeleza. Izinto eziphilayo kanye nezinsiza zazo ziqoqwe zibe izingxenye ezithile ezinemicibisholo ekhombisa ubudlelwano kanye nokudluliswa kwamandla noma izakhamzimba phakathi kwazo. Ngakho-ke, lezi zinhlobo amagremu ngezinye izikhathi zibizwa ngokuthi amamodeli ezingxenye.

 Ukuze kuboniswe ukujikeleza kwezakhamzimba zamaminerali, izakhamzimba eziphilayo kanye nezinga-organic zihlukaniswe zibe yilezo ezitholakalayo (ezilungele ukufakwa kuma-macromolecule ezinto eziphilayo) kanye nalezo ezingatholakali. Isibonelo, endaweni yemvelo eseduze nendawo yamalahle, ikhabhoni izotholakala ezitshalweni zale ndawo yemvelo njengegesi yekhabhoni dioksijini esikhathini esifushane, hhayi elahleni elicebile ngekhabhoni uqobo. Kodwa-ke, esikhathini eside, izinto ezincane ezikwazi ukugaya amalahle zizofaka ikhabhoni yalo noma ziyikhulule njengegesi yemvelo (i-methane, i-CH4), zishintshe lo mthombo wezinto eziphilayo ongatholakali ube otholakalayo. Lokhu kuguqulwa kusheshiswa kakhulu ukushiswa kwamafutha asetshenziswa ngabantu, okukhipha inani elikhulu lekhabhoni dioksijini emoyeni. Lokhu kucatshangwa ukuthi kuyimbangela enkulu yokwenyuka kwamazinga e-carbon dioxide esemkhathini esikhathini sezimboni. I-carbon dioxide ekhishwa ekushisweni kwamafutha emvelo ikhiqizwa ngokushesha kunokuba izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthesis zingayisebenzisa. Le nqubo iqiniswa ukunciphisa izihlahla ze-photosynthesis ngenxa yokugawulwa kwamahlathi emhlabeni jikelele. Ososayensi abaningi bayavuma ukuthi i-carbon dioxide ephezulu esemkhathini iyimbangela enkulu yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni jikelele.

 Amamodeli omqondo nawo asetshenziswa ukukhombisa ukugeleza kwamandla ezindaweni ezithile zemvelo. Umfanekiso 37.8 usekelwe ocwaningweni lwakudala lukaHoward T. Odum lwe-Silver Springs, eFlorida, i-holistic ecosystem maphakathi nekhulu lama-20.2 Lolu cwaningo lubonisa okuqukethwe kwamandla kanye nokudluliselwa phakathi kwezingxenye ezahlukene ze-ecosystem.
question1: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko yemodeli yomqondo we-ecosystem?
answer1: Ukuchaza isakhiwo se-ecosystem, ukuguquguquka, kanye nobudlelwano phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezizungezile
distractor1a: Ukubala ukukhula kwabantu kusetshenziswa izibalo zezibalo
distractor1b: Ukudala kabusha izimiso zemvelo ekuhlolweni kwelebhu
distractor1c: Ukuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo zibe amaqembu e-taxonomic
question2: Amamodeli emvelo aqondwayo avame ukumelwa kanjani?
answer2: Njengamashadi okugeleza kwezithombe abonisa izingxenye kanye nokudluliswa kwamandla noma izakhamzimba
question3: Kungani amamodeli anengqondo ngezinye izikhathi ebizwa ngokuthi amamodeli ahlanganisiwe?
answer3: Ngoba izinto eziphilayo kanye nezinsizakusebenza zihlanganiswe ngemicibisholo ekhombisa amandla noma ukugeleza kwezakhamzimba
distractor3a: Ngoba bahlukanisa izindawo zemvelo zibe yizifunda zezepolitiki
distractor3b: Ngoba zichaza kuphela izinto eziphilayo ngazinye
distractor3c: Ngoba bahlukanisa abakhiqizi nabathengi ngaphandle kokubonisa ukusebenzisana
question4: Lisho ukuthini igama elithi bioavailable kumamodeli e-ecosystem?
answer4: Izakhamzimba ezilungele ukufakwa kuma-macromolecule ezinto eziphilayo
question5: Kungani ikhabhoni emalahleni ingatholakali ngokushesha ezitshalweni?
answer5: Ngoba izitshalo zithola ikhabhoni kakhulu emoyeni ongcolile kunokuba zithole amalahle
distractor5b: Ngoba izitshalo zimunca ikhabhoni ngezimpande zazo kuphela
distractor5c: Ngoba ama-microorganisms aguqula ngokushesha wonke amalahle abe umoya-mpilo
question6: Ukushiswa kwamafutha emvelo kuyithinta kanjani imjikelezo yekhabhoni?
answer6: Ikhipha ngokushesha i-carbon dioxide emoyeni ngokushesha kunokuba izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-photosynthesis zingayisusa
distractor6b: Iguqula i-carbon dioxide esemoyeni ibe yilahle
distractor6c: Kuvimbela ama-microorganisms ukuthi aphinde asebenzise ikhabhoni
question7: Kungani ukugawulwa kwamahlathi emhlabeni wonke kuhlotshaniswa nokwenyuka kwamazinga e-carbon dioxide emoyeni?
answer7: Izihlahla ezimbalwa ze-photosynthesis ziyatholakala ukususa i-carbon dioxide emoyeni
distractor7a: Ukugawulwa kwamahlathi kwandisa ukusetshenziswa komoya-mpilo yizitshalo
distractor7b: Izihlahla zikhipha ikhabhoni diokside eningi kuneziphehli zemvelo
distractor7c: Ukugawulwa kwamahlathi kuvimbela ukubola kwezinto eziphilayo
question8: Amamodeli anengqondo asetshenziswa kanjani ukutadisha ukugeleza kwamandla ezindaweni zemvelo?
