answer8: Zibonisa indlela amandla adluliselwa ngayo phakathi kwezingxenye ezahlukene zemvelo
distractor8b: Bahlukanisa izinto eziphilayo zibe amazinga e-trophic ngaphandle kokubonisa ukudluliselwa kwamandla
distractor8c: Balinganisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo besebenzisa izimpawu zofuzo
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.8. Kungani ucabanga ukuthi inani lokukhiqiza okuphelele kwabakhiqizi abayinhloko lifana nenani lokushisa okuphelele nokuphefumula (20,810 kcal/m2/ngonyaka)?
answer9: Ukushisa okuphelele nokuphefumula kubhekisela emandleni asetshenziswa yiwo wonke amazinga e-trophic futhi amandla okutholakala kuphela kula mazinga anikezwa abakhiqizi abayinhloko.
distractor9a: Ukushisa okuphelele nokuphefumula kubhekisela emandleni asetshenziswa yiwo wonke amazinga e-trophic futhi amandla anikezwa abakhiqizi abayinhloko angaphezu kwamandla anikezwa ngabathengi abayinhloko kula mazinga.
distractor9b: Ukukhiqiza okuphelele kwabakhiqizi abayinhloko kufana nenani lokushisa okuphelele kanye nokuphefumula ngenxa yokusebenza kahle kokuguqulwa kwamandla elanga abe amandla asetshenziswa yiwo wonke amazinga e-trophic ngabakhiqizi abayinhloko.
distractor9c: Inani lokukhiqiza okuphelele kwabakhiqizi abayinhloko kanye nokushisa okuphelele kanye nokuphefumula kuyafana njengoba abakhiqizi abayinhloko behlinzeka ngamandla kubathengi abayinhloko kanye nabathengi abaphezulu kuphela.

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems | Ucwaningo nge-Ecosystem Dynamics: Ukuhlolwa kwe-Ecosystem kanye nokumodela | Amamodeli Okuhlaziya Nokulingisa
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems | Ucwaningo nge-Ecosystem Dynamics: Ukuhlolwa kwe-Ecosystem kanye nokumodela | Amamodeli Okuhlaziya Nokulingisa
chapterContent:
Umkhawulo omkhulu wamamodeli omqondo ukungakwazi kwawo ukubikezela imiphumela yezinguquko ezinhlotsheni zemvelo kanye/noma endaweni. Amasistimu emvelo ayizinto eziguquguqukayo futhi angaphansi kokuphazamiseka okuhlukahlukene kwe-abiotic kanye ne-biotic okubangelwa amandla emvelo kanye/noma imisebenzi yabantu. Amasistimu emvelo ashintshiwe kusukela esimweni sawo sokuqala sokulingana angavame ukululama ekuphazamisekeni okunjalo futhi abuyele esimweni sokulingana. Njengoba iningi lezindawo zemvelo libhekene nokuphazamiseka ngezikhathi ezithile futhi livame ukuba sesimweni sokushintsha, ngokuvamile liya noma lisuka esimweni salo sokulingana. Kunezimo eziningi zokulingana phakathi kwezingxenye ezahlukene ze-ecosystem, ezithinta i-ecosystem iyonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, njengoba abantu benekhono lokushintsha kakhulu nangokushesha okuqukethwe kwezinhlobo kanye nendawo yokuhlala ye-ecosystem, isidingo samamodeli okubikezela avumela ukuqonda ukuthi i-ecosystem isabela kanjani kulezi zinguquko siba yinto ebaluleke kakhulu.

 Amamodeli okuhlaziya avame ukusebenzisa izingxenye ezilula, eziqondile ze-ecosystem, njengezintambo zokudla, futhi aziwa ukuthi ayinkimbinkimbi ngokwezibalo; ngakho-ke, adinga ulwazi oluningi lwezibalo kanye nobuchwepheshe. Nakuba amamodeli okuhlaziya enekhono elikhulu, ukulula kwawo kwezindawo zemvelo eziyinkimbinkimbi kucatshangwa ukuthi kukhawulela ukunemba kwawo. Amamodeli okulingisa asebenzisa i-computer pro grams akwazi kangcono ukubhekana nobunzima besakhiwo se-ecosystem.

 Intuthuko yakamuva ekubumbeni ukulingisa isebenzisa ama-supercomputer ukudala nokusebenzisa ukulingisa okusekelwe kumuntu ngamunye, okubangela ukuziphatha kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nemiphumela yazo ku-ecosystem iyonke. Lokhu kulingisa kubhekwa njengokunembile kakhulu nokubikezela izimpendulo eziyinkimbinkimbi ze-ecosystem eziphazamisekile.
question1: Iyini imingcele emikhulu yamamodeli emvelo anomqondo?
answer1: Abakwazi ukubikezela ngokunembile imiphumela yezinguquko ezinhlotsheni zemvelo noma emvelweni
distractor1a: Abakwazi ukubonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo
question2: Kungani amamodeli e-ecosystem abikezelayo ebaluleke kakhulu?
answer2: Ngoba imisebenzi yabantu ingashintsha ngokushesha ukwakheka kwezinhlobo kanye nezindawo zokuhlala
distractor2a: Ngoba izimiso zemvelo aziphinde zilulame ekuphazamisekeni
distractor2b: Ngoba izimiso zemvelo azihlangabezani nokuphazamiseka kwemvelo
distractor2c: Ngoba amamodeli omqondo achaza ngokuphelele amandla e-ecosystem
question3: Izimiso zemvelo zivame ukusabela kanjani ngemva kokuphazamiseka?
answer3: Bangase balulame futhi babuyele esimweni sokulingana
distractor3c: Balahlekelwa unomphela yizo zonke izinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo
question4: Kungani izimiso zemvelo zingavamile ukuba sesimweni sokulingana esihlala njalo?
answer4: Ngoba babhekana nokuphazamiseka kwemvelo okubangelwa abantu ngezikhathi ezithile
distractor4a: Ngoba ukulingana kukhona kuphela ezindaweni zemvelo zelebhu
distractor4b: Ngoba izinto eziphilayo azikwazi ukuzivumelanisa noshintsho lwemvelo
distractor4c: Ngoba izimiso zemvelo azikaze zibe nabakhiqizi
question5: Uhlobo luni lwesakhiwo se-ecosystem oluvame ukusetshenziswa amamodeli okuhlaziya?
answer5: Izingxenye ezilula, eziqondile njengezintambo zokudla
distractor5a: Ama-food web kuphela anokuxhumana kwazo zonke izinhlobo
question6: Iyini imingcele emikhulu yamamodeli okuhlaziya?
answer6: Ukwenza lula izindawo zemvelo eziyinkimbinkimbi kunganciphisa ukunemba kwazo
question7: Kungani amamodeli okulingisa ngokuvamile enembe kakhulu kunamamodeli okuhlaziya?
answer7: Bangachaza kangcono ubunzima besakhiwo se-ecosystem besebenzisa i-computer pro grams
question8: Iyini imodeli yokulingisa esekwe kumuntu ngamunye?
answer8: Ukulingisa okubonisa ukuziphatha kwezinto eziphilayo ngazinye kanye nemiphumela yazo ohlelweni lwemvelo
question9: Kungani amamodeli okulingisa asekelwe kumuntu ngamunye ebhekwa njengokubikezela kakhulu?
answer9: Zihlanganisa ukuziphatha kwezinto eziphilayo ngazinye ukuze zibikezele kangcono izimpendulo zesimiso semvelo eziphazanyisweni
distractor9c: Bayisibonelo sezingxenye ezingasebenzi kahle zemvelo kuphela

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.2 Ukugeleza Kwamandla Nge-Ecosystems | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.2 Ukugeleza Kwamandla Nge-Ecosystems | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Njengoba sifundile lapho sihlola imiqondo ezahlukweni zangaphambilini, zonke izinto eziphilayo zidinga amandla ngendlela ethile, ngokuvamile i-ATP, ukuze zenze izinqubo zamaseli. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ohlelweni lwe-ecosystem zithola kanjani amandla amahhala nokuthi lawo mandla adluliselwa kanjani phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ngokusebenzisa ama-food webs kanye namaketanga azo okudla. Amandla athatha indlela eyodwa ngokusebenzisa i-ecosystem ngoba ukuguqulwa kwamandla kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwamandla asebenzisekayo (amahhala) ngokukhishwa kokushisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinto ezidaliwe ziyajikeleza futhi ziphinde zisetshenziswe njengoba zihamba zisuka ezintweni ezidaliwe ziye ezintweni ezidaliwe. Siphinde safunda ukuthi izingxenye ze-biotic kanye ne-abiotic ze-ecosystem ziyasebenzisana. Ama-Autotroph, ama-chemoautotroph, ama-heterotroph kanye nama-decomposers ahlanganisa izingxenye eziphilayo, kanti izici ze-abiotic zifaka izakhamzimba, izinga lokushisa, i-pH, ukutholakala kwelanga, kanye nohlobo lomhlabathi. Kulesi sigaba, kuzovezwa izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokubonisa lokhu kuhamba kwamandla ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lwe-ecosystem. Ukusebenzisa ukumelwa okuningi kwedatha kanye nokuqonda ukunyakaza kwezinto kanye namandla ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo kuyimiqondo ebalulekile enkambweni ye-AP® Biology.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 4 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezimpahleni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezikuyo kuphumela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
2.2 Umfundi angasebenzisa izindlela zezibalo enanini elichaza izenzakalo zemvelo.
Inhloso Yokufunda
4.14 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izindlela zezibalo emananini achaza ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo nendawo ezikuyo, okuholela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezikuyo kuholela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.15 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo ezibonakalayo ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi ukuze abonise ukuthi ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezikuyo kuholela kanjani ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Zonke izinto eziphilayo zidinga amandla ngendlela ethile noma enye. Amandla adingwa yizindlela eziningi eziyinkimbinkimbi ze-metabolic (ngokuvamile ngesimo se-adenosine triphosphate, i-ATP), ikakhulukazi lezo eziphethe ukwakha ama-molecule amakhulu kusuka kuma-com amancane amakhilogremu, futhi impilo ngokwayo iyinqubo eqhutshwa amandla. Izinto eziphilayo ngeke zikwazi ukuhlanganisa ama-macromolecule (amaprotheni, ama-lipid, ama-nucleic acid, nama-carbohydrate ayinkimbinkimbi) kusuka kuma-subunit azo e-monomeric ngaphandle kokufakwa kwamandla okuqhubekayo.

 Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zithola kanjani amandla nokuthi lawo mandla adluliselwa kanjani kusuka kwesinye isidalwa kuya kwesinye ngama-food web kanye ne-food chain yazo. Ama-food web abonisa ukuthi amandla ageleza kanjani ngendlela eqondile ezindaweni zemvelo, okuhlanganisa ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ziwathola kanjani, ziwasebenzisa kanjani, nokuthi kusele malini ukuze kusetshenziswe ezinye izinto eziphilayo ze-food web.
question1: Kungani zonke izinto eziphilayo zidinga amandla?
answer1: Ukwenza izinqubo zamaseli kanye nokunika amandla imisebenzi ye-metabolic njengokwakha ama-macromolecule
question2: Iyini imali yamandla eyinhloko esetshenziswa amaseli amaningi?
answer2: I-ATP (i-adenosine triphosphate)
question3: Amandla ahamba kanjani endaweni ezungezile?
answer3: Igeleza ohlangothini olulodwa ngokusebenzisa ama-food web kanye nama-food chain, amandla alahleka njengokushisa ekudlulisweni ngakunye
distractor3a: Ijikeleza njalo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa
question4: Izinto ezihamba kanjani ezindaweni zemvelo?
answer4: Iyajikeleza futhi isetshenziswe kabusha njengoba isuka kokuphilayo iye kokuphilayo
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyingxenye engeyona i-abiotic ye-ecosystem?
answer5: Inhlabathi
question6: Yiliphi iqembu eliqukethe izingxenye eziphilayo (eziphilayo) zesimiso sezinto eziphilayo?
answer6: Ama-Autotroph, ama-chemoautotroph, ama-heterotroph, kanye nama-decomposers
distractor6a: Ukukhanya kwelanga, inhlabathi, izakhamzimba, kanye ne-pH
question7: Ngokusho kwe-AP® Biology Learning Objective 4.14, yini okufanele abafundi bakwazi ukuyenza?
answer7: Sebenzisa izindlela zezibalo ukuchaza ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezizungezile okuholela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla
distractor7a: Bala amazinga okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ku-DNA
distractor7b: Hlukanisa izinto eziphilayo zibe amaqembu e-taxonomic
question8: Ngokusho kwe-AP® Biology Learning Objective 4.15, yini okufanele abafundi bakwazi ukuyisebenzisa?
answer8: Izethulo ezibonakalayo zokuhlaziya indlela ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezizungezile okuholela ngayo ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla
distractor8a: Izibalo zezibalo kuphela ezingenayo i-dia amagremu
question9: Kungani ama-food webs ebalulekile emvelweni?
answer9: Zibonisa ukugeleza kwamandla ngendlela eqondiswa ngayo ezindaweni zemvelo nokuthi amandla adluliselwa kahle kanjani phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor9b: Zichaza kuphela ubudlelwano phakathi kwezilwane ezidla ezinye ngaphandle kokudluliselwa kwamandla

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.2 Ukugeleza Kwamandla Ezindaweni Eziphilayo | Indlela Izinto Eziphilayo Ezithola Ngayo Amandla Kuwebhu Yokudla
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.2 Ukugeleza Kwamandla Ezindaweni Eziphilayo | Indlela Izinto Eziphilayo Ezithola Ngayo Amandla Kuwebhu Yokudla
chapterContent:
Amandla atholakala ngezinto eziphilayo ngezindlela ezintathu: i-photosynthesis, i-chemosynthesis, kanye nokusetshenziswa kanye nokugaya ezinye izinto eziphilayo noma ezaziphila ngaphambilini yi-heterotrophs.

 Izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthetic kanye ne-chemosynthetic zombili ziqoqwe ngesigaba esaziwa ngokuthi ama-autotrophs: izinto eziphilayo ezikwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla kwazo (ngokuqondile, ezikwazi ukusebenzisa ikhabhoni engaphili njengomthombo wekhabhoni). Ama-autotrophs e-photosynthetic (ama-photoautotrophs) asebenzisa ukukhanya kwelanga njengomthombo wamandla, kanti ama-autotrophs e-chemosynthetic (ama-chemoautotrophs) asebenzisa ama-molecule angaphili njengomthombo wamandla. Ama-Autotrophs abalulekile kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo. Ngaphandle kwalezi zinto eziphilayo, amandla abengeke atholakale kwezinye izinto eziphilayo futhi impilo ngokwayo ibingeke ibe khona.

 Ama-Photoautotrophs, njengezitshalo, ulwelwe, kanye namagciwane e-photosynthetic, asebenza njengomthombo wamandla wezindawo eziningi zemvelo zomhlaba. Lezi zindawo zemvelo zivame ukuchazwa ngama-web okudla adla imifino. Ama-photoautotrophs asebenzisa amandla elanga ngokuwaguqula abe amandla amakhemikhali ngesimo se-ATP (ne-NADP). Amandla agcinwe ku-ATP asetshenziselwa ukuhlanganisa ama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi e-organic, njenge-glucose.

 Ama-chemoautotrophs ngokuyinhloko amabhaktheriya atholakala ezindaweni zemvelo ezingavamile lapho ukukhanya kwelanga kungatholakali khona, njengalezo ezihlotshaniswa nemihume emnyama noma imigodi yamanzi ashisayo phansi kolwandle (Isithombe 37.9). Ama-chemoautotrophs amaningi ezindaweni zemvelo ezishisayo asebenzisa i-hydrogen sulfide (H2S), ekhishwa ezindaweni zemvelo njengomthombo wamandla amakhemikhali. Lokhu kuvumela ama-chemoautotrophs ukuthi ahlanganise ama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi e-organic, njenge-glucose, ukuze abe namandla awo futhi anikeze amandla kuyo yonke indawo zemvelo.
question1: Yiziphi izindlela ezintathu izinto eziphilayo ezithola ngazo amandla?
answer1: I-Photosynthesis, i-chemosynthesis, kanye nokudla ezinye izinto eziphilayo noma ezaziphila ngaphambilini
question2: Kuyini i-autotroph?
answer2: Isidalwa esikwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla kwaso sisebenzisa ikhabhoni engakhiqizi izinto eziphilayo njengomthombo wekhabhoni
distractor2a: Isidalwa esithola amandla ngokudla izitshalo kuphela
question3: Uyini umehluko phakathi kwama-photoautotrophs nama-chemoautotrophs?
answer3: Ama-photoautotrophs asebenzisa ukukhanya kwelanga njengomthombo wamandla, kanti ama-chemoautotrophs asebenzisa ama-molecule amakhemikhali angaphili
distractor3a: Ama-photoautotrophs asebenzisa izinto eziphilayo, kanti ama-chemoautotrophs asebenzisa ukukhanya kwelanga
distractor3c: Ama-photoautotroph adinga umoya-mpilo, kanti ama-chemoautotroph awadingi umoya-mpilo.
question4: Kungani ama-autotrophs ebalulekile ezindaweni zemvelo?
answer4: Zinikeza amandla asekela zonke ezinye izinto eziphilayo ohlelweni lwe-ecosystem
question5: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo eziyizibonelo zama-photoautotrophs?
answer5: Izitshalo, ulwelwe, kanye namagciwane e-photosynthetic
question6: Yiluphi uhlobo lwamandla ama-photoautotrophs aqala ukuwabamba elangeni?
answer6: Amandla amakhemikhali agcinwe njenge-ATP (kanye ne-NADP)
question7: Zitholakala kuphi i-chemoautotrophs?
answer7: Ezindaweni ezingenalo ukukhanya kwelanga, njengezindawo zokungenisa umoya ezisebenzisa amanzi ashisayo kanye nemihume emnyama
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.9. Yiliphi ikhemikhali elivame ukusetshenziswa yi-hydrothermal vent chemoautotrophs njengomthombo wamandla?
answer8: I-hydrogen sulfide (H2S)
question9: Ama-chemoautotrophs ayisekela kanjani yonke ingxenye ye-ecosystem?
answer9: Basebenzisa amandla amakhemikhali ukuhlanganisa ama-molecule e-organic anikeza amandla kwezinye izinto eziphilayo
distractor9a: Ziguqula i-glucose ngqo ibe ukukhanya kwelanga
distractor9c: Zivimbela ukudluliselwa kwamandla ngokusebenzisa ama-food webs

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.2 Ukugeleza Kwamandla Ezindaweni Eziphilayo | Ukukhiqiza Ngaphakathi Kwamazinga E-Trophic
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.2 Ukugeleza Kwamandla Ezindaweni Eziphilayo | Ukukhiqiza Ngaphakathi Kwamazinga E-Trophic
chapterContent:
Ukukhiqiza ngaphakathi kwe-ecosystem kungachazwa njengephesenti lamandla angena ku-ecosystem ehlanganiswe ne-biomass ezingeni elithile le-trophic. I-Biomass iyisisindo esiphelele, endaweni yeyunithi ngesikhathi sokulinganisa, sezinto eziphilayo noma eziphilayo ngaphambili ngaphakathi kwezinga le-trophic. I-ecosystems inenani elihlukile le-biomass ezingeni ngalinye le-trophic. Isibonelo, ku-ecosystem ye-English Channel abakhiqizi abayinhloko babala i-biomass engu-4 g/m2 ([amagremu ngemitha ngayinye eyisikwele), kuyilapho abathengi abayinhloko bebonisa i-biomass engu-21 g/m2.

 Ukukhiqiza kwabakhiqizi abayinhloko kubaluleke kakhulu kunoma iyiphi i-ecosystem ngoba lezi zinto eziphilayo ziletha amandla kwezinye izinto eziphilayo nge-photoautotrophy noma i-chemoautotrophy. Izinga lapho abakhiqizi abayinhloko be-photosynthetic befaka khona amandla avela elangeni libizwa ngokuthi i-gross primary productivity. Isibonelo sokukhiqiza okuyinhloko okuyinhloko sikhonjiswa kumdwebo wengxenye yokugeleza kwamandla ngaphakathi kwe-ecosystem yasemanzini yaseSilver Springs njengoba kuboniswe (Isithombe 37.8). Kule nqubo yemvelo, amandla aphelele aqoqwe ngabakhiqizi abayinhloko (ukukhiqiza okuyinhloko okuphelele) aboniswe ukuthi angama-20,810 kcal/m2/ngonyaka.

 Ngenxa yokuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo zidinga ukusebenzisa amanye ala mandla ngemisebenzi yazo (njengokuphefumula kanye nokulahlekelwa ukushisa okubangelwa yi-metabolic) ososayensi bavame ukubhekisela ekukhiqizeni okuyinhloko okuyisisekelo kwenqubo yemvelo. Ukukhiqiza okuyinhloko okuyisisekelo okuhlanzekile amandla ahlala kubakhiqizi abayinhloko ngemva kokubala ukuphefumula nokulahlekelwa ukushisa kwezinto eziphilayo. Ukukhiqiza okuhlanzekile kuyatholakala kubathengi abayinhloko ezingeni elilandelayo le-trophic. Esibonelweni sethu se-Silver Spring, ama-kcal angu-13,187 kwangu-20,810/m2/ngonyaka asetshenziselwa ukuphefumula noma alahleka njengokushisa, okushiya ama-kcal angu-7,632/m2/ngonyaka wamandla ukuze asetshenziswe ngabathengi abayinhloko.
question1: Kuyini ukukhiqiza ngaphakathi kwesimiso sezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Iphesenti lamandla angena ohlelweni lwe-ecosystem olufakwe ku-biomass ezingeni elithile le-trophic
distractor1a: Inani eliphelele lezinto eziphilayo endaweni ezungezile
distractor1c: Inani lokukhanya kwelanga elifinyelela ebusweni bomhlaba
question2: Kuyini i-biomass?
answer2: Isisindo esiphelele sezinto eziphilayo noma eziphilayo ngaphambili ngaphakathi kwezinga le-trophic endaweni ngayinye
distractor2a: Inani lezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ngaphakathi kwe-ecosystem
question3: Kungani umkhiqizo wabakhiqizi abayinhloko ubaluleke kakhulu?
answer3: Zethula amandla ezindaweni zemvelo ngokusebenzisa i-photoautotrophy noma i-chemoautotrophy
distractor3b: Ziphinda zisebenzise zonke izakhamzimba zibuyele emoyeni
distractor3c: Bathola amandla avela kubathengi abasezingeni eliphezulu
question4: Kuyini umkhiqizo oyinhloko ophelele?
answer4: Izinga abakhiqizi abayinhloko be-photosynthesis ababamba ngalo amandla avela elangeni
question5: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.8. Yayiyini isivuno esikhulu sezinto eziphilayo zaseSilver Springs?
answer5: 20,810 kcal/m2/ngonyaka
question6: Kuyini ukukhiqiza okuyisisekelo okungenayo i-intanethi?
answer6: Amandla asele kubakhiqizi abayinhloko ngemva kokuphefumula nokulahlekelwa ukushisa
distractor6a: Amandla aphelele athathwe ekukhanyeni kwelanga ngaphambi kokuphefumula
question7: Kungani umkhiqizo oyinhloko ophelele uhlala uphansi kunomkhiqizo oyinhloko ophelele?
answer7: Amanye amandla abanjwe asetshenziselwa ukuphefumula bese elahleka njengokushisa
distractor7a: Abakhiqizi abayinhloko badlulisela wonke amandla ngqo kubathengi
distractor7c: Ukukhiqiza okuyinhloko okuyisisekelo kufaka phakathi amandla avela kuma-decompolser
question8: Kuhlelo lwe-Silver Springs, kungakanani amandla asele atholakala kubathengi abayinhloko ngemva kokuphefumula nokulahlekelwa ukushisa?
answer8: 7,632 kcal/m2/ngonyaka

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.2 Ukugeleza Kwamandla Ezindaweni Eziphilayo | Ukusebenza Kahle Kwe-Ecological: Ukudluliselwa Kwamandla Phakathi Kwamazinga E-Trophic
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.2 Ukugeleza Kwamandla Ezindaweni Eziphilayo | Ukusebenza Kahle Kwe-Ecological: Ukudluliselwa Kwamandla Phakathi Kwamazinga E-Trophic
chapterContent:
Njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 37.8, inani elikhulu lamandla liyalahleka kusuka endaweni yemvelo kusuka kwelinye izinga le-trophic kuya kwelinye njengoba amandla egeleza evela kubakhiqizi abayinhloko ngokusebenzisa amazinga ahlukahlukene e-trophic abathengi kanye nababolayo. Isizathu esiyinhloko salokhu kulahlekelwa umthetho wesibili we-thermodynamics, othi noma nini lapho amandla eguqulwa kusuka kwesinye isimo aye kwesinye, kukhona ukuthambekela kokuphazamiseka (i-entropy) ohlelweni. Ezinhlelweni ze-biologic, lokhu kusho ukuthi amandla amaningi alahleka njengokushisa kwe-metabolic lapho izinto eziphilayo ezivela kwelinye izinga le-trophic zidla izinga elilandelayo. Esibonelweni se-Silver Springs ecosystem (Isithombe 37.8), sibona ukuthi abathengi abayinhloko bakhiqize u-1103 kcal/m2/yr kusuka ku-7618 kcal/m2/yr wamandla atholakala kubo kubakhiqizi abayinhloko. Ukulinganiswa kokusebenza kahle kokudluliselwa kwamandla phakathi kwamazinga amabili e-trophic alandelanayo kubizwa ngokuthi ukusebenza kahle kokudluliselwa kwezinga le-trophic (TLTE) futhi kuchazwa ngefomula:

 TLTE =

 ukukhiqizwa okwamanje ezingeni le-trophic

 ÷

 ukukhiqizwa ezingeni le-trophic langaphambilini

 × 100

 E-Silver Springs, i-TLTE phakathi kwamazinga amabili okuqala e-trophic yayicishe ibe ngamaphesenti angu-14.48. Ukusebenza kahle okuphansi kokudluliselwa kwamandla phakathi kwamazinga e-trophic ngokuvamile kuyisici esiyinhloko esikhawulela ubude bezintambo zokudla ezibonwa kuwebhu yokudla. Iqiniso liwukuthi, ngemva kokudluliselwa kwamandla okune kuya kwayisithupha, akusekho amandla anele asele ukusekela elinye izinga le-trophic. Esibonelweni saseLake Ontario esiboniswe ku-Ecology of Ecosystems, ukudluliselwa kwamandla okuthathu kuphela okwenzeka phakathi komkhiqizi oyinhloko, (i-green algae), kanye nomthengi oyinhloko (i-Chinook salmon).

 Ososayensi be-ecology banezindlela eziningi ezahlukene zokulinganisa ukudluliselwa kwamandla ngaphakathi kwe-ecosystems. Okunye ukudluliselwa kulula noma kunzima ukukulinganisa kuye ngobunzima be-ecosystem kanye nokuthi ososayensi banokufinyelela okungakanani ukuze babone i-ecosystem. Ngamanye amazwi, ezinye i-ecosystems kunzima ukuzifunda kunezinye, futhi ngezinye izikhathi ukulinganiswa kokudluliselwa kwamandla kufanele kulinganiswe.

 Enye ipharamitha ebalulekile ekuchazeni ukuhamba kwamandla ngaphakathi kwe-ecosystem ukusebenza kahle kokukhiqiza okune-net. Ukusebenza kahle kokukhiqiza okune-net (i-NPE) kuvumela izazi zemvelo ukuthi zilinganise ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zezinga elithile le-trophic ziwafaka kanjani amandla eziwatholayo ku-biomass; kubalwa kusetshenziswa ifomula elandelayo:

 I-NPE = umkhiqizo wabathengi ophelele

 ÷

 ukuhlanganiswa

 × 100

 Ukukhiqiza kwabathengi okune-net okuqukethwe kwamandla okutholakala ezintweni eziphilayo zezinga elilandelayo le-trophic. Ukuhlanganiswa yi-biomass (okuqukethwe kwamandla okukhiqizwa endaweni ngayinye) yezinga lamanje le-trophic ngemuva kokubala amandla alahlekile ngenxa yokungagwinywa kokudla okungaphelele, amandla asetshenziselwa ukuphefumula, kanye namandla alahlekile njengemfucuza. Ukufakwa okungaphelele kubhekisela eqinisweni lokuthi abanye abathengi badla ingxenye yokudla kwabo kuphela. Isibonelo, lapho ibhubesi libulala i-antelope, lizodla konke ngaphandle kwesikhumba namathambo. Ibhubesi alinawo umnkantsha wethambo ocebile ngamandla ngaphakathi kwethambo, ngakho-ke ibhubesi alisebenzisi wonke amakhalori isisulu salo esingawanikeza.

 Ngakho-ke, i-NPE ilinganisa ukuthi izinga ngalinye le-trophic lisebenzisa kanjani kahle futhi lifaka amandla avela ekudleni kwalo liye kwi-biomass ukuze linikeze amandla ezingeni elilandelayo le-trophic. Ngokuvamile, izilwane ezinegazi elibandayo (ama-ectotherms), njengezilwane ezingenamgogodla, izinhlanzi, ama-amphibians, nezilwane ezihuquzelayo, zisebenzisa amandla amancane eziwatholayo ekuphefumuleni nasekufudumaleni kunezilwane ezinegazi elifudumele (ama-endotherms), njengezinyoni nezilwane ezincelisayo. Ukushisa okwengeziwe okukhiqizwa kuma-endotherms, yize kuyinzuzo maqondana nomsebenzi walezi zinto eziphilayo ezindaweni ezibandayo, kuyiphutha elikhulu maqondana ne-NPE. Ngakho-ke, ama-endotherm amaningi kufanele adle kaningi kune-ectotherms ukuze athole amandla awadingayo ukuze asinde. Ngokuvamile, i-NPE yama-ectotherm iphakeme kakhulu (10x) kune-endotherms. Isibonelo, i-NPE yamaqabunga adla isibungu ilinganiswe ngamaphesenti angu-18, kanti i-NPE ye-squirrel edla ama-acorn ingaba ngaphansi ngamaphesenti angu-1.6.

 Ukungasebenzi kahle kokusetshenziswa kwamandla yizilwane ezinegazi elifudumele kunemiphumela ebanzi ekuhlinzekweni kokudla komhlaba wonke. Kuyamukelwa kabanzi ukuthi imboni yenyama isebenzisa inani elikhulu lezitshalo ukondla imfuyo, futhi ngenxa yokuthi i-NPE iphansi, amandla amaningi avela ekudleni kwezilwane ayalahleka. Isibonelo, kubiza cishe u-$0.01 ukukhiqiza amakhalori ayi-1000 okudla (kcal) ommbila noma ubhontshisi, kodwa cishe u-$0.19 ukukhiqiza inani elifanayo lamakhalori akhulisa izinkomo ukuze zisetshenziswe inyama yenkomo. Okuqukethwe kwamandla afanayo kobisi oluvela ezinkomeni nakho kuyabiza, cishe u-$0.16 nge-1000 kcal. Okuningi kwalokhu mehluko kungenxa ye-NPE ephansi yezinkomo. Ngakho-ke, kube nokunyakaza okukhula emhlabeni wonke ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kokudla okungeyona inyama nokungewona ubisi ukuze kusetshenziswe amandla amancane okondla izilwane embonini yenyama.
question1: Iyini imbangela eyinhloko yokuthi amandla anciphe phakathi kwamazinga e-trophic alandelanayo?
answer1: Amandla alahleka njengokushisa kwe-metabolic ngokomthetho wesibili we-thermodynamics
distractor1a: Iningi lamandla liguqulwa ngqo libe amaminerali
distractor1b: Abakhiqizi abayinhloko basebenzisa iningi lamandla atholakalayo
question2: Kulinganisani ukusebenza kahle kokudluliselwa kwezinga le-trophic (TLTE)?
answer2: Iphesenti lamandla adluliselwe kusuka ezingeni elilodwa le-trophic kuya kwelinye
distractor2c: Inani lezinto eziphilayo ezingeni ngalinye le-trophic
question3: Kungani izintambo zokudla zivame ukukhawulelwa emazingeni ambalwa kuphela e-trophic?
answer3: Kusele amandla amancane kakhulu ngemva kokudluliselwa kwamandla kaningana ukuze kusekelwe elinye izinga le-trophic
distractor3a: Abathengi abakwazi ukudla amazinga angaphezu kwelilodwa e-trophic
question4: Kulinganisani ukusebenza kahle kokukhiqiza (i-NPE)?
answer4: Indlela izinto eziphilayo eziguqula ngayo amandla ahlanganisiwe abe yi-biomass ngempumelelo
distractor4a: Indlela abakhiqizi ababamba ngayo ukukhanya kwelanga ngempumelelo
question5: Kuyini ukuhlanganiswa ekubalweni kokusebenza kahle kokukhiqiza okunetha?
answer5: I-biomass esele ngemva kokufaka ukudla okungaphelele, ukuphefumula, kanye nokulahlekelwa udoti
question6: Kungani ukusebenza kahle kwe-net kwe-ectotherms ngokuvamile kuphakeme kunokwe-endotherms?
answer6: Ama-ectotherm asebenzisa amandla amancane ekuphefumuleni nasekukhiqizeni ukushisa
distractor6c: Ama-ectotherm alahlekelwa amandla amaningi njengokushisa kwe-metabolic
question7: Yisiphi isidalwa ngokuvamile esingaba nokusebenza kahle kokukhiqiza okunetha okuphezulu?
answer7: Isibungu sidla amaqabunga
question8: Kungani ukukhiqizwa kwenyama kungasebenzi kahle njengokukhiqiza ukudla kwezitshalo?
answer8: Imfuyo inokukhiqiza okuphansi, ngakho-ke amandla amaningi okudla ayalahleka ngaphambi kokuba abe yi-biomass edliwayo.
distractor8a: Izitshalo zidinga amandla amaningi kunezilwane ukuze zikhule
distractor8c: Izilwane zidlulisela amandla ngendlela ephumelela kakhulu kunezitshalo
question9: Ukungenisa okungaphelele kunciphisa kanjani ukusebenza kahle kokukhiqiza?
answer9: Abathengi abazidli zonke izingxenye zokudla kwabo, okushiya amandla athile engatholakali ukuze kukhiqizwe i-biomass
distractor9a: Abathengi baguqula konke ukudla okudliwe kube ukushisa ngqo
distractor9b: Abathengi balahlekelwa amandla abo onke ngokuphefumula ngaphambi kokugaya ukudla
question10: Ngokuvamile, yiluphi ushintsho lokudla olunganciphisa ukulahlekelwa amandla ekukhiqizweni kokudla?
answer10: Ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kokudla okusekelwe ezitshalweni esikhundleni senyama nobisi

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.2 Ukugeleza Kwamandla Nge-Ecosystems | Ukulingisa I-Ecosystems Ukugeleza Kwamandla: Amaphiramidi E-Ecological
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.2 Ukugeleza Kwamandla Nge-Ecosystems | Ukulingisa I-Ecosystems Ukugeleza Kwamandla: Amaphiramidi E-Ecological
chapterContent:
Isakhiwo sezindawo zemvelo singabonakala ngemipiramidi yezemvelo, eyaqala ukuchazwa yizifundo zokuqala zikaCharles Elton ngawo-1920. Imipiramidi yezemvelo ikhombisa inani elilinganiselwe lama-para amamitha ahlukahlukene (njengenani lezinto eziphilayo, amandla, kanye ne-biomass) kuwo wonke amazinga e-trophic.

 Amapiramidi ezinombolo angaba aqondile noma aguqulwe, kuye nge-ecosystem. Njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 37.10, utshani obujwayelekile ehlobo bunesisekelo sezitshalo eziningi futhi izinombolo zezinto eziphilayo ziyehla ezingeni ngalinye le-trophic. Kodwa-ke, ehlobo ehlathini elinomoya opholile, isisekelo sepiramidi siqukethe izihlahla ezimbalwa uma kuqhathaniswa nenani labathengi abayinhloko, ikakhulukazi izinambuzane. Ngenxa yokuthi izihlahla zinkulu, zinekhono elikhulu le-photosynthesis, futhi zibusa ezinye izitshalo kule ecosystem ukuthola ukukhanya kwelanga. Ngisho nangamanani amancane, abakhiqizi abayinhloko emahlathini basakwazi ukusekela amanye amazinga e-trophic.

 Enye indlela yokubona ngeso lengqondo isakhiwo se-ecosystem ngamapiramidi e-biomass. Le phiramidi ilinganisa inani lamandla aguqulwe abe yizicubu eziphilayo emazingeni ahlukene e-trophic. Isebenzisa isibonelo se-Silver Springs ecosystem, le datha ibonisa iphiramidi ye-biomass eqondile (Isithombe 37.10), kanti iphiramidi evela esibonelweni se-English Channel iguquliwe. Izitshalo (abakhiqizi abayinhloko) be-ecosystem ye-Silver Springs zakha iphesenti elikhulu le-biomass etholakala lapho. Kodwa-ke, i-phytoplankton esibonelweni se-English Channel yakha i-biomass encane kunabathengi abayinhloko, i-zooplankton. Njengakumaphiramidi aguquliwe ezinombolo, le phiramidi eguquliwe ayibangelwa ukuntuleka kokukhiqiza okuvela kubakhiqizi abayinhloko, kodwa ibangelwa izinga eliphezulu lokuphuma kwe-phytoplankton. I-phytoplankton idliwa ngokushesha ngabathengi abayinhloko, ngaleyo ndlela, inciphisa i-biomass yabo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Kodwa-ke, i-phytoplankton izalana ngokushesha, ngaleyo ndlela iyakwazi ukusekela lonke uhlelo lwe-ecosystem.

 Ukumodelwa kwe-pyramid ecosystem kungasetshenziswa futhi ukukhombisa ukugeleza kwamandla emazingeni e-trophic. Qaphela ukuthi lezi zinombolo ziyafana nalezo ezisetshenziswe kumdwebo we-compartment flow compartment ku-Figure 37.8. Amaphiramidi amandla ahlala eqondile, futhi i-ecosystem engenakho ukukhiqiza okuyinhloko okwanele ayinakusekelwa. Zonke izinhlobo zamaphiramidi e-ecosystem ziwusizo ekuchazeni isakhiwo se-ecosystem. Kodwa-ke, esifundweni sokugeleza kwamandla ku-ecosystem, amaphiramidi amandla ayimodeli ehambisanayo futhi emele kakhulu yesakhiwo se-ecosystem (Isithombe 37.10)
question1: Yini eboniswa yizipiramidi zemvelo?
answer1: Inani elilinganiselwe lezinto eziphilayo, i-biomass, noma amandla emazingeni ahlukene e-trophic
distractor1a: Izinga lokuziphendukela kwemvelo ngaphakathi kwenani labantu
question2: Kungani amaphiramidi ezinombolo angaba aqondile noma aguquliwe?
answer2: Ngoba inani lezinto eziphilayo ezingeni ngalinye le-trophic lincike esakhiweni se-ecosystem
distractor2a: Ngoba amandla ayanda emazingeni aphezulu e-trophic
distractor2b: Ngoba i-biomass ihlala ingcono kakhulu kubathengi
distractor2c: Ngoba abakhiqizi bahlala bembalwa kakhulu kunezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane
question3: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.10. Kungani ihlathi elinesimo sezulu esipholile lingaba nephiramidi eguquliwe yezinombolo?
answer3: Inani elincane lezihlahla ezinkulu lingasekela izinambuzane eziningi ezidla ukudla okuyinhloko
distractor3c: Abathengi abayinhloko baningi kunabakhiqizi kuzo zonke izindawo zemvelo
question4: Iyini iphiramidi ye-biomass?
answer4: Inani lamandla agcinwe njengezicubu eziphilayo ezingeni ngalinye le-trophic
distractor4a: Inani lezinto eziphilayo ezingeni ngalinye le-trophic
question5: Kungani iphiramidi ye-biomass ye-English Channel iguquliwe?
answer5: I-phytoplankton idliwa ngokushesha, okuholela ekutheni i-biomass ingabi namandla naphezu kokukhiqiza okuphezulu
distractor5c: Abathengi abayinhloko bakhiqiza amandla amaningi kunabakhiqizi
question6: Kungani amaphiramidi amandla ehlala eqondile?
answer6: Amandla ayalahleka kukho konke ukudluliselwa kwe-trophic, ngakho-ke amandla amancane atholakala emazingeni aphezulu e-trophic
question7: Yiluphi uhlobo lwephiramidi yemvelo olunikeza ukumelwa okuvumelana kakhulu kokugeleza kwamandla emvelo?
answer7: Iphiramidi yamandla
question8: Kungani i-phytoplankton ingasekela inani elikhulu le-zooplankton naphezu kokuba ne-biomass ephansi?
answer8: Zizala ngokushesha futhi zinezinga eliphezulu lokuphuma kwezitshalo
distractor8a: Zigcina amandla ngendlela ephumelela kakhulu kunabo bonke abanye abakhiqizi
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.10 kanye noMfanekiso 37.10.1. Ithebula libonisa izilinganiso zokuguqulwa kokudla (i-FCR) zezilwane zasemapulazini ezahlukene. I-FCR ibalwa ngokuhlukanisa inani lokudla okunikezwa isilwane ngesisindo esidliwayo sezilwane. Izinkukhu ze-broiler ziyizinkukhu ezifuywe ngenyama yazo. Ungumnikazi wepulazi ofuna ukukhulisa imfuyo yenyama. Ufuna imfuyo ibe ne-FCR esebenza kahle, kodwa awufuni ukukhulisa izinyoni. Yisiphi isilwane esifaneleka esimweni sakho?
answer9: Izingulube

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.2 Ukugeleza Kwamandla Ezindaweni Ezizungezile | Imiphumela Yewebhu Yokudla: Ukukhuliswa Kwezinto Eziphilayo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.2 Ukugeleza Kwamandla Ezindaweni Ezizungezile | Imiphumela Yewebhu Yokudla: Ukukhuliswa Kwezinto Eziphilayo
chapterContent:
Omunye wemiphumela ebaluleke kakhulu yemvelo ye-ecosystem dynamics yi-biomagnification. I-biomagnification ukwanda kokugcwala kwezinto ezihlala njalo, ezinobuthi ezintweni eziphilayo ezingeni ngalinye le-trophic, kusukela kubakhiqizi abayinhloko kuya kubathengi abaphezulu. Izinto eziningi zikhonjiswe ukuthi ziyanqwabelana, okuhlanganisa nezifundo zakudala nge-pesticide dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT), eyanyatheliswa encwadini ethengiswa kakhulu ngawo-1960, i-Silent Spring, nguRachel Carson. I-DDT yayiyi-pesticide esetshenziswa kakhulu ngaphambi kokuba izingozi zayo zaziwe. Kwezinye izindawo zemvelo zasemanzini, izinto eziphilayo ezivela ezingeni ngalinye le-trophic zazidla izinto eziningi zezinga eliphansi, okwabangela ukuthi i-DDT yande ezinyonini (apex consumers) ezazidla izinhlanzi. Ngakho-ke, izinyoni zaqoqa inani elanele le-DDT ukuze zibangele ubuthakathaka emagobolondweni azo amaqanda. Lo mphumela wandisa ukuphuka kwamaqanda ngesikhathi sokuzalela futhi kwabonakala ukuthi unemiphumela emibi kulezi zinyoni. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-DDT kwavinjelwa e-United States ngawo-1970.

 Ezinye izinto ezikhulisa imvelo yi-polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs), ezazisetshenziswa koketshezi olupholile e-United States kwaze kwaba yilapho ukusetshenziswa kwazo kuvinjelwa ngo-1979, kanye nezinsimbi ezisindayo, njenge-mercury, i-lead, ne-cadmium. Lezi zinto zafundwa kangcono ezindaweni zemvelo zasemanzini, lapho izinhlobo zezinhlanzi emazingeni ahlukene e-trophic ziqoqa izinto ezinobuthi ezilethwa endaweni zemvelo ngabakhiqizi abayinhloko. Njengoba kuboniswe ocwaningweni olwenziwe yi-National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) eSaginaw Bay of Lake Huron (Isithombe 37.11), amazinga e-PCB akhuphuke kusukela kubakhiqizi abayinhloko be-ecosystem (phytoplankton) ngokusebenzisa amazinga ahlukene e-trophic ezinhlobo zezinhlanzi. I-apex consumer (i-walleye) inenani eliphindwe kane le-PCB uma kuqhathaniswa ne-phytoplankton. Futhi, ngokusekelwe emiphumeleni evela kwezinye izifundo, izinyoni ezidla lezi zinhlanzi zingase zibe namazinga e-PCB okungenani okukodwa kobukhulu kunalawo atholakala ezinhlanzini zasechibini.

 Okunye ukukhathazeka kuye kwaphakanyiswa ukuqongelela kwezinsimbi ezisindayo, njenge-mercury ne-cadmium, ezinhlotsheni ezithile zokudla kwasolwandle. I-United States Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) incoma ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe nezingane ezincane akufanele badle noma iyiphi i-swordfish, i-shark, i-king mackerel, noma i-tilefish ngenxa yokuqukethwe kwayo okuphezulu kwe-mercury. Laba bantu belulekwa ukuba badle izinhlanzi ezine-mercury eningi: i-salmon, i-tilapia, i-shrimp, i-pollock, kanye ne-catfish. I-biomagnification iyisibonelo esihle sendlela i-ecosystem dynamics engathinta ngayo izimpilo zethu zansuku zonke, ngisho nokuthonya ukudla esikudlayo.
question1: Kuyini ukukhulisa izinto eziphilayo (i-biomagnification)?
answer1: Ukuhlushwa okwandayo kwezinto ezinobuthi eziqhubekayo ezingeni ngalinye le-trophic elilandelanayo
distractor1c: Ukwanda kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo emazingeni aphezulu e-trophic
question2: Kungani amazinga e-DDT enyuke kakhulu ezinyonini ezidla inyama?
answer2: Badla izinto eziningi eziphilayo ezingcolisiwe ezivela emazingeni aphansi e-trophic
question3: Yimuphi umphumela olimazayo i-DDT enawo ezinyonini eziningi?
answer3: Kwabangela ukuba amagobolondo amaqanda abe buthakathaka, okwandisa ukuphuka kwamaqanda
distractor3b: Kwabangela ukuthi izinyoni zilahlekelwe yizimpaphe zazo
question4: Yisiphi esinye isithako esaziwa ngokukhulisa ukudla kuma-food webs?
answer4: Ama-biphenyls e-polychlorinated (ama-PCB)
question5: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.11. Yisiphi isidalwa esiqongelele ukuhlushwa okuphezulu kakhulu kwe-PCB kuwebhu yokudla yaseSaginaw Bay?
answer5: I-Walleye
question6: Kungani izinsimbi ezisindayo njenge-mercury ziyinkinga ezinhlanzini ezinkulu ezidla ezinye izilwane?
answer6: Zikhulisa ukudla ngokusebenzisa ama-food web, okuholela ekugxileni okuphezulu kwabathengi abaphezulu
distractor6c: Zitholakala kuphela ezindaweni zemvelo zamanzi ahlanzekile
question7: Ngokwezincomo ze-EPA, yiliphi iqembu okufanele ligweme ukudla izinhlanzi ezine-mercury ephezulu njenge-swordfish kanye ne-shark?
answer7: Abesifazane abakhulelwe nezingane ezincane
distractor7b: Abantu abadala abangaphezu kweminyaka engama-65 kuphela
question8: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo ukudla kwasolwandle okubhekwa njengokuphansi kwe-mercury?
answer8: Uhlobo lwenhlanzi
question9: Kungani i-biomagnification ibhekwa njengendaba ebalulekile yemvelo?
answer9: Kungathinta izilwane zasendle futhi kuthinte ukuphepha kokudla kwabantu
distractor9b: Kuvimbela ubuthi ukuthi bungangeni ezindlini zokudla
distractor9c: Kuthuthukisa ukudluliselwa kwamandla phakathi kwamazinga e-trophic
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.12 kanye noMfanekiso 37.10.1. Ithebula libonisa izilinganiso zokuguqulwa kokudla (i-FCR) zezilwane zasemapulazini ezahlukene. I-FCR ibalwa ngokuhlukanisa inani lokudla okunikezwa isilwane ngesisindo esidliwayo sesilwane. Izinkukhu ze-broiler ziyinkukhu ezifuywe ngenyama yazo. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi
answer10: Izimvu zisebenza kahle kakhulu ekukhiqizeni inyama kunezinkomo
distractor10a: Izinkukhu zamahansi nezinkukhu ze-broiler zisebenza kahle ngendlela efanayo
distractor10c: Inyama yenkomo iyisilwane esisebenza kahle kakhulu ukufuya ukuze kube yinyama

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.3 Imijikelezo ye-Biogeochemical | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.3 Imijikelezo ye-Biogeochemical | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Njengoba sifundile ku-Energy Flow through Ecosystems, amandla athatha indlela eyodwa (ageleza ngendlela ethile) ngokusebenzisa amazinga e-trophic ku-ecosystem. Kodwa-ke, into equkethe izinto eziphilayo igcinwa futhi isetshenziswe kabusha ngalokho okubizwa ngokuthi imijikelezo ye-biogeochemical. Izinto eziyisithupha ezivame kakhulu ezihlobene nama-molecule e-organic—i-carbon, i-nitrogen, i-hydrogen, i-oxygen, i-phosphorus, ne-sulfur—zithatha izinhlobo ezahlukene zamakhemikhali futhi zingase zibe khona isikhathi eside emkhathini woMhlaba, emhlabeni, emanzini, noma ngaphansi kobuso beplanethi yethu. Izinqubo ze-geological, okuhlanganisa ukuguguleka kwesimo sezulu nokuguguleka komhlabathi, zidlala indima kulokhu kuphinde kusetshenziswe izinto ezivela emvelweni ziye ezintweni eziphilayo. Ngenhloso ye-AP®, awudingi ukwazi imininingwane yawo wonke umjikelezo we-biogeochemical, yize eminye imininingwane yaleyo mijikelezo ihlanganisiwe kulesi sigaba.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 kanye ne-Big Idea 4 yohlaka lwe-AP® Biology Curriculum. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zebhayoloji zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala kanye nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.3 Izinto eziphilayo kumele zishintshane ngezinto nemvelo ukuze zikhule, zizale futhi zilondoloze ukuhleleka.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.1 Umfundi angakha izethulo kanye namamodeli ezehlakalo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu kanye nezinhlelo kulesi sizinda.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.9 Umfundi uyakwazi ukumela ngokwegrafu noma ukulingisa ngokwezibalo ukushintshana kwama-molecule phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo nendawo ezikuyo, kanye nokusetshenziswa okulandelayo kwala ma-molecule ukwakha ama-molecule amasha alula i-homeostasis enamandla, ukukhula nokuzala.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezakhiweni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezikuyo kuphumela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.15 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo ezibonakalayo ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngendlela efanele ukuze abonise ukuthi ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezizungezile kuphumela kanjani ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Amanzi aqukethe i-hydrogen kanye ne-oxygen, okubalulekile kuzo zonke izinqubo eziphilayo. I-hydrosphere yindawo yoMhlaba lapho ukunyakaza nokugcinwa kwamanzi kwenzeka khona: njengamanzi acwebezelayo ebusweni nangaphansi kobuso noma eqandisiwe (imifula, amachibi, izilwandle, amanzi angaphansi komhlaba, ama-polar ice caps, kanye nama-glaciers), kanye nomhwamuko wamanzi emkhathini. I-carbon itholakala kuzo zonke i-macromolecule eziphilayo futhi iyisici esibalulekile samafutha emvelo. I-nitrogen iyisici esiyinhloko sama-nucleic acid namaprotheni ethu futhi ibalulekile kwezolimo zabantu. I-phosphorus, ingxenye enkulu ye-nucleic acid (kanye ne-nitrogen), ingenye yezithako eziyinhloko kumanyolo wokwenziwa asetshenziswa kwezolimo kanye nemiphumela yawo ehambisanayo emvelweni emanzini ethu angaphezulu. I-sulfur, ebalulekile ekugoqweni kwamaprotheni angu-3-D (njengasekubopheni kwe-disulfide), ikhishwa emkhathini ngokushiswa kwamafutha emvelo, njengamalahle.

 Ukujikeleza kwalezi zinto kuxhumene. Isibonelo, ukuhamba kwamanzi kubalulekile ekudonseleni i-nitrogen ne-phosphate emifuleni, emachibini nasezilwandle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ulwandle ngokwalo luyindawo enkulu yokugcina ikhabhoni. Ngakho-ke, izakhamzimba zamaminerali zijikeleziswa, kungaba ngokushesha noma kancane, kuyo yonke indawo, kusukela kwesinye isidalwa esiphilayo kuya kwesinye, naphakathi kwezwe le-biotic ne-abiotic.
question1: Ukunyakaza kwezinto kuhluke kanjani ekuhambeni kwamandla ezindaweni zemvelo?
answer1: Izinto ziphinde zisetshenziswe ngemijikelezo ye-biogeochemical, kuyilapho amandla egeleza ohlangothini olulodwa ngokusebenzisa i-ecosystems
distractor1a: Kokubili izinto kanye namandla kusetshenziswa kabusha unomphela
distractor1b: Izinto zigeleza ohlangothini olulodwa ngenkathi amandla esetshenziswa kabusha
question2: Yiziphi izakhi eziyisithupha ezivame ukuhlotshaniswa nama-molecule e-organic emijikelezweni ye-biogeochemical?
answer2: I-carbon, i-nitrogen, i-hydrogen, i-oxygen, i-phosphorus, ne-sulfure
distractor2a: I-Carbon, i-calcium, i-sodium, i-potassium, i-chlorine, kanye ne-iron
distractor2b: I-hydrogen, i-helium, i-lithium, i-beryllium, i-boron, ne-carbon
distractor2c: I-nitrogen, i-magnesium, i-silicon, i-chlorine, ithusi, ne-zinc
question3: Izinqubo ze-geological zinegalelo kanjani emijikelezweni ye-biogeochemical?
answer3: Basebenzisa kabusha izinto ngokusebenzisa izinqubo ezifana nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu kanye nokuguguleka komhlabathi
distractor3b: Zivimbela izakhi ukuthi zingangeni ezintweni eziphilayo
distractor3c: Baguqula zonke izinto eziphilayo zibe amafutha asetshenziswa ezintweni ezingaphili
question4: Ngokusho kwe-AP® Biology Learning Objective 2.9, yini okufanele abafundi bakwazi ukuyenza?
answer4: Mela noma ubonise ukushintshana kwama-molecule phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo nendawo ezizungezile kanye nokusetshenziswa kwazo ekukhuleni, ekuzaleni, kanye nase-homeostasis
distractor4a: Hlukanisa izinto eziphilayo zibe amazinga e-trophic
distractor4b: Bikezela izinguquko ze-DNA ezibangelwa ushintsho lwemvelo
distractor4c: Chaza kuphela ukuhamba kwamandla ngokusebenzisa ama-food webs
question5: Iyini i-hydrosphere?
answer5: Ingxenye yoMhlaba lapho amanzi egcinwa futhi ehamba khona, okuhlanganisa ulwandle, amachibi, amanzi angaphansi komhlaba, iqhwa, kanye nomhwamuko wamanzi womoya
question6: Kungani i-nitrogen ibalulekile ezintweni eziphilayo?
answer6: Kuyingxenye enkulu yamaprotheni nama-nucleic acid
question7: Kungani i-phosphorus ibalulekile ku-biology?
answer7: Kuyingxenye eyinhloko yama-nucleic acid futhi kusetshenziswa kakhulu kumanyolo wezolimo
question8: Ukushiswa kwamafutha emvelo kuyithinta kanjani umjikelezo wesibabule?
answer8: Ikhipha isibabule emoyeni
distractor8c: Kuvimbela isibabule ukuthi singangeni ezintweni eziphilayo
question9: Kungani amanzi ebalulekile ekuxhumaniseni imijikelezo ehlukene ye-biogeochemical?
answer9: Ithutha izinto ezifana ne-nitrogen ne-phosphate ziye emifuleni, emachibini nasezilwandle
distractor9a: Kuvimbela izakhamzimba ukuthi zingahambi ezindaweni zemvelo
distractor9c: Iguqula izakhamzimba ezingaphili zibe ukukhanya kwelanga

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.3 Imijikelezo ye-Biogeochemical | Umjikelezo Wamanzi (we-Hydrologic)
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.3 Imijikelezo ye-Biogeochemical | Umjikelezo Wamanzi (we-Hydrologic)
chapterContent:
Amanzi ayisisekelo sazo zonke izinqubo zokuphila. Umzimba womuntu ungaphezu kwengxenye yamanzi kanti amangqamuzana omuntu angaphezu kwamaphesenti angama-70 amanzi. Ngakho-ke, izilwane eziningi zasezweni zidinga ukutholakala kwamanzi ahlanzekile ukuze ziphile. Kodwa-ke, lapho kuhlolwa izitolo zamanzi eMhlabeni, amaphesenti angama-97.5 awo angamanzi anosawoti angaphili (Isithombe 37.13). Kumanzi asele, amaphesenti angama-99 avaliwe ngaphansi komhlaba njengamanzi noma njengeqhwa. Ngakho-ke, angaphansi kwephesenti elilodwa lamanzi ahlanzekile atholakala kalula emachibini nasemifuleni. Izinto eziningi eziphilayo, njengezitshalo, izilwane, kanye nesikhunta, zincike enanini elincane lamanzi ahlanzekile angaphezulu, ukuntuleka kwawo kungaba nemiphumela emikhulu emizileni yezemvelo. Abantu, vele, bathuthukise ubuchwepheshe bokwandisa ukutholakala kwamanzi, njengokumba imithombo yokuvuna amanzi angaphansi komhlaba, ukugcina amanzi emvula, nokusebenzisa ukukhipha usawoti emanzini ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile olwandle. Nakuba lokhu kuphishekela amanzi ahlanzekile bekulokhu kuqhubeka kuwo wonke umlando wesintu, ukutholakala kwamanzi ahlanzekile kuseyinkinga enkulu ezikhathini zanamuhla.

 Ukujikeleza kwamanzi kubaluleke kakhulu emizileni yezemvelo. Amanzi anethonya elikhulu esimweni sezulu, ngakho-ke, ezindaweni ezizungezile imvelo, ezinye ezitholakala ezingxenyeni ezikude zoMhlaba. Iningi lamanzi eMhlabeni ligcinwa isikhathi eside olwandle, ngaphansi komhlaba, nanjengeqhwa. Isithombe 37.14 sibonisa isikhathi esimaphakathi i-molecule yamanzi ngayinye engasichitha ezindaweni zokugcina amanzi ezinkulu zoMhlaba. Isikhathi sokuhlala siyisilinganiso sesikhathi esimaphakathi i-molecule yamanzi ngayinye ehlala endaweni yokugcina amanzi ethile. Inani elikhulu lamanzi oMhlaba livalelwe endaweni kulezi zindawo zokugcina amanzi njengeqhwa, ngaphansi komhlaba, nasolwandle, futhi, ngakho-ke, alitholakali ukuze lijikeleze isikhathi esifushane (amanzi angaphezulu kuphela angahwamuka).

 Kunezinqubo ezahlukahlukene ezenzeka ngesikhathi sokujikeleza kwamanzi, eziboniswe kuSithombe 37.15. Lezi zinqubo zifaka okulandelayo:

 ukuhwamuka/ukususwa kwamanzi
ukuminyana/imvula
ukugeleza kwamanzi angaphansi komhlaba
ukugeleza kwamanzi okugeleza kwamanzi/ukuncibilika kweqhwa
ukugeleza kwamanzi
Umjikelezo wamanzi uqhutshwa amandla elanga njengoba ufudumeza ulwandle namanye amanzi angaphezulu. Lokhu kuholela ekuhwamukeni (amanzi abe umhwamuko wamanzi) kwamanzi angaphezulu kanye nokuncishiswa (iqhwa libe umhwamuko wamanzi) kwamanzi aqandisiwe, okufaka inani elikhulu lomhwamuko wamanzi emkhathini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lo mhwamuko wamanzi uhlangana ube amafu njengoketshezi noma amaconsi aqandisiwe futhi ekugcineni kulandelwa imvula (imvula noma iqhwa), ebuyisela amanzi ebusweni boMhlaba. Imvula ekugcineni ingena emhlabathini, lapho ingaphinde ihwamuke khona uma iseduze nobuso, igeleza ngaphansi kobuso, noma igcinwe isikhathi eside. Kulula kakhulu ukuqaphela ukugeleza kwamanzi angaphezulu: ukugeleza kwamanzi amasha kungaba yimvula noma iqhwa elincibilikayo. Ukugeleza kwamanzi kungaba sekudlula emifuleni nasemachibini kuya olwandle noma kugeleze ngqo olwandle ngokwalo.

 Imvula kanye nokugeleza kwamanzi angaphezulu kuyizindlela ezinkulu lapho amaminerali, okuhlanganisa i-carbon, i-nitrogen, i-phosphorus, ne-sulfur, ejikeleziswa khona ukusuka ezweni kuya emanzini. Imiphumela yemvelo yokugeleza kwamanzi izoxoxwa kamuva njengoba le mijikelezo ichazwa.
question1: Cishe yiphesenti elingakanani lamanzi omhlaba angamanzi anosawoti angaphili?
answer1: Amaphesenti angu-97.5
question2: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.13. Kungani amanzi ahlanzekile atholakala kalula elinganiselwe kangaka eMhlabeni?
answer2: Iningi lamanzi ahlanzekile livalelwe ngaphansi komhlaba noma liqandisiwe njengeqhwa, okushiya ngaphansi kwephesenti elilodwa kufinyeleleka kalula emachibini nasemifuleni.
distractor2b: Cishe wonke amanzi ahlanzekile ayahwamuka minyaka yonke
question3: Kungani umjikelezo wamanzi ubalulekile ekushintsheni kwemvelo?
answer3: Kuthinta isimo sezulu kanye nokutholakala kwamanzi adingwa yizinto eziphilayo
distractor3a: Kuvimbela izakhamzimba ukuthi zingahambi ezindaweni zemvelo
distractor3b: Iguqula amanzi anosawoti ngqo abe yi-glucose
question4: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.14. Siyini isikhathi sokuhlala?
answer4: Isikhathi esimaphakathi i-molecule yamanzi ihlala echibini elithile
distractor4c: Isikhathi esidingekayo ukuze amanzi angaphansi komhlaba abe amanzi anosawoti
question5: Yimuphi umthombo wamandla oyinhloko oqhuba umjikelezo wamanzi?
answer5: Ilanga
question6: Uyini umehluko phakathi kokuhwamuka kanye nokuncibilika kwe-sublimation?
answer6: Ukuhwamuka kwamanzi ukuguqulwa kwamanzi abe umhwamuko wamanzi, kanti ukuncibilikiswa kwamanzi ukuguqulwa kweqhwa kube umhwamuko wamanzi ngqo.
distractor6a: Ukuhwamuka kwakha iqhwa, kanti ukuncibilika kwakha amanzi acwebezelayo
distractor6b: Ukuhwamuka kwenzeka ngaphansi komhlaba, kanti ukuncishiswa komswakama kwenzeka kuphela olwandle.
distractor6c: Zombili lezi zinqubo ziguqula umhwamuko wamanzi ube amanzi acwebezelayo
question7: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokujiya komjikelezo wamanzi?
answer7: Umhwamuko wamanzi uyaphola bese udala amaconsi amanzi noma aqandisiwe adala amafu
distractor7b: Amanzi acwebezelayo ashintsha ngqo abe yiqhwa
question8: Kuyini ukugeleza kwamanzi ebusweni?
answer8: Ukugeleza kwamanzi ahlanzekile avela emvuleni noma eqhweni elincibilikayo phezu komhlaba kuya emifuleni, emachibini, noma olwandle
distractor8a: Ukuhamba kwamanzi angaphansi komhlaba ngaphansi kobuso boMhlaba
question9: Kungani ukugeleza kwamanzi ebusweni kubalulekile emijikelezweni ye-biogeochemical?
answer9: Ithutha amaminerali afana nekhabhoni, i-nitrogen, i-phosphorus, nesibabule kusuka ezweni kuya ezindaweni zemvelo zasemanzini
distractor9b: Kuvimbela ukuguguleka kwesimo sezulu kanye nokuguguleka komhlabathi

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. Izinhlelo Ze-Ecosystem | 37.3 Imijikelezo Ye-Biogeochemical | Umjikelezo Wekhabhoni
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. Izinhlelo Ze-Ecosystem | 37.3 Imijikelezo Ye-Biogeochemical | Umjikelezo Wekhabhoni
chapterContent:
Ikhabhoni iyinto yesibili eningi kakhulu ezintweni eziphilayo. Ikhabhoni ikhona kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo, futhi indima yayo ekwakhiweni kwama-macromolecule ibaluleke kakhulu ezintweni eziphilayo. Ikhabhoni amakhilogremu iqukethe amandla aphezulu kakhulu, ikakhulukazi lawo avela ezintweni eziphilayo ezifakwe emafossil, ikakhulukazi izitshalo, abantu abazisebenzisa njengophethiloli. Kusukela ngawo-1800, inani lamazwe asebenzisa inani elikhulu lamafutha asetshenziswa emafossil liye landa. Kusukela ekuqaleni kweNguquko Yezimboni, isidingo somhlaba wonke sokutholakala kukaphethiloli okulinganiselwe koMhlaba sikhuphuke; ngakho-ke, inani lekhabhoni dioxide emkhathini wethu liye landa. Lokhu kwanda kwekhabhoni dioxide kuye kwahlotshaniswa nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu kanye nokunye ukuphazamiseka kwezindawo zemvelo zoMhlaba futhi kuyinkinga enkulu emvelweni emhlabeni jikelele. Ngakho-ke, "umthelela wekhabhoni"usekelwe ekutheni kukhiqizwa i-carbon dioxide engakanani nokuthi amazwe asebenzisa uphethiloli ongakanani.

 Umjikelezo wekhabhoni ufundwa kalula njengemijikelezo emibili exhumene: omunye ubhekene nokushintshana kwekhabhoni okusheshayo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kanti omunye ubhekene nokujikeleza kwekhabhoni isikhathi eside ngezinqubo ze-geologic. Umjikelezo wekhabhoni wonke uboniswe kuMfanekiso 37.16
question1: Kungani ikhabhoni ibalulekile ezintweni eziphilayo?
answer1: Kuyingxenye yawo wonke ama-molecule e-organic futhi kuyisisekelo sesakhiwo sama-macromolecule e-biological
question2: Kungani i-carbon com amakhilogremu iqukethe amandla amaningi?
answer2: Izibopho zabo zamakhemikhali zigcina amandla amaningi angasetshenziswa izinto eziphilayo
distractor2a: Zimunca amandla ngqo kusuka enkabeni yoMhlaba
question3: Kungani i-carbon dioxide esemkhathini ikhuphukile kusukela ngeNguquko Yezimboni?
answer3: Ukusetshenziswa okwandisiwe kwamafutha emvelo kukhiphe inani elikhulu le-carbon dioxide emkhathini
distractor3c: Ukuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo kuwukuphela komthombo we-carbon dioxide esemkhathini
question4: Iyiphi inkinga enkulu yemvelo ehlotshaniswa nokwenyuka kwamazinga e-carbon dioxide emoyeni?
answer4: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu
question5: Lisho ukuthini igama elithi carbon footprint?
answer5: Inani le-carbon dioxide elikhiqizwa ngokusetshenziswa kukaphethiloli wezinto zakudala kanye neminye imisebenzi
question6: Umjikelezo wekhabhoni uvame ukuhlukaniswa kanjani ukuze kufundwe?
answer6: Kusuka emjikelezweni wekhabhoni webhayoloji osheshayo kanye nomjikelezo wekhabhoni wesikhathi eside wejiyoloji
distractor6a: Kutholakala kuphela ezindaweni zokudla zasemhlabeni nezasemanzini
distractor6c: Kuphela kumjikelezo wesimo sezulu somoya kanye nolwandle
question7: Yini echaza umjikelezo wekhabhoni osheshayo?
answer7: Ukushintshana kwekhabhoni phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo
question8: Yini echaza umjikelezo wekhabhoni wesikhathi eside?
answer8: Ukuhamba kwekhabhoni ngezinqubo ze-geologic isikhathi eside
distractor8a: Ukushintshana kwansuku zonke kwekhabhoni phakathi kwezitshalo nezilwane
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.16. Yimuphi umsebenzi womuntu oye waba nomthelela omkhulu ekwandeni kwe-carbon dioxide esemkhathini emakhulwini eminyaka amuva nje?
answer9: Ukushisa amafutha asetshenziswa kudala

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. Izinhlelo Ze-Eco | 37.3 Imijikelezo Ye-Biogeochemical | Umjikelezo We-Carbon | Umjikelezo We-Carbon We-Biological
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. Izinhlelo Ze-Eco | 37.3 Imijikelezo Ye-Biogeochemical | Umjikelezo We-Carbon | Umjikelezo We-Carbon We-Biological
chapterContent:
Izinto eziphilayo zixhumene ngezindlela eziningi, ngisho naphakathi kwezindawo zemvelo. Isibonelo esihle salokhu kuxhumana ukushintshana kwekhabhoni phakathi kwama-autotroph nama-heterotroph ngaphakathi naphakathi kwezindawo zemvelo ngendlela ye-carbon dioxide esemkhathini. I-carbon dioxide iyisakhiwo esiyisisekelo esisetshenziswa ama-autotroph amaningi ukwakha i-multi-carbon, amandla aphezulu com amakhilogremu, njenge-glucose. Amandla asetshenziswa elangeni asetshenziswa yilezi zinto eziphilayo ukwakha izibopho ze-covalent ezixhumanisa ama-athomu ekhabhoni ndawonye. Lezi zibopho zamakhemikhali ngaleyo ndlela zigcina la mandla ukuze asetshenziswe kamuva enkambisweni yokuphefumula. Iningi lama-autotroph asemhlabeni lithola i-carbon dioxide yalo ngqo emkhathini, kuyilapho ama-autotroph asolwandle eyithola ngesimo esincibilikisiwe kusukela ku-ionization engaphelele ye-carbonic acid ibe yi-bicarbonate ions (H2CO3−). Kodwa-ke i-carbon dioxide itholakala, umkhiqizo ophumayo wale nqubo yi-oxygen. Izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthetic zinesibopho sokudala okuqukethwe kwe-oxygen emkhathini wethu; i-oxygen yakha cishe amaphesenti angama-21 omkhathi esiwubonayo namuhla.

 Ama-heterotroph nama-autotroph angabalingani ekushintshaneni kwekhabhoni yezinto eziphilayo (ikakhulukazi abathengi abayinhloko, ikakhulukazi izilwane ezidla uhlaza). Ama-heterotroph athola ikhabhoni enamandla aphezulu amakhilogremu kuma-autotroph ngokuwadla, futhi awahlukanise ngokuphefumula ukuze athole amandla eseli, njenge-ATP. Uhlobo lokuphefumula olusebenza kahle kakhulu, ukuphefumula kwe-aerobic, ludinga umoya-mpilo otholakala emoyeni noma oncibilikiswe emanzini. Ngakho-ke, kukhona ukushintshana okuqhubekayo komoya-mpilo kanye nekhabhoni dioxide phakathi kwama-autotroph (adinga ikhabhoni) nama-heterotroph (adinga umoya-mpilo). Ukushintshana kwegesi emoyeni nasemanzini kuyindlela eyodwa umjikelezo wekhabhoni oxhumanisa ngayo zonke izinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni.
question1: Uyini umthombo oyinhloko wekhabhoni yama-autotroph amaningi?
answer1: I-carbon dioxide
question2: Ama-autotroph asemhlabeni avame ukuthola kanjani i-carbon dioxide?
answer2: Ngokuqondile kusuka emkhathini
distractor2a: Kusukela kuma-ion e-bicarbonate ancibilikisiwe emanzini angaphansi komhlaba
question3: Iningi lama-autotrophs asolwandle liyithola kanjani ikhabhoni ukuze lenze i-photosynthesis?
answer3: Kusuka kuma-ion e-bicarbonate ancibilikisiwe akhiwe nge-carbonic acid
question4: Uyini umkhiqizo ophumayo we-photosynthesis?
answer4: I-oxygen
question5: Cishe ingakanani iphesenti lomoya-mpilo womhlaba?
answer5: Cishe amaphesenti angu-21
question6: Ama-heterotroph athola kanjani i-carbon enamandla aphezulu amakhilogremu?
answer6: Ngokudla ama-autotroph noma ezinye izinto eziphilayo
question7: Kungani ama-autotroph nama-heterotroph ebhekwa njengabalingani emjikelezweni wekhabhoni webhayoloji?
answer7: Ama-Autotroph ahlinzeka nge-carbon kanye nomoya-mpilo ophilayo, kuyilapho ama-heterotroph ebuyisela i-carbon dioxide ngokuphefumula
distractor7a: Womabili amaqembu athola wonke amandla awo kumafutha asetshenziswa ezintweni ezisetshenziswa kudala
distractor7b: Womabili amaqembu enza i-photosynthesis ngamazinga alinganayo
distractor7c: Amaqembu amabili awashintshisani ngamagesi nendawo ezungezile
question8: Yiluphi uhlobo lokuphefumula oludinga umoya-mpilo?
answer8: Ukuphefumula kwe-Aerobic
question9: Ukushintshaniswa kwegesi kuxhumanisa kanjani izimiso zemvelo emjikelezweni wekhabhoni webhayoloji?
answer9: I-carbon dioxide kanye nomoya-mpilo kushintshaniswa njalo emoyeni nasemanzini phakathi kwama-autotroph nama-heterotroph
distractor9a: Ikhabhoni ihamba kuphela ezintweni eziphilayo zasemhlabathini
distractor9b: Izindawo zemvelo zomhlaba kuphela ezihlanganyela ekushintshaneni kwekhabhoni
distractor9c: Ukushintshana kwegesi kwenzeka kuphela phakathi kwezitshalo zohlobo olufanayo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. Izinhlelo Ze-Eco | 37.3 Imijikelezo Ye-Biogeochemical | Umjikelezo We-Carbon | Umjikelezo We-Carbon We-Biogeochemical
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. Izinhlelo Ze-Eco | 37.3 Imijikelezo Ye-Biogeochemical | Umjikelezo We-Carbon | Umjikelezo We-Carbon We-Biogeochemical
chapterContent:
Ukuhamba kwekhabhoni ezweni, emanzini, nasemoyeni kuyinkimbinkimbi, futhi ezimweni eziningi, kwenzeka kancane kakhulu ngokwejiyoloji kunalokho okubonwa phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo. Ikhabhoni igcinwa isikhathi eside kulokho okwaziwa ngokuthi izindawo zokugcina ikhabhoni, okuhlanganisa umkhathi, imizimba yamanzi aketshezi (ikakhulukazi izilwandle), inhlabathi, inhlabathi, inhlabathi (kufaka phakathi amafutha angaphansi komhlaba), kanye nengaphakathi loMhlaba.

 Njengoba kushiwo, umkhathi uyisizinda esikhulu sekhabhoni ngesimo sekhabhoni diokside futhi ubalulekile enkambisweni ye-photosynthesis. Izinga lekhabhoni diokside emkhathini lithonywa kakhulu yisizinda sekhabhoni olwandle. Ukushintshana kwekhabhoni phakathi komkhathi nezindawo zokugcina amanzi kuthonya ukuthi ingakanani ikhabhoni etholakala endaweni ngayinye, futhi ngayinye ithinta enye ngokulandelana. Ikhabhoni diokside (CO2) evela emkhathini iyancibilika emanzini futhi ihlangane nama-molecule amanzi ukuze yakhe i-carbonic acid, bese i-ionize ibe yi-carbonate nama-ion e-bicarbonate (Isithombe 37.17)

 Ama-coefficients okulingana anjalo kangangokuthi amaphesenti angaphezu kwama-90 ekhabhoni olwandle atholakala njengama-ion e-bicarbonate. Amanye alawa ma-ion ahlangana ne-calcium yasemanzini olwandle ukuze akhe i-calcium carbonate (i-CaCO3), ingxenye enkulu yamagobolondo ezinto eziphilayo zasolwandle. Lezi zinto eziphilayo ekugcineni zakha inhlabathi phansi kolwandle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi se-geological, i-calcium carbonate yakha i-limestone, ehlanganisa indawo yokugcina ikhabhoni enkulu kunazo zonke eMhlabeni.

 Emhlabeni, ikhabhoni igcinwa enhlabathini ngenxa yokubola kwezinto eziphilayo (ngaboli) noma ngenxa yokuguquka kwedwala lomhlaba kanye namaminerali. Le khabhoni ingadonswa emanzini ngokugeleza kwamanzi. Ngaphansi komhlaba, emhlabeni kanye nasolwandle, kukhona amafutha asetshenziswayo: izinsalela zezitshalo ezibolile ngendlela engadingi umoya-mpilo ezithatha izigidi zeminyaka ukwakheka. Amafutha asetshenziswayo abhekwa njengomthombo ongavuseleleki ngoba ukusetshenziswa kwawo kudlula kakhulu izinga lokwakheka kwawo. Umthombo ongavuseleleki, njengophethiloli, uvuselelwa kancane kakhulu noma awuvuselelwa nhlobo. Enye indlela ikhabhoni engena ngayo emkhathini isuka ezweni (kufaka phakathi umhlaba ongaphansi kolwandle) ngokuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo nezinye izinhlelo ze-geothermal. Imfucumfucu yekhabhoni evela phansi kolwandle ithathwa ijule ngaphakathi koMhlaba ngenqubo yokunciphisa: ukunyakaza kwepuleti elilodwa le-tectonic ngaphansi kwelinye. Ikhabhoni ikhishwa njengekhabhoni dioksijini lapho kuqhuma intaba-mlilo noma emithonjeni yamanzi entaba-mlilo.

 Ikhabhoni dioksijini nayo yengezwa emkhathini ngemikhuba yokufuya izilwane yabantu. Inani elikhulu lezilwane zomhlaba ezikhuliswa ukuze zondle inani labantu abakhulayo loMhlaba liphumela emazingeni aphezulu ekhabhoni dioksijini emkhathini ngenxa yemikhuba yokulima kanye nokukhiqizwa kokuphefumula kanye ne-methane. Lesi esinye isibonelo sendlela umsebenzi womuntu othinta ngayo ngokungaqondile imijikelezo ye-biogeochemical ngendlela ebalulekile. Nakuba ingxoxo enkulu mayelana nemiphumela yesikhathi esizayo yokwanda kwekhabhoni emkhathini ekushintsheni kwesimo sezulu igxile kumafutha asetshenziswa yizinsalela, ososayensi bathatha izinqubo zemvelo, njengezintaba-mlilo kanye nokuphefumula, njengoba bebonisa futhi bebikezela umthelela wesikhathi esizayo walokhu kwanda.
question1: Ziyini izindawo zokugcina ikhabhoni?
answer1: Izindawo lapho ikhabhoni igcinwa khona isikhathi eside, njengomoya, ulwandle, inhlabathi, inhlabathi, amafutha angaphansi komhlaba, kanye nengaphakathi loMhlaba.
distractor1b: Izindawo lapho ikhabhoni isuswa khona unomphela eMhlabeni
question2: Kungani umkhathi uyindawo ebalulekile yokugcina ikhabhoni?
answer2: Igcina i-carbon dioxide ebalulekile kwi-photosynthesis
distractor2b: Kuvimbela ikhabhoni ukuthi ingangeni ezindaweni zemvelo
distractor2c: Igcina ikhabhoni kuphela ngesikhathi sokuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo
question3: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.17. Kwenzekani uma ikhabhoni dayoksayidi incibilika emanzini?
answer3: Yakha i-carbonic acid, engashintsha ibe yi-ion ye-bicarbonate ne-carbonate
question4: Ingakanani i-carbon eningi egcinwa olwandle?
answer4: Njenge-ion ye-bicarbonate
question5: Kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi i-limestone ibe yindawo yokugcina ikhabhoni enkulu kunazo zonke eMhlabeni?
answer5: Izinto eziphilayo zasolwandle zakha amagobolondo e-calcium carbonate aqoqana njengenhlabathi yolwandle futhi ekugcineni abe yi-limestone
distractor5a: I-limestone yakhiwa ngqo kusuka ku-carbon dioxide esemoyeni
question6: Kungani amafutha asetshenziswa kudala ebhekwa njengemithombo engeke ivuseleleke?
answer6: Zakheka eminyakeni eyizigidi kodwa zidliwa ngokushesha kakhulu kunalokho ezikhiqizwayo.
question7: Ikhabhoni egcinwe ekujuleni koMhlaba ingabuyela kanjani emkhathini?
answer7: Ngokuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo kanye nomsebenzi we-geothermal okhipha i-carbon dioxide
question8: Kuyini ukwehlisa?
answer8: Ukuhamba kwepuleti elilodwa le-tectonic ngaphansi kwelinye, lithwala inhlabathi ecebile ngekhabhoni liyise ngaphakathi koMhlaba
distractor8b: Ukwakheka kwamagobolondo e-carbonate yizinto eziphilayo zasolwandle
question9: Ukufuya izilwane kunegalelo kanjani emazingeni e-carbon asemoyeni?
answer9: Inani elikhulu lemfuyo likhipha i-carbon dioxide ngokuphefumula kanye ne-methane ngokugaya ukudla
distractor9a: Imfuyo isusa i-carbon dioxide emoyeni nge-photosynthesis
distractor9b: Ukufuya izilwane kugcina ikhabhoni ngaphansi komhlaba unomphela
question10: Kungani ososayensi befaka izinqubo zemvelo lapho bebonisa ushintsho lwesimo sezulu esikhathini esizayo?
answer10: Ngenxa yokuthi imithombo yemvelo efana nezintaba-mlilo nokuphefumula, kanye nemisebenzi yabantu, konke kuthinta amazinga e-carbon dioxide emoyeni
distractor10a: Ngoba imisebenzi yabantu ayinawo umthelela emjikelezweni wekhabhoni
distractor10b: Ngoba izintaba-mlilo kuphela ezithinta umoya-mpilo ongcolile
distractor10c: Ngoba amafutha asetshenziswa kudala yiwona kuphela umthombo wekhabhoni yomoya

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.3 Imijikelezo ye-Biogeochemical | Umjikelezo we-Nitrogen
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.3 Imijikelezo ye-Biogeochemical | Umjikelezo we-Nitrogen
chapterContent:
Ukufaka i-nitrogen ezweni eliphilayo kunzima. Izitshalo kanye ne-phytoplankton azihlomele ukufaka i-nitrogen evela emkhathini (ekhona njenge-N2 ehlanganisiwe ngokuqinile) yize le molekyuli yakha cishe amaphesenti angama-78 omkhathi. I-nitrogen ingena ezweni eliphilayo ngamabhaktheriya aphilayo mahhala kanye ne-symbiotic, afaka i-nitrogen kuma-macromolecule awo ngokufaka i-nitrogen (ukuguqulwa kwe-N2). Ama-Cyanobacteria ahlala ezindaweni eziningi zemvelo zasemanzini lapho kukhona khona ukukhanya kwelanga; adlala indima ebalulekile ekufakeni i-nitrogen. Ama-Cyanobacteria ayakwazi ukusebenzisa imithombo ye-nitrogen engakhiqizi izinto eziphilayo ukuze alungise i-nitrogen. Ama-bacteria e-Rhizobium ahlala ngokubambisana ezimpandeni zemifino (njenge-peas, ubhontshisi, namakinati) futhi awanikeze i-nitrogen ephilayo ayidingayo. Ama-bacteria aphila ngokukhululeka, njenge-Azotobacter, nawo angama-nitrogen fixers abalulekile.

 I-nitrogen engokwemvelo ibaluleke kakhulu ekufundweni kwe-ecosystem dynamics njengoba izinqubo eziningi ze-ecosystem, njengokukhiqiza okuyinhloko kanye nokubola, zinqunyelwe ukutholakala kwe-nitrogen. Njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 37.18, i-nitrogen engena ezinhlelweni eziphilayo ngokulungiswa kwe-nitrogen iguqulwa ngokulandelana kusuka ku-nitrogen ephilayo ibe yigesi ye-nitrogen ngama-bacteria. Le nqubo yenzeka ngezinyathelo ezintathu ezinhlelweni zomhlaba: i-ammonification, i-nitrification, kanye ne-denitrification. Okokuqala, inqubo ye-ammonification iguqula imfucuza ye-nitrogen evela ezilwaneni eziphilayo noma ezinsaleleni zezilwane ezifile ibe yi-ammonium (NH4+) ngama-bacteria athile kanye ne-fungi. Okwesibili, i-ammonium iguqulwa ibe yi-nitrites (NO2−) ngokufaka ama-bacteria, njenge-nitrifying, Ama-nitrosomona, ngokusebenzisa i-nitrification. Ngemva kwalokho, ama-nitrite aguqulwa abe ama-nitrate (NO3−) yizinto eziphilayo ezifanayo. Okwesithathu, inqubo yokukhipha i-nitrification iyenzeka, lapho amabhaktheriya, njenge-Pseudomonas ne-Clostridium, eguqula ama-nitrate abe yigesi ye-nitrogen, evumela ukuthi iphinde ingene emoyeni.

 Imisebenzi yabantu ingakhipha i-nitrogen emvelweni ngezindlela ezimbili eziyinhloko: ukushiswa kwamafutha emvelo, okukhipha ama-nitrogen oxide ahlukene, kanye nokusetshenziswa komanyolo wokwenziwa kwezolimo, abese egezwa emachibini, emifuleni, nasemifuleni ngokugeleza kwamanzi angaphezulu. I-nitrogen yasemkhathini ihlotshaniswa nemiphumela eminingana ezindaweni zemvelo zoMhlaba okuhlanganisa ukukhiqizwa kwemvula ye-acid (njenge-nitric acid, i-HNO3) kanye negesi yokushisa (njenge-nitrous oxide, i-N2O) okungenzeka kubangele ushintsho lwesimo sezulu. Umphumela omkhulu ovela ekugelezeni komanyolo amanzi anosawoti kanye ne-eutrophication yamanzi ahlanzekile, inqubo lapho ukugeleza kwezakhamzimba kubangela ukukhula ngokweqile kwama-microorganisms, kunciphisa amazinga e-oxygen ancibilikisiwe futhi kubulale izilwane zemvelo.

 Inqubo efanayo yenzeka emjikelezweni we-nitrogen wasolwandle, lapho izinqubo ze-ammonification, i-nitrification, kanye ne-denitrification zenziwa yibhaktheriya yasolwandle. Enye yale nitrogen iwela phansi kolwandle njengenhlabathi, engasuswa iye ezweni ngesikhathi se-geological ngokuphakanyiswa kobuso boMhlaba ngaleyo ndlela ifakwe edwaleni lomhlaba. Nakuba ukuhamba kwe-nitrogen edwaleni ngqo ezimisweni eziphilayo kuye kwabonakala kungabalulekile uma kuqhathaniswa ne-nitrogen egcinwe emkhathini, ucwaningo lwamuva lubonise ukuthi le nqubo ingaba yinto ebalulekile futhi kufanele ifakwe kunoma yiluphi ucwaningo lomjikelezo we-nitrogen womhlaba wonke.
question1: Kungani izitshalo eziningi zingakwazi ukusebenzisa i-nitrogen esemoyeni (i-N2) ngqo?
answer1: Ngoba i-nitrogen esemoyeni ibanjwe ndawonye ngesibopho esiqinile se-covalent esiphindwe kathathu izitshalo ezingenakusiphula
distractor1b: Ngoba i-nitrogen ikhona kuphela ezindaweni zasemanzini
distractor1c: Ngoba izitshalo zimunca i-nitrogen ephilayo kuphela ezilwaneni
question2: Iyiphi inqubo eguqula igesi ye-nitrogen esemoyeni ibe yindlela engasetshenziswa ngokwezinto eziphilayo?
answer2: Ukulungiswa kwe-nitrogen
question3: Yimaphi amabhaktheriya ahlala ngokubambisana emaqhubu ezimpande zemifino futhi aqinise i-nitrogen?
answer3: I-Rhizobium
question4: Kungani i-nitrogen ivame ukuba yisakhamzimba esivimbelayo ezindaweni zemvelo?
answer4: Ngoba izinqubo eziningi zemvelo, okuhlanganisa ukukhiqizwa okuyinhloko kanye nokubola, kuncike ekutholakaleni kwe-nitrogen engasetshenziswa
distractor4b: Ngoba izinto eziphilayo azikwazi ukufaka i-nitrogen kumaprotheni
question5: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokufakwa kwe-ammonization?
answer5: I-nitrogen engokwemvelo iguqulwa ibe yi-ammonium (NH4+) ngamabhaktheriya kanye nesikhunta
distractor5b: Igesi ye-nitrogen iguqulwa ibe yi-organic com amakhilogremu
question6: Iyini indima yamagciwane anika amandla njenge-Nitrosomonas?
answer6: Ziguqula i-ammonium (NH4+) ibe yi-nitrites (NO2-)
question7: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokukhishwa kwe-nitrification?
answer7: Amabhaktheriya aguqula ama-nitrate (NO3-) abe yigesi ye-nitrogen (N2)
distractor7b: Izitshalo ziguqula igesi ye-nitrogen ibe amaprotheni
distractor7c: Izilwane ziguqula ama-nitrate abe ama-amino acid
question8: Imisebenzi yabantu ingayandisa kanjani i-nitrogen engena ezindaweni zemvelo?
answer8: Ngokushisa amafutha asetshenziswa kudala nokusebenzisa umanyolo wokwenziwa
question9: Kuyini i-eutrophication?
answer9: Ukugeleza ngokweqile kwezakhamzimba okubangela ukukhula okusheshayo kwamagciwane, ukuncipha komoya-mpilo, kanye nokufa kwezinto eziphilayo zasemanzini
distractor9c: Ukuqhekeka kwamafutha emvelo abe yigesi ye-nitrogen
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.18. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo mayelana nomjikelezo we-nitrogen esingamanga?
answer10: Ukwenziwa kwe-nitrification ngamabhaktheriya kuguqula ama-nitrate (NO3-) abe ama-nitrites (NO2-)
distractor10a: I-Ammonification iguqula izinto eziphilayo ze-nitrogen ezivela ezintweni eziphilayo zibe yi-ammonium (NH4+)
distractor10b: Ukususwa kwe-nitrification ngamagciwane kuguqula ama-nitrate (NO3-) abe yigesi ye-nitrogen (N2)
distractor10c: Amabhaktheriya alungisa i-nitrogen aguqula igesi ye-nitrogen (N2) ibe yi-organic com amakhilogremu

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.3 Imijikelezo ye-Biogeochemical | Umjikelezo we-Phosphorus
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.3 Imijikelezo ye-Biogeochemical | Umjikelezo we-Phosphorus
chapterContent:
I-phosphorus iyisakhi esibalulekile sezinqubo zokuphila; iyisakhi esiyinhloko se-nucleic acid kanye ne-phospholipids, futhi, njenge-calcium phosphate, yakha izingxenye ezisekelayo zamathambo ethu. I-phosphorus ivame ukuba isakhi esivimbela ukukhula (esidingekayo ekukhuleni) ezindaweni zemvelo zasemanzini (Isithombe 37.19).

 I-phosphorus ivela emvelweni njenge-phosphate ion (PO43−). Ngaphezu kokugeleza kwe-phosphate ngenxa yomsebenzi womuntu, ukugeleza kwemvelo kwenzeka lapho ikhishwa edwaleni eliqukethe i-phosphate ngokuguguleka, ngaleyo ndlela ithumela ama-phosphate emifuleni, emachibini, kanye nolwandle. Leli dwala livela olwandle. Izinsalela zolwandle eziqukethe i-phosphate zakha ngokuyinhloko emizimbeni yezinto eziphilayo zasolwandle kanye nasezintweni eziphuma kuzo. Kodwa-ke, ezindaweni ezikude, umlotha wentaba-mlilo, ama-aerosol, kanye nothuli lwamaminerali nakho kungaba imithombo ebalulekile ye-phosphate. Le nsedi isuswa iye ezweni ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngokuphakanyiswa kwezindawo zobuso boMhlaba.

 I-phosphorus iphinde ishintshaniswe ngokushintshana phakathi kwe-phosphate encibilikisiwe olwandle kanye nezindawo zemvelo zasolwandle. Ukuhamba kwe-phosphate kusuka olwandle kuya ezweni kanye nasenhlabathini kuhamba kancane kakhulu, kanti i-phosphate ion ejwayelekile inesikhathi sokuhlala olwandle phakathi kweminyaka engu-20,000 no-100,000.

 I-phosphorus ne-nitrogen eningi engena kulezi zindawo zemvelo kusukela ekugelezeni komanyolo kanye nendle kubangela ukukhula ngokweqile kwama-microorganisms futhi iqede umoya-mpilo oncibilikisiwe, okuholela ekufeni kwezilwane eziningi zemvelo, njenge-shellfish kanye ne-finfish. Le nqubo ibangela izindawo ezifile emachibini nasemilonyeni yemifula eminingi emikhulu (Isithombe 37.19).

 Bheka Isithombe 37.20. Indawo efile yindawo engaphakathi kwendawo yamanzi ahlanzekile noma indawo zemvelo yasolwandle lapho izindawo ezinkulu zincishisiwe khona izitshalo nezilwane zazo ezivamile; lezi zindawo zingabangelwa yi-eutrophication, ukuchitheka kwamafutha, ukulahlwa kwamakhemikhali anobuthi, kanye neminye imisebenzi yabantu. Inani lezindawo ezifile liye landa iminyaka eminingana, futhi kunezindawo ezingaphezu kuka-400 zalezi ezazikhona kusukela ngo-2008. Enye yezindawo ezifile kakhulu iseduze nogu lwase-United States eGulf of Mexico, lapho ukugeleza komanyolo ovela esigodini soMfula iMississippi kudale indawo efile engamakhilomitha-skwele angaphezu kuka-8463. Ukugeleza kwe-phosphate ne-nitrate okuvela kumanyolo nakho kuthinta kabi izindawo zemvelo eziningana zamachibi nama-bay okuhlanganisa neChesapeake Bay empumalanga ye-United States.
question1: Kungani i-phosphorus ibalulekile ezintweni eziphilayo?
answer1: Kuyingxenye enkulu yama-nucleic acid, ama-phospholipid, namathambo
question2: I-phosphorus ivame ukuvela ngayiphi indlela emvelweni?
answer2: I-phosphate ion (PO43-)

answer3: Ukutholakala kwayo kuvame ukuvimbela ukukhula kwezinto eziphilayo
