answer4: Ukuwa kwezulu kanye nokugeleza kwamanzi okugeleza phezulu kuvela emadwaleni
question5: Uyini umthombo wokuqala wamatshe amaningi aqukethe i-phosphate emhlabeni?
answer5: Inhlabathi yolwandle eyakhiwe ngezinto eziphilayo zasolwandle kanye nemfucuza yazo
question6: Kungani umjikelezo we-phosphorus uqhubeka kancane kuneminye imijikelezo eminingi ye-biogeochemical?
answer6: I-phosphate ihlala isikhathi eside kakhulu olwandle futhi incike ezinqubweni ze-geologic ezihamba kancane.
question7: I-phosphorus eningi evela kumanyolo ingathinta kanjani imvelo yasemanzini?
answer7: Kungabangela i-eutrophication, okuholela ekukhuleni ngokweqile kwamagciwane kanye nokuncipha komoya-mpilo
question8: Iyini indawo efile?
answer8: Indawo lapho ukuncipha komoya-mpilo kuqede khona ingxenye enkulu yempilo evamile yezitshalo nezilwane
distractor8b: I-ecosystem enezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo eziningi ngendlela engavamile
question9: Iyiphi enye yezindawo ezinkulu kakhulu ezifile e-United States ezihlotshaniswa nayo?
answer9: Ukugeleza kukamanyolo kusuka esigodini soMfula iMississippi kuya eGulf of Mexico

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.3 Imijikelezo ye-Biogeochemical | I-Chesapeake Bay
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.3 Imijikelezo ye-Biogeochemical | I-Chesapeake Bay
chapterContent:
I-Chesapeake Bay ibilokhu ibhekwa njengenye yezindawo ezinhle kakhulu eMhlabeni; manje isenkingeni futhi ibhekwa njenge-ecosystem ewohlokayo. Ngawo-1970, i-Chesapeake Bay yayingenye yezindawo zokuqala zemvelo ukuhlonza izindawo ezifile, eziqhubeka nokubulala izinhlobo eziningi zezinhlanzi nezinhlobo ezihlala phansi, njenge-clams, ama-oyster, nezibungu. Izinhlobo eziningana ziye zancipha e-Chesapeake Bay ngenxa yokugeleza kwamanzi angaphezulu aqukethe izakhamzimba eziningi ezivela kumanyolo wokwenziwa osetshenziswa emhlabeni. Umthombo wamanyolo (onokuqukethwe okuphezulu kwe-nitrogen ne-phosphate) awugcini nje emikhubeni yezolimo. Kunezindawo eziningi zasemadolobheni eziseduze kanye nemifula nemifudlana engaphezu kuka-150 ethululela e-bay ethwala umanyolo ovela otshanini nasezingadini. Ngakho-ke, ukwehla kwe-Chesapeake Bay kuyinkinga eyinkimbinkimbi futhi kudinga ukubambisana kwezimboni, ezolimo, kanye nabaninikhaya abavamile.

 Okuthakazelisa kakhulu abalondolozi bemvelo inani labantu be-oyster; Kulinganiselwa ukuthi kwakukhona amahektha angaphezu kuka-200,000 emithombo yama-oyster echwebeni ngawo-1700, kodwa lelo nani manje lehlile laya kumahektha angu-36,000 kuphela. Ukuvunwa kwama-oyster kwakuke kwaba imboni enkulu eChesapeake Bay, kodwa kwehle ngamaphesenti angu-88 phakathi kuka-1982 no-2007. Lokhu kwehla kwakungenxa yokugeleza kukamanyolo nezindawo ezifile kodwa futhi nokuvuna ngokweqile. Ama-oyster adinga inani elincane labantu ngoba kumele abe seduze ukuze azale. Imisebenzi yabantu ishintshe inani lama-oyster nezindawo, yaphazamisa kakhulu imvelo.

 Ukubuyiselwa kwenani lama-oyster eChesapeake Bay bekulokhu kuqhubeka iminyaka eminingana ngempumelelo exubile. Abantu abaningi abagcini nje ngokuthola ama-oyster elungele ukudliwa, kodwa futhi ahlanza nechwebeni. Ama-oyster ayizinto zokondla izihlungi, futhi njengoba edla, ahlanza amanzi azungezile. Ngawo-1700, kwalinganiselwa ukuthi kwathatha izinsuku ezimbalwa kuphela ukuthi inani lama-oyster lihlunge lonke inani lechwebeni. Namuhla, njengoba izimo zamanzi zishintshile, kulinganiselwa ukuthi inani labantu bamanje lizothatha cishe unyaka ukwenza umsebenzi ofanayo.

 Imizamo yokuvuselela ibilokhu iqhubeka iminyaka eminingana yizinhlangano ezingenzi nzuzo, njengeChesapeake Bay Foundation. Umgomo wokuvuselela ukuthola indlela yokwandisa inani labantu ukuze ama-oyster akwazi ukuzala kahle. Izinhlobo eziningi ezingamelana nezifo (ezakhiwe eVirginia Institute of Marine Science for the College of William and Mary) seziyatholakala manje futhi zisetshenziswe ekwakhiweni kwama-oyster reefs okuhlola. Imizamo yokuhlanza nokulungisa i-bay yiVirginia neDelaware iye yaphazamiseka ngoba ukungcola okuningi okungena e-bay kuvela kwezinye izifundazwe, okugcizelela isidingo sokubambisana phakathi kwamazwe ukuze kutholakale ukuvuselelwa okuphumelelayo.

 Izinhlobo ezintsha zama-oyster ezinawo amandla nazo ziveze imboni entsha nephumelelayo kwezomnotho—i-oyster aquaculture—engagcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ama-oyster ngokudla nenzuzo, kodwa futhi inenzuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlanza i-bay.
question1: Kungani iChesapeake Bay iqashelwe njengendawo ewohlokayo?
answer1: Ukugeleza ngokweqile kwezakhamzimba kudale izindawo ezifile eziye zalimaza izinhlobo eziningi zasemanzini
distractor1a: Umsebenzi wezintaba-mlilo ubhubhise izindawo eziningi zokuhlala

answer4: Kumelwe zisondelene ngokwanele ukuze zizalane ngempumelelo

answer5: Ziyizinto zokondla izihlungi ezisusa izinhlayiya futhi zithuthukise ikhwalithi yamanzi

answer6: Cishe unyaka owodwa

distractor8a: Isifundazwe esisodwa kuphela esiqukethe ama-oyster reefs
distractor8c: Ama-oyster athuthela phakathi kwezifundazwe minyaka yonke

answer9: Kuyasiza ukuhlanza i-bay ngokuhlunga amanzi
distractor9c: Iqeda zonke izinto eziphilayo ezibangelwa amagciwane
question10: Ukugeleza kukamanyolo kwaveza kanjani indawo efile eChesapeake Bay?
answer10: I-nitrogen eningi evela kumanyolo ikhulisa ukukhula kwamagciwane, iqeda umoya-mpilo oncibilikisiwe emanzini, ngaleyo ndlela ibulale izilwane zesimiso sezinto eziphilayo
distractor10a: I-nitrogen eningi evela kumanyolo inciphisa ukukhula kwamagciwane, iqeda umoya-mpilo oncibilikisiwe emanzini, ngaleyo ndlela ibulale izilwane zesimiso sezinto eziphilayo
distractor10b: Ukugeleza kukamanyolo kunciphisa ukugcwala kwe-carbon dioxide emanzini, ngaleyo ndlela kubulale izilwane ze-ecosystem
distractor10c: Ukugeleza kukamanyolo kukhiqiza indawo efile eChesapeake Bay ngokwandisa ukugcwala komoya-mpilo endaweni ezungezile.

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. Izinhlelo Ze-Ecosystem | 37.3 Imijikelezo Ye-Biogeochemical | Umjikelezo We-Sulfur
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. Izinhlelo Ze-Ecosystem | 37.3 Imijikelezo Ye-Biogeochemical | Umjikelezo We-Sulfur
chapterContent:
I-sulfur iyisici esibalulekile kuma-macromolecule ezinto eziphilayo. Njengengxenye ye-amino acid cysteine, ihilelekile ekwakhekeni kwezibopho ze-disulfide ngaphakathi kwamaprotheni, okusiza ekunqumeni amaphethini azo okugoqeka angu-3-D, ngakho-ke imisebenzi yawo. Njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 37.21, i-sulfur ijikeleza phakathi kolwandle, umhlaba, kanye nomkhathi. I-sulfur ye-atmospheric itholakala ngesimo se-sulfur dioxide (SO2) futhi ingena emkhathini ngezindlela ezintathu: kusukela ekubolekeni kwama-molecule e-organic, kusukela emisebenzini yentaba-mlilo kanye nemigodi ye-geothermal, kanye nokushiswa kwamafutha e-fossil ngabantu.

 Emhlabeni, i-sulfur ibekwa ngezindlela ezine ezinkulu: imvula, ukuvela okuqondile okuvela emkhathini, ukuguquka kwamadwala, kanye nemigodi ye-geothermal (Isithombe 37.22 kanye noMfanekiso 37.23). I-sulfur ye-atmospheric itholakala ngesimo se-sulfur dioxide (SO2), futhi njengoba imvula ina emoyeni, i-sulfur iyancibilika ngesimo se-sulfurous acid ebuthakathaka (H2SO3). I-sulfur nayo ingawa ngqo emoyeni ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-fallout. Futhi, ukuguguleka kwamatshe aqukethe i-sulfur kukhipha i-sulfur enhlabathini. Lawa matshe avela ezihlabathini zasolwandle ezithuthelwa ezweni ngokuphakanyiswa kwe-geological kwezihlabathi zasolwandle. Izindawo zemvelo zasemhlabeni zingasebenzisa lawa ma-sulfur enhlabathi (SO4−), futhi lapho lezi zinto eziphilayo zifa futhi zibola, zikhulula i-sulfur emuva emoyeni njengegesi ye-hydrogen sulfide (H2S).

 I-sulfur ingena olwandle ngokugeleza okuvela ezweni, kusuka ekugugulekeni komoya, kanye nasezindaweni ezingaphansi kwamanzi ezikhipha umoya. Ezinye izindawo zemvelo (Isithombe 37.9) zithembele kuma-chemoautotrophs asebenzisa i-sulfur njengomthombo wamandla webhayoloji. Lesi sihlabathi sibe sesisekela izindawo zemvelo zasolwandle ngesimo sama-sulfur.

 Imisebenzi yabantu idlale indima enkulu ekushintsheni ibhalansi yomjikelezo we-sulfur womhlaba. Ukushiswa kwamafutha amaningi e-fossil, ikakhulukazi avela emalahleni, kukhipha inani elikhulu le-sulfur dioxide kanye negesi ye-hydrogen sulfide emkhathini. Njengoba imvula iwela kakhulu ngegesi ye-sulfur dioxide, idala into eyaziwa ngokuthi imvula ye-acid. Imvula ye-acid iyimvula ebhubhisayo ebangelwa amanzi emvula awela phansi ngegesi ye-sulfur dioxide, eyiguqula ibe yi-sulfurous acid ebuthakathaka, ebangela umonakalo ezindaweni zemvelo zasemanzini. Imvula ye-acid ilimaza indawo yemvelo ngokunciphisa i-pH yamachibi, okubulala izilwane eziningi ezihlala kuyo; futhi ithinta indawo eyenziwe ngabantu ngokuwohloka kwamakhemikhali kwezakhiwo. Isibonelo, izikhumbuzo eziningi zemabula, njengeLincoln Memorial eWashington, DC, ziye zabhekana nomonakalo omkhulu ngenxa yemvula ye-acid eminyakeni edlule. Lezi zibonelo zibonisa imiphumela ebanzi yemisebenzi yabantu endaweni yethu kanye nezinselele ezisele zesikhathi esizayo sethu.
question1: Kungani isibabule sibalulekile ezintweni eziphilayo?
answer1: Kuyingxenye ye-amino acid cysteine futhi kusiza ekwakheni izibopho ze-disulfide eziqinisa isakhiwo seprotheni
question2: Iyiphi indlela evame ukutholakala ngayo isibabule emkhathini?
answer2: I-Sulphur dioxide (SO2)
question3: Yimuphi umsebenzi womuntu okhuphule kakhulu amazinga e-sulfur dioxide emoyeni?
answer3: Ukushisa amafutha emvelo, ikakhulukazi amalahle
question4: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyindlela eyinhloko yokuba isibabule sibekwe emhlabeni?
answer4: Imvula
question5: Isibabule sikhishwa kanjani emuva emoyeni ngemva kokuba izinto eziphilayo zifile futhi zibola?
answer5: Njengegesi ye-hydrogen sulfide (H2S)
question6: Isibabule singena kanjani ezindaweni zemvelo zasolwandle?
answer6: Ngokugeleza kwamanzi avela ezweni, emkhathini, kanye nemigodi yamanzi angaphansi komhlaba
question7: Kungani izimiso zemvelo ze-hydrothermal vent zikwazi ukuba khona ngaphandle kokukhanya kwelanga?
answer7: Ama-chemoautotrophs asebenzisa i-sulfur com amakhilogremu njengomthombo wamandla
question8: Iyini imvula ene-asidi?
answer8: Amanzi emvula akhiqiza i-asidi lapho i-sulfur dioxide incibilika kuyo ukuze yakhe i-asidi ye-sulfurous ebuthakathaka
distractor8a: Imvula equkethe i-carbon dioxide encibilikisiwe kuphela
distractor8c: Imvula ivele kuphela ngesikhathi sokuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo
question9: Uyini umphumela owodwa wemvelo wemvula ene-asidi?
answer9: Yehlisa i-pH yamachibi, ilimaze noma ibulale izinto eziningi zasemanzini
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.24. Isithombe sibonisa izindawo zokugcina i-nitrogen eMhlabeni. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kulesi sithombe
answer10: Iningi le-nitrogen eMhlabeni lisemkhathini
distractor10c: Izinto eziphilayo zasolwandle ziqukethe i-nitrogen eningi kunezinto eziphilayo zasemhlabeni

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.4 Amagama Ayinhloko
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.4 Amagama Ayinhloko
chapterContent:
imvula ene-asidi
imvula ebhubhisayo ebangelwa amanzi emvula awela phansi ngegesi ye-sulfur dioxide, eyiguqula ibe yi-sulfuric acid ebuthakathaka; ingalimaza izakhiwo kanye nezindawo zemvelo

 imodeli yokuhlaziya
imodeli yezindawo zemvelo edalwe ngamafomula ezibalo ukubikezela imiphumela yokuphazamiseka kwemvelo esakhiweni sendawo nasemandleni ayo

 i-apex consumer
izinto eziphilayo phezulu kochungechunge lokudla

 ukuhlanganiswa
i-biomass esetshenzisiwe futhi ehlanganiswa kusukela ezingeni le-trophic langaphambilini ngemuva kokubala amandla alahlekile ngenxa yokungagwinywa kokudla okungaphelele, amandla asetshenziselwa ukuphefumula, kanye namandla alahlekile njengemfucuza

 umjikelezo we-biogeochemical
ukujikeleza kwezakhamzimba zamaminerali ezindaweni zemvelo kanye nasemhlabeni ongaphili

 ukukhulisa i-biomagnification
ukwanda kokugxila kwezinto ezihlala njalo, ezinobuthi ezintweni eziphilayo ezingeni ngalinye le-trophic, kusukela kubakhiqizi abayinhloko kuya kubathengi abaphezulu

 i-biomass
isisindo esiphelele, ngesikhathi sokulinganisa, kwezinto eziphilayo noma eziphilayo ngaphambili endaweni yeyunithi ngaphakathi kwezinga le-trophic

 i-chemoautotroph
izinto eziphilayo ezikwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla kwazo zisebenzisa amandla avela kuma-molecule angaphili

 imodeli yomqondo
(futhi, amamodeli ezingxenye) imodeli ye-ecosystem equkethe amashadi okugeleza abonisa ukusebenzisana kwezingxenye ezahlukene zezinto eziphilayo nezingaphili ze-ecosystem

 indawo efile
indawo ngaphakathi kwe-ecosystem emachibini naseduze kwemilomo yemifula lapho izindawo ezinkulu ze-ecosystem ziphelelwe yizitshalo nezilwane zazo ezivamile; lezi zindawo zingabangelwa yi-eutrophication, ukuchitheka kwamafutha, ukulahla amakhemikhali anobuthi, kanye neminye imisebenzi yabantu

 iwebhu yokudla engcolile
uhlobo lwewebhu lokudla lapho abathengi abayinhloko bahlanganisa khona ama-decompolser; lokhu kuvame ukuhlotshaniswa nama-developers okudla adla ngaphakathi kwendawo efanayo

iphiramidi yemvelo
 (futhi, iphiramidi ye-Eltonian) ukumelwa okucacile kwamazinga ahlukene e-trophic endaweni ephilayo esekelwe ezinambeni zezinto eziphilayo, i-biomass, noma okuqukethwe kwamandla

indawo ephilayo
 umphakathi wezinto eziphilayo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo nendawo yazo ezungezile

i-ecosystem dynamics
 isifundo sezinguquko esakhiweni se-ecosystem ezibangelwa izinguquko endaweni ezungezile noma amandla angaphakathi

ukulingana
 isimo esizinzile sendawo ezungezile lapho zonke izinto eziphilayo zilingana nendawo yazo kanye nomunye nomunye

i-eutrophication
 inqubo lapho ukugeleza kwezakhamzimba kubangela ukukhula ngokweqile kwama-microorganisms, kunciphisa amazinga e-oxygen ancibilikisiwe futhi kubulale izilwane ze-ecosystem

i-fallout
 idiphozithi eqondile yamaminerali aqinile emhlabeni noma olwandle oluvela emkhathini

uchungechunge lokudla
ukumelwa okuqondile kochungechunge lwabakhiqizi abayinhloko, abathengi abayinhloko, kanye nabathengi abasezingeni eliphezulu abasetshenziswa ukuchaza isakhiwo kanye nokuguquguquka kwemvelo

 iwebhu yokudla
ukumelwa okucacile kwewebhu ephelele, engeyona eqondile yabakhiqizi abayinhloko, abathengi abayinhloko, kanye nabathengi abasezingeni eliphezulu abasetshenziswa ukuchaza isakhiwo kanye nokuguquguquka kwemvelo

 iwebhu yokudla edlayo
uhlobo lwewebhu lokudla lapho abakhiqizi abayinhloko beyizitshalo emhlabeni noma i-phytoplankton emanzini; ngokuvamile kuhlotshaniswa newebhu yokudla eyonakele ngaphakathi kwendalo efanayo

 umkhiqizo oyinhloko ophelele
izinga lapho abakhiqizi abayinhloko be-photosynthesis bafaka khona amandla avela elangeni

 imodeli yendawo yonke
ucwaningo oluzama ukulinganisa ukwakheka, ukusebenzisana, kanye nokuguquguquka kwezindawo zonke zemvelo; ngokuvamile kunqunyelwe ubunzima bezomnotho kanye nobezokuthutha, kuye ngendalo

 i-hydrosphere
indawo yoMhlaba lapho kwenzeka khona ukunyakaza nokugcinwa kwamanzi

 i-mesocosm
ingxenye ye-ecosystem yemvelo ezosetshenziselwa ukuhlola

 i-microcosm
ukudalwa kabusha kwe-ecosystem yemvelo ngokuphelele endaweni yelabhorethri ezosetshenziselwa ukuhlola

 umkhiqizo wabathengi ophelele
okuqukethwe kwamandla okutholakala ezintweni eziphilayo zezinga elilandelayo le-trophic

 umkhiqizo oyinhloko ophelele
amandla ahlala kubakhiqizi abayinhloko ngemva kokubala ukuphefumula nokulahlekelwa ukushisa kwezinto eziphilayo

 ukusebenza kahle kokukhiqiza okwanele (i-NPE)
isilinganiso sekhono lezinga le-trophic lokuguqula amandla eliwatholayo kusuka ezingeni le-trophic langaphambilini abe yi-biomass

 umthombo ongavuseleleki
umthombo, njengophethiloli wezinto zasendulo, ovuselelwa kancane kakhulu noma ongaphindwa nhlobo

 umthengi oyinhloko
izinga le-trophic elithola amandla alo kubakhiqizi abayinhloko be-ecosystem

 umkhiqizi oyinhloko
izinga le-trophic elithola amandla alo elangeni, amakhemikhali angaphili, noma izinto eziphilayo ezifile kanye/noma ezibolayo

 isikhathi sokuhlala
isilinganiso sesikhathi esimaphakathi i-molecule yamanzi ngayinye ehlala kuso echibini elithile

 ukuqina (kwezemvelo)
isivinini lapho i-ecosystem ithola khona ukulingana ngemva kokuphazamiseka

 ukumelana (kwezemvelo)
ikhono le-ecosystem lokuhlala i-ecosystem naphezu kokuphazamiseka

 umthengi wesibili
ngokuvamile isilwane esidla abathengi abayinhloko

 imodeli yokulingisa
imodeli ye-ecosystem edalwe nge-computer pro grams ukuze i-ecosystems ibonise ngokuphelele futhi ibikezele imiphumela yokuphazamiseka kwemvelo esakhiweni se-ecosystem kanye ne-dynamics

 subduction
ukuhamba kwepuleti elilodwa le-tectonic ngaphansi kwelinye

 abathengi besithathu
izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane

 izinga le-trophic
isikhundla sohlobo noma iqembu lezinhlobo ochungechungeni lokudla noma kuwebhu yokudla

 ukusebenza kahle kokudluliselwa kwezinga le-trophic (TLTE)
ukusebenza kahle kokudluliselwa kwamandla phakathi kwamazinga amabili e-trophic alandelanayo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.5 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 37. I-Ecosystems | 37.5 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
37.1 I-Ecology ye-Ecosystems
I-Ecosystems ikhona emhlabeni, olwandle, emoyeni, nangaphansi komhlaba. Izindlela ezahlukene zokulingisa i-ecosystems ziyadingeka ukuze kuqondwe ukuthi ukuphazamiseka kwemvelo kuzothinta kanjani isakhiwo kanye nokuguquguquka kwe-ecosystem. Amamodeli anomqondo awusizo ekuboniseni ubudlelwano obujwayelekile phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nokugeleza kwezinto noma amandla phakathi kwazo. Amamodeli okuhlaziya asetshenziswa ukuchaza izintambo zokudla eziqondile, futhi amamodeli okulingisa asebenza kangcono nge-food webs ephelele.

 37.2 Amandla Ageleza Nge-Ecosystems
Izinto eziphilayo ku-ecosystem zithola amandla ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene, adluliselwa phakathi kwamazinga e-trophic njengoba amandla egeleza esuka phansi aye phezulu ku-food web, amandla elahleka ekudlulisweni ngakunye. Ukusebenza kahle kwalokhu kudluliselwa kubalulekile ekuqondeni ukuziphatha okuhlukile kanye nemikhuba yokudla yezilwane ezinegazi elifudumele nezilwane ezinegazi elibandayo. Ukulingisa amandla e-ecosystem kwenziwa kangcono ngama-ecosystem pyramid of ecosystem, yize amanye ama-ecosystem pyramid enikeza olunye ulwazi olubalulekile mayelana nesakhiwo se-ecosystem.

 37.3 Imijikelezo Ye-Biogeochemical
Izakhamzimba zamaminerali zijikeleziswa ezindaweni zemvelo kanye nendawo ezikuyo. Okubaluleke kakhulu amanzi, ikhabhoni, i-nitrogen, i-phosphorus, kanye nesulfure. Yonke le mijikelezo inemithelela emikhulu esakhiweni nasemsebenzini wezindawo zemvelo. Njengoba imisebenzi yabantu ibangele ukuphazamiseka okukhulu kule mijikelezo, ukutadisha kanye nokwenza imodeli yayo kubaluleke kakhulu. Imisebenzi eyahlukahlukene yabantu, njengokungcola, ukuchitheka kukawoyela, kanye nemicimbi) yonakalise izindawo zemvelo, okungase kubangele ushintsho lwesimo sezulu emhlabeni jikelele. Impilo yoMhlaba incike ekuqondeni le mijikelezo nokuthi ungayivikela kanjani indawo emonakalweni ongenakuguqulwa.
question1: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-ecosystem oluyivelakancane kakhulu eMhlabeni, phakathi kwe-ecosystem yasemhlabeni kanye neyasemanzini?

question2: Uma indawo ezungezile ibhekwa njengeqinile kakhulu, yini engacatshangwa ngaleyo ndawo ezungezile?
answer2: Isimiso semvelo silulama ngokushesha ekuphazamisekeni
distractor2b: I-ecosystem inamandla okuhlala isesimweni esilinganayo naphezu kokuphazamiseka
question3: Iyini i-ecosystem edalwe kabusha endaweni yelabhorethri eyaziwa ngokuthi?
answer3: I-microcosm
question4: Usosayensi ufuna ukuhlaziya indlela ukudla izinyamazane okushintsha ngayo ukwakheka kwezinhlobo zezitshalo ehlathini kanye nokuhlukanisa ingxenye yehlathi ukuze kubhekwe futhi kuhlaziywe. Lolu hlobo lwesistimu olusetshenziswa usosayensi?
answer4: I-mesocosm
question5: Yiliphi igama elichaza ukusetshenziswa kwezibalo zezibalo ekubumbeni izici eziqondile zezindawo zemvelo?
answer5: Ukumodela kokuhlaziya
question6: Uma usosayensi akha ishadi lokugeleza ukuze abonise ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlobo zezilwane esizalweni somfula, hlobo luni lwemodeli aludalayo?
answer6: Imodeli yomqondo
question7: Obani ngokuvamile abakhiqizi abayinhloko kuwebhu yokudla okudliwa olwandle?
answer7: I-phytoplankton
question8: Yisiphi kulezi zitatimende ezilandelayo esiyiqiniso ngamazinga e-trophic ohlelweni lwe-ecosystem?
answer8: Inani elincane kakhulu lamandla litholakala phezulu kochungechunge lokudla
distractor8a: Amaketanga okudla ayizibonakaliso ezinembile zezinguquko ohlelweni lwemvelo
distractor8b: Ezindaweni zemvelo zomhlaba, abakhiqizi abayinhloko bavame ukudla izitshalo
distractor8c: Kulula ukulichaza izintambo zokudla kunezintambo zokudla
question9: Zitholakalaphi izihlabathi zamakhorali?
answer9: Amanzi olwandle angajulile
question10: Singakanani isisindo sezinto eziphilayo endaweni ezungezile ngesikhathi esithile esaziwa ngokuthi?
answer10: I-biomass
question11: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.25. Isithombe sibonisa indlela isibungu esisebenzisa ngayo amandla. Iyini i-net consumer efficiency (NCE) yesibungu esiboniswe lapha?
question12: Yimuphi umthetho wekhemistri onquma ukuthi angakanani amandla angadluliselwa uma eguqulwa esuka kwesinye isimo aye kwesinye?
question13: Yisiphi isici esiyinhloko esikhawulela ubude bezintambo zokudla ezindaweni zemvelo?
answer13: Ukusebenza kahle kokudlulisa amandla okuphansi phakathi kwamazinga e-trophic
question14: Yiluphi uhlobo lwephiramidi olubhekwa njengolumele kakhulu isakhiwo se-ecosystem?
question15: Kungani inani labakhiqizi abayinhloko lincane kunenani labathengi abayinhloko ohlelweni lwe-English Channel?
answer15: Abakhiqizi abayinhloko banezinga eliphezulu lokushintshana kwezimali
distractor15a: Abathengi abayinhloko banezinga eliphezulu lokuphuma kwemali
distractor15b: Abakhiqizi abayinhloko banezinga eliphansi lokushintshana kwezimali
distractor15c: Abathengi abaphezulu banezinga eliphansi lokuphuma kwemali
question16: Yiziphi izinhlobo zokuphila ezitholakala ezindaweni lapho ukukhanya kwelanga kungatholakali khona futhi kuyadingeka ukusebenzisa ama-molecule angaphili njengomthombo wamandla?
question17: Iyini inqubo lapho i-nitrogen ilethwa khona kuma-molecule e-organic?
question18: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyindlela yokukhipha i-phosphorus emvelweni?
question19: Yini ekhiqizwa yi-eutrophication nge-nitrogen eningi lapho ichibi lamanzi lintula khona izitshalo nezilwane ezivamile?
question20: Iyini imiphumela engaba khona ye-phosphorus ne-nitrogen eningi endaweni ezungezile?
answer20: Indawo efile ingakhiqizwa ngokuphefumula komoya-mpilo ophelile
distractor20a: Lokhu kungabangela ukwanda kwamazinga okushisa emhlabeni jikelele
question21: Yiliphi igama elinikezwa ngamanzi ahlanzekile ageleza emvuleni noma eqhweni elincibilikayo emjikelezweni wamanzi?
question22: Yini ethonya kakhulu ukuthi ingakanani ikhabhoni ekhona endaweni ethile?
question23: Kungani ukuhlanganisa izinto eziphilayo zasemhlabeni zibe yi-biomes kufihla ukuhlukahluka?
answer23: Kukhona ukuhlukahluka ngaphakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-biome lapho ukuhlukaniswa kwe-biome kungakubambi khona
distractor23a: Ama-Biomes aqoqa izinto eziphilayo zasemhlabeni kuphela ngokusekelwe ezimweni ezifanayo zokuhlala
distractor23b: Izinto eziphilayo eziyingxenye ye-biome efanayo zinokungafani ekwakhekeni kwazo
distractor23c: Ama-biome asemhlabeni achazwa ngokusekelwe kuphela esimweni sokukhula kwezitshalo ezivelele
question24: Kungani ukuhlolwa kwe-mesocosm kanye ne-microcosm kungabhekwa njengokumelela uhlobo lwangempela lwezindawo zemvelo?
answer24: I-ecosystem idalwa kabusha noma ihlukaniswe kuzo zombili izivivinyo, okungase kushintshe ukuguquguquka kwe-ecosystem izivivinyo ezihlose ukuyihlaziya.
distractor24a: Kuzo zombili lezi zivivinyo, ukuguquguquka kwemvelo kungase kushintshe ngenxa yokwehluka kwezinombolo zezinhlobo kanye nokuhlukahluka kwazo yize kungekho zinguquko emvelweni.
distractor24b: Kuzo zombili izivivinyo, i-ecosystem iyadalwa kabusha okungashintsha ukuguquguquka kwe-ecosystem izivivinyo ezihlose ukuyihlaziya
distractor24c: Ukushintsha indawo yemvelo ngokuhlukanisa, okwenzeka kuzo zombili izivivinyo kungashintsha amandla ayo ngenxa yokwehluka kwezinombolo zezinhlobo kanye nokuhlukahluka kwazo.
question25: Uma usosayensi efuna ukuqapha uchungechunge lokudla lwasehlane, yiluphi uhlobo lwemodeli angaluthuthukisa futhi kungani?
answer25: Imodeli yokuhlaziya ingaba ngcono ngoba ingabhekana nezingxenye zemvelo ezilula, eziqondile eziyinkimbinkimbi ngokwezibalo
distractor25a: Imodeli yokulingisa ingaba ngcono ngoba ingabhekana nezinhlelo ezilula, eziqondile eziyinkimbinkimbi ngokwezibalo
distractor25b: Imodeli yokuhlaziya ingaba yinto efanelekile njengoba ibhekwa njengengokoqobo kakhulu ngokwemvelo kunanoma iyiphi enye imodeli
distractor25c: Imodeli yokulingisa ingaba ngcono ngoba isebenzisa amasu ezinombolo ukuxazulula izinkinga nokubona ngeso lengqondo ubudlelwano obuyinkimbinkimbi obukhona ohlelweni lwe-ecosystem.
question26: Qhathanisa futhi uqhathanise izintambo zokudla kanye nezintambo zokudla. Yiziphi amandla omqondo ngamunye ekuchazeni izimiso zemvelo?
answer26: Kokubili iwebhu yokudla kanye nochungechunge lokudla kuchaza ukuguquguquka kokudluliselwa kwamandla endaweni ezungezile. Amaketanga okudla ayizinhlelo eziqondile, kulula ukuzilandela nokuzihlola kanti ama-food web awaqondile, anembile futhi aphelele futhi angasetshenziswa ngqo njengokufaka amamodeli okulingisa.
distractor26a: Kokubili uchungechunge lokudla kanye nohlelo lokudla kulandela indlela eyodwa njengoba amandla edluliselwa endaweni ezungezile. Uchungechunge lokudla kulula ukululandela nokuluzama kodwa alunembile kangako kanti uchungechunge lokudla luphelele futhi luyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu.
distractor26b: Kokubili i-food web kanye ne-food chain kuchaza ukuguquguquka kokudluliselwa kwamandla endaweni ezungezile. I-food chains iyizinhlelo ezingezona eziqondile okulula ukuzilandela nokuzihlola kanti i-food webs iqondile, iphelele futhi ingasetshenziswa ngqo njengokufaka amamodeli okulingisa.
distractor26c: Kokubili uchungechunge lokudla kanye newebhu lokudla kulandela indlela eyodwa njengoba amandla edluliselwa endaweni ezungezile. Uchungechunge lokudla luyizinhlelo eziqondile, kulula ukuzilandela futhi zisetshenziswa ngqo njengokufakwa kwamamodeli okulingisa, kanti uchungechunge lokudla aluqondile, lunembile, luphelele futhi luguquguquka ekuklameni okuhlaziyiwe.
question27: Qamba uhlobo olulodwa lokuphazamiseka kwemvelo kanye nohlobo olulodwa oluhlobene nabantu. Kungani lokhu kukhathaza abalondolozi bemvelo?
answer27: Ukukhanyisa uhlobo lokuphazamiseka kwemvelo kanti ukungcola kuyisiphazamiso esihlobene nabantu. Kokubili kuyabakhathaza abalondolozi bemvelo ngoba kushintsha imvelo
distractor27a: Ukukhanyisa uhlobo lokuphazamiseka kwemvelo kanti ukungcola kuyisiphazamiso esihlobene nabantu. Kokubili kuyabakhathaza abalondolozi bemvelo ngoba kuthinta yonke indawo.
distractor27b: Umlilo uhlobo lokuphazamiseka kwemvelo kanti ezolimo ziwukuphazamiseka okuhlobene nabantu. Zombili lezi zinhlobo ziyabakhathaza abalondolozi bemvelo ngoba izimiso zemvelo azikwazi ukubuya zisuka ekuphazamisekeni.
distractor27c: Ukungcola kuwuhlobo lokuphazamiseka kwemvelo kanti umbani uwukuphazamiseka okuhlobene nabantu. Kokubili kuyabakhathaza abalondolozi bemvelo ngoba kushintsha imvelo
question28: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.26. Isithombe sibonisa iphiramidi ye-biomass ohlelweni lwemvelo lwasolwandle. Ngokusekelwe kule phiramidi, yenza isimangalo mayelana ne-phytoplankton
answer28: I-Phytoplankton inokukhiqiza okuphezulu kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izilwane
distractor28a: I-Phytoplankton inokukhiqiza okuphansi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izilwane
distractor28b: I-phytoplankton incane kakhulu ngokomzimba uma iqhathaniswa nezinye izilwane eziboniswe lapha.
distractor28c: I-phytoplankton inkulu ngokomzimba uma iqhathaniswa nezinye izilwane eziboniswe lapha.
question29: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.27. Iphiramidi ngakwesobunxele ikhombisa inani labantu abakhiqizi abayinhloko, kanye nabathengi abayinhloko, abesibili kanye nabesithathu. Iphiramidi ngakwesokudla inikeza i-biomass yabo. Yikuphi ukukhetha okuchaza le ecosystem?
answer29: Ihlathi elivuthiwe lapho abakhiqizi abayinhloko kuyizihlahla ezinkulu
distractor29a: Indawo yotshani lapho abakhiqizi abayinhloko bewutshani
distractor29b: Indawo ewugwadule lapho abakhiqizi abayinhloko beyizihlahla ezimfushane
distractor29c: Idwala lamakhorali lapho abakhiqizi abayinhloko kuyi-coral
question30: Qhathanisa izinhlobo ezintathu zamaphiramidi e-ecosystem nokuthi zichaza kahle kangakanani isakhiwo se-ecosystem. Khomba ukuthi yiziphi ezingaguqulwa bese unikeza isibonelo esithile sephiramidi eguqulwe ngayinye
answer30: Izinhlobo ezintathu zamaphiramidi e-ecosystem ziyi-pyramid yamandla, inombolo kanye ne-biomass lapho kungaguqulwa khona amaphiramidi enani kanye ne-biomass. Izibonelo zamaphiramidi aguquliwe enani kanye ne-biomass zingamahlathi afudumele ehlobo kanye ne-phytoplankton e-English Channel ngokulandelana.
distractor30a: Izinhlobo ezintathu zamaphiramidi e-ecosystem ziyi-pyramid yamandla, inombolo kanye ne-biomass lapho kungaguqulwa khona amaphiramidi enani namandla. Izibonelo zamaphiramidi aguquliwe enani kanye namandla yihlathi elinomoya opholile ehlobo kanye ne-phytoplankton e-English Channel ngokulandelana.
distractor30b: Izinhlobo ezintathu zamaphiramidi e-ecosystem ziyi-pyramid yamandla, inombolo kanye ne-biomass lapho kungaguqulwa khona amaphiramidi enombolo kanye ne-biomass. Izibonelo zamaphiramidi aguquliwe enani kanye ne-biomass zingamahlathi afudumele ehlobo kanye ne-Silver Springs ecosystem eFlorida ngokulandelana.
distractor30c: Izinhlobo ezintathu zamaphiramidi e-ecosystem ziyi-pyramid yamandla, inombolo kanye ne-biomass lapho kungaguqulwa khona amaphiramidi enani kanye ne-biomass. Izibonelo zamaphiramidi aguquliwe enani kanye ne-biomass ziyizindawo zotshani ehlobo kanye ne-phytoplankton e-English Channel ngokulandelana.
question31: Kungani ososayensi bevame ukuhlaziya umkhiqizo oyinhloko ophelele uma kuqhathaniswa nomkhiqizo oyinhloko ophelele?
answer31: Njengoba ukuphefumula nokulahlekelwa ukushisa kusebenzisa amandla omkhiqizi oyinhloko, ngakho-ke, umkhiqizo oyinhloko ophelele yilokho okutholakala kubathengi abayinhloko.
distractor31a: Ukukhiqiza okuyisisekelo okune-Net kufaka izici ezifana nokukhiqiza okwamanje kanye namazinga alandelayo e-trophic, kanti ukukhiqiza okuyisisekelo okuphelele akwenzi lokho
distractor31b: Ukukhiqiza okuyisisekelo okuyisisekelo yisilinganiso lapho abakhiqizi abayinhloko be-photosynthesis befaka khona amandla avela elangeni
distractor31c: Njengoba umkhiqizo oyinhloko ungokuqukethwe kwamandla okutholakala ezintweni eziphilayo zezinga elilandelayo le-trophic
question32: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.28. Ucwaningo luhlole imiphumela yokwengeza i-nitrogen (izakhamzimba) ezitshalweni ezindaweni ezahlukene zemvelo. Amagrafu amelela okutholakele kwawo. Igrafu engakwesobunxele ikhombisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo (SR - ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo) kanti igrafu engakwesokudla ikhombisa inani labantu (IA - ukuchichima komuntu ngamunye). Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kula magrafu
answer32: Ezinye izinhlobo zincintisana nezinye uma kukhona imithombo eminingi ye-nitrogen
distractor32a: Izakhamzimba eziningi zithinta zonke izinhlobo zezitshalo ngokulinganayo
distractor32b: I-nitrogen ibangela ukuthi i-biomass yezitshalo inciphe
distractor32c: Amazinga aphansi okufakwa kwe-nitrogen awathinti inani lezitshalo
question33: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.29. Isithombe sibonisa izindawo zokugcina ikhabhoni kanye nokujikeleza kwekhabhoni. Izinombolo ezibomvu zimelela izinguquko emjikelezweni wekhabhoni ngenxa yemisebenzi yabantu. Izinombolo eziseduze nemicibisholo ziyizinguquko zaminyaka yonke, kanti izinombolo ezisezindaweni zokugcina zimelela ushintsho oluphelele eminyakeni eminingi. Iyini indawo yokugcina ikhabhoni enkulu kunazo zonke eMhlabeni?
question34: Yiluphi uhlobo lwesibabule olutholakala emkhathini futhi luphuma kanjani emkhathini?
answer34: I-sulfur dioxide, eshiya umkhathi njengemvula ye-sulfuric acid ebuthakathaka
distractor34a: I-hydrogen sulfide, eshiya umkhathi njengemvula ye-sulfur dioxide ebuthakathaka
distractor34b: I-sulfur dioxide, eshiya umkhathi njengemvula ye-sulfur dioxide ebuthakathaka
distractor34c: I-hydrogen sulfide, eshiya umkhathi njengemvula ye-sulfuric acid ebuthakathaka
question35: Abakhiqizi nabathengi bayadingeka ekusebenzeni kwe-ecosystem kanye namandla ukuze kudlule i-ecosystem. Yini engase yenzeke ohlelweni lwamanzi olunabakhiqizi abaningi uma kuqhathaniswa nabathengi?
distractor35a: Ngeke kube khona umthombo wamandla ayisisekelo
question36: Amandla ayingxenye eyisisekelo ohlelweni lwemvelo futhi anikelwa ngabakhiqizi abayinhloko. Chaza ukuthi amandla okukhanya angasekela kanjani abathengi behlelo lwemvelo
answer36: Abakhiqizi abayinhloko baguqula amandla okukhanya nge-photosynthesis futhi abathengi bathola amandla ngokudla ngawo noma abanye abathengi abadle laba bakhiqizi
distractor36a: Amandla okukhanya aguqulwa ngabakhiqizi abayinhloko kanye nabathengi abayinhloko. Abathengi abasezingeni eliphezulu le-trophic bayawondla ukuze bathole amandla
distractor36b: Abakhiqizi abayinhloko bangathola amandla avela elangeni kuphela nge-photosynthesis futhi bathole amandla ngokudla bona noma abanye abathengi abadle laba bakhiqizi.
distractor36c: Abakhiqizi abayinhloko baguqula amandla okukhanya ngokusebenzisa i-chemosynthesis futhi abathengi bathola amandla ngokudla ngawo noma abanye abathengi abasebenzise laba bakhiqizi.
question37: Ekuhlolweni kwe-microcosm kusetshenziswa amathangi ezinhlanzi ukulingisa indawo echibini, ukwanda kwenani lezinhlobo ze-stickleback kungandisa usayizi wezinhlayiya ze-carbon eziphilayo ezincibilikisiwe. Lokhu kungabathinta kanjani abakhiqizi abayinhloko ohlelweni lwe-ecosystem?
question38: Izifundo ngezinhlanzi ze-stickleback zembule ukuthi ukuba khona kwezinhlobo ezimbili ze-stickleback kunciphisa inani lezimbali ze-algal uma kuqhathaniswa nokuba khona kohlobo olulodwa lwe-stickleback ekuhlolweni kwe-microcosm. Lokhu kwenzeka kanjani?
answer38: Lokhu kwenzeke njengoba ukuba khona kwezinhlobo ezimbili kubangele ukwanda kosayizi wama-molecule e-carbon ancibilikisiwe, okwavimba ukungena kokukhanya emanzini futhi kwavimbela i-photosynthesis yama-algae.
distractor38a: Lokhu kwenzeke ngoba izinhlobo ezimbili ze-stickleback zadla zonke izakhamzimba okwavimbela ulwelwe ukuthi lukhule
distractor38b: Lokhu kwenzeke ngoba usayizi wama-molecule e-carbon ancibilikisiwe wanda lapho kukhona uhlobo olulodwa lwenhlanzi okwakhulisa inani lezimbali ze-algal.
distractor38c: Lokhu kwenzeke njengoba ulwelwe ludliwa ngobuningi obukhulu uma kukhona izinhlobo ezimbili ze-stickleback.
question39: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.30. Lesi sibalo sibonisa ukushintshana kwamandla ngokusebenzisa amazinga e-trophic. Yiliphi izinga elimelela abakhiqizi abayinhloko?
question40: Bheka Umfanekiso 37.31. Amahlathi amakhulu e-kelp ayizindawo zemvelo zasolwandle ezinezinhlobonhlobo eziningi zezinto eziphilayo. Ama-sea otter ayizinhlobo ezibalulekile emahlathini amakhulu e-kelp. Ama-sea otter adla ama-sea urchin, abhubhisa ama-kelp uma eshiywa wodwa. Ucwaningo luhlole izinga le-trophic le-black rockfish kanye ne-copper rockfish, izinhlobo ezimbili zezinhlanzi ezihlala emahlathini e-kelp, lapho kukhona futhi kungekho ama-otter. Igrafu ikhombisa okutholakele kwabo. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kugrafu
answer40: Ukuba khona kwe-otter kuthinta izinga le-trophic le-copper rockfish kodwa hhayi i-black rockfish.
distractor40a: Ukuba khona kwe-otter kuthinta izinga le-trophic le-black rockfish kodwa hhayi i-copper rockfish.
distractor40b: Izinga le-trophic lezinhlanzi ezincane zethusi lithinteka kakhulu ukungabikho kwama-otter
distractor40c: Izinga le-trophic lezinhlanzi ezinkulu zethusi lithinteka kakhulu ukungabikho kwama-otter
question41: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.32. Okulandelayo indawo yokudla yendawo yokuhlala yasendle ethatha amakhilomitha angu-25.6 ubude. I-biomass yabakhiqizi abayinhloko isatshalaliswa ngokulinganayo kuyo yonke indawo yokuhlala futhi ifinyelela ku-1,500 kg /km2. Abathuthukisi bavumile iphrojekthi ezonciphisa unomphela i-biomass yabakhiqizi abayinhloko ngamaphesenti angu-50 futhi isuse bonke onogwaja nezinyamazane. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungenzeka kube umphumela ekuqedweni kwephrojekthi?
distractor41a: I-biomass yama-coyote izoba ngu-6 kg, kanti i-biomass yama-hawk izoba ngu-0.5 kg
distractor41b: Ama-coyote azoshintsha izintandokazi zezisulu futhi ancintisane nama-hawk
distractor41c: Kuzoba nama-voles angaphansi ngo-50% kanye nama-hawk angaphansi ngo-90%.
question42: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.33. Lesi sibalo sibonisa inethiwekhi yokudla yesistimu yemvelo. Bekuyokwenzekani kunethiwekhi yokudla uma zonke izinhlobo zomugqa B wonke zingasuswa yinhlekelele yemvelo njengokuchitheka kukawoyela? Kungani?
answer42: Abathengi besithathu bazofa ngenxa yokuntuleka kokudla futhi lokhu kungase kuholele ekuweni kwewebhu yokudla yonke.
distractor42a: Abakhiqizi bangase baphele, okubangela ukuthi iwebhu yokudla iwele
distractor42b: Inethiwekhi yokudla ngeke ithintwe njengoba abathengi besibili nabathathu bezoba abathengi bokuqala nabaphezulu, ngokulandelana.
distractor42c: Iwebhu yokudla ingase ihlupheke ngokulahlekelwa abakhiqizi abayinhloko okwesikhashana okuzolulama ngokushesha, ngaleyo ndlela, kuvuseleleke imvelo
question43: Abantu bamatasa kakhulu ekuguquleni izimiso zemvelo emhlabeni wonke. Uma isethi entsha yezakhiwo ezisemaphethelweni ehlathi ivimba ukukhanya kwelanga ekufinyeleleni ingxenye enkulu yehlathi, yini engase yenzeke kuleyo ngxenye yehlathi?
answer43: Izilwane ezidla uhlaza zizotholakala ngobuningi obuncane
distractor43a: Izilwane ezidla uhlaza zizotholakala ngobuningi obukhulu
question44: Uma uhlola ubudlelwano phakathi kwezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane ngaphakathi kwendawo ezungezile futhi waphawula ukuthi ukususwa kwezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane nakho kwaholela ekufeni kwezilwane ezidla uhlaza, yini obungasola ukuthi yenzekile?
answer44: Ukudla ngokweqile yizilwane ezidla uhlaza kwakungabangela ukuncipha kwabakhiqizi abayinhloko, okushiya izilwane ezidla uhlaza zingenakudla okwanele.
distractor44a: Ukususwa kwezilwane ezidla ezinye kuzonciphisa ngqo inani lezilwane ezidla uhlaza
distractor44b: Ukuntuleka kwezilwane ezidla ezinye kungasho ukuthi kwenzeke ukukhiqizwa okuningi kakhulu kokuqala
distractor44c: Izilwane ezidla uhlaza ezivela kwenye indawo kungenzeka ukuthi zingene endaweni ezungezile futhi zadla abakhiqizi abayinhloko, okwabangela ukufa kwezinhlobo zokuqala zezilwane ezidla uhlaza.
question45: Nakuba abakhiqizi bebalulekile ukuze amandla ageleze endaweni ezungezile, abathengi nabo banendima ebalulekile. Yini engenzeka ohlelweni lwasemanzini olunabathengi abaningi uma kuqhathaniswa nabakhiqizi?
distractor45b: Kuzoba khona okungaphezu komthombo wamandla ayisisekelo
question46: Okulandelayo yi-equation yokusebenza kahle kokudluliselwa kwezinga le-trophic: (ukukhiqizwa ezingeni le-trophic/ukukhiqiza ezingeni le-trophic elidlule)×100. Uma abakhiqizi abayinhloko bekhiqiza i-1600 kcal/m2, kanti abathengi abayinhloko bane-900 kcal/m2, iyini ukusebenza kahle kokudluliselwa kwezinga le-trophic?
question47: Kunezigaba ezine ze-trophic ochungechungeni lokudla kanti inani lamandla ezingeni le-trophic lomkhiqizi oyinhloko lingu-33,000 kcal/m2. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okumele inani lamandla lomthengi wesithathu?
question48: Bheka uMfanekiso 37.34. Kungani lesi sibalo sibonisa inani eliphakeme lokukhiqiza okuphelele kwababolayo kunabathengi besithathu?
answer48: Ngoba abathengi besithathu basebenzisa abathengi besibili kuphela kuyilapho ababolayo besebenzisa izingxenye ezifile zezinga ngalinye le-trophic
distractor48a: Ngenxa yomehluko ekusebenzeni kahle kokuguqulwa kwama-decompolser kanye nabathengi be-tertiary
distractor48b: Ngoba izilwane ezinkulu ziyizidli eziphezulu kanti izinto ezincane eziphilayo ziyizinto ezibolayo
distractor48c: Ngoba abathengi besithathu basebenzisa abathengi bokuqala kuphela kuyilapho ababolayo besebenzisa izingxenye ezifile zezinga ngalinye le-trophic
question49: Enye yezinto ezibalulekile ezikhathazayo ngokushintsha kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni wonke inani elikhulu lekhabhoni elikhishwa emoyeni. Nokho, kunezindlela ezithile ikhabhoni engasuswa ngazo emoyeni. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyinqubo yemvelo ekhuthaza ukuthuthwa kwekhabhoni?

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo kanye Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent: Ngawo-1980, izazi zezinto eziphilayo ezazisebenza eLake Victoria e-Afrika zathola omunye wemikhiqizo engavamile kakhulu yokuziphendukela kwemvelo emhlabeni. Itholakala eGreat Rift Valley, iLake Victoria iyichibi elikhulu elingaba ngu-68,900 km2 endaweni (elikhulu kuneLake Huron, elingelesibili ngobukhulu eGreat Lakes eNyakatho Melika). Izazi zezinto eziphilayo zazicwaninga ngezinhlobo zomndeni wezinhlanzi ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-cichlid. Zathola ukuthi njengoba zazihlola izinhlanzi ezindaweni ezahlukene zechibi, azizange ziyeke ukuthola izinhlobo ezintsha, futhi zathola cishe izinhlobo ezingama-500 zama-cichlid eziguqukile. Kodwa ngenkathi zifunda lezi zinhlobo, zasheshe zathola ukuthi i-Nile Perch ehlaselayo yayibhubhisa inani lama-cichlid echibini, iletha amakhulu ezinhlobo zama-cichlid ekuqothulweni ngokushesha okukhulu.

answer1: IGreat Rift Valley e-Afrika
question2: Cishe likhulu kangakanani iLake Victoria?
answer2: Cishe amakhilomitha angu-68,900
question3: Yimuphi umndeni wezinhlanzi owawufundwa yizazi zezinto eziphilayo eLake Victoria?
answer3: Ama-Cichlid
question4: Cishe zingaki izinhlobo zama-cichlid eziguqukile ezatholakala eLake Victoria?
answer4: Cishe ama-500
question5: Kungani iLake Victoria yayibhekwa njengesibonelo esingavamile sokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer5: Izazi zezinto eziphilayo ziyaqhubeka zithola izinhlobo ezintsha ze-cichlid ezazivele ngaphakathi kwechibi
distractor5a: Yayiqukethe izinhlanzi zasemanzini kuphela emhlabeni wonke
distractor5b: Zonke izinhlobo zezinhlanzi echibini zazifana ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question6: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezihlaselayo ezazisongela inani lama-cichlid eLake Victoria?
answer6: I-Nail Perch
question7: Yayiyini ithonya elikhulu le-Nile Perch eLake Victoria?
answer7: Kwaholela amakhulu ezinhlobo ze-cichlid ekuqothulweni
question8: Kungani isibonelo seLake Victoria sibalulekile kubhayoloji yokulondolozwa kwemvelo?
answer8: Kubonisa ukuthi uhlobo oluhlaselayo lunganciphisa kanjani ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo ngokushesha futhi lubangele ukuqothulwa kwezinhlobo eziphilayo.
distractor8a: Kubonisa ukuthi izinhlobo ezihlaselayo zihlala zandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor8b: Kubonisa ukuthi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuyaphela lapho kungeniswa izilwane ezidla ezinye
distractor8c: Kufakazela ukuthi izindawo zemvelo zamanzi ahlanzekile azithinteki yizinhlobo ezihlaselayo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Bheka uMfanekiso 38.1. Sifike esahlukweni sokugcina embhalweni, futhi lolu hambo lusisuse ekuqalweni kokuphila eMhlabeni saya ekuhloleni izinto eziphilayo eziningi nezihlukahlukene ezihlala eplanethini yethu njengamanje. Nakuba ulwazi oluthile kulesi sahluko lungekho emkhakheni we-AP®, kumelwe siqaphele ukuthi imisebenzi yezinhlobo zethu, ama-Home sapiens, ithinta kanjani imvelo kanye nezinhlobo ezihlala kuzo. Ngokwazisa nokuvikela ezinye izinhlobo, silondoloza ezethu. Okuphambene nakho kuyiqiniso.

 Inani eliqondile nezinhlobo zezinhlobo eMhlabeni alaziwa, kodwa ososayensi balinganisela ukuthi kunezinhlobo ze-eukaryotic ezingaba yizigidi ezingu-8.7, kanti eziyizigidi ezingu-1.5 kuphela ezitholiwe, eziqanjwe ngamagama, futhi ezifundwe. Inani lama-prokaryotes lidlula kakhulu lezi zinombolo. I-Biodiversity ichaza inani kanye nokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo ku-biosphere.

 Sifunde ukuthi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nokwahlukahluka kuyaqhubeka nokwenzeka, kodwa uMhlaba ubhekane nokuqothulwa okukhulu okuhlanu—ukuqedwa kwamaqembu amakhulu ezinhlobo. Ku-AP® awudingi ukwazi amagama, izinsuku kanye nezimbangela zalokhu kuqothulwa; nokho ukuqonda kuzokusiza uqonde ukuthi ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kushintshe kanjani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 kanye no-Big Idea 4 woHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi olusekelwe ebholeni lokucwaninga, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 1
Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka kanye nobunye bokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.C
Ukuphila kuyaqhubeka nokuguquka ngaphakathi kwendawo eshintshayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.C.1 Ukuzikhethela kanye nokuqothulwa kuye kwenzeka kuwo wonke umlando woMhlaba.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
5.1 Umfundi angahlaziya idatha ukuze abone amaphethini noma ubudlelwano.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.20 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuhlaziya idatha ehlobene nemibuzo yokwakheka kanye nokuphela kwayo kulo lonke umlando woMhlaba.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.C.1 Ukwakheka kanye nokuphela kwayo kuye kwenzeka kulo lonke umlando woMhlaba.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
4.2 Umfundi angaklama uhlelo lokuqoqa idatha ukuze aphendule umbuzo othile wesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.21 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuklama uhlelo lokuqoqa idatha ukuze aphenye isimangalo sesayensi sokuthi ukwakheka kanye nokuphela kwayo kuye kwenzeka kulo lonke umlando woMhlaba.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.B
Ukuncintisana nokubambisana kuyizinto ezibalulekile zezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.B.4 Ukusatshalaliswa kwezindawo zemvelo zasendaweni nezasemhlabeni wonke kuyashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.3 Umfundi angachaza izizathu zokuthi izincazelo zesayensi kanye nemibono kuhlungwa noma kuthathelwe indawo.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.20 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuthi ukusatshalaliswa kwezindawo zemvelo kushintsha kanjani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngokuhlonza izehlakalo ezinkulu eziye zabangela lezi zinguquko esikhathini esidlule.

 Ngokwesiko, izazi zemvelo ziye zalinganisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo ngokubheka kokubili inani lezinhlobo kanye nokufana kwazo. Ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kungalinganiselwa emazingeni amaningana okuhlela izinto eziphilayo. Lezi zinkomba zokulinganisa, ezivela ku-information theory, ziwusizo kakhulu njengesinyathelo sokuqala sokulinganisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo phakathi nangaphakathi kwezindawo zemvelo; azisizi kangako lapho ukukhathazeka okukhulu phakathi kwezazi zesayensi yokulondolozwa kwemvelo kungukulahlekelwa nje kokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo. Kodwa-ke, izazi zezinto eziphilayo ziyaqaphela ukuthi izindlela zokulinganisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo, maqondana nokuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo, zingasiza ekugxiliseni imizamo yokulondoloza izinto ezibalulekile eziphilayo noma kwezobuchwepheshe zokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo.

 Ama-cichlid aseLake Victoria anikeza isibonelo esingaqala ngaso ukuqonda ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo. Izazi zezinto eziphilayo ezifunda ama-cichlid ngawo-1980 zathola amakhulu ezinhlobo zama-cichlid ezimele ukukhethekile okuhlukahlukene ezinhlotsheni ezithile zendawo yokuhlala kanye namasu athile okuphakela: ukudla i-plankton entanta emanzini, ukuklwebha bese kudla ulwelwe emadwaleni, ukudla izibungu zezinambuzane kusukela phansi, nokudla amaqanda ezinye izinhlobo zama-cichlid. Ama-cichlid aseLake Victoria angumkhiqizo wokukhanya okuguquguqukayo. Ukukhanya okuguquguqukayo kuyindlela esheshayo (engaphansi kweminyaka eyizigidi ezintathu uma kukhulunywa ngama-cichlid aseLake Victoria) ekhula ngokuhlukaniswa kwesihlahla se-phylogenetic sibe izinhlobo eziningi ezihlobene eduze; ngokuvamile, lezi zinhlobo ziyaphuma ziye ezindaweni zokuhlala nasezindaweni ezihlukene. Ama-finch aseGalápagos ayisibonelo semisebe eguquguqukayo ephansi enezinhlobo ezingu-15. Ama-cichlid aseLake Victoria ayisibonelo semisebe eguquguqukayo emangalisayo ehlanganisa izinhlobo ezingaba ngu-500.

 Ngesikhathi izazi zezinto eziphilayo zenza lokhu kuthola, ezinye izinhlobo zaqala ukunyamalala ngokushesha. Imbangela yalokhu kwehla kwakuyizinhlobo zezinhlanzi ezinkulu ezalethwa eLake Victoria ngokudoba ukuze zondle abantu abahlala eduze kwechibi. I-Nile perch yethulwa ngo-1963, kodwa yahlala phansi kwaze kwaba ngawo-1980 lapho inani lazo liqala ukwanda. Inani lama-perch aseNayile landa ngokudla ama-cichlid, liqhuba izinhlobo ngezinhlobo kwaze kwaba sezingeni lokuphela (ukunyamalala kohlobo). Eqinisweni, kwakunezici eziningana ezadlala indima ekuqothulweni kwezinhlobo zama-cichlid ezingaba ngu-200 eLake Victoria: i-Nile perch, ukwehla kwekhwalithi yamanzi echibini ngenxa yezolimo kanye nokuhlanzwa komhlaba ogwini lweLake Victoria, kanye nokwanda kwengcindezi yokudoba. Ososayensi babengakabhalisi ngisho nazo zonke izinhlobo ezazikhona—eziningi zazikhona ezilahlekile ezingakaze zibizwe ngamagama. Ukuhlukahluka manje sekuyisithunzi salokho okwakuyikho ngaphambili.

 Ama-cichlid aseLake Victoria ayisithombe esincane sokulahleka kwezinhlobo zesimanje okusheshayo okwenzeka emhlabeni wonke futhi kubangelwa imisebenzi yabantu. Ukuqothulwa kuyinqubo yemvelo yokuguquka okukhulu okwenzeka ngesilinganiso sokuthi cishe uhlobo olulodwa kweziyisigidi luphele ngonyaka. Umlando wezinsalela uveza ukuthi kube nezinkathi ezinhlanu zokuqothulwa okukhulu emlandweni ngezilinganiso eziphakeme kakhulu zokulahlekelwa kwezinhlobo, futhi izinga lokulahlekelwa kwezinhlobo namuhla lifana nalezo zikhathi zokuqothulwa okukhulu. Kodwa-ke, kunomehluko omkhulu phakathi kokuqothulwa okukhulu kwangaphambilini kanye nokuqothulwa kwamanje esikubonayo: imisebenzi yabantu. Ngokukhethekile, imisebenzi emithathu yabantu inomthelela omkhulu: ukubhujiswa kwendawo yokuhlala, ukungeniswa kwezinhlobo ezingavamile, kanye nokuvunwa ngokweqile. Izibikezelo zokulahlekelwa kwezinhlobo phakathi nekhulu leminyaka elizayo, isikhathi esincane esikalini se-geological, zisukela kumaphesenti ayi-10 kuya kwangama-50. Ukuqothulwa kwalesi silinganiso kwenzeke izikhathi ezinhlanu kuphela emlandweni weplanethi, futhi kubangelwe yizehlakalo ezinkulu ezashintsha indlela ngomlando wokuphila kuzo zonke izimo. Umhlaba manje usesikhathini salezo zikhathi

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Izinhlobo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Izinhlobo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo
chapterContent:
Ososayensi ngokuvamile bayakwamukela ukuthi igama elithi ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo lichaza inani nezinhlobo zezinhlobo endaweni noma emhlabeni. Izinhlobo kungaba nzima ukuzichaza, kodwa iningi lezazi zezinto eziphilayo lisazizwa likhululekile ngalo mqondo futhi liyakwazi ukubona nokubala izinhlobo ze-eukaryotic ezimweni eziningi. Izazi zezinto eziphilayo ziphinde zathola izindlela ezihlukile zokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo, ezinye zazo ezibalulekile ekuhleleni indlela yokulondoloza ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo.

 Ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kungenye yalezo zindlela ezihlukile. Ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo noma ukuhlukahluka kuyizinto zokusetshenziswa zokuzivumelanisa nezimo ohlotsheni oluthile. Amandla esikhathi esizayo ezinhlobo zokuzivumelanisa nezimo ancike ekuhlukeni kwezakhi zofuzo okugcinwe kuma-genome abantu ngabanye kubantu abakha izinhlobo. Kunjalo nangezigaba eziphakeme ze-taxonomic. Uhlobo olunezinhlobo ezahlukene kakhulu zezinhlobo luzoba nokuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo okuningi kunohlobo olunezinhlobo ezibukeka zifana futhi ezine-ecology efanayo. Uma bekukhona ukukhetha phakathi kolunye lwalezi zinhlobo zezinhlobo olugcinwayo, olunamandla amakhulu okuziphendukela kwemvelo okulandelayo yilona oluhlukahlukene kakhulu kwezakhi zofuzo. Kungaba kuhle ukungadingi ukwenza izinqumo ezinjalo, kodwa ngokuqhubekayo lokhu kungaba yinto evamile.

 Izakhi zofuzo eziningi zibhala amaprotheni, wona enza izinqubo ze-metabolic ezigcina izinto eziphilayo ziphila futhi zizalana. Ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kungalinganiswa njengokuhlukahluka kwamakhemikhali ngoba izinhlobo ezahlukene zikhiqiza amakhemikhali ahlukahlukene emaseli azo, kokubili amaprotheni kanye nemikhiqizo kanye nemikhiqizo ye-metabolism. Lokhu kuhlukahluka kwamakhemikhali kunenzuzo engaba khona kubantu njengomthombo wemithi, ngakho-ke kunikeza indlela eyodwa yokulinganisa ukuhlukahluka okubalulekile empilweni nasenhlalakahleni yabantu.

 Abantu bakhiqize ukuhlukahluka ezilwaneni zasekhaya, ezitshalweni, kanye nefungi. Lokhu kuhlukahluka nakho kulahlekelwa ngenxa yokufuduka, amandla emakethe, kanye nokwanda kwembulunga yonke kwezolimo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinabantu abaningi njengeShayina, iNdiya, neJapan. Inani labantu lithembele ngqo kulokhu kuhlukahluka njengomthombo wokudla ozinzile, futhi ukwehla kwalo kuyakhathaza izazi zezinto eziphilayo kanye nososayensi bezolimo.

 Kuwusizo futhi ukuchaza ukuhlukahluka kwe-ecosystem, okusho inani le-ecosystem ezahlukene emhlabeni noma endaweni ethile yezwe (Isithombe 38.2). I-ecosystem yonke inganyamalala noma ezinye zezinhlobo zingasinda ngokuzivumelanisa nezinye i-ecosystem. Ukulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala kusho ukulahlekelwa ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlobo, ukulahlekelwa izici eziyingqayizivele zokuzivumelanisa nezimo, kanye nokulahlekelwa umkhiqizo wezinto eziphilayo okwenziwa yindawo yokuhlala yokuhlala. Isibonelo sendawo yokuhlala yokuhlala engapheli eNyakatho Melika yindawo yokuhlala yasezindaweni zasemakhaya. Izindawo zokuhlala zasezindaweni zasemakhaya zazisakazeke eNyakatho Melika ephakathi kusukela ehlathini laseBoreal enyakatho yeKhanada ziye eMexico. Manje seziphelile, zathathelwa indawo amasimu okutshala, amadlelo, kanye nokwanda kwezindawo zasemadolobheni. Eziningi zezinhlobo ziyasinda, kodwa indawo yokuhlala ekhiqiza kakhulu eyayinesibopho sokudala inhlabathi yezolimo ekhiqiza kakhulu isiphelile manje. Ngenxa yalokho, inhlabathi iyanyamalala noma kumele inakekelwe ngezindleko ezinkulu.
question1: Kuchaza ukuthini ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo ngokuvamile?
answer1: Inani nezinhlobo zezinhlobo endaweni ethile noma eMhlabeni
question2: Kuyini ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer2: Ukwehlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ngaphakathi kohlobo oluthile oluhlinzeka ngezinto zokusetshenziswa ukuze zivumelane nezimo
distractor2b: Izinhlobonhlobo zezindawo zokuhlala ezihlalwa uhlobo oluthile
question3: Kungani ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kubalulekile ohlotsheni oluthile?
answer3: Inquma amandla ezinhlobo zokuzivumelanisa nezimo ezishintshayo
distractor3b: Kuvimbela ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ukuthi kungenzeki
question4: Uma abalondolozi bemvelo bekufanele bakhethe phakathi kokulondoloza izinhlobo ezimbili, yiziphi ngokuvamile ezaziyoba namandla amakhulu okuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer4: Uhlobo olunezinhlobonhlobo ezinkulu kakhulu zofuzo
question5: Ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kungalinganiswa kanjani futhi?
answer5: Ngokuhlukahluka kwamakhemikhali kwamaprotheni kanye nemikhiqizo ye-metabolic ekhiqizwa izinto eziphilayo
distractor5a: Ngenani lezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane endaweni ezungezile
question6: Kungani ukuhlukahluka kwamakhemikhali kubalulekile kubantu?
answer6: Ihlinzeka ngemithombo engaba khona yemithi kanye nezinye izinto ezizuzisayo amakhilogremu
distractor6b: Kuvimbela ukushabalala kwazo zonke izinhlobo zezilwane
question7: Kungani izazi zezinto eziphilayo zikhathazekile ngokulahlekelwa ukuhlukahluka kwezitshalo ezifuywayo, izilwane kanye nesikhunta?
answer7: Ukuvikeleka kokudla kwabantu kuncike ekulondolozeni lokhu kuhlukahluka
question8: Kuyini ukuhlukahluka kwezindawo zemvelo?
answer8: Inani lezindawo ezahlukene zemvelo endaweni ethile noma emhlabeni
distractor8a: Inani lezinhlobo ngaphakathi kwesimiso semvelo esisodwa
distractor8b: Inani lokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo ngaphakathi kwesibalo sabantu
question9: Kungani ukulahlekelwa yisimiso sezinto eziphilayo kubaluleke kakhulu?
answer9: Kubangela ukulahlekelwa kokuxhumana kwezinhlobo, ukuzivumelanisa nezimo, kanye nokukhiqiza kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor9a: Zonke izinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ngaphakathi kwesimiso sezinto eziphilayo ziyanyamalala ngokushesha
question10: Yisiphi isibonelo semvelo esiphelelwe kakhulu eNyakatho Melika?
answer10: I-ecosystem yasezintabeni

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Izinhlobo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinhlobo Zamanje
chapterContent:
Naphezu komzamo omkhulu, ulwazi ngezinhlobo ezihlala kule planethi lulinganiselwe. Isilinganiso sakamuva sibonisa ukuthi izinhlobo ze-eukaryote isayensi enamagama azo, cishe izinhlobo eziyizigidi ezingu-1.5, zingaphansi kwamaphesenti angama-20 enani lilonke lezinhlobo ze-eukaryote ezikhona kule planethi (izinhlobo eziyizigidi ezingu-8.7, ngokulinganisa okukodwa). Izilinganiso zenani lezinhlobo ze-prokaryotic ziyizibikezelo eziningi, kodwa izazi zezinto eziphilayo ziyavuma ukuthi isayensi isiqalile nje ukuklebhula ukuhlukahluka kwazo. Ngisho nalokho okwaziwayo, akukho ndawo yokugcina amagama noma amasampula ezinhlobo ezichazwe; ngakho-ke, ayikho indlela yokuqiniseka ukuthi izincazelo eziyizigidi ezingu-1.5 ziyinombolo enembile. Kuyisilinganiso esihle kakhulu esisekelwe emibonweni yochwepheshe emaqenjini ahlukene e-taxonomic. Njengoba uMhlaba ulahlekelwa izinhlobo ngesivinini esisheshayo, isayensi isendaweni eyayikuyo nama-cichlid aseLake Victoria: azi okuncane ngalokho okulahlekayo. Ithebula Izilinganiso Zezinombolo Zezinhlobo Ezichazwe Nezibikezelwe yi-Taxonomic Group ngezansi liveza izilinganiso zamuva zezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo emaqenjini ahlukene.

 Kunezinhlelo ezahlukahlukene zokubhala uhlu lwezinhlobo ezichazwe ngezindlela ezifinyelelekayo, futhi i-inthanethi iyenza kube lula lowo mzamo. Noma kunjalo, kuye kwavezwa ukuthi ngesilinganiso samanje sencazelo yezinhlobo, okuthi ngokusho koMbiko Wezinhlobo Eziqashelwayo ziyizinhlobo ezintsha ezingu-17,000 kuya ku-20,000 ngonyaka, kuzothatha cishe iminyaka engu-500 ukuqeda ukuchaza impilo kule planethi.4 Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umsebenzi uba nzima kakhulu futhi uba lula njengoba ukuqothulwa kususa izinhlobo kule planethi.

 Ukuqamba nokubala izinhlobo kungase kubonakale kuyinto engabalulekile uma ubheka ezinye izidingo zesintu, kodwa akuyona nje indlela yokubala. Ukuchaza izinhlobo kuyinqubo eyinkimbinkimbi lapho izazi zezinto eziphilayo zinquma khona izici ezihlukile zezinto eziphilayo nokuthi ngabe lezo zinto eziphilayo zingezolunye uhlobo oluchazwe noma cha. Kuvumela izazi zezinto eziphilayo ukuthola nokuqaphela uhlobo ngemva kokutholwa kokuqala, futhi kubavumela ukuthi balandelele imibuzo mayelana ne-biology yalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izici ezihlukile zohlobo ngalunye zikwenza kube yigugu kubantu noma kwezinye izinhlobo abantu abathembele kuzo. Ukuqonda lezi zici kuyinzuzo yokuthola nokuqamba izinhlobo.
question1: Cishe zingaki izinhlobo ze-eukaryotic eziqanjwe ngokusemthethweni yisayensi?
answer1: Izinhlobo ezingaba yizigidi ezingu-1.5
question2: Cishe yimaphi amaphesenti ezinhlobo ze-eukaryotic ezilinganiselwa eMhlabeni ezichazwe?
answer2: Ngaphansi kwamaphesenti angama-20
question3: Kungani izilinganiso zezinhlobo ze-prokaryotic zingaqinisekile kakhulu?
answer3: Ososayensi basanda kuqala ukuqoqa izinhlobo zabo ezahlukene
question4: Kungani inani elibikiwe lezinhlobo ezichazwe libhekwa njengesilinganiso esingcono kakhulu kunokuba inani eliqondile?
answer4: Ayikho indawo yokugcina eyodwa equkethe zonke izinhlobo ezichazwe kanye namagama azo
distractor4c: Zonke izinhlobo zinegama lesayensi elisemthethweni eliningi
question5: Ngokwesilinganiso samanje sokutholakala kwezinhlobo, cishe kungathatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuchaza konke ukuphila eMhlabeni?
answer5: Cishe iminyaka engu-500
question6: Cishe zingaki izinhlobo ezintsha ezichazwa minyaka yonke ngokusho kombiko we-State of Observed Species Report?
answer6: Izinhlobo ezingaba ngu-17,000 kuya ku-20,000
question7: Kungani ukuchaza nokuqamba izinhlobo kubalulekile?
answer7: Ivumela ososayensi ukuthi baqaphele izinhlobo zezilwane, bafunde i-biology yazo, futhi babone inani lazo elingaba khona
distractor7a: Kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlobo zezilwane azikwazi ukuphela
question8: Kungani umsebenzi wokubhala uhlu lwezinto eziphilayo emhlabeni uba nzima ngokwengeziwe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
answer8: Izinhlobo ziyalahleka ngokuqothulwa kanti eziningi azikatholakali
distractor8a: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuyekile ukukhiqiza izinhlobo ezintsha zezilwane
question9: Ngokwezilinganiso zezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo eziboniswe etafuleni, yimuphi umbuso oqukethe inani elikhulu kakhulu lezinhlobo ezibikezelwe?
answer9: Izilwane

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Izinhlobo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Amaphethini Okuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Izinhlobo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Amaphethini Okuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo
chapterContent:
Ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo akusatshalaliswa ngokulinganayo eMhlabeni. ILake Victoria yayinezinhlobo ezingaba ngu-500 zama-cichlid zodwa, inganaki eminye imindeni yezinhlanzi ekhona echibini. Zonke lezi zinhlobo zatholakala eLake Victoria kuphela; ngakho-ke, izinhlobo ezingu-500 zama-cichlid zazihlala zinjalo. Izinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo zitholakala endaweni eyodwa kuphela. Izinto eziphilayo ezinokusatshalaliswa okulinganiselwe kakhulu zisengozini yokuqothulwa. Amazinga aphezulu e-taxonomic, njengezizukulwane nemindeni, nazo zingaba khona zinjalo. ILake Huron iqukethe izinhlobo zezinhlanzi ezingaba ngu-79, zonke ezitholakala kwamanye amachibi amaningi eNyakatho Melika. Yini ebangela umehluko ekuhlukeni kwezinhlanzi kula machibi amabili? ILake Victoria iyichibi elishisayo, kanti iLake Huron iyichibi elinomoya opholile. ILake Huron ngesimo sayo samanje ineminyaka engaba ngu-7,000 kuphela ubudala, kanti iLake Victoria ngesimo sayo samanje ineminyaka engaba ngu-15,000 ubudala. Izazi ze-biogeografi ziphakamise ukuthi lezi zici ezimbili, i-latitude kanye nobudala, ziyizimbili zezinkolelo-mbono eziningana zokuchaza amaphethini okuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo emhlabeni.

 Enye yamaphethini amadala kakhulu abonwayo ku-ecology ukuthi ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo cishe kuzo zonke izinhlobo ze-taxonomic kuyanda njengoba i-latitude incipha. Ngamanye amazwi, ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo kuyanda eduze kwe-equator (Isithombe 38.3).

 Akukacaci okwamanje ukuthi kungani ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo ze ... Kodwa-ke, lo mbono unenkinga yokujikeleza okuthile—izinhlelo zemvelo ezinezinhlobo eziningi zikhuthaza ukwakheka kwezinhlobo, kodwa zaqala kanjani ukuthola izinhlobo eziningi? Izindawo ezishisayo ziye zabonwa njengezizinzile kunezindawo ezinesimo sezulu esishisayo, ezinesimo sezulu esicacile kanye nokwakheka kwesizini emini. Izindawo ezishisayo zinezinhlobo zazo zokwakheka kwezinhlobo, njengemvula, kodwa ngokuvamile zicatshangwa ukuthi ziyindawo ezizinzile futhi lokhu kuzinza kungase kukhuthaze ukwakheka kwezinhlobo.

 Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yiziphi izindlela, kuyiqiniso ukuthi wonke amazinga okuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo aphezulu kakhulu ezindaweni ezishisayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinga lokusabalala kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo liphezulu kakhulu, futhi kunezindawo eziningi ezishisayo zezinto eziphilayo. Kodwa-ke, lokhu kuceba kokuhlukahluka kusho nokuthi ulwazi lwezinhlobo luphansi kakhulu, futhi kunethuba elikhulu lokulahlekelwa kwezinto eziphilayo.
question1: Luyini uhlobo olutholakala kalula?
answer1: Uhlobo olutholakala endaweni eyodwa kuphela
question2: Kungani izinhlobo ezitholakala ezindaweni ezithile ezisabalala kakhulu zisengozini enkulu?
answer2: Zisengozini enkulu yokuqothulwa ngoba zenzeka endaweni eyodwa kuphela
question3: Yiliphi ichibi elalinezinhlobo ze-cichlid ezingaba ngu-500 ezitholakala endaweni ethile?
answer3: ILake Victoria
question4: Cishe zingaki izinhlobo zezinhlanzi ezitholakala eLake Huron?
answer4: Cishe izinhlobo ezingu-79
question5: Yiziphi izici ezimbili izazi ze-biogeografi eziye zasikisela ukuthi zisize ukuchaza umehluko phakathi kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo phakathi kweLake Victoria neLake Huron?
answer5: I-Latitude kanye nobudala
question6: Kungani ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo kungaba kukhulu ezindaweni ezishisayo kunasezindaweni ezinesimo sezulu esipholile?
answer6: Izindawo zemvelo zasezindaweni ezishisayo sezindala, zithola amandla elanga amaningi, futhi ziqukethe izindawo zemvelo eziningi.
distractor6a: Izindawo zemvelo ezifudumele zithola ukukhanya kwelanga okwengeziwe unyaka wonke
distractor6b: Izindawo zemvelo zasezindaweni ezishisayo zinezindlela ezimbalwa zokuxhumana kwemvelo
distractor6c: I-Speciation yenzeka kuphela ezindaweni zemvelo ezishisayo
question7: Kuyini ukungafani kwemvelo?
answer7: Ukuba khona kwezindawo eziningi ezahlukene zemvelo ngaphakathi kwe-ecosystem
distractor7a: Inani lezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane endaweni ezungezile
distractor7c: Ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ngaphakathi kohlobo olulodwa
question8: Kungani ukungafani okukhulu kwemvelo kungase kukhuthaze ukukhethekile?
answer8: Inikeza amathuba engeziwe ochwepheshe, ukuguquka kwesimo semvelo, kanye nokwehlukaniswa kwabantu
distractor8b: Kunciphisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwabantu
question9: Kukuphi lapho ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nokusabalala kwazo ngokuvamile kuphezulu khona?
answer9: Izindawo ezishisayo
question10: Kungani izindawo ezishisayo zibaluleke kakhulu kwibhayoloji yokulondolozwa kwemvelo?
answer10: Ziqukethe ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kakhulu kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nokusabalala kwazo kodwa futhi zinamandla amakhulu okulahlekelwa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo.
distractor10a: Ziqukethe izinhlobo ezimbalwa kakhulu ezitholakala endaweni eyodwa
distractor10c: Ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo sekuye kwabhalwa phansi ngokuphelele lapho
question11: Enye yezindlela ezindala kakhulu ezibonwayo emvelweni ukuthi ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo kuyanda njengoba i-latitude incipha. Kusho ukuthini lokhu?
answer11: Ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo kuyanda eduze kwenkabazwe
distractor11a: Ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezilwane kuyanda eduze kwezinsika
distractor11b: Ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo kuyafana kuzo zonke izindawo ezikude
question12: Yisiphi isifunda soMhlaba esivame ukuba nezinhlobo eziningi kakhulu zezinhlobo eziphilayo?
question13: Ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezilwane ngokuvamile kushintsha kanjani njengoba ububanzi bezindawo bukhula kude ne-equator?
question14: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono i-latitudinal diversity gradient?
answer14: Ukuceba kwezinhlobo ngokuvamile kuyanda kusukela ezimpondweni kuya enkabazwe
distractor14a: Ukuceba kwezinhlobo ngokuvamile kuyanda kusukela enkabazwe kuya ezindaweni eziphansi
distractor14c: Ukuceba kwezinhlobo zezitshalo kukhulu kakhulu ezindaweni eziphakathi nendawo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | Izinhlobo Zokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | Ukulondolozwa Kokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | Izinhlobo Zokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | Ukulondolozwa Kokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo
chapterContent: Ngo-1988, isazi sezemvelo saseBrithani uNorman Myers sakha umqondo wokulondolozwa kwemvelo ukuze sithole izindawo ezicebile ngezinhlobo nezingozi ezinkulu zokulahlekelwa izinhlobo: izindawo ezishisayo zezinto eziphilayo. Izindawo ezishisayo zezinto eziphilayo ziyizindawo zezwe eziqukethe inani elikhulu lezinhlobo ezitholakala kalula. Inhloso yalo mqondo kwakuwukukhomba izindawo ezibalulekile emhlabeni ukuze kwenziwe imizamo yokulondolozwa kwemvelo, uhlobo lokuhlola izindawo ezishisayo. Ngokuvikela izindawo ezishisayo, ohulumeni bayakwazi ukuvikela inani elikhulu lezinhlobo. Izindlela zokuqala zezindawo ezishisayo zazihlanganisa ukuba khona kwezinhlobo zezitshalo ezitholakala kalula ezingu-1500 noma ngaphezulu kanye namaphesenti angu-70 endawo aphazanyiswa imisebenzi yabantu. Manje kunezindawo ezishisayo zezinto eziphilayo ezingu-34 (Isithombe 38.4) eziqukethe inani elikhulu lezinhlobo ezitholakala kalula, ezihlanganisa ingxenye yezitshalo ezitholakala kalula eMhlabeni.
question1: Iyini indawo ethandwa kakhulu yizinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Indawo equkethe inani elikhulu lezinhlobo ezitholakala endaweni ethile ezisengozini enkulu yokulahlekelwa yizinhlobo
distractor1a: Isifunda esinenani elikhulu kakhulu lezinhlobo ezihlaselayo
question2: Ubani owasungula umqondo wezindawo ezithandwa kakhulu yizinto eziphilayo?
answer2: UNorman Myers
question3: Umqondo wezindawo ezithandwa kakhulu yizinto eziphilayo wasungulwa nini?
question4: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko yokuhlonza izindawo ezithandwa kakhulu yizinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo?
answer4: Ukubeka phambili imizamo yokulondolozwa lapho bangavikela khona inani elikhulu kakhulu lezinhlobo
distractor4b: Ukuthola izindawo ezinobuningi babantu obuphezulu kakhulu
question5: Kungani indlela yokukhetha izindawo ezithandwa kakhulu ngokwezinto eziphilayo ibhekwa njengendlela yokulandelela imvelo?
answer5: Ibeka phambili ukuvikela izindawo ezibaluleke kakhulu ngokwebhayoloji lapho izinsiza zilinganiselwe
question6: Ngokwezindlela zokuqala, zingaki izinhlobo zezitshalo ezitholakala endaweni enezinto eziphilayo okufanele zibe nazo?
answer6: Izinhlobo zezitshalo eziyi-1,500 noma ngaphezulu ezitholakala endaweni eyodwa
distractor6a: Izinhlobo zezitshalo ezingama-500 noma ngaphezulu ezitholakala endaweni eyodwa
distractor6b: Izinhlobo zezitshalo ezitholakala endaweni eyodwa ezingu-5,000 noma ngaphezulu
distractor6c: Izinhlobo zezitshalo eziyi-150 noma ngaphezulu ezitholakala endaweni eyodwa
question7: Ngokwezindlela zokuqala, yiliphi iphesenti lendawo ethandwa kakhulu yizinto eziphilayo okumele ukuthi laphazanyiswa yimisebenzi yabantu?
answer7: Amaphesenti angu-70
question8: Cishe zingaki izindawo ezithandwa kakhulu yizinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo njengamanje?
question9: Cishe iyiphi ingxenye yezinhlobo zezitshalo ezitholakala eMhlabeni ezitholakala ezindaweni ezishisayo zezinto eziphilayo?
answer9: Cishe ingxenye
question10: Kungani ukuvikela izindawo ezishisayo zezinto eziphilayo kungalondoloza inani elikhulu lezinhlobo?
answer10: Ngoba izindawo ezishisayo ziqukethe izinhlobo eziningi ezitholakala kalula ezitholakala kwenye indawo
distractor10a: Ngoba izindawo ezishisayo ziqukethe izinhlobo ezisakazeke kabanzi kuphela
distractor10b: Ngoba izindawo ezishisayo zivimbela konke ukuvela kwemvelo
distractor10c: Ngoba izindawo ezishisayo azinazo iziphazamiso zabantu

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ushintsho Lwezinto Eziphilayo Ngesikhathi Se-Geological
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ushintsho Lwezinto Eziphilayo Ngesikhathi Se-Geological
chapterContent:
Inani lezinhlobo emhlabeni, noma kunoma iyiphi indawo, liwumphumela wokulingana kwezinqubo ezimbili zokuziphendukela kwemvelo eziqhubekayo: ukwakheka kanye nokuqothulwa. Zombili ziyizinqubo zokuzalwa kanye nokufa ngokwemvelo zokuguquka okukhulu. Lapho amazinga okwakheka kwezinhlobo eqala ukwedlula amazinga okuphela, inani lezinhlobo lizokhula; ngokufanayo, inani lezinhlobo lizokwehla lapho amazinga okuphela eqala ukwedlula amazinga okwakheka kwezinhlobo. Kuwo wonke umlando woMhlaba, lezi zinqubo ezimbili ziye zashintshashintsha—ngezinye izikhathi ziholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu enanini lezinhlobo eMhlabeni njengoba kuboniswe kurekhodi lezinsalela (Isithombe 38.5).

 Izazi ze-paleontologists zikhombe izigaba ezinhlanu kurekhodi lezinsalela ezibonakala zibonisa ukulahlekelwa okungazelelwe nokukhulu (phakathi kuka-25-55% wezinhlobo kanye nengxenye enkulu yazo zonke izinhlobo ezikhona ezinyamalala kurekhodi lezinsalela) ezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukuqothulwa okukhulu. Kunezigameko eziningi ezincane, kodwa ezisalokhu zinkulu, zokuqothulwa okukhulu, kodwa ukuqothulwa okukhulu okuhlanu kuye kwaheha ucwaningo oluningi. Kungenziwa impikiswano yokuthi ukuqothulwa okukhulu okuhlanu kuyizehlakalo ezinhlanu ezimbi kakhulu ochungechungeni oluqhubekayo lwezehlakalo ezinkulu zokuqothulwa kulo lonke iPhanerozoic (kusukela eminyakeni eyizigidi ezingu-542 edlule). Ezimweni eziningi, izimbangela ezicatshangelwayo zisaphikisana; nokho, isenzakalo sakamuva sibonakala sicacile.
question1: Yiziphi izinqubo ezimbili zokuziphendukela kwemvelo ezinquma inani lezinhlobo eMhlabeni ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
answer1: Ukuzikhethela kanye nokuphela
distractor1a: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokukhetha kwemvelo
question2: Kwenzekani uma izinga lokuzikhethela lidlula izinga lokuphela?
answer2: Inani lezinhlobo liyakhula
question3: Kwenzekani uma amazinga okuphela kwezilwane edlula amazinga okukhethwa kwezilwane?
answer3: Inani lezinhlobo liyancipha
question4: Yibuphi ubufakazi obusetshenziswa ososayensi ukutadisha izinguquko ezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo emlandweni woMhlaba?
answer4: Umlando wezinsalela
question5: Kuyini ukuqothulwa kwabantu abaningi?
answer5: Isikhathi lapho ingxenye enkulu yezinhlobo zeMhlaba inyamalala khona ngesikhathi esifushane kakhulu ngokwejiyoloji
distractor5c: Ukufuduka kwezinhlobo zezilwane kuya ezindaweni ezintsha zokuhlala
question6: Zingaki izazi ze-paleontologists eziye zathola ukuthi ziningi kangakanani izinsalela zokuqothulwa kwezinto eziphilayo?
answer6: Ezinhlanu
question7: Cishe yiliphi inani lezinhlobo ezikhona ezanyamalala ngesikhathi sokuphela okukhulu?
answer7: Ngaphezu kwengxenye
question8: Kusukela cishe nini i-Phanerozoic Eon yanda?
answer8: Eminyakeni engaba yizigidi ezingu-542 edlule
question9: Kungani inani lezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni lishintshashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
answer9: Ngoba amazinga okukhetha kanye nokuqothulwa ashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor9a: Ngoba ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuyayeka ngezikhathi ezithile
distractor9b: Ngoba zonke izimiso zemvelo zihlala zilingana
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo emlandweni woMhlaba?
answer10: Ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kuye kwashintsha ngokuphindaphindiwe njengoba amazinga okuhlukahluka kanye nokuqothulwa kwezilwane eshintshashintsha
distractor10a: Ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kuye kwanda njalo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka
distractor10b: Ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kuye kwahlala kungaguquki
distractor10c: Ukuphela bekulokhu kwenzeka ngesivinini esiphezulu kune-speciation

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ushintsho Lwezinto Eziphilayo Ngesikhathi Se-Geological | Ukuphela Kwezinto Ezinhlanu Eziningi
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ushintsho Lwezinto Eziphilayo Ngesikhathi Se-Geological | Ukuphela Kwezinto Ezinhlanu Eziningi
chapterContent:
Umlando wezinsalela zokuqothulwa kwenqwaba wawuyisisekelo sokuchaza izikhathi zomlando we-geological, ngakho-ke zivame ukwenzeka endaweni yokuguquka phakathi kwezinkathi ze-geological. Ukuguquka kwezinsalela kusukela kwesinye isikhathi kuya kwesinye kubonisa ukulahlekelwa okukhulu kwezinhlobo kanye nemvelaphi kancane kancane yezinhlobo ezintsha. Lokhu kuguquka kungabonakala esigabeni samadwala. Ithebula le-Mass Extinctions ngezansi linikeza idatha ngokuqothulwa kwenqwaba okuhlanu.

 Leli thebula libonisa amagama nezinsuku zokuqothulwa kwenqwaba okuhlanu emlandweni woMhlaba.

 Ukuqothulwa Kwenqwaba
Isikhathi Se-Geological
Igama Lokuqothulwa Kwenqwaba_____Isikhathi (izigidi zeminyaka edlule)

 Ordovician–Silurian
ukuphela-Ordovician O–S_____450–440

 I-Devonian Yasekupheleni
ukuphela-Devonian____375–360

 I-Permian–Triassic
ukuphela-kwe-Permian_____251

 I-Triassic–Jurassic
ukuphela-kwe-Triassic_____205

 I-Cretaceous–Paleogene
ukuphela-kwe-Cretaceous K–Pg (K–T)_____65.5

 Umcimbi wokuphela kwe-Ordovician-Silurian ungowokuqala ukubhalwa phansi ngobuningi futhi owesibili ngobukhulu. Phakathi nalesi sikhathi, cishe amaphesenti angama-85 ezinhlobo zasolwandle (izinhlobo ezimbalwa ezazihlala ngaphandle kolwandle) zaphela. Umbono oyinhloko wembangela yaso isikhathi seqhwa bese kuba ukufudumala. Umcimbi wokuphela empeleni uqukethe izehlakalo ezimbili zokuphela ezihlukaniswe cishe iminyaka eyisigidi. Umcimbi wokuqala wabangelwa ukupholisa, kanti owesibili wawubangelwa ukufudumala okulandelayo. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuthinte amazinga okushisa kanye namazinga olwandle. Abanye abacwaningi basikisele ukuthi ukuqhuma kwe-gamma-ray, okubangelwa yi-supernova eseduze, kuyimbangela engaba khona yokuqothulwa kwe-Ordovician-Silurian. Ukuqhuma kwe-gamma-ray ngabe kwasusa ungqimba lwe-ozone loMhlaba okubangele imisebe ye-ultraviolet enamandla evela elangeni futhi kungase kubangele izinguquko zesimo sezulu ezabonwa ngaleso sikhathi. Inkolelo-mbono iyingcingane, kodwa amathonya angaphandle komhlaba emlandweni woMhlaba ayindlela yocwaningo esebenzayo. Ukubuyiselwa kwezinto eziphilayo ngemva kokuqothulwa okukhulu kwathatha iminyaka eyizigidi ezi-5 kuya kwezingama-20, kuye ngendawo.

 Ukuqothulwa kwe-Devonian ngasekupheleni kungenzeka kwenzeke esikhathini eside. Kubonakala sengathi kuthinte izinhlobo zasolwandle hhayi izitshalo noma izilwane ezihlala ezindaweni zokuhlala zomhlaba. Phakathi nalesi sikhathi amaphesenti angama-75 azo zonke izinhlobo anyamalala. Izimbangela zalokhu kuqothulwa aziqondakali kahle.

 Ukuqothulwa kwe-Permian ekupheleni kwakuyinto enkulu kunazo zonke emlandweni wokuphila. Ngempela, kungenziwa impikiswano yokuthi uMhlaba cishe waphelelwa ukuphila ngesikhathi salesi senzakalo sokuqothulwa. Iplanethi yayibukeka ihluke kakhulu ngaphambi nangemva kwalesi senzakalo. Kulinganiselwa ukuthi amaphesenti angama-96 azo zonke izinhlobo zasolwandle kanye namaphesenti angama-70 azo zonke izinhlobo zasemhlabeni alahleka. Kwakungalesi sikhathi, isibonelo, lapho ama-trilobite, iqembu elasinda ekuqothulweni kwe-Ordovician-Silurian, aphela khona. Izimbangela zalokhu kuqothulwa okukhulu azicaci, kodwa okusolwa kakhulu umsebenzi wentaba-mlilo owande kakhulu owaholela emcimbini wokufudumala komhlaba wonke. Izilwandle zaba kakhulu yi-anoxydetic, eziqeda amandla okuphila kwasolwandle. Ukuhlukahluka kwe-tetrapod yomhlaba kwathatha iminyaka eyizigidi ezingama-30 ukululama ngemva kokuphela kwe-Permian. Ukuqothulwa kwe-Permian kwashintsha kakhulu ukwakheka kwezinto eziphilayo zoMhlaba kanye nenkambo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo.
