 Izimbangela zokuphela kwe-Triassic-Jurassic azicacile futhi imibono yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, umthelela we-asteroid, kanye nokuqhuma kwentaba-mlilo kuye kwaphikiswana ngayo. Ukuphela kwentaba-mlilo kwenzeka ngaphambi nje kokuhlukana kwe-supercontinent Pangea, yize ucwaningo lwamuva nje lubonisa ukuthi ukuqothulwa kwentaba-mlilo kungenzeka kwenzeke kancane kancane kulo lonke i-Triassic. Phakathi nalesi sikhathi amaphesenti angu-76 kuya kwangu-80 azo zonke izinhlobo anyamalala.

 Izimbangela zokuphela kwe-Cretaceous yizo eziqondakala kangcono. Kwakuphakathi nalesi senzakalo sokuphela eminyakeni engaba yizigidi ezingu-65 edlule lapho ama-dinosaur, iqembu lezilwane ezinomgogodla elivelele eminyakeni eyizigidi, anyamalala khona emhlabeni (ngaphandle kwe-theropod clade eyazala izinyoni). Sekukonke, phakathi nalesi sikhathi cishe amaphesenti angu-75 azo zonke izinhlobo anyamalala. Ngempela, zonke izilwane zasemhlabeni ezazinesisindo esingaphezu kwama-25 kg zanyamalala. Imbangela yalokhu kuqothulwa manje iqondwa njengomphumela womthelela omkhulu we-meteorite enkulu, noma i-asteroid, ogwini lwalokho manje okuyi-Yucatán Peninsula. Lo mbono, owaphakanyiswa okokuqala ngo-1980, wawuyincazelo ejulile esekelwe ekukhuphukeni okukhulu kwamazinga e-iridium (ena imvula isuka esikhaleni kuma-meteor ngesivinini esifanayo kodwa engekho ebusweni boMhlaba) endaweni yamadwala ephawula umngcele phakathi kwezikhathi zeCretaceous nePaleogene (Isithombe 38.6). Lo mngcele waphawula ukunyamalala kwama-dinosaur ezinsalela zasendulo kanye nezinye izinhlobo eziningi. Abacwaningi abathola i-iridium spike bayichaza njengokugeleza okusheshayo kwe-iridium kusuka esikhaleni kuya emkhathini (ngendlela ye-asteroid enkulu) kunokuba kube ukwehla kokubekwa kwezinsalela phakathi naleso sikhathi. Kwakuyincazelo ejulile, kodwa umbiko we-impact crater endala nesayizi efanele ngo-1991 wenza lo mbono wakholeka kakhudlwana. Manje ubufakazi obuningi be-geological busekela lo mbono. Izikhathi zokubuyiselwa kwezinto eziphilayo ngemva kokuphela kwe-Cretaceous zifushane, ngesikhathi se-geological, kunesikhathi sokuphela kwe-Permian, ngokulandelana kweminyaka eyizigidi eziyi-10.
question1: Zingaki izinsalela ezinkulu zokuqothulwa kwezilwane ezikhona emhlabeni eziye zatholakala emlandweni wezinsalela zoMhlaba?
answer1: Ezinhlanu
question2: Yisiphi isenzakalo emlandweni wezinsalela ezivame ukuphawula umngcele phakathi kwezinkathi zejiyoloji?
answer2: Ukuqothulwa okukhulu okulandelwa ukuvela kancane kancane kwezinhlobo ezintsha
question3: Yikuphi ukuqothulwa okukhulu okwakukhulu emlandweni woMhlaba?
answer3: Ukuphela kwePermian
question4: Iyini inkolelo-mbono ehamba phambili ngembangela yokuphela kwePermian?
answer4: Umsebenzi omkhulu wezintaba-mlilo oholela ekufudumaleni komhlaba kanye nolwandle olunobuthi
distractor4c: Ukuvela okusheshayo kwezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane
question5: Yikuphi ukuqothulwa okukhulu okuchazwe kangcono ngomthelela we-asteroid enkulu?
answer5: Ukuphela kwe-end-Cretaceous (K–Pg)
question6: Yibuphi ubufakazi obusekela ngokuqinile umbono womthelela we-asteroid wokuqothulwa kwe-Cretaceous kokuphela?
answer6: Ungqimba olucebile nge-iridium emhlabeni wonke kanye nokutholakala kwe-crater enkulu yomthelela eduze ne-Yucatán Peninsula
distractor6c: Ukwanda okungazelelwe kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo zasolwandle
question7: Yiliphi iqembu lezinto eziphilayo elanyamalala ngesikhathi sokuphela kwePermian ngemva kokusinda ekuqothulweni kwangaphambili kwe-Ordovician-Silurian?
answer7: Ama-Trilobite
question8: Yini okungenzeka ukuthi yayiyimbangela yezigaba ezimbili zokuqothulwa kwe-Ordovician-Silurian?
answer8: Isikhathi sokuqala sokupholisa silandelwa ukufudumala
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 38.6. Ososayensi balinganise ubuningi bezinhlamvu ze-fern ngaphezulu nangaphansi komngcele we-Cretaceous-Paleogene kusampula yedwala. Yisiphi kulezi zitatimende ezilandelayo okungenzeka ukuthi simele okutholakele kwabo?
answer9: Izinhlobo eziningi ze-fern spores zatholakala ngaphezulu nangaphansi komngcele, kodwa inani eliphelele le-spores lalilikhulu ngaphezu komngcele.
distractor9a: Kutholakale inqwaba yezinhlamvu ze-fern ezivela ezinhlotsheni eziningana ngaphezu komngcele we-Cretaceous-Paleogene, kodwa azikho ezitholakale ngezansi.
distractor9b: Ama-spores e-fern atholakale ngaphezulu nangaphansi komngcele we-Cretaceous-Paleogene, kodwa ama-spores ayeningi kakhulu ngaphansi komngcele kunangaphezu komngcele.
distractor9c: Inqwaba yezinhlamvu ze-fern ezivela ezinhlotsheni eziningana zatholakala ngaphansi komngcele we-Cretaceous-Paleogene, kodwa azikho ezitholakale ngenhla.
question10: Kungani ukuqothulwa kwezidalwa eziphilayo okubangelwa ukuqothulwa kwezidalwa eziphilayo kubhekwa njengokunye kokuqothulwa kwezidalwa eziphilayo okuqondwa kahle kakhulu?
answer10: Ubufakazi obuningi be-geological busekela umthelela we-asteroid njengembangela yawo eyinhloko
distractor10a: Ososayensi baqinisekisile ukuthi kubangelwe ukuguguleka kweqhwa emhlabeni jikelele
distractor10b: Yisona kuphela isenzakalo sokuphela esigcinwe emlandweni wezinsalela zasendulo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ushintsho Lwezinto Eziphilayo Ngesikhathi Se-Geological | Ukuphela Kwe-Pleistocene
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ushintsho Lwezinto Eziphilayo Ngesikhathi Se-Geological | Ukuphela Kwe-Pleistocene
chapterContent:
Ukuqothulwa kwePleistocene kungenye yezinhlobo ezincane zokuqothulwa, futhi muva nje. Kwaziwa kahle ukuthi iNyakatho Melika, kanye nezilwane ezinkulu zase-Eurasia, noma zase-megafauna, zanyamalala ngasekupheleni kwesikhathi sokugcina seqhwa. Kubonakala sengathi ukuqothulwa kwenzeke esikhathini esilinganiselwe seminyaka eyi-10,000-12,000 eyedlule. ENyakatho Melika, ukulahlekelwa kwakukhulu kakhulu futhi kwakuhlanganisa ama-woolly mammoth (okugcina angomhlaka-4,000 eyedlule kubantu abahlukene), ama-mastodon, ama-giant beaver, ama-giant ground sloths, amakati anamazinyo abukhali, kanye nekamela laseNyakatho Melika, ukubala nje ezimbalwa. Ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi ukuqothulwa okusheshayo kwalezi zilwane ezinkulu kwabangelwa ukuzingela ngokweqile kwaphakanyiswa okokuqala ngawo-1900. Ucwaningo ngalo mbono luyaqhubeka nanamuhla. Kubonakala sengathi ukuzingela ngokweqile kwabangela ukuqothulwa okuningi komlando okubhalwe kusengaphambili ezindaweni eziningi zomhlaba.

 Ngokuvamile, isikhathi sokuphela kwe-Pleistocene sihlobene nokufika kwabantu hhayi nezenzakalo zokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, okuwumqondo oyinhloko ophikisanayo walokhu kuqothulwa. Ukuqothulwa kwaqala e-Australia eminyakeni engaba ngu-40,000 kuya ku-50,000 eyedlule, ngemva nje kokufika kwabantu endaweni: ibhubesi le-marsupial, i-wombat enkulu yethani elilodwa, kanye nezinhlobo eziningana ezinkulu ze-kangaroo zanyamalala. ENyakatho Melika, ukuqothulwa cishe kwazo zonke izilwane ezinkulu ezincelisayo kwenzeka eminyakeni eyi-10,000-12,000 eyedlule. Okusele yizilwane ezincane ezincelisayo njengebhere, i-elk, i-moose, kanye ne-cougar. Ekugcineni, eziqhingini eziningi ezikude zasezilwandle, ukuqothulwa kwezinhlobo eziningi kwenzeka ngesikhathi esifanayo nokufika kwabantu. Akuzona zonke iziqhingi ezazinezilwane ezinkulu, kodwa lapho kunezilwane ezinkulu, zalahleka. IMadagascar yabuswa cishe eminyakeni engu-2,000 eyedlule futhi izilwane ezinkulu ezincelisayo ezazihlala lapho zaphela. I-Eurasia ne-Afrika azibonisi le ndlela, kodwa azizange zithole ukufika kwabantu muva nje. Abantu bafika e-Eurasia eminyakeni engamakhulu ezinkulungwane edlule ngemuva kokuvela kwalolu hlobo e-Afrika. Lesi sihloko sisalokhu siyindawo yocwaningo olusebenzayo kanye nokucatshangelwa. Kubonakala kusobala ukuthi noma ngabe isimo sezulu sadlala indima, ezimweni eziningi ukuzingela abantu kwabangela ukuqothulwa kwalezi zilwane.
question1: Kwenzeka nini ukuphela kwe-Pleistocene kwe-megafauna yaseNyakatho Melika?
answer1: Eminyakeni engaba ngu-10,000–12,000 edlule
question2: Lisho ukuthini igama elithi megafauna?
answer2: Izilwane ezinkulu
question3: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okwanyamalala ngesikhathi sokuphela kwePleistocene eNyakatho Melika?
answer3: Ama-mammoth anoboya
question4: Iyini inkolelo-mbono ehamba phambili ngembangela yokuqothulwa kwezinhlobo eziningi ze-Pleistocene megafaunal?
answer4: Ukuzingela ngokweqile ngabantu
question5: Yikuphi ukuqaphela okusekela ngokuqinile umbono wokuzingela ngokweqile?
answer5: Isikhathi sokuphela kwezinhlobo eziningi zezinto eziphilayo sifana kakhulu nokufika kwabantu
distractor5a: Ukuqothulwa kwezintaba-mlilo kwakuhlale kwenzeka ngesikhathi sokuqhuma kwezintaba-mlilo
distractor5c: Ukuqothulwa kwezinto eziphilayo kwenzeka ngaphambi kokuba abantu bathuthuke
question6: Yiliphi izwekazi elabhekana nokuqothulwa kwezilwane eziningi ezinkulu ngemva nje kokufika kwabantu eminyakeni engu-40,000-50,000 eyedlule?
answer6: I-Australia
question7: Kungani i-Eurasia ne-Afrika zingabonisi iphethini efanayo yokuqothulwa kwezilwane ezinkulu muva nje ngemva kokufika kwabantu?
answer7: Abantu babelokhu bekhona lapho amakhulu ezinkulungwane zeminyaka
distractor7a: Azikho izilwane ezincelisayo ezinkulu ezazihlala lapho
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esifingqa kangcono ukuqonda kwesayensi kwamanje ngokuqothulwa kwePleistocene?
answer8: Isimo sezulu kungenzeka ukuthi sibe nomthelela, kodwa ukuzingela abantu kungenzeka ukuthi yikho okwabangela ukuqothulwa kwezinhlobo eziningi zezilwane
distractor8a: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuphela okuchaza konke ukuqothulwa kwe-Pleistocene
distractor8c: Izimbangela zokuqothulwa kwezilwane sezixazululiwe ngokuphelele futhi azisafundwa

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ushintsho Lwezinto Eziphilayo Ngesikhathi Se-Geological | Ukuphela Kwezinto Zamanje
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ushintsho Lwezinto Eziphilayo Ngesikhathi Se-Geological | Ukuphela Kwezinto Zamanje
chapterContent:
Kubonakala sengathi ukuqothulwa kwesithupha, noma iHolocene, kwaqala ngaphambi kwalokho okwakucatshangwa ngaphambili futhi kuhlobene kakhulu nemisebenzi yamaHomo sapiens. Kusukela ekuqaleni kwesikhathi seHolocene, kunezinhlobo eziningi zokuqothulwa kwezinhlobo ngazinye ezilotshwe emibhalweni yabantu. Iningi lalezi zihambisana nokwanda kwamakoloni aseYurophu kusukela ngawo-1500.

 Esinye sezibonelo zangaphambili nezaziwa kakhulu yi-dodo bird. I-dodo bird yayihlala emahlathini aseMauritius, isiqhingi esise-Indian Ocean. I-dodo bird yanyamalala cishe ngo-1662. Yayizingelwa ngamatilosi ukuze ithole inyama yayo futhi yayilula ukuyibamba ngoba i-dodo, engaguqukanga ngabantu, yayisondela kubantu ngaphandle kokwesaba. Izingulube, amagundane, nezinja ezilethwe esiqhingini yimikhumbi yaseYurophu nazo zabulala ama-dodo amancane namaqanda.

 Inkomo yolwandle yaseStellers yanyamalala ngo-1768; yayihlobene ne-manatee futhi cishe yake yahlala ogwini olusenyakatho-ntshonalanga yeNyakatho Melika. Inkomo yolwandle iStellers yaqala ukutholwa ngabantu baseYurophu ngo-1741 futhi yazingelwa inyama namafutha. Inkomo yolwandle yokugcina yabulawa ngo-1768. Lokho kufinyelela eminyakeni engama-27 phakathi kokuxhumana kokuqala kwenkomo yolwandle nabantu baseYurophu kanye nokuphela kwalolu hlobo.

 Ngo-1914, ijuba lokugcina eliphilayo elihambayo lashona e-zoo eCincinnati, e-Ohio. Lolu hlobo lwaluke lwaba mnyama isibhakabhaka saseNyakatho Melika ngesikhathi sokufuduka kwalo, kodwa lazingelwa futhi lalahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala ngokugawulwa kwamahlathi ukuze libe yindawo yokulima. Ngo-1918, i-Carolina parakeet yokugcina ephilayo yafa ithunjiwe. Lolu hlobo lwaluvame kakhulu empumalanga ye-United States, kodwa lwalahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala. Lolu hlobo lwaluzingelwa futhi ngoba lwaludla izithelo zensimu lapho ukudla kwalo kwendabuko kubhujiswa ukuze kutholakale indawo yokulima. Ingonyama yolwandle yaseJapan, eyayihlala endaweni ebanzi ezungeze iJapan kanye nogu lwaseKorea, yaphela ngawo-1950 ngenxa yabadobi. I-Caribbean monk seal yasakazeka kulo lonke uLwandle lwaseCaribbean kodwa yaphoqeleka ukuba iphele ngokuzingela ngo-1952.

 Lezi zimbalwa nje zezinhlobo eziqoshwe phansi eminyakeni engu-500 edlule. I-International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) igcina uhlu lwezinhlobo eziqothukile nezisengozini yokuqothulwa ezibizwa ngokuthi iRed List. Lolu hlu aluphelele, kodwa luchaza izinhlobo ezingu-380 zezilwane ezinomgogodla eziqothukile ngemva kuka-1500, ezingu-86 zazo ezaqothulwa ngenxa yokuzingela ngokweqile noma ukudoba ngokweqile.
question1: Kubizwa kanjani ukuqothulwa kwesithupha kwenqwaba?
answer1: Ukuqothulwa kwenqwaba yeHolocene
question2: Yini ebhekwa njengembangela eyinhloko yokuqothulwa kweHolocene mass?
answer2: Imisebenzi yabantu
question3: Kungani inyoni i-dodo yanyamalala?
answer3: Yayizingelwa ngabantu futhi amaqanda ayo kanti amaphuphu ayo ayedliwa yizilwane ezethulwe.
distractor3b: Ukuqhuma kwentaba-mlilo kwabhubhisa indawo yayo yokuhlala
question4: Yiziphi izilwane ezethulwe ezafaka isandla ekuqothulweni kwe-dodo?
answer4: Izingulube, amagundane, nezinja
question5: Cishe iminyaka emingaki eyadlula phakathi kokutholakala kwenkomo yolwandle iStellers ngabaseYurophu kanye nokuphela kwayo?
answer5: Iminyaka engama-27
question6: Yiziphi izimbangela eziyinhloko zokuphela kwe-passenger pigeons?
answer6: Ukuzingela ngokweqile kanye nokulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala
question7: Iyiphi inhlangano egcina uhlu olubomvu lwezinhlobo ezibhubhile nezisengozini yokuphela?
answer7: I-International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN)
question8: Ngokusho kombhalo, zingaki izinhlobo zezilwane ezinomgogodla eziphelile kusukela ngo-1500 ezichazwe ku-IUCN Red List?
question9: Ngokusho kohlu olubomvu lwe-IUCN oluchazwe kulo mbhalo, zingaki izinhlobo zezilwane ezinomgogodla ezanyamalala ngenxa yokuzingela ngokweqile noma ukudoba ngokweqile ngemva kuka-1500?
question10: Zibonisani izibonelo ze-dodo, inkomo yolwandle i-Stellers, ijuba elihambayo, kanye nemvu yamanzi yaseCaribbean?
answer10: Imisebenzi yabantu ibangele ukuqothulwa kwezinhlobo eziningi muva nje
distractor10a: Ukuphela okukhulu kwenzeka kuphela ngemva kokushayisana kwe-asteroid
distractor10b: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu yisona sizathu sokuphela kwazo zonke izilwane
distractor10c: Izinhlobo zesiqhingi azikaze zibe sengozini yokuqothulwa

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ushintsho Lwezinto Eziphilayo Ngesikhathi Se-Geological | Izilinganiso Zamazinga Okuphela Kwezinto Eziphilayo Esikhathini Samanje
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ushintsho Lwezinto Eziphilayo Ngesikhathi Se-Geological | Izilinganiso Zamazinga Okuphela Kwezinto Eziphilayo Esikhathini Samanje
chapterContent:
Izilinganiso zamazinga okuphela kwezinyoni ziphazanyiswa iqiniso lokuthi ukuqothulwa okuningi kungenzeka kwenzeke ngaphandle kokubonwa. Ukuqothulwa kwezinyoni noma isilwane esincelisayo kungenzeka ukuthi abantu bakubone, ikakhulukazi uma bezingelwa noma zisetshenziswe ngenye indlela. Kodwa kunezinhlobo eziningi eziphilayo ezingabakhathaleli abantu (hhayi ngempela ukuthi zinenani eliphansi) kanye neziningi ezingachazwanga.

 Izinga lokuphela kwezinyoni kg eliyindilinga lilinganiselwa cishe kuhlobo olulodwa ngesigidi ngonyaka (E/MSY). Isibonelo, uma sicabanga ukuthi kunezinhlobo ezingaba yizigidi eziyishumi ezikhona, okulindelekile ukuthi izinhlobo eziyishumi zizophela minyaka yonke.

 Isilinganiso sezinga lokuphela kwezinyoni sanamuhla sisebenzisa ukuqothulwa kwezinyoni embhalweni obhaliwe kusukela ngonyaka ka-1500. Ezinyonini zodwa le ndlela iveza isilinganiso esingu-26 E/MSY. Kodwa-ke, leli nani lingancishiswa ngezizathu ezintathu. Okokuqala, izinhlobo eziningi bezingeke zichazwe kuze kube kamuva kakhulu esikhathini, ngakho-ke ukulahlekelwa kwazo bekungeke kuqashelwe. Okwesibili, inani lezinhlobo ezisanda kushabalala liyanda ngoba izinhlobo ezisanda kushabalala manje zichazwa kusukela ezinsaleleni zamathambo. Okwesithathu, ezinye izinhlobo cishe sezivele zishabalele yize abalondolozi bemvelo bengathandi ukuzibiza kanjalo. Uma ucabangela lezi zici kuphakamisa izinga lokuphela elilinganiselwayo eliseduze ne-100 E/MSY. Izinga elibikezelwe ekupheleni kwekhulu leminyaka lingu-1500 E/MSY.

 Indlela yesibili yokulinganisa amazinga okuphela kwesikhathi samanje ukuhlobanisa ukulahlekelwa kwezinhlobo nokulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala ngokulinganisa ukulahlekelwa kwehlathi nendawo nokuqonda ubudlelwano bezinhlobo nendawo. Ubudlelwano bezinhlobo nendawo yizinga lapho izinhlobo ezintsha zibonakala khona lapho indawo ehloliwe ikhuphuka. Izifundo zikhombisile ukuthi inani lezinhlobo ezikhona liyanda njengoba usayizi wesiqhingi ukhuphuka. Lesi simo siboniswe futhi ukuthi siyiqiniso nakwezinye izindawo zokuhlala. Ukuguqula lobu budlelwano, uma indawo yokuhlala incishisiwe, inani lezinhlobo ezihlala lapho nalo lizoncipha. Izilinganiso zamazinga okuphela ngokusekelwe ekulahlekelweni kwendawo yokuhlala kanye nobudlelwano bezinhlobo nendawo ziphakamise ukuthi ngokulahlekelwa cishe ngamaphesenti angama-90 kwendawo yokuhlala, kulindeleke ukuthi amaphesenti angama-50 ezinhlobo azoshabalala. Izilinganiso zezinhlobo nezindawo ziye zaholela ekubalweni kwezinga lokuphela kwezinhlobo ezingaba ngu-1000 E/MSY nangaphezulu. Ngokuvamile, ukubonwa kwangempela akubonisi leli nani lokulahleka futhi kwenziwe iziphakamiso zokuthi kukhona ukubambezeleka kokuphela. Umsebenzi wakamuva uphinde wabuza ukuthi ubudlelwano bezinhlobo nezindawo busebenza kanjani lapho kulinganiswa ukulahleka kwezinhlobo. Lo msebenzi uphikisana ngokuthi ubudlelwano bezinhlobo nezindawo buholela ekulinganisweni ngokweqile kwamazinga okuphela. Ubudlelwano obungcono obungasetshenziswa kungaba ubudlelwano bendawo ehlala khona. Ukusebenzisa le ndlela kuzokwehlisa izilinganiso zibe cishe ngu-500 E/MSY ekhulwini elizayo. Qaphela ukuthi leli nani lisaphindwe izikhathi ezingu-500 kunezinga eliyindilinga le-bac kg . Bheka Umfanekiso 38.7
question1: Kungani kunzima ukunquma ngokunembile izilinganiso zamazinga okuphela kwezilwane zanamuhla?
answer1: Ukuphela okuningi kwenzeka ngaphandle kokubonwa ngoba izinhlobo eziningi azichazwanga noma azibonakali kakhulu
distractor1a: Ososayensi bayekile ukuqapha ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor1c: Zonke izinhlobo eziphelile zishiya izinsalela eziningi
question2: Iyini izinga lokuphela elilinganiselwe le-bac kg round?
answer2: Cishe ukuphela okukodwa ngezigidi zezinhlobo ngonyaka (1 E/MSY)
distractor2a: Cishe izinhlobo eziyi-10 zokuphela kwezilwane ngonyaka
distractor2b: Cishe izinhlobo eziyi-100 ezibhujiswayo ngezigidi ngonyaka
question3: Uma kunezinhlobo ezingaba yizigidi eziyi-10 eMhlabeni, zingaki izinhlobo ezizoshabalala minyaka yonke ngesilinganiso sokuphela kwe-bac kg nxazonke?
answer3: Izinhlobo eziyi-10
question4: Ngokusekelwe embhalweni obhaliwe kusukela ngonyaka ka-1500, lingakanani izinga lokuphela kwezinyoni elilinganiselwayo?
answer4: 26 E/MSY
question5: Ngemva kokubala izinhlobo ezingachazwanga nezisanda kuqashelwa, lingakanani izinga lokuphela elilinganiselwayo lanamuhla?
answer5: Cishe i-E/MSY eyi-100
question6: Yiliphi izinga lokuphela elibikezelwa ekupheleni kwekhulu leminyaka kusetshenziswa indlela yokuqala yokulinganisa?
answer6: 1,500 E/MSY
question7: Yibuphi ubudlelwano bezinto eziphilayo obusetshenziswayo ukulinganisa amazinga okuphela kwezinto eziphilayo ngenxa yokulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala?
answer7: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinhlobo nezindawo
distractor7a: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane
question8: Ngokusho kobudlelwano phakathi kwezinhlobo nezindawo, yini elindelekile uma indawo yokuhlala incipha?
answer8: Inani lezinhlobo zezilwane ezihlala lapho nalo lizoncipha
distractor8c: Izinhlobo zezilwane ezidla ezinye kuphela ezizoncipha
question9: Yiliphi izinga lokuphela elilinganisiwe kusetshenziswa ubudlelwano bezindawo ezihlala khona kuleli khulu leminyaka elizayo?
answer9: Cishe ama-E/MSY angu-500
question10: Uma kuqhathaniswa nesilinganiso sokuphela kwezilwane esizungeza i-bac kg, izinga lokuphela kwezilwane elibikezelwe ubudlelwano bendawo ekhona cishe liyi:
answer10: Iphindwe izikhathi ezingu-500

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.2 Ukubaluleka Kokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo Empilweni Yomuntu | Ukuxhumana Nezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.2 Ukubaluleka Kokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo Empilweni Yomuntu | Ukuxhumana Nezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi olukulesi sigaba alusebenzi ngqo emiqondweni nasekuqukweni okudingekayo ku-AP®. Kodwa-ke, njengabafundi bebhayoloji, sidinga ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokulondoloza izinhlobo nezindawo zemvelo ngaphambi kokubhekana nokuthi kungani kufanele sikhathazeke ngemiphumela emibi yomsebenzi womuntu ezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo (Izinsongo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo)

Ukulahlekelwa uhlobo olulodwa, njenge-passenger pigeon, i-dodo bird, noma i-woolly mammoth, kubonakala kungabalulekile esithombeni esikhulu,” ngaphandle kokuthi ukulahlekelwa uhlobo oluyinhloko (bheka isahluko esixoxa nge-population kanye ne-community ecology). Ukuqothulwa kuyingxenye evamile yokuziphendukela kwemvelo okukhulu. Kodwa-ke, amazinga okuqothulwa okusheshayo ahambisana nokulahlekelwa amashumi ezinkulungwane zezinhlobo kanye nokuwa kwezindawo zemvelo kungathinta inhlalakahle yabantu. Ngokuphathelene nempilo, imithi eminingi, okuhlanganisa i-aspirin, i-codeine, i-digoxin, i-atropine, ne-vincristine, itholakala ezitshalweni. Eminyakeni yamuva nje, ubuthi bezilwane kanye nobuthi kuye kwajabulisa abacwaningi ngenxa yamandla azo emithi. Ukuhlukahluka kwezolimo kuyimfuneko yokuvikeleka kokudla, futhi ukulahlekelwa yizihlobo zasendle ngenxa yezitshalo kusongela ikhono lethu lokudala izinhlobo ezintsha ezingakhula ezindaweni ezinezimo zezulu nezimo zomhlabathi ezazingenakwenzeka ngaphambili. Kusukela ngo-1990, ukukhiqizwa kwezinhlanzi emhlabeni wonke kuye kwehla, futhi cishe izigidigidi zethu, izinsiza zasemanzini zinikeza umthombo oyinhloko wamaprotheni ezilwane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubani ongabeka inani noma inani lemali ezinzuzweni zengqondo zezindawo zemvelo esizijabulelayo ngenkathi siseholidini futhi abaculi basebenzisela ugqozi?

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe kulesi sigaba azikho ngaphakathi kwe-AP® futhi azihambisani noHlaka Lwezifundo.

 Ezolimo zaqala ngemuva kokuba imiphakathi yabazingeli nabaqoqi bokuqala iqale ukuhlala endaweni eyodwa futhi yashintsha kakhulu indawo yayo eseduze. Lokhu kuguquka kwamasiko kwenze kwaba nzima ngabantu ukuqaphela ukuthembela kwabo ezintweni eziphilayo ezingafuywayo emhlabeni. Izazi zezinto eziphilayo ziyaqaphela ukuthi uhlobo lwabantu lufakwe ezindaweni zemvelo futhi luncike kuzo, njengoba nje zonke ezinye izinhlobo emhlabeni zincike kuzo. Ubuchwepheshe bulungisa izinto ezibaluleke kakhulu ekuphileni, kodwa ekugcineni uhlobo lwabantu alukwazi ukuba khona ngaphandle kwendawo yalo ezungezile.
question1: Kungani amazinga okuqothulwa okusheshayo angaba yingozi kubantu?
answer1: Zingaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezinhlobo nezindawo zemvelo ezisekela impilo yabantu, ukuphepha kokudla, kanye nezinsizakalo zezindawo zemvelo.
question2: Kungani ukulahlekelwa uhlobo oluthile kubaluleke kakhulu kunokulahlekelwa ezinye izinhlobo eziningi?
answer2: Ukunyamalala kwayo kungabangela izinguquko ezinkulu noma ukuwohloka ngaphakathi kwesimiso sezinto eziphilayo
distractor2a: Izinhlobo ze-Keystone zihlala ziyizinto eziphilayo ezinkulu kakhulu
distractor2b: Izinhlobo ze-Keystone zihlala ziyizilwane ezidla ezinye
distractor2c: Izinhlobo ze-Keystone yizo kuphela izinto eziphilayo ezikwazi ukuzala
question3: Imithi eminingi ebalulekile itholakala kuwuphi umthombo?
answer3: Izitshalo
question4: Kungani ubuthi bezilwane kanye nobuthi buyinto ethakazelisayo kubacwaningi?
answer4: Banezinhlelo zokusebenza zemithi ezingaba khona
question5: Kungani ukuhlukahluka kwezolimo kubalulekile?
answer5: Kusiza ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kokudla futhi kuvumela ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlobo zezitshalo ezivumelaniswe nezimo ezishintshayo
distractor5c: Kuqinisekisa isivuno esiphezulu kuzo zonke izilimo
question6: Kungani ukulahlekelwa yizihlobo zasendle zezitshalo zezitshalo kuyindaba ekhathazayo?
answer6: Kunciphisa izinsiza zofuzo ezitholakalayo ukuthuthukisa izinhlobo zezitshalo ezithuthukisiwe
question7: Cishe bangaki abantu abathembele ezinsizeni zasemanzini njengomthombo wabo oyinhloko wamaprotheni ezilwane?
answer7: Abantu abangaba yizigidi eziyinkulungwane
question8: Ngaphandle kokuhlinzeka ngokudla nemithi, iyiphi enye inzuzo ebalulekile yokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo okukhulunywe ngayo kulo mbhalo?
answer8: Izindawo zemvelo zinikeza inani lezengqondo, lokuzilibazisa, kanye nobuciko
question9: Kungani abantu ngezinye izikhathi behluleka ukuqaphela ukuthi bathembele ezintweni eziphilayo ezihlukahlukene?
answer9: Ezolimo kanye nobuchwepheshe kungenza abantu bangazi ukuthi bathembele kangakanani ezintweni zemvelo
distractor9b: Ubuchwepheshe buthathe indawo ngokuphelele yezindawo zemvelo
distractor9c: Izilwane zasendle kuphela ezithembele ezintweni eziphilayo
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esifingqa kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nezindawo zemvelo?
answer10: Abantu bangaphakathi kwezindawo zemvelo futhi ekugcineni bathembele kuzo ukuze baphile
distractor10a: Abantu bangaphila unomphela ngaphandle kwezinhlelo zemvelo ngenxa yobuchwepheshe
distractor10b: Abantu bathinta izimiso zemvelo, kodwa izimiso zemvelo azibathinti abantu

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.2 Ukubaluleka Kokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo Empilweni Yomuntu | Impilo Yomuntu
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.2 Ukubaluleka Kokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo Empilweni Yomuntu | Impilo Yomuntu
chapterContent:
Imiphakathi yanamuhla ehlala eduze nezwe ivame ukuba nolwazi olubanzi ngokusetshenziswa kwezitshalo kwezokwelapha ezikhula endaweni yazo. Izitshalo eziningi zikhiqiza izitshalo zesibili amakhilogremu, okuyizinto ezinobuthi ezisetshenziselwa ukuvikela isitshalo ezinambuzaneni nakwezinye izilwane ezizidlayo, kodwa ezinye zazo zisebenza njengomuthi. Sekungamakhulu eminyaka eYurophu, ulwazi oludala mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwezitshalo kwezokwelapha lwahlanganiswa emithini yamakhambi—izincwadi ezazikhomba izitshalo kanye nokusetshenziswa kwazo. Abantu akuzona zodwa izinhlobo ezisebenzisa izitshalo ngezizathu zokwelapha: izinkawu ezinkulu, ama-orangutan, ama-chimpanzee, ama-bonobo, nama-gorilla konke kuye kwabonwa zokwelapha izitshalo.

 Isayensi yezokwelapha yanamuhla nayo iyaqaphela ukubaluleka kwalezi zitshalo amakhilogremu. Izibonelo zemithi ebalulekile etholakala kuzitshalo amakhilogremu zifaka phakathi i-aspirin, i-codeine, i-digoxin, i-atropine, kanye ne-vincristine (Isithombe 38.8). Imithi eminingi yayitholakala ezitshalweni kodwa manje isiyenziwe. Kulinganiselwa ukuthi, ngesinye isikhathi, amaphesenti angama-25 emithi yesimanje ayequkethe okungenani isithako esisodwa sesitshalo. Lelo nani cishe lehle laya cishe kumaphesenti ayi-10 njengoba izithako zezitshalo zemvelo zithathelwa indawo yizinhlobo zokwenziwa. Ama-antibiotic, abangela ukuthuthuka okumangalisayo empilweni nasekuphileni kwabantu emazweni athuthukile, atholakala kakhulu ku-fungus namabhaktheriya.

 Eminyakeni yamuva nje, ubuthi bezilwane kanye nobuthi kuye kwavusa ucwaningo olunzulu ngamandla azo ezokwelapha. Ngo-2007, i-FDA yayivumile imithi emihlanu esekelwe ebuthi bezilwane ukwelapha izifo ezifana nomfutho wegazi ophakeme, ubuhlungu obungapheli, nesifo sikashukela. Eminye imithi emihlanu iyavivinywa emitholampilo, futhi okungenani imithi eyisithupha iyasetshenziswa kwamanye amazwe. Eminye ubuthi obuphenywayo buvela ezincelisayo, izinyoka, izibankwa, izilwane ezihlukahlukene ezihlala emanzini nasemanzini, izinhlanzi, iminenke, ama-octopus, kanye nofezela.

 Ngaphandle kokumelela izigidigidi zamaRandi enzuzweni, le mithi ithuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Izinkampani zemithi zifuna ngenkuthalo ama-com amasha amapawundi akhiwe izinto eziphilayo ezingasebenza njengomuthi. Kulinganiselwa ukuthi ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu yocwaningo lwemithi kanye nentuthuko isetshenziswa ku-natural com amakhilogremu nokuthi cishe amaphesenti angama-35 emithi emisha elethwe emakethe phakathi kuka-1981 no-2002 yayivela ku-natural com amakhilogremu. Amathuba emithi emisha azoncishiswa ngokuqondene nokunyamalala kwezinhlobo.
question1: Kungani izitshalo eziningi zikhiqiza i-com yesibili amakhilogremu?
answer1: Ukuzivikela ezinambuzaneni nakwezinye izilwane ezibadlayo
question2: Yayiyini imithi yezitshalo?
answer2: Izincwadi ezazikhomba izitshalo zokwelapha futhi zichaza ukusetshenziswa kwazo
distractor2c: Izingadi lapho kwakutshalwa khona izitshalo zokwelapha
question3: Yiliphi iqembu kulawa alandelayo eliye labonwa lizilapha ngezitshalo?
answer3: Izinkawu ezinhle
question4: Yimuphi umuthi olandelayo otholakala ku-plant com pounds ?
answer4: I-aspirini
question5: Ama-antibiotic amaningi anamuhla atholakala kakhulu kuziphi izinto eziphilayo?
answer5: Isikhunta namagciwane
question6: Kungani ubuthi bezilwane nobuthi buthakazelisa kakhulu abacwaningi bemithi?
answer6: Ziqukethe i-com amakhilogremu kanye nokusetshenziswa okungenzeka kwezokwelapha
question7: Ngo-2007, zingaki izidakamizwa ezisuselwa ebuthi bezilwane ezazivunyelwe yi-FDA?
answer7: Ezinhlanu
question8: Cishe iyiphi ingxenye yocwaningo lwezemithi kanye nentuthuko echithwa kwimikhiqizo yemvelo amakhilogremu?
answer8: Cishe ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu
question9: Cishe yiliphi iphesenti lemithi emisha eyethulwa phakathi kuka-1981 no-2002 evela ku-natural com amakhilogremu?
answer9: Cishe amaphesenti angu-35
question10: Ukulahlekelwa yizinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo kukuthinta kanjani ukutholakala kwemithi emisha?
answer10: Ukunyamalala kwezinhlobo kunciphisa amathuba okuthola i-com entsha yezokwelapha amakhilogremu
distractor10b: Akunamphumela ngoba zonke izinto eziwusizo amakhilogremu sezitholakale kakade

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.2 Ukubaluleka Kokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo Empilweni Yomuntu | Ukuhlukahluka Kwezolimo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.2 Ukubaluleka Kokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo Empilweni Yomuntu | Ukuhlukahluka Kwezolimo
chapterContent:
Kusukela ekuqaleni kwezolimo zabantu eminyakeni engaphezu kwe-10,000 eyedlule, amaqembu abantu abelokhu ezalisa futhi ekhetha izinhlobo zezitshalo. Lokhu kwehlukahluka kwezitshalo kufana nokuhlukahluka kwamasiko kwabantu abahlukene kakhulu. Isibonelo, amazambane afuywa kusukela eminyakeni engaba ngu-7,000 eyedlule e-Andes ephakathi nePeru naseBolivia. Amazambane akhuliswe kuleso sifunda angowezinhlobo eziyisikhombisa futhi inani lezinhlobo cishe liyizinkulungwane. Uhlobo ngalunye luye lwafuywa ukuze luchume ezindaweni ezithile eziphakeme kanye nezimo zenhlabathi kanye nesimo sezulu. Ukuhlukahluka kuqhutshwa yizidingo ezahlukahlukene zesimo sendawo, ukunyakaza okulinganiselwe kwabantu, kanye nezidingo ezidalwe ukujikeleziswa kwezitshalo zezinhlobo ezahlukene ezizosebenza kahle emasimini ahlukene.

 Amazambane ayisibonelo esisodwa nje sokuhlukahluka okudalwe ngabantu. Zonke izitshalo, izilwane, kanye nesikhunta ezitshalwe ngabantu ziye zafuywa kusukela ezinhlotsheni zasendulo zasendle zaba izinhlobo ezahlukahlukene ezivela ezidingweni zenani lokudla, ukuzivumelanisa nezimo zokukhula, kanye nokumelana nezinambuzane. Izambane libonisa isibonelo esaziwayo sezingozi zokuhlukahluka kwezitshalo okuphansi: indlala edabukisayo yamazambane ase-Ireland lapho uhlobo olulodwa olukhuliswe e-Ireland luba sengozini yokutheleleka yizambane, lwaqeda isivuno. Ukulahlekelwa yisivuno kwaholela endlaleni, ekufeni nasekufudukeni kwabantu abaningi. Ukumelana nezifo kuyinzuzo enkulu yokugcina ukuhlukahluka kwezitshalo, futhi ukuntuleka kokuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezitshalo zanamuhla kunezingozi ezifanayo. Izinkampani zembewu, eziwumthombo wezinhlobo eziningi zezitshalo emazweni athuthukile, kumele zihlale zizala izinhlobo ezintsha ukuze zihambisane nezinambuzane ezishintshayo. Lezi zinkampani zembewu ezifanayo, nokho, ziye zahlanganyela ekwehleni kwenani lezinhlobo ezitholakalayo njengoba zigxile ekuthengiseni izinhlobo ezimbalwa ezindaweni eziningi zomhlaba.

 Amandla okudala izinhlobo ezintsha zezitshalo ancike ekuhlukeni kwezinhlobo ezitholakalayo kanye nokufinyeleleka kwezinhlobo zasendle ezihlobene nesitshalo sezitshalo. Lezi zinhlobo zasendle zivame ukuba umthombo wezinhlobo ezintsha zezakhi zofuzo ezingazalaniswa nezinhlobo ezikhona ukuze kudalwe izinhlobo ezinezimfanelo ezintsha. Ukulahlekelwa kwezinhlobo zasendle ezihlobene nesitshalo kuzosho ukulahlekelwa amandla okuthuthukiswa kwezitshalo. Ukugcina ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kwezinhlobo zasendle ezihlobene nezinhlobo ezifuywayo kuqinisekisa ukutholakala kwethu kokudla okuqhubekayo.

 Kusukela ngawo-1920, iminyango kahulumeni yezolimo ibilokhu igcina amabhange embewu yezinhlobo zezitshalo njengendlela yokugcina ukwehlukahlukana kwezitshalo. Lolu hlelo lunamaphutha ngoba, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amabhange embewu ayalahleka ngezingozi, futhi ayikho indlela yokuwashintsha. Ngo-2008, iSvalbard Global Seed Vault (Isithombe 38.9) yaqala ukugcina imbewu evela emhlabeni wonke njengohlelo lokusekela amabhange embewu yesifunda. Uma ibhange lembewu lesifunda ligcina izinhlobo eSvalbard, ukulahlekelwa kungathathelwa indawo yiSvalbard. Ibhokisi lembewu litholakala ekujuleni kwedwala lesiqhingi sase-Arctic. Izimo ngaphakathi kwebhokisi zigcinwa ekushiseni okuhle kanye nomswakama ukuze imbewu iphile, kodwa indawo ejulile engaphansi komhlaba yebhokisi e-Arctic isho ukuthi ukwehluleka kwezinhlelo zebhokisi ngeke kuphazamise izimo zezulu ngaphakathi kwebhokisi.

 Impumelelo yezitshalo incike kakhulu kwikhwalithi yenhlabathi. Nakuba ezinye inhlabathi yezolimo zigcinwa zingenamsoco kusetshenziswa ukutshala okuphikisanayo kanye nokwelashwa ngamakhemikhali, eziningi zazo ziqukethe ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezinto eziphilayo ezigcina imijikelezo yezakhamzimba—ukuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo zibe izakhamzimba amakhilogremu izitshalo ezidinga ukukhula. Lezi zinto eziphilayo zigcina nokuthungwa komhlabathi okuthinta amanzi kanye ne-oxygen dynamics enhlabathini okudingekayo ekukhuleni kwezitshalo. Uma abalimi bekufanele balondoloze inhlabathi etshalwa kahle besebenzisa ezinye izindlela, izindleko zokudla beziyoba ziphakeme kakhulu kunamanje. Lezi zinhlobo zezinqubo zibizwa ngokuthi izinsizakalo ze-ecosystem. Zenzeka ngaphakathi kwezindawo zemvelo, njengezindawo zemvelo zomhlabathi, ngenxa yemisebenzi ehlukahlukene ye-metabolic yezinto eziphilayo ezihlala lapho, kodwa zinikeza izinzuzo ekukhiqizweni kokudla kwabantu, ukutholakala kwamanzi okuphuza, kanye nomoya ophefumulayo.

 Ezinye izinsizakalo ezibalulekile ze-ecosystem ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kokudla ukuthuthwa kwezitshalo kanye nokulawulwa kwezinambuzane zezitshalo. Izitshalo ezingaphezu kuka-150 e-United States zidinga ukuthuthwa kwembewu ukuze kukhiqizwe. Isilinganiso esisodwa senzuzo yokuthuthwa kwembewu yezinyosi e-United States singamaRandi ayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-1.6 ngonyaka; ezinye izinto ezithuthwayo zinikela ngamaRandi ayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-6.7 ngaphezulu.

 Izinhlobo eziningi zezinyosi ziphathwa ngabanakekeli bezinyoni abaqasha izinsizakalo zabo zezindlu zangasese kubalimi. Izinhlobo zezinyosi eNyakatho Melika bezilokhu zilahlekelwa kakhulu ngenxa yesifo esaziwa ngokuthi i-colony collapse disorder, imbangela yaso engacaci. Ezinye izinambuzane zihlanganisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinye izinhlobo zezinyosi kanye nezinambuzane nezinyoni ezahlukahlukene. Ukulahlekelwa yilezi zinhlobo kungenza ukukhula kwezitshalo ezidinga ukuvundiswa kwembewu kungenzeki, okwandisa ukuthembela kwezinye izitshalo.

 Okokugcina, abantu bancintisana ngokudla kwabo nezinambuzane zezitshalo, eziningi zazo eziyizinambuzane. Izinambuzane zilawula laba bancintisani; noma kunjalo, izibulala-zinambuzane ziyabiza futhi zilahlekelwa ukusebenza kwazo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi njengoba izinambuzane zijwayela. Ziphinde ziholele ekulimaleni okuhlobene ngokubulala izinhlobo ezingezona izinambuzane futhi zibeke impilo yabathengi kanye nezisebenzi zezolimo engozini. Izazi zemvelo zikholelwa ukuthi umsebenzi omkhulu wokususa izinambuzane empeleni wenziwa yizilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane kanye nezinambuzane zalezo zinambuzane, kodwa umthelela awukafundwa kahle. Ukubuyekezwa kuthole ukuthi kumaphesenti angama-74 ezifundo ezazifuna umphumela wobunzima bendawo ezitheni zemvelo zezinambuzane, lapho ubunzima bukhulu, kulapho umphumela wezinto eziphilayo ezicindezela izinambuzane uba mkhulu. Ucwaningo lokuhlola luthole ukuthi ukwethula izitha eziningi ze-pea aphid (isinambuzane esibalulekile se-alfalfa) kwandisa kakhulu isivuno se-alfalfa. Lolu cwaningo lubonisa ukubaluleka kokuhlukahluka kwendawo ngombuzo wokuthi ukuhlukahluka kwezitha zezinambuzane kusebenza kahle yini ekulawuleni kunomcindezeli wezinambuzane oyedwa; imiphumela ibonise ukuthi kunjalo. Ukulahlekelwa ukuhlukahluka kwezitha zezinambuzane kuzokwenza kube nzima futhi kubize kakhulu ukulima ukudla.
question1: Kungani kubalulekile ukugcina ukuhlukahluka kwezitshalo?
answer1: Kuyasiza ekuhlinzekeni ukumelana nezifo futhi kusekela ukuthuthukiswa kwezitshalo esikhathini esizayo
question2: Yisiphi isenzakalo somlando esabonisa izingozi zokuhlukahluka okuncane kwezitshalo?
answer2: Indlala yamazambane ase-Ireland
question3: Kungani izihlobo zasendle zezitshalo zezitshalo zibalulekile?
answer3: Ziqukethe izinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo ezingasetshenziswa ukuthuthukisa izitshalo ezitshaliwe
distractor3c: Ziyakwazi ukumelana ngokwemvelo nazo zonke izinambuzane
question4: Iyini injongo eyinhloko yeSvalbard Global Seed Vault?
answer4: Ukusebenza njengendawo yokugcina imbewu yezitshalo ezivela emhlabeni wonke
question5: Bheka uMfanekiso 38.9. I-Svalbard Global Seed Vault itholakala esiqhingini saseSpitsbergen eNorway, esinesimo sezulu esishisayo. Kungani isimo sezulu esishisayo singaba kuhle ukugcina imbewu?
answer5: Ngenxa yokuthi inhlabathi iqandisiwe unomphela, imbewu izogcinwa ngaphansi kuka-0°C noma ngabe ugesi awusebenzi.
distractor5a: Izimo zezulu ezinzima kangaka azivumeli imbewu yome; zigcina amanzi futhi zihlala ziphila
distractor5b: Inhlabathi iqandisiwe unomphela, ngakho imbewu izogcinwa ku-10°C noma ngabe ugesi uyaphela.
distractor5c: Ngoba isimo sezulu esinjalo sandisa izikhathi zokulala kwembewu zibe ngaphezu kwalokho okuvamile
question6: Ziyini izinsizakalo zemvelo?
answer6: Izinqubo zemvelo ezenziwa yizinto eziphilayo ezizuzisa abantu, njengokujikeleza kwezakhamzimba, ukuthuthwa kwempova, kanye nokulawula izinambuzane
question7: Kungani izinto ezithutha impova zibalulekile kwezolimo?
answer7: Izinhlobo eziningi zezitshalo zidinga ukuthululwa kwempova ukuze zikhiqize izithelo nembewu
distractor7c: Ziqeda zonke izinambuzane ezibangela izinambuzane ezitshalweni
question8: Kuyini ukuphazamiseka kokuwa kwekoloni?
answer8: Isifo esibangela ukulahlekelwa okukhulu kwezinhlobo zezinyosi
question9: Kungani izibulala-zinambuzane zivame ukungasebenzi kahle ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
answer9: Izinambuzane zithuthukisa ukumelana nokuzivumelanisa nezimo
question10: Ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwendawo kukuthinta kanjani ukulawulwa kwezinambuzane zemvelo?
answer10: Kwandisa ubuningi kanye nokusebenza kahle kwezitha zemvelo ezicindezela izinambuzane zezitshalo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.2 Ukubaluleka Kokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo Empilweni Yomuntu | Imithombo Yokudla Kwasendle
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.2 Ukubaluleka Kokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo Empilweni Yomuntu | Imithombo Yokudla Kwasendle
chapterContent:
Ngaphezu kokutshala izitshalo nokukhulisa izilwane ukuze zidle, abantu bathola izinsiza zokudla ezilwaneni zasendle, ikakhulukazi izinhlanzi. Kubantu ababalelwa ezigidini eziyi-1, izinsiza zasemanzini zinikeza umthombo oyinhloko wamaprotheni ezilwane. Kodwa kusukela ngo-1990, ukukhiqizwa kwezinhlanzi emhlabeni wonke kuye kwehla. Naphezu kwemizamo emikhulu, zimbalwa izinhlanzi emhlabeni eziphathwayo ukuze kuqhubeke isikhathi eside.

 Ukuqothulwa kwezinhlanzi akuvamile ukuholela ekuqothulweni okuphelele kwezinhlobo ezivuniwe, kodwa kunalokho ekuhleleni kabusha okukhulu kwendawo yasolwandle lapho uhlobo oluvelele luvunwa khona kakhulu kangangokuthi luba ngumdlali omncane, ngokwemvelo. Ngaphezu kokulahlekelwa ngabantu umthombo wokudla, lezi zinguquko zithinta ezinye izinhlobo eziningi ngezindlela okunzima noma okungenakwenzeka ukuzibikezela. Ukuwa kwezinhlanzi kunemiphumela emikhulu nehlala isikhathi eside ezilwaneni zasendaweni ezisebenza kwezokudoba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukulahlekelwa umthombo wamaprotheni ongabizi kubantu abangakwazi ukuwushintsha kuzokhulisa izindleko zokuphila futhi kunciphise imiphakathi ngezinye izindlela. Ngokuvamile, izinhlanzi ezithathwe ezidobeni ziye zashintshela ezinhlotsheni ezincane njengoba izinhlobo ezinkulu zidotshwa ziye ekuqothulweni. Umphumela wokugcina ungaba ngokusobala ukulahlekelwa kwezinhlelo zasemanzini njengemithombo yokudla
question1: Cishe bangaki abantu abathembele ezinsizeni zasemanzini njengomthombo wabo oyinhloko wamaprotheni ezilwane?
answer1: Abantu abangaba yizigidigidi eziyi-1
question2: Kwenzekeni ekukhiqizweni kwezinhlanzi emhlabeni wonke kusukela ngo-1990?
answer2: Inqabile
question3: Yini evame ukwenzeka ngesikhathi sokuphela kwezindawo zokudoba?
answer3: Uhlobo oluvunwayo oluvelele luba yingxenye encane yezemvelo kunokuba luphele ngokuphelele
distractor3a: Zonke izinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo endaweni ezungezile ziyashabalala
distractor3b: Izilwane ezidla ezinye kuphela ezinyamalala endaweni ezungezile
distractor3c: Izinhlobo ezivuniwe ziguquka ngokushesha zibe uhlobo olusha
question4: Kungani ukuwa kwezindawo zokudoba kunzima ukubikezela ngokwemvelo?
answer4: Izinguquko ezinhlobonhlobo ezivelele zingashintsha ukusebenzisana kuyo yonke indawo yasolwandle
distractor4a: Izindawo zemvelo zasolwandle ziqukethe izinga elilodwa kuphela le-trophic
question5: Ukudoba okuwile kuthinta kanjani imiphakathi yabantu bendawo?
answer5: Zinciphisa imisebenzi futhi ziqeda umthombo wokudla obalulekile
question6: Kungani ukulahlekelwa yiprotheni yezinhlanzi engabizi kubaluleke kakhulu?
answer6: Kukhulisa izindleko zokuphila kubantu abangakwazi ukushintsha kalula lowo mthombo wokudla
distractor6b: Kunciphisa amanani okudla kwasolwandle emhlabeni jikelele
question7: Ngokusho kombhalo, yimuphi umkhuba oye wabonwa ezinhlanzini ezivunwe ezidobeni?
answer7: Ukuvuna kushintshe kusuka ezinhlotsheni ezinkulu zezinhlanzi kuya kwezincane
distractor7a: Isivuno manje sihlanganisa kakhulu izilwane ezincelisayo zasolwandle
distractor7c: Manje sekuvunwa izinhlanzi zamanzi ahlanzekile kuphela
question8: Iyini imiphumela yokugcina uma ukudoba ngokweqile kuqhubeka kungalawulwa?
answer8: Izindawo zemvelo zasemanzini zingase zingasakwazi ukusebenza njengemithombo yokudla ethembekile
distractor8a: Izinhlobo zezinhlanzi zizoguquka zibe izilwane zasemhlabeni
distractor8b: Izinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo zasolwandle zizokhula kakhulu

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.2 Ukubaluleka Kokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo Empilweni Yomuntu | Inani Lengqondo Nelokuziphatha
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.2 Ukubaluleka Kokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo Empilweni Yomuntu | Inani Lengqondo Nelokuziphatha
chapterContent: Okokugcina, kuye kwaphikiswana ngokuthi abantu bayazuza ngokwengqondo ngokuphila ezweni elinezinto eziphilayo ezihlukahlukene. Umsekeli oyinhloko walo mbono yisazi sezinambuzane u-E. O. Wilson. Uphikisana ngokuthi umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwabantu usiguqulele ekubeni siphile endaweni yemvelo nokuthi izindawo ezakhiwe zikhiqiza izinto ezicindezelayo ezithinta impilo nenhlalakahle yabantu. Kukhona ucwaningo olukhulu ngezinzuzo zokuvuselela ngokwengqondo zezindawo zemvelo ezisikisela ukuthi umbono ungase ube neqiniso elithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunempikiswano yokuziphatha yokuthi abantu banomthwalo wemfanelo wokulimaza kancane ngangokunokwenzeka kwezinye izinhlobo.
question1: Ngokusho kuka-E. O. Wilson, kungani abantu bezuza ngokwengqondo ngokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Abantu bavela ezindaweni zemvelo futhi bajwayelana nazo ngokwengqondo
distractor1c: Ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kwandisa ukuhlakanipha kwabantu
question2: Ubani osekela kakhulu umbono wokuthi abantu bayazuza ngokwengqondo ngokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo?
answer2: E. O. Wilson
question3: Ngokusho kombhalo, yiziphi ithonya izindawo ezakhiwe ezingaba nalo kubantu?
answer3: Zingadala izinto ezibangela ukucindezeleka ezithinta impilo kanye nenhlalakahle
question4: Ucwaningo lusikiselani ngezindawo zemvelo?
answer4: Zinikeza izinzuzo zokuvuselela ngokwengqondo
question5: Iyini impikiswano yokuziphatha evezwe kulesi sigaba?
answer5: Abantu banomthwalo wemfanelo wokulimaza kancane ngangokunokwenzeka ezinye izinhlobo
distractor5a: Abantu kufanele babeke phambili izinhlobo ezibaluleke kakhulu kwezomnotho kuphela
distractor5c: Abantu kufanele baqede izinhlobo ezihlaselayo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi imiphumela izoba yini
question6: Ngokusho kwe-E. O. Wilsons, kungani izindawo zemvelo zingathuthukisa inhlalakahle yabantu?
answer6: Umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwabantu uye wavumelanisa abantu nokuhlala ezindaweni zemvelo
distractor6a: Izindawo zemvelo zihlala zinikeza ukudla okwengeziwe
distractor6c: Izindawo zemvelo zivimbela zonke izifo zengqondo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.3 Izinsongo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukuxhumana Nezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.3 Izinsongo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukuxhumana Nezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Izinsongo eziyinhloko zokuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zemvelo zifaka phakathi ukukhula kwabantu kanye nokususwa kwezinsizakusebenza ezingagcineki emvelweni. Izinsongo ezintathu ezinkulu kakhulu zokuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zemvelo ukulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala, ukuvunwa ngokweqile, kanye nokungeniswa kwezinhlobo ezingavamile. Imbangela yesine enkulu yokuqothulwa kwezinhlobo—ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu—iya ngokuya iba yinto ebaluleke kakhulu. Ukushiswa kwamafutha emvelo kuphakamisa amazinga e-carbon dioxide emoyeni, futhi lo mphumela wokushisa komhlaba” uphumela ekushintsheni kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni jikelele.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 kanye no-Big Idea 4 wohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi olusekelwe ebholeni lokucwaninga, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 1
Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka nobunye bokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.C
Ukuphila kuyaqhubeka nokuguquka ngaphakathi kwendawo eshintshayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.C.1 Ukuzikhethela nokuqothulwa kuye kwenzeka kuwo wonke umlando woMhlaba.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
5.1 Umfundi angahlaziya idatha ukuze ukuhlonza amaphethini noma ubudlelwano.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.20 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuhlaziya idatha ehlobene nemibuzo yokwakheka kanye nokuphela kwayo kulo lonke umlando woMhlaba.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.C.1 Ukwakheka kanye nokuphela kwayo kuye kwenzeka kulo lonke umlando woMhlaba.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
4.2 Umfundi angaklama uhlelo lokuqoqa idatha ukuphendula umbuzo othile wesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.21 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuklama uhlelo lokuqoqa idatha ukuze aphenye isimangalo sesayensi sokuthi ukwakheka kanye nokuphela kwayo kuye kwenzeka kulo lonke umlando woMhlaba.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezimpahleni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.6 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kanye nendawo ezikuyo kuholela ekuhambeni kwezinto kanye namandla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo kanye nezibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi kanye namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.16 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela imiphumela yokushintsha kwezinto noma ukutholakala kwamandla emiphakathini.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.B
Ukuncintisana kanye nokubambisana kuyizinto ezibalulekile zezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.B.4 Ukusatshalaliswa kwezinhlelo zemvelo zasendaweni nezomhlaba wonke kuyashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo kanye nezibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ezisekelwe ngemibono yesayensi namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.21 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela imiphumela yezenzo zabantu kuzo zombili izindawo zemvelo zasendaweni nezomhlaba wonke.

 Inani labantu lidinga izinsiza ukuze liphile futhi likhule, futhi lezo zinsiza zisuswa ngendlela engazinzile emvelweni. Njengoba kushiwo, izinsongo ezintathu ezinkulu kakhulu eziseduze nezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ukulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala, ukuvunwa ngokweqile, kanye nokungeniswa kwezinhlobo ezingavamile. Ezimbili zokuqala zalezi ziwumphumela oqondile wokukhula kwenani labantu kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza. Umphumela wesithathu wokwanda kokuhamba kanye nokuhweba. Imbangela yesine enkulu yokuqothulwa, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu okubangelwa abantu, ayikakabi nomthelela omkhulu, kodwa kubikezelwa ukuthi kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu phakathi naleli khulu leminyaka. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni wonke nakho kuwumphumela wezidingo zabantu zamandla kanye nokusetshenziswa kwamafutha asetshenziswayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nalezo zidingo (Isithombe 38.10). Izinkinga zemvelo, njengokungcola okunobuthi, zinemiphumela ethile eqondiwe ezinhlotsheni, kodwa ngokuvamile azibhekwa njengezinsongo ngobukhulu bezinye
question1: Yiziphi izingozi ezintathu ezinkulu kakhulu eziseduze zokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo ezichazwe kulo mbhalo?
answer1: Ukulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala, ukuvuna ngokweqile, kanye nokwethulwa kwezinhlobo ezingavamile
distractor1c: Ukufuduka kwabantu emadolobheni, i-photosynthesis, kanye nokulandelana
question2: Kungani ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu okubangelwa abantu kulindeleke ukuthi kube usongo olukhulu ezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo kuleli khulu leminyaka?
answer2: Ukusetshenziswa kukaphethiloli ngabantu kwandisa amagesi okushisa umhlaba, okuholela ekushintsheni kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni jikelele
distractor2a: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuthinta kuphela izindawo zemvelo ezisemaphethelweni ezwe
distractor2c: Kuthinta isimo sezulu kuphela, hhayi ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo
question3: Ukukhula kwabantu kunomthelela kanjani ekulahlekelweni kwezinto eziphilayo?
answer3: Kukhulisa isidingo sezinsizakusebenza, okuholela ekususweni kwezinsizakusebenza okungazinzile kanye nokubhujiswa kwezindawo zokuhlala.
distractor3c: Kukhulisa amazinga okuhlukanisa kuzo zonke izindawo zemvelo
question4: Kungani ukwethulwa kwezinhlobo ezingavamile sekuvame kakhulu?
answer4: Ngenxa yokwanda kokuhamba kwabantu kanye nokuhwebelana komhlaba wonke
distractor4a: Ngoba izimiso zemvelo ngokwemvelo zidala izinhlobo ezingavamile
distractor4b: Ngoba ushintsho lwesimo sezulu luveza izinhlobo ezintsha zezilwane
question5: Yini ebangela umphumela wokushisa ochazwe embhalweni?
answer5: Ukwanda kwe-carbon dioxide esemoyeni ngenxa yokushisa amafutha asetshenziswa kudala
question6: Yimuphi umsebenzi womuntu ohlobene ngqo nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni wonke kulo mbhalo?
answer6: Ukushisa amafutha angaphansi komhlaba ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zamandla
question7: Ngokusho kombhalo, iyiphi inkinga yemvelo ngokuvamile eye yaba nemiphumela ebhekwe kakhulu ezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo kunokuba ibe nemiphumela ebanzi?
answer7: Ukungcola okunobuthi
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esifingqa kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwemisebenzi yabantu kanye nokuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo?
answer8: Ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza okungazinzile kanye nezinguquko zemvelo ezibangelwa abantu yizona zinto ezibangela ukulahleka kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo
distractor8a: Imisebenzi yabantu ngokuvamile yandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo emhlabeni jikelele
distractor8b: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuphela okuthinta ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor8c: Ukulahlekelwa yizinto eziphilayo kwenzeka ngaphandle kwemisebenzi yabantu
question9: Yimuphi umgomo wokufunda we-AP Biology osekelwa kakhulu yilesi sigaba?
answer9: Ukubikezela imiphumela yezenzo zabantu ezindaweni zemvelo zasendaweni nezomhlaba wonke

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.3 Izinsongo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukulahlekelwa Yindawo Yokuhlala
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.3 Izinsongo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukulahlekelwa Yindawo Yokuhlala
chapterContent:
Abantu bathembele kubuchwepheshe ukuze bashintshe indawo yabo futhi bathathe indawo yemisebenzi ethile eyake yenziwa yindawo yemvelo. Ezinye izinhlobo azikwazi ukwenza lokhu. Ukususwa kwendawo yazo yemvelo—kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ihlathi, ugwadule, utshani, indawo yokungena emanzini ahlanzekile, noma indawo yasolwandle—kuzobulala abantu abakulolu hlobo. Susa yonke indawo yokuhlala ngaphakathi kohlobo oluthile futhi, ngaphandle kokuthi ingenye yezinhlobo ezimbalwa ezenza kahle ezindaweni ezakhiwe ngabantu, lolu hlobo luzophela. Ukubhujiswa kwabantu kwezindawo zokuhlala kwashesha engxenyeni yokugcina yekhulu lama-20. Cabanga ngezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezingavamile zaseSumatra: iyikhaya lohlobo olulodwa lwe-orangutan, uhlobo lwendlovu esengozini enkulu, kanye nengwe yaseSumatra, kodwa ingxenye yehlathi laseSumatra manje ayisekho. Isiqhingi esiseduze saseBorneo, ikhaya lezinye izinhlobo ze-orangutan, silahlekelwe yindawo efanayo yehlathi. Ukulahlekelwa yihlathi kuyaqhubeka ezindaweni ezivikelwe zaseBorneo. I-orangutan eBorneo ibhalwe njengesengozini yi-International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN), kodwa imane iyizinhlobo ezibonakala kakhulu ezinkulungwaneni ezingeke zisinde ekunyamalaleni kwamahlathi aseBorneo. Amahlathi ayasuswa ukuze kutshalwe imithi futhi kutshalwe amasimu kawoyela wesundu (Isithombe 38.11). Uwoyela wesundu usetshenziswa emikhiqizweni eminingi okuhlanganisa imikhiqizo yokudla, izimonyo, kanye ne-biodiesel eYurophu. Isilinganiso seminyaka emihlanu sokulahlekelwa yihlathi lomhlaba wonke eminyakeni ka-2000-2005 sasingu-3.1%. Ezindaweni ezishisayo ezinomswakama lapho ukulahlekelwa yihlathi kubangelwa kakhulu ukukhishwa kwemithi, ama-272,000 km2 alahlekile esilinganisweni somhlaba wonke esingu-11,564,000 km2 (noma amaphesenti angu-2.4). Ezindaweni ezishisayo, lokhu kulahlekelwa ngokuqinisekile kumelela nokuqothulwa kwezinhlobo ngenxa yamazinga aphezulu okusabalala kwezitshalo.

 Ukubhujiswa kwendawo yokuhlala kungathinta imvelo ngaphandle kwamahlathi. Imifula nemifudlana kuyimvelo ebalulekile futhi kuvame ukuguqulwa ngokuthuthukiswa komhlaba kanye nokususwa kwamadamu noma amanzi. Ukubhujiswa kwemifula kuthinta ukugeleza kwamanzi kanye nokufinyelela kuzo zonke izingxenye zomfula. Izindlela zokugeleza ezihlukene zinganciphisa noma ziqede inani labantu abavumelana nalezi zinguquko emaphethini okugeleza. Isibonelo, kulinganiselwa ukuthi amaphesenti angama-91 ubude bemifula e-United States athuthukisiwe: anezinguquko ezifana namadamu, ukudala amandla noma ukugcina amanzi; ama-levee, ukuvimbela izikhukhula; noma ukumba noma ukushintsha umzila, ukudala umhlaba ofanelekela kakhulu intuthuko yabantu. Izinhlobo eziningi zezinhlanzi e-United States, ikakhulukazi izinhlobo noma izinhlobo ezingavamile ezinokusatshalaliswa okulinganiselwe, ziye zabona ukwehla okubangelwa ukuminyana kwemifula nokulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala. Ucwaningo luqinisekisile ukuthi izinhlobo zezilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini okumele zenze izingxenye zemijikelezo yazo yokuphila kokubili ezindaweni zokuhlala zasemanzini nasemhlabathini zinethuba elikhulu lokubhekana nokuncipha kwenani labantu nokuqothulwa ngenxa yamathuba akhulayo okuthi enye yezindawo zazo zokuhlala noma ukufinyelela phakathi kwazo kuzolahleka.
question1: Kungani ukulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala kubhekwa njengenye yezinsongo ezinkulu ezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Izinhlobo eziningi azikwazi ukusinda uma izimiso zemvelo ezithembele kuzo zibhujiswa
distractor1a: Ukulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala kuthinta izitshalo kuphela
distractor1b: Izinhlobo zijwayela ngokushesha kunoma iyiphi indawo entsha yokuhlala
distractor1c: Ukulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala kwenzeka kuphela ezihlane
question2: Kungani amahlathi aseSumatra naseBorneo esuswa?
answer2: Ukuvuna izingodo kanye nokusungulwa kwamasimu kawoyela wesundu
question3: Yiziphi izilwane ezisengozini yokuqothulwa ezigqanyiswe njengezisengozini yokulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala eSumatra naseBorneo?
answer3: I-Orangutan
question4: Kungani ukulahlekelwa amahlathi ezindaweni ezishisayo kuvame ukuholela ekuqothulweni okuningi?
answer4: Ngoba amahlathi asezindaweni ezishisayo aqukethe izinhlobo eziningi ezitholakala kalula
distractor4a: Ngoba amahlathi asezindaweni ezishisayo aqukethe izinhlobo ezimbalwa kakhulu
distractor4b: Ngoba izinhlobo zezitshalo zasezindaweni ezishisayo zithuthela kalula kwezinye izindawo zokuhlala
distractor4c: Ngoba zonke izinhlobo zezitshalo zasezindaweni ezishisayo zingaphila emasimini
question5: Yiliphi iphesenti lokumbozwa kwamahlathi emhlabeni wonke elalahleka phakathi kuka-2000 no-2005 ngokusho kombhalo?
answer5: Amaphesenti angu-3.1
question6: Ukwakhiwa kwamadamu emifuleni kungakunciphisa kanjani ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo?
answer6: Kushintsha ukugeleza kwamanzi kwemvelo futhi kuphazamise izindawo zokuhlala ezidingwa yizinto eziphilayo zasemanzini
distractor6a: Yandisa umoya-mpilo kuzo zonke izindawo zemvelo zasemanzini
distractor6b: Kudala izindawo zokuhlala ezengeziwe kuzo zonke izinhlobo
distractor6c: Kuvimbela zonke izikhukhula ngaphandle kokuthinta izilwane zasendle
question7: Cishe yimaphi amaphesenti obude bemifula e-United States ashintshwe yimisebenzi yabantu?
answer7: Amaphesenti angu-91
question8: Kungani izilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini zisengozini enkulu yokulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala?
answer8: Zithembele kokubili ezindaweni zokuhlala zasemanzini nasemhlabeni ngesikhathi somjikelezo wazo wokuphila
question9: Yimuphi umsebenzi wabantu olandelayo oshiwo njengoguqula imvelo yomfula?
answer9: Ukwakha amadamu, ama-levee, ukumba imisele, nokushintsha indlela yemifula
question10: Kungani izinhlobo ezinezindawo ezilinganiselwe zisengozini enkulu yokulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala?
answer10: Ngoba ukubhujiswa kwendawo yazo yokuhlala elinganiselwe kungaqeda lonke uhlobo lwezilwane
distractor10a: Ngoba zizala kancane kunezinhlobo ezisakazeke kabanzi
distractor10c: Ngoba zingathuthela kalula kunoma iyiphi indawo yokuhlala

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.3 Izinsongo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukuvimbela Ukubhujiswa Kwezindawo Zokuhlala Ngokukhetha Izinkuni Ezihlakaniphile
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.3 Izinsongo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukuvimbela Ukubhujiswa Kwezindawo Zokuhlala Ngokukhetha Izinkuni Ezihlakaniphile
chapterContent:
Iningi labathengi alicabangi ukuthi imikhiqizo yokuthuthukisa amakhaya abayithengayo ingase ibe nomthelela ekulahlekelweni kwezindawo zokuhlala kanye nokuqothulwa kwezinhlobo. Kodwa-ke, imakethe yezinkuni zasezindaweni ezishisayo ezivunwe ngokungemthetho inkulu kakhulu, futhi imikhiqizo yezinkuni ivame ukuzithola isezitolo zokwakha e-United States. Okunye ukulinganiselwa ukuthi amaphesenti ayi-10 omfula wezingodo ezingenisiwe e-United States, okuyiwona mthengi omkhulu emhlabeni wemikhiqizo yezinkuni, kungenzeka ukuthi uqoshwe ngokungemthetho. Ngo-2006, lokhu kwafinyelela ku-$3.6 billion emikhiqizweni yezinkuni. Iningi lemikhiqizo engekho emthethweni ingeniswa emazweni asebenza njengabalamuli futhi angewona abasunguli bezinkuni.

 Kungenzeka kanjani ukunquma ukuthi umkhiqizo wokhuni, njengophansi, uqotshwe ngendlela eqhubekayo noma ngokusemthethweni? I-Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) iqinisekisa imikhiqizo yehlathi evunwe ngendlela eqhubekayo, ngakho-ke, ukufuna isitifiketi sabo sophansi kanye neminye imikhiqizo yokhuni kuyindlela eyodwa yokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukhuni aluthathwanga ngokungemthetho ehlathini lasezindaweni ezishisayo. Isitifiketi sisebenza emikhiqizweni ethile, hhayi kumkhiqizi; eminye imikhiqizo yabakhiqizi ingase ingabi nesitifiketi ngenkathi eminye imikhiqizo iqinisekisiwe. Nakuba kunezinye izitifiketi ezisekelwa yimboni ngaphandle kwe-FSC, lezi azithembekile ngenxa yokuntuleka kokuzimela embonini. Enye indlela ukuthenga izinhlobo zezinkuni zasekhaya. Nakuba kungaba kuhle ukube bekukhona uhlu lwemikhiqizo yezinkuni esemthethweni nengekho emthethweni, akulula kangako. Imithetho yokugawula imithi kanye nokuphathwa kwamahlathi iyahlukahluka kuye ngezwe; lokho okungekho emthethweni kwelinye izwe kungase kube semthethweni kwelinye. Ukuthi umkhiqizo uvunwa kuphi futhi kanjani nokuthi ihlathi elivela kulo liyagcinwa yini ngendlela eqhubekayo konke kuthinta ukuthi umkhiqizo wezinkuni uzoqinisekiswa yi-FSC. Kuhlale kungumqondo omuhle ukubuza imibuzo mayelana nokuthi umkhiqizo wezinkuni uvelaphi nokuthi umhlinzeki wazi kanjani ukuthi uvunwe ngokusemthethweni.
question1: Kungani ukuthenga imikhiqizo ethile yokhuni kungaba nomthelela ekulahlekelweni kwezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Eminye imikhiqizo yokhuni ivela emahlathini avunwe ngokungemthetho noma ngendlela engazinzile, okuholela ekubhujisweni kwezindawo zokuhlala
distractor1a: Imikhiqizo yokhuni ihlala ivela emasimini avuselelekayo
distractor1b: Ukugawulwa kwezinkuni kuthinta kuphela izindawo zotshani
distractor1c: Ukugawulwa kwemithi okungekho emthethweni kwenzeka kuphela emahlathini anesimo sezulu esipholile
question2: Cishe yiliphi iphesenti lezingodo ezingenisiwe e-United States okulinganiselwa ukuthi zingase zigawulwe ngokungemthetho?
answer2: Amaphesenti ayi-10
question3: Iyiphi inhlangano eqinisekisa imikhiqizo yamahlathi evunwe ngendlela eqhubekayo?
answer3: UMkhandlu Wokuphathwa Kwamahlathi (i-FSC)
distractor3a: I-International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN)
question4: Isitifiketi se-FSC sibonisa ukuthini?
answer4: Umkhiqizo wokhuni uvunwe ngendlela eqhubekayo
distractor4b: Izinkuni zivela emahlathini asezindaweni ezishisayo kuphela
question5: Kungani ezinye izitifiketi zokhuni ezisekelwa yimboni zibhekwa njengezingathembekile kangako kunezitifiketi ze-FSC?
answer5: Bangase bangabi nakuzimela embonini yezinkuni
question6: Kungani kuvame ukunconywa ukuthenga izinhlobo zezinkuni zasekhaya?
answer6: Ngokuvamile kulula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zivunwe ngokusemthethweni nangokuqhubekayo
distractor6a: Izinkuni zasekhaya zihlala ziqinile kunezinkuni ezingenisiwe
question7: Kungani kunzima ukudala uhlu oluphelele lwemikhiqizo yokhuni esemthethweni nengekho emthethweni?
answer7: Imithetho yokugawula imithi kanye nokuphathwa kwamahlathi iyahlukahluka phakathi kwamazwe
distractor7c: Amazwe asezindaweni ezishisayo kuphela avuna izingodo
question8: Yiliphi ihlathi elilandelayo okungenzeka ukuthi lalivunwa ngokusemthethweni?
answer8: I-maple ye-bird-eye evela eVermont enesitifiketi se-FSC
