chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.3 Izinsongo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukuvunwa Okudlulele
chapterContent:
Ukuvunwa ngokweqile kuyingozi enkulu ezinhlotsheni eziningi, kodwa ikakhulukazi ezinhlotsheni zasemanzini. Kunezibonelo eziningi zokudoba kwezentengiselwano ezilawulwayo eziqashwe ososayensi bezokudoba eziye zawa. Ukudoba ama-cod entshonalanga ye-Atlantic kuwukuwa okumangalisayo kwamuva. Nakuba kwakuyindlela yokudoba ekhiqiza kakhulu iminyaka engu-400, ukwethulwa kwemikhumbi yokudoba yanamuhla yefektri ngawo-1980 kanye nengcindezi yokudoba kwaholela ekubeni ingaqhubeki. Izimbangela zokuwa kokudoba zingokomnotho nangokwezombusazwe. Iningi lokudoba liphathwa njengensiza evamile (eyabiwe) ngisho nalapho indawo yokudoba ingaphakathi kwamanzi endawo yezwe. Izinsiza ezivamile zingaphansi kwengcindezi yezomnotho eyaziwa ngokuthi inhlekelele yezindawo ezivamile lapho empeleni kungekho mdobi onesifiso sokuzibamba ekuvuneni indawo yokudoba lapho ingeyona eyalowo mdobi. Umphumela wemvelo wokuvunwa kwezinsiza ezibanjwa ndawonye ukusetshenziswa kwazo ngokweqile. Ngenkathi izindawo zokudoba ezinkulu zilawulwa ukuzama ukugwema le ngcindezi, isakhona endaweni yokugcina kg. Lokhu kuxhashazwa ngokweqile kuyaqina uma ukufinyelela ezindaweni zokudoba kuvulekile futhi kungalawulwa, futhi lapho ubuchwepheshe bunikeza abadobi ikhono lokudoba ngokweqile. Kwezinye izindawo zokudoba, ukukhula kwezinto eziphilayo kwengcebo kuncane kunokukhula okungenzeka kwenzuzo etholakala ngokudoba uma leso sikhathi nemali kutshalwe kwenye indawo. Kulezi zimo—imikhomo iyisibonelo—amandla ezomnotho azohlala eqhubela phambili ekudobeni inani labantu kuze kuphele.

 Ngokuvamile, ukuqothulwa kwezindawo zokudoba akufani nokuqothulwa kwezindawo eziphilayo—inhlanzi yokugcina yohlobo oluthile ayivami ukudoba olwandle. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, ukuqothulwa kwezindawo zokudoba kuseyingozi ezinhlotsheni zezinhlanzi kanye nemvelo yazo. Kunezinye izimo lapho ukuqothulwa kwangempela kungenzeka. Imikhomo inezinhlobo ezikhula kancane futhi isengozini yokuqothulwa ngokuphelele ngokuzingela. Kunezinhlobo ezithile zoshaka ezinokusabalala okulinganiselwe ezisengozini yokuqothulwa. Ama-grouper ayinye inqwaba yezinhlanzi ezikhula kancane, eCaribbean, ezihlanganisa izinhlobo eziningana ezisengozini yokuqothulwa ngenxa yokudoba ngokweqile.

 Ama-coral reef ayizindawo zemvelo zasolwandle ezahlukahlukene kakhulu ezibhekene nengozi ngenxa yezinqubo eziningana. Ama-reef ayikhaya le-1/3 yezinhlobo zezinhlanzi zasolwandle emhlabeni—cishe izinhlobo ezingu-4,000—naphezu kokuthi akha iphesenti elilodwa kuphela lezindawo zokuhlala zasolwandle. Iningi lezinhlanzi zasolwandle zasekhaya ligcwele izinto eziphilayo ezibanjwe endle, hhayi izinto eziphilayo ezikhuliswe kahle. Nakuba kungekho zinhlobo ezaziwayo ukuthi zibhujiswe ukuhweba ngezilwane zasolwandle, kunezifundo ezibonisa ukuthi izinhlobo ezithile zezinhlobo ziye zehla ngenxa yokuvuna, okubonisa ukuthi ukuvunwa akuhlali isikhathi eside kulawo mazinga. Kunokukhathazeka ngomphumela wokuhweba ngezilwane ezifuywayo kwezinye izinhlobo zasemhlabeni njengezinhlanzi, izilwane ezihlala emanzini nasemanzini, izinyoni, izitshalo, ngisho nama-orangutan.

 Inyama yasendle yigama elijwayelekile elisetshenziselwa izilwane zasendle ezibulewe ukuze zidle. Ukuzingela kwenziwa emhlabeni wonke, kodwa imikhuba yokuzingela, ikakhulukazi e-Afrika enkabazwe kanye nezingxenye ze-Asia, kukholakala ukuthi isongela izinhlobo eziningana ngokuqothulwa. Ngokwesiko, inyama yasendle e-Afrika yayizingelwa ukuze kondliwe imindeni ngqo; nokho, ukuthengiswa kwamuva kwalo mkhuba manje sekuthole inyama yasendle ezitolo zokudla, okwenze amazinga okuvuna akhuphuka aze afike ezingeni lokungaqhubeki kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhula kwabantu kukhulise isidingo sokudla kwamaprotheni okungahlangatshezwana nakho kwezolimo. Izinhlobo ezisongelwa ukuhweba ngenyama yasendle ikakhulukazi izilwane ezincelisayo okuhlanganisa nezinkawu eziningi ezihlala eCongo basin.
question1: Kungani ukuvuna ngokweqile kubhekwa njengosongo olukhulu ezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Isusa izinto eziphilayo ngokushesha kunokuba abantu bangalulama ngokwemvelo
question2: Iyini inhlekelele yabantu abavamile?
answer2: Abantu basebenzisa ngokweqile izinsiza ezihlanganyelwe ngoba akekho onesisusa sokuzilondoloza
distractor2c: Ukuphela kwazo zonke izinhlobo endaweni yokuhlala
question3: Yikuphi ukuthuthuka kobuchwepheshe okube nomthelela ekuweni kokudoba ama-cod entshonalanga ye-Atlantic?
answer3: Imikhumbi yokudoba yasefektri yesimanje
question4: Kungani imikhomo isengozini enkulu yokuvuna ngokweqile?
answer4: Zinezixuku ezikhula kancane futhi zizala kancane kancane
question5: Cishe iyiphi ingxenye yezinhlobo zezinhlanzi zasolwandle emhlabeni ezihlala eziqongweni zamakhorali?
answer5: Cishe ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu
question6: Kungani ukuhweba ngezinhlanzi zasemanzini kuyindaba yokulondolozwa kwemvelo?
answer6: Izinto eziphilayo eziningi zase-aquarium ziqoqwa endle, okubangela ukwehla kwenani kwezinye izinhlobo
distractor6b: Kuthengiswa izinto eziphilayo ezifuywe ezivalelwe kuphela
question7: Iyini inyama yehlathi?
answer7: Izilwane zasendle ziyazingelwa ukuze zidle
question8: Kungani ukuhweba ngenyama yehlathi sekuye kwaba yinto engazinzile?
answer8: Ukuthengiswa kanye nesidingo esikhulayo sabantu samaprotheni kuye kwanda amazinga okuzingela
question9: Yiliphi iqembu lezilwane elisengozini enkulu yokuhweba ngenyama yasehlathini esigodini saseCongo?
answer9: Ama-Primate
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuqothulwa kwezinhlanzi?
answer10: Ngokuvamile kusho ukuthi uhlobo oluvuniwe luba yivelakancane kakhulu ukusekela ukudoba kunokuba luphele ngokwezinto eziphilayo
distractor10a: Kusho njalo ukuthi wonke umuntu wohlobo usenyamalele
distractor10b: Kwenzeka kuphela ezindaweni zemvelo zamanzi ahlanzekile

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.3 Izinsongo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Izinhlobo Ezingavamile
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.3 Izinsongo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Izinhlobo Ezingavamile
chapterContent:
Izinhlobo ezingavamile yizinhlobo eziye zangeniswa ngamabomu noma ngokungahlosile ngabantu endaweni ezungezile lapho zingavelanga khona. Ukwethulwa okunjalo kungenzeka ukuthi kwenzeka kaningi njengezinto zemvelo. Isibonelo, i-Kudzu (i-Pueraria lobata), edabuka eJapane, yangeniswa e-United States ngo-1876. Kamuva yatshalwa ukuze kulondolozwe inhlabathi. Ngokuyinkinga, ikhula kahle kakhulu eningizimu-mpumalanga ye-United States—ifinyelela ku-1 feet ngosuku. Manje sekuyizinhlobo zezinambuzane futhi ihlanganisa amahektha angaphezu kwezigidi ezingu-7 eningizimu-mpumalanga ye-United States. Uma uhlobo olufakiwe lukwazi ukusinda endaweni yalo entsha yokuhlala, lokho kwethulwa manje kubonakala ebangeni elibonakalayo lalolu hlobo. Ukuthuthwa kwabantu nezimpahla, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthwa kwezinto eziphilayo ngenhloso yokuhweba, kuye kwandisa kakhulu ukungeniswa kwezinhlobo ezindaweni ezintsha ezungezile, ngezinye izikhathi emabangeni angaphezulu kakhulu kwamandla alolu hlobo okuhamba ngokwalo nangaphandle kwebanga lezilwane ezidla ezinye zemvelo.

 Ukwethulwa kwezinhlobo eziningi ezingavamile cishe kuyahluleka ngenxa yenani eliphansi labantu abangeniswayo noma ukuzivumelanisa kabi nendawo ezungezile abangena kuyo. Nokho, ezinye izinhlobo zinezimo ezingaphambi kokuba zilungiswe ezingazenza ziphumelele kakhulu endaweni entsha yokuphila. Lezi zinhlobo ezingavamile zivame ukwanda kakhulu endaweni yazo entsha yokuhlala futhi ziphinde zilungise izimo zemvelo endaweni entsha, zisongela izinhlobo ezikhona lapho. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, izinhlobo ezingavamile nazo zibizwa ngokuthi izinhlobo ezihlaselayo. Izinhlobo ezingavamile zingasongela ezinye izinhlobo ngokuncintisana ngezinsiza, ukudla ezinye izilwane, noma izifo.

 Amachibi neziqhingi zisengozini enkulu yokuqothulwa yizinhlobo ezethuliwe. ELake Victoria, njengoba kushiwo ngaphambili, ukungeniswa ngamabomu kwe-Nile perch kwaba yimbangela enkulu yokuqothulwa kwezinhlobo ezingaba ngu-200 zama-cichlid. Ukungeniswa ngengozi kwenyoka yesihlahla esinsundu ngendiza (Isithombe 38.12) isuka eSolomon Islands iya eGuam ngo-1950 kuholele ekuqothulweni kwezinhlobo ezintathu zezinyoni kanye nezinhlobo ezintathu kuya kwezinhlanu zezilwane ezihuquzelayo ezitholakala kulesi siqhingi. Ezinye izinhlobo eziningana zisasongelwa. Inyoka yesihlahla esinsundu inekhono lokusebenzisa ukuthuthwa kwabantu njengendlela yokufuduka; eyodwa yatholakala ngisho nasendizeni efika eCorpus Christi, eTexas. Kudingeka ukuqapha njalo kwabasebenzi bezindiza zasezikhumulweni zezindiza, ezempi, kanye nabezentengiselwano ukuze kuvinjelwe inyoka ukuthi ingasuki isuka eGuam iye kwezinye iziqhingi ePacific, ikakhulukazi eHawaii. Iziqhingi azakhi indawo enkulu emhlabeni, kodwa ziqukethe inani elingalingani lezinhlobo ezitholakala kalula ngenxa yokuhlukaniswa kwazo nokhokho bamazwekazi.

 Manje kubonakala sengathi ukwehla komhlaba wonke kwezinhlobo zezilwane eziphila emanzini angaphandle okwaqashelwa ngawo-1990, ngandlela thile, kubangelwa yi-fungus i-Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis, ebangela isifo i-chytridiomycosis (Isithombe 38.13). Kunobufakazi bokuthi i-fungus ivela e-Afrika futhi kungenzeka ukuthi yasakazeka emhlabeni wonke ngokuthuthwa kwezinhlobo zelabhorethri ezisetshenziswa kakhulu kanye nezilwane ezifuywayo: i-African clawed toad (Xenopus laevis). Kungenzeka ukuthi izazi zezinto eziphilayo ngokwazo zinesibopho sokusabalalisa lesi sifo emhlabeni jikelele. Ixoxo laseNyakatho Melika, iRana catesbeiana, eliye lafakwa kabanzi njengesilwane sokudla kodwa eliphunyuka kalula ekuthunjweni, lisinda ezifweni eziningi zeBatrachochytrium dendrobatidis futhi lingasebenza njengendawo yokugcina lesi sifo.

 Ubufakazi bokuqala busikisela ukuthi enye i-fungus pathogen, i-Pseudogymnoascus destructans, eyethulwa eYurophu inesibopho se-white-nose syndrome, ethelela amalulwane ahlala emihumeni empumalanga yeNyakatho Melika futhi isakazeke kusukela endaweni evela kuyo entshonalanga yeNew York State (Isithombe 38.14). Lesi sifo siqede inani lamalulwane futhi sisongela ukuqothulwa kwezinhlobo esezibaliwe njengezisengozini yokuqothulwa: ilulwane lase-Indiana, i-Myotis sodalis, kanye nelulwane laseVirginia elikhulu elinezindlebe ezinkulu, i-Corynorhinus townsendii virginianus. Indlela i-fungus eyethulwa ngayo ayicaci, kodwa okunye ukucabanga okunengqondo kungaba ukuthi ama-caverns okuzijabulisa aletha i-fungus engahlosile ezingutsheni noma emishinini evela eYurophu.

 Izitshalo ezihlaselayo zingabhubhisa nezindawo zokuhlala zendabuko. Umuthi wepelepele waseBrazil oboniswe ngezansi walethwa eFlorida ngawo-1800. Manje ususakazeke kulo lonke elaseFlorida, ukhiqiza umthunzi oqinile, odala umthunzi omningi kakhulu ukuze izinhlobo zezitshalo zomdabu zikhule.

 Bheka Isithombe 38.15. Izibalo zamalulwane ezindaweni eziningi zokuhlala ziyancipha ngenxa yokutheleleka okubizwa ngokuthi i-white-nose syndrome. I-pathogen yakha i-mycelia, ama-tangles afiphele e-filament emhlophe, ekhaleni lamalulwane. Uma ekhuhlwa ekhaleni lamalulwane futhi ebonwa ngaphansi kwe-microscope yokukhanya, ama-filament abonisa amangqamuzana ane-nucleus kanye nodonga lwamaseli.
question1: Luyini uhlobo olungavamile?
answer1: Uhlobo olwethulwa ngabantu endaweni ezungezile lapho lungazange luguquke khona
distractor1c: Uhlobo oluvela emahlathini emvula asezindaweni ezishisayo
question2: Kungani ezinye izinhlobo ezingavamile zibizwa nangokuthi izinhlobo ezihlaselayo?
answer2: Zisakazeka ngokushesha futhi zisongela izinhlobo zemvelo ngokuncintisana, ukuzingela, noma izifo
distractor2b: Zihlasela kuphela izindawo zemvelo zamanzi ahlanzekile
distractor2c: Bandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kuzo zonke izindawo zemvelo
question3: Kungani imisebenzi yabantu ikhulise kakhulu ukusabalala kwezinhlobo zezilwane ezingavamile?
answer3: Ukuthuthwa kwabantu nezimpahla kuhambisa izinto eziphilayo kude kakhulu nobubanzi bazo bemvelo
distractor3a: Abantu sebeqede zonke izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane zemvelo
distractor3b: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu yisona kuphela isizathu sokwethulwa kwezinhlobo
distractor3c: Izinhlobo zezilwane manje zingathuthuka ngokushesha okukhulu
question4: Kungani i-kudzu isibe yinkathazo enkulu eningizimu-mpumalanga ye-United States?
answer4: Ikhula ngokushesha okukhulu futhi idlula izitshalo zemvelo
distractor4a: Imelana nazo zonke izinhlobo zokubulala ukhula
question5: Kungani iziqhingi zisengozini enkulu yezinhlobo ezihlaselayo?
answer5: Ziqukethe izinhlobo eziningi ezitholakala endaweni eyodwa ezavela zodwa
distractor5a: Abanazo izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane zasendaweni
question6: Yisiphi isilwane esihlaselayo esabangela ukuqothulwa kwezinhlobo ze-cichlid ezingaba ngu-200 eLake Victoria?
answer6: I-perch yaseNayile
question7: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezihlaselayo ezabangela ukuqothulwa kwezinyoni eziningana ezihlala khona kanye nezilwane ezihuquzelayo eGuam?
answer7: Inyoka yesihlahla esinsundu
question8: Yisiphi isifo sefungus esiye saba nomthelela ekunciphiseni kwezilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini emhlabeni jikelele?
answer8: I-Chytridiomycosis ebangelwa yi-Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis
question9: Yiluphi uhlobo okukholakala ukuthi lusize ekusabalaleni i-Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis emhlabeni wonke?
answer9: Ixoxo lase-Afrika elinezinzipho (Xenopus laevis)
question10: Yisiphi isifo sefungus esibhubhise amalulwane ahlala ebusika emihumeni empumalanga yeNyakatho Melika?
answer10: I-White-nose syndrome ebangelwa yi-Pseudogymnoascus destructans
question11: Umuthi wepelepele waseBrazil usongela kanjani imvelo yendawo eFlorida?
answer11: Yakha uphahla oluminyene oluvikela izinhlobo zezitshalo zomdabu
distractor11b: Isebenzisa wonke amanzi angaphansi komhlaba atholakalayo
question12: Yisiphi isici esabonwa ngaphansi kwe-microscope ekhanyayo esisize ososayensi ukuthi babone i-pathogen ye-white-nose syndrome njenge-fungus?
answer12: Amaseli ane-nuclei kanye nezindonga zamaseli akha i-mycelia
distractor12c: Amaketanga amaseli e-prokaryotic angenazo i-organelles eziboshwe nge-membrane
question13: Yisiphi kulezi zinto eziphilayo ezilandelayo esiyimbangela enkulu yesifo sempumulo emhlophe yamalulwane?

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.3 Izinsongo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.3 Izinsongo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu
chapterContent:
Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ikakhulukazi umkhuba wokufudumala obangelwa abantu (okusho ukuthi, obangelwa abantu) oqhubekayo njengamanje, ubhekwa njengosongo olukhulu lokuqothulwa, ikakhulukazi uma kuhlanganiswa nezinye izinsongo ezifana nokulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala. Ososayensi abavumelani ngobukhulu bemiphumela, njengoba izinga lokuqothulwa lisukela kumaphesenti angu-15 kuya kwangu-40 ezinhlobo ezizimisele ukuqothulwa ngo-2050. Ososayensi bayavuma, nokho, ukuthi ushintsho lwesimo sezulu luzoshintsha isimo sezulu sesifunda, okuhlanganisa nemvula kanye namaphethini eqhwa, okwenza izindawo zokuhlala zingabi nokwamukela izinhlobo ezihlala kuzo. Umkhuba wokufudumala uzoshintsha isimo sezulu esibandayo siye enyakatho naseningizimu, uphoqe izinhlobo ukuba zihambe ngezindinganiso zazo zesimo sezulu eziguquliwe ngenkathi zibhekene nezikhala zendawo yokuhlala endleleni. Ububanzi obushintshayo buzobeka izindlela ezintsha zokuncintisana ezinhlotsheni njengoba zizithola zixhumana nezinye izinhlobo ezingekho ohlwini lwazo lomlando. Okunye ukuxhumana okunjalo okungalindelekile kwezinhlobo phakathi kwamabhere asezindaweni ezibandayo namabhere angama-grizzly. Bheka Umfanekiso 38.16. Ngaphambilini, lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zazinezinhlobo ezahlukene. Manje, izinhlobo zazo ziyahambisana futhi kunezimo ezibhaliwe zalezi zinhlobo ezimbili ezihlangana futhi zikhiqiza inzalo ephilayo. Izimo zezulu ezishintshayo nazo zilahla ukuzivumelanisa kwesikhathi okubucayi kwezinhlobo nezinsiza zokudla zesizini kanye nezikhathi zokuzala. Ukungafani okuningi kwanamuhla nokushintsha kokutholakala kwezinsiza kanye nesikhathi sekubhaliwe kakade.

 Ukushintsha kwezindawo sekuqashelwe kakade: isibonelo, ezinye izinhlobo zezinyoni zaseYurophu sezithuthele enyakatho ngamakhilomitha angu-91. Ucwaningo olufanayo luphakamise ukuthi ushintsho oluhle olusekelwe ekuthambekeni kokufudumala lwaluphindwe kabili lelo banga, okuphakamisa ukuthi inani labantu alihambi ngokushesha ngokwanele. Ukushintsha kwezindawo kuye kwabonwa nasezitshalweni, ezimvemvaneni, kwezinye izinambuzane, ezinhlanzini zamanzi ahlanzekile, ezihuquzelayo, nasezincelisayo.

 Ukwehla kwesimo sezulu kuzophinde kukhuphuke izintaba, ekugcineni kugcwale izinhlobo eziphakeme kakhulu futhi kuqede indawo yokuhlala yalezo zinhlobo ezijwayele ukuphakama okuphezulu. Ezinye izimo zezulu zizonyamalala ngokuphelele. Izinga lokufudumala libonakala lishesha e-Arctic, okuqashelwa njengosongo olukhulu ezinhlotsheni zamabhere asezindaweni ezibandayo ezidinga iqhwa lolwandle ukuzingela izimvu zamanzi phakathi nezinyanga zasebusika: izimvu zamanzi ziwukuphela komthombo wamaprotheni atholakalayo kumabhere asezindaweni ezibandayo. Umkhuba wokunciphisa ukumbozwa kweqhwa lolwandle uye wehla selokhu kwaqala ukubonwa maphakathi nekhulu lama-20. Izinga lokwehla elibonwe eminyakeni yamuva likhulu kakhulu kunalokho okwakubikezelwe ngaphambili ngamamodeli esimo sezulu.

 Okokugcina, ukufudumala komhlaba kuzophakamisa amazinga olwandle ngenxa yamanzi ancibilikayo avela eziqhingini zeqhwa kanye nomthamo omkhulu wamanzi afudumele. Izindawo zogu zizogcwala amanzi, kuncishiswe ubukhulu beziqhingi, okuzoba nomthelela kwezinye izinhlobo, futhi iziqhingi eziningana zizonyamalala ngokuphelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuncibilika kancane kancane kanye nokuqandisa kabusha kwezinsika, iziqhingi zeqhwa, kanye nezintaba eziphakeme—umjikelezo oye wanikeza amanzi ahlanzekile ezindaweni ezizungezile amakhulu eminyaka—nawo uzoba sengozini. Lokhu kungabangela ukugcwala kwamanzi anosawoti kanye nokuntuleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile.
question1: Kungani ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu okubangelwa abantu kubhekwa njengosongo olukhulu ezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Ishintsha izindawo zokuhlala kanye nezimo zemvelo ngokushesha kunokuba izinhlobo eziningi zingazivumelanisa noma zifuduke
question2: Ngokusho kombhalo, ingakanani iphesenti lezinhlobo ososayensi abalinganisela ukuthi zingase ziphele ngo-2050 ngenxa yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu?
answer2: Amaphesenti angu-15 kuya kwangu-40
question3: Ushintsho lwesimo sezulu kulindeleke ukuthi luthinte kanjani izindawo eziningi zezinhlobo?
answer3: Izinhlobo zizoshintsha ububanzi bazo ziye ezigxotsheni noma ezindaweni eziphakeme
question4: Kungani ukushintshashintsha kwezinhlobo zezilwane kungandisa ingozi yokuqothulwa?
answer4: Izinhlobo zihlangana nezimbangi ezintsha futhi zingase zingakwazi ukuwela izikhala zezindawo zokuhlala
distractor4a: Izinhlobo zihlala zizalana kancane ezindaweni ezintsha zokuhlala
distractor4b: Izinhlobo zilahlekelwa yizo zonke izinhlobo zofuzo ngokushesha
distractor4c: Izilwane ezidla ezinye ziyanyamalala ezindaweni ezintsha zokuhlala
question5: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezimbili zamabhere eseziqalile ukukhiqiza inzalo exubile ephilayo ngenxa yokushintshashintsha kwezindawo?
answer5: Amabhere ase-polar namabhere aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka
question6: Cishe zingakanani izindawo zezinyoni zaseYurophu ezishintshe kuzo izindawo zazo enyakatho?
answer6: 91 km
question7: Kungani amabhere asezindaweni ezibandayo esongelwa kakhulu ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu?
answer7: Ukwehla kweqhwa lolwandle kunciphisa ikhono lazo lokuzingela izimvu zamanzi
distractor7a: Ukuphakama kwamanzi olwandle kugcwala indawo yabo yokuhlala ehlathini
distractor7b: Amazinga okushisa afudumele aqeda yonke imithombo yamanzi ahlanzekile
question8: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kungathinta kanjani imvelo yasezintabeni?
answer8: Izimo zezulu ezifanele ziyakhuphuka, zishiya izinhlobo eziphakeme zingenandawo yokufuduka
distractor8a: Izintaba ziba zifaneleka kakhulu kuzo zonke izinhlobo
question9: Ukufudumala komhlaba kunomthelela kanjani ekukhuphukeni kwamazinga olwandle?
answer9: Ngokuncibilikisa izinguzunga zeqhwa nokwandisa umthamo wamanzi olwandle afudumele
question10: Yimuphi omunye umphumela ongaba khona wokuncibilika okuqhubekayo kweqhwa kanye neqhwa lasezindaweni ezibandayo?
answer10: Ukuncipha kokutholakala kwamanzi ahlanzekile kanye nokwanda kobuningi bamanzi anosawoti
distractor10a: Ukwanda kwemithombo yamanzi ahlanzekile emhlabeni jikelele
distractor10c: Ukuqedwa kwazo zonke izimiso zemvelo zasogwini

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.4 Ukulondoloza Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.4 Ukulondoloza Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi olukulesi sigaba alusebenzi ngqo emiqondweni nasekuqukweni okudingekayo ku-AP®. Kodwa-ke, njengomfundi webhayoloji nomhambi emhlabeni omangalisayo wezinto eziphilayo zoMhlaba, ufunde ukuthi kungani kubalulekile ukuvikela imvelo nokulondoloza izinhlobo. Uma sicabanga ngokusindisa izinhlobo ngemizamo yokulondoloza, sivame ukugxila ezilwaneni ezisengozini yokushabalala—naphezu kokuthi ukudla okuningi emhlabeni kuvela ezitshalweni, hhayi ezilwaneni. Izinselele ezihambisana nokulondoloza izinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo kumele kuhlangatshezwane nazo ngokuqonda izinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ngokwazo, izinguquko ekuziphatheni kwabantu nasezinkolelweni zabo, kanye namasu ahlukahlukene okulondoloza.

 Ubuchwepheshe besimanje, njengokuhlaziywa kwe-DNA, buvumela abacwaningi ukuthi babhale izinhlobo futhi balandelele izinguquko zofuzo kanye nokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Umthetho womhlaba wonke usetshenzisiwe ukuvikela izinhlobo. Indlela yokuvikela izinhlobo ngazinye zodwa ayanele ukubhekana nemiphumela emibi yemisebenzi yabantu. Imizamo yokulondoloza ephumelelayo nesabalele, njengokusungulwa kwezilwane zasendle kanye nezindawo zokugcina imvelo, ingasetshenziswa. Izindawo zokugcina imvelo ziyizindawo zomhlaba ezibekelwe eceleni ezinamazinga ahlukahlukene okuvikela izinto eziphilayo ezihlala kuzo. Ukubuyiselwa kwendawo yokuhlala kungenye ithuluzi lokuvikela izindawo eziphilayo futhi kungathuthukisa izinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezonakele. Ukulondolozwa kwemvelo kukhombisile ukuthi izimiso zemvelo kanye nezinhlobo ezihlala kuzo, okuhlanganisa ne-Homo sapiens, zingaqhubeka futhi zichume uma siqaphela izinzuzo zokulondoloza izindawo zokuhlala zoMhlaba.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe kulesi sigaba azikho ngaphakathi kwe-AP® futhi azihambisani noHlaka Lwezifundo
question1: Kungani ukulondolozwa kwezilwane ezisengozini yokuphela kukodwa kunganele ukulondoloza ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Ngoba ukuvikela ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kudinga nokulondolozwa kwezitshalo, izindawo zemvelo kanye nezindawo zokuhlala, hhayi nje uhlobo lwezilwane ngazinye.
distractor1a: Ngoba izilwane ezisengozini yokuqothulwa azikwazi ukuvikelwa
distractor1b: Ngoba izitshalo azibalulekile ezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo
question2: Ukuhlaziywa kwe-DNA kunegalelo kanjani ekulondolozweni kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo?
answer2: Ivumela abacwaningi ukuthi babhale izinhlobo zezilwane futhi balandelele izinguquko zofuzo kanye nokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor2c: Ithatha indawo yezinhlobo ezisengozini yokuqothulwa ngezinhlobo ezixubile
question3: Ngokusho kombhalo, yiliphi isu lokulondoloza elivame ukusebenza kangcono kunokuvikela uhlobo olulodwa kuphela?
answer3: Ukusungula izindawo zokugcina izilwane zasendle kanye nezindawo zemvelo
distractor3a: Ukubamba zonke izinhlobo zezilwane ezisengozini yokuqothulwa eziqiwini
distractor3b: Ukususa izilwane ezidla ezinye ezindleleni zemvelo
question4: Ziyini izilwane zasendle noma izindawo zokugcina imvelo?
answer4: Izindawo zomhlaba ezibekelwe eceleni ngamazinga ahlukahlukene okuvikelwa kwezinto eziphilayo ezihlala lapho
distractor4a: Amalabhorethri asetshenziselwa ukutadisha izinhlobo ezisengozini yokuqothulwa
question5: Iyini injongo yokuvuselela indawo yokuhlala?
answer5: Ukuthuthukisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo ngokubuyisela imvelo eyonakele
distractor5c: Ukuguqula izindawo zokuhlala zemvelo zibe izindawo zokulima
question6: Ngokusho kwendima, yini ebalulekile ekulondolozweni kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ngempumelelo?
answer6: Ukuqonda ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo, ukushintsha ukuziphatha kwabantu kanye nezinkolelo zabo, kanye nokusebenzisa amasu okulondoloza asebenzayo
distractor6b: Kuvikela kuphela izilwane ezincelisayo ezisengozini yokuqothulwa

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.4 Ukulondoloza Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukulinganisa Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.4 Ukulondoloza Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukulinganisa Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo
chapterContent:
Ubuchwepheshe bezakhi zofuzo zama-molecule kanye nokucubungula nokugcina idatha kukhula kuze kufike lapho ukuklanywa kwezinhlobo zeplanethi ngendlela efinyelelekayo kuseduze nokuba nokwenzeka. I-DNA barcoding iyindlela eyodwa yezakhi zofuzo zama-molecule, esebenzisa ithuba lokuvela okusheshayo ku-mitochondrial gene ekhona kuma-eukaryotes, ngaphandle kwezitshalo, ukuhlonza izinhlobo kusetshenziswa ukulandelana kwezingxenye zezakhi zofuzo. Izitshalo zingafakwa amabhakhodi kusetshenziswa inhlanganisela yezakhi zofuzo ze-chloroplast. Imishini yokulandelelana okusheshayo kwesisindo yenza ingxenye yomsebenzi wezakhi zofuzo zama-molecule ingabizi futhi isheshe. Izinsiza zekhompyutha zigcina futhi zenze kutholakale inani elikhulu ledatha. Amaphrojekthi ayaqhubeka okwamanje okusebenzisa i-DNA barcoding ukuklanywa kwezibonelo zemyuziyamu, eseziqanjwe futhi zafundwa, kanye nokuhlola indlela emaqenjini angafundwanga kangako. Kusukela maphakathi no-2012, cishe izinhlobo ezingu-150,000 eziqanjwe ngamagama zazifakwe amabhakhodi. Izifundo zakuqala ziphakamisa ukuthi kunezinhlobo ezibalulekile zezinhlobo ezingachazwanga ezazibukeka njengezinhlobo zezelamani ukuthi zingabonwa njengezihlukile ngaphambilini. Lezi manje zingabonakala nge-DNA barcoding.

 Izizindalwazi eziningi zamakhompyutha manje zinikeza ulwazi mayelana nezinhlobo eziqanjwe ngamagama kanye nohlaka lokwengeza izinhlobo ezintsha. Kodwa-ke, njengoba sekuphawuliwe kakade, ngesilinganiso samanje sencazelo yezinhlobo ezintsha, kuzothatha cishe iminyaka engu-500 ngaphambi kokuba ikhathalogi ephelele yokuphila yaziwe. Izinhlobo eziningi, mhlawumbe eziningi kakhulu, emhlabeni azinaso isikhathi esiningi kangako.

 Kukhona nenkinga yokuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ezaziwa yisayensi ezisongelwa nokuthi zisongelwa ngezinga elingakanani. Lo msebenzi wenziwa yi-IUCN engenzi nzuzo, njengoba kushiwo ngaphambili, egcina uhlu olubomvu—uhlu oluku-inthanethi lwezinhlobo ezisengozini yokuqothulwa oluhlukaniswe ngokwe-taxonomy, uhlobo losongo, kanye nezinye izindlela (Isithombe 38.17). Uhlu Olubomvu lusekelwa ucwaningo lwesayensi. Ngo-2011, uhlu lwaluqukethe izinhlobo ezingu-61,000, zonke zinemibhalo esekelayo
question1: I-DNA barcode isetshenziselwani ngokuyinhloko?
answer1: Ukuhlonza izinhlobo usebenzisa ukulandelana kwe-DNA kusuka ku-genes ethile
question2: Yiluphi uhlobo lwezakhi zofuzo oluvame ukusetshenziswa ekubhaleni i-DNA kuma-eukaryotes amaningi?
answer2: Izakhi zofuzo ze-mitochondrial ezishintsha ngokushesha
question3: Kungani izitshalo zivame ukufakwa amabhakhodi ngendlela ehlukile kwezinye izinhlobo eziningi ze-eukaryotes?
answer3: Izitshalo zivame ukutholakala kusetshenziswa inhlanganisela yezakhi zofuzo ze-chloroplast esikhundleni sezakhi zofuzo ze-mitochondrial.
distractor3c: Izakhi zofuzo ze-mitochondrial zezitshalo zishintsha ngokushesha okukhulu
question4: Yiziphi intuthuko kwezobuchwepheshe ezenze i-DNA barcode yaba usizo ngezinga elikhulu?
answer4: Imishini yokulandelela i-DNA esheshayo kanye nezizindalwazi zekhompyutha ezinamandla
question5: Yikuphi ukutholakala okungalindelekile okuye kwasiza ososayensi ukuba bakwenze nge-DNA barcode?
answer5: Izinhlobo eziningi ezazingaziwa ngaphambili empeleni ziyizinhlobo ezihlukile
distractor5c: Amasampula emyuziyamu awakwazi ukuhlaziywa ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question6: Cishe zingaki izinhlobo eziqanjwe ngamagama ezazise-DNA barcoded maphakathi no-2012?
answer6: Cishe izinhlobo ezingu-150,000
question7: Ngokwesilinganiso samanje sokutholakala kwezinhlobo, cishe kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuhlukanisa zonke izinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni?
answer7: Cishe iminyaka engu-500
question8: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko yohlu olubomvu lwe-IUCN?
answer8: Ukuhlonza nokuhlukanisa izinhlobo ezisengozini ngokwesimo sazo sokulondolozwa kanye nezinsongo
question9: Yiluphi ulwazi oluqukethwe yi-IUCN Red List?
answer9: Izinhlobo zihlukaniswe ngokwe-taxonomy, izinga lokusongela, kanye nezinye izindlela zokulondoloza
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 38.17. Yisiphi kwezitatimende ezilandelayo ESINGASEKELWE yigrafu?
answer10: Ngaphakathi kweqembu ngalinye, kunezinhlobo ezisengozini enkulu kakhulu kunezinhlobo ezisengozini enkulu.
distractor10a: Kunezinhlanzi eziningi ezisengozini kakhulu kunezinhlanzi ezisengozini enkulu kanye nezinhlanzi ezisengozini enkulu zihlangene.
distractor10b: Kunezilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini eziningi ezisengozini enkulu kunezilwane ezihuquzelayo ezisengozini, ezisengozini kanye nezisengozini enkulu zihlangene.
distractor10c: Iphesenti elikhulu lezinhlobo zezinyoni lisengozini enkulu kunezinhlobo ze-mollusk

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.4 Ukulondoloza Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukushintsha Ukuziphatha Komuntu
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.4 Ukulondoloza Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukushintsha Ukuziphatha Komuntu
chapterContent:
Kuye kwenziwa umthetho emhlabeni wonke wokuvikela izinhlobo. Lo mthetho uhlanganisa izivumelwano zamazwe ngamazwe kanye nemithetho kazwelonke neyesifundazwe. Isivumelwano se-Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES) saqala ukusebenza ngo-1975. Lesi sivumelwano, kanye nomthetho kazwelonke osisekelayo, sinikeza uhlaka lwezomthetho lokuvimbela izinhlobo ezingaba ngu-33,000 ezisohlwini ukuthi zithuthwe ngaphesheya kwemingcele yezizwe, ngaleyo ndlela zivikeleke ekubanjweni noma ekubulaweni lapho kuhileleke ukuhweba kwamanye amazwe. Lesi sivumelwano silinganiselwe ekufinyeleleni kwaso ngoba sibhekana kuphela nokuhamba komhlaba wonke kwezinto eziphilayo noma izingxenye zazo. Siphinde silinganiselwe yikhono noma ukuzimisela kwamazwe ahlukahlukene ukuphoqelela isivumelwano kanye nokusekela umthetho. Ukuhweba ngokungemthetho kwezinto eziphilayo nezingxenye zazo cishe kuyimakethe engamakhulu ezigidi zamaRandi. Ukuhweba ngezilwane zasendle okungekho emthethweni kubhekwa ngomunye umbutho ongenzi nzuzo: Ukuhlaziywa Kwamarekhodi Okuhweba Ngezitshalo Nezilwane Kwezohwebo (TRAFFIC).

 Ngaphakathi kwamazwe amaningi kunemithetho evikela izinhlobo ezisengozini yokuqothulwa futhi elawula ukuzingela nokudoba. E-United States, uMthetho Wezinhlobo Ezisengozini (i-ESA) wamiswa ngo-1973. Izinhlobo ezisengozini zifakwa ohlwini yilo Mthetho; i-U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service iyadingeka ngokomthetho ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphatha ezivikela izinhlobo ezisohlwini futhi zibuyisele enanini eliqhubekayo. Lo Mthetho, kanye neminye efana nawo kwamanye amazwe, uyithuluzi eliwusizo, kodwa uyahlupheka ngoba kuvame ukuba nzima ukuthola uhlobo olusohlwini, noma ukuthola uhlelo lokuphatha olusebenzayo uma selusohlwini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlobo zingasuswa ngokuphikiswana ohlwini ngaphandle kokuthi kube noshintsho esimweni sazo. Okubaluleke kakhulu, indlela yokuvikela izinhlobo ngazinye kunezindawo zemvelo eziphelele ayisebenzi kahle futhi igxila emizamweni ezinhlotsheni ezimbalwa ezibonakala kakhulu futhi ezivame ukuba nomusa, mhlawumbe ngezindleko zezinye izinhlobo ezingavikelwe. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, lo Mthetho unelungiselelo elibalulekile lendawo yokuhlala elichazwe endleleni yokubuyisela engase izuzise izinhlobo ngaphandle kwalezo ezihloselwe ukuphathwa.

 UMthetho Wesivumelwano Sezinyoni Ezifudukayo (i-MBTA) uyisivumelwano phakathi kwe-United States neCanada esasayinwa saba ngumthetho ngo-1918 ngenxa yokwehla kwezinhlobo zezinyoni zaseNyakatho Melika okubangelwa ukuzingela. Lo Mthetho manje ubala izinhlobo ezingaphezu kuka-800 ezivikelwe. Ukwenza kube semthethweni ukuphazamisa noma ukubulala izinhlobo ezivikelwe noma ukusabalalisa izingxenye zazo (iningi lokuzingela izinyoni esikhathini esidlule kwakungenxa yezimpaphe zazo).

 Impendulo yamazwe ngamazwe ekufudumaleni komhlaba ixubile. I-Kyoto Protocol, isivumelwano samazwe ngamazwe esaphuma kwi-United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change eyabophezela amazwe ekunciphiseni ukukhishwa kwegesi ebamba ukushisa ngo-2012, yavunyelwa amanye amazwe, kodwa yenqatshwa ngamanye. Amazwe amabili abalulekile ngokwethonya lawo elingase libe khona elingazange liqinisekise i-Kyoto Protocol kwakuyi-United States ne-China. I-United States yayenqaba ngenxa yemboni enamandla yamafutha emvelo kanye ne-China ngenxa yokukhathazeka ukuthi izovimbela ukukhula kwesizwe. Eminye imigomo yokunciphisa amagesi abamba ukushisa yahlangatshezwa futhi yadlulwa amazwe ngamanye, kodwa emhlabeni wonke, umzamo wokunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwegesi ebamba ukushisa awuphumeleli. Ukufakwa esikhundleni kwe-Kyoto Protocol akukafezeki ngoba ohulumeni abakwazi ukuvumelana ngezikhathi nezilinganiso. Okwamanje, ososayensi besimo sezulu babikezela ukuthi izindleko ezizovela emiphakathini yabantu kanye nokuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo zizoba phezulu.

 Njengoba sekushiwo kakade, umkhakha ozimele ongenzi nzuzo udlala indima enkulu emzamweni wokonga kokubili eNyakatho Melika nasemhlabeni jikelele. Izindlela zisukela ezinhlanganweni eziqondene nezinhlobo ezithile kuya ku-IUCN kanye ne-TRAFFIC egxile kakhulu. I-Nature Conservancy ithatha indlela entsha. Ithenga umhlaba futhi iwuvikele ngomzamo wokusetha izindawo zokugcina izinto eziphilayo. Ekugcineni, ukuziphatha kwabantu kuzoshintsha lapho amanani abantu eshintsha. Njengamanje, ukukhula kwabantu emadolobheni kuyithonya elibangela izinselelo ekwabeni inani lokuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo.
question1: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko yeSivumelwano Sokuhweba Kwamazwe Ngamazwe Ngezinhlobo Ezisengozini Yokushabalala (CITES)?
answer1: Ukulawula ukuhweba kwamazwe ngamazwe kwezinhlobo ezisengozini yokuqothulwa nokuvimbela ukuxhashazwa kwazo
distractor1a: Ukusungula amapaki kazwelonke kuwo wonke amazwe
distractor1c: Ukuhlukanisa izindawo zemvelo zibe izindawo ezishisayo zezinto eziphilayo
question2: Cishe zingaki izinhlobo ezivikelwe ngaphansi kwe-CITES?
answer2: Izinhlobo ezingaba ngu-33,000 ezibalwe ohlwini
question3: Iyini imingcele emikhulu ye-CITES?
answer3: Ilawula kuphela ukuhamba kwezinto eziphilayo emhlabeni wonke futhi incike emazweni ukuthi aqinisekise isivumelwano
question4: Iyini indima ye-TRAFFIC?
answer4: Iqapha ukuhweba okungekho emthethweni ngezilwane zasendle kanye nemikhiqizo yezilwane zasendle
distractor4b: Iphatha ukufuya kwezinhlobo ezisengozini yokuphela amagremu
question5: Iyini inhloso yoMthetho Wezinhlobo Ezisengozini Yokushabalala (i-ESA) wase-U.S.?
answer5: Ukuvikela izinhlobo ezisengozini yokuqothulwa nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphatha ukubuyisela inani elihlala njalo
distractor5a: Ukulawula ukuhweba kwamazwe ngamazwe ngezilwane zasendle
distractor5c: Ukudala izindawo ezithandwa kakhulu yizinto eziphilayo
question6: Kungani ukuvikela izinhlobo ezithile zezilwane ngokuvamile kubhekwa njengokungaphumeleli kakhulu kunokuvikela izimiso zemvelo?
answer6: Ngoba igxila ekulondolozweni kwezinhlobo ezimbalwa esikhundleni sokulondoloza yonke imvelo esekela izinhlobo eziningi
distractor6b: Ngoba izinhlobo ezisengozini yokuqothulwa azivamile ukuphola
distractor6c: Ngoba izinhlobo ngazinye azibalulekile ezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo
question7: Iyini inhloso yoMthetho Wesivumelwano Sezinyoni Ezifudukayo (MBTA)?
answer7: Ukuvikela izinhlobo zezinyoni ezifudukayo ngokwenza kube semthethweni ukuphazamisa, ukubulala, noma ukuhwebelana ngezinyoni ezivikelwe noma izingxenye zazo
distractor7b: Ukusungula izindawo zokugcina izinyoni kuzo zonke izifundazwe
question8: Kungani amanye amazwe akhetha ukungasivumi iSivumelwano saseKyoto?
answer8: Ngenxa yokukhathazeka ngemiphumela yezomnotho kanye nokwehla kokukhula kwezimboni
distractor8a: Ngoba ushintsho lwesimo sezulu lucatshangelwe ukuthi luxazululiwe
distractor8b: Ngoba isivumelwano sigxile kuphela ekuhlukahlukaneni kwezinto eziphilayo
question9: Iyini isu eliyinhloko lokulondolozwa kwemvelo le-Nature Conservancy?
answer9: Ukuthenga umhlaba ukuze kusungulwe futhi kuvikelwe izindawo ezigcina imvelo
distractor9b: Ukuqapha ukuhweba ngezilwane zasendle okungekho emthethweni
question10: Ngokusho kwendima, yini okumele ishintshe ekugcineni ukuze ukulondolozwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo isikhathi eside kuphumelele?
answer10: Izindinganiso kanye nokuziphatha kwabantu ngokuphathelene nokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | 38.4 Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo | Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo Ezindaweni Zokulondolozwa Kwemvelo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | 38.4 Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo | Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo Ezindaweni Zokulondolozwa Kwemvelo
chapterContent: Ukusungulwa kwezindawo zokugcina izilwane zasendle kanye nezindawo zokugcina imvelo kungenye yamathuluzi abalulekile emizamweni yokonga. Indawo yokugcina imvelo yindawo ebekelwe eceleni enamazinga ahlukahlukene okuvikela izinto eziphilayo ezikhona ngaphakathi kwemingcele yendawo yokugcina imvelo. Izindawo zokugcina imvelo zingasebenza kahle esikhathini esifushane ekuvikeleni kokubili izinhlobo kanye nezindawo zokugcina imvelo, kodwa zibhekene nezinselelo ososayensi abasazihlola ukuze baqinise ukusebenza kwazo njengezixazululo zesikhathi eside.
question1: Iyini indawo yokugcina izinto uma kuziwa ekulondolozweni kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Indawo ebekelwe eceleni enamazinga ahlukahlukene okuvikela izinto eziphilayo ezihlala kuyo
distractor1a: Ilabhorethri lapho kuzalaniswa khona izinhlobo zezilwane ezisengozini yokuphela
question2: Kungani izindawo zokugcina zibhekwa njengethuluzi elibalulekile lokulondoloza?
answer2: Zisiza ekuvikeleni kokubili izinhlobo kanye nemvelo yonke
distractor2b: Zivimbela yonke imiphumela yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu
question3: Ngokusho kwendima, yini umkhawulo omkhulu wokulondolozwa?
answer3: Ososayensi basafunda ukuthi bangathuthukisa kanjani ukusebenza kwabo njengezixazululo zokonga isikhathi eside
distractor3c: Zisebenza kuphela ekulweni nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | 38.4 Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo | Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo Ezindaweni Zokulondolozwa | Ingakanani Indawo Okufanele Igcinwe?
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | 38.4 Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo | Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo Ezindaweni Zokulondolozwa | Ingakanani Indawo Okufanele Igcinwe?
chapterContent: Ngenxa yendlela izindawo ezivikelwe ezabiwe ngayo (zivame ukuqukatha izinsiza ezingabalulekile kangako kwezomnotho kunokuba zibekelwe eceleni ngqo izinhlobo noma izindawo zemvelo ezisengozini) kanye nendlela ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo okusatshalaliswa ngayo, ukunquma iphesenti eliqondiwe lomhlaba noma indawo yokuhlala yasolwandle okufanele ivikelwe ukuze kulondolozwe amazinga okuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kuyinselele. I-IUCN World Parks Congress ilinganisele ukuthi amaphesenti angu-11.5 omhlaba womhlaba ambozwe yizindawo zokugcina izilwane zezinhlobo ezahlukene ngo-2003. Le ndawo inkulu kunemigomo yangaphambilini; noma kunjalo, imelela kuphela ama-biome angu-9 kwangu-14 aqashelwayo. Ucwaningo lukhombisile ukuthi amaphesenti angu-12 azo zonke izinhlobo eziphilayo ahlala ngaphandle kwezindawo zokugcina izilwane; la maphesenti aphezulu kakhulu lapho kucatshangelwa izinhlobo ezisengozini kanye nezindawo zokugcina izilwane zekhwalithi ephezulu. Isibonelo, izindawo zokugcina izilwane zekhwalithi ephezulu zifaka cishe amaphesenti angu-50 kuphela ezinhlobo zezilwane zasemanzini ezisongelwayo. Isiphetho kumele sibe ukuthi iphesenti lendawo evikelwe kumele lande, noma iphesenti lezindawo zokugcina izilwane zekhwalithi ephezulu kumele lande, noma izindawo zokugcina izilwane kumele ziqondiswe ngokunaka okukhulu ekuvikelweni kwezinto eziphilayo. Abacwaningi baphikisana ngokuthi kudingeka ukunaka okwengeziwe esixazululweni sokugcina.
question1: Kungani kunzima ukuthola iphesenti elifanele lomhlaba noma indawo yokuhlala yasolwandle okufanele ilondolozwe?
answer1: Ngoba izindawo ezivikelwe zivame ukukhethwa ngokusekelwe enanini eliphansi kwezomnotho kunokuthi lapho ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kukhulu khona, futhi ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kusatshalaliswa ngokungalingani
distractor1a: Ngoba zonke izimiso zemvelo ziqukethe ukuhlukahluka okufanayo
distractor1b: Ngoba zonke izindawo ezivikelwe zisebenza ngokulinganayo
distractor1c: Ngoba izinhlobo zezilwane zisakazwa ngokulinganayo emhlabeni wonke
question2: Ngokusho kwe-IUCN World Parks Congress, cishe yiliphi iphesenti lomhlabathi woMhlaba elalivikelwe yizindawo zokugcina ngo-2003?
question3: Naphezu kokuvikela u-11.5% womhlaba, yimuphi umkhawulo omkhulu osele?
answer3: Lezi zilondolozi zazimelela kuphela ama-biome angu-9 kwangu-14 aqashelwa kakhulu.
question4: Cishe yiliphi iphesenti lazo zonke izinhlobo zezilwane elitholakale ngaphandle kwezindawo ezivikelwe kuphela?
question5: Yiliphi iphesenti lezinhlobo zezilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini ezisengozini ezifakiwe ezindaweni zokugcina imvelo ezisezingeni eliphezulu?
answer5: Cishe u-50%
question6: Ngokusho kwabacwaningi, iyiphi indlela engcono kakhulu yokuthuthukisa ukongiwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ngokusebenzisa izindawo zokugcina imvelo?
answer6: I-Target igcina ngokucophelela izindawo ezinezinhlobonhlobo eziningi zezinto eziphilayo
distractor6b: Vikela kuphela umhlaba obaluleke kakhulu ngokwezomnotho
distractor6c: Gxila ekulondolozweni kwezindawo zemvelo zasolwandle kuphela

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | 38.4 Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo | Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo Ezindaweni Zokulondolozwa | Umklamo Wendawo Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | 38.4 Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo | Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo Ezindaweni Zokulondolozwa | Umklamo Wendawo Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo
chapterContent:
Kuye kwaba nocwaningo olunzulu mayelana nemiklamo yokulondolozwa engcono kakhulu yokugcina ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo. Isimiso esiyisisekelo ngemuva kocwaningo oluningi kube umsebenzi oyinhloko wemfundiso kaRobert H. MacArthur no-Edward O. Wilson owanyatheliswa ngo-1967 ku-biogeography yesiqhingi.5 Lo msebenzi wawufuna ukuqonda izici ezithinta ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo eziqhingini. Isiphetho esiyisisekelo kwaba ukuthi ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo esiqhingini kwakuwumsebenzi wemvelaphi yezinhlobo ngokufuduka, ukuhlukanisa, kanye nokuqothulwa kuleso siqhingi. Iziqhingi ezikude nezwekazi kunzima ukufinyelela kuzo, ngakho ukufuduka kuphansi futhi inani lokulingana kwezinhlobo liphansi. Ngaphakathi kwezinhlobo zesiqhingi, ubufakazi busikisela ukuthi inani lezinhlobo likhuphuka kancane kancane liye ezingeni elifanayo nenani elisezwenikazi okusolwa ukuthi uhlobo luthuthele kulo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iziqhingi ezincane kunzima ukuzithola, ngakho amazinga azo okufuduka kwezinhlobo ezintsha aphansi. Iziqhingi ezincane nazo azifani kakhulu ngokwendawo ngakho kunezindawo ezimbalwa zokukhuthaza ukuhlukahluka. Futhi ekugcineni, iziqhingi ezincane zisekela inani elincane labantu, ngakho-ke amathuba okuphela aphakeme.

 Njengoba iziqhingi zikhula, inani lezinhlobo liyashesha, yize umphumela wendawo yesiqhingi enanini lezinhlobo ungeyona into eqondile. Izindawo zokugcina ukulondolozwa zingabonakala njengeziqhingi "zendawo yokuhlala ngaphakathi kolwandle"olungeyona indawo yokuhlala. Ukuze uhlobo luqhubeke endaweni yokugcina ukulondolozwa, indawo yokugcina ukulondolozwa kumele ibe nkulu ngokwanele. Ubukhulu obubalulekile buxhomeke, ngokwengxenye, endaweni yokuhlala ephawuleka kulolu hlobo. Indawo yokugcina izimpisi, engaba amakhulu amakhilogremu amamitha, kumele ibe nkulu kakhulu kunendawo yokugcina izimvemvane, engaba ngaphakathi kwamakhilogremu ayishumi amamitha ngesikhathi sokuphila kwayo. Kodwa izindawo zokugcina ukulondolozwa ezinkulu zinendawo eyinhloko yokuhlala engcono kakhulu yezinhlobo ngazinye, zinezindawo eziningi zokusekela izinhlobo eziningi, futhi ziheha izinhlobo eziningi ngoba zingatholakala futhi zifinyelelwe kalula.

 Izindawo zokugcina ukulondolozwa zisebenza kangcono uma kunezindawo zokugcina ukulondolozwa ezizungezile zendawo yokuhlala engaphansi kwekhwalithi. Indawo yokugcina ukulondolozwa ivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi ziphume emingceleni yendawo yokugcina ukulondolozwa ngaphandle kwemiphumela emibi ngokushesha evela ekudlaleni noma ukuntuleka kwezinsiza. Indawo yokugcina ukulondolozwa eyodwa enkulu ingcono kunendawo efanayo yezindawo zokugcina ukulondolozwa eziningana ezincane ngoba kunendawo yokuhlala eyinhloko engathintwa yimiphetho. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu esifanayo, ukugcina okusesimweni sesikwele noma indilinga kuzoba ngcono kunokugcina okunezingalo eziningi ezincane. Uma izindawo zokugcina izilwane kumele zibe zincane, khona-ke ukuhlinzeka ngemigwaqo yezilwane zasendle phakathi kwazo ukuze abantu kanye nezakhi zofuzo zabo bakwazi ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo zokugcina, isibonelo emifuleni nasemifudlaneni, kuzokwenza izindawo zokugcina ezincane ziziphathe njengenkulu. Zonke lezi zici ziyacatshangelwa lapho kuhlelwa uhlobo lwendawo yokugcina ngaphambi kokuba umhlaba ubekelwe eceleni.

 Ngaphezu kwemininingwane engokwenyama, yebhayoloji, kanye neyemvelo yendawo yokugcina, kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zemigomo, imithetho, kanye nokuphoqelelwa okuhlobene nokusetshenziswa kwendawo yokugcina imisebenzi ngaphandle kokuvikela izinhlobo zezilwane. Lokhu kungafaka noma yini kusukela ekukhishweni kwezinkuni, ekukhishweni kwamaminerali, ekuzingeleni okulawulwayo, ekuhlaleni kwabantu, kanye nokuzilibazisa kwabantu okungonakalisi. Eziningi zalezi zinqumo zenqubomgomo zenziwa ngokusekelwe ekucindezelweni kwezepolitiki kunokuba kucatshangelwe ukulondolozwa. Kwezinye izimo, izinqubomgomo zokuvikelwa kwezilwane zasendle beziqinile kangangokuthi abantu bomdabu abaphila ngokuziphilisa baye baphoqeleka ukuba basuke ezindaweni zokhokho ababengena endaweni yokugcina. Kwezinye izimo, noma ngabe indawo yokugcina iklanyelwe ukuvikela izilwane zasendle, uma ukuvikelwa kungaphoqelelwa noma kungenakusetshenziswa, isimo sendawo yokugcina ngeke sibe nancazelo enkulu lapho kubhekene nokuzingela okungekho emthethweni kanye nokukhishwa kwezinkuni. Lena inkinga ebanzi ngezindawo zokugcina ezindaweni izindawo ezishisayo
question1: Yimuphi umbono wesayensi owakha isisekelo somklamo omningi wesimanje wokulondolozwa kwezinto?
answer1: Umbono we-biogeography yesiqhingi
question2: Ngokusho kwe-biogeography yesiqhingi, kungani iziqhingi ezikude nezwekazi ngokuvamile zinezinhlobo ezimbalwa?
answer2: Ngoba ukufuduka eziqhingini ezikude akuvamile
question3: Kungani iziqhingi ezincane zivame ukusekela izinhlobo ezimbalwa zezilwane?
answer3: Banezindawo ezimbalwa zokuhlala, amazinga aphansi okufuduka, kanye namazinga aphezulu okuphela kwabantu
distractor3b: Zinezinhlobonhlobo zezindawo zokuhlala eziningi kuneziqhingi ezinkulu
question4: Kungani izilondolozi ezinkulu ngokuvamile zisebenza kangcono kunezilondolozi ezincane?
answer4: Ziqukethe indawo yokuhlala eyinhloko eyengeziwe, izindawo zemvelo eziningi, futhi zisekela inani elikhulu labantu
distractor4b: Zivimbela ukuqothulwa kwazo zonke izinhlobo zezilwane
question5: Kungani indawo yokugcina izimpisi ngokuvamile kufanele ibe nkulu kunendawo yokugcina izimvemvane?
answer5: Ngoba izimpisi zinezindawo zokuhlala ezinkulu kakhulu kunezimvemvane
distractor5a: Ngoba izimpisi zidinga ukukhanya kwelanga okwengeziwe
distractor5b: Ngoba izimvemvane azikwazi ukusinda ezindaweni zokugcina izithombo
question6: Iyini injongo yendawo evikelayo ezungeze indawo yokugcina izinto?
answer6: Ukunciphisa imiphumela emibi lapho izinto eziphilayo zihamba ngale komngcele wokulondolozwa
distractor6a: Ukuvimbela zonke izinhlobo zezilwane ukuthi zingaphumi endaweni yokugcina imfuyo
question7: Kungani indawo yokugcina enkulu eyodwa ngokuvamile ingcono kunezindawo zokugcina eziningana ezincane ezinendawo elinganayo iyonke?
answer7: Ihlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala eyinhloko eningi ngemiphumela embalwa yemiphetho
distractor7a: Ihlala iqukethe izinhlobo eziningi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ikuphi indawo yokuhlala
question8: Yisiphi isimo sokugcina esivame ukubhekwa njengesisebenza kahle kakhulu ekulondolozweni kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo?
answer8: Isivikelo sesikwele noma esiyindilinga
distractor8a: Indawo ende, encane yokugcina impahla enamagatsha amaningi
question9: Iyini inhloso yemizila yezilwane zasendle?
answer9: Ukuvumela izinto eziphilayo kanye nezakhi zazo zofuzo ukuthi zihambe phakathi kwezinto ezigciniwe
question10: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo senkinga yenqubomgomo engathinta ukuphathwa kokulondolozwa?
answer10: Izinqumo mayelana nokumba izingodo, ukuzingela, ukuzijabulisa, noma indawo yokuhlala yabantu
question11: Kungani ezinye izindawo zokugcina imvelo zingase zehluleke ukuvikela ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo naphezu kokuklama ngokucophelela?
answer11: Ngoba imisebenzi engekho emthethweni njengokuzingela ngokungekho emthethweni kanye nokumba izinkuni kungenzeka ingaphoqelelwa ngempumelelo
distractor11a: Ngoba izilondolozi zihlala zilahlekelwa izinhlobo ngokwemvelo
distractor11b: Ngoba izindawo ezivikelayo zivimbela ukulondolozwa kwemvelo
distractor11c: Ngoba imihubhe yezilwane zasendle yandisa amazinga okuphela
question12: Ngokusho kwendima, iyiphi inselele yomphakathi engaba khona ngokusungula izindawo zokulondoloza ezivikelwe?
answer12: Izinqubomgomo zokuvikela eziqinile zingaphoqa abantu bomdabu ukuba bashiye izindawo zabo zokhokho babo
distractor12a: Izindawo ezivikelwe zisusa konke ukuzijabulisa kwabantu
distractor12b: Izindawo ezivikelwe zihlala zikhulisa umkhiqizo wezolimo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | 38.4 Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo | Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo Ezindaweni Zokulondolozwa | Imikhawulo Ezindaweni Zokulondolozwa
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | 38.4 Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo | Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo Ezindaweni Zokulondolozwa | Imikhawulo Ezindaweni Zokulondolozwa
chapterContent:
Eminye yemikhawulo ekugcinweni kwezilwane njengamathuluzi okulondolozwa ibonakala engxoxweni yomklamo wokulondolozwa. Izingcindezi zezombusazwe nezomnotho zivame ukwenza izindawo zokulondolozwa zibe zincane, zingabi zinkulu, ngakho-ke ukubeka eceleni izindawo ezinkulu ngokwanele kunzima. Uma indawo ebekwe eceleni inkulu ngokwanele, kungase kungabi nendawo eyanele yokwakha isivikelo esizungeze indawo yokulondolozwa. Kulesi simo, indawo emaphethelweni angaphandle kwendawo yokulondolozwa ngokungenakugwenywa iba yindawo yokuhlala eyingozi kakhulu yezinhlobo ezikuleyo ndawo yokulondolozwa. Ukuphoqelelwa kokuvikelwa nakho kuyinkinga ebalulekile emazweni angenazo izinsiza noma intando yezepolitiki yokuvimbela ukuzingela ngokungemthetho kanye nokukhishwa kwezinsiza ngokungemthetho.

 Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuzodala izinkinga ezingenakugwenywa ngendawo yokugcina izilwane. Izinhlobo ezikuyo zizothuthela ezindaweni eziphakeme njengoba indawo yokuhlala yendawo yokulondolozwa iba yinto engafanele. Ososayensi bahlela imiphumela yokufudumala komhlaba ezindaweni zokulondolozwa zesikhathi esizayo futhi balwela ukubikezela isidingo sezindawo zokulondolozwa ezintsha ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezinguquko ezilindelwe ezindaweni zokuhlala; noma kunjalo, ukusebenza kahle kokugcina kuncane njengoba le mizamo isekelwe ekubikezelweni.

 Okokugcina, kungashiwo impikiswano yokuthi izindawo zokugcina imvelo ziqinisa umbono wamasiko wokuthi abantu bahlukile emvelweni, bangaba khona ngaphandle kwayo, futhi bangasebenza ngezindlela ezilimaza ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kuphela. Ukudala izindawo zokugcina imvelo kunciphisa ingcindezi emisebenzini yabantu ngaphandle kwezizinda zokugcina imvelo ukuze iqhubeke futhi ingabi yingozi ezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo. Ekugcineni, izingcindezi zezepolitiki, ezomnotho, kanye nezenhlalo yabantu zizowohloka futhi zinciphise usayizi wezizinda zokugcina imvelo uma imisebenzi engaphandle kwazo ingashintshwa ukuze ingabi yingozi kakhulu ezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo.
question1: Kungani izindawo zokugcina imvelo zivame ukuba zincane kunalokho ososayensi abakuncomayo?
answer1: Ngoba izingcindezi zezepolitiki nezomnotho zenza kube nzima ukubeka eceleni izindawo ezinkulu
distractor1a: Ngoba ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kuphezulu kakhulu ezindaweni ezincane zokuhlala
distractor1b: Ngoba izindawo ezinkulu zokugcina izilwane zandisa amazinga okuphela
distractor1c: Ngoba imikhawulo yemithetho yamazwe ngamazwe igcina usayizi
question2: Iyini imiphumela yokuthi izindawo zokugcina azinazo izindawo ezifanelekile zokuvikela?
answer2: Izinhlobo eziseduze nemiphetho yokulondolozwa zichayeka endaweni yokuhlala eyingozi kakhulu nengafaneleki
question3: Kungani ukuphoqelelwa komthetho kuyinselele enkulu ezindaweni eziningi zokugcina imvelo?
answer3: Amanye amazwe awanazo izinsiza noma intando yezepolitiki yokuvimbela ukuzingela ngokungemthetho kanye nokuqoqwa kwezinsiza ngokungemthetho
distractor3b: Izilwane zasendle ngokwemvelo ziyazigwema izindawo zokugcina imvelo
distractor3c: Izinhlobo ziyafuduka ngokushesha kakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa
question4: Ushintsho lwesimo sezulu kulindeleke ukuthi luzithinte kanjani izinhlobo eziphilayo ezihlala ezindaweni zokugcina izilwane?
answer4: Izinhlobo eziningi zizothuthela ezindaweni eziphakeme njengoba izindawo zazo zokuhlala zingasafaneleki
distractor4a: Izinhlobo zizohlala unomphela ngaphakathi kwemingcele yokulondolozwa
distractor4b: Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuzokwenza zonke izindawo zokugcina imvelo zibe zinhle kakhulu
question5: Kungani ukuhlela izindawo zokugcina imvelo zesikhathi esizayo ngaphansi kokushintsha kwesimo sezulu kunzima?
answer5: Ngoba izibikezelo mayelana nokushintsha kwezindawo zokuhlala zesikhathi esizayo aziqinisekile
distractor5a: Ngoba ushintsho lwesimo sezulu seluvele luyekile
distractor5c: Ngoba zonke izindawo zokuhlala zisabela ngendlela efanayo ekufudumaleni
question6: Yikuphi ukugxekwa kwezindawo zokugcina imvelo okukhulunywe ngakho kulesi sigaba?
answer6: Zingaqinisa umbono wokuthi abantu bahlukile emvelweni esikhundleni sokukhuthaza imikhuba eqhubekayo yonke indawo
distractor6a: Zikhuthaza ukuhlukahlukana kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ngokweqile
question7: Ngokusho kwendima, yini ekugcineni esongela impumelelo yesikhathi eside yezindawo zokulondoloza imvelo?
answer7: Imisebenzi yabantu engazinzile ngaphandle kwezindawo zokugcina imvelo eqhubeka nokulimaza ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor7a: Izinhlobo eziningi ezivikelwe ngaphakathi kwezindawo zokugcina imvelo
distractor7c: Ukungabikho kwezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane ezifuywayo

chapterName: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | 38.4 Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo | Ukulondolozwa Kwezindawo Zokulondolozwa | Ukubuyiselwa Kwezindawo Zokuhlala
chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | 38.4 Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo | Ukulondolozwa Kwezindawo Zokulondolozwa | Ukubuyiselwa Kwezindawo Zokuhlala
chapterContent:
Ukubuyiselwa kwendawo yokuhlala kunesithembiso esikhulu njengendlela yokubuyisela nokugcina ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo. Vele uma uhlobo seluphelile, ukubuyiselwa kwalo akunakwenzeka. Kodwa-ke, ukubuyiselwa kungathuthukisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo ezonakele. Ukuletha kabusha izimpisi, isilwane esidla ezinye izilwane, eYellowstone National Park ngo-1995 kwaholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu ohlelweni lwemvelo olwandise ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo. Izimpisi (Isithombe 38.18) zisebenza ukucindezela inani lezimpisi kanye nezimpisi futhi zinikeze izinsiza eziningi eqenjini lezimpisi ezidla izimpisi. Ukunciphisa inani lezimpisi kuye kwavumela ukutshalwa kabusha kwezindawo zasemanzini, okwandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo kuleyo ndawo yokuhlala. Ukunciphisa inani lezimpisi kuye kwandisa inani lezinhlobo ezazicindezelwe yilesi silwane esidla izimpisi ngaphambilini. Inani lezinhlobo zezimpisi ezidla izimpisi liye landa ngenxa yemisebenzi yezimpisi ezidla izimpisi. Kule ndawo yokuhlala, impisi iyinhlobo yetshe eliyinhloko, okusho uhlobo olubalulekile ekugcineni ukuhlukahluka ohlelweni lwemvelo. Ukususa uhlobo lwetshe eliyinhloko emphakathini wemvelo kungabangela ukuwohloka kokuhlukahluka. Imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwe-Yellowstone iphakamisa ukuthi ukubuyisela uhlobo lwe-keystone kungaba nomphumela wokubuyisela ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo eziphilayo emphakathini. Izazi zemvelo ziye zaphikisana ngokuhlonza izinhlobo ze-keystone lapho kungenzeka khona kanye nokugxila emizamweni yokuvikela kulezo zinhlobo; ngokufanayo, kunengqondo futhi ukuzama ukuzibuyisela endaweni yazo yokuphila uma zisusiwe.

 Ezinye izivivinyo ezinkulu zokubuyiselwa eziqhubekayo zihilela ukususwa kwedamu. E-United States, kusukela maphakathi nawo-1980, amadamu amaningi asebekhulile ayacatshangelwa ukususwa esikhundleni sokushintshwa ngenxa yezinkolelo ezishintshayo mayelana nenani lemvelo lemifula egeleza ngokukhululekile futhi ngoba amadamu amaningi awasanikezi izinzuzo nemisebenzi ayeyenza lapho eqala ukwakhiwa. Izinzuzo ezilinganisiwe zokususwa kwedamu zifaka phakathi ukubuyiselwa kwamazinga amanzi ashintshashintshayo ngokwemvelo (inhloso yamadamu ivame ukunciphisa ukuhlukahluka kokugeleza kwemifula), okuholela ekwandeni kokuhlukahluka kwezinhlanzi kanye nekhwalithi yamanzi ethuthukisiwe. E-Pacific Northwest, amaphrojekthi okususa amadamu kulindeleke ukuthi andise inani le-salmon, elibhekwa njengohlobo lwe-keystone ngoba lithutha izakhamzimba ezibalulekile ezindaweni zemvelo zangaphakathi ngesikhathi sokufuduka kwalo kwaminyaka yonke. Kwezinye izifunda ezifana nogu lwase-Atlantic, ukususwa kwedamu kuye kwavumela ukubuya kwezinhlobo zezinhlanzi ezingenamsebenzi (izinhlobo ezizalelwa emanzini ahlanzekile, eziphila impilo yazo eminingi emanzini anosawoti, bese zibuyela emanzini ahlanzekile ukuze ziyozala). Eminye yemisebenzi emikhulu yokususwa kwedamu ayikakenzeki noma yenzeke muva nje kakhulu ukuba imiphumela ingalinganiswa. Ukuhlolwa okukhulu kwemvelo okwakhiwa yile misebenzi yokususwa kuzohlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile yeminye imisebenzi yamadamu ehlelelwe ukususwa noma ukwakhiwa.
question1: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko yokuvuselela indawo yokuhlala?
answer1: Ukuthuthukisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo zezindawo zemvelo ezonakele
question2: Kungani ukubuyiselwa kwendawo yokuhlala kungenakukwazi ukubuyisela zonke izinhlobo ezilahlekile?
answer2: Ngoba uma uhlobo oluthile seluphelile, alukwazi ukubuyiselwa
distractor2a: Ngoba izinhlobo eziphelile zihlala ziguquka zibe izinhlobo ezintsha
distractor2c: Ngoba izinhlobo eziphelile ziyathuthela kwenye indawo
question3: Yimuphi umphumela omkhulu wemvelo owalandela ukubuyiselwa kwezimpisi eYellowstone National Park?
answer3: Ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kwanda kuyo yonke indawo
question4: Izimpisi zakhulisa kanjani ukuhlukahluka kwezitshalo eYellowstone?
answer4: Ngokunciphisa inani lama-elk, okuvumela izitshalo zasemanzini ukuthi ziphinde zikhule
question5: Ukubuyiselwa kwezimpisi kwabathinta kanjani abantu abahlukahlukene bezimpisi?
answer5: Ukuhlasela kwezimpisi kunciphisa inani lama-coyote, okuvumela ezinye izinhlobo ukuba zande
distractor5a: Ama-coyote athatha indawo yezimpisi njengezilwane ezidla ezinye
question6: Kungani inani lezinhlobo ezidla ingcuba landa ngemva kokubuya kwezimpisi?
answer6: Ukubulawa kwezimpisi kunikeze ukudla okwengeziwe kwabaqoqi bezinto ezingafuneki
distractor6a: Ama-Wolves aqede bonke abancintisana nabo be-scavengers
distractor6b: Abadli benyama yenkomo baqala ukuzingela ama-elk ngokwabo
distractor6c: Imifino yaba umthombo wabo oyinhloko wokudla
question7: Kungani izimpisi zibhekwa njengezinhlobo ze-keystone eYellowstone?
answer7: Ngoba ukuba khona kwazo kusiza ekulondolozeni ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kuyo yonke indawo
distractor7b: Ngoba yizona zilwane ezincelisayo ezinkulu kunazo zonke epaki
question8: Yini engase yenzeke uma uhlobo oluthile lwe-keystone lususwa endaweni ezungezile?
answer8: I-ecosystem ingase ibhekane nokuwohloka kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo
distractor8b: Isimiso sezinto eziphilayo siba sizinzile kakhulu
question9: Kungani amadamu amaningi asebekhulile esuswa e-United States?
answer9: Ukubuyisela imvelo yemifula yemvelo nokuthuthukisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo
question10: Yiziphi izinzuzo zemvelo ezivame ukuvela ngokususwa kwedamu?
answer10: Ukwehlukahlukana kwezinhlanzi okuthuthukisiwe kanye nekhwalithi yamanzi engcono
question11: Kungani i-salmon ibhekwa njengohlobo lwe-keystone eNyakatho-ntshonalanga yePacific?
answer11: Ngoba ukufuduka kwe-salmon kuthutha izakhamzimba ezibalulekile ezindaweni zemvelo zangaphakathi nezwe
distractor11a: Ngoba i-salmon iyinhlanzi enkulu kunazo zonke emanzini ahlanzekile
answer12: Izinhlanzi ezizalelwa emanzini ahlanzekile, ziphila impilo yazo eningi emanzini anosawoti, bese zibuyela emanzini ahlanzekile ukuze ziyozala
distractor12a: Izinhlanzi ezichitha impilo yazo yonke emanzini ahlanzekile
distractor12b: Izinhlanzi ezichitha impilo yazo yonke olwandle
distractor12c: Izinhlanzi ezifuduka zisuka emanzini ahlanzekile ziye ezweni ukuze zizale

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwemvelo | 38.4 Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo | Ukulondolozwa Kwemvelo Ezindaweni Zokulondolozwa | Indima Yokuzalana Okuthunjiwe
chapterContent: Ama-zoo afune ukudlala indima emizamweni yokulondoloza kokubili ngokusebenzisa i-pro yokuzalanisa evalelwe grams kanye nemfundo. Ukuguqulwa kwemisebenzi yama-zoo kusukela ezindaweni zokuqoqa kanye nezokubukisa kuya ezinhlanganweni ezizinikele ekulondolozeni kuyaqhubeka. Ngokuvamile, kuye kwaqashelwa ukuthi, ngaphandle kwezinye izimo ezithile eziqondiwe, i-pro yokuzalanisa evalelwe grams yezinhlobo ezisengozini yokuqothulwa ayisebenzi kahle futhi ivame ukwehluleka lapho izinhlobo zibuyiselwa endle. Izikhungo zama-zoo zilinganiselwe kakhulu ukucabanga ngokuzalanisa i-pro grams evalelwe ngenani lezinhlobo ezisengozini manje. Imfundo ingenye imiphumela emihle engaba khona yama-zoo emizamweni yokulondoloza, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa ukuthambekela komhlaba wonke kokukhula kwamadolobha kanye nokunciphisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu nezilwane zasendle. Izifundo eziningana zenziwe ukubheka ukusebenza kahle kwama-zoo emibonweni nasezenzweni zabantu mayelana nokulondolozwa; okwamanje, imiphumela ivame ukuxubana.
question1: Iyiphi indima ama-zoo anamuhla ayisebenzisa kakhulu?
answer1: Izinhlangano ezizinikele ekulondolozweni kwemvelo ngokufuya nokufuya okuvalelwe
question2: Kungani i-pro-breeding generating pro grams ngokuvamile ibhekwa njengeqhinga lokulondoloza elilinganiselwe?
answer2: Ngokuvamile aziphumeleli kahle futhi izilwane eziningi ezibuyiselwe azikwazi ukwakha izilwane zasendle
distractor2b: Ama-zoo awavunyelwe ukudedela izilwane ziye endle
question3: Kungani ama-zoo engenciki ekuzaleni izilwane ezivalelwe ukuze asindise zonke izinhlobo zezilwane ezisengozini yokuqothulwa?
answer3: Izindawo ze-zoo zilinganiselwe kakhulu ukuba zizalane futhi zigcine inani elikhulu lezinhlobo ezisengozini
distractor3a: Izinhlobo ezisengozini yokuqothulwa azikwazi ukuzala lapho zithunjiwe
question4: Ngaphandle kokuzalanisa izilwane ezivalelwe, yiliphi igalelo elikhulu ama-zoo angalinikela ekulondolozweni kwazo?
answer4: Ukufundisa umphakathi ngokulondolozwa kwezilwane zasendle kanye nokuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo
question5: Kungani imfundo yezilwane iba yinto ebaluleke kakhulu?
answer5: Ngoba ukufudukela emadolobheni kunciphise ukuxhumana kwabantu ngqo nezilwane zasendle
distractor5a: Ngoba abantu abaningi manje bahlala emahlathini
distractor5b: Ngoba izilwane zasendle sekulula ukuzibona ngokwemvelo
distractor5c: Ngoba izinhlobo ezisengozini yokuphela zikhona emadolobheni kuphela
question6: Yini izifundo eziye zaphetha ngayo ngokusebenza kahle kwama-zoo ekushintsheni izimo zengqondo kanye nokuziphatha kwabantu ngokulondolozwa kwemvelo?
answer6: Imiphumela ixubile
distractor6a: Ama-zoo ahlala ekhiqiza izinguquko ezinhle kakhulu
distractor6c: Ama-zoo ahlala enciphisa ukwesekwa kokulondolozwa kwemvelo

chapterContent:
imisebe eguquguqukayo
ukuhlangana okusheshayo ngokuhlukaniswa kwesihlahla se-phylogenetic sibe izinhlobo eziningi ezihlobene eduze

 ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo
uhlobo lwesistimu yezinto eziphilayo, evame ukubhekwa njengenani lezinhlobo, kodwa futhi isetshenziswa ku-genes, biochemistry, kanye ne-ecosystems

 indawo eshisayo yezinto eziphilayo
umqondo owasungulwa nguNorman Myers ukuchaza indawo enezinhlobo eziningi zezinto eziphilayo kanye nephesenti elikhulu lendawo yokuhlala eyonakele

 inyama yasehlathini
isilwane esibanjwe endle esisetshenziswa njengokudla (ngokuvamile izilwane ezincelisayo, izinyoni, nezilwane ezihuquzelayo); ngokuvamile kubhekiselwa ekuzingeleni ezindaweni ezishisayo zase-Afrika engaphansi kweSahara, e-Asia, naseMelika

 ukuhlukahluka kwamakhemikhali
ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo amakhilogremu endaweni ephilayo

 chytridiomycosis
isifo sama-amphibians esibangelwa yi-fungus i-Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis; okucatshangwa ukuthi siyimbangela enkulu yokwehla kwama-amphibian emhlabeni jikelele

I-DNA barcode
indlela yezakhi zofuzo zama-molecule yokuhlonza ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo okuhlukile okuhlobana nohlobo

 ukuhlukahluka kwezindawo zemvelo

 izinhlobo ezitholakala endaweni eyodwa

 izinhlobo ezingavamile
(futhi, izinhlobo ezihlaselayo) izinhlobo ezethulwe endaweni zemvelo lapho zingaguqukanga khona

 ukushabalala
ukunyamalala kohlobo oluvela eMhlabeni; ukunyamalala kwendawo ukunyamalala kohlobo oluvela esifundeni

 izinga lokunyamalala
inani lezinhlobo ezinyamalala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngezinye izikhathi lichazwa njengokuphela kwezinhlobo ngezigidi zeminyaka ukuze kwenziwe izinombolo zilawuleke (E/MSY)

 ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo
izinhlobo ezahlukene zezakhi zofuzo ohlotsheni noma kwelinye iqembu le-taxonomic noma i-ecosystem, leli gama lingabhekisela ekuhlukeni kwe-allelic noma ukuhlukahluka kwe-genome

ukungafani
inani lezindawo zemvelo

 izinyoni ezinkulu
izilwane ezinkulu

 inhlanganisela yesitshalo sesibili
inhlanganisela ekhiqizwa njengemikhiqizo yezinqubo ze-metabolic zezitshalo ezivame ukuba yingozi, kodwa ezithathwa yisitshalo ukuze zivikele ezidla uhlaza

 ubudlelwano bezinhlobo nendawo
ubudlelwano phakathi kwendawo ehlolwe kanye nenani lezinhlobo ezihlangatshezwayo; ngokuvamile kulinganiswa ngokukhulisa kancane kancane indawo yocwaningo kanye nokunquma izinombolo eziqongelelekayo zezinhlobo
inhlekelele yezindawo ezivamile
isimiso sezomnotho sokuthi izinsiza ezigcinwe ndawonye zizosetshenziswa ngokweqile ngokungenakugwenywa

 i-white-nose syndrome
isifo samalulwane ahlala ebusika emihumeni empumalanga ye-United States naseCanada esihlotshaniswa nesikhunta i-Pseudogymnoascus destructans
question1: Iyini imisebe eguquguqukayo?
answer1: Ukukhula ngokushesha ngokusebenzisa izinhlobo ezahlukene kube izinhlobo eziningi ezihlobene eduze
distractor1b: Ukufuduka kwezinhlobo zezilwane ziye ezindaweni ezintsha zokuhlala
question2: Kuchaza ukuthini ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo?
answer2: Izinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo, okuhlanganisa izinhlobo, izakhi zofuzo, i-biochemistry, kanye nezindawo zemvelo
distractor2c: Ukwehlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kuphela ngaphakathi kwabantu
question3: Iyini indawo ethandwa kakhulu yizinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo?
answer3: Isifunda esinezinhlobo eziningi zezilwane ezitholakala kalula kanye nokuwohloka okukhulu kwendawo yokuhlala
distractor3c: Indawo lapho ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kuphansi khona ngokwemvelo
question4: Iyini inyama yehlathi?
answer4: Izilwane ezibanjwe endle zisetshenziswa njengokudla, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezishisayo
distractor4a: Imfuyo efuywayo efuywe ukuze idliwe inyama
question5: Kuyini ukuhlukahluka kwamakhemikhali?
answer5: Izinhlobo ezahlukene ze-metabolic com amakhilogremu ezitholakala ngaphakathi kwe-ecosystem
question6: Kuyini i-chytridiomycosis?
answer6: Isifo sefungus sama-amphibians esibangelwa yi-Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis
question7: Kuyini i-DNA barcode?
answer7: Indlela yofuzo yama-molecule esetshenziswa ukuhlonza izinhlobo ngezinhlobo ze-DNA ezihlukile
distractor7a: Indlela yokwenza izinhlobo zezilwane ezisengozini yokuqothulwa
distractor7c: Inqubo esetshenziswa ukukala ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo ngokubala abantu ngabanye
question8: Kuyini ukuhlukahluka kwezindawo zemvelo?
answer8: Izinhlobonhlobo zezindawo zemvelo esifundeni noma eMhlabeni
distractor8b: Ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ngaphakathi kohlobo oluthile
distractor8c: Inani lezilwane ezidla ezinye ezidla ezinye ezisogwini lokudla
question9: Luyini uhlobo olutholakala kalula?
answer9: Uhlobo oluvela endaweni eyodwa kuphela
question10: Luyini uhlobo olungavamile (oluhlaselayo)?
answer10: Uhlobo olufakwe endaweni ezungezile lapho lungazange luvele khona
distractor10a: Uhlobo oluvela endaweni ethandwa kakhulu yizinto eziphilayo
distractor11a: Ukufuduka kohlobo oluthile luye endaweni entsha yokuhlala
distractor12a: Inani lezinhlobo ezintsha ezishintsha minyaka yonke
distractor12b: Izinga lapho izinto eziphilayo zakhiwa khona
answer13: Izinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo ngaphakathi kohlobo noma i-ecosystem
distractor14a: Inani lezilwane ezidla ezinye ezidla ezinye ezisogwini lokudla
answer16: Umkhiqizo ophumayo we-metabolic, ngokuvamile onobuthi, osiza ukuvikela izitshalo ezifweni ezidla uhlaza
distractor16c: I-hormone ekhiqizwa kuphela ngesikhathi sokuqhakaza kwezimbali
answer17: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwendawo ehloliwe kanye nenani lezinhlobo ezitholakele
distractor17a: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwesimo sezulu kanye nezinga lokuphela
distractor17b: Ubudlelwano phakathi kobukhulu bomzimba nendawo yokuhlala
distractor17c: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezilwane ezidla ezinye kanye nezilwane ezidla ezinye
answer18: Isimiso sokuthi izinsiza ezabiwe zivame ukusetshenziswa kabi kakhulu
distractor18a: Ukuphela kwazo zonke izinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo endaweni ezungezile
distractor18b: Ukulahleka kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ngenxa yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuphela
distractor18c: Ukuwa kwezindawo zokudla ngenxa yezinhlobo ezihlaselayo
answer19: Isifo sefungus samalulwane ahlala ebusika emihumeni esibangelwa yi-Pseudogymnoascus destructans

chapterNameEnglish: 8. I-Ecology | 38. I-Biology Yokulondolozwa Kwemvelo Nokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 38.6 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
38.1 Inkinga Yokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo
Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo kukhona emazingeni ahlukahlukene okuhlela futhi kulinganiswa ngezindlela ezahlukene kuye ngezinhloso zalabo abathatha izilinganiso. Lezi zilinganiso zifaka phakathi inani lezinhlobo, ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo, ukuhlukahluka kwamakhemikhali, kanye nokuhlukahluka kwezindawo eziphilayo. Inani lezinhlobo ezichazwe kulinganiselwa ukuthi liyizigidi ezingu-1.5 kanti izinhlobo ezintsha ezingaba ngu-17,000 zichazwa minyaka yonke. Izilinganiso zenani eliphelele lezinhlobo eMhlabeni ziyahlukahluka kodwa zilingana nezigidi eziyi-10. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo kuhlobene kabi ne-latitude yezinhlobo eziningi, okusho ukuthi ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kuphakeme ezindaweni ezishisayo. Indlela yokusebenza yale ndlela ayaziwa ngokuqiniseka, kodwa imibono eminingana enengqondo iye yathuthukiswa.

 Ukuqothulwa kwezinto ezinhlanu ngobuningi kanye nokulahlekelwa okungaphezu kwamaphesenti angama-50 ezinhlobo ezikhona ziyabonakala kurekhodi lamathambo. Izikhathi zokubuyiselwa kokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo ngemva kokuqothulwa kwezinto eziningi ziyahlukahluka, kodwa ziye zaba yiminyaka eyizigidi ezingama-30. Ukuqothulwa kwamuva kubhalwe emlandweni obhaliwe futhi kuyisisekelo sendlela eyodwa yokulinganisa amazinga okuqothulwa kwanamuhla. Enye indlela isebenzisa izindlela zokulinganisa ukulahlekelwa kwendawo yokuhlala kanye nobudlelwano bezinhlobo nezindawo. Izilinganiso zamazinga okuphela kwezitshalo zanamuhla ziyahlukahluka, kodwa amanye amazinga aphezulu ngokuphindwe ka-500 kunesilinganiso se-bac kg, njengoba kunqunywe kurekhodi lamathambo, futhi kubikezelwa ukuthi azokhuphuka.

 38.2 Ukubaluleka Kokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo Ekuphileni Komuntu
Abantu basebenzisa ama-com amakhilogremu amaningi atholwa noma atholakala ezintweni eziphilayo njengemithi: izitshalo zesibili amakhilogremu, ubuthi bezilwane, kanye nama-antibiotic akhiqizwa amabhaktheriya kanye nesikhunta. Kulindeleke ukuthi kutholakale imithi eminingi emvelweni. Ukulahlekelwa kokuhlukahluka kwezitshalo kuzothinta inani lemithi etholakalayo kubantu.

 Ukuhlukahluka kwezitshalo kuyimfuneko yokuvikeleka kokudla, futhi kuyalahleka. Ukulahlekelwa yizihlobo zasendle ezitshalweni nakho kusongela amakhono abalimi bokudala izinhlobo ezintsha. Izinhlelo zemvelo zihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zemvelo ezisekela ezolimo zabantu: ukuvundisa impova, ukujikeleza kwezakhamzimba, ukulawulwa kwezinambuzane, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwenhlabathi nokugcinwa kwayo. Ukulahlekelwa kokuhlukahluka kwezitshalo kusongela lezi zinsizakalo zemvelo futhi kuyingozi yokwenza ukukhiqizwa kokudla kubize kakhulu noma kungenzeki. Imithombo yokudla kwasendle ikakhulukazi itholakala emanzini, kodwa imbalwa ephathwayo ukuze kuqhubeke isikhathi eside. Amandla okudoba ukunikeza amaprotheni kubantu ayasongelwa lapho kwenzeka ukuqothulwa.

 Ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kunganikeza izinzuzo ezibalulekile zengqondo kubantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezimpikiswano zokuziphatha zokugcinwa kokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo.

 38.3 Izinsongo Zokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo
Izinsongo eziyinhloko zokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo ukukhula kwabantu kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza okungazinzile. Kuze kube manje, izimbangela ezibaluleke kakhulu zokuqothulwa kwemvelo ukulahleka kwendawo yokuhlala, ukungeniswa kwezinhlobo ezingavamile, kanye nokuvuna ngokweqile. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kubikezelwa ukuthi kuyimbangela ebalulekile yokuqothulwa kwemvelo ekhulwini elizayo. Ukulahlekelwa yindawo yokuhlala kwenzeka ngokugawulwa kwamahlathi, ukuvinjelwa kwemifula, neminye imisebenzi. Ukuvunwa ngokweqile kuyisongo ikakhulukazi ezinhlotsheni zasemanzini, kuyilapho ukudla inyama yasehlathini ezindaweni ezishisayo ezinomswakama kusongela izinhlobo eziningi e-Asia, e-Afrika naseMelika. Izinhlobo ezingavamile ziye zaba yimbangela yokuqothulwa okuningi futhi zilimaza kakhulu iziqhingi namachibi. Ukwethulwa kwezinhlobo ezingavamile kuyanda ngenxa yokwanda kokuhamba kwabantu kanye nokukhula kokuhweba kanye nokuhamba komhlaba wonke. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuphoqa izinguquko ezinhlobonhlobo ezingase ziholele ekuqothulweni. Kuphinde kuthinte ukuzivumelanisa nesikhathi sokutholakala kwezinsiza ezithinta kabi izinhlobo ezindaweni zonyaka. Imiphumela yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu mikhulu kakhulu e-Arctic. Ukufudumala komhlaba kuzophakamisa amazinga olwandle, kuqede ezinye iziqhingi futhi kunciphise indawo yazo zonke ezinye.

 38.4 Ukulondoloza Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo
Izindlela ezintsha zobuchwepheshe ezifana ne-DNA barcode kanye nokucubungula ulwazi kanye nokufinyeleleka kwenza kube lula ukuhlelwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo zeplanethi. Kukhona futhi uhlaka lwezomthetho lokuvikelwa kokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo. Izivumelwano zamazwe ngamazwe ezifana ne-CITES zilawula ukuthuthwa kwezinhlobo ezisengozini yokuphela kwemingcele yamazwe ngamazwe. Imithetho ngaphakathi kwamazwe ngamanye evikela izinhlobo kanye nezivumelwano ngokufudumala komhlaba ziye zaba nempumelelo elinganiselwe; okwamanje akukho sivumelwano samazwe ngamazwe mayelana nezinhloso zokukhishwa kwamagesi okushisa umhlaba. E-United States, uMthetho Wezinhlobo Ezisengozini Yokushabalala uvikela izinhlobo ezisohlwini kodwa uphazanyiswa ubunzima benqubo kanye nokugxila ezinhlotsheni ngazinye. UMthetho Wezinyoni Ezifudukayo uyisivumelwano phakathi kweCanada ne-United States sokuvikela izinyoni ezifudukayo. Umkhakha ongenzi nzuzo nawo usebenza kakhulu emizamweni yokonga ngezindlela ezahlukene.

 Izindawo zokugcina imvelo ziyithuluzi elikhulu ekuvikelweni kwezinto eziphilayo. Njengamanje, amaphesenti ayi-11 omhlaba womhlaba avikelwe ngandlela thile. Isayensi ye-biogeography yesiqhingi iye yazisa ukwakheka okuhle kwezilondolozi; nokho, izindawo zokugcina zinemingcele ebekwe amandla ezepolitiki nezomnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kuzonciphisa ukusebenza kwezilondolozi esikhathini esizayo. Inkinga yezilondolozi ukuthi zinganciphisa ingcindezi emphakathini wabantu ukuthi isebenze ngokuqhubekayo ngaphandle kwezilondolozi.

 Ukubuyiselwa kwendawo yokuhlala kunamandla okubuyisela izindawo zemvelo emazingeni ezinhlobo eziphilayo zangaphambilini ngaphambi kokuba izinhlobo ziphele. Izibonelo zokubuyiselwa zihlanganisa ukubuyiselwa kwezinhlobo ze-keystone kanye nokususwa kwamadamu emifuleni. Izindawo zokugcina imvelo ziye zazama ukuthatha indima ekhuthele kakhulu ekulondolozeni futhi zingaba nendima elinganiselwe ekuzaleni okuvalelwe amagremu. Izindawo zokugcina imvelo nazo zingaba nendima ewusizo emfundweni
