Usebenzisa lesi simo, chaza ukuthi ukulahlekelwa kwezinto eziphilayo kungathinta kanjani ukuhlukahluka kwezitshalo
answer43: Ukulahlekelwa kwezinhlobo zasendle kunganciphisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ngoba izakhi zofuzo ezivela ezihlotsheni zasendle zisetshenziselwa ukwethula izici ezibalulekile ezinhlotsheni zezitshalo
distractor43a: Ukulahlekelwa kwezinhlobo zasendle kungabangela ukucindezeleka kokuzalanisa izinhlobo ezifanayo ngoba izinhlobo zezitshalo kumele zizalane njalo nezinhlobo zasendle ukuze zihlale ziphila.
distractor43b: Ukulahlekelwa yizinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo kunciphisa ukutshalwa kwezitshalo eziningi kodwa kuqinisa ukufana kwezakhi zofuzo, okubangela ukulahlekelwa ukuhlukahluka kwezitshalo
distractor43c: Ukulahlekelwa kwezinhlobo zasendle kuzokwandisa ukuhlukahluka okuqondile ngaphakathi kwezinhlobo zezitshalo ngenkathi kunciphisa ukuhlukahluka kwezitshalo okuqondile
question44: Bikezela imiphumela yokuwa kwesimo sezinyosi esifundazweni esikhulu sezolimo njengeCalifornia
answer44: Ukuntuleka kwezinambuzane ezithutha impova kuzonciphisa ngqo ukuvunwa kwezithelo futhi kuthinte ngokungaqondile izimboni ezifana nokukhiqizwa koju kanye nejamu
distractor44a: Ukukhiqizwa kwemithi kanye nokukhiqizwa koju kuphela okuzothinteka
distractor44b: Ezinye izinambuzane zizothatha indawo yezinyosi zoju, ngakho-ke isivuno somkhiqizo ngeke sithinteke kakhulu
distractor44c: Ukukhiqizwa koju kuzokwehla, kodwa ukuvunwa kwezithelo ngeke kwehle ngoba ezinye izinambuzane zizokhokhela ngokugcwele
question45: Izibulala-zinambuzane eziningi zamakhemikhali zitholakala ngokwemvelo emagxolweni nasemaqabungeni ezitshalo zasezindaweni ezishisayo. Kungani ukukhiqiza lezi com amakhilogremu kuzuzisa kakhulu ezindaweni ezishisayo?
answer45: Izitshalo kumele zizivikele unyaka wonke ngoba ubusika obushisayo abuziqedi izinambuzane eziyingozi njengoba ubusika obufudumele buvame ukwenza
distractor45a: Izibulala-zinambuzane ezisetshenziswa ngabantu azisebenzi ezindaweni ezishisayo
distractor45b: I-com amakhilogremu ithuthukisa kakhulu ukululama ekulimaleni kwemvelo
distractor45c: I-com amakhilogremu ngokuyinhloko ilawula ukukhula nokuziphatha kwezitshalo zasezindaweni ezishisayo
question46: Chaza ukuthi ukwanda kosayizi wabantu kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza kwandisa kanjani amazinga okuphela ngokushintsha izimiso zemvelo
answer46: Ukwanda kwabantu kuholela ekusetshenzisweni kwezinsiza okungazinzile, ukubhujiswa kwezindawo zokuhlala, ukudoba ngokweqile, ukuzingela ngokweqile, kanye nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu okubangelwa ukusetshenziswa kukaphethiloli wezinto zasendulo.
distractor46a: Ukukhula kwenani labantu kunciphisa kakhulu ukuvela kwezinhlobo ezintsha ngokubhujiswa kwendawo yokuhlala kanye nokuvuna ngokweqile
distractor46b: Ukwanda kwabantu kunciphisa kakhulu inani lezinhlanzi ngoba ukusetshenziswa ngokweqile kukaphethiloli wezinsalela kuthinta ngqo imvelo yasemanzini
distractor46c: Ukwanda kwabantu kunciphisa kakhulu inani lemikhiqizo etholakala ezinhlotsheni zezilwane, okuholela ekuqothulweni kwazo
question47: Njengomlondolozi wemvelo olungiselela umbiko ngenani lamaxoxo ahlala eceleni kwentaba eCosta Rica, yiziphi izinsongo okufanele uzibone?
answer47: Ixoxo lisengozini yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, izinhlobo ezingavamile, kanye nokubhujiswa okungenzeka kwendawo yokuhlala
distractor47a: Ixoxo lisengozini yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ukubhujiswa kwendawo yokuhlala, kanye nezilwane ezidla ezinye ezinolaka
distractor47b: Ixoxo lisengozini yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ukubhujiswa kwendawo yokuhlala, kanye nokutholakala kokudla okulinganiselwe
distractor47c: Ixoxo lisengozini yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, izinhlobo ezingavamile kanye nokuzingela ngokweqile
question48: Izazi zezifo zibikezela ukuthi izifo ezifana negciwane laseWest Nile, umkhuhlane we-dengue, kanye nomalaleveva zingase zande ezindaweni zazo. Uma amagciwane kungama-virus noma ama-protist, angasakazeka kanjani ngokushesha ezindaweni ezinkulu?
distractor48c: Ngokuthintana ngqo nabantu okubangelwa ukwanda kokuchayeka ehlane
question49: Bheka uMfanekiso 38.20. Ngawo-1920, izimpisi zasuswa eYellowstone National Park. Inani lezimpisi landa kwaze kwaba yilapho izimpisi ziphinde zavela ngawo-1990. Ngokusekelwe kugrafu, yisiphi isimangalo esingenziwa mayelana nenani lezimpisi, izimpisi kanye nezimpisi?
answer49: Izinhlobo ze-willow zithinteka kabi yizinhlobo ze-elk uma izimpisi zingekho
distractor49a: Izinhlobo ze-willow azithinteki yizinhlobo ze-elk noma zezimpisi
distractor49b: Izinhlobo ze-willow zithinteka kahle yizinhlobo ze-elk uma izimpisi zingekho
distractor49c: Akukho ulwazi olwanele lokwenza isimangalo kulolu cwaningo
question50: ISivumelwano Sokuhweba Kwamazwe Ngamazwe Ngezinhlobo Ezisengozini Yokushabalala (CITES) sivikela obhejane, abaye bazingelwa izimpondo zabo. Kungani ukuvikelwa kobhejane kudinga isivumelwano samazwe ngamazwe?
answer50: Obhejane bayazingelwa emazweni abo, kodwa ukuhweba ngezimpondo zabo kweqa imingcele yamazwe ngamazwe
distractor50a: Ukusetshenziswa kwezimpondo zikabhejane njengomuthi wokukhuthaza ukuthandwa kwezilwane kunemiphumela emibi emhlabeni jikelele
distractor50b: Abazingeli abavela emazweni ahlukene baya ezweni labo lokuzalwa ukuyozingela ama-rhinocerose
distractor50c: Isidingo sezimpondo zobhejane sikhulu emazweni angaphandle kunasemazweni abo okuzalwa.
question51: Kuklanywa indawo yokugcina izilwane enabantu abaningi basemadolobheni. Yimuphi umklamo ophelele ongalondoloza kangcono imvelo yendawo?
answer51: Setha izindawo eziningana ezinkulu ezizobekwa eceleni ukuze zisetshenziselwe imvelo yemvelo
distractor51b: Khetha indawo encane eyodwa ehlukanisiwe nezindawo zokuhlala
distractor51c: Hlela izindawo zokuvimba ezizungeze zonke izindawo zasemuva
question52: Izimpisi ziyizinhlobo eziyinhloko eYellowstone National Park. Kungenzeka yini ukuthi kwenzeke uma bezingelwa zize ziphele?
answer52: Izinhlobo eziningi bezizonyamalala futhi inani lama-elk lizokwanda
distractor52a: Izinhlobo eziningi bezizokwanda futhi inani lama-elk lizonyamalala
distractor52b: Izinhlobo eziningi kanye nenani lama-elk kuzokwanda kokubili
distractor52c: Izinhlobo eziningi kanye nenani lama-elk kuzonyamalala kokubili
question53: Kungani izivumelwano zemvelo zomhlaba wonke ziye zaba nzima ukuzisebenzisa?
answer53: Amazwe asayine izivumelwano avame ukungalandeli izibopho zawo, futhi akukho nhlangano ebusayo yokuphoqelela ukuvikelwa kwemvelo kwamazwe ngamazwe
distractor53a: Izizwe ezisayinile ngokuvamile ziyazigcina izibopho zazo, kodwa akukho nhlangano ebusayo ekhona
distractor53b: Izizwe ezisayinile azilandeli izibopho zazo, kodwa indikimba ebusayo iqinisekisa ukuvikelwa kwemvelo kwamazwe ngamazwe
distractor53c: Izizwe ezisayinile ziyazigcina izibopho zazo, futhi kukhona indikimba ebusayo, kodwa ayikho neyodwa yazo esebenzayo
question54: Bheka uMfanekiso 38.21. Abafundi bahlaziya izinhlamvu zempova kanye nezinhlamvu ze-fern ezitholwe ezidakeni ezithathwe ngaphansi nangaphezulu komngcele we-Cretaceous-Paleogene. Yisiphi isiphetho esisekelwa kangcono yigrafu mayelana nomthelela wokuqothulwa kwezitshalo eziningi?
answer54: Ama-fern ayemaningi kakhulu ngemva kokuphela kwe-Cretaceous-Paleogene (K-Pg) mass kunangaphambili.
distractor54a: Ukuphela okukhulu kwesitshalo kunciphise inani lama-fern nama-angiosperm
distractor54b: Ngokusekelwe ekubalweni kwempova okuncishisiwe, ukuqothulwa kwenqwaba yezitshalo kunciphisa ngokusobala kokubili ama-fern nama-angiosperms
question55: Bheka Umfanekiso 38.21. Kungani ama-fern spores abonise ukwanda okukhulu ngokushesha ngemva kokuphela kwe-K-Pg mass?
answer55: Ama-fern angabantu bokuqala abahlala emakoloni akhula ngokushesha enhlabathini empofu futhi azale ngokushesha. Ukuqothulwa okukhulu kwashiya nezizinda eziningi ezingenalutho ezingase zihlale ezinhlotsheni ezisindile.
distractor55a: Ama-fern asheshe athatha indawo yama-angiosperms ngoba ancintisana nawo unomphela
distractor55b: Ukuqothulwa okukhulu kwavumela izinhlobo ezintsha ze-fern ukuba zivele ngokushesha futhi zigcwalise izindawo ezingenalutho
distractor55c: Izinhlobo eziningi ze-fern zaphela, okuvumela uhlobo olulodwa olusele ukuba lubuse
question56: Bheka uMfanekiso 38.22. Abafundi bafuna izinsalela zesikhathi samaDevoni. Ngokusekelwe esifinyezweni sokuphela, yiluphi uhlelo olufanele kakhulu?
answer56: Ukubheka ezingqimbeni ezingaphansi komhlaba eduze kwamanzi ukuthola izinsalela zasolwandle ezifana nama-bivalves nama-trilobites
distractor56a: Ukusesha ngokuvundlile kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lwedwala ukuthola izendlalelo ezinenani elikhulu kakhulu lezinsalela zasendulo
distractor56b: Ukuqoqa izinsalela ezibekwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi samaPermian eziqukethe amathambo ezilwane ezinomgogodla zakuqala
distractor56c: Ukusebenzisa ukuqomisana okuhlobene ukubala izinga lokwahlukaniswa kwezinto eziphilayo zakuqala
question57: Bheka Umfanekiso 38.23. Abafundi bahlunge izinhlamvu zempova ze-angiosperm ezitholwe ngaphansi nangaphezulu komngcele we-Cretaceous-Paleogene ngokwesimo sazo. Yisiphi isincazelo esifanelana kahle nemiphumela?
answer57: Ukuqothulwa okukhulu kwenani lezinto eziphilayo, okuboniswe yizinhlayiya zempova ezimbalwa, kanye nokuncipha kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo, okuboniswe yizinhlayiya zempova ezimbalwa.
distractor57a: Ukuqothulwa kwenqwaba kunciphisa inani lezinto eziphilayo, okukhonjiswa yizimo zempova ezimbalwa, kanye nokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo, okukhonjiswa yinani eliphansi.
distractor57b: Ukuqothulwa kwenqwaba kunciphise inani eliphelele lezinto eziphilayo, okuboniswe yizinhlayiya zempova ezimbalwa.
distractor57c: Ukuqothulwa kwenqwaba kunciphisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo, okuboniswa ukwakheka okuncane kwembewu yempova
question58: Bheka uMfanekiso 38.22. Izinsalela ezihlanganisa amagobolondo e-bivalve, izingcezu zamakhorali, uphawu lwe-trilobite, kanye nama-vertebrae aneminyaka eyizigidi ezingu-250 edlule atholakala epulazini elicebile nge-calcium carbonate. Yisiphi isiphetho esinengqondo kakhulu?
answer58: Indawo yokulima cishe yayiyingxenye yolwandle ngesikhathi samaPermian
question59: Bheka uMfanekiso 38.24. Amazinga okushisa ajwayelekile ayeshintshashintsha ngesikhathi sePleistocene. Usebenzisa igrafu nolwazi lwakho, yini okungenzeka ukuthi yenzeka kuma-woolly mammoth kanye nezinye izilwane ezinkulu ezikwazi ukumelana nokubanda eminyakeni eyi-10,000 edlule?
answer59: Ukufudumala kancane kancane kuhlangene nokuzingela ngokweqile kwabantu kwaba negalelo ekuqothulweni kwazo
distractor59a: Ukubhujiswa kwezindawo zokuhlala okubangelwa ukushintshashintsha kwezinga lokushisa kuphela kanye nokuzingela ngokweqile kubangele ukushabalala kwazo
distractor59b: Ukwanda okungazelelwe kwezinga lokushisa kanye nokuzingelwa ngokweqile ngabantu kwabangela ukuqothulwa kwazo
distractor59c: Ukwanda okungazelelwe kwezinga lokushisa kanye nokudla izilwane ezincelisayo ezinkulu kwabangela ukuqothulwa kwazo
question60: Bheka Umfanekiso 38.25. Ebusika, ama-lichen awukudla kuphela kwemihlambi yama-caribou e-tundra. Njengoba ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kwandisa amazinga okushisa, ama-lichen athathelwa indawo kancane kancane yizihlahla nezihlahla. Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono izinguquko ebuningini bama-caribou phakathi kuka-1975 no-1980?
answer60: Inani labantu base-caribou lehle ngemuva kokwehla kokutholakala kwe-lichen
distractor60a: Inani lama-caribou landa ngemva kokwehla kwenani lama-lichen
distractor60b: Ukwehla kwenani lama-caribou kanye nenani lama-lichen akuhlobene
distractor60c: Inani lama-caribou laqedwa lapho ama-lichen encipha
question61: Uchungechunge lokudla kwasolwandle lwase-Arctic luyi: Phytoplankton → Zooplankton → Arctic char/cod → Ringed seal → Polar bear. Uchungechunge lokudla lwase-Arctic lwase-Arctic luyi: Lichen/shrub → Caribou/hare/small rodent → Fox/lynx/bird of prey. Uma amabhere ase-polar ethuthela ezweni ngenxa yokulahlekelwa yiqhwa lolwandle, yini engaba umphumela omkhulu?
answer61: Amabhere ase-polar, njengoba eyizidlakudla ezihamba phambili, azonqoba abanye abathengi ngaphandle kokuthola amakhalori anele ngokwawo.
distractor61a: Amabhere ase-polar, njengoba engabathengi besibili, azodlula abanye abathengi ngaphandle kokuthola amakhalori anele ngokwawo.
distractor61b: Amabhere ase-polar, njengoba eyizidlakudla ezihamba phambili, azonqoba abakhiqizi ngaphandle kokuthola amakhalori anele ngokwawo
distractor61c: Amabhere ase-polar, njengoba engabathengi besibili, azodlula abakhiqizi ngaphandle kokuthola amakhalori anele ngokwawo.
question62: Bheka uMfanekiso 38.26. Igrafu ikhombisa inani lama-cod ase-Atlantic ngemuva kokufika kwemikhumbi emikhulu yokudoba efektri ngawo-1960. Yini okungenzeka ukuthi ichaza ukuwohloka kwenani lama-cod asenyakatho-ntshonalanga?
answer62: Ukudoba ngokweqile kwaholela ekuweni kwenani lama-cod
distractor62a: Isifo sasezindaweni ezishisayo sabulala inani lama-cod
distractor62c: Inani labantu be-cod limane lidlula umjikelezo walo ojwayelekile wabantu
question63: Bheka uMfanekiso 38.27. Amagrafu abonisa izinguquko enanini labantu kanye nezinga lokuphela. Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi ukwanda kwabantu kunganciphisa kanjani ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo?
answer63: Njengoba inani labantu landa, izidingo zomhlaba, amanzi, ukudla, kanye namandla ziyanda, okuholela ekubhujisweni kwezindawo zokuhlala.
distractor63a: Wonke umuntu owengeziwe uthatha indawo yohlobo oluhlukile lwesidalwa ngokuqondile
distractor63b: Abantu abaningi bahlala bekhulisa izinga lokushisa lomhlaba ngqo, okubangela ukulahleka kwezinhlobo
distractor63c: Ukwanda kwabantu kunciphisa kuphela inani lomhlaba otholakala kwezinye izinhlobo zezilwane
